comments: This was a comfortable and spacious place to stay for our family close to many gorgeous sites of Florence.  We walked everywhere without any problems.  The back garden itself was an unexpected shaded delight in the morning which, if we'd stayed longer, would have been a great place to share a bottle of wine.
very good apartmentand super quiet! the air condition is great and I can defintivively recommend the apartment! rita is a good host

Great journey! The host is very nice, the place is perfect for a short stay. Also you have to take a less than 10 minute-walk to see the cathedral and the historical heart of the town. I recommend without a doubt

Excellent location and apartment in Firenze! Good and helpful host. Would stay here again.

It did not bother our group, but I would note for others that the neighborhood can be noisy at night and the air conditioner limitations may require you to leave windows open.

Meeting up with Andrea was very easy, we just stopped in at his family restaurant and he was there to show us to the flat. The apartment was very clean, spacious, and had many modern amenities. Wifi was fast, lots of hot water (there was 5 of us), everything was great. It was the perfect location for exploring Florence with your family.

The apartment is MUCH better than the pictures, the location is perfect! We see all the important places from Florence walking just minutes...including two small kids.
Andrea and his parents are amazing, feel the family atmosphera .
The restaurant they have have the same high level as the apartment.
Next time we will be in Florence we will back to Andreas apartment guarantee.
Ben fatto Andrea, grazie mille di tutto e tanti saluti, a presto!

Apartment was in a great safe location and had an accurate description on AirBnb. Elevator was very convenient. Shower water pressure was excellent. Apartment was modern and felt very fresh and new. But the best part of our experience was Andrea. Andrea was a great host and very helpful in answering our questions. He was also responsible to returning text or emails. Upon arrival, the were some snacks and water left for us which was very nice. Also, Andrea's parents (Pino and Rita) who run the restaurant below apartment were wonderful. They treated us like family. We had dinner with them and the food was excellent. Not much left to say, other than we were very happy with our first Airbnb experience and we will be trying it again. As for Florence, it is a great walking city and this location is perfectly situated near the Ponte Vecchio bridge. We would like to thank Andrea and his family for making us feel comfortable.

Andrea was a great host.  He was kind and helpful, allowing us to leave our bags in the restaurant for a short while before the official check-in time.  The apartment was wonderful, exceeding expectations.  It was spotlessly clean, the kitchen was truly fully stocked, the beds were very comfortable, WiFi was completely reliable, and the location for touring Florence terrific.  Andrea had juice and milk and other basic items stocked for us which was very much appreciated.  After being in busy Florence we were so glad each day to come back to the quiet of the apartment.  We very much enjoyed the delicious meal in his family's restaurant downstairs.  Thank you, Andrea (and family) for a wonderful stay in Florence!

We loved our stay at the Barbadori guesthouse. It was very clean and bigger than it looks in the photos. We are a family of four and it suited us perfectly. the position is central and we walked to all the major sights no problem. Thanks Andrea

Beautiful, very clean and spacious apartment in perfect location right near Ponte Vecchio. Easy to get to, and very quiet despite being in the heart of all activity. Andrea was a great host and we had everything we needed. Highly recommended!

Well appointed 3 bedroom apartment ideally located next to Ponte Vecchio. Great location within easy walking distance of all main sights and within the Oltrano neighbourhood. Second floor apartment, down an arcade off the main thoroughfare. Andrea's family run a restaurant in the arcade which caters for gluten intolerant guests (also 10% discount for Airbnb guests). My wife had high praise for the gluten  free pizza (normally finds the bases pretty "cardboard like"). Small living area probably suits 4 person max. Good wifi reception kept the teenagers happy as did the second bathroom. Highly recommend. If coming from train station suggest take taxi (16 euros) as those cobblestones can be hard on your luggage and the footpaths are very narrow!
Great location in Florence.  Very clean and modern apartment with luxury bathrooms.  It was perfect for our short visit.  Thanks Andrea
Location, location, location! Super close to all you need in Florence!  The place was extremely spacious and clean for our family of 5. Very modern and new.  Would stay there again in a heart beat!
Would recommend staying at Andreas place! Great location in the city and can easily walk to any attraction. We loved our stay here and would absolutely come back. Plus the apartment is adorable!

Apartment was very well positioned and the rooms were exactly as expected. We only stayed there for 2 nights and were able to walk to all places. The building had a elevator. The only negative was that there was construction above the apartment, which started at about 8 am and lasted until 18:00.
Apartment was spacious and clean. Accommodated five adults easily and in a great part of town. Nights were quiet and Andrea was very helpful.

Andrea's place is just a minute away from ponte vachio. Everything is very close to the place. The house is comfortable for five people. It is sparklingly clean. Andrea response promptly for any issue. We could leave our luggage at the place well before check in. Though there is a lift we used it only to carry luggage. The staircase is good.

Super clean, spacious apartment, exactly as advertised. Andrea, kept in touch and  met us promptly and explained all we needed. I was grateful for milk,  coffee, juice and a few breakfast things as we arrived late at night. The location is amazing, very central and still quiet. We had a great stay.

Andrea's apartment was perfect for our 5-day stay in Firenze.  It was across the river, so quiet, but easy to access and still easily within walking distance from everything we wanted to do.  He was very communicative and even though check-in was at 5, since we arrived in town early, he offered to let us store our bags.  But, the apartment was ready, so we were thankfully actually able to check in early, get unpacked, and settled for our stay.  All rooms were very clean, updated, well-accommodated, and nicely laid out. Andrea left snacks, coffee, tea, and milk for our use if needed, which was appreciated.  The rooms were large with comfy beds and well air-conditioned, the bathrooms had everything you needed, and honestly, we couldn't ask for anything more.  A wonderful place to call home and we'd recommend it to anyone!

When visiting Florence, this is the place to stay. Everything went really smoothly with checkin. Andrea’s apartment is just as it is listed, clean, roomy, great location for tourists like us. He had some extras in the kitchen which we appreciated. He made it easy to store our luggage before and after we stayed in the apartment.
Added benefit is that Andrea’s restaurant is below the apartment. Good Italian food at reasonable prices.
Thanks Andrea for a wonderful stay in Florence with my family.

Great location, easy to get in and out of the building. The family restaurant on the first floor is a real plus. Andrea was very helpful when our arrival and departure plans changed. We had a nice stay!

Andrea is a very professional host, his flat is particularly clean, comfortable, and conveniently located.
I also recommend his restaurant "La Galleria Il Vino dei Guelfi" which serves typical dishes of the Tuscan region ; it was a really pleasant moment :)

Andrea’s apartment is located in an excellent spot for exploring Florence! It’s near one end of the Ponte Vecchio, which makes shopping and visiting the city attractions very easy.
Andrea met us downstairs when we arrived and held on to our bags until checkin. The showers had hot water and the A/C worked great. We didn’t use the kitchen other than to do some laundry, but it seemed stocked with what we would have needed for coffee and some meals. The beds were firm, but we made due because we were only here a short time.
Very good location. Andrea's Restaurant is superb and the cheesecake is delicious. The place is very comfortable and big.

Andrea’s place was exactly as the description. We loved our stay and he was easy to communicate and quicker to respond to any requests. Also His father is a lovely man. We wish we could have stayed longer. Next time in Florence we will definitely book with Andrea’s again and try his restaurant that we didn’t have time to try this time.

Andrea was very accommodating. The location of the apartment was fantastic. The space was updated and very clean. Coffee and a snack was provided. Andrea works downstairs at a restaurant. So he is available on site if needed. We loved our stay there. Very comfortable and quiet.

The rooms were spacious - and we loved the seating area!
Best of all - so clean!!

This was easily the nicest place we have stayed...Airbnb vs hotel; US vs Europe. The apartment had so many amenities and was spotlessly clean. The location was amazing, and it was steps from the Ponte Vecchio, restaurants, shops, etc. We loved the multiple bedrooms and bathrooms as well as the fully equipped kitchen and available laundry within the unit. Andrea was a very responsive host and met us at the apartment, helped us get our bags up to the apartment, and made sure we knew how to use everything in the apartment. He even left some coffee and food items to make our stay better. I cannot recommend this place enough and I will be keeping the information for a future visit. Thank you, Andrea, for making our trip to Florence the best of the entire trip!
We can confirm earlier comments about Pietro and the appartment: he has been very supportive and friendly and the appartment was very nice, clean and well decorated/furnished.

We stayed with our 4 kids for one week.  Perfect apartment in the center of Florence, only 10-15 minutes walking from the Dome. Everything was exactly as shown and described on the website. Pietro was always available by text messages within a couple of minutes. Highly recommended.

Perfect location, place, design, price and super clean. You're basically in the center at 5 mins walk from every major historic point.

Elisabetta is super, always connected and responsive, ready to help you anytime.

One of the best experiences I had on AirBnb, highly recommended!

We spent a fantastic days in Florence in September in the apartment of Claudia and Elisabetta, it is in the city center near every where, and it's very bright and spacious, and Claudia and Elisabetta take attention to detail and they were very kind to us and always answered very quickly. We loved the advices on nearby restaurants.
Definitely a place to recommend and where we'd go back
The apartment is beautiful , everything supplied that you need to make it feel like a home away from home , location was perfect

My parents spent 10 great days at Elisabetta and Claudia's apartment. It was well furbished. As tourists, they were very happy with location. It took them about 20 min by taxi to get to the apartment from the airport (and it took them a bit of time to figure out the right door bell), it was a short walk to any attraction and a walking distance to the train station.

Elisabetta and Claudia's listing was very nice! Lots of communication from them right away, they even have a little website with info and restaurant recommendations. Very fast responses as well when we asked a couple questions while in Florence.
Comfortable bed and pillows. Nice clean floors, new appliances. They also have a washer so we were able to pack light on our trip!
Absolutely perfect location, easy walk to everything, very central.

Ely and Claudia's apartment was a fantastic home from which to explore Florence. It's very spacious and clean, with a good kitchen and bathroom. Ely met us at the apartment and took great care to explain everything, including their favourite restaurants, cafes and bars, where the local supermarket was, where to go for a picnic, etc - they deserve the rank of Super Host without a doubt. If you come to Florence, don't hesitate in staying here.

Beautiful apartment, and the warmest hosts.  Elisabetta = what I love about airbnb abroad: a friendly welcoming face, happy to introduce you to the city she loves.  she was kind to walk me around the neighborhood, telling me stories about the places we passed.  she was also flexible when my flights got delayed, and kindly came to introduce me to the apartment at night when i arrived.  i was happy to meet her and florence, and i would love to stay at this apartment again!
Very enjoyable stay. Brilliant hosts, have great restaurant recommendations and stayed in touch throughout our stay. Would highly recommended staying here!

We stayed in florence for 5 nights to take our wedding photos so we needed a place close to everything and we cannot ask for a better location. Ely and Claudia were great host as well. The apartment is big enough to fit up to 4 people. Truly recommend this place.

Very nice apartment with everything you need, located in a very central location. Elisabetta was great, she gave us helpful information about restaurants, what to see and how to avoid the lines :) We recommend it.

Fantastic apartment in an amazingly central location. Elisabetta and Claudia were brilliant hosts. Very welcoming and had a folder with tips on local restaurants which was super handy. Wifi was great and the bed was comfortable with a fan above. Thank you for an enjoyable stay!

Lovely apartment in 5 minutes from santa maria del fiore. Big and clean apartment with proper kitchen where you can find everything that you could need. Friendly host met us there and answered all questions. That was awesome experience

We found the flat and the keys without any problems thanks to the recommandations Claudia and Elisabetta gave us. The place is really nice and perfectly located in the center of Firenze. In a calm street but close to everything you need to discover in this lovely city.
Thank you and ciao !!

This is a fantastic apartment in the middle of Florence. It's within walking distance to so many great sights and restaurants, yet it's still one of the quieter streets in the area. The apartment was spotless, had plenty of space for 2 people, and all of the amenities worked flawlessly (including the wifi).
Claudia was a wonderful host - she provided us with very clear instructions on how to get to the apartment, and then met us there for check in to show us around and help us get situated. We were also given a map with some suggested places to visit, as well as a lot of great restaurant recommendations which helped make our trip fantastic.
I would gladly recommend this place to anyone visiting Florence!
Very centrally located and LARGE apartment with high ceilings.  Close to everything without the noise of the larger streets. Well outfitted, and excellent communication from the hosts.

Stayed a week in Florence, Italy. The apartment location was in the cent of Florence, which was very convenient. Every Iconic museums, Ponte Vecchio, farmers market, restaurants and shopping cent with in 10 to 15 minutes walking distant. I love staying at this apartment but one thing that was very hard for me was it's at 4th floor. So just be aware of that. In the future I would defiantly stay again at this apartment. Happy travels.

This was a great stay! Cute little flat in the center of the city, about a ten minute walk from most popular attractions in Florence.
Instructions on how to get in were clear and pictures were provided.

Great location! Clean and tidy apartment. Although we didn't meet Federico himself we had an easy check in and out. Air -con only really worked in the bedroom, (was really loud at night) we ended up moving the sofa couch into the bedroom as it was just to hot in the lounge. The internet wi-fi didn't really work for us in the apartment.

We enjoyed very much the stay in Castellani appartment. Perfect location and everything  was exactly  as shown on the pics. The air conditioning was a bit loud in the night and there was small problem with shower . But in general everything  was great. It is very lovely apartment  and I would highly recommend  to everyone
The location of the apartment is amazing, quite convenient, quite and clean. The apartment is cozy and comfortable, we would like to recommend it!
Good location. Host tried to get us to pay more attention than was advertised and expected tips. I have never been asked to pay tip at airbnb or even hotel where an actual service is provided.

We were given three towels for three people for three nights.  It's warm in Florence in late May.  People have to shower daily.  It would have been nice to have more than one towel per person/per night.  It was also quite a noisy place, but we expected that, considering the GREAT location, so near the Piazza Signoria and other FABULOUS tourist sites.  Lastly, we tried to use the air-condition unit, but it didn't work.  Luckily, it wasn't roasting, just warm, during our stay.

This is a perfectly located apartment. It is perfect for 3 people (e.g. Couple and one child). Everything is walking distance in Florence, and this apartment is located in the middle. Great price/quality ratio.

Federicos apartment couldn't be in a better spot! It was so central to absolutely everything. He communicated great in the lead up and during our stay. We arrived early to florence train station - before we were able to check in and he suggested to leave our luggage at the train station luggage area which was a great tip!
Only issue was the wifi stopped working for the last two nights - which was a little inconvenient when planning travels. Other than that couldn't fault the apartment or Federico.
Booked this place for my parents and my sister. They had a great stay. They said everything was close by including restaurants, place was clean and you don’t need to get transport anywhere.
Convenient location, cozy place. Bed (which is just two twin thin mattresses pushed together) is a little stiff, but still a very nice spot.
Niccolo’s place is awesome. The location is unbeatable, close to everything you will visit in Florence. Niccolo is very responsive, kind, and helpful. I definitely recommend his place.

We really liked the location of the flat with access to several historical sites within walking distance. Niccolò welcomed us personally and explained in detail the apartment to us. The apartment is safe and very clean. The building has a small elevator that was great to bring our luggages up and down.
Very responsive host and we appreciate his check-ins messages to make sure all was going well during our stay!
Niccolo was lovely, place couldn’t of been in a better location, woukd definitely return.
The location of the flat was perfect - just round the corner of the Uffizi, and Ponte Vecchio.  Federico was very helpful, and our stay was perfect.
Great location as accessible to the central town, a little noisy at night. Air conditioning was great lovely to have a washing machine to clean clothes in. Overall pleasant stay, WiFi was great.
Good place it was great for my stay during the weekend, easy to find and directly in the city center close to everything

This apartment is a little tiny but it's clean and  you find there everything you need. The location is great: walking distance to the train station, restaurants and supermarkets are close. The host is flexible in check-out if it's possible. highly recommend!
The place is located in the best part of town you can ever get. Really clean, quite and still in the middle of everything. Best place to stay in Florence.

The apartment is very great and well located. The host was always helpful.

Thank you again!!

Brenda E Matteo were incredibly accommodating at the last minute. Brenda even took my suitcase up the stairs in their building to help me. Their map and little notes were perfect for figuring out my way around the city. Thank you two for everything!

Very easy check in! Also got help with my bags up the stairs which was a life saver as it was very hot in florence. The room stayed reasonably cool with the fan and window open. Nice kitchen and bathrooms. We were very happy with our stay.

The apartment was nice and well equiped. It was only a short walk to the centre of town and close to the train station. The room was large and comfortable and two bathrooms in the apartment made life easier. The apartment was regularly cleaned. We would recommend this apartment for those wanting to visit Florence.
Great place to stay, it was so nice being in the middle of Florence. Everything was so close

The air bnb worked out perfectly for our trip to Florence! The room was comfortable and the bathroom and kitchen were very clean. Nice location not too far from most of the major attractions. Thank you!

I had a pleasant stay here. The location is good, just a few minutes walk from the station and Firenze's main attractions: Il duomo, ponte vecchio, museums, etc.. The apartment is very spacious and clean. The kitchen was great with a big table, big fridge and even jams, butter, biscotti, cakes, oil, vinegar, etc.. We stayed in room 3 which I found perfect: spacious, clean, comfortable bed. I had a good night sleep all 3 nights. The other guests were quiet and respectful. The only thing is the wifi is very slow and one day there was no toilet rolls in both bathrooms but it was topped up in the evening. I reccomend this apartment, Klara was very nice.

My cousin and I stayed here for 3 nights, we walked everywhere. About 15 minutes from the center and 10 from train station. The room and bathroom were clean. Only complaint is that the water sometimes didn't work.

We really enjoyed our stay at M&B’s place. They were really friendly, lovely hosts who gave some great recommendations. We’d definitely stay again here however the only problem was that the lock on the apartment door was very temperamental and the shower was very weak at some points. Despite this we had a lovely stay and it was in a great location very close to the train station and supermarkets!
Warm and friendly host, she baked me an apple pie, usefull information, clean space, like it!

A lovely, comfortable and stylish guest house with great amenities, good coffee, well-equipped kitchen and a great location.  Check in was very easy and we were given great tips for good restaurants and places to visit.  A wonderful stay

M&B Florence was the perfect stay! It was a short walk to the station and the streets weren't as crowded.
Lots of good restaurants nearby! Close to all the attractions, we walked everywhere.
Excellent communication with the Host. Very kind and provided excellent recommendations.
One thing to note is that the bnb is located on the third floor (2nd in florence) and there is no elevator. We ofcourse did not mind at all but definitely something to keep in mind for those who would care. :)
10/10

The location is close to Santa Maria Novella station and 20 mins walk from the attractions.
The room was nice and comfortable.
There are 4 rooms in the house and 2 shared toilets.
Overall we spent a comfortable 2 days in Florence.
This place is near the main station which is a great place to be if you’re traveling near Florence

First time I have enconter such a cozy and comfortable conditions. There was absoulutly nothing you want and could not find during daily live in this appartment. Even if you forget to buy something to eat you would not stay hungry at this home. Free cookies, pies, unlimited coffee and tea, sweets and etc. I am very satisfied. Thank you very much.
The host is so friendly, easy to contact, near tram/bus stations. Place is same like the discriptions.

Matteo is one of the best hosts I’ve come across; the listing is super comfortable and just as shown. Was very warm and comfortable in Jan when it was freezing outside. The kitchen and place is kept beautifully and you do see his moms cake if you’re lucky :)
He also went out of the way to get me a taxi at midnight and was responsive throughout. Absolutely recommend.

We stay 3 days with my girlfriend and hoped we would stayed more! It was just perfect, very close to downtown (you can walk anywhere from there) and Michele was so nice and attentive. Nothing that I would change about it.
We are going back for sure !!

Primula Apartment exudes hospitality, Deanne is an excellant host, wealth of knowledge. You could spend all day on the terrace and we did once or twice, the  changing light and little swallows flying by, make it a very special place to watch, read, eat, photograph, anything goes really. Cool location with friendly locals. Made Firenze a place we all fell in love with. Tiffany ,Keenan & Hunter:)

We love firenze but also more about your apartment. It’s stylish and cozy enough. Good location since there are a lot of restaurants around and some historical attractions. We found a beatitudine city but also interesting people. Highly recommended this apartment!
很漂亮的复古罗马式公寓，公寓里面远远比图片要大很多。附近就是一个景点，很安全，位置很好

Diana was a wonderful hostess. The apartment was beautiful, a real Tuscan gem! My favourite moments were on the balcony listening to the bells of all the historic churches in Florence toll. It was a truly beautiful spot, centrally located and  easy to find. Diana was available and happy to help when we had questions. Her restaurant recommendations were some of our favourite meals on the trip. Highly recommend.

This apartment is so lovely and full of character.  I’m grateful we were able to book Diana’s place for our stay in Florence.  Location is wonderful;  a close walk to everything we wanted to get to.  Our family of four loved sitting out on the balcony at night and taking in the stunning sites...  it’s really breathtaking to have the St.  Croce church right behind you!   Laundry is accessible and easy to use.  There are a few sets of stairs in the apartment so just keep that in mind If you are traveling with  anyone who is not good with stairs.  I would  definitely  stay at this lovely apartment again!

The location was perfect and so close to everything!
Diana was extremely helpful and responded to our requests quickly!
We have a wonderful time there.

We loved our stay here. The beautiful terrace is worth it alone but we loved the rest of the living space as well. Great location in a great neighborhood. Diana was a wonderful host who was so helpful with all our questions. 10/10 would recommend.
Apartment was cosy and as described. Great value for money. Thank you! I recommend visiting the location in spring or autumn when the weather is optimal.
The layout of this place is very cool and is a great location! Loved the balcony and the views it offered. Wish we stayed longer!

Beautiful apartment with lovely decorations and interior. Terrace was amazing and we enjoyed sitting out there all the time. Diana and Daniela were extremely helpful and friendly. Only challenges were the loud restaurant in the courtyard below the bedroom windows and the hungry mosquitoes.
That is a wonderful experience to stay in this wonderful apartment in Florence. Recommend big families and group of friends to stay.

The apartment was very large for our family.  Very clean.  The check in was easy and the gentleman was helpful and pleasant.  The location near Santa Croce Square was ideal.  Convenient to restaurants and sites.

Great location in the center of Firenze.
However, the appartment looks older than the photos and is not well adapated for the number of hosts if you plan to eat there. The kitchen and dining room are quite small, at least for a large family.

Fine. Worked for our large group of 9, but it wasn’t as nice as pictured in the post. The AC didn’t work in one of the rooms but the host was quick to respond and fix. Bathrooms were ok. Felt like things weren’t in the best condition (breaking/about to break). That being said, it was in a great location and the host was very responsive to all requests and questions. Wouldn’t recommend staying here with a small group (find somewhere nicer) but not a bad spot for a big group like ours.
Stayed at the villa for a week for my 40th birthday. The villa is well located and near to the bus stop, which takes you into central florence. Had a lovely time and lorenzo was a great help.

Lorenzo and Mario are some of the most helpful and kindest hosts you’ll meet. They offered help and information as needed, and went above and beyond. The Villa is a perfect place to have a relaxing time around Florence. It’s historic, spacious, and close enough to the city to take the bus or a taxi for activities in town. It’s also far enough away to feel like you’re in the countryside, and it’s so tranquil. Our favorite part of the Villa was the beautiful views and yard. We hope to return someday, and highly recommend!

Great view of Firenze. Big, spacious home with lots of room to spread out and have privacy. Pool with view was fantastic, especially in the hot temps. A/C in each bedroom. Bus route gets you into town. Bus was sometimes difficult with so many delays and heavy traffic. We frequently took taxis which must be reserved over the phone or the app.
Lorenzo and his crew- Mario and Andrea made sure everything was taken care of for excursions, groceries, reservations and more. They provided top notch service.
Be sure to go on the rooftop!
Thank you, Lorenzo, for your hospitality.

An amazing villa for our family trip of 9. Plenty of space for everyone. The bus stop is easily accessible. Taxis are easy to get back to the villa but can be challenging to get picked up. Sometimes required numerous attempts. Had enough room for everyone and everyone was comfortable. We went in July and it was hot! All of the rooms have AC but the main living areas do not - the pool helped tremendously to beat the heat. Great place that I would recommend close enough to the city yet private, quiet and beautiful

This apartment is AWESOME! Family of 5 (inc 3 teenagers) fitted easily. Rooftop terraces are simply wonderful. Worth the 81 steps needed to be climbed to reach the unit. Quality of fittings etc. is very good. We stayed for 3 nights. Wish it was 300! Position of unit is perfect. 5-10 minute stroll to everything.

Four of us stayed at the Antonino 3b in May of 2016 and had a wonderful time. Christine was incredibly accessible and pleasant to deal with - she even helped find and deliver a birthday cake from a local bakery for a surprise birthday celebration. The apartment was clean, comfortable and modern. The kitchen and common areas are wonderful and we spent several evenings enjoying the roof decks watching the sunset. You feel that you're in the center of Florence with many of the top landmarks incredibly accessible. We didn't have a car in Florence and didn't feel like we missed out on anything. Just be aware that the apartment is on the top floor and with no elevator in the building, it's quite a few stairs to carry everything up and down. Also, if you're new to Florence or Italy, mosquitos can be prevalent and a nuisance - keep that in mind when leaving windows open or enjoying the balconies.

This apartment is so beautiful! It is very modern. Right in the heart of the city. The views are spectacular. We were traveling with 4 adults and 2 small children. There is lots of space. I will say this apartment is not the most baby friendly. We had to be very careful with the babies to not crawl around upstairs. BUT, I think that is probably clearly shown in the photos. I really loved the place. Check in was very easy and I would love to stay here again!

Avoid the crowds and enjoy Florence from the rooftops. The pictures and description of this place is spot on and we had an excellent time. The views from the two balconies were amazing, and we were centrally located to everything we needed. It is a short walk from the train/bus station, two blocks from duomo, located near several restaurants, and in the evening the bustle from below ceased and it was quiet. I would stay here again for sure. Enjoy!

This is a lovely place and the views are exactly as they look in the pictures. It feels more like a hotel than a private residence, which some people may like, but lacks the personal feel. It would be great for a family group, as there is ample space. Great location.

This apartment was amazing, once you get up the 4 flights of stairs. The views are phenomenal, the space is clean and perfect for a small family or group of friends. The showers were very clean, but small as they usually are in Europe. It is located perfectly close to train station and the Duomo (my favorite place in the world).

We stayed in Thomas' Florence flat for 4 nights during our recent trip to Europe.  It looks just like it does in the photos.  It's beautifully decorated and centrally located, close to many of the significant museums and landmarks in Florence, as well as one of the best gelato shops, Perche No.  My husband, myself, and two sons were very comfortable in the apartment and would definitely recommend it for your next vacation.

Ideal location, close to all major places and yet in calm street.  The living room is spacious and nicely decorated.  The kitchen has all appliances.  We definitely recommend Thomas' apartment as a place to enjoy Florence and surroundings.

We arrived late and were met by a friend of Thomas who kindly waited for us and showed us how everything worked. The apartment was clean and was very much like the photos and descriptions. It is in a great location to see all that Florence city has to offer. We loved that we could have breakfast everyday in a nearby Square and that there are plenty of good small restaurants all around. All he major churches, galleries and markets are within easy walking distance. The street itself is also typical old Florence. Great area

We had a wonderful stay and Thomas really helped us feel like locals. He was kind enough to check up on us to make sure we arrived properly and was helpful whenever we needed him. In fact, we even had a bit of a strange issue with the washing machine but Thomas was quick to help us resolve that matter as well. On our future trips to Florence we now know where to call home. I highly recommend this central loft in the heart of the city where everything is a quick walk away.

Thomas was a great host! We were able to get into the loft right away and it was a great space. The location was perfect and allowed us to see almost everything within a walking distance. Lastly, Thomas was helpful in helping us book a taxi as we headed to the airport. I would recommend this place.

An excellent apartment in a great location perfect for exploring the with all the major sites within 10 minutes walk. Everything was clean and well presented with all the amenities you could need, perfect for unwinding after a long day exploring Florence . Thomas was a great host quick to respond and even accommodated our early arrival. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to explore this great city!

Excellent spot! Right in the 1st floor so very convenient if you have lots of luggage. The location is excellent, walked everywhere even to the Fiorentina Futbol Stadium to watch a game! The Duomo is like a 5 minute walk and the main train station about a 17 min walk. There is a couple of clubs on the same street so it can get a little loud at night with people walking by but its not terrible. Florence is a small city and very populated with tourists so I'm sure you have to expect that wherever you stay really. I would definitely recommend this place and Thomas is a superb host!

Thomas was always forthcoming by allowing us to book in earlier and check out little later. Our apartment was very well located and had everything we need to make our stay comfortable. Very good cupboard space, because don't like living out of a suitcase.
In short a very pleasant stay and would recommend to anyone visiting Florence.
The location is perfect it’s a short walk anywhere in city center. The apartment was great for my stay.
This place was great! Elisabetta was very helpful and even greeted us with a bottle of wine and homemade food. I would definitely stay here again and would recommend my friends as well.

We had a wonderful stay. Very well-located - near the Santa Croche Duomo. The apartment is bigger than it looks in the pictures and felt happy and lived-in. The apartment didn't seem to have AC/fans (or maybe we just missed it) but was very cool and we were very comfortable. The kids loved the spiral staircases (one of our guests was elderly and took the ground floor room). We were greeted with a bottle of Prosecco and some fresh fruits. Quality restaurants nearby. All-in-all - very recommended.

Absolutely fantastic. The property is gorgeous and centrally located and every major location including the Uffizi gallery is within walkable distance. Elisabetta met us with a bottle of wine and walked us through the details. She had everything organized with a full binder of places to eat, things to do, etc. It had all the essentials with a brand new kitchen, beautiful furniture, a nice library; just great overall.
Given that we were there in the middle of summer, the lack of air conditioning made the place quite hot but one message to Elisabetta late in the evening and she got us brand new floor fans first thing in the morning.
We enjoyed our stay and will certainly stay at this place if we visit Florence again.
Spectacular palace, thanks Elisabetta for sharing your home with us! From booking to leaving everything was smooth and we are looking forward to visiting again!
Perfect place for discovering the Renaissance in Florence, very beautifull setting, very central Location, well equipped and very helpful host!
Elisabetta was super helpful and accommodating. The place is beautiful, very clean, and a one-of-a-kind experience. We didn't want to leave!

This is a really stunning property in central Florence. It's a very unique experience to stay here.
Property is ideal for older families. The ground floor bedroom and en suite is stunning. Upstairs , you have 2 big double rooms with a 3rd floor twin room above 1 of the doubles
Only 2 watchouts
1) the 3rd floor twin room is better for older children as walls are not so high.
2) The spiral staircase is beautiful but may not be suitable for older people (although there is lift access if needed)
Elisabetta is a great host. Gives very useful tips and very friendly
If you do chose this property, make sure you get addresses for best parking places as unloading and parking is not so easy in such a central location
The Location is superb for exploring Florence

The location is excellent, as it is right next to the amazing Santa Croce basilica and within easy walking distance of most other attractions in Florence. The apartment itself was great and met all our needs. Elisabetta made it a very easy process.

Our 4 kids all voted The Renaissance Palace as their favorite accommodation during our tour of Italy. It was really hot so AC was greatly appreciated. The location was perfect for walking everywhere but was nice to be on a quieter street. All the recommendations from the hosts were spot on, and communication. was fantastic and prompt. We can’t wait to return to Florence and stay here again.

Tornabuoni Apartment is perfectly located even although Florence is a small town, it is very nice to reach every place just in 5-10 min walk. Federico was very nice in welcoming us and tried to meet all our needs. The apartment is equipped with everything needed. There was not much sun these days and thus it was a bit dark in the apartment but nonetheless we had a very pleasant stay in Florence at Tornabuoni apartment.

The place was just as described. The host was very easy to communicate with. Location is fantastic and is quick wall to the train station which was really nice for arrival and departure. We felt like this place was within 5 blocks of everywhere we wanted to be. We loved it.

This was our first air bnb experience and very positive.  The apartment was in a fantastic location and very close to all the sights and there are some great restaurants / bars on the doorstep.  The apartment was incredibly spacious and I'd highly recommend.  Federico was a helpful host with providing restaurant recommendations and taxi numbers - he was also prompt with communicating

Amazing apartment in the best location, historical building, well-equipped. Near to every attraction in Florence. Federico welcomed us, we didnt have any problem during our stay. I definitely recommend this apartment
We LOVED this apartment! We didn't want to leave! Very cool space with eclectic style. It was very spacious, very nice bathroom, and in a great location by all the high end shopping.

The apartment was very good and extremely well located; we were able to visit everything by foot. It was very big, and matched perfectly the description that was made, although it was a bit darker than expected, especially at night (not much lighting). The man we met for the keys was reachable and on time (but it was not Federico, one of his associate). The apartment was very clean also. Very good experience overall and I recommend it!!

Apartment is in a great location and is very comfortable. Only a few minutes walk to Duomo, Accademia and Uffuzi, so it is easy to explore the city and return to rest or change for dinner. Wonderful coffee shop across the street for morning cappuccino.

Perfect location. Spacious apartment near wonderful cafes, shops and sites. We enjoyed our stay here very much and would absolutely return! Susanna gave us a gracious welcome with great recommendations.
Great location, photos as they appear, no complaints. Really clean when we arrived, no problem with the man our host asked to let us in

My bf and I moved to Florence for good, and we stayed at Federico's place for a month while looking for a longterm apartment. The location is perfect, it's close to everywhere. 8 minutes from the train station. A few steps from via Tornabuoni and Palazzo Strozzi. The apartment is in a beautiful palace, very spacious. Big living room, big kitchen and dining area. The bedroom is very quiet, because it's at the inside part of the apartment facing the terrace. The mattress is quite soft, some people may prefer the hard ones. The terrace is big but no much sun comes in because it's surrounded by buildings. Over all we had a great time staying there!
Beautiful space in a great central location. I wish I could live here! The washer was a bit confusing to use but otherwise we had a great stay. Arrival instructions were very clear.

Nice place to stay! Great location near shopping, the sites, and the Arno.
Bring your own toilet paper though!
the place was spacious, clean and well equipped. we especially loved the bakery next door, and everything was walking distance.
We had another great stay at this apartment. The location is the absolute best and would happily stay here again!
Fantastic location near to everything. For the price you pay for it , the amenities should be maintain better.

Amazing big place that’s great value. Best location too. We stayed for three weeks, so it would have been great to have a spare set of sheets and towels since we only got one of each, but Frederico did bring us more towels within 24 hrs of asking which was really great. Air conditioning in the apartment was very good and highly reliable, even in a heat wave. You also need to buy your own detergent for the washing machine & bags for the trash can as it doesn’t seem to be provided, but we stayed a while so that wasn’t a big issue. They were building an Elevator during our stay which was a little noisy in the mornings, but they were finishing it on our last few days so now there is an elevator! I will be recommending this place to everyone I know, overall it was a wonderful stay.

One of the most beautiful appartments I have stayed in on Air BnB, old wooden floors, heigh coffered ceilings. Wooden shutters on all windows, Le Corbusier lounge chair. It's even larger then it looks like in the photos.
Tha location was perfect.Christina was very helpful and the whole experience was really good.Wi-fi was poor.
A good place very close to the center of Florence. It is noisy, so earplugs a strongly recommended. Lots of things very close by.
Perfect place to stay, extremely central and everything is within walking distance. It's also a very nice studio with everything you need, would definitely book again.

Perfect location. Nearby attractions, shops and restaurants. Near the central station. Apartment on the 2nd floor - lifn is not needed. The apartment had everything necessary for a good accommodation. Recommend!
Great location, walkable to everything. Had everything that was needed. Note that it is centrally located and on a very busy street. Walls are very thin and it is extremely noisy at night.

Gessjca and Luca’s place in Florence was perfect! Very cute and well-appointed, and has the perfect location (less than 5 minutes from the Duomo). As other reviewers mentioned, the central location means that the street outside is busy/noisy. However, we didn’t notice this to be a problem at night (maybe more so if you’re trying to take a nap during the day but even then, would be fine with ear plugs). Also the AC worked well and didn’t cause any strange smells! Definitely recommend.

Beautiful room with a really amazing location. Had a slight issue with the shower but the hosts were very responsive and accommodating. The space was very nice and the location was unbeatable - halfway (2 blocks each) between the duomo and the palace.

Absolutely loved this place!! It was perfect for an August honeymoon in Italy. A walking distance to literally everything. Near so much good food(especially the place across the street). I have already recommended it verbally to so many people. Would wholeheartedly recommend this place. Host was excellent. Washer worked great. Air conditioning was perfect. Bed was comfortable. And lastly, everything was clean. Would 1000% recommend!
Very central place for a short visit to Venice. Bit noisy at night, but that’s because you’re in the middle of everything.

The apartment was as avertised, it is ok located, especially if you want to move around the region because it is not in the centre and the parking space is easy to use.
Evertything worked fine in the apartment.
Marco was not around to help us with the check in but he sent a friend of his to help us with the check in and she was very nice.

Massimo’s place is as described in the description text. The Porta al Prato tram station is only 600 meters away. The next tram station is the Central railway station, which is the beginning of the centre. Massimo’s place is equipped with all the necessary items you could require during your stay. Massimo’s friend was very helpful and gave us plenty of information on the historic sites and restaurants. I have no hesitation in recommending this place to anyone.

Maximo was very welcoming and helpful with lots of information on Florence, thank you! His apartment is a "home", very nicely decorated with a good sized bedroom and a comfortable double bed, a large lounge/kitchen area with a sofa bed and a massive TV. The lovely balcony have views of the city and the hills beyond, nearby is the very recently build opera house, a modern building within the almost deactivated train station. The place is very quiet, the building is modern and build with quality, truly useful is the underground garage where our rental car was parked securely and away from the August heat. We walked to the centre of Florence, it takes about 20 minutes to main area, it's a stroll that we done along the river. We truly enjoyed our stay!
Stylish apartment in Florence just a short walk from the main attractions of the historic centre. Massimo made us feel very welcome in his place. Would recommend to anyone

Massimo's place was very nice and comfortable. He had one of his friends meet us at the apartment who was very helpful when we go lost on our way in. He recommended some fantastic restaurant.  The location was perfect for us and not far from the downtown. I would for sure stay here again.

Beautiful appartment as Massimo accurately described it. it is fully equipped, decorated with taste, just like the city.
Perfect for a couple.
Massimo welcomed us warmly, taking time not only to describe the appartment but also to give us tips about the neighboorhood.
You reach the city center walking around 15min. We recommend. Thank you Massimo !

Massimo was a very friendly host, meeting upon arrival and giving us all the required information plus local tips. The apartment had car parking, all the amenities we needed and was a short walk to the historical centre of Florence. It was also a clean and stylish apartment plus had the added benefit of being in a quiet area. Highly recommend staying here!

Massimo’s house location is too close to the city center in a quiet neighborhood! Also we came by car and he has a very convenience parking to leave the car and visit all the sights by foot! The house is comfort and very clean! He also told us and some local tips !
I totally recommend it we enjoyed our stay!

We stayed in the property for 7 days and the apartment is a home away from home! I would have forgotten that I was in a rented apartment!
The apartment is sparkling clean and is furnished with personal touches. It is also fully equip with all amenities and more. There’s an elevator so there’s no need to carry our heavy luggage up the stairs!
We based ourselves in Florence and made day trips south to the old town in Tuscany. The garage at the apartment is very useful for those who rent a car.
The location is about 20 mins walk to the old town which is lovely anyway.
Thanks Massimo for the apartment!

We had a lovely stay in Massimo's appartment. Massimo is a very friendly host. Comfortable, spacious appartment with all necessary facilities.
20 minute walk from the city centre. Bus stop close by. We would recommend.

Massimo is great host with great apartment. The place is even better then on the pictures and location is perfect. You are just 10min walking distance from the old town with quiet neighborhood. Free parking under the building is important if you travel by car as finding parking place can be hard. Big big thanks to Massimo for letting us stay in his apartment and giving us tips about sightseens and restaurants in Florence. When we go back to Florence we will definitely like to stay in Massimo’s apartment again
I couldn’t recommend Massimo’s place more - the apartment itself is fantastic and in a great location, while Massimo is a great host who was very accommodating with our check in time

Elly's apartment was first class.  It was highly recommended by our friends and we would definitely recommend it as well.  It was a very stylish apartment with everything you would need to make your stay comfortable.  We are a family of 5 and we would definitely stay again.
This place is amazing! Everything was just perfect and I would definitely recommend it to everyone. Thank's a lot, Ellen!

This Flat is fantastic! You have everything you need (hairdryer, dishwasher, toaster, wifi, washer...) ! The décoration is very Nice and the location perfect ! We were a family of five in it, and it was great !
Be very careful with the parking ! We should be Warned since the beginning...you have a ticket if you are not resident... If you Wait for the keys go park you car at the international parking 50 meters after the apartment. You would be able to come back and forth as you want during your stay, it's safe but not free.

Nice apt but we found it a little cramped for 5 people. The bathroom ceiling leaked during our stay and there was a minor ant situation in the living room/kitchen.  The bed linen provided for the pull out sofa was worn out and uncomfortable to lie on. The apt is centrally located and close to almost everything. We did not find the stairs a problem.
Elly was a most welcoming host.  She explained how everything worked, took her time, and was readily available by phone during our stay.  She has the most beautiful smile!!
Elly made us feel welcome. She met us promptly and was very helpful with explaining everything in the apartment and the neighborhood.
Elly made us feel completely welcome and was very quick to respond with any questions I had.

Amazing location--less than 10 minutes on foot to center area.
House was very clean and sweet--there are three air conditioners and comfortable beds.
And in the kitchen you have everything you need from wine glasses to pots.
The host was also very kind and flexible--out train got delayed more than 30 mins but she was very understanding.
She even gave us a bottle of wine as a welcoming gift.
One of the best apartments we have been to.
Totally recommend this place!
The apartment is great! As is on the pictures, very well located and Elly is a great host!

Very pretty spacious place to stay and handy to get to wonderful sights. Well appointed and a nice welcome.
The only downside was noise.

Great place with perfect location. Rooms were of a good size and the beds slept really well. Little bit of noise at night from a bar located nearby. Other than that perfect place and I would definitly recommend staying here!

Wonderful hospitality!  Clean & perfect location to explore Florence.  Listing was exactly as described.  Wonderful restaurants, grocery, shops, & gelato all within a short 5 minute walk!  Perfect place for our family of 5 to explore Florence!

Perfect location close to the train station and everything in Florence.  The apartment had everything we needed to make meals, very comfortable with great air conditioning, and plenty of space.  Everything was as listed.  Elly was very informative and responsive.

DO NOT BOOK
This place is infested with mosquitoes
we had to kill 20+ mosquitoes in first night alone.
also bed is very uncomfortable and couch surface is uneven

The location was superb, with easy access to both popular tourist sites and hidden gems. St. Mark’s Square, Rialto Bridge, and countless delightful restaurants and cafes were all within walking distance. We truly felt like we were living like locals.

It was great place to stay, my family members enjoying the beautiful places surroundings. Elly very helpful for some of our inquiries. Best restaurant recommendations just same building & by the entrance of the apartment.

Matilda was there to meet us as promised - the apartment is very stylish, as in the description. Very secure, well equipped.
Great position - close to centre and close to train station. Good supermarket about 10 mins walk. Fabulous restaurant Gargar in next street.
Loved it and would stay again. Thank you.

We enjoyed staying at Matilda's apartment. It made us feel as though we lived in the heart of Florence.

Matilda is a nice host. She waited for us on the first day and ordered taxis for us on our final day.

We were very centrally located and walking distance from the train. The apt was comfortable, clean, quiet and well equipped. The only thing we didn't realize was the second shower is on the first floor.

Beautifully furnished apartment in a quiet location with everything you need. Comfortable beds, big windows with lot's of natural light looking across to the hills of Florence. Matilda was very friendly and helpful and we will back! Ps. Newly opened pizza restaurant downstairs was delicious!!

Matilda was a very sweet lady who greeted us at the time we arranged. She toured us around the house and made sure we knew everything before she left. We had a slight problem understanding the WIFI and call
ed her and she helped us immediately. Great host!!

A few words can describe this apartment and its ambiance in the historic part of gorgeous Firenze !!!!
Thank u for the stay Matilda

The apartment was gorgeous! It was spacious and Super near The Central market and train station. Lots of cafes and restaurants near it as well. The view from the rooms was stunning! Matilda was extremely accommodating as she came back the following day after we checked in to help fix the heating temperature upon my request. Thanks Matilda for the hospitality and we really enjoyed our stay in ur beautiful place!

This apt is the highlight of our time in Florence! Absolutely beautiful! Everything was exactly like what you see in the pictures. Rooms are spacious and beautiful, beds are comfy, kitchen is well equipped, very well maintained and spotless, and not to mention the view from the window. Matilda was very accommodative, she was waiting standing in front of the door when we arrived. And she explained the necessaries about and around the apt too. Just a little note, the door at bathroom downstairs doesn't have a lock. So when I shower I sometimes concern about others opening the door accidentally. But other than that, our stay was perfect! And oh, the restaurant next door serve the best pizza ever and people actually queue there. You should try!

Perfect apartment, very good location and very helpful reception.
Matilda was always there to answer my questions.

What a great space for our family to stay in Florence. The heat was a little high when we arrived, but Matilda was able to visit the following day to make adjustments. Plenty of space for a decently sized group. We enjoyed a family dinner in the dining room and enjoying nearby restaurants. A quick call for a taxi and the car was waiting by the time we descended to the ground level - very convenient. The beds were a little tougher than our memory foam at home, but we're spoiled. Thanks for a great stay, Matilda!

Stunning apartment in a fabulous location to all of Florence's sights, restaurants and nightlife.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and found Matilda to be very accommodating and friendly.

Matilda was a great host.  She met us herself at check-in and showed us how things in the apartment worked.  The apartment was so pretty,  exactly as in the pictures.  Matilda was very helpful,  willing to go the extra mile when we encountered a problem (not related to the apartment).  Thanks Matilda!

This is a truly exceptional location and a superb host! The accommodations are luxerious and the home is quiet and spacious for our family of 6. Matilda went out of her way to welcome us, providing a map (don't rely on google maps to find the house number, look at her map) and recommendations for local restaurants. We loved the champaign and Panettone she kindly gave us!

If you are looking for a great apartment that is within walking distance to great restaurants - I mean great - and all the sites to see in Florence this is your place. The apartment is in great shape and comfortable for up to 6 people.  I can’t really say enough about the entire experience. Matilda was a great host and we would recommend this place to anyone visiting Florence
Excellent place, great location, very modern, plenty of space, very accurate pictures and descriptions.  Host is outstanding.  Very enjoyable.

Very good location and nice flat in Florence down town. 10 minutes away from the train station and shuffle from the airport! however if you need 3 beds or more, be aware that there are only 2 real bedrooms and 2 real bed (the other ones are sofas right above the living room and very uncomfortable)
The apartment was spacious, super near the city centre and Firenze's main locations and Matilda was an superb host (quick responses, on time in checking in).

Great location, wonderful views and very convenient to get over to San Marco.  Hostess was there to greet us and very helpful, answering questions about how to get around in Venice.  Quiet neighborhood, lovely apartment.
Great apartment, very clean, in an excellent location, very responsive host - we had a nice time

Matilda’s apartment was amazing for our quick stay in Florence. It was our first time visiting and the location is great and within walking distance to all the major sights. There are some amazing restaurants nearby as well. The space is decorated very nicely and is very impressive, we would definitely stay here again. The amenities were convenient as it includes a washer and dryer and full kitchen. The apartment also felt very safe and secure having a few doors to enter through.
We had a really tough time finding the apartment when we were to check in, Google maps sent us about 3 blocks away. It was frustrating but Matilda eventually found us. Make sure to have her phone number and ask for the name of the restaurant next door if you are having the same issue.
I would absolutely recommend staying here if visiting Florence!

Wonderful location!  Close to everything and very safe.  Lots of thoughtful touches and very accommodating.  There are quite a bit of stairs, something to keep in mind for those who struggle with stairs.
We had a wonderful stay at Matilda’s place - I would highly recommend! It was a beautiful space and a great location.
Matilda's space was perfect for 5 people, but could comfortably fit more. The location is perfect, not too far but not too close to Florence's main sites. It was immaculate and accommodating.
A wonderful apartment for my family! Matilda was so accommodating and helpful. Excellent location, communication, and value!
It was a beautiful and well located flat. Design was amazing and we could walk to everything. Matilda was a top tier host. Can’t recommend this place enough!!!
Great location and very comfortable for my group of 4. It’s also quiet at night which is a huge bonus

A gorgeous and spacious Florentino apartment.
Located in a very walkable neighborhood.

It’s so nice and cozy.
She responded quickly and kindly.
And it’s so big size b&b! Three days here was a very good experience:)

Matilda was a responsive host and made
Booking and check-in very easy. The apartment was lovely, very clean and beautifully decorated. We had more than enough space and beds for five of us traveling together. The location was perfect for walking to everything we wanted to see in Florence.

Matilda was very responsive and a wonderful lady to work with. She met us at the front door and showed us all the amenities of her place. The apartment was absolutely beautiful and walking distance to all the main attractions and amazing restaurants. I would highly recommend her place! We definitely will be back!!

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb! The location is perfect, making it easy to explore Florence on foot. The room was spotlessly clean and incredibly quiet, providing a peaceful retreat after a day of sightseeing. I couldn't have asked for a better place to stay. If I ever find myself back in Florence, I would definitely choose to stay here again. Highly recommended!

This place was awesome. Beautifully decorated. Pristine. Matilda was so responsive and helpful. The place had perfect towels, and other amenities. Wonderful experience!! Highly recommended. Five stars!

This is an absolutely beautiful apartment.  There was so much space and it was very well appointed. The photos match very well with the experience.  Our small family of three spent 10 days in Italy and stayed in three different Airbnb properties in three different cities.  Matilda's was by far our favorite.  She has thought of every single detail from the linens and towels to the coffee set up.  There was even a toaster which we appreciated! We did not want to leave and would definitely want to return if we are in Florence again.

We had a wonderful time staying at the apartment.  It was better than the pictures and had everything we needed. Matilda always responded promptly and was very helpful.  We also liked a location where we were able to walk everywhere we needed to go and loved a cafe in the morning just right across the street. It was a perfect place to stay for a group of 4 first timers in Florence.

Unbelievable! This apartment's highly undervalued. Its location is good enough for travellers (at a very quiet area, 15-minute walk to the central train station and roughly the same to the city centre). The most important thing is the apartment is very modern, spacious, tidy, clean and comfortable. It has everything that a traveller needs (basic cooking material, coffee and tea). In fact, it's an apartment which has three rooms. All shared the same entrance but has its own bathroom and kitchen.
A special thank to our host for taking us the towels at very late night when we couldn't find one inside the flat. We'll definitely stay at this home again when we're back.
Excellent!!! The apartment is like the pictures or better!! Everyrhing id New and very clean!!! And Lorenzo is polite and friendly.
Clean and nice apartment.near to bus stop or you can walk to central in about 10 to 15 mins.lorenzo was very helpful and answer any query you have about florence.
Location was very close to the main train station (walkable). Apartment was extremely clean and as advertised. Host was very accommodating. Would recommend this place to any.

Our stay in Lorenzo's place was exactly what we needed. He provided any information needed and answered all our questions. The room was beautiful and clean. The kitchen was a big benefit as well so we could cook some of our own meals. Overall I loved our stay, and would definitely book with him again. :)

Lorenzo's apartment was exactly as it says in the discription. We had no difficulties to find the apartment. The apartment was very clean and we found all things we needed in the kitchen. The communication with Lorenzo was very good and he explained us how to get to nearby shops and the city center. We can definitely recommend Lorenzo's apartment.

Lorenzo was a great host. The apartment was basic, but clean, warm and had everything we needed. The perfect base for our work trip.
Ask Lorenzo for directions to the amazing pizza restaurant off the square!

The apartment is easy to reach from all public transport. Lorenzo was a great host, meeting us on arrival and had great tips and directions for the area. Exactly as described and an excellent location.

We will recommend staying at Lorenzo's apartment and will stay here again. There was a lot of information available on Florence in the apartment and it is easy to get around from the apartment. The wifi is fast and Lorenzo was very helpful and fast to respond!

This was our second stay at Lorenzo's apartment.
It suits us perfectly for work trips. Great location, basic, but clean and well equipped. The addition of air con was a bonus as the temp was 30+ degrees on our trip.
Lorenzo is polite and helpful and communication with him is very good.
We will definitely return.

We had a wonderful time in Lorenzo's place. He came 2 hours early to let us inside. The place is very close to centre and you can walk easily to everywhere. It's a quite place also so you can rest without a problem.

The room is a well sized room in an apartment which is very well located. City center is about 10-15min walking distance, there's a pizza restaurant located on the corner which has take away service. There's also a nice park on the corner good to sit and relax.

Lorenzo is kind, punctual and hospitable host, arrived at the appointed time. The apartment is clean and cozy. It is located near the park and the School of Music. As well as it is written down to the center of 20 minutes on foot. We felt like at home. Thank you, Lorenzo!
The appartment was close to the historical center (25 min by walk). Perfect for spending a couple of days in Florence !

It was a great pleasure to stay at this location. Small studio offered to us, was very much sufficient, we had a small kitchen, sofa, small tv... near by there was a pizza shop and a bar.... it was bit far from city center but walking in a nice weather was pleasant.... we really enjoyed our stay.... Thanks! Lorenzo
Lorenzo's Airbnb is close to the center of the city. He is a responsive and helpful host!
Generally good, bed felt a bit uncomfortable and the location was quite far from the centre, but overall a good, clean place and a kind host
Lrenzo is a very nice host.  Everything was on time.  He had a lot of tips about the area.  The premises is located in a very nice tenement house.  Very close to the center.

It was a nice stay - reasonably clean, room big with a nice built in kitchen and a couch. Check in was uncomplicated and friendly.
There was a strange smell in the room which did not go away with airing the room, but for the few days it was okay.

the room was good, but we had a bed smell all 5 days that we stayed there.
our advice to provide iron as we live in the modern era and definitely should be provided simple everyday things.

Antonella is a lovely host who went out of her way to try and help me with maps, directions & recommendations. The room was clean & as described on arrival. I was also exceptionally grateful that Antonella hung out / dried some of my laundry for me whilst I was out exploring, a very loving gesture!
If you are looking for more of a non-intrusive B&B style then this possibly isn't your place as it is very much a family type environment but if you wish to feel as though you are experiencing the Italian way of life this would be a fantastic choice.

Charming family. I spent a month @ Antonella's house to follow a Italian course for foreign student. I had a lovely stay. The family is welcoming, very nice. There is a cute little dog that welcome you when you arrive as well. They are polite and respectful. The city of Florence is absolutely beautiful! Lot of things to see and do in the city. I had some strong allergies to pollen (plants) because it was spring time and Antonella was very kind and help me with medication to take. Alessandro is also very nice and I enjoyed chating with him and practicing my Italian language.
The host was present and very attentive , cordial and informative. The apt is big and close to the important places in Firenze. It is all walking distance. The neighborhood is quiet and fine.

Ulrika was wonderful! So helpful and accomodating.

The Apartment is perfectly located!

We will absolutely return to Florence and stay in the Duomo apartment :)

We spent 2 nights here. The apartment was extremely clean and also very spacious. The terraces were wonderful. We stayed in the Il Duomo room. The view from our room terrace was spectacular. The neighborhood was off the beaten path but only a few minutes walk to all of the popular sights. The room has a small kitchen with all the things needed to prepare simple meals. There is a grocery store only 2 minutes walk from apartment.  Ulrika was a fantastic hostess. She assisted our needs 100%.  There are also great vintage shops and artist studios along the walk to city center. I would stay here over and over! Though the room pictures are great, they don't do the room justice. The space is much larger  and nicer than it appears!

Great apartment, spacious, clean and well located! Renee, Carrmen, and Ashleigh.

The room was incredible! Exactly as advertised, and even better. The view was so charming as was the rest of the apartment. We were greeted so generously with friendliness and a small gift of chocolate. Our stay was amazing. This place is an easy A+!

We had a lovely stay with Giorgio and Massimo. They were always very quick to respond if we had a query and were very welcoming and helpful. The apartment matched the description very well, and the view from the kitchen balcony was absolutely beautiful. Thank you for your hospitality!

Lovely apartment in a fantastic location. We stayed in the blue room and it was perfect...clean and spacious. The three flights of stairs was a challenge with large luggage but other than that it was perfect. Giorgio was very sweet and helped with the luggage. Would definitely stay here again.
Giorgio was very kind and gave great recommendations on sites to visit and places to eat. He was able to accommodate us despite our early arrival!

Giorgio's place is lovely! We didn't meet with him, but the communication with him was very efficient. His brother helped us with carrying our luggage to upstairs, and I appreciate it so much. Giorgio's father checked in with us and asked if everything is fine. It was easy to reach to attractions, shops, and restaurants.
Lovely spacious and comfortable room in secure and really convenient location. Great shower, nice kitchen with amazing view over city buildings. Some street noise but otherwise a great place to stay.

The rooms are very nice and the hosts are very helpfull. The location is perfect. Only 5 min walk from the train station and all the musea, restaurants and many other nice places are within walking distance.

Paola and roberto’s space is charming and comfortable. Everything you might need is there - even an umbrella!  Paola’s warmth, hospitality, and generosity was exceptional and really added to my experience of falling in love with Florence. If you can, stay with Paola and Roberto!

Ricardo's house is located in the center of city and most of the attractions were at walkable distance. Though we faced problem while checkin and finding the place, there were no other issues. It looked like a 18th century or older building renovated with needed amenities which was a first time experience for us.

Amazing place! Riccardo provided clear instructions on how to access the apartment, it was super easy to get in! Also an amazing location, tons of great restaurants and site seeing within a 5 minute walk. I would definitely stay at Ricardo’s place again. Only thing is the AC unit in the main bedroom was not working properly (maybe a user error?), but the other ones in the main areas worked perfectly well enough to keep cool during our stay. Overall, AMAZING PLACE! So much character in the apartment!

The apartment is very well located, spacious, and with good air conditioning available throughout. However, with limited furnishings or utilities, and sleeping anything more than 2 requiring sofa beds and pullouts (the apartment advertises it sleeps 6), I would say it is a somewhat basic accommodation.
If all you need is somewhere to sleep and leave bags, as you intend to eat out mostly, it is great for this. If you expect to spend more time in the apartment than most, this may not be the place for you. But overall, a perfectly good experience
PS the stairs in to the building and flat are quite steep, so if your mobility is a bit reduced you may struggle.

Mauricio did not send complete instructions including how to enter the apt. in advance.  He finally texted  complete information on where the key could be found on  our first day.  We did not have good internet access so never received it until much later.  He was not available by phone either so we had to find another place to stay.  We called him repeatedly over the next 2 days but got a recorded message.  The apartment was not very convenient, and as he said, accessible by taxi.  We wanted a closer place to downtown.  We wound up never staying there at all.  Make sure he sends you complete instructions before you leave the U.S. (including information about the key box). I really think we deserve our money back.

What to say that has not already been said? A perfect place to experience the Italian apartment living experience, but in a virtually traffic free street, yet only a few minutes walk from all the sights! Within the apartment, everything you could possibly need for a week stay, and the kindest host in Maurizio, who picked us up at the station even though our train from Pisa was running an hour late on a Saturday night, and looked after our bags on checkout day, so we did not have to drag them around on the final sightseeing outing.
Highly recommended, excellent value, and would certainly return.

Maurizio's apartment was perfect for my stay in Florence. I was able to recover from jet lag easily and slept well in this peaceful apartment. The location allows for an easy walk to anywhere you might want to go in Florence. Maurizio left some basic kitchen items and a nice bottle of wine. There is a wonderful hot shower and a washing machine available for use. I would stay in the silent Oltrano apartment again, and I highly recommend it!

Maurizio's apartment was a absolute gem of a place to stay in Florence.
Great location, spacious and the host provided a few extra touches that made the stay an excellent experience.
I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone planning a visit to Florence.
Tony & Glenda
Melbourne, Australia
Fantastic location. Great restaurants 5 minutes walk. Strong WIFI. Best shower I had in Europe. Maurizio met us and explained everything. I'll be back.
Maurizio was a fantastic host. He was very courteous and hospitable. He went above and beyond to make our stay in Florence great and comfortable.

Maurizio was very kind to wait for us at SMN station, he picked us and helped us with our luggage. The apartment was very lovely, spacious and the neighborhood is very calm. We really enjoyed our stay.
It's a pleasure to stay in such a lovely place. Makes you feel like you are local. Very close to the city centre. Will definitely recommend to stay here.
Great place! Maurizio was so helpful and we loved this charming apartment. Wish we could have stayed longer!!

What a STUNNING find in Firenze!! Extremely walkable to all the major attractions and sights. We love Maurizio's place as it's a beautiful, cozy and quiet home away from the hustle and bustle. Maurizio was extremely hospitable to pick us up from the train station as well with his beautiful daughter! Overall a delightful 5 star stay :)

Maurizio's place was beautiful and well maintained.  The pictures showed his apartment accurately. Loved the purple bathroom!  He had food in the refrigerator when we arrived.  We were able to get ahold of him easily and he even went to the train station to pick us up.  We needed a taxi called for one of our guests to get to the airport and he arranged this which was helpful.  Overall, a wonderful stay!
Maurizio was a wonderful host.  The accommodation was amazing and spacious for two people. We would stay here again.  Grazie Maurizio.
Beautiful, quiet apartment close to hip dining, bars and tourist attractions. Easy to get around. Definitely recommend a stay here.
Maurizho was just a good host. His recommendation was superb n gave us the right advises on our trip in Florence. 5 stars

The flat has everything you may wish for and more. By far it is once of the best places I have been in. Even if you haven't gone to the supermarket you'll be able to have a complete breakfast. The ocassional mosquitoes are also thoght of with the repellent you find in every space. And the location is peaceful at night (during the day you'll hear the sounds from the children inside a playground across the street). Perfect in every sense.

We really loved the apartment. It had a real Tuscany, but quaint decor. It was very accommodating for a family of 5. It was well stocked with everything you need and so much more.
