Maurizio greeted us in person and provided local information with maps. He even set up a taxi for return to the train station. Everything was in walking distance. The market was right around the corner. Restaurants were near by. The apartment was very clean and neat. We enjoyed our visit thoroughly. I would recommend this place very highly to anyone visiting Florence. Thank you for your amazing hospitality, Maurizio.
This is a place you want to stay at. Maurizio helps you through every step of the process and lays everything out for you when you get there. Great recommendations for food and is a very good host
Great location! Just a minute from the bridge to the main tourist places, and it’s also in a cool neighborhood. Highly recommend this apartment.

Maurizio’s place was amazing. The location was a quick walk to all the main attractions. Really easy check in and was surprised with how many extra items were made available to us which made the stay so much more enjoyable.

A great place to stay in Florence. It had loads of character. Apartment was v clean. Kitchen was fully equipped. Host had provided all the basics. Oil vinegar spices  butter. We enjoyed making couple of meals there. 15 min walk from train station SMN. Maurizio was v helpful. When we had trouble arranging taxi to station he even offered to drop us himself.
Maurizio's apartment is really beautiful and perfectly located in the city centre of Florence. Maurizio is a superhost, extremely kind and thoughtful ; we had a wonderful stay in his apartment !
We had a fabulous time at Maurizio's, the space and location was perfect for our trip to Florence.
Absolutely recommend this truly beautiful, charmingly decorated and perfectly located gem! Fantastic host, great experience! Looking forward to coming back!

Had a great stay in Florence. Maurizio met us -- he was lovely and explained everything we needed to know. The apartment is charming, quiet and very clean.  There were plenty of books about Florence on the shelves and the location was perfect -- close to everything in the Oltrarno. Would love to return!

Absolutely beautiful apartment! Perfect location, very close to popular destinations and nightlife but on a very  peaceful and quiet side street. Super cozy and cute, and equipped with everything we needed. And Maurizio was the best host we could have asked for! We will definitely be looking to book here again :)
Amazing location, lovely house & Maurizio is a really helpful, welcoming & kind host! Thank you Maurizio!!

We had a very pleasant and enjoyable stay. Maurizio is a lovely host, extremely responsive, accommodating and kind. I highly recommend staying here if you’d like to stay off the beaten path, in Oltrarno.

Maurizio, big big thanx for being able to rent your apartmenr. it was perfect in every way. both close to everything by a short walk but also secluded an it felt like living in a real italian neigborhood. we would love to come again. take care. Stina and Lars

Maurizio's place was perfect for our time in Florence. The location was close enough to all popular sites and tucked away in a quiet neighborhood. His hospitality is unmatched! We looked forward to returning again some day.

Maurizios place was possibly the very best hospitality I’ve ever experienced from an Airbnb.  He was incredibly responsive, he left lots of snacks, and everything was set up for a comfortable stay.  It was truly amazing!

Fabulous place and lovely trip to a vibrant interesting city. Flat is great location to walk to city and try all local restaurants plus coffee places too.
Maurizio was very helpful especially when we had difficulty booking a taxi. Nice touches in flat like some snacks, tea and bathroom products. All things you need were provided. Best place we have stayed using Airbnb really.
Would highly recommend and love to return again sometime.
Thanks for our few special days 😄

Maurizio was one of the most responsive and friendly hosts that we have experienced and his apartment was the best equipped that we have stayed in. We had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. We particularly enjoyed the well-equipped kitchen and large bedroom with an armoire, a chest of drawers, and lovely linens with extra blankets. The Oltarno neighborhood is less crowded than some others in the city but contains many excellent restaurants and shops.  It is also walkable to all the major attractions.

We had a great stay at Maurizio’s place! It was a pleasant place and very spacious. Maurizio was also flexible about the check in/out time since no one was coming right after us and we really appreciated that. The only thing that might be tricky for taller people is the door frames were a bit low so could require stopping for some.
Very nice and cozy flat in central Florence, if I ever come back to this city I will surely rent Maurizio‘s flat again!

Beautiful roomy flat with a lovely Tuscan feel. Beverages and snacks were a wonderful welcome. Felt very safe. Close to everything we wanted to see. Maurizio went above and beyond our expectations. He always responded quickly and helped so much. He even ordered a taxi for us for our extremely early flight. We would love to come back!
Beautiful and comfortable apartment within easy walking distance of nearly everything. The apartment was gorgeous and Maurizio was the perfect host.
Great host, accomodating. We asked for help with AC because of the heatwave and he found us a poetable AC to use which was a lifesaver.
Large and beautiful house to spend time if you want to cherish the true Italian living. Beautifuly decorated.

Great place located on a side street 5 minutes from the river. Awesome restaurants within 5 minutes and an easy walk to all the activities. We also walked to the train station which is about 15-20 minutes.
Great spacious shower and a large bedroom. It’s up a couple flights of stairs if that matters to you.
We would definitely stay here again!
Very spacious and pretty apartement, easy access with code and located in a very charming district - can recommend :)

Maurizio was a fantastic host and even brought our luggage to the apartment while we returned our rental car. The neighbourhood is perfect. Slightly less crowded than the city centre but also within walking distance of everything!
A wonderful home base in a perfect location. Alda was ver attentive, informative and kind.

Lovely loft. Ideally positionned next to the train station. Alda was lovely and gave us the best tips to enjoy our stay (not mentionning the home made tiramisu !!)
Highly recommanded !
Alda's place was great! Very close to the train station and lots of shops, we walked everywhere and did not require a bus pass.
This was my favorite stay of my trip... The location is perfect and she gives the best recommendations.... I highly recommend anyone to book!!

Perfect in every way. The room is very tastefully presented and spotlessly clean. The location is just a few minutes walk from the station and central to all the sights of Florence. Cafes, restaurants and markets are literally just round the corner, as are the shops and small supermarkets.
Alda is an excellent host, kind and welcoming and offers advice, information and tips on where to go and where to eat. Highly recommended.

Host is very kindness. She gave many information about firenze. and House is very clean and comfortable. We cooked pasta in the house. Loction is very good, nereby S.M.N station also another duomo. Thank you for your kindness. We had happy memories in firenze thanks to you.

Alda's place was located very close to the train station and just a few minutes from the very center of Florence, the Duomo. It was a lovely apartment and we had a great time. Alda was very helpful and gave us a map and local tips which saved us!

What a sweet host and apartment!
Alda gave us the most detailed check-in instructions and tourist tips. She was quick with her responses via WhatsApp and was always available to help. She even had tiramisu cakes for us in the fridge which she made herself.
Apartment was clean and comfortable and offered everything we needed. It is also conveniently located near the train station.
Our train did not leave until a 3 hours after check-out but Alda kept our luggages with her until we were ready to leave. This allowed us to explore a little more and enjoy our last moments in Florence.
Overall, I was happy with our stay at Alda's. I would recommend it to others.

Alda's apartment is in a central, safe, and very convenient location. She was responsive to concerns immediately and gave us plentiful information about the area.  The apartment is very close to the Mercato Centrale, where we ate several times. We took the tram from the airport, which was easy to do and the Unita tram stop is very close to the apartment. The bed is very comfortable and the shower is great. We highly recommend it.

A really excellent apartment. Located very close to the station (easily walkable for me with 2 pieces of luggage and aged 79!). Beautifully equipped. The sofa bed was exceptionally comfortable. Alda was really helpful in communications and in local information. I was alone but it would be great for a couple. Will come again if I revisit Florence.

Alda was a lovely hostess! We really enyojed our stay, the place was very clean and the location was fantastic. Alda helped us with any questions we had and even let us stay an extra night to catch the early train. She was very welcoming and caring! Thank you Alda for 3 amazing weeks in Firenze.
Everything is perfect!!! Would love to return when I visit Florence again. Maria was very helpful and responsive throughout the stay. Thank you so much!

Everything as pictured/expected! Our train got in early and Riccarda let us check in early. Riccarda’s friend, Annamarie explained everything perfectly. Overall we had a great experience and I’m glad we chose this Airbnb!
Nice, comfortable and quiet apartment, located in the center of the city. Lysiane is a charming and wellcoming person ! We really enjoyed our stay !

Staying at Lysiane's flat was more than wonderful. My girlfriend and I felt immediately comfortable upon arriving and meeting Lysiane, who pointed us in the direction of Mercato Centrale, which soon became our favorite place! The flat is accessible to all parts of the city and is on a quiet street. It took no time at all for is to begin referring to the flat as "our home." We can't wait to come back!

The apartment was located in a great, quiet, safe area near many of the main attractions of the city. It was very clean and had everything we needed. Check in was simple and there were no issues. Thanks again!

Wonderful flat within 10 to 20 minutes walking distance of virtually all of the major sites. The place was fantastically clean and incredibly quiet at night. The bed was comfy. The AC worked amazingly well in the July heat, especially if you shut the door to the bedroom when you sleep. We really appreciated the line outside the window to hang the wash on. We had no problems with everything drying quickly. We would definitely stay here again.
Lysianne was very nice and helpful upon arrival. Her place is well located , small but cozy and has everything you will need. Recommended.

Lysiane's place is in a perfect location in Florence...close enough to every attraction without being in a touristy area. The apartment is very clean and has everything you need from a kitchen to a washer. The bed can be made into two if necessary. Lysiane is very good at communicating. Would highly recommend!

The flat was very centrally located and easy to navigate from Lysiane was very helpful when we had questions.  She also provided maps and other various guides to help us see all of Florence!!! Great time and flat!!!
We loved the location of the accommodation; twenty minutes walk from the station, ten minutes from the Duomo, and just round the corner from restaurants and shops.  Thanks!

Lysiane’s place was perfect for our three days in Florence. It has such a central location, minutes walk from most key sights. Communication was quick and excellent. The flat itself is clean and beautifully decorated with everything you might need! It’s also beautifully cool at night in mid summer so great to come back to after a long day. Thanks again!

Our weeklong stay at Lysiane's apartment was perfect. We are completely in love with Florence! The apartment is so close to the Duomo but tucked away in a little street so we always looked forward to coming back from the tourist crowds. Everything you could possibly need is all within walking distance, which we appreciated as we actually did cook at home a few nights. Thank you Lysiane for such a wonderful stay and for sharing your home with us!

Lysiane's apartment is cozy and in a good location--easy walking distance to everything we wanted to see in Florence. The apartment is well equipped with amenities, and is decorated with Lysiane's own artwork. It was clean and communication with Lysiane was excellent.

This apartment is in a fantastic spot, close to the duomo and easy walking distance to  everything else.  The apartment was very clean and had everything you needed.  We enjoyed Lysianne's art on the walls and she supplied a book with recommendations for restaurants, maps,  etc.  I would recommend this apartment.
Lysiane was very friendly and helpful. We had a great stay and her stylish flat which is in a great location. Would love to return in future!
Clean, tidy, comfortable, complete and artsy. Me and my dad had a great stay at Lysiane's place. The welcome by Lysiane was friendly. Thank you Lysiane for the great stay!
Great stay, very central and safe area. Apartment was clean and exactly like the photos. Made our trip all the better, thank you Lysiane!

Lysiane’s place was very cute and cosy, decorated in a very eclectic and interesting way. It’s located in a quiet but central part of Florence within easy walking distance of the main attractions. We very much enjoyed our time there and would happily recommend it as a place to stay in Florence.
Quaint, all-in-one apartment.  Lysiane was very responsive and helpful.  Would love to rebook!

An excellent apartment in a quiet part of town. It was a perfect location, walking distance to everything. It's about a 15 minute walk from the train station and a 25 euro cab ride from the airport. Host was very friendly and gave some great suggestions of places to eat.

Lorenza's place was awesome for my wife and I on our honeymoon.  The location was great, far enough away from the busy tourist areas to be quiet but still within easy walking distance of them.  When we arrived they provided us with a map and some recommendations for some local restaurants that were awesome. Would definitely recommend for another couple.
Stylish space in a perfect location to reach all the major sights with a lovely balcony where you can dine 'al fresco' in the mornings. Just watch your head on the beam in the attic!

The location was perfect. Just a quick walk down the street to get to the center of Florence. So many cafes and restaurants nearby. The terrace outside was really nice to sit out and enjoy coffee in the mornings. There is a full kitchen and wifi is strong. The host was very welcoming and had good communication and lots of knowledge about the area. Would definitely stay here again next time I’m in Florence!

The apartment in Santa Croce is an absolute dream. You will feel very much at home in this apartment. The owner is absolutely wonderful and very helpful. To top it off I would rate this warm, comfortable hide away with 5 stars.

Had a lovely stay at this apartment. Great location and the host was super helpful with info on the area and flexible around check-in and checkout. The bathroom while having all the amenities was a little tight on space.
Francesca is a great host and wonderful about getting back to you quickly. The apartment is beautiful and spacious. The location is great for getting around to all the main attractions.

The apartment was just as described and pictured on the site. Bright and clean, we loved it. Traveling with my wife and 3 daughters 17-24. We got all checked in with operational instructions for all appliances and facilities. Good Wifi. Nice views of the city and surrounding hills from the windows. Great location with major sites and restaurants close by. Nice grocery store a couple blocks away. Apartment has a nice espresso machine, lots of champagne and wine glasses for evening drinks. Two levels with lots of room to spread out after a long day walking the city. Francesca checked in throughout our stay to make sure we had everything we needed. I left behind a personal item and she went out of her way to make sure I got it back. The one and only thing I would mention to older folks is that it is up several flights of stairs so carrying suitcases up upon arrival may be difficult for some.
Apartment was clean. We were able to cook a meal with fresh produce from the nearby market. Listing was very accurate
Great location! The place was beautiful and very clean. The host was very nice and very informative. I would highly recommend this place if you planning to visit Florence.

Nice apartment. Location was great too. Big and comfortable place. Only thing to take note is the climb up to the 4th floor if you have heavy luggages. It might be a little tiring for the older folks.

What a fabulous place! The location was absolutely perfect! The place itself was wonderful for a family vacation- lots of space and great kitchen! The tub upstairs has an amazing view of the city! Staying in contact was easy-with fast response times! Francesca was the perfect host! Couldn't recommend more!
Francesca was a perfect host and very accommodating allowing us to change our plans at last minute, which was a godsend for us.  A perfect host, great location and easy to find.  Highly recommend.
Francesca's apartment is lovely! Amazing spaces, beautiful views and great location. I'll come back in this flat for sure on my next trip in Florence!

Francesca's apartment is absolutely stunning with views of the Duomo and all the surrounding homes with terra-cotta roofs. It was a very spacious apartment with a fully equipped kitchen. Great location. Francesca was out of town but a management company contacted us prior to our arrival to arrange check in. Gabriel was very kind and very helpful. Even helped us carry our bags down the stairs and offered to call us a taxi. Can't say enough wonderful things about this place and hope to come back soon!

We stayed 3 days and nights in Florence in the Bellavista apartment and we had a great time. The location is excellent, everything was clean and Francesca was a great host. Would definitely recommend.

The apartment is gorgeous exactly as described and same as the pictures. Very spacious accommodation.The location is fantastic very close to all the amenities and places of interest. It was easy to get to.
The only point to note is that the apartment is on the top floor so there are several flights of stairs to get to it.
If you like to be in the center of Florence, this is the place. Beautifully appointed and you are there right across academia.

Donatella's apartment is centrally located, overlooking a beautiful square. It is surrounded by Florence's main attractions as well as plenty of places to eat and shop. Donatella was a great host. We'd love to be back.

We enjoyed our stay here! The apartment is very spacious and nicely appointed. The location is pretty central, but off the beaten path a little so is quieter. Francesca was very easy to work with and always quick to respond. I’d recommend this apartment!

Literally could not have asked for a better location.  The apartment was fantastic for our family of four.  Clean.  Spacious.  Well appointed.  Nothing quite like looking directly on the Uffizi from your own private balcony!  Donatella was very responsive throughout the process (before, during and after our trip).  Eight thumbs up (from everyone in the family!)  Just wish our trip could have been longer.

What a fantastic, amazing apartment. Wow! Donnatella was quite flexible with our arrival time and was there to meet us and make us feel welcome. We had a wonderful time. I'd love to come back to Florence some day and, if we do, it is hard to imagine staying anywhere else.

Very nice experience in this terrific city .
The apartment is in the best location surrounded by Museums and historic sites .
Donatella has excellent communication skills and has arranged for our stay to go as smoothly as possible .
We will recommend this apartment for sure .
This was a superb apartment in a great location and great value for the cost. The host was very helpful throughout the process and we would be sure to use it again if available. Thank you

This place is awesome! Accommodation, amenities, and location were exactly as advertised! Beautiful apartment!
To top it all off, Francesca is a great host! She communicated clearly from the start , and was very responsive with any questions I had.
Donatella was very helpful from arrival to departure. She even made reservations for us at a very nice restaurant. The apartment had old school and the location is very convenient.
Apartment was in perfect position. Clean with everything we needed, Donatella helpful when we had problems with tour booking. Would definitely stay again
Great apartment. Host has great communication and left us a bottle of wine to enjoy during the stay which was lovely.

Francesca’s place is in the heart of a fun neighborhood. We enjoyed the food and atmosphere. Very lively.
The apartment is very comfortable. I felt right at home.
Highly recommended.

Excellent location, close to everything, walkable to almost all attractions or easy access to buses. The apartment was an excellent setup for our proud of 6. Living room and kitchen was open and allowed for a great meeting place.
Francesca was very lovely to rent from. She was quick with communication and quite hospitable highly recommend her Airbnb.

Beautiful apartment in a lovely area slighly away from the hustle and bustle.  We had one minor issue with the hot water and Francesca's father fixed it immediately.  Would recommend this stay to anyone.

The appartment was great. Small but well designed and equipped. Clean.
perfect location.
We didnt meet Niccolo, but his brother was so nice to us (even tough we were a bit late) and helped us with the suitcases.
Great communication all the time, and they tried to help us even with the weirdest requests we had.
Recommended!!!

Very lovely and spacious apartment right in the centre of town. Noisy at night though as on busy street but its not that much of a problem. Amenities in the apartment are excellent, would recommend to anyone :)

The apartment was in a great location and easy correspondence with host.
One warning - it is extremely noisy at night (second floor) and bad sound insulation. If you're a light sleeper don't stay here.
Otherwise great apartment.

Nicolò's place is decent and not far away from centrale station and major transportations, there are many bars/restaurants, and the place is close to the market so very convenient.
The apartment has almost everything you need, clean and tidy. The only problem is the proximity to the street which the noise might be little problem.
Overalls recommend this place.

This apartment was a great choice for us. It is an excellent location right near the heart of Florence city center. The apartment had plenty of space and our host was extremely accommodating and even let us check in early. We will definitely stay here again when we return. Thank you so much Francesca for making our stay so welcoming.
Amazon place. Clean, spacious and a beautiful view of the piazza. Donatella was very accommodating and helpful. I would highly recommend it.

Stay here. Seriously. Beautiful apartment, beautiful historic piazza, simply beautiful. We would stay here again in a second; loved the balcony for our coffee in the morning and our wine in the evening. We were able to be a part of the excitement of the Piazza della Signoria in absolute comfort. Big thanks to Donatella who made our stay perfect.

I booked this space after reading all of the great reviews, and I'm so very glad I did! Donatella has a beautiful apartment in a wonderful location of Florence. Very comfortable for two adults and two teens, nice bathrooms, linens, etc. It is just a beautiful place in a magical city. I hope to stay again soon! Perfect stay.

Perfect location, very close to the train station and sites. Nicolo and his friend Simone were very understanding and helpful when we had missed our connection and had make other arrangements to check in. The apartment itself was clean and exactly what we expected for our stay.

An excellent place to spend a few days in Florence. Niccolò was always quick to respond during communication, and his friend Carolina met us at the train station to bring us to the place. The place was all we needed, and felt like home for a couple days. We were able to make breakfast every morning before setting out, and made dinner in the hideaway kitchen one night. The bathroom was spacious and clean. Would stay with Niccolò again for sure!
The pictures don't do it justice: the view from the windows is simply incredible! Donatella is great host, kind and very accomodating. It's hard to go wrong with this apartment
Fantastic location across from the Uffizi.  We enjoyed all the activity on the square!  Donatella was a terrific hostess!
Great place in a perfect location and a great hostess.  Only issue was a slight funky smell in the hallway.

Excellent location in central Florence. Very authentic, large apartment was perfect for our family of four for a 4 night stay to experience NYE. Noise canceling headphones were handy due to the crowded Piazza! We knew it would be like that though. Highly recommended.

Donatella's house has a convenient location; it is near many tourist spots, restaurants, bakeries. The inner decoration is of luxurious and classical. I love the balcony that reached outside above the crowed main square. We could have breakfasts there and enjoying the flourishing of Florence at the same time.

Donatelli’s home is simply lovely and the view can’t be beat! To wake up every morning and see the people walking about the Piazza della Signoria? Are you kidding me? Fantastic!
The location is perfect. She’s a doll and very helpful. Next time we are in Firenze we definitely staying here again!
We had an amazing time staying at Niccolo's apartment. It was nice and clean! I highly recommend this place!
Nice apartment walking distance to all of Florence's hot spots. Very noisy throughout the night and bed is a bit firm but great location and clean space.

Fast and objective answers.
Noisy place because it is in front of the street, however, it is acceptable when the windows are completely close.
Great location and beautiful apartment. The street is pretty busy at night so if you're an early sleeper it might be a little loud.

Staying at Donatella’s apartment was one of the greatest decisions we made regarding our trip. Not only was Donatella incredibly helpful and easy to communicate with, but the apartment is stunning. Perfect location, perfect view, beautiful home. We only want to stay here for future trips. Thanks again Donatella!
We had a wonderful stay. The apartment was very elegant and comfortable and couldn't be in a better location for getting to know Florence!

This was a magical stay. The place is gorgeous and comfortable. Right in the heart of Florence. This was a dream location and the beauty exceeded my expectations. We were thrilled to stay here. The beds were very comfortable and the noise from the piazza was not bad at all. I was prepared for much worse given some of the reviews we read. Very comfortable stay and we would definitely stay again.
Greatly enjoyed my time! Very clean and central location. Made my trip to Florence even better.
Beautiful location and apartment. The view is unparalleled! The space was clean & functional, the AC was a plus during the heatwave. Enjoyed our stay and the close proximity to everything.

A fabulous comfortable and clean apartment in the heart of everything. Excellent communication as the stay drew closer. Amazing views of the piazza. The only thing that would make this apartment absolutely perfect is a washing machine. We loved this stay and highly recommend!
Great location, wonderful apartment with amazing views. Donatello was very kind and helpful. Thank you very much for everything! Hope to see you again.
Donatella’s flat was very homey yet elegant.  We loved the furniture and paintings throughout the flat.   Having a small balcony overlooking the Piazza was very cool!

Great location, easy walking distance to everything. Enough space for our family of 4. Air con a blessing on hot days.
Street a little noisy at night but earplugs helped and my kids slept soundly in a room further from the window.

Stylish space with one of the most comfortable beds I've had. Street noise was significant, but earplugs resolved this issue. We were escorted from the train station to the flat, which was very helpful because google maps address does not correspond with the actual flat location. Highly recommend

Niccolo’s place is in an excellent location. It is extremely close to a trendy food market in Florence, and about a 15-20 minute walk to all the sites. It is also helpful for how close it is to the Santa Maria Novella station (3 min walk!). Due to the space being located on a main road it gets very noisy at night. It was fine for me, but my partner needed earplugs to sleep. He did say it was the best rest he has of the trip though!

Place was small and a bit tight. At night the street noise was very loud through the window. Not pleased that we had to pay such an expensive cleaning fee, but if you just need a place to sleep and stash your stuff while you explore that is short walk to main sights then this is the place.

Nothing to complain about. I booked this for my parents and had no issues, clean apartment and central location. It might a bit noisy at night but this is because of the location obviously has a vibrant night life.

Check-in: Not very friendly welcome, the host's friend has been a little bit annoyed.
Good: Very cleaned apartment, good position to reach the city center.
Bad: Missing some sugar, tea, biscuits, shower gel and other basical stuff.
The location is great, the apartment is clean and cozy. The place is great to stay for a couple of days in Florence.
Great location but a bit noisy at night. Everything else made it worth it though. Very clean and overall great stay
Loved the place it was as good as I expected it. And the checkin process was great! Will 10/10 recommend this place.
Not quite the same as it looks in the pictures but still a good place to stay in Florence. Short walk away from The Central station is a plus

Niccolo texted us before arriving, communication was always great and on time. The wifi of the location works perfectly and it’s close to everything you’ll want to see and visit in Firenze. Also, being just a couple blocks away to the train station was great.
Thank you for such a lovely stay. Your apartment is perfect and we felt privileged to stay here in such a wonderful location.
Beautiful flat!!! So luxurious! . One of my favorite flats we stayed in on our Europe trip. Perfect location. Donatella was a perfect host!

This was our second time staying at this lovely apartment. It is the perfect location for walking everywhere. We spent lots of time on the balcony people watching which was fun. It is very lively area and lots of fun to be in the center of everything, but if you need extreme quiet when sleeping this is not the place for you. I would highly recommend Donatella’s apartment. She is very helpful and responsive. She even went the extra mile and picked up decaf coffee pods for the machine there and she ordered that taxi for us the day before our departure. We definitely plan to visit again someday. A magical place to visit. A wonderful place to stay when visiting Florence!!!!!

Beautiful apartment and amazing location. We loved how close we were to everything. The apartment is beautiful and has a lovely balcony that overlooks the piazza. Donatella is a great host who provided us information and tips as needed during our stay. We highly recommend her apartment.

I can’t say enough great things about Dontella’s apartment! In the middle of everything Florence has to offer, extremely walkable, but the space itself felt like a quiet oasis. Very clean, comfortable bed, beautiful decor. The windows and patio overlooking the square are the highlight of the space. As a host, Donatella was accommodating, responsive, and provided clear arrival and departure instructions. We’d absolutely stay here again next time we’re in Florence!
Perfect apartment for exploring Florence, an ideal location! Very clean, easy to access and had everything I needed :)
Comfortable and secure location, right near the main train station and a 2 minute walk from Central Market. Bed was comfortable, bit of noise from the street as it is a busy road but was fine!

This place was in a great location! Super close to the Central Market and lots of different restaurants and cafes. The apartment was clean and the bathroom was spacious. It was located at the top of a tall set of steep steps so just a heads up if you have heavy suitcases that you will need to do some lifting. Other than that we had a wonderful stay and would recommend.

We had a great stay at Niccolo's apartment! It is in a super location close to the Santa Maria Novella Station and many of Florence's famous tourist spots. It was spacious and clean and Niccolo was a very responsive host.
Nice place. Many good restaurants nearby. Less than a 10 minute walk to the train station.
Was at a great location, close enough to the main station and to the main city centre. They were very responsive and made our check in easy.

Great stay at Niccolo's home. Just a couple minute walk from the train station. Even with our luggage it was easy to negotiate and flat so moving around was a breeze.
Check in was smooth and the apartment was very clean, well appointed and comfortable.
GREAT location! We walked everywhere and there are numerous restaurants and sites to see all within 15-20 mins .... or less.
Highly recommend Niccolo's home for a wonderful stay in Firenze!

Wow, Pierpaolo was the most amazing host I ever had. He was super generous, the communication with him was easy and convenient. He loves the details and thought through many many steps of our experience. He was incredibly nice and I could easily made friends with him beyond staying at his beautiful place. The apartment's location is extremely convenient, couldn't be any better – only a few minutes walk to the center of Florence. The apartment was recently remodelled, so it felt like we moved in a totally new and clean space. Next time in Florence, I'll definitely will give Pierpaolo a heads up!

Pierpaolo is a wonderful host (best of our five city trip), and the apartment is chic and luxe. The location feels like a local neighborhood yet is minutes from the train station, river and all the historical sites of Florence.  I look forward to staying with Pierpaolo again and would recommend his place to everyone.

We had a wonderful time staying in this flat. It was in a great location very close to the train station (easy to walk with heavy luggage) and was very close to all of the sites. We were welcomed with a treat and bottle of prosecco which was very nice and accommodating. As far as the flat it is as gorgeous  as the pictures you see and everything was extremely clean. The host was also available for any questions and suggestions on things to do and was even willing to book activities for us ahead of time if we wished. Hope i have a chance to stay again and will highly suggest to anyone who wants to visit Florence.

BEST Airbnb stay! Incredible host, amazing apartment and fantastic location!
From our arrival, we were blown away. Pierpaolo greeted us warmly (with a bottle of wine), showed us around the apartment and sat down with us to give a great explanation of Florence as well as providing fantastic restaurant recommendations.
The apartment. Wow. Modern, clean, spacious and had everything we needed. Despite a hard mattress, we absolutely loved the place and it was a bigger treat than staying in a nice hotel.
The apartment was well located, walking distance from all the sights, as well as close to restaurants, a supermarket and cute bakery.
Staying here was a memorable experience and we were very impressed with Pierpaolo's above and beyond hosting. He was professional and friendly, easily contactable (24/7) and gave us little extras such as fresh fruit and juice. We would not hesitate to stay here again.

This apartment was beautiful and well equipped for our stay in Florence. It has everything you need. It is in a great quiet location just a short walk to the main attractions in Florence. There are also some great bars and restaurants nearby and a supermarket next door which was so handy. From the very beginning Pierpaolo was so helpful and great at keeping in contact. He was also available at all times throughout our stay in case we had any queries and offered to help us plan our trip. He also left us a bottle of wine and some refreshments which was lovely to arrive to especially on such a hot day. If we were to return to Florence we would definitely stay here again. There is nothing that we could have recommended that Pierpaolo do better. Thanks for a lovely trip.

This was probably one of the best Airbnb experiences we've had! Me and my wife stayed here for three nights. Pierpaolo himself was not able to meet us personally, however his dad (who is just wonderful!) walked us through the apartment. Everything looked exactly like the pictures, it was really clean and contemporary - we loved the washroom and the bluetooth speakers! The apartment was walking distance to all of Florence's major sights and some really nice restaurants - especially towards the Oltrarno side.

I would say that Pierpaolo is the best host we have ever had. Even before we arrived he helped us with taxis, restaurant bookings and advice and was incredibly friendly.
The apartment was clean, modern and perfectly equipped for our short stay, and in a fantastic location just minutes from shops, bars, restaurants and all the sights
Highly recommend people to stay here -made our Florence experience even better!

This place is the BEST. We stayed for five nights and loved everything about it. What makes this place so special is the care and compassion that Pierpaolo has for his guests. He genuinely cares about your stay and does everything he can to make it amazing. We feel so lucky that we found this place and I am sure everyone that stays here feels the same. The apartment itself is immaculate and in a great location with lots of nice restaurants, shops, and a Conad supermarket right next door.

I would highly recommend Pierpaolo and the apartment. As a host Pierpaolo was fantastic, extremely helpful in planning our trip before and while we were out there he kept in contact giving advice on restaurants and helping us book tickets for attractions. The apartment is in the perfect location a 5 minute walk from the train station and 10 minutes from the centre. A very beautiful, modern, clean apartment, I would definitely look to stay here again when I'm next in Florence.

Pieropaulo was by far the best Air BnB host we have ever had. He personally met us at his place, welcomed us with a bottle of wine, cold drinks and a fruit bowl. He thoroughly showed us around his house and walked us through the map and places of interest.
He was very responsive to our emails and assisted us with calling a cab and restaurant suggestions.
His apartment is beautiful it is very modern and clean and is located in the heart of Florence. It is a short stroll to the central train station.
I only ever book with super hosts on air BnB, after staying with Pierpaolo I think they need to revise the criteria because he is beyond AMAZING!
We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend that you stay with him.
Monica
Melbourne, Australia

The place is amazing! Close to everything and yet very safe and calm! Nice modern apartment, with everything you need for a few days in thiz amazing city! But the best thing by far is Pierpaolo. Definitely the best host we have had in ABNB ever! Very helpful, communicative, gave us the best advices on where to go, visit and eat, helped us with reservations... again he is the BEST! Don’t think other place, stay in his place!

Pierpaolo is amazing, pretty much like a personal concierge for your stay in Florence. The apartment is exactly as pictured, very comfortable and safe. Close to train station and buses. Florence is pretty much a walkable town and this is a great spot. He took the time to recommend places, highlights and even shopping spots. He even made reservations for dinner for us one night. Communication is excellent and this is true Italian hospitality! Thanks again.
Pierre is warm hearted host with splendid apartment, the location is ideal and the facility is premium
Perfect blend of local neighborhood and locale to attractions.  The smell of the pastries in the morning from the bakery downstairs is priceless.  Has everything.

Pierpaolo was probably one of the best hosts I've met. 👍 He was communicative and super helpful leading up to our trip. He did not only make some amazing restaurant recommendations, he also took time to book dinner reservations in advance for us. He also helped arrange rapid covid test appointment that we had to change the time/day a few times. On the day of our arrival, he greeted us at the door and made the whole trip enjoyable with all his kindness and hospitality!
The apartment is modern, clean, comfortable and central to all major attractions.
Overall, we very much enjoyed the apartment and would be very happy to stay there again!! I'd definitely recommend this place to my family and friends!

Pierpaolo’s place is the best! He made us feel so welcomed and kept us informed of everything we needed for an amazing few days in Florence. The place is clean, spacious, in a great location, and has all the amenities to make for a pleasant stay. I would recommend his place to anyone going to Florence. Grazie mille Pierpaolo!
Great location! Easy to find, right by the train station. Pierpaolo was very responsive and helpful with our questions. Highly recommend!

This was a great place and great location. The apartment is super nice, all modern, no detail spared.
We loved the location, right next to a Bar(coffee shop) and a fantastic bakery and short walking distance from everything you want to do in Florence.
If you want to try a cooking class ask Pier for help and he’ll connect you with a fantastic place to take classes.
Overall a wonderful experience

I cannot say enough about how wonderful this apartment is. While the building is from the early 18th century, the apartment is extremely modern, comfortable and well furnished.
Pierpaolo is a wonderful host. We had daily communication from him as he wanted to make sure all was well. He was extremely helpful with restaurant suggestions and even booked a tour for us.
The apartment location is ideal. It is very close to the train station making it easy for day trips. The river is nearby and the Duomo is 10-15 minute walk.

It was wonderful experience in Firenze! thanks to Paolo's apartment. Quiet, safe and super tidy and super clean😊 well-equipped also like a hotel.
Restaurants he recommend were also tasty.
He responded quickly and was very helpful for everything👏 thanks a lot again.
I will love to stay here again, when i visit Firenze later.

Definitely a hidden gem. This apartment is so close to everything. We walked everywhere. There is even a grocery store right beside it and a great bakery. I would recommend this apartment to anyone. We absolutely loved it!

We stayed in Florence for two nights prior to a cycling tour in Tuscany. We loved the area. Super close to the river and the train station and within walking distance of the museums. Pierpaolo was so kind to meet us upon arrival, show us the place and then give a quick introduction to Florence on a map. He gave some great recommendations for restaurants and places to visit. He made it very easy to feel comfortable during our stay.

Pierpaolo's place was amazing. The apartment was modern, pristine clean, and had everything we needed for a quick one day visit. It's walking distance to great restaurants and incredible historic sites, so that made it extra special. My husband and I can't wait to visit again!

This was the best Airbnb I ever stayed in. I felt at home and at peace the whole time. He had everything I needed. And everything was super clean and super nice. Better than the pictures. I love the shower it was amazing. The sink was nice and big has space for everything I needed. The toilet was comfortable and easy to use. The bed was comfortable. It was quiet at night. It smelled great. It was better than I could’ve ever asked for. And the host is so nice you feel so at ease right away. I felt very safe in the area and in the apartment. I will definitely rebook when I go back to Florence.

Pierpaolo was very helpful with planning our stay and a fabulous host.
The apartment is spacious and beautifully laid out with all the amenities you could need.
It’s in a lovely area with all the city attractions and fantastic restaurants within a short walk.
Lovely cafe and bakers downstairs as well.
We had a fabulous stay and would highly recommend to others.
Ciao

This apartment is in a great area, surrounded by restaurants, shops, and historical sites. It was clean, and we were greeted at the door and made to feel very welcome, with help getting reservations at a very good restaurant. It was not easy to access the site by car, but because of the ease of communication, that small problem was taken care of easily and efficiently. Thanks for a great stay!

Nice, clean room, convenient place, close to Mandela Forum. I didn't see Francesco, just texts, not always friendly texts. Overall my stay was ok, as I left early in the morning and came back late in the evening.

Nice and confortable room ideal for short stay. Francesco and other members of his family are very friendly and helpful. The apartment is close to bus stops and about 3kms to city center. Thank you again Francesco

The hostess and her daughter are very kind and warm-hearted. It is not difficult to find this place and the room is wonderful. It is a little far from the city center but you can easily take the bus. I will live again if I have the chance to go to this city again.
The room was clean and the beds were comfortable. It was in a great central location to Florence.
Giorgio has been very helpful, and room is very big and clean and comfortable. Very nice experience staying here! Thank you!
The host Najat was very friendly and welcoming. The apartment is in a good location in Florence near the train station and within walking distance of the historical centre of Florence.
The room was very spacious and just as described. It was easy to find and in a great location close to the train station, the mercato centrale and a laundromat around the corner.
Najat was a very attentive host and very helpful. The room was situated very centrally which was ideal. Would stay here again no problem

She is so smart and kindness.
So I was staying to be comfortable at there.

Very responsive host, super friendly.
Cozy apartment, close to all the great tourist attractions.
Would definitely recommend.

Great location!
Very close to train station and major attractions of the city!
Kitchen facility was well equipped & quite useful!
The apartment was nicely decorated and very clean!
The host is friendly enough and helpful!

One of my best Airbnb hosts ever. Giorgio was extremely easy to communicate with, and offered us many possible check-in times as well as information on what parts of the city we should visit. His place was very comfortable and situated walking distance from most major tourist hotspots. I would recommend this space to anyone wanting to stay in Florence.
Nice place. Room is big and very comfortable. Giorgio and his dad were very nice. Quiet place and very clean.

A must recommended place to stay in Florence! :)
Great host :
The host is very kind, generous and quick responses. He welcomed us and also help us with 3 big luggages all the way up to the apartment with a stair elevator. As well as the check-out, he prepared our luggages downstair which really save our time.
Good location :
The apartment located near the train station, right in the middle of a city centre and many interested places to visit. The apartment surrounded with various restaurants and market that you would feel really safe when going back at night.
Smooth check-in and check-out :
The host let us leave the luggages before the check-in time and also for the check-out time which we came back to grab the luggages in the afternoon.
5-star to the place and the host!!!
Very near to Fierenze station. Host is very kind. I had a very happy time in Fierenze.

Staying at Irene & Alan's apartment was great. It is peaceful, spacious and cozy as well. Many places to visit are just around the corner. Alan was very helpful and really makes you feel at home. We recommend this flat to anyone coming to Florence!

Apartment was very clean with a great  courtyard for sitting outside. In addition, it was easy to find and a great location. Irene was out of town, but her friend met us and gave us some great recommendations of things to see, places to eat, and places to have a drink. We would definitely stay here again!

I have been to Florence many times, and this was easily my best stay. I was there about a month, and the place had everything I needed, and was the most convenient stayi have had.it takes a minute to walk to the duomo even at a snail's pace, and is easy to get to anywhere you would like to go in the city since Florence is a relatively small city to begin with, but mainly that it is right in it's heart. Alain was a great host. He was very friendly, responsive and helpful. The place had laundry which was amazing for a month's stay. In short, if you come to Florence, this is where to stay. Next time I am in Florence I plan to stay here again.
We had a great stay here.  Nice amenities.  Good location.  Alain gave us plenty of good recommendations upon arrival.  I would definitely stay here again.

In January 2016, two adults and one teenager stayed in this centrally located apartment. It is small, but adequate.
The beds are comfortable, but the door separating bedrooms does nothing to mute sound. Small bathroom, but lots of hot water.

The Good:
- location and security
- cleanliness
- water pressure
- host friendliness and attempt to address the heating issue (a workman attempted to fix the thermostat and we were given extra blankets)

The Disappointing:
- The heat was turned off when we arrived.
- The apartment never got above 16 degrees (60 F), making the apartment uncomfortable
- No way to adjust the heat inside the apartment

Extremely convenient and quiet location just minutes from the Duomo. Very good value for the cost. The apartment provides all the necessities required. The beds are comfortable. There is a small neighborhood grocer very nearby for any foodstuffs you would need. There is a community washer and dryer should you need it. Irene was available for any and all questions and was very sweet and friendly. I would definitely stay here again!

This was a great apartment for our family of four to explore Florence. We loved the way it was in the middle of everything yet still felt private and quiet. The clothes washing/drying room was very useful. Irene and Elisa were helpful with communications/planning. Thanks!
Alain's apartment was clean, centrally located, and otherwise well-represented by the listing. Would very much recommend for a stay in the absolute center of Florence
Great location in the heart of Florence. Despite this, the apartment was really quiet due to facing onto a central courtyard. Check-in and communication process was very good.

Great location with a great view of the dome idle the Duomo!  Nice space and very welcoming hosts!  Walking distance to great attractions and neighborhoods.   Secure and quiet in the middle of the city .

The location of this apartment makes it all the more worthwhile! The Duomo is in plain view and almost everything is in close proximity! The hosts are amazing and always available; checking in via text regularly to make sure everything was going well. The apartment is beautiful and despite being so close to tourist attractions, there was no noise problem whatsoever. Great place and great people!
Seamless and hassle free check-in. The location is great and you feel like duomo is in your backyard.

What a great stay we had in Florence. Everything in the apartment was what we needed, and we loved all the cool pictures/art. And the view of the Duomo from the courtyard coming/going was the icing on the cake.
This apartment is in an amazing location. Facilities were okay - hot water for the shower was limited, but the washing machine was fab/huge and greatly appreciated.

This apartment is so perfectly located. You walk out your door into the private parking area and can see the Duomo a block away. Inside, it's a well-equipped, clean and stylish place. The beds are comfortable, the kitchen has all the tools you'd need for quick lunch prep and the TV and wifi work perfectly. It is very quiet, despite having a hospital across the street (your home faces into a small garden parking lot rather than the road)
The only downside is in size. The bedrooms are big enough, as is the living room. The kitchen is suitable only for quick prep as there really isn't any counter space. The bathroom is tight. Specifically, the shower stall is extremely small.
Overall, a beautiful home and perfectly situated for touring.

Excellent location and a nice apartment. Easy to access and very secure. The beds were really comfortable and linen/towels were excellent quality. All the staff were so lovely and very helpful. Nothing was too much trouble and we had a great stay in beautiful Florence. Thanks for being great hosts!
We loved our recent 3 night stay here, the location is absolutely ideal. It was the perfect introduction to Florence and a terrific bargain as well. We can't wait to be back!!

The apartment is so well located, a great price, and we appreciated your help with all of the baby items.
Thanks so much for your help and communication - it was really exceptional! We have already recommended the apartment to family and are really happy to recommend it to other AirBnB travellers too!

Our stay at La Gabbia Del Grillo was amazing! The apartment was very cute and clean, and check in was very easy. It’s walking distance from everything we wanted to do during our stay! It was cold while we were there but the outside seating area was very nice and a great view of the duomo. The staff were very communicative and were so helpful when we couldn’t figure out the washing machine! Definitely a great place to stay.

Giorgio is a really nice and responsive host! The room is really clean and spacious for all four of us. The kitchen appliance is only available for breakfast which is quite hard for us since we're always eating something at night. Overall, we really love our stay and our room! ❤️
We had a really great time in the apartment. Te location is very good, everything is in walking distance. The hosts were really helpful and kind. Recommend choosing this place to stay

This apartment was fantastic and just as advertised. It was incredibly fresh and had everything you need (including great AC) with big windows and beautiful rooftop views. The location of the apartment was perfect. The only warning is that it is on the top floor of the building.

I had a wonderful stay in Antonio's apartment: it is perfectly located in the center of Florence, the check in and check out services are clear and well organized, Antonio has also been very careful and available to answer our questions. The flat has all the necessary equipment, it is calm and designed with taste. The perfect spot for a romantic stay in Florence.

Antonio's place was great- the location is fantastic and the apartment was gorgeous and as described. He went over and above to provide thoughtful touches to make our stay in Florence really special- thank you!

Loved the apartment and the location was great! All of the main tourist attractions were close by. Thank you Antonio and also a big thank you to Stefano for carrying my very heavy suitcase up the whole way to the apartment! We had a wonderful stay and hope to return some day in the future!

We had a wonderful 3 night stay and immediately felt at home in the apartment. The location gives you easy access to everything but is on a quiet side street so you feel like a local! Antonio and Stefano were caring hosts and gave us lots of great recommendations. We'd stay here again for sure!
We loved staying at Antonio's apartment - it is beautifully presented and has everything you need for a great stay in Florence. Antonio was a great host, highly recommend staying here!

Awesome place! Highly recommend. Great location: everything is near, one can go by foot everywhere, really close to the river so it's easy to walk to the bridge and experience the most beautiful sunsets,  lots of good restaurants in the neighbourhood and we found our favourite gelato place almost right around the corner (Gelateria Dei Neri). The apartment was great, just like in the pictures. However, the stairs were pretty steep and ponderous and could be too rough for some people. Antonio was friendly and helpful, he gave us good tips before and during our vacation and wanted to make sure everything was ok with us and that we were enjoying our stay!
We had a great time at Antonio's. The flat is stylish and tidy and equipped with everything you might need. The location is to die for!

Antonio’s place was charming with an unbeatable location. It was our first time booking with AirBnb. He made the entire process easy and had the best suggestions for our trip. There was even a bottle of wine waiting for us when we arrived. You’ll need it after 4 flights of stairs with your suitcase. We can’t wait to stay there again the next time we’re in Florence. Grazie Mille Antonio!

My husband and I really enjoyed our three-night stay at Antonio’s apartment. We felt very welcomed by Maria Elena who met us right when we arrived and showed us around the place. The apartment is spacious for two guests and very comfortable. Air worked well and bed was comfy! Pack light and be ready to haul your suitcases up 5 flights of narrow stairs - but worth it for the enjoyable stay at Antonio’s! We also loved exploring all of the suggestions Antonio provided, especially for restaurants, cafes, gelato, etc. Helpful to have some places in mind since there are so many to choose from in Florence. Would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone!

Antonio was a wonderful host on many levels! The apartment was absolutely lovely - clean, cozy, stylish - & in a wonderful neighborhood. Antonio went above & beyond to make us comfortable & himself available. His thoughtful recommendations for all over Florence made our stay even better than we could imagined. 10/10 would stay here again in a heartbeat.

We had a fantastic stay. We immediately felt at home. The apartment is absolutely amazing: perfectly located in the city centre of Florence, it is charming, comfortable and tastefully decorated. The view is great. Antonio is an excellent host. The communication was perfect and thanks to his great recommendations, we could discover the authentic spots of Florence. We had a wonderful stay: we definitely recommend Antonio and his beautiful apartment.

A great place in a great location in the center of Florence. It’s the top floor of a building so there are a good number of flights of stairs to climb so be physically prepared if you’re bringing big luggage. The entrance is on a cute side street right next to some popular street food vendors which was a great treat. The hosts are incredibly nice and accommodating and really know their way around the town! A great place for young couples trying to enjoy what Florence has to offer.

Antonio’s place was perfect for our stay in Florence.  The location is great, a 10-15 minute walk from all of the major attractions.  The place is well appointed and Antonio’s partner met us for check in, which was helpful.  The apartment is located on the top floor, so there are 4-5 flights to navigate with suitcases, something to be aware of.  All in all, we were very happy with our stay and would certainly book here again.  Antonio was great with communicating with us and we appreciated his recommendations.

The apartment was perfect for our stay in Florence! It's in a great location for walking to all of the sites, and right in the center of many cute restaurants. Antonio was easy to communicate with and the apartment was in great condition. Would highly recommend!
A centrally located place and a highly resourceful and responsive host. The location made it easy for us to access all the places we wanted to visit. Much thanks Antonio:)

Absolutely top notch experience. I’ve never stayed somewhere with a more accommodating host - he was fully available and communicated with us throughout our stay to check in on how we were doing, to offer accommodations, and even to order a taxi for us as we checked out. The home is charming and exactly what we needed to feel like locals! Cannot recommend this spot more!

Antonio’s place was amazing! It was within walking distance to major attractions and great restaurants. The space was nice and just what we needed to start off our stay in Italy on the right foot! Antonio also checked in often and gave excellent recommendations for places that was much appreciated :)
Antonio's place was perfectly situated, clean, and comfy. Antonio gave really great local suggestions including not well known spots. Highly recommend!
Great quiet street in central location. A comfortable home away from home with everything you could need. Antonio is a fantastic host with plenty of tips and advice on places to eat and visit.

I had an excellent stay at Antonio’s! He provided a ton of great recommendations for Florence. He even provided additional activities and recommendations for indoor activities on days that it rained. The flat is spacious and comfortable. Great location and super walkable to all the main attractions and restaurants. Antonio’s communication is top notch!
I wish I can remodel my condo like this!  Perfect Upgraded with artistic furniture!  The host is very excellent with great and prompt responses and proactive information.
It was a beautiful flat and in a perfect location! The recommendations on different restaurants, local walks, and sites were  excellent.
We loved this space bright, clean and spacious.  Do note it is up 4 floors no elevator but worth it. close to everything you want to do and the host is fantastic.

We loved staying here! Not only was it super close to the tourist attractions but it was also right next door to many amazing restaurants and cafes! Additionally, Antonio was the most helpful and responsive airbnb host I’ve ever encountered on this site. 10/10 experience :)

Antonio was very responsive and friendly The place was in a great location that was close to many sights and places to eat. It was clean and tidy. Our family of three was comfortable here. The kitchen and bathroom were fully stocked as well.
The apartment is on the 4th floor, so a lot of stairs which would not be appropriate for anyone with mobility issues or carrying large items. Pack light!

David's place was really nice and cozy. The 6 of us had everything we needed. The apartment is at a 20 minute walk from the city center, and the place is sourrounded with coffee shops, pizza places and it also has a supermarket nearby. We really enjoyed our stay.

Excellent host. Lovely apartment across the street from a really nice cafe. Great for the morning coffee. Apartment is well stocked, clean and air.conditioning works very well. About a 20 minute stroll to the heart of the city centre. Be aware there are about 4 flights of stairs. It was fine but if you're not able bodied, you will struggle. Well recommended.

This was one of the best AirBnB experiences of mine. From start to finish it was smooth with a fine taste. David arranged us to have the keys to a very clean apartment hours before the actual checkin. And left us a bottle of Chianti? Wow. That was an experience.
The location was very convenient. 15-20 minute walk to the historic center with loads of gastronomic gems.
Last but not the least, David has a great library filled with books, movies and excellent music that just elevated our mood.
Grazie mille

We all thoroughly enjoyed our stay at David'a apartment in Florence. The location was even more convenient than I expected - we could easily walk to the Duomo and other major sites within 20 Minutes, and the neighborhood felt safe with cute cafés and boutiques. David was very easy to communicate with and five people fit comfortably in the apartment. It was clean and comfortable. I would definitely recommend and would stay again!

It was the best apartment during our trip to Italy. It has everything you may need. The host was very helpful. We were pleased to be met with a bottle of complimentary wine. It takes about 15 minutes of walk to all major attractions.

Antonio is truly a super-host!  He helped us make the most of our visit with his helpful recommendations.  The location is great.  We were able to walk everywhere after we arrived.  We took taxi from the airport and on our way home we took a taxi to the train station.

Antonio is a great host! He is very responsive and gave us a lot of local recommendations for Florence and a few other cities we were going to! We were planning on going to a soccer game that got canceled and he helped us find tickets for a different game in Florence. The apartment was very clean and within walking distance to everything we hoped to see and do in Florence. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb!

Antonio was the best!! Such a great host.
The location of the apartment was perfect, surrounded by great food and hangout spots!

Antonio was an amazing host! He made our stay at his flat and in Florence wonderful. He gave so many recommendations for local restaurants and activities. Checked in with us daily and he allowed us to drop our bags in the flat before check in time so we can enjoy Florence. Thank you, Antonio, for being a wonderful host!

We had an excellent stay in Florence at Antonio’s place. Antonio provided lots of excellent recommendations and was very helpful during our stay. His place was beautifully decorated and felt very homely. I loved the journal book there where all previous guests have shared their experiences and recommendations.
The only minor downsides are there are lots of stairs to get up to the apartment so be mindful if you have any mobility issues or struggle lifting your suitcases up stairs (8+ flights).

David's place truly is a great find in Florence. Its a bit removed from the tourist areas (20 min walk) but it was exactly perfect for us.  The apartment was in great condition and David's book, art and music collection added more character to our stay in Florence. Would recommend this place to anyone who is looking to visit Florence
Very beautiful, clean and cosy flat about 1km from the centre. Everything went perfectly fine. David has been very friendly and corteous.

Antonio’s place was great for our stay in Florence. It is conveniently located near the Uffizi museum and Palazzo Vecchio which made it easy to walk to anywhere in the heart of Florence. The location near the river made it very easy to explore the Oltroarno (across the river) as well.
The flat is the perfect size for a couple or small family. Be aware that it is at the top of the building so there are many stairs.
The best part of staying at Antonio’s place was his guide book and recommendations. He provided a detailed guide of Florence and local spots. We didn’t need to research anywhere to eat because we used his guide and it always delivered! It felt like we had a personal travel host with Antonio.
Highly recommended this place if you are planning a trip to Florence!

We loved our stay in Florence! The location was perfect and the home was so cute! The bed was very comfy!! Antonio was amazing and was quick to reply when we had any questions about Florence. He gave amazing recommendations! We can’t say enough amazing things about this home. Thank you Antonio xx
Very nice spacious flat located 20 mins from the centre of Florence. David’s communication was quick and check in/out was easy - all in all a great trip.

The apartment looks like on the picture. There was everything my family and I needed. The location is nice, the neighborhood is very nice. Felt safe.
David was very responsive. I would stay at David’s again!
Thank you
Very well located place. David is very carring and helpful host. In the apartement is every thing You need to spend nice time.

David's apartment is simply amazing! Sunlight at all hours, in a lively neighbourhood just a quick stroll from the city centre. We stayed there for over fifteen days and enjoyed every minute of it. We did not know that due to security concerns only one set of keys is provided per group of guests; this is perfectly understandable, of course! Just keep in mind that if your group is not going to go everywhere together it may require some coordination. This is just a minor issue, of course, and have we mentioned the apartment is just amazing? :)

Lovely spacious apartment in a great location!!
Nice restaurants close by.
Easy to communicate with David.
I recommend his place.

Great location in a quieter part of Florence while still being close to major sights. You can walk to them or take a bus to them. The place is spacious and the kitchen is well equipped. Lots of very interesting books around which we loved.
There were some hiccups with our stay (biggest one was issues with the WiFi), but David was very communicative and accommodating and I'm hopeful issues will be resolved for the next guests.
The flat is nice and placed in a great area for tourists. David is a great host as he responds quickly and cares about his guests. I strongly recommend this host and this place.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at David’s place. We were near some great shops including the coop supermarket and about a 20 minute walk to city centre. The beds were comfortable and the kitchen had everything we needed to make our breakfasts. Thank you David

Lovely spot. Not too far from the centre. Quiet neighbourhood at night. Co-op 5 minutes from door. Bins were a bit of a pain because they are locked with an app (which I could probably have gotten to work eventually) but a neighbour helped us out. The bin thing will apply to every flat in the city anyway.
Everything you need for visiting the city.

WOW! This is the BEST Airbnb we have stayed in. The pictures show a spacious roomy suite and that is exactly what it was. We are a family of 4 and there was plenty of room. Mariangela met us at the apartment and gave us an orientation the apartment and what was around us in the city. Apartment was well stocked, clean and very tastefully decorated. Mariangela left us a gift of delicious biscotti and some chocolates and was so quick to respond to any of our questions. We walked everywhere from her place and it is a 5 minute walk from the Firneze train station. The shower was awesome...big with enough hot water which has not been the case in many of the other airbnb's we have stayed in. Definately would love to come back here when/if we come back to Florence. Thank you so much Mariangela.

Unbeatable location within very short walking distance from station and to most of sightseeing spots. Great and complete amenities with fully equipped kitchen, cookeries, cutleries and even spices!! Very clean and spacious apartment. Great host and she was very kind to allows us to keep luggage in the flat until mid afternoon before next customer check in. 10/10!!

Mariangela was a wonderful host from the start of our booking.
She answered our inquiries quickly even weeks prior to our arrival.
She was very thorough with the arrival aspect and gave us great tips relating to the area.
The loft was just as pictured. It was simply beautiful and roomy. It was just the right size for our family of four. The washing machine was a bonus as well.
We were steps from the Medici Chapel and minutes to the Duomo. There were endless restaurants to choose from, a grocery store extremely close by and an amazing Gelato place a block away.
If we return to Florence, we hope to call the Purple Suite our home again!
Thank you Mariangela for being an exceptional Host!

Great location, very clean apartment with AC, definitely comfortable. Mariangela helped me to find my lost luggage - she contacted me immediately when the airport contacted her and responded to my messages just as quickly. Thanks for a great stay!

Wonderful place to stay in the heart of Florence!  Stayed for 8 nights and walked everywhere.  Mariangela is a fabulous host!  Very personable with lots of recommendations.  Her communication skills were exemplary - I was hurt and she reached out to offer her assistance multiple times.  The Purple Suite is bright and happy - a nice place to come back to after a day of sightseeing.  Highly recommend!

Mariangela is THE BEST host on Airbnb. We stayed at the purple suite long term and thoroughly enjoyed our experience. She was super helpful with any questions we had and responded right away. She went above and beyond to make sure we had what we needed and were comfortable in the apartment. The suite itself is gorgeous. The location is a 15 minute walk from most attractions and has some great restaurants in the area. The view is hard to beat as well. Both the A/C and heating worked very well during the winter months and summer months. I 100% recommend this listing. You will be well taken care of!

Mariangela was a fantastic host -- very informative, responsive, and welcoming. I arrived several hours late due to train delays, and there was still someone there to meet me when I arrived. The place is great and right in the middle of beautiful Florence.
Thanks Mariangela!

This stay was the highlight of our European trip! From booking to check out, the team of ladies were phenomenal. Beautiful apartment, spacious, clean and amazing location. Book this! You won’t regret it!
Alessio was an amazing host. The apartment was clean and tidy, 10 minute walk to everything you want to see in Florence!

The space was exactly what I needed. The location was close to the train station and walking distance to everything in the guide book.  Cristiana gave great recommendations for food, shopping, running paths, anything I asked.  It was a great experience.

Staying with Cristiana & Marco was an absolute joy. I got to Florence and was so tired and worn out but a beautiful chat with Cristiana with her passion for her town and the locals insite into where to eat and what to visit was infectious and was so genuine and helpful. Florence become my favourite place I visited in Italy. The room was very spacious and could not be faulted. Location perfect. An absolute wonderful place to stay would recommend to everyone. Thank you x

Great hosts, wonderful space, good location.  It can be very difficult wading through the many housing options available through airbnb, and you always take a bit of a chance when making the final booking.  Rest assured that you will find a comfortable space (both physically and psychologically) in the home of Marco and Christiana.  They are a friendly and gracious couple, and Christiana's breakfast sets the bar very high for other hosts.  I recommend whole-heartedly!

Cristiana and Marco are very warm, welcoming and helpful.  Loved that they sat down with us having breakfast together and held a conversation with us. They showed their interest in what I did and how I spent my time in Florence.  Cristiana was very helpful in providing sightseeing and dining options in Florence.  The place is clean and tidy and in a convenient location (close to the train station). It is also very close to the river which provides a nice morning jog or walk :)

Cristiana and Marco were amazing hosts! I was provided detailed instructions from Cristiana prior to arriving in Florence and surprisingly did not get lost :). Their home is adorable, well kept and makes you feel right at home. The room was great and located in the home where it provide privacy. Cristiana was so kind to provide a map upon my arrival and highlight recommendations of places to see and eat. You must try what's recommended...still my favorite of all the foods I ate in Flornece. Breakfast was also provided each morning and it was great getting to know the other guest staying there over breakfast. I can't wait to return to Flornece and this is where I will stay again! Thank you Cristiana and Marco for your genuine hospitality!

Cristiana and Marco were amazing ! they were most welcoming and basically gave us the best tips and recommendation of where to go and what to see. We really enjoyed talking together and they're great hospitality and advises really made our trip to Florence be one to be remembered !

The location is right on the center, located only 5 minutes of walking from the central train station (the bus from Florence airport dropping location). Walking to the main district shouldn't take more than 10 minutes.

The breakfast was great ! The room was clean and "styled", and the shared bathroom was always clean (unless told by Cristiana, we wouldn't be aware that there were guests in the other room).

This was the first experience in AirBNB for us and I can only hope the next ones will be similar to this one - really recommended if you plan to visit Florence !!!

Staying at Marco and Christiana's was one of our best Airbnb experiences. Marco and Christiana are super friendly and love sharing their insider tips of Florence. The location is perfect- the central train station is a five minute walk away and you easily reach all of Florence's main sites on foot. Breakfast was great especially the pastries that Marco gets daily from the bakery. Christiana has the best tips for where to go to eat. Definately stay here if you want an authentic Airbnb home stay experience.

I have to say that I enjoyed a lot in Cristina and Marco's BnB. They were so kind and helpful .I could feel the charming of Cristina through our morning conversation in breakfast and I understood Italian more because of them . I highly recommend everyone who will come to Florence to stay with them and you wont regret.And Hope to see u Cristina and Marco in China again.I will be the tourist guide next time :)

Thanks so much to Christiana and Marco for a fabulous stay in Florence. The recommendations around food and places to see were 'perfetto' for us.
