The bed and pillows were superb, the location was the best as was the lovely breakfast. Great conversations too which gave us some insights into life in Italy.

The hosts are very welcome! She introduced lots of places and restaurants to go which are very good. Also, she offered very delicious breakfasf for us. Really considerate!! She replied our message immediately. The location is heart of Florence, very close to Firenze station and every tourists attractions. very recommend this place. I will return here if I visit Flonace in the future again.
Amazing Airbnb in the heart of Florence! Easy walking distance to everything you could want. A lovely breakfast and conversation included every morning. Very well informed and helpful hosts.
We're so happy to stay in Cris's house. It's very nice and cozy apartment. Cris was so helpful and supportive. If i come back, i will definitely book this place again ❤️

We had a great stay at Cristiana and Marco's wonderful home. We appreciated their hospitality very much as all was very familiar. The flat is very local and the included breakfast was a good start into the day! Grazie mille, also for all your recommendations e a benvenuti!

Without a doubt my best Airbnb experience so far. Cris and Marco are outstanding hosts who truly understand what it means to run a bed and breakfast. Great touches to the place like a water bottle with my name on it. The house is charming and Cris and Marco make for great conversation too. I even practiced my Italian with them :) If you're in Florence, you absolutely must stay here and look nowhere else!
This is a nice place to stay in Florence, just a little bit hard to find! Marco and Christiana are lovely and the room is very cute.
Great place, close to the train station and walkable to town. Nice host, very friendly and very clean place.

Outstanding hospitality, Cristiana really goes out of her way to give advice on the best things to do, see and eat in Florence. Comfortable room and great, quiet location near SMN station and within walking distance to all major attractions. Would definitely stay again.

Stellar place. A true Airbnb experience with hosts genuinely interested in meeting people and sharing their way of life in Florence. Brilliant tips for where to go (outside the touristic areas). The location is perfect and I without a doubt stay here each time I go back to Florence.

Marco and Cristiana were great hosts! They were very helpful with giving me directions and recommendations for places to eat. Their apartment is also in a great location near the train station and within walking distance to many of the main attractions in Florence. I would definitely stay at Marco and Cristiana's place again.

I had a great time staying at Cristiana & Marco's, the room was nice and clean.
Don't hesitate to ask Cristiana for restaurant recommendations, they were all perfect :)
Comfortable and quiet environment, perfect location, warm and considerate landlord, all the conditions are great!

This was an excellent place to be hosted for my visit to Florence, and a highlight of my trip to Italy. You can expect to have some of the best insights into local sights and experiences, a comfortable place to relax, and have the option to also enjoy the a great breakfast (highly recommend!!).
I enjoyed insightful conversations with the hosts, and couldn’t ask for a better place to be. I look forward to returning here in the future!

Very central location, cozy spotless room.
Everything great, except no lift in the building.
Thank you so much Marco and Cristiana.
It was a lovely experience. I had no problems and Cristiana was really helpful with everything I asked and about the city itself.

Had a fabulous stay! The apartment is beautiful. Cristiana was very welcoming and provided her own little map of recommendations which was so helpful and we enjoyed many of her recommendations.
Thanks for a fabulous stay!!!

Had a wonderful stay at Marco and Cristiana’s house. A great location near the florence train station and walkable to many tourist sites. Cristiana is very friendly and helpful. She provided a map of many good restaurants too. The room was cozy and clean.

Marco and Cristiana's place is conveniently located near the centre of Firenze--it took me around 15 minutes to walk to the central market and the big church next to it. She's also very kind that she provided me a map that highlights all the local favorite restaurants.
A great place to stay. Cristiana is very nice and had lots of recommendations about where to eat and spend time!

This location was PERFECT - walking distance from truly everywhere I wanted to go - the AC worked great, and Cristiana was a kind host who provided an incredible personally-made map of cool places to check out around the city. Also: the cat was cute. Would strongly recommend this airbnb!
Marco and Cristiana are such nice people and their apartment was very welcoming, clean, and comfortable. I’ll absolutely stay here again the next time I’m in the lovely city of Florence! A++

It was one of my best airbnb experiences. Besides having a super clean, cozy place in a walking distance to every main attraction in city, Cristina and Marco are such cool and warm people. I especially loved our conversations with Cristina in the mornings with a warm cup of herbal tea and cookies they put on dining table for the guests. I’ll check their availablity next time i travel to Firenze for sure. Thank you for everything guys.
Very nice place. Amazing aircon. Close to all attractions and train station. Very helpful host as they provided a personal map of everything close.
Excellent location to explore Florence. Host was friendly and gave us great suggestions for things to see and where to eat and drink. Room was clean and comfortable.
Cristiana and Marco were great. Cristiana had a whole pdf with places to eat/see/drink. The room was cozy and the location was excellent. Highly recommend!!
Cris and Marco are super friendly and helpful. They were responsive and gave the guests great privacy. The location is very convenient and close to everything. I highly recommend their place.

Thanks to Marco and Cristiana! She was so lovely and friendly and gave us a lot of recommendations for Florence, which made our journey more enjoyable! The room was very clean and nice, even the bathroom.
Best Airbnb experience I even had!
Excellent hosts with amazing recommendations! The location is perfect, everything you want to see is within a 15-30 minute walk!

Our stay here was very good ! Cris greeted us as we were walking up to her apartment. She gave us a map of recommendations for icecream, food , attractions spots. She really went above and beyond to make sure our stay was comfortable. The place is good walking distance to train station and to major attractions.
We had a great time at Cristiana's house. She is kind, friendly and helpful. Thanks for the tips on how to have a great experience in Florence.

Marco & Cris are truly exceptional hosts! Their warm, welcoming energy made my solo trip unforgettable. The room was sparkling clean and had everything I needed. Cris’s passion for life is contagious, and our chats were a highlight:) she’s definitely one of the most memorable person I met on my travels! Their adorable cat was the cherry on top. Highly recommend!
Flavia was a wonderful host and our stay at her apartment was great! It was in a central location and everything was as pictured.

Nice location, close to everything. Mariaflavia was really a nice host!
Air conditioning would be a nice plus!
Very nice room and perfect location! The hostess was very helpfull and gave good tips for visiting Florence.

We didn't meet Flavia when the arrival, but her friend, Andrea, was really friendly. The wifi is kind of not too fast but traffic here is convenient. Less than three minutes by foot to the bus station.

This was a nice little flat with a large kitchen and living room area, the balcony was good addition.  The area is pretty nice, theres a market five minutes away and a good little bakery on the street corner (we went there every morning!).
We had a great stay at Flavia's place. It is very close to Santa Croce, a supermarket, restaurants and accessible by public transport. The room was very clean too.
Flavia was a great host. She was easy to communicate with, and very quick to answer emails when we had any questions. The room was comfortable and spacious. We enjoyed our stay here!

Mr. Mauro and his wife, daughter were all so nice and super kind, warm hearted! They responded to my inquiries so fast and i could feel they are always willing to help me well!
The location is so good that i could walk to every spot including central city, museums etc, and there are 2 markets - coop and carrefour - nearby that i could by things easily. The home is also not far from the arno river that i walked in the morning. And there is also a bus stop nearby!
The room is well equipped that i could stay without any inconvenience. And the room is very clean!
I highly recommend this beautiful house of Mr. Mauro's family, and i wish i can stay here again when i come again to Firenze. Grazie mille!!

Mauro has been a wonderful host.
The flat was clean and had all the necessities. I would happily stay here again.

Mauro & Rosanna are AMAZING hosts!!  They picked us up at the train station & took us to their lovely apartment for check in.  They were very helpful during our two week stay & came at the end to help us check out.  They were very quick to communicate at all times.  Such a special couple!  Great neighborhood & location.  Apartment is very well appointed.  We cooked in every night & had everything we needed.  Would definitely stay here again!!
Thank you Mauro, you and your wife were very helpful and kind to us. We loved your place it was beautiful and comfortable. ❤️

Everything was clean and well prepared, Flavia was a sweetheart and communication was uncomplicated. The location is nice and close to the centre and good (less touristy) restaurants.
10/10 - would book again.
Mariaflavia was always available to help and gave me a hand whenever I needed it. A perfect host in every sense
Amazing place in Firenze Center,  Flavia is very easygoing the flat is fully equipped if you need anything. We had a very pleasant stay.
The apartment is really nice - not too hot inside when it is outside. There are many fans, the equipment (bed, kitchen etc) is perfect. Plus Flavia and her husband are really nice host.

Flavia is a nice, considerate and communicative host. She had left water bottles for us when we arrived, she has guide books available in multiple languages for guests to have a loot at. Her apartment is very well situated (10-15min by walk from everything, convenience stores 2min away), super clean, the checking in/out are very easy. By far the best Airbnb I have stayed in. I recommend her 100%!

We really enjoyed our stay here.
It was very close to lots of tourist attractions such as the Florence Cathedral and the host was very helpful and friendly.
Such a sweet place to stay! very close to nice viewpoints and the room was very clean and as pictured. flavia was very helpful and friendly, would love to come back soon!
Perfect stay if you don’t mind sharing the common spaces with one other room. Very central and everything is walkable from here. Great host and exceptionally clean.

Venus on the roofs of Florence was exactly as described and shown. Well appointed kitchen, comfortable beds (even the bunkbeds) and really nice cotton bed linens. Everything you needed was supplied. The very best thing however was it's location. We could have spent the whole week just walking around the immediate area as it is very near the Duomo and old city center. The Ambrogio Market just a couple blocks away was as beautiful to look at as the food was to eat and literally around the corner was a wonderful bakery for great sandwiches, pastries and of course espresso. Gianni was so patient about waiting for my arrival and was very helpful about everything we asked of him. He also responded fast when we needed his assistance. I would definitely stay there again and highly recommend it to everyone.

We loved this space! There were 5 of us and it was very comfortable, clean, and Gianni was accommodating. There were converters for the outlets and maps available. Everything was just like the photos and the listing. Gianni was very kind and even helped us to call our taxis for our trip to the airport in advance. He was very responsive. The neighborhood nearby was very cute with shops. I appreciated that it was slightly away from the main area of Florence, but a quick walk to Trevi fountain.
It was a pleasure to stay at this place, Gianni and his Son where really nice host - everything went quit well and easy! We would definitely go there again! Thanks for this lovely weekend

Gianni's place was awesome and he was a great host! He was very professional! He was waiting for us when we got there and even asked us the next day if we needed anything else! We were very close to all the major sites and there were great restaurants in the area!
The description and pictures are accuracte. Commucation was also great. Check in was easy and we were given a tour of the place and told about where to eat and see etc. Thank you

Lovely place to stay with all the amenities you need for a few days or more. Really close to the main attractions and great restaurants within walking distance. There is an ATM and supermarket close by which is great when you first arrive.

My friend and I were here for 2 days...the apartment was quiet and lovely. Close walk to everything without being in a loud area. Our host gave us great suggestions on places to eat and what to see. Would stay here again anytime.

Gianni is very kind and a wonderful host.
The apartment is beautiful and the location is also great!
He gave me a lot of useful information which was a ​big help for us.

The place was very tastfully done up and extremely clean. The Host was very responsive and went the extra mile to provide information and response to any and every question/ request I had. I enjoyed my stay and would definately stay here the next time I am in Florance. I highly recommend this place to everyone visiting Florance.

Wow!  What a great apartment for our family of five. There was more than adequate space for all of us and the location can’t be beat. Be sure to make Venus on your list of apartments in Florence!  It’s a must stay for families!

We had an excellent stay here. Gianna connected with us a few days beforehand to confirm check in time and provided tips on how to get to the AirBnB. Gianna was there to greet us and it was so lovely to meet with him. The place itself was perfect for a small group. Can't say enough about the location - close to restaurants, nightlife and landmarks but was also very quiet. Gianna was very accommodating when we asked to check out late, giving us more time to exlore the City. Would stay here again if I ever return!
The stairs are definitely steep and since we of course overpacked that made it more fun!!! The location was great !!! Our host was great!!! A very pleasant experience overall 😊

This apartment was stunning, and in a perfect area. Me and my friends walked to majority of the places we wanted to go. You are even able to walk to the train station if needed (recommend a taxi if you have suitcases). Ac was 10/10, which we appreciated a lot cause alot of ac’s weren’t working in other airbnbs in Italy.

What a wonderful family! There was a hiccup at check in but they rushed over to fix it and make sure we could get in quickly. The apartment is very spacious, close to the main attractions, and on a quiet street. Highly recommend
Ludovica went above and beyond during our stay to make sure we were comfortable. Excellent host and I will certainly be contacting her again if I come back to Firenze. Thank you Ludovica

Oh my gosh, what a great first stay here in Florence! Gianni and family were very helpful and communicative for our stay and it made the short stay worthwhile! The apartment is cozy and it made me feel like I was at home. It was perfect for 4 people and restaurants/cafes were in walking distance. The only thing though that caught us off guard were the 4 flights of stairs. It was intimidating at first but we did our absolute best when it came to climbing up the stairs! It was our own personal stair master, lol. All in all, we had a wonderful experience and can’t wait to come back and experience it again!❣️🇮🇹

Convenient location that isn't too far from the main attractions but also not too busy. The apartment itself was clean and aesthetic, with a nice view of the nearby temple. Keep in mind the four flights of stairs for each time you return/leave for any luggage/long journeys.
we enjoyed our stay aside from the stairs. once you reach the airbnb it is beautiful! central location and quiet area. will definitely stay here again!
Nice apartment for a group of friends or a family, the host was very kind and super reactive and the location is also very good in Florence !

Our stay at Ludovica’s place was wonderful. We really enjoyed the apartment and the surrounding city, it was in a perfect walking distance from everything we wanted to see in Florence. We highly recommend this stay.

Very clean and well located apartment, close to all touristic places.
Well amenities, nice kitchen, safe, good choice.

The location was fantastic.  Every direction in which we wandered we came across something amazing.  It is close to the the train station which makes day trips easy.  The market across the street has great food and drinks.  It was interesting to watch the street merchants load and unload their carts every day.  I had worried about noise but the apartment has great shutters (more like doors) over the windows which block out the noise.  The air conditioning worked wonderfully and we slept like babies.  The washing machine was a great.  Our host was very helpful and allowed us to store our luggage in the apartment before we had to leave for our flight in the evening.  Being able to leave out luggage after check out gave us another day to enjoy Florence.
Mauro is a great host. His apartment is lovely and in a great central location. Comfortable beds and very clean.  I would recommend it for families. I would love to visit again. Thank you Mauro.

We had a lovely stay at Mauro's apartment. It was clean and spacious. We loved the interior and the furnishings of the place. We also appreciated Mauro's hospitality. As a simple welcome gift, he graciously provided us with a bottle of wine and cantucci biscuits!

Pros - Superb location; very clean; easy check in & check out; excellent communication
Cons - location noisy. The market and neighbours
Perfect location.  Close to good restaurants, markets and landmarks. The apartament was clean and had everything we needed.  Good communication with host. Minor issue with A/C was resolved promptly.

We love Murao's apartment, it is so specious, so beautiful, so clean, beds were so comfortable, duvets were little too warm but apartment also have lighters covers available too in the cupboards.
Kitchen have all the essentials you ll need. Location is amazing, all the shops, restaurants, and everything you need to visit in Florence is just by walking distance few minutes away.
Murao was so helpful and really really very quick to response within seconds.
She welcomed us with a bottle of wine (which we didn't drink as we don't drink hahaha) but it was such a nice touch. Eva welcomed us very nicely and help us all the info we required.
Thanks a lot Murao, if we ever visited Florence again we will definitely stay at your place.

By far, the best place we've stayed. The Basilica is only 5 minutes away. Outside is the clothing market, across the road there is fresh veges, fruit, meat. Beautiful home, so many thoughtful gestures. Thank you so much for letting us stay in your home.

Our family had an excellent time at Mauro’s apartment. Everything was so close by, we didn’t have to use any public transport. There are clothing/jewellery markets are right outside and a fantastic food market in the building across the road. The kitchen was spacious and Mauro very kindly left us a wine bottle for our stay! Thank you for everything Mauro ❤️
Great location across from the markets where it was easy to go out for dinner every night. Apartment was clean and comfortable.

The apartment is super well located, near to the center but away from the tourists rush craziness, the neighbourhood is really quiet, it's ideal to rest.
Patrizia was really helpful giving us advices of what places to visit, where to eat.
I totally recommend this place and this hosts.

Very nice place
Hosts were quick to respond
However had some problems with getting the water hot for showers. Found out to put the shower on full power then it worked after a few minutes
Allergri loft was perfect for us! Great neighborhood and interesting people, shops, etc. If we ever come back to Firenze, we will stay here again!

What a gorgeous & perfectly Florentine apartment! My mom & I spent a few days at Patrizia's charming apartment & truly loved every moment. Besides that, Patrizia was an smacking host-- helping with directions, recommendations & reservations! Truly a magical place!

We enjoyed everything about our visit, which was enhanced by Patrizia's warm welcome, helpfulness, and excellent communications. The apartment was  very comfortable, and the Santa Croce area was perfect for what we wanted to see and do in Florence. We will be looking for opportunities to go back!

My husband and I had a great stay at Patrizia’s home this past week. The apartment was spotless and very charming. Upon arrival Patrizia greeted us with snacks, wine and maps / tips for exploring the area. So above and beyond what we expected. The street is quiet but very safe and a stones throw from all the main attractions in Florence. When we checked out Patrizia even called a cab for us to take us to the train station. Again - above and beyond the call of duty! You will not regret staying here!

Don't stay anywhere else in Florence! Patrizia is truly a Superhost, and goes well beyond what you would expect. She's also incredibly patient and kind to silly tourists - we locked ourselves out and she and her lovely brother were amazing.
Allegri Loft is a truly beautiful place. How many people can say they've stayed in a stunning 15th century ex-convent, complete with glorious antiques and a 17th century painting over the fireplace?
Patrizia welcomed us with many Tuscan treats, made my husband a REAL coffee on the stovetop, provided everything that we didn't know we needed and has created a perfect haven after a hard day's walking and soaking up the beauties of this perfect city.
Thank you, Patrizia and Paulo - we hope to be back some day XX
Patrizia’s apartment was in a great location and she is a wonderful host we would definitely stay there again. Everything you need and more was provided in the apartment.

We loved the easy access from Sante Croce to the historic downtown of Florence. Sante Croce was quiet, local feel, yet steps away. Perfect. The apartment was comfortable and lovely and Patrizia was a perfect host, whom we relied upon for several items of assistance.

Patrizia is a wonderful host and did everything to make our stay comfortable, personalised and very memorable! From the moment I booked the apartment she was proactive in communicating and throughout our stay she remained in touch and went further to add some breakfast items without extra charges and even booked us a taxi to the airport. The apartment itself is gorgeous, so tastefully done up and very comfortable. My parents loved the attention to detail that Patrizia had provided and all the instructions for using appliances, finding our way around etc were descriptive and very helpful. I don’t think we could have asked for a better experience in the wonderful city of Florence. Thank you Patrizia!
This was one of the best air bnbs I’ve stayed in! It was spotless. Partizia was a fabulous host. So kind and thoughtful.

We visited Florence for 7 days.  Patrizia was very accommodating upon check-in.  The apartment was ready early and we were allowed to get settled earlier than expected.  Everything was so clean, spotless and well organized.  Patrizia has done a wonderful job decorating the apartment.  Upon arrival, Patrizia was easy to communicate with and promptly met us so we could gain access.  She offered us a glass of pineapple juice while she reviewed a map of the city and highlighted local restaurants and attractions.  Wonderful location, easily accessible to shopping, museums and churches.  We would definitely stay at Patrizia’s apartment in the future and encourage others to as well.

This is the most amazing AirBnB, in possibly the best location, in perhaps the most interesting city I’ve ever stayed in. And without a doubt, Patrizia is the best AirBnB host I have ever encountered.  She is a masterclass in hosting, personally meeting her guests for checkin, taking the time to recommend and map the best restaurants and shopping options, and serving throughout the stay to answer any questions about the city.  She even arranged our taxi for a 4:45am pickup the day we left.  Do yourself a favor and stay here as long as you can.

Patrizia greeted is personally, gave us a tour and provided a map with wonderful suggestions for great food and activities.  We felt like we were living in Florence for the week - it felt just like home!

Had an amazing time at Patrizia’s apartment. Peaceful side street away from busiest areas but still close to all the main attractions. The host was incredibly kind and generous with her time recommending a number of restaurants and places to see. Don’t think the photos do the property justice as there is a lot more space than we excited, particularly upstairs. Could house 4-5 people easily. Would 100% look to book the apartment again if we revisit Florence

We had an amazing experience renting from Silvia! She was easy to communicate with and answered many of our questions before arriving. The apartment was spacious and in a great location. She's thought of all the small details and even had a lovely welcome basket of treats waiting for us on our arrival. You have everything you need to cook and relax in the apartment. The beds are very comfortable and everything is very new. We had a couple questions during our stay and she was quick to get back to us, and even ordered us a taxi to take us to the airport! We could not be happier with our stay and can't wait to go back!!

Silvia responds very quickly, the apartment was in a fantastic location and super quiet. There is a little shop directly across the road to buy milk, wine etc. There are many restaurants only a few metres away the pizza one on the corner was great. The heating was awesome as it was the middle of winter. It was very clean and tidy, photos are just as the apartment is.....nice touches of flowers on our beds.

The apartment is quite across the river in a walking building near coffee. , bakeries   Fine dining, a famous gelato shop. The beds were comfortable and would be enough room for two couples staying together. Clean and nicely decorated. Has washer and all needed amenities. Host was very gracious explained how to work things. Helped carry up luggage. Called cab for us. I would definitely recommend. Easy walking to major sites
Amazing location. Accurate description. Lovely and kind host. Very quiet yet right in the center of town which is a rare find in Florence. Definitely a five star property.
Great location, clean, spacious and cozy apartment, near the best gelato shop. Excellent communication with the hosts.

The apartment was lovely, we would definitely stay there again. It was clean and the bedrooms were decorated nicely. The location was very convenient. We walked to most of the city’s monuments (if you have mobility issues just keep in mind it is a 3rd floor walk up).  It was the perfect place to stay in Florence, and the best gelato is right downstairs. Silvia and Felix were also communicative and very helpful.
Wonderful stay. It felt like a special place. Would have been happy to rest at Silvia’s place rather than go out and see Florence. Cafe downstairs especially good and friendly.

Felix and Silvia’s place was perfectly located for us. We could easily walk to all of the Florence activities we wanted to do without staying in an area that was too crowded.  Although the front door appeared to be on a busy street, the unit was located in the center of the building and very quiet. We’d love to visit again when the temperature isn’t near 100°F every day :)  Arriverderci Firenze e Italia.

The perfect space in Florence! Close enough to walk to everything but out of the hustle and bustle of the tourist center. Near by a ton of delicious restaurants and a more local vibe. Silvia and Felix were lovely and extremely helpful. Would definitely recommend this space and would love to stay here again one day!
Excellent location, a really large and quiet place and super clean and homely. Will come back and stay again!

Lorenzo has been a fantastic host! He is very generous and welcoming host who has helped us fit into life into florence well. his apartment is beautiful and in a fantastic location in florence. We love it so much we have booked it again! Thankyou lorenzo for a wonderful experience.

Francesco is a perfect host, he received us, explained the most important sightseens and museums and arrange breakfast in a local cafe near the apartment. The apartment is brand new, we're a party of 7 and the bedrooms were spacious and clean. Nice stay in Florence thanks to Francesco!.

Francesco was an excellent host and the apartment was super lovely.

It was clean, modern and so close to all the main sights of Florence. It was perfect for a group of 4 girls. We felt at home.

Francesco was incredibly helpful with enduring we were settled in and gave us lots of tips for places to go and to eat. We took him up on his restaurant advice and it was excellent local food - off the beaten track.

Thank you so much for hosting us! Francesco was welcoming and flexible. He responded to our questions very quickly and was very helpful! The apartment is clean, cozy and situated in a perfect location, which is close to the main tourist attractions.
Francesco is a phenomenal host who attends to every detail! You won't be disappointed.

The place is very comfortable, clean and quiet. Location is so close to all the main attractions. The host is super friendly and giving a lot of insights. That made our visit to Florence extremely nice.

Very homey and comfortable. It has a pretty large bedroom and 2 bathroom which is perfect for group of 7 like us. Francesco waited for us to check in and explained everything about the house. He also gave us many recommendations for food and city attraction which very helpful for us.
Had a very nice stay here!

The location was excellent—within walking distance to many famous landmarks. The host provided clear instructions and also offered disposable items and toiletries, which was very thoughtful. Definitely recommended!
Andrea personally came to the apartment to help orient me to the place. The manual on the dining table is extremely helpful with useful information of Florence and the neighborhood.
Andrea was a very nice and symathic host. We loved the appartment near by the Arno. Everything was very comfortable. Thank you for a great time in Florence! Everytime again!

Andrea was a kind and helpful host spending time to explain to us the apartment (which was great modern and amazing location in the quiet and cooler/younger part of town but only 10 mins away from the centre and museums etc) and to recommend places to see and eat. We went to a restaurant that he visits and It was great! Would definitely stay here next time we visit Florence

Andrea was really helpful, especially considering we arrived so late after our flight was cancelled. The apartment is beautiful and in a great location to easily explore Florence. There are plenty of local cafes and we loved the bakery down the street for breakfast each morning.
Best apartment in a fantastic quiet location but walkable to every sight. Andrea was the best host I have ever had. I recommend this place in every way. We will be back!

Andrea met us and helped us carry our suitcases up to the apartment - he virtually carried everything.
The apartment has a great location a bit outside the very centre of Florence, but in easy walking distance to the Duomo and central shopping area.
Everything in the apartment was clean and fresh and we loved staying there. The apartment is light and bright, but also very quiet. Andrea was great, he even helped us order a taxi to pick our rented car.

Andrea was a most gracious host from start to finish, and the suite is lovely and spacious. Andrea was responsive to questions and emails leading up to arrival and during our stay. He was incredibly accommodating, helping my mom and I with our luggage, offering suggestions and assisting us with our taxi to the airport. The suite was modern, very spacious and clean. It's location on the other side of the Arno river offers the experience of living among the locals, while being a 15 minute walk from the busy tourist area. I loved our time here and would recommend to anyone staying in Florence!

We love this side of the Arno river and the apartment was really excellent. Our hosts Hanna and Andrea were warm and welcoming and provided lots of detailed information.  We look forward to repeating the visit at some point.

Hanna and Andrea's place inside was very nice. Modern,clean and a washer/dryer. Andrea met us and took the time to know us and explained his neighborhood . He and his wife live around the corner. The location across the river was very hip with locals and just enough tourists. Walking distance to the center of all the museums and churches. We highly recommend staying here when in Florence.

Andrea is a great host, very kind and he knows very well, what guests need. His hints and suggestions for sight seeing, restaurants, ice-cream and shops are great and very helpful. The appartment is just beautiful, very clean, cool, quiet  and central. We hope to come back soon and would highly recommend this awesome location.

We stayed for 5 nights in this lovely apartment, and found it an absolute gem.
The space itself is really charming, an old building with a very contemporary vibe to the flat itself. As this is a top floor flat, there are quite a few stairs worth considering for anyone with mobility issues.
Location is good, within a fair walking distance to most tourist sites (15mins walk usually) and with restaurants and amenities literally on the doorstep. Very quiet, peaceful neighbourhood- so we were never disturbed.
Andrea was an incredibly thoughtful host. He was very helpful and accommodating throughout our stay, giving us plenty of local hints and tips- leaving absolutely nothing lacking!
Would gladly stay again!

Our favorite Airbnb that we stayed at on this trip. Beautiful space, walking distance to everything you'd like to do, and very attentive and accommodating host. (Ask for restaurant suggestions, we ate some amazing food that was away from the classic tourist traps because of it!)
Hanna & Andrea's place was one word; stunning. Everything was so clean and well presented. Overall I was very comfortable throughout my stay and just wished I could have stayed longer.

This place was fantastic! Very centrally located, clean, and quiet. The hosts are also fantastic. Andrea gave us exceptional tips on what to do and where to go. He is truly one of the best hosts we have ever encountered, and we have been using Airbnb extensively for at least 6 years.

Firstly Andrea was the host you would wish for coming to Florence, particularly for the first time.
The apartment is in a fantastic location just far enough away from the city center that it's very quiet, but close enough you can walk to in 10 minutes.
The neighborhood feels like you are living like a local it's got great atmosphere and plenty of local restaurants, cafes and bars without going into the centre.
My husband had a dental emergency and Andrea was so wonderful in organising a dentist appointment with a wonderful dentist not far away, which we were so grateful for.
Communication is fantastic and the apartment (even though up a few flights of stair) was excellent. The stairs were a blessing sometimes to work off all the food.
I would not hesitate to book with Andrea and Hanna again

Andrea is an amazing host! Very friendly, extraordinarily uncomplicated man and very good on giving you great tips as a local who lives and love Firenze.
The flat is as described and the location is the best one can get in the central Firenze.

One of the better places I’ve stayed via AirBnB. Cozy yet spacious, Andrea and Hana’s place is a place to relax before an adventurous explore into the history of Florence. Located just a bit away from the crowdy and busy touristy area and just at the entrance of the Piazzale Michelangelo, the place has many small restaurants and bars surrounding it. The only complaint/word of caution is that it is located on 5th floor without an elevator, so be ready to hike up with your luggage (two 31” luggages in my case). Also, Andrea was extremely professional, friendly, and prompt in response and to questions. He gave very good suggestions and even has a booklet with all the numbers and places to go. Overall, it was a great place for us newly wed to stay in. Thanks Andrea.

Hanna and Andreas place is lovely. Great location, with restaurants and bars close by. The apartment was sparkling clean with everything we needed for our weekend in Florence.
Andrea met us and showed us round, and gave us lots of information on what to see and where to eat. The communication before the trip was fantastic and they even recommended restaurants for my birthday.
I would highly recommend this place, and will no doubt visit Florence again.
Overall, we had a good stay. Andrea was very responsive and easy to reach, and the location was great. I also liked the apartment.

We loved this place! Andrea greeted us and gave us some fantastic tips and history on Florence. The place is well located in the quieter and trendier place of Florence, an easy walk to Santo Spirito and a quick walk to the Uffizi. The apartment was clean and stylish, and the shower was very nice! Thanks for having us, we'll be back here when in Florence.
This is a cozy apartment in the heart of Florence. The location is amazing, the floor plan is even better and the hospitality was the best.
Super clean, stylish apartment in a wonderful location. Everything about this place was great, from the check-in process to sleeping on the comfy bed. We would definitely stay here again!

Great location, Hanna & Andreas space is in a nice part of Florence a little bit away from the touristy center of the city. Only an easy 5-10 minute walk to get to anything in that area. Andrea was very helpful with laying out to us his recommendations about what to do with our time in Florence.

Andrea was more than happy to meet us around midnight when we needed to check in as we had a late flight. He stayed to give us some info about the city which was welcomed! The apartment was beautiful and spacious, very clean too! It was in an amazing location too - down our street alone we had a speak easy bar, bakery, groceries shop, fruit shop and multiple eateries/bars - including the best pizza place we’ve ever eaten at, I’Pizzacchiere. A short 15 minute walk to Ponte Vecchio, but we found the smaller bridge closer to the apartment was quieter and had a lot of cheaper restaurants/bars. Thanks Hanna and Andrea
Andrea, was a very good host. Warm and caring. Definitely, a place worth staying.

Thank you for being such a wonderful host. Your passion for Florence is amazing. We enjoyed the book you made with all the great information. You were also so quick to respond to us.
My sister and I thank you so much!

Do yourselves a favour and stay here! Andrea was an amazing host and the apartment is so beautiful and unique. It’s in the perfect location - close to everything! We absolutely loved it. Thank you Andrea and Hanna!

Quiet apartment, great location away from the chaos at the center of the city. Lots of great restaurants nearby, options for breakfast, dinner, wine, groceries. Only complaint is one of the beds was not terribly comfortable but doable for the 3 nights. Andrea kindly checked us in early and gave a thorough review of the apartment, showed us the map of the city and gave suggestions on what to see. All around a great stay!

Great location. Host was gracious and was flexible in checking us in early. The shower was extremely small for a heavier person. The elevator was definitely a plus.
Great place to stay in Florence.

Exceptionally clean and comfortable air bnb. Lovely part of Florence that feels more local away from the throngs of tourists. Very quiet and peaceful stay. Hosts were kind and easy to communicate with. Really enjoyed my stay. Highly recommend.

My husband and I stayed for a month with our son, and it was wonderful. The location is surrounded by wonderful restaurants but is also nested in a beautiful natural setting. Andrea was a helpful, responsive, and kind host. We hope to return on our next visit to Florence!

We loved staying at Hanna and Andrea's beautiful apartment! The neighborhood is quiet and charming with great restaurants and shops and within easy walking distance to important sites. Andrea is an exceptional host - great communication, very responsive, and thoughtful. We greatly appreciated his extra kindness. We would love to return some day. Thanks, Andrea!!

Hanna & Andrea are great hosts. The apartment matched exactly how they described. It was clean, spacious, and has everything you need. Besides, it is also very conveniently located in Florence. You can walk up to Michelangelo plaza within 15 min, which is one of the most popular tourist attraction points in Florence.

Andrea was a helpful host, provided great local recommendations and was flexible and accommodating. The apartment is ideally located , walkable to Piazzelle Michaelangelo and Ponte Vecchio, but in a quiet , less touristy neighborhood. We had a lovely time in Florence!

Great stay. Such a lovely neighbourhood. Apartment is small but perfect for what we needed. Our 4 boys plus 2 adults fitted in perfectly. Andrea was extremely helpful and accommodating. Really made our stay.
Very central but in a peaceful part of town. Right next to the Piazzale Michelangelo. Andrea was a great host who met us to check-in. He offered to hold out luggage on check-out day if needed.

We really enjoyed our stay at Andrea and Hanna’s apartment. Andrea met us in person and was incredibly helpful and kind with local recommendations. Their communication was superb throughout. The apartment is in a characterful neighbourhood in easy walking distance of the main sights. If anything we would have liked a kettle to boil water and some larger tea cups but that’s us being British! I did enjoy the coffee maker and generous supply of pods, however!
Giulio is a very nice and easy guest! His flat is amazingly situated in the heart of Florence, close to everything. I highly recommend this place!

We stayed for 4 nights at Giulio's apartment which is ideally located, just a few walking minutes from the centre of Florence. The apartment was clean, spacious, calm, not especially light-flooded but very well-equipped. Giulio was an excellent host, kind, helpful and always answering immediately to all messages. We also appreciated the welcome bottle of wine. I would recommend Giulio's apartment.

Thanks for allowing us to stay at your wonderful apartment. We had everything we needed and it was very comfortable. The apartment is only a short walk from all the fantastic Florence sites - very convenient. Giulio was a great host, he was incredibly efficient and gave us a brilliant restaurant recommendation. We highly recommend his apartment for anyone looking for a central place to stay in Florence.

We had a great time in Florence, the apartment was very conveniently located and we easily walked everywhere. We comfortable apartment for accommodating the two couples that we were, and great to have it on a ground floor. Giulio was a very kind host, we had no problem communicating with him and he gave us very good tips about the city and places where to have good food.
Giulio is a great host, very friendly and helpful. The location is lovely, in a great area of Florence. Would stay again!

I chose Tina's B&B for the first time in my life because I couldn't find any good hotel in that area. The location is just perfect; (1) 5 min. walk from Firenze SMN station (2) 5 min. walk from Duomo; so it's good to put your luggage in the room and begin your schedule right away. You will see all buildings in that area is older than your imagination, but her apartment inside is extremely clean. The room, restroom, and bathroom are all immaculate. Finally, the most important thing, she is very friendly and kind. I really thank her for making me feel like home there. Now I'm back in my home country and writing this feedback to share my wonderful experience there. If you still don't know where to stay in Firenze, now you have a very good choice. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED.

Stay with confidence at Tina's apartment located in a terrific location! Tina was great in responding to questions, easy to reach on the phone, and provided many helpful suggestions and tips. Close proximity to the Duomo and walkable from the train station. Right in the middle of the action!

Tina is a incredible nice person with a lovely spirit. She is very caring and I felt absolutely welcome. The room was spacious, clean (not to forget about the ironed linen) and the location couldn't be better. Any time again.

Staying with Tina was a great choice. She was very hospitabile and ensured that we had everything we needed during our stay. Her welcome was very warm and she took the time to take me through a map of Florence and suggest some palces to visit.

The room is just as pictured and the bed was very nice and comfortable to sleep in. Tina also made sure there was something prepared for breakfast in the morning and also made us countless amounts of espressos whenever we met (in the afternoon, in the morning, when we first met and even just before we left).

I highly recommend Tina and would very likely come for another visit if I'm passing by Tuscany once again :)

This is such a great place and Tina was super helpful! She has this green guidebook that she made, with great restaurants, gelato places, etc. And she was also very familiar with the places to visit. Also, breakfast was not listed, but simple breakfast was actually included - she makes coffee, and leave cookies, cereals, milk, yogurt, etc for us to take. Strongly recommend this place if you come to Florence!

We had an AMAZING time Florence thanks to Tina! She was so helpful and accommodating with plenty of tips and suggestions. The location was right in the center yet still only a 5-10 walk from the train station.  I cannot wait to visit again!!

Tina was a really friendly host. And the room provided was very comfortable. But it was too cold at dawn. Maybe It was like turning off the radiator at dawn. Except one, everything was a really satisfactory hostel.

Tina was very welcoming and she gave us some fantastic recommendations for food and especially gelato! The room was lovely and the locations couldn't be better. Very close to the main station and all the sights are within easy walking distance. Would stay again in a heartbeat!

Tina's friend welcomed me at home. Tina sent me an email with a map and others details to arrive the house, which was very sweet and helpful. The communication through Airbnb was great and Tina managed to response within short time. There are labels in English  indicating the use of the tap, the gas, the toilet, etc. , which were clear and with great help. In general, it's been a stay excellent.

Right in the heart of Florence but in a very quiet part of town! You are a two minute walk from the Santa Maria del Fiore and 5-10 from most of the shopping and museums in town. Tina is very personable, she gives you a (accurate and local) list of the best places in Florence to visit, and the room was exactly what I was looking for!
I love the room and the house. But do not bring heavy suitcase  or luggage  as you have to carry it to the top  floor (third floor)

Really nice and convenient place near the centre like Duomo and Sinario.
Tina is very kind and nice.

Great stay overall. Place is in a prime location with thoughtful lists of local recommendations for coffee, dinner, drinks, etc. when you arrive. Was able to do a loud of laundry which is a HUGE help when traveling for extended periods of time.

Tina is very good. On the first day, we are one hour later than the scheduled time. The landlord has to wait for us. The whole process is pleasant to communicate. The roof on the top floor of the house must be seen. The landscape is superb!

Tina’s place is exactly as advertised. It is located an easy walk from the train station and in the center of everything, yet it was on a side street and quiet!
Tina is good at communicating and her location and amazing roof deck can’t be beat! The room and bed are large and very clean and comfortable. Guests should just be aware that there are 67 stairs up to her place from the ground floor, so be ready for that and some tight space in the toilet and shower area.
I would recommend the very kind Tina and her special place in the heart of Florence!

The location is ideal as it is near most of the major attractions, the railway station, and the tram to the airport. Besides great location, the  accommodation was fabulous. The bed was comfy and there was kitchen privileges. Touches that I liked was the great selection of guide books to peruse and a great reading light.
this home is in the best location in florence, in the heart of everything! and the rooftop is unbeatable. tina is an incredibly kind host and excellent communicator
It's got the best location if you're staying in Firenze. Loved the place wide and spacious.

I had a fantastic stay at Tina’s apartment. The location is perfect, close to every place to visit in few minutes walking. The apartment is cozy, quiet and clean, and Tina is always attentive for questions or to give helpful tips. I would defenitly stay in her apartment again!

Tina and Diego's place was one of my favorite AirBnbs that I've stayed at. They were attentive, welcoming, and very personable. They made me feel like it was my home too. I would highly recommend this AirBnb to anybody coming to Florence.
This was an ideal place for my Firenze weekend. Super well located as you can do everything on foot,  nice rooftop, very good adresses/advices and amazing hosts! I will come back

Really convenient spot just minutes away from the city centre. Tina was extremely responsive to all our messages. View from the terrace is outstanding. Recommend this place to those looking for a spot close to everything.
Apartment was nice and big. Despite its location (city center), the street was in a quite area, so we couldn't hear any noise. The terrace was anytime accessible and with an amazing view.

Tina and Diego are considerate hosts, committed to their guests having a good stay in Florence. I enjoyed the roof terrace one evening and did a small amount of cooking in the apartment kitchen during my stay. The address is close to the central market so buying groceries was fun and the quality very high. I walked everywhere in the city and the river and bridges made it easy to navigate. I would return to this light, airy apartment.

Tina and Diego were fantastic hosts. Plenty of amazing recommendations for food and activities. The views from the terrace are even better than the pictures. And although we were nervous to share a space at first, it was a non issue. You cannot find a better place to stay!

This place was perfect for our one night in Florence. Diego gave us the most warm welcome and was so helpful with recommendations on things to do and places and eat! We had a great time chatting with our flat mates up on the terrace, which has a wonderful view. Great value and location! Thank you Tina and Diego!
Excellent space to stay in Florence. quite near to all attractions, and the hosts are really great ! the view from the terrace is also great !
This is such an amazing stay! Amazing hosts who are just so lovely to talk to. Would come stay again!

Walking distance from the train station was such a bonus. The apartment is in the center of Florence. The check-in was easy although it's at the 3rd floor no elevator. The AC worked wonderfully. Drinking coffee on the balcony in the morning was my highlight. The host kept the place very clean. You can lock your own door and all other guest while I stayed there were respectful. Thank you Tina and Elana! Very friendly Host!

Tina is a warm and welcoming host. On my first night, she greeted me personally and gave me a clear introduction to the entire apartment. The place is amazing—centrally located and within walking distance to everything. The upstairs balcony offers a stunning night view. Highly recommend
Great place to stay if you want to be near the hot spots in Florence. Has a unique character and the hosts are friendly and informative. Would stay again.

Silvia's house was awesome. Really well located as it is close to the city center. We never actually met Silvia, however, her husband was very helpful during check-in/check-out. They are great with the suggestions and are always very responsive for any questions you might have. Definitely use them on your trip to Florence!

Thanks to Silvia and her husband for a nice stay in Florence . We stayed for the new year and our host welcomed us with a bottle of champagne and wine and some snacks. The appartment is very nice and within walking distance from most of attractions. Y

Silvia and Antonio were really nice and explained us everything we needed. The apartment is excellent and very clean! And it is located near the city center so you can easily walk on feet. We liked the place and would recommend others to stay there!

The apartment was VERY clean and had everything you would need for a short stay. A block and across the street is a bus stop that can take you into the city. I loved Florence and plan to return and, if available, will book this same place.

I had a great stay at Silvia's apartment. Not beeing in the exact center, location is fairly good anyway, walking distance from St Maria Novela train station (20 min slow walk) and historic center (30 min slow walk). The apartment itself is perfect! Great bed and bathroom, total equiped kitchen, good wi-fi, safety and everything you can expect. Totaly reccomend it!

Fantastic place in great neighbourhood. It’s only s short walk to the nearest supermarket and a few minutes walk into the centre.
A lovely, clean apartment with very friendly hosts who even left us u complimentary bottle of wine- would definitely recommend to anyone
I would definitely recommend this flat. It was clean and centrally located. Silvia and her husband were great hosts!

Silvia’s house was wonderful! The place was a little off the beaten path but a quick walk into the city center. Silvia was very sweet and welcoming when we arrived and even left us a bottle of wine and some water.  The entire place was very clean and comfortable. We would highly recommend staying here!

Great little apartment, very clean and supplied with all you would need. Ideal for a couple or maybe with one child at a push.
Located about 15 to 20 minute walk from centre keeps you fit 😊
We enjoyed our stay at Silvia’s while we were in Florence.  Her place is very nice and she is a great host.
This was a great place, close to metro.  The flat was clean and comfortable, and they left a bottle of wine for us! Thanks!

This lovely, bright and roomy apartment is up two flights of stairs. It is a 15-minute walk from the train station and about a 20-minute walk from Plaza Della Republica. It is on a busy street but it was quiet in the apartment.

Spacious and bright apartment. Easy communication with the host. A little bit far from the center and groceries, but for the price you pay it is understandable. The only negative thing about the apartment is the noise from outside, you can hear neighbors even if you close the windows.

Really nice, clean and quiet home, close to city center 10 to 15 min walking depends on you're speed. Plus a close tram station that can take you in 2 min to the center.
The owner we're fast on answering our messages and informed us about some attractions.

The stay was perfect and just what we needed. Silvia and Antonio are great hosts! We went to a recommended restaurant and the food was fantastic! We loved our stay and the flat was exactly as described! We would definitely come back to stay again!
Nice and cosy place. Everything was clean, good size and  location is perfect as it's very close to all the attractions. Sylvia was very friendly and responsive. Would highly recommend!
Great place to stay, very walkable and lots to do! Silvia and her husband were so friendly and had a great list of local recommendations. Would definitely recommend!

Great cleanliness, LOVELY air conditioning, close enough to city center to walk or scooter, cafes and shops nearby. Very comfortable bed, very good shower.
Thank you Silvia for a wonderful time in Florence! It was a pleasure meeting you and Antonio, and your apartment was absolutely phenomenal

We have returned to Giulietta's place again to stay with our grandchildren for a week at Easter and we once again had a wonderful stay. Giulietta is always very welcoming and attentive to her guest's needs. As customary, she left a very generous breakfast and she kindly topped it up with fresh fruit and other things during the week. We couldn't recommend it more.

Giulietta's appartment is very cozy and clean. I couln't tell by the photos initially, but it provides direct and exclusive access to the garden through two french windows - one in the kithen and one in one of the bedrooms. The apartment is in fact in the sousterrain, the garden itself being below the level of the street.
Unfortunately Giulietta wasn't in Florence at the time, but her sister Cecilia took very good care of us!

We spent few days in Domenico and Mario's guest house in Florence. The house is very nice and clean. The Old Mosaic room in which we stayed is very spacious and light, has beautiful old mosaic floor, private bathroom and a small terrace. The place is walking distance to the city centre but if you are tired of allday walking and sightseeing you may take a bus (the bus stop is 2 minutes walking). The house is equipped with shared kitchen which is great for preparing breakfast. There is some noise from the street, but apart from that it is a great place to stay.
Domenico and Mario are very nice and helpful hosts who do their job with attitude. If I came back, I would certainly consider staying there again.

The room was spacious, with high ceilings and was very clean.  Slightly noisy due to being next to the road, bit I imagine this will be an issue anywhere in downtown Florence.  Overall a good experience and they are both very pleasant and helpful.  I would recommend them to anyone.
The district is good, very calm and not noisy. Hosts were absolutely kind, open-minded and friendly!
Had a great time here. Room was beautiful and so was the outdoor area. Kitchen was a bit small but very pretty and clean. Hosts were very kind and helpful. Would recommend!! THanks :)

On arriving Marco gave us an excellent welcome including carrying our luggage to our room, places of interest was shown and marked on map, also directions to various shops that we might need. 2nd day there I sustained a injury that needed the pharmacy Marco gave my daughter great details in the directions of which pharmacy was open, offered to ring taxi for hospital thankfully not needed,a much needed coffee saved the day.

On behalf of my daughter and myself a big thank you.

Mario and Domenico were very welcoming hosts. The room was spacious and we also had a patio which was nice to sit out on! Location is good, just a 10-15 minute walk to the centre of Florence. Overall very happy with the accomodation.

Perfekt room and hostel, friendly host, everything as advertised.
you could take the bus to the center but it was also easy to walk (30 min). Thanks for the beautiful stay!
The street was a bit loud, but you get used to it.
Great hosts. We had everything we needed, check in and check out were very smooth! A bit of a walk from the center but public transport is close and simple to use.

Mario was ready to meet us at the scheduled time- he was ready with neighborhood suggestions, map, bus info, etc.  It was about a 20 minute walk to the start of the old section of Florence.  The guest house was nice and very clean.  Our room and its private bathroom were both spacious, the bed was comfortable.  As the room we were in was on the ground floor it was very loud at night so be prepared for that.  Besides the noise we loved our stay at L'Aranceto Guest House.

We had a fantastic stay here. Claudia met us there, showed us around and answered any questions we had. The pictures do not do the apartment justice. The terrace now has flowers growing up the sides which was very charming. The center was a 20 minute walk across the river, which has the view of beautiful Ponte Vecchio. This apartment is located in a less touristy part of town, so you feel like one of the locals. Wish we could have stayed here longer!

This was our favorite airbnb on our entire Italy trip. Beautiful and spacious, great location, and private yet close to everything. Very accommodating with great extra amenities in the kitchen and bathroom provided. The washer was super helpful and the sky deck was an AMAZING bonus. Claudia was helpful and spoke English perfectly which helped us get settled in a new place. She even arranged for a taxi to pick us up on our checkout.

The apartment was perfect for us. We were in walking distance to all the art and history spots in Florence you would want to visit and will never forget. The neighborhood was friendly and not crowded. The little rooftop terrace is so lovely - we used it in the evenings for a drink and some relaxing. Claudia is great, communicating was easy and uncomplicated.
We totally recommend taking this apartment, when staying in Florence.
Our stay in Florence was spectacular. We found everything we wanted: hospitality, quality, comfort and places to visit. Recomendad 100%

Everything was lovely! Domenico was very friendly and available for anything that we needed. The house is very cozy, comfortable and friendly, everything was clean and neat and it looks the same as the pictures. The only bad thing is that the room is next to the shared kitchen so there is a lot of noise in the mornings.

We liked the accommodation and its location very much. A little quieter in San Frediano than around the dom and yet everything within walking distance. We were warmly welcomed and got some tips for our stay. We liked the San Frediano/Santo Spirito quarter very much. Clementina gave us an address for a birthday dinner and made reservations right away. Thank you very much, the food was wonderful and we liked the ambience very much.
The terrace was a nice place with a view to drink a glass in the evening.
We are happy to recommend the accommodation to others.
Esther and Daniel

The apartment had modern amenities. Large bathrooms and showers. We loved the terrace to sit and have afternoon drinks and morning coffee. This side of the river is where the locals are but close enough to walk to the center of town. We never had to use public transportation, except to airport. We walked from the train station to the apartment in 15 minutes. The bar across the street has breakfast and is open until late for snack. Great value! Great hosts!
Excellent communication. Mario took time to tell us about local spots as well as bus routes. Night traffic can be a bit noisy. But great experience overall. Thank you again!

Lovely place - directions are clear, room is spacious, bathroom is well equipped. Host met us warmly on arrival. Our room was on the ground floor - to our surprise we had terrace with orange tree. :) Kitchen is also open for personal use.

L’Aranceto Guest House is a perfect quite place to stay for visit Florence. It’s 20 minutes walk from city center, in a really nice and easy position. Mario is been a lovely host.
Thank you!!

The flat was one of the best living situations we have experienced.  We stayed for a month and thoroughly were impressed with its location and all the amenities it had to offer.   The roof-top terraces was a blessing to come home to for the evening views and a glass of wine (or two), as well as a wonderful start to the morning with a cup of coffee and a pastry.

Nice and cosy room, but quite noisy (the street is just outside the window and the kitchen on the other side of the wall). Staff is friendly and the location is good - city center is 25 min walk or short tram ride away.

We had great time at L'Arento Guest House. it is at walckable distance from the city center (20-30 min), but you can use convenient transportation by tram and buss as well. We had everything we needed, the appartment was clean, spacious and beautiful. Our host was great. There is convinient store  bars and reataurants near by. would recomend!

It was a pleasant stay. Room was big and clean, as well as the toilet. There’s a balcony connected with the room. The host is nice and polite and helpful when we asked for recommendations and stuff. Just be mindful that it’s next to the road so it can be noisy at times. I’m noise sensitive so I always bring earplugs with me. It solves the problem.
Overall a good stay.
We were very happy with the apartment, it was really well located, clean and with all the amenities you could need. Theo made the check in and out very easy for us. A great stay all in all.
Everything was perfect, the emplacement, the flat etc.... except for the lot of noise in the building....
Excellent place. You can walk everywhere around the city. It’s quite, complete and big for two people. Mariella was really helpful with the check in and gave us a full recommendation about the city

Great spot to stay, very smooth check in, lovely staff and good location. The room was spacious and had its very own private outdoor patio. There was also a shared kitchen which was a bonus! Although there was no air conditioning, there was a fan which did a great job at keeping us cool! We would definitely stay here again !
Such a lovely stay at Mariella’s. Finding the place, checking-in were easy and Mariella was proactive and flexible. Felt like a home, would recommend.

Mariella place is in a great neighbourhood.  Lots of lovely restaurants and sights If you don’t mind walking. Her apartment is authentic and quaint. Two air conditioning units kept us cool and helped with air circulation.  The courtyard was great for drying out clothes but not really big enough to sit outside.  That was fine as each evening we walked up the Michelangelo piazza only 5 mins away.  Mariella was very responsive to my requests. I Would recommend her place if you want to be away from the hurly burly but close enough to enjoy all the Florence has to offer

Exceptionally good value for money, and a very central location without the hustle and bustle of the tourist crowd. The two high-powered air conditioners saved our life during an extreme heat-wave. Mariella’s apartment is a great choice
Great home away from home, it has everything you need. Great communication from both Filippo and Daniel, made our late check in very easy

Terrific time in Florence and the place is close to everything we wanted to go to. It's super clean and modern, communication is super easy and we were accommodated with an early check in - much appreciated. Highly recommended if you're planning to stay in Florence.

It was a long walk from train station to the apartment.  In the absence of elevator, climbing two floors with luggage was most inconvenient.Strange layout of the apartment. Basic amenities like tea/coffee/sugar were not provided, we were pretty much told to fend for ourselves. No COOP or convenience store in the neighbourhood. Nearest supermarket was at the train station. All in all not a particularly happy experience.

This is the perfect location easy access via tram to main tourist area. Several great places to eat close by
Will stay here again when I return
Located very close to the metro so it was easy to get to the city center. Neighborhood was nice and quiet. Apartment was clean and just as pictured. Would stay again!
The flat is situated really at the very center of Florence,easy access to most tourist' spots. Very clean and comfortable as well. The owner were also nice.

The flat looks like the pictures, it's clean and so well located, near every important sites to visit :)
Andrea is very sympatic, and concilient with the hour of leaving.
The only optimization will probably to have wifi in the flat but it isn't essential.
Many thanks

Wondeful stay in a central area within Florence! Andrea was very responsive and met us on time outside the apartment for check-in. The stay is in the heart of Florence next to St. Croce and only a 5-7 min walk from the Duomo / 15 min walk from the train station. Highly recommend for 1-2 travelers staying in Florence for a few days.

I would say that Andrea's place would be ideal if you did not have children with you or even if you cared about sleeping. The location is central, which is great to see the sights but the NOISE all through the night is unbearable. you can expect to be woken up every single hour of the night due to noisy neighbors, noisy people outside the apartment, and even the street cleaners in the early morning. The walls and windows are paper thin. everything else about the place was fine. Fully stocked kitchen and accessible.

Hard to say anything bad.  The place was very well equipped and Nicola was helpful and responsive.  The place is well located, close to services and restaurants and we were able to walk to most attractions.  Highly recommended!

Nicola's place was wonderful.  It was clean, cute, and close to everything.  We had an awesome stay there, and Nicola is a wonderful host who even provided cookies upon our arrival.  He made our stay in Florence very easy and comfortable.
Nicola was a great host. He had spend time putting information together and has an appartment in great condition. It really made our holiday enjoyable

The appartment is located in the city center, close to monuments, but in a relatively quiet street.
Interior of the flat is welcoming.
We spent a very pleasant stay !

Great location. Breakfast, lunch and dinner around the corner. We walked to all the sights. Just far enough away from all the hubbub to avoid the crowds yet close enough to everything. This is a great place to stay with many extras provided by the host.
We highly recommend.

The apartment was a great location just far enough away from the touristy areas of Florence but still very walkable. It had everything we needed including a good size shower and bathroom with hair dryer. A great spot to spend a few days in Florence!

We had a great stay at Nicola’s place. The apartment was clean, the bed was very comfortable, the shower was fabulous. It was great to have a cloths washer. The kitchen was well appointed. The windows open onto a quaint street. Able to close for quite and darkness. The neighborhood is in a great location with a mix of locals and tourists.
Highly recommended! The place was perfect for our needs. Comfortable, quiet and clean. The local tips were great, too!
Nicola’s apartment was perfect for our stay in Firenze!  It is very comfortable and spacious and close to everything.  He local tips were great and communication first class. Thanks Nicola.

Don’t miss out..Book this apartment now.!!..Nicola is an outstanding Host, his apartment is a gem..Most of the tourist attractions are easily walkable from here.Also the area is teeming with Local family run restaurants...Absolutely loved our stay.!

Great location in a quiet street, off the normal tourist route yet within easy walking distance to the river, Santa Croce, Palazzo Vecchio etc. Very good value too, and we were met and made to feel welcome right from the start. Nicola always replied to our questions quickly & efficiently.   Comfy bed, great shower & nice touches like the Italian biscuits & water for us. A really pleasant stay. We would come again!
I was traveling on my honeymoon with my wife and this was our favorite Airbnb in our travels.  Nice space, clean, comfortable bed, great shower.

Nicolas apartment is very comfortable, it's very close to the most important sights, we also felt very safe here. The apartment is beautiful, clean and very nicely decorated. Nicola is a very friendly host, we would definitely recommend to stay at his apartment.
A good, affordable option conveniently located within walking distance of all the major tourist sites in Florence. Host was very helpful and responsive.

Highly recommend this airbnb for your next stay in Florence!! Nicola was very helpful and caring. The apartment was big and so well situated. Everything was walking distance!! I would definitely come back 😊

Had a wonderful stay in Florence. A few minor hiccups checking in but were resolved quickly.  The location was great close to all we wanted to see and all within walking distance. Thanks Nicola we really enjoyed our stay .
Great location in a very walkable neighborhood - nice bathroom, bed and washing machine was a nice bonus
We had a wonderful time! Nicola was kind and responsive and the apartment was in a great location. We walked everywhere!!

Nicola, was in touch at every step from check in to check out.
The location was fantastic as close to everything we needed to do.
Apartment was clean and good size for 2 people
Nicola was a very responsive host, clear instructions. We had everything we needed in a great location.

We stayed two nights in this amazing place. Clean, cute, and the service is perfect, polite and really helpful. At night it could be a bit noisy becouse of the passing by taffic but it wasn't a problem for us.

Stayed in this guesthouse of Domenico and Mario for 2 nights. Was clean and comfortable. Bathroom was shared but very clean and good shower. Hosts were friendly and helpful. Close to buses that can take you to the train station or centre of city if you want to give your legs a break. Thanks!

This place was a room quite near to a bus stop, but unfortunately the amount of traffic noise late at night/early morning was quite loud (at least in the room we were in). Other then than it was clean, convenient and there was street parking and a parking lot nearby (both paid).

Perfect for an economical stay in Florence. Close to everything by bus and ok if you are up for a little longer walk. The only drawback would be that the front room faces a busy street. Earplugs would improve your sleep.
Great stay in a wonderful room in florence. The room was spacious, with lovely double heighted ceiling and extremely clean. Loved our stay!
This was a very good experience. All clean and comfortable. Nice, friendly and helpful people. We would come back.

I'm really satisfied with everything!
The staff is very nice and helpful in any way,
the room was spotless as the rest of the bathroom and the kitchen!

Great place great staff!

I'll be back for sure!

The place is very professional, something you must know if you're looking to staying with locals in a house. It's a hotel type of accommodation, but in a bed & breakfast style. The hosts were welcoming and friendly, very professional, they'll answer all your questions. The room is big and the bathroom is close, but shared with other guests. Everything seemed clean enough. The place is at easy access to city center and you can hear all the buses passing by, so not quite the place if you're looking for something more quiet, definitely the one if you're a budget traveler and want easy access to city center. It's important to notice you have to pay a city tax fee directly at the hotel in addition to the payment made through Airbnb.

Really lovely guest house, really great room, beautiful garden and the hosts were communicative and very helpful with maps and recommendations. Only downside to this place was the room was very loud from the road outside so found it difficult to get settled at night. Despite this though I would stay again :)
Very clean, very nice place to stay for one night! A little far walk from the city center, I recommend to take the bus there or a cab. Very accessible and such a lovely experience!
We loved our stay here, two very helpful, friendly and welcoming hosts in a beautiful Florentine home with gorgeous tile floors.  Clean and sparkling with comfortable bed.

The place was good, clean, and spacious. The host was very helpful. However, it was really really noisy. Although all the windows were closed, we could hear everything from outside; cars, buses, silent, and constructions.

Bathrooms very clean and the host helped us with bus instructions and with the main places to visit. He is a very nice guy.
Thanks for everything!!

Nice guesthouse in beautiful old house, on a noisy street but with quiet back garden, not too far from city Centre and close to trams that will bring you to bus and train station. Very fast and clear communication with host.

L'Aranceto Gest House is a nice and sparkly clean place. Mario, the host, is a pleasant person very helpfull and receptive. The place is located at 35min by walk from the hystoric center and by tram arround 10min. Recommand!
The place was clean, and the room was spacious and quiet. Everything was exactly as described. I stayed for two nights and enjoyed my stay.

For the second time I chosed this appartment for my stay at florence. As the first time alberto has well organized everything! Towels, soap etc. and also some sweets and juice!
Also the view and location of the appartment is wonderful - right in the center of Florence!
Thank you Alberto - I promise I will come back soon!
Saluti Tanja

We had a wonderful time at VVBILO! The apartment is very pretty, has a beautiful view and is well furnished with everything you might need during your stay. There is an elevator so you don't have to carry your luggage up the stairs. The location is perfect - you can easily walk to the train station and all the major sights on either side of the Arno. There are several small supermarkets in the city center to buy provisions. Alberto is a great host - he responds very quickly to questions you have and he even called us a taxi when we left. I would definitely recommend this apartment for a stay in Florence!
Lovely view and very clean apartment with all the cooking essentials needed and great bathroom. Very easy and convenient stay, and a great location!

Enrico greeted me warmly and showed me through the apartment.
