Detailed information and contact details were made available. The apartment is in a perfect location, major sights a walk away and great shops too just outside the door. Great view of the duomo, light filled meals and sitting area to enjoy the view. Throughout my stay Alberto contacted me to ensure everything was ok and that he was available 24/7. Wifi connection was excellent, had everything I needed to enjoy my stay in Florence. A home away from home.
Very welcome.  He had someone who worked for him show us the place and any questions or concerns we had he was on top of.

Alberto was a great host.  Very communicative.  He kept in touch weeks leading up to our arrival and didn't lose touch once we arrived.  The place was incredible, with a wonderful top floor view of Florence's red roofs.  I would definitely recommend it!

I spent 32 wonderful days in this beautiful apartment in Firenze, and felt at home immediately. The apartment has all of the comforts anyone may need, and a little more... and what a spectacular view! Enrico, the manager, was perfect; he was always prompt and gracious in responding to any of my questions. I hope to be back next year and, hopefully, will have the opportunity of spending some more wonderful days here.

We chose this place because it was an easy walk from the train station and a short walk to the main part of town. It also had all we required including air conditioning and a washing machine. A pleasant and spacious apartment. Highly recommended!

Alberto was an amazing host! Was very flexible with my check-in and check out. Also gave me excellent restaurant and grocery store recommendations. And finally was very patient with my many questions!

Caterina was a great host, and the apartment was incredible. Plenty of space for our group of 9 with everyone having their own bed. Upon arrival, we showed up a few minutes earlier than we had told Caterina, but she was there waiting for us. The neighborhood is easily walkable to all of Florence's big sights, and only a ten minute walk from Firenze SMN train station. Overall, we had a great experience with this rental, and I would definitely recommend it to others.
Caterina was very punctual and made the arriving for us very smooth. We really enjoyed the large terasse and the apartment was clean.
A lovely apartment with ample space just walking distance from central florence. The apartment terrace is sublime at sunset. Would recomend this to anyone!
Very nice apartment. Spacious and well maintained. Close to train station. Will be even better when roadworks are finished nearby.

Caterina is a great host.
the apartment is very spacious and close to all attractions , the Duomo and pontivechio bridge are a 20minute stroll away and the station is only 7-8 mins away .
the terrace was a perfect way to start the day with a breakfast and then a great way to have a drink at the end of a long day .
you have so much space in the apartment that you are not on top of each other .
I will be back to Florence and I will stay at Caterina again , it was perfect

A very nice house to stay in with lots of space in the rooms. There is no lounge but a couch in two bedrooms. Very clean.  It was a bit far to walk to the sightseeings because we had two small children but we managed. Will stay here again
The host was very friendly, we got there later than check in time due to a delay and she was very patient and friendly.

A truly lovely place. I think one of the best airbnb places I ever stayed in. Convenient location, very responsive host,  apartment is very spacious, super clean, the terrace is beautiful and big. The whole place has a very good Feeling about it. Great for a family stay.
Caterian was very helpful throughout. She responded to out messages very quickly and made our stay comfortable in any way she could. Thank you for an amazing stay!
Very large space with an awesome outdoor space. Location is a bit remote but easily walkable to lots of attractions.

A traditional Italian apartment with a great balcony space.  The apartment is located a 10 minute walk from the station and a 20 minute walk into the centre of Florence. Has pretty much everything you need for a family or group of travellers.

Caterina's beautiful apartment was 'very' convenient for our friends.  The tram was literally a few steps away, the main train terminal was walking distance, and all the main amenities and sites were extremely close.  The apartment had beautiful large rooms and was lovely and clean.  We hope to go back to Florence again one day, and would definitely stay at Caterina's Airbnb Apartment.  Thankyou from the Brown's in Canada and group
Highly recommend.  Great to be near tram stop.  Terrace was a great place for evening drinks.
The apartment is not far from the train station and many attractions. There are also many restaurants nearby. The apartment itself is spacious with 5 bedrooms. It’s a cool historical building !

stay and host were excellent , location was perfect, less than 5 minute walk from the duomo and restaurants. host couldn't be mire helpful. will certainly stay there again. apartment was spotless. host gave full information and maps of entire surrounding area and recommendations on where to eat.

Irene and Alain's apartment is a great place to stay when visiting Florence. It is just as it is pictured, and in fact we were pleasantly surprised to find that it felt larger than it appeared in the photos. The location is excellent and the view of the Duomo from the courtyard is fabulous. The apartment was clean, very well renovated and has everything you might need for cooking in the kitchen (although the kitchen is small it is perfectly functional). We only met Alain briefly, but Vieri was very welcoming when we arrived and Alain and Irene were so helpful with flexibility of check-in and check-out times. A very comfortable stay thank you!

I was welcomed at the door by Alain at nearly midnight shown around and made to feel at home. The apartment is amazingly centrally located with a lovely upstairs loft and a small living/dining room and kitchenette. I would definitely go back!

This apartment is perfectly located in Florence's historical centre, it is very cosy and has everything you need.
Alain is an excellent host, always quick to answer any question and he is very knowledgeable about Florence. He helped arrange parking for us which was greatly appreciated!

Do you want to feel at home away from home??? This is your place. A cosy apartment in a 16th century courtyard with the best views, where you can admire the Duomo. Just in the city center, a short walk to the main attractions, museums, markets, station, hospital........ Alain & Irene are the best hosts possible, very kind and patient and the best tourist guides. You won't need to go to the Tourism Office of Firenze, they can answer all your questions and recommend you about what to see and do in such amazing city. What else, It has been a pleasure to spend these amazing days at their place. The best value.

Alain, Irene, and Vieri were perfect hosts. It was easy to make text arrangements with them. The location is stunning and the apartment was even more lovely than the pictures! Thank you for a wonderful place to stay!

Amazing location just around the corner from the dome. Incredible view especially at night.  Great experience with Alain, who was very welcoming and gave us many recommendations for what to do in the area. Beautiful place, can't wait to stay again!
Perfect location. It was e rael pleasure to communicate with Alain he explained everything, give good advices where to go and how make it faster and cheaper. Thank you so much!

Lovely small apartment, very central with easy check in and access close to many restaurants, shops, points of interest etc.
Hosts were very informative especially recommending to purchase train tickets in advance to save money.
This place was perfect! Appears as pictured- great location too! Check in, check out, and communication with our host was also very easy. Thank you!
Great location. Very cute and stylish apartment. Very clean and great amenities. Host was prompt in meeting us for a smooth check in.  Highly recommend this place if you want to explore Florence!

Love love love this apartment.
We had 2 wonderful weeks here . Walking distance to restaurants , galleries and tourist shops. Supermarket next street and the best cafes surrounding us.
Mid stay Alain , Irene and Vieri had the apartment cleaned with new linen and towels. Lovely garden with fresh herbs great for cooking. I highly recommend this lovely apartment .

Our stay at Alain, Irene & Friends place was simple, efficient and great value. We were right in the centre of Florence amongst all the action. We booked our stay last minute and they were also very quick at responding and provided us with helpful tips.
Great space in a fantastic area of Firenze. The hosts were incredibly helpful and accommodating. The space was cozy and in the best location we could think. Definitely recommend!

Only stayed one night, but this airbnb was great. It couldn't have been in a better, more central location. It was easy to check in to, and we were allowed to leave our luggage in a separate locked room during the day we checked out, so we could explore more of Florence. The washer/dryer was a big help too. Our questions were answered very quickly online as well. Had a great, if brief, time and I hope to stay again in the future!
The location was perfect and the hosts were really helpful. We were especially happy that it had a washer/dryer in the apartment.

Centrally located, small and cozy apartment less than five minutes walking to the Duomo and 10–15 minute walk from the train station. Couldn’t ask for a better landing point. We had big issues with the WiFi during our stay, which they were actively trying to fix, but unfortunately weren’t able to get a solution together. From what we were told, it was just our apartment and another that had issues.

This location was so good and the apartment was cute and useful. The mattress was a bit thin and they’re fighting a mold problem in the shower. However it still felt very clean and cozy. Not lots of unnecessary junk cluttering up the space. Would recommend
It was fantastic place ever I have stayed. We had very joyful time with great scene for Doumo. And I am really appreciated to welcome for my honeymoon. Thank you for all.

An amazing location with a very friendly staff that  informs you every step of the way of what to do I truly appreciated the access code, and the instructions they gave that included pictures of the door and the area. My stay was amazing and the Duomo is right behind the unit. It is also in a very quiet building. The only thing that will wake you up is the church bells in the morning. It was a fabulous day and I would definitely stay here again.

Overall, my stay at this  Airbnb in Florence was fantastic. The location was perfect – central yet surprisingly peaceful. The host was incredibly responsive and accommodating. The space was clean and equipped with everything I needed for a comfortable stay. Highly recommended!

Nice, spacious apartment in Florence! It was nice to be away from the main area a bit but still walking distance to everything. Great view of Piazzale Michelangelo! Alessandra was helpful at check in and provided good recommendations in the apartment.
We had a great stay at Alessandras appartment. It is perfectly located to explore Florence and well equipped. Communication and Hospitality were outstanding with flexible check-in and out.

We found this apartment to be in the perfect location just over the bridge in a quiet neighborhood. There are restaurants just down the street and the view is outstanding!
The apartment is just as shown on the listing and was quite comfortable. Alessandra was a great host and very helpful in orienting us to the area and in arranging for taxis.

Alessandra's house is perfect.
The house is located in an just behind the river, and you can walk to major tourist attractions.
The view from the house is fantastic.
There is an elevator in the building, so you can easily carry your luggage.
The house is warm and comfortable.
Alessandra welcomed us and gave us delicious tarts as a gift.
She checked if there was any problem with us. She even reserved a taxi to the airport for us.
She is a kind and perfect host.
If we come to Florence again, we will definitely come back to Alessandra's house.

We had a wonderful stay and Alessandra was very helpful.  The apartment has a beautiful view of Piazzale Michelangelo, the rose garden and the San Miniato church. It's also located a few steps from a cute square with fun restaurants.  Thanks for a great stay.
Alessandra’s apartment is a tranquil oasis with enchanting views.  Alessandra was always helpful and responsive.

We enjoyed our week in Alessandra's apartment. It had a very homely, welcoming, lived in feel, it was easy to relax in and great to come back to after a day of being out and about. We found it well equipped (with everything in working order) and warm, with lightning fast wifi and plenty of recommendations and guide books to help us make the most of our time in Florence. Alessandra greeted us in person and showed us how various things worked, which we really appreciated - and allowed us to check in early, which was very kind! Brilliant location, close to everything but so quiet. And of course, the glorious views... A joy at any time of day or night. We'd definitely stay again!
The place was perfect—peaceful, away from the tourist crowds, and very comfortable. Alessandra was attentive and quick to respond to anything we needed. We had a wonderful stay and a great trip!

It's so unrealistic to have Doumo in dining room window. I wake up, wash my face, make & drink espresso, and look out, there it is, Doumo! Location is perfect as well. It's easy to get any tourists spots, as well as cozy local shops. Litizia's place has everything I need, and spacious. Also, it was so helpful that it has an elevator. I wish I could stay more than a week. Letizia and her friend Laura made my stay very comfortable and homy. The city itself is wonderful, plus my stay at her place, I was totally enchanted!

Letizia’s apartment is exactly as it appears in the photos - superbly situated, with a view of the dome, sparkling clean, with everything you need to make your stay comfortable. We would unhesitatingly recommend it! Thank you Letizia and Laura for always being available and for making our stay so pleasant.

Leonardo was very welcoming and punctual.  They had a few restaurant and neighborhood suggestions, which are always helpful.  The space is compact but very well thought out and designed.  Perfect location for visiting this beautiful city.

Lovely loft in the most amazing location- right in the heart of Firenze!
The flat is very atmospheric and the photos describe it perfectly. The interior is really cool and the flat was in immaculate condition- we were always looking forward to returning after a long day of touristing. Would absolutely stay here again. Leonardo and Annalisa were super easy to communicate with and extremely helpful!
The espresso machine proved to be a real hit and great restaurants literally on the doorstep. Grazie mille!

We spent a wonderful long week end in Annalisa & Leonardo beautiful and very cozy apartment! Very well situated to discover the city. Very warm welcome from Leonardo.
You have my full recommendation!
Loft is in a perfect location and upstairs from some of the best places to eat in Florence. Cozy accommodations for a couple who enjoys exploring. Highly recommend.

Very nice, small apartment in the center of the town and an extremely friendly host... The only problem is that the area where the bed is located has very limited height, making it difficult to move around...
Little Cozy Loft is exactly as described! The amenities and location are perfect! You could easily eat all of your meals at the Mercato Centrale across the road.

We really enjoyed our stay in this lovely, cosy and comfy little loft. We felt directly like at home. The loft is perfectly located next to the market and at a quick distance from the main station. Leonardo was great too and provided us with good advice and suggestion. Would certainly suggest this place

The apartment of Annalisa and Leonardo is small but very well designed (by Annalisa who is the architect herself)!
Leonardo was very welcoming and obliging. They respond quickly to any questions we had and made us feel home.
The apartment is near to top restaurants and the trainstation. We loved to visit all the places and restaurants by foot (everything is in walking distance).
We highly recommend this place!

We really enjoyed our time in Firenze and this apartment. It is very cosy but it's good for two people. The loft is short, you cannot stand up in it. The toilet and sink are a little tight but the shower is very roomy. It's less than 10 minutes from the train station and about a 5 minute walk to the duomo. The apartment is right next to many good food options as well. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again!

The apartment is located in a lively piazza, close to good restaurants and market. Leonardo met us for check-in, very friendly and had great restaurant recommendations. Apartment was very clean with updated furnishings. Communication with the hosts was great. Would recommend this apartment when staying in Florence!

Wonderful cute space! Very good busy location. Keep the windows closed and it is quiet. Our hosts were very very nice! Easy to contact and very accommodating. We decided to stay another night and they accommodated us no problem. You must stay with them! Well worth it
Great appartment in a perfect location. Nicely decorated and facilities are good, even though the appartment is not so big. Will definitly recommend the place.
The place is great and exactly as described. Central location, everything walkable. Amenities are all clean and modern. Looks like the pictures! We would love to come back!

This is a gorgeous little apartment, in a perfect location! The space was super clean, and the decor beautiful. I don't think I'd appreciated just how cosy the space would be, my boyfriend and I hit our heads a few times, and there wasn’t much space to get ready, etc. but I think it’s a small price to pay for the location.
Within the apartment, there’s everything you could need for a great stay in Florence.
Also,be sure to go to the market across the road and sample some pizza – it was some of the best we tasted 😊.
We really enjoyed our stay here. Easy walk from the train station, great food markets across the square and nice outlook down to the square. Quick responses from host.

Lovely apartment, location is perfect to see everything in Florence, right beside an amazing food market. The bed is in a loft space, but once you're ok with that then the apartment is great. There is approximately 50 steps up to the apartment, but it's worth it for the view and never bothered us at all. Apartment is very close to train station, 5-10 mins walking.

Annalisa and Leonardo's loft was perfect for us. It has a lot of character, and its location is superb. Nearly everything we planned to do was less than a 10 minute walk from the loft, and it was always easy to find our way because of its proximity to San Lorenzo. We are glad we chose this AirBnB. I do want to note that the bed is very firm, which was fine for us, but you should be aware of it if you are sensitive to such things.
We had a great time here. Perfect location, access to shopping, restaurants and local markets. Definitely will be back

Lovely flat in a perfect location. Stylish and with a number of lovely touches (tea, coffee, chocolate!). Wouldn’t suit someone tall as the headroom in the sleeping platform is very restricted but aside from that a great place to stay in Florence.
Fantastic hosts. Great and prompt communication & very accommodating. Easy check in and check out. We will be back!

Annalisa's apartment is beautiful, very clean and really easy to get to from the airport train. it's a great location, close to lots of great restaurants, the market and the duomo! we loved staying here and wouldn't hesitate to do so again.

The best part of this place is its location. It is very close to Duomo you can go to all big cultural attractions by walking. The design of the house is beautiful and holds every need for two people in a compact place. Leonardo was a perfect host. He gave us good suggestions and answered all our questions.

We loved this air bnb! Awesome location, super clean, and great personal touches! It is perfect for two people. The loft sleeping area is so cozy too and the place as a whole is super stylish. Great restaurants right downstairs. 100% recommend!

If you like to eat local food, doesn't get any better than this. Za-za is right under and Mercato Centrale is just across the square. This place certainly helped make Florence the best highlight of our Italy tour.
Such an amazing little place! Perfect location, amazing restaurants and shops around and so close to the central market! We will definitely be back!

Great little apartment in the middle of Florenz. Very clean and Leonardo is very nice!
Great experience to try out a nice little loft in the middle of Florenz
The apartment kept what it promised - it´s very central, very cozy and exactly right for a long weekend in Florence!

Just the perfect place to spend a few beautiful days in Florenz! The apartment ist located perfectly in the middle of the city and still close to the train station. The restaurants around are amazing and all the magnificent spots of Florenz are reachable by walking. Check-in & Check-out are made very easy. Nothing negative to say. We‘ll be back.

Caution: This little beauty of an apartment will make you wanting to spend more time in it than outside!
It was beyond everything we expected - cozy, clean, central, uncomplicated (we booked less than 24h in advance) and something unique in every way. Perfect for a short trip to explore Florence and/or just enjoy the food market across the street.
Maybe just watch your head when going upstairs ;)
We really enjoyed this loft during our stay in Florence and would recommend it to anyone passing through town. The old world charm and coziness made it a very memorable stop.

Great location! Annalisa and Leonardo were great hosts and offered great restaurant recommendations. They also helped us find a safe and affordable place to store our luggage after check out - would definitely stay there again!

The apartment has a great location, close to a lot of points of interest in Florence. The communication was great, Annalisa and Leonardo were really helpful.
But the place is way too smal, even for two people. It was hard for us to keep our lugagge opensbecause of lack of space.
The bed is on the superior part of the loft, too close to the roof which was a bit unconfortable. To go downstairs we had to "walk" with our bodies curved, which was exhausting.
The bathroom is also small.

The location is extremely central and the area is lovely. The apartment is beautiful but much smaller than in the pictures. It consists of a small room that has not much place to put your luggage or clothes and a loft area that is too low for an adult to stand in. There are metal stairs to the loft but in order to get to them, you must first step on a wooden bench that doubles as a coffee table. There are wooden beams on the way so even a small person must crouch in order not to hit their head. Toilet seat is placed under the metal stairs so one must be careful when getting up or moving in the bathroom, because there is a sharp edge that you can hit your head into. Also the lower edge of the stairs outside the bathroom is hanging in the air and it's very sharp, we used a towel to prevent hitting it. This apartment is not for the claustrophobic, big or clumsy people.

The location was perfect to get around the city center! The recommendations that they had for restaurants were great as well! They were very communicative and had a very clean space. It definitely is a loft so it is quite cozy and somewhat of a tight space. But overall we loved our stay!!

The pictures posted are deceiving, the space is ridiculously small. But more importantly, the place DOES NOT comply with any health and safety standards. Anyone can get hurt just by using the washroom.
I DO NOT recommend to anyone.

Annalisa and Leonardo’s place was great!
They were very attentive and responsive. Messages for check-in in and check out were very detailed and amazing!
Accurate description of apartment and beautiful!
The location is close to so many things and windows have a great look out. Annalisa and Leonardo also recommended some great restaurants.
Only thing if you’re tall watch the ceiling up in the loft, it can be a little tight.
Amazing stay, would definitely return!
This place was a gem! Highly recommended. A spotlessly clean home and very communicative hosts. Would absolutely stay again.

Location is very good. It was very clean. We had good communication with hosts.
The bedroom was a lot of lower than expected.

Really enjoyed our stay! The place was exactly as described! Perfectly located for all the main sites. Great restaurants all around. Easy to access. Very responsive hosts and provided some great recommendations.

A perfect location to walk to restaurants and shops! It was easy to get to/from the train station and airport too. The only caution I would give is the lofted bed area is not ideal for tall people like me! :)
Really great location, and tons of helpful recommendations. Being across from the market was perfect and the restaurant down stairs is an absolute must.
Really nice apartment in a great location - hosts were really helpful & check in/out process was really easy - would definitely recommend if visiting Florence!

Lift does not go to the apartment floor ( apartment 1 floor up) and few steps at ground floor to lift.
Good view from balcony.

Great place to stay outside of the core of Florence. Looks exactly as pictured, stunning terrace. Approx 25 minute walk to downtown Florence. Great for family or couples looking to stay a little outside of the city.

The pros of the flat are the great views of Florence from the very large terrace, the flat is very spacious, with clean bathrooms and beds. The main train station is about a 15-minute walk, and the downtown is about 25 minutes. The building is very clean and private and the surroundings felt safe.
The cons are the elevator shaft is located next to one of the rooms, and you could hear it every time is used, the kitchen is equipped with just a few items (we only had 1 glass cup), basic amenities like coffee, coffee filters, paper towels, etc. were not provided. As the description notes, you must carry your luggage for quite a few steps.

Thanks for hosting us Federico! We really enjoyed staying at the apartment - exactly as pictured / described with amazing views over the city. It's a nice walk into town and a very peaceful area. Thanks for being so responsive and for your recommendations.

Great place to stay. Close from the center, walk distance but the tram is also close. Really really great view from the terrace. Very spacious and clean. Nice kitchen. Federico was always responsive and kind.
I would love to come back here.

We had a great stay at Beniamino. We received a warm welcome by his mum despite reaching late in the evening. The house is fully furnished and there is abundant greenery around. We wished we had stayed longer in Florence.

A great place for families with a nice private home on grounds that include a trampoline, pool, and  treehouse for the kids and lovely olive orchard and views for the adults. Walking the narrow, walled streets to the bus stop was fun and interesting. And while our kids are light weights when it comes to walking, more dedicated types could easily walk into the city proper. Beniamino made us feel very welcome and even left some wine and treats for us. Very thoughtful!
The apartment was spacious and lovely. Loved the welcome bottle of wine and note. Great location close to restaurants, shops and museums. It can be noisy at night. A lot of nice touches.

Shelby and Nicco are great.  They gave us terrific recommendations for the area and were such a nice, welcoming couple.  The apartment is in an awesome location in the heart of the historic area near pointe vex his.  The apartment is very spacious, and had everything we needed including great air conditioning and fully equipped kitchen.  Highly recommend!

Shelby and Nicco are the most attentive and helpful airbnb hosts we've had. Our family of six was extremely comfortable in the Lovely Ponte Vecchio. Very nice and clean and close to EVERYTHING. This is the must-have apartment for Florence!  We will definitively be back and highly recommend it to others.

The apartment was as advertised. It was in a very good location and was very well maintained. We had no problems getting in and out and the feedback and tips from the hosts were very helpful. We had an awesome time in Florence!!

Shelby and Nicco were excellent hosts who made us feel most welcome. They kept in touch during our stay and were very helpful.
The apartment is ideally situated in the centre and everywhere is within short walking distance. It's a large apartment and had everything we needed. Both showers were excellent with plenty of towels.
Would recommend this apartment and would definitely return.

I can't begin to say how wonderful this apartment is. It is a wonderful and quiet location. A huge space. Very well equipped , clean and comfortable. Close to all the sites in Florence.
but what made it truly special was Shelby and Nicco. Our lives are richer for meeting them. And they went out of their way to give us advise and help
May we meet again
We would love to stay here again when we return to Florence.

Our best Airbnb experience EVER! The apartment is wonderful..spacious, clean, cold A/C, perfect wifi and best of all in the most perfect location you could ask for in the beautiful city of Florence.
Shelby and Nicco are so lovely - super communicative and even took care of us as we left cash under the mattress (so American!), they had it to us in less than 24 hours.
I can't say enough about the enchanting time my family enjoyed at their apartment - we fell in love with Firenze!
It's really centrally located,  the owners are very nice and everything is within walking distance. It was exactly as advertised. We would stay there again

Great central location with enough space for a family of 4. We were able to walk to most of the places and enjoyed stay in Florence. Great and respinsive hosts made us feel comfortable. Shower area is a bit tight even for an average person.
If you go to Florence you must stay at this place. No better location, spacious, confortable, clean and cozy.

The most wonderful huge apartment close to all the things that matter but far enough away to get a peaceful night sleep. Apartment is huge with a lot of quaint homely touches. We really felt like we were at a favourite relatives home. Good restaurants nearby and an easy precise checkin, great communication with the hosts.
Will absolutely stay here again!!

We had a lovely time in this wonderful apartment - you can hardly find a more central and yet more quiet and peaceful place in Firenze - 2 minutes to Ponte vecchio or the Ufficis. The apartment has all you may need or want. Don't expect US-sized bathrooms, and be aware that the bedrooms are only separated by curtains  so you can hear everything - none of this was a problem for us. The matresses were very good. Shelby and Nicco were excellent hosts, easy to communicate with and very patient with all our questions. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves in this apartment and in Firenze!
Great place. Big, clean and right next to the center of town. Also right across the street from 2 great restaurants.
Great apartment and everything was true to listing. Very clean and host went out of the way to leave great tips.
Apartment was in a great location. Apartment better in person when compared to online photos. Air conditioners worked extremely well.

We had a lovely stay, the home was very clean and the beds were comfortable. The airconditioning was very welcome with the hot weather. Walking distance to everything. The host was very helpful and check in was easy. We will be back again, likely for a longer stay.

This apartment is a great choice for 4 people and for getting to all of the many attractions in Florence.  There are great restaurants and bars all around and you can walk everywhere from the apartment within minutes (airport tram, Duomo, Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, David, etc.).  Shelby and Nicco are great hosts.  They check in a few times via messaging to make sure you are happy.  Checking in and out is easy and most of your questions are answered with FYIs in the apartment, but Shelby was very quick to answer all of the questions we asked.  This was a great experience for us.
A clean, beautiful, comfortable, and central place for anyone looking to explore Florence!!! Great communication and helpful notes and instructions as well. We would absolutely book again!! Grazie!!
The unit is very clean and in a great location. We had trouble figuring out the locks, but we called and they were super responsive and understanding.

Hosts have perfected the airbnb experience.  Great location close to the center of town and easily walkable to all of the main tourist sites.  Comfortable beds, good wifi and AC and best of all, cozy towels!
Very clean and nice apartment in a great location to walk to all the sights in Florence. Hosts were very nice and easy check in.
Great spot for a family looking to visit Florence! Would recommend to anyone visiting, hopefully will be back soon!

Great location and nice apartment. Lots of space for a family. Would not recommend for families with young kids due to stairs and loft style rooms with rails but no walls. Early luggage storage is not available, but this was easily accommodated at the train station.
Cecilia is a great host - responsive and accommodating! The apartment is in a perfect location, with a very fun vibe.

Marco and Domenico received us really well in their guest house. All spaces are really cosy and the small garden in the backyard...lovely! Bus stop to city center is just in the other side of street :)

This listing was compact and beautiful as seen in the pics. Very easily accessible from the central SMN station as well. Mario was very friendly and accommodative. He gave us loads of information on restaurants and maps to go around. We loved every bit of our stay at Florence and would most certainly recommend this listing to anyone who plans a trip here.

Lovely little spot!! It was about a 20 minute or so walk from Stazione Rifrede, easy to get to with the help of iMaps. The space is delightfully clean and well-kept (very clean bathrooms!!!); there were many rooms and a lot of guests but we never had any trouble with bathroom time or anything like that. Mario was very friendly and quite helpful in terms of mapping out the city for us and recommending a place for dinner.100% would recommend!
Our host was wonderful and willing to help us out with any information that we may have needed. He was very accommodating when we informed him that we would be checking out early to catch our flight!
This was a great place to stay, only a short bus ride or walk away from Florence. Would recommend to others. Room, facilities, and owner all made the experience worth while.
Nice clean, Basic room. Nice balcony.  Inner yard. Some mosquitos, but there was also repellent available in the room which was good.
L’Aranceto Guest house was a convenient place to stay, the room was well equipped and our host was very friendly and helpful. The only problem was bugs in the house.

We only stay for a night, but we had a very good experience in Florence. I love the balcony in the room where my friend and I had a nice chat at night. The hospitality is great, the host kindly showed us where to go, where to eat and guide us in terms of transportation. It was very useful for us. Besides, the location is near the bus stop that takes you to the centre.
Perfect for what we needed, great location into Florence city center and the train station. If you're worried about a shared bathroom, dont be! It was always clean and no problems at all.
Cozy guest house few walking minutes to Firenze SMN with soft clean-smelling pillowcases and bed sheets! It was a short but comfortable stay.

Domenico was so kind, he is a nice person. The place is so close to the center and transportation is very easy and cheap. The room was clean and had all the basic amenities that we needed. Everything was better than we expected. It was nice to met him ❤️

The room is exactly like on the photos, really clean. We could have a coffee in the morning, what was nice. A little problem for us was that we couldn't let out luggages there after the check out. But everything else was fine.
Thank you for the nice stay. The check-in was very easy. It is a 25 min. walk into the city centre :) i would totally recommend :)

The place is great if you’re looking for a hostel-like set up. The shared bathrooms were clean and never had to wait very long for availability. The hosts were accommodating to us needing to check in late. A short walk from nearby bus stations. Would stay again.

The house was beautiful, and our room was clean and comfortable. The host was very friendly and helpful. The shared kitchen was well equipped. Both the shared bathrooms and the kitchen was cleaned every day. It is a nice place where in our experience mostly young people stay. It is a bit further away from the center, but it is well connected by bus and there are also bikes that you can use for free.

The place was clean, easy to get to from Firenze SMN (23 min by foot) and there is a tramway station (T2) just 5 min away. The neighborhood was calm and the host was friendly with great recommendations for food. Great place for a short stay in Florence.

Friendly host and great location from central station by tram or bus and 2 shared bathroom with other guests.
This room is located in the first floor without the elevator, so the host supported to carry up my big suitcase. Thank you!
Great accomodation for this price range. Host was really friendly and we met some new people there. It was great
Apartment was great- close walk to main area. Quiet and peaceful. Gave pretty good recommendations. Only thing is the water heater doesn't last very long, so plan on taking super fast showers!!

Marco was very responsive from the beginning of the inquiry, Giovanni welcomed us with tuscan wine and biscottis and water. the apartment is much nicer than the pictures, the neighborhood is great and parking is free in the nearest plaza on the weekend and there is a carrefour express 3 blocks away . Only suggestion is to beware there are 2 sets of numbers in some streets the black ones are for residences and the other color is for business and we could not find the apartment at first. My family of 4 loved our stay in Marco's apartment. GRAZIE MILLE
It was a great place. Air conditioner during summer in every room and it was nice and cozy and the location is excellent!! no elevator but only on the first floor.

Staying at Marco's was great.. The apartment is in a central area.. Few minutes walking from all the touristic attractions .. The flat is Very vast.. Has everything we "a family of 4" needed.. Florence is such a great place to be.. I would definitely recommend staying at Marco's..

Absolutely loved the stay. Though we did not meet Marco personally his friends Miro and his girlfriend  Julia took amazing care of us. The apartment is beautiful, clean and very comfortable and well located, walking distance near all the main attractions.

Marco was easy to communicate with, the apartment is in a convenient, quiet location with easy walking distance to the sights.  We were comfortable with our 2 teenage kids who slept well on the quality pull out couch, and the master bedroom was spacious and comfortable.  The apartment was roomy, clean and we liked having 2 bathrooms.  Highly recommended for up to 4 people.

We were very happy with Marco's place. It was very clean, new appliance, newly remodeled bathrooms (one full one half), great communication with host (Marco was not in town but his friend was very helpful checkin us in) the location is away from the tourist area but just on the other side of the river with walking distance or bus stop is right in front of the apartment.  nice restaurants, supermarket near by.  We couldn't be happier at his place, will definitely recommend to anyone coming to Florence!

Marco was very helpful and caring, contact was always easy and smooth. The apartment is fantastic - impeccably clean, well equipped and well maintained. The area is very nice too, only 10 min walking to city center. Highly recommended!

Marco was extremely responsive, and took care of our every need. He had great restaurant recommendations, a very clean and roomy apartment, and helped us understand bus schedules. I would highly recommend staying with Marco. He made the trip easy at every step.

The apartment is fantastic! Really clean, spacious, and comfortable. Two bathrooms were a bonus, and the shower was great- so nice to have a dependable hot shower. Easy walk to and from train station. The apartment was quiet, yet so much to do so close.
Perfect apartment. Extremely comfortable and was everything as advertised. Would definitely recommend Marco as a host. Communication was A++. I hope to stay at the apartment in the future!

Marco’s apartment is clean and comfortable. It is also on a street with many very good restaurants- much better than what you will find in the tourist sections across the river. I would highly recommend this place!
Super clean, cute, and stylish apartment with a great location. Check-in was very easy and Marco was on top of everything. Would recommend for staying in Florence!

Clean, spacious apartment. Quick responses from Marco. His parents helped check us in and were very helpful even with a language barrier. Apartment is About a mile from the train station, but cabs are available there for around $7 euros. I Would recommend staying here!
This apartment checks all the boxes and then some. Amazing amenities and hospitality. Marco did not have to be so nice to us, but he was and we greatly appreciated him!
Marco's place is very well equipped and the location is great for sightseeing and Oltrano nightlife. We really enjoyed our stay. Thanks to Marco and his parents for lovely touches and great advice.
Place is very clean and well decorated. Has 3 air conditioners, a variety of kitchen appliances... everything you need. The only downside was that I got to stay only 1 day at the place...

Marco's apartment was excellent. The location is perfect for accessing the main centre of Florence and being across the river it is in a quieter neighbourhood. The bed was very comfortable and the amenities were very good. Marco's parents went out of there to welcome us and show us the best parking areas.

Spacious, super clean, nicely located and with great, thoughtful details and helpful lovely hosts.
Modern bathroom with a gorgeous wooden ceiling.

This place was perfect to stay in Firenze as I gave 100% for every aspect. We, family of four, really enjoyed staying there. The place is not small for four adults even though it is one bedroom apartment. Thanks Marco!!

Marco made me feel safe at any moment of the trip.  My mom who finally came by herself without speaking the language was perfectly met, felt absolutely comfortable and said that it was the happiest of her trips. I am immensely grateful to Marco for that.  Highly recommended.

Good Airbnb. Clean and good value. It’s about 0.5 miles from the city center which keeps it quiet and close to a good local food. Only frustrating thing about the stay is the required 25€ in cash on arrival—Marco doesn’t forget it.

We had a great time at Marco's place.
The apartment is at a perfect location, very easy to get around with public transportation and walking distance to awesome bars and restaurants. The apartment is clean and has everything you need. Marco was also very helpful since the beginning and his mom was lovely and helped us with the check-in and check-out.
Would absolutely recommend to stay there!

What is advertise is what you get to a t. Everything looks like the pictures but better. We we didn’t get to meet Marco but we met his mother who was extremely nice and explained everything to us and made sure we understood everything. I would highly recommend this place if you want to visit Florence!

This is a beautiful apartment. It had everything we needed and a few extras as well. Marco's mother, Valeria, was so lovely giving us all the information we needed and helping us settle in. It is in a great location beside some good restaurants. It's only about 15 -20 minutes walk from the main sights, and only a minute from the nearest bus stop.
Lovely, comfortable apartment in a nice residential neighborhood but also close to restaurants, bars nightlife. Easy waking to all the Florence sights. Hosts are a joy!
Very beautiful and tasteful decorated apartment in a lively but not so touristy area! Great communication and help with everything with Marco and his parents! 100% recommended

Perfect apartment in an amazing location! We were close enough to Florence attractions, yet far enough from all the people.
The bed was extremely comfortable; apartment had a kitchen with everything you need to cook meals. The wine was an added bonus (best we had) and Valerie (Marco’s mom) was kind and hospitable, took great care of us.
Def recommend this one!

This property is a perfect fit for a family of 5 with children under 10s. It has plenty of cafes/restaurants, supermarkets and bakeries in the surroundings, and it is 10 minutes away walking from the heat zone. The apartment is at the back of the property, away from the street noise.
The kitchen is equipped with all the minimum toys to cooking a decent meal if needed. The pantry still has some leftovers (salt, sugar, coffee, olive oil and some herbs), so you don't need to shop for everything from scratch.
Marco is an extraordinary host; he goes far and beyond his duties to support his guest by all means. Not to mention his mother, a lovely lady who looked after us during check-in/out.
Thank you for everything, and I look forward to seeing you in the near future.
Arrivederchi!
J

Our trip around Italy was made special with the stay at Marco’s place. Marco’s mom was already waiting for us at the door upon arrival. She was ever helpful and responsive, the place was spotless clean and have what we need for a wonderful stay. Great location within walking distance to the city centre. I would not hesitate to stay there again when I’m back!

Marco was very considerate to allow us to check in earlier and even had his mother welcome us when we checked in. They gave us very clear instructions which were easy to follow. The house was also very clean and matched our expectations. Location is very convenient as well. Highly recommend this AirBnB!
Fantastic apartment in a great neighborhood that’s close to the center of Florence but just enough off the beaten path that you don’t feel like a total tourist.

This was the nicest Airbnb I have ever stayed in. Absolutely immaculate, with beautiful linen, pillows and mattress. Very thoughtful attention to details to make us feel comfortable and right at home. Loved the restaurant recommendations. Thank you Marco!
This is a gem of an air bnb! One of the best we went to, especially considering the location! I would highly recommend to book this air bnb!

Amazing place and amazing host! Marco was super friendly and responsive. His mother checked us in and she was wonderful.
In 2019 we went all over Europe and stayed in Airbnbs and they all had personal touches and made the effort to make sure our stay was great. During this trip we had not been getting that feeling until we stay at Marco’s place. The simplest thing of giving us a map with local recommendations makes all the difference. Yes, I can look things up online but who knows better, a local, so we appreciated the time to show us the map and the delicious wine they provided. The AC was a blessing!
Marco also helped with items I left behind. Overall great host and great stay.

If you're looking for a place that is spotless, comfortable, away from the big crowds but close enough to walk anywhere, you can stop looking now! Marco's place in the Oltrano neighborhood was everything we needed and more!  We were met by his wonderful mother who gave us a tour of the place and provided us with local recommendations - she was the sweetest! There are bars, restaurants, cafes, and even a wine window within just a few minutes walk! Don't hesitate in picking this place as your home away from home.  It was perfecto!
A nice place to stay! My family and I love the apartament. Great location and very pratical.
Marcos’s place was very neat and clean and had everything you might need for your stay. His communication was prompt and the apartment is in a convenient area away from the hustle of tourists.
Fransesca is so nice! You can always ask her anything. Apartment was very clean and nice!

Staying at Francesca's place was the best! The room and the bathroom are super clean and comfortable. Francesca loves traveling herself so she knows what travelers need. Best experience! Absolutely recommended!

Francesca is a great host. The place is very clean, excellent space, excellent bathroom. Lack of aircondition maybe difficult during the hot months of summer. Otherwise I highly recommend.
It is about 15-20 minute walk from the major attractions.
Great place to live in Florence, and Francesca is one of the best hosts you’ll meet!

I really had a good time for my 4 nights in this little nest. It's very well situated and comfy and well decorated. Francesca is super helpful cause she lives next-door. I recommend the Caffetteria in front of the street 🙂

Francesca's place is on a very good location in Florence. Only 10-15 minutes walk from the old center. The studio is very clean and renovated and Francesca is very nice host, ready to help, if you need something. I would stay here again, if in Florence.

Very nice apartment
Exactly like in photo
But I don’t recommend during hot wave because it’s very very hot inside
Francesca is one of the best host I have met on Airbnb. She was really helpful and flexible with timings.

Francesca’s place is amazing. Very neat, tidy and properly laid out. The location is just 1-2 minutes away from the closest bus and tram station, and right next to the city centre.
Francesca is very helpful and always ready to answer any questions you may have. She provided great recommendations for food to eat as well as leather shopping.
I absolutely loved my stay at her place and would happily come back again.
Highly recommend!!!
Lovely location and close to everything. Host was responsive and gave us great recommendations. We ate the best food in a nearby restaurant!

The amount of space and storage was amazing! We were there for 5 days and I wish we had even more time to really use the space. It was easy to hop on a bus or take a beautiful walk into the city.
The only downside was the hot water heater. The weather was fantastic while there, but I came home sweaty and just wanted to shower. I waited 10 minutes after turning on the hot water heater, but i still had to take a very quick shower. This is not the place for someone who likes to take a luxurious 20 minute shower after a long day of walking around the city.

Very good and large apartment, private garden, comfortable, walking distance (20 min) to downtown, overall nice experience, can not complain except the garage which is rather small and not for bigger cars. For us was worth the money, will be gladly back.

This apartment was perfect for us, very spacious and outdoor area an added bonus.  Easy walk to the city centre (20mins) and other restaurants/cafes/supermarkets/shops within 5-10mins.  Public transport both bus and train 5mins away.  Beds comfortable, everything you need in the apartment and very clean.  Hosts very responsive and helpful.  Would highly recommend and would stay again particularly for a long break.  Thanks again to the hosts Duccio and his Grandmother (Anna).

Had a great time in this lovely apartment. It was perfectly clean and fully equipped with everything we needed. Also it is only a short walk from the train station, but not noisy at all.
I highly recommend this apartment!

The apartment was gorgeous and new, well furnished and clean.

We were met as instructed - nice and close to the station but not noisy at all!!

A nearby gym, some cute coffee shops in the street and mini-marts when we needed to grab anything.

A comfortable bed and the temperature control was perfect. Thanks for having us! Wish we could have stayed longer in this gorgeous city. A great find!

We had a fantastic Four days week-end by Vincenzo's apartment. Since Firenze is a pretty small city, being in a central place such as Vincenzo's one was delighting and very convenient. The apartment was spacious and bright, perfect for couples. I would definitely recommend it.

We arrived in Firenze in the middle of a heatwave and were grateful for the extra living space and air conditioning to relax and unwind away from the crowds and heat. The kitchen is well equipped so we cooked every night and enjoyed living like 'normal' people for a few days! The location is perfect.

Really great apartment in the heart of Florence located in easy reach of the train station and all that Florence has to offer.  This flat is very spacious and well appointed with everything you would need for a perfect holiday or business trip.  Vincenzo made things really easy to check in and get settled and was a truly gracious host.  Thanks Vincenzo!

Very nice apartment. It provided exactly what I was looking for during my stay. This was my first time visiting Florence and Vincenzo was very helpful with answering questions about the apartment and the city of Florence. His associate Ana was also very helpful and made recommendations about where to eat and what to see. I would definitely recommend this apartment if you will be visiting Florence.

House was very good.
Good location for train and travel firenze.
House is cozy and chic. Same the pictute.
Host is very kind. She introduce the house and firenze.
We enjoyed the house and rest. It is best experience.

Fabulous stay for a week here? The apartment is big and spacious and the perfect room for my husband and I. Wifi. Strong air condition. Just a note - it's a third floor walk up which didn't bother us but if you have trouble with stairs I wouldn't recommend. GREAT LOCATION. we walked everywhere and strolled along the river every night. Beautiful.
Flat was great and just as described. Centrally located, very clean, and comfy bed. I would definitely recommend.

Loved this beautiful apartment. Includes all the amenities you need for a wonderful stay in Florence. Our only problem was that the Wi-Fi was extremely slow, despite that would love to stay here again

Nice apartment in a great neighborhood!
the room was just to noisy for us because of the street.
The communication was perfect.
Wow wow wow! I would live here if I could. The only downside was having to leave the comfort and beauty of this place to visit Florence 🙃

The apartment is lovely and, most importantly, very well situated - an easy walk to virtually everything we wanted to visit. Angelo was communicative re check in and very helpful on arrival. Only two things really bothered us: 1) we clearly indicated that we were travelling with our son yet no towels were given for him, and when we asked for them we were told no; 2) there is no microwave in the  kitchen, which made warming milk and reheating leftovers difficult. Other than this, we had a really enjoyable stay in Florence and would stay at this apartment again.

Great location with parking available bang opposite the apartment. Very close to some great locations and restaurants. The apartment itself was fantastic with all modern amenities. Vincenzo made sure we were met on arrival by Anselo, who showed us the flat and pointed us in the direction of some fabulous restaurants.

Beautiful apartment and good location for visiting the city. Our stay was wonderful we would definitely come back an recommend it!
Only thing the neighbors were a bit loud.
Thanks again for a wonderful time in Florence in your apartment.
Amazing stay with a great location, everything being in the vicinity. Clean home with all the required amenities. Had a very pleasant stay in Florence
Great location, walkable to all the big sites of Florence. Vincenzo was responsive to messages.

We had a great stay at Vincenzo's airbnb in Florence. The location was perfect. It was close enough to the central areas without being too hectic. It was also really close to the train station where we were able to visit other cities. We had an amazing stay here during our time in Florence. Thanks for being a great host!

Really enjoyed our stay in Vincenzo's place, his assistant Sami was very helpful meeting us for check in and showing us the place. the location is great easily walking distance to all the main areas of Florence. It is up a fair few flights of stairs so make sure you travel light otherwise it might be a struggle which I found out the hard way.
Vincenzo’s place is such a great find! This neighborhood is a little bit tucked away from the busyness of the city center, but still so accessible. Loved my stay here!
Very nice place in Florence, walkable to nearly all of the major destinations! Vincenzo was very responsive and helpful. Would stay here again!

Very nice and cozy apartment. The location is not far from the Station and also walkable distance to the center of Firenze. Apartment is spacious and nicely designed. The kitchen was nice, but could be equipped a bit more with some more appliances. There were pots for boiling moka coffee, but no electric kettle for boiling water for tea. The mattress on the bed is very soft. For those who are used to firmer  mattresses this could be challenging. But despite these small inconveniences, we really enjoyed our stay. The place felt like home for our five days in the city.
Great location and very clean. There was a strong smell of sewerage when we arrived but it only lasted 24 hours. I'd recommend it.

Very nice stay with plenty of space and good amenities. Very close to the centre without being in a noisy neighbourhood. Only issue was the smell of the drains on the first day as it had been raining the day we got there but this quickly cleared. Great stay and would recommend.

Fabulous little apartment, great location and excellent host!
Although very small, also very functional and fitted the two of us just fine.
Edo was very accommodating!
Internet was a bit annoying at times, but better than nothing.

This location is really great. A four minute walk to the Duomo and one minute from the best Trattoria! The apartment was very clean and on the first floor so no stairs with your luggage. It was a bit smaller than I was expecting but it didn't really matter as we didn't spend much time in the room during the day.
We loved the location of the apartment. It was perfect for our 2 nights in Florence. Thanks Edo!

Amazing hospitality and perfect location!! Edo was wonderful, met us when we arrived and answered questions all throughout our stay. You can walk everywhere which made it easy to navigate. Will definitely stay here again when we visit Florence!

Edo was a wonderful host! He was really flexible about us checking in. The flat was extremely clean which was really nice for a change! The bathroom had renovations in it and the shower was very nice! The flat was small but a bed and shower were all we needed so it was perfect. The flat is located close to city center so we were able to walk around to all the major sites very easily! Edo also gave me and my boyfriend excellent recommendations for sights to see and places to dine around the city. He was very knowledgable about Florence. To top it off, our taxi didn't show up to take us to the airport so Edo left work to take us to the airport so we wouldn't miss our flight. What a life saver! All in all, the place was wonderful and Edo was an amazing host. Next time we're in Florence, we will book with Edo again!

Edo was a great host. He provided everything that we needed during our short stay in Florence. The apartment was in the city center of Florence. Everything was walking distance. The place was very cozy, clean and comfortable for two people. We really felt at home during our stay in Florence! Thank you Edo!

Edo was a fantastic host! He had great tips for Florence and was extremely responsive. He was also very flexible about our timing. We had a lovely stay in his studio. I would recommend light sleepers bring earplugs as the first floor unit is facing the street.

Our stay at Edo's studio was awesome! He was super understanding about a delay in our arrival, the apartment is exactly as advertised and his suggestions about things to enjoy in florence were very helpful. Would definitely recommend to anyone!
Great place to stay. For being a studio apartment it did not seem too small and had all the amenities that you would need. Would stay there again if I came back to Florence.

This was a sweet little studio in an amazing location - I' stayed 8 days and would definitely stay here again. Edo and his sister Rita made me feel very welcome and provided a wealth of helpful information about food, sightseeing, nightlife etc... As would apply to any ground-floor apartment in Florence, you'll want to stock up on bottled water, and ear plugs are a good idea given the vibrant nightlife! Otherwise it is a dreamy place to stay, walk two blocks and you'll see the Duomo, and are surrounded by beauty in all directions.

Edo was an amazing host, an i am shure it wasn't our last stay in this beautiful accomodation :-) It is almost directly in the city center - duomo about 5 minutes by foot! Edo has had some amazing tips for us so ask him ;-) thanks Edo for the overwhelming hospitality :-)
That was a very nice staying in a very central location. Apartment small but very clean equipped with exerting one might need. Just for those to wh it matters: it's quite noisy co

Edo’s place was perfect. A beautiful compact studio with everything you might need and more for two people. 15 minute walk from either train station and can easily walk to anywhere on the city from it. Edo’s sister kindly met us and explained the best way to enjoy the city and relax. Would definitely stay again given the opportunity!

Me and my boyfriend stayed at Edo's apartment for a week. Great location, just a short walk to everything really! Perfect for going back in the afternoon for a siesta. Small but perfectly sized, with a really nice shower. Edo sent us a guidebook for Florence, left some bits for breakfast and even sorted a taxi for us on checking out. Would definitely recommend.
Perfect central place if you are a tourist. Close to everything. We had fun walking around since this place is so close to everything
The apartment is very small and would be a good fit for someone not bothered by the street noise and lack of privacy curtains on the windows that look onto the street.

Rita was such a great host, a nice and friendly person, she gave us really great tips for visiting the town. The location is also great, very close to all important objectives. I totally recommend and can't wait to come back again.

The studio by Edo&Rita is great, there have few convenience store nearby, also it is not hard to reach from the bus station. And Rita is very helpful and told us everything we should explore with detailed information. Moreover, they reply instantly which made us felt very safe during staying at studio!!!!!

The studio apartment is small but equipped with everything necessary. It's also very close to the city centre! The only thing to keep in mind is that there is an open shower in the bathroom, so you have to wait for everything to dry before being able to use the bathroom again. Aside from that, it's a very good place and the host gives plenty of lovely suggestions about places to visit!

Rita was very helpful and responded to messages very quickly. The apartment was tidy and a walking distance away from all of the main attractions. Rita had some awesome tips for restaurants/activities. Highly recommended!

Edo & Rita were awesome! The check-in was smooth. Their place is about a 20 min walk from the train station. Everything is pretty much walkable from their house. Very responsive, all around an awesome experience - I would definitely recommend her place.
The place is too small and theres a lot of noise at night (the window faces a transited street?
Great room, very convenient location. Amazing and very polite hosts, offering the best recommendations for Florence. I would definitely recommend!

Thank you for letting us stay in your lovely place. The bed was so inviting after a long train trip from the uk. Everywhere was lovely and clean and I felt comfortable and at home immediately.  We took your advise and went around the corner for dinner last night and was thrilled with our meal. Just perfect. Thank you again.
Very nice stay, conveniently located in the center of Florence. Museums are within 15 minute walk. Self check in was easy. Place was vey warm. Host was very accommodating.

The location was very close to the center. Rita was very nice and helpful. The place was comfortable. Even though it was very central it wasn’t too loud at night on the streets. Absolutely recommend.🙏

Great place to stay and explore historic city of Florence for one person. Host sends useful travel tips before the trip amd I suggest you take them seriously, e.g. booking tickets online for key attractions well in advance. Overall, can fully recommend.
Excellent! Stay, very communicative host. The apartment is very small and the toilet and shower is in the same cubicle, which may cause a problem for some...... But overall and excellent experience

I've enjoyed staying at Rita's apartment with my girlfriend for nearly a week. It is located near everything in the centre and is very walkable. The apartment is so clean and really fits a couple travelling together or someone staying solo in it. I got to meet Rita daughter's but not her unfortunately. She was welcoming and friendly with us and gave us an early check-in look inside the apartment since we arrived early in Florence so left our carry-on luggage that time and left to explore the city and have a meal. Everything functioned amazingly and no issue happened at all while our stay.
I want to thank Rita for having us staying at her apartment. It was very lovely and special experience for us within Florence because we discovered many things and tried as well new food. I was worth it staying at Rita's and will surely stay again in the future visits.

Loved this stay! Wonderful for a couple or one person traveling, I adored this small perfect place! It has all I needed for 4 days in Florence and I loved the energy of the apartment. Safe and small and perfect. Thank you so much!
Small apartment but making the most out of the space available. It has everything a couple needs for a stay of a few days in an excellent location. The communication with the host its fantastic.

Everything was great, the host was very responsive and helpful.
Also got sent a lot of suggestions on where to go and what to see and even helped with ordering taxi to airport.

Everything about Tiziana's place was perfect. The location is about as central as you can get right in the downtown area, but so quiet! The apartment is just as it looks, very nice and comfortable (including the bed) and has everything you need. Tiziana was very nice and easy to communicative with. We will definatly stay here again if we come back to Florence.
This was the cutest air bnb I've ever stayed at! Location was perfect and the host was amazing! Thank you for the wonderful hospitality! We had a fabulous time!

A great place to explore Florence from. Everything is within reach on foot. Despite of this, the apartment is very quiet, as it doesn't face any streets (it's in the backalley just by Palazzo Strozzi). The place is spotless clean, and communication works flawlessly. All-in-all a wonderful spot.

Outstanding location. Walking distance to all sights: Uffizi, Academia, Bargello. I did not take a taxi once during my 4-night stay. Ponte Vecchio is literally a 3-minute walk which takes you to the ever so popular Oltrarno neighborhood. SMF train station is also about 12-minutes away on foot. Clean, quiet, studio. Perfect for a solo or couple traveler. Highly recommended for anyone who leaves the house early in the morning and returns in the evening.
Very welcoming, small but perfectly formed apartment close to everything and in a lovely district couldn’t have been more pleased. Sparkling clean. Hope to visit again, thank you to our host too.

The location is ideal.  A walkable journey to and from the the train station, right next to the river, very safe neighborhood.  The apartment was perfect for two people, plenty of room and everything you would need for a long stay.  The kitchen is small but has everything you need for cooking and morning coffee.  The washing machine worked great and was easy to operate.  There was also a great place to line dry your clothes on the balcony.  Tiziana and Klara were great hosts!  We had a fantastic time and highly recommend this apartment and host.  Wish we had stayed longer, three nights went fast.
Tiziana's place is great. Location is fantastic - very central. The place was very clean and had everything we need. Highly recommend.
The house is located in the center of the city and easy to access to every famous sigts. The host was kind and responded quickly. It was a  wonderful experience.

Definitely recommend staying here on your trip to Florence. The location was absolutely perfect, it was in the middle of everything. The apartment was clean. Its not very large but its fine for two people.

Great location! And decent amount of space for 2 people. Everything was clean and tidy. The door by the bedroom unfortunately opened to balcony overlooking an interior closed in space (I only mention bc one reason we booked was for a balcony overlooking a street below). Otherwise, great experience.

Perfect location! Most comfortable bed, felt like am sleeping on a marshmallow. Great AC, hot water, everything was perfect. Asked to change the pillow and was provided with a new one. Great host!
Will definitely be coming back again.

This was a perfect home base for two people in Florence. While a little tricky to find at first, the location was very walkable to all Florence neighborhoods and the space itself was clean and cozy. We loved our time and will absolutely be back! Grazie Tiziana and Marco!

The Blue Pearl is a lovely apartment in a perfect location. The minute you walk out the front door, you see an incredible view of the Duomo and you are in a neighborhood with tons of restaurants and shops. Angela was a great host, and the apartment is clean and spacious. We can't wait to come back to Florence!

The apartment is very close to the duomo and most of the famous places, all in a walking distance. Lots of restaurant around, also very close to the shopping area. Location is perfect!
The room is spacious for 2 people, it’s tidy and clean. Angela is nice and very responsive!
Angela has a very nice place in amazing location and super helpful with many many tips. Would highly recommend to stay. Thanks for everything

The best apartment in Florence. Amazing value, perfect location (stunning morning views of Brunelleschi's Dome from the front door), really comfortable apartment for extended stay. Also the restaurant at the doorstep is the best we could find in the city.

Dirty dishes, bad smell coming from cabinet with dishes.
Everything else was great! Angela was very responsive and easy to get ahold of. Great location!

Angela’s apartment was wonderful! Clean, all amenities needed for our stay, comfortable bed and quiet. It was in a great location and you could see the Duomo at the end of the street. We liked Angela meeting us at the apartment and she was a lovely person. Angela was a friendly, responsive host who even offered to arrange a taxi to take us to the train station upon our departure. We would love to stay here again when we return to Florence! Highly recommend.

Super apartment, super host, and super family's host! We had an amazing time! The apartment is very close to the city center, has a super equiped kitchen, great bathroom and two lovely bedrooms. Everything is very new and well kept. Nicola the host and his parents were extremely helpful from before we got there until after we left, making our stay even more perfect. We can't wait until we have a new opportunity to go to Florence and stay there again!

Nicola was extremely welcoming and kept his word - taking us on a great little tour of his city. He showed us places to eat and drink, towns to drive to, tips within the city and essentially any other question we could think of he answered well.

The apartment was clean and had all basic amenities as described + more. The place is central and easy to get to.

The apartment is on a busy street, so there's a bit of street noise at night - but that also means there are markets, bars, cafes and restaurants at the doorstep.

Highly recommended.

My mother and I had an excellent stay at Nicola's place. It was easy to get to with his directions and very well-located for exploring Florence. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and has everything you need for your stay. Communication with the host was great.

Nico's apartment is clean and tidy, comfortable and fully equipped. The apartment is close to the No.6 bus stop which commute between Florence SMN station and his apartment. Since Florence is a small and beautiful city, and the scenic spot spread all around city, it's a good choice to walk to any place you want. There is a supermarket which takes 5 minutes walking. Nico is a very nice person. When we arrived at his apartment, he was already there waiting for us.  After a detailed introduction, he left us his mobile number and WhatsApp in case of any need. He also gave us good advice on restaurant, what is the best choice when we cancel the planned trip to Viareggio because of the heavy rain.  Highly recommendation!!

we had a wonderful time in Florence and having Nicola as a host definitely played a part in that! When we arrived, Nicola was there to greet us and give us a brief overview of the city. He was easy to reach and provided us with a few suggestions of places to visit in the city. Nicola was even kind enough to arrange transportation for both my mother and I to the train station!  I would definitely recommend his apartment to anyone visiting Florence and would stay again if o were to return

Nico was fabulous host. He provided all the tips to get to place and was waiting for us when we arrived at his place. He even helped us to take our big bag in his apartment.
Overall great place and close to tourist destinations.

Nico’s place is lovely, great location, very clean and comfortable. He allowed us to drop our bags early and was very hospitable.
Nico also gave us a great walking tour of Florence - very fun and informative and I’d highly recommend it!

Accommodations are well located close to everything. Nicola is a wonderful host and his parents, pitched in while I Nicola was on vacation and met us at the bus stop and arranged a taxi when we left, which wasn’t easy as it was  during the Firenze half marathon. Overall we had a wonderful  experience with lots of suggestions from Nicola on things to see and eat. Highly recommend. Thank you

Where do I begin? What an amazing time we had a Nicola’s place. Everything was great. He was so helpful from beginning to end.
It was especially nice that he is a tour guide in addition to being a great host. He and Spina took us out to the Chianti region and arranged a winery tour, tasting and dinner at a quaint small family winery. Even though it was off season, he still managed to arrange it for us.
I highly recommend his place!
We can highly recommend staying at Nicolo's apartment.  It was comfortable and convenient and Nicolo himself is delightful.

Nicola’s flat was amazing, the amenities and surroundings are real good. The flat is quite central and Nicola gave us some tips, which were really helpful, we would definitely stay here again.
Also the city tour was really interesting and insightful, thanks, Nicola!

Nico and Spina are amazing hosts who have a great place. We had everything we needed and were very comfortable. The location is great for accessing all the sights. We did hear some street noise (late on Friday night), but that's what you get in a big city!

This is my second time in Florence and second time staying in Nico’a home and it’s by far still my favorite parts of my trips to Italy! Nico is an above and beyond host who honestly adds to the already amazing location of his apartment. This place is spacious and the beds are so comfortable. I always regret not booking my stays here for longer when I come to Florence! Do not hesitate to book and don’t forget to inquire about his tours, they are beyond amazing! Thank you Nico!

Nicola’s apartment is great, it’s spacious, well equipped, comfortable and well located.
I’d highly recommend to anyone and will definitely be coming back to
Nicola is a fantastic and generous host, even giving us a lift his car, so we wouldn’t miss our visit to the cupola.
Very nice location. It's convenience to have everything in downstairs. If they can prepare some water, would be better. :)

Excellent place to stay: it was a great location - very close to the Mercato Centrale and the convent/museum of San Marco and an easy walk to other sights such as the Duomo. We walked everywhere other than getting a bus up to the the Roman & Etruscan sites of Fiesole one day. The apartment was very nice and worked well for the 5 of us - two bathrooms, 3 bedrooms and a good sized and well-equipped kitchenette/living area. Mavi was lovely and answered all communications quickly. She met us at the apartment on arrival and suggested places for us to visit, including local restaurants.  All in all, we thoroughly recommend Mavi and her apartment for a stay in Florence.

we didn't meet Mavi but she provided us a lot of help. One of our check in luggage is delayed, even one of our backpack was stolen in one of the city square. Mavi's wonderful house comfort us. It's on the top flat of and ancient house, with very beautiful view. The street is quiet and safe.10mints walk to train station, also 10mints walk to duomo. If you like Chinese food I recommend the Chinese restaurant just downstair of the apartment called Tang Dynasty. Everything of Mavi's house is nice, convenient. We love it and will recommend to anyone.
