Mavi is really great host. We could arrive at her apartment very easy according to her guide.
This apartment is very comfortable, quiet and clean. She prepared everything we needed.
Close to many famous spots in Firenze, so we could go to anywhere on our foot.
We eager to stay here again really.
I recommend Mavi's apartment.
Thank you Mavi!

This apartment is on the 4th Floor, I believe?  Other than having to go up so many stairs this apartment was beautiful and probably my favorite of all places we stayed at.  The location is wonderful and extremely close to the market and all points of interest.
Nicola was great! the walking tour and tour of the Chianti region was amazing! his place is close to a lot of main attractions and great restaurants.

Comfortable, walkable location with an excellent, responsive host who is also a registered tour guide.  The two day trips he planned for us were excellent (Cinque Terra with a side trip to Pisa  and Chianti in the rain) and we much appreciated his flexibility due to the weather.  Nico  is a thoughtful, gracious host and we thoroughly enjoyed our stay at his apartment.  The walking tour he did for us was very informative and it was obvious he loves his city! Great way to start our visit to Florence!  Thank you Nico for making our visit so enjoyable.

Simona was a fantastic host! She couldn't have been more welcoming and helpful, she looked after us throughout our entire stay, gave us restaurant recommendations and in general made us feel at home.

Her apartment is amazing - its immaculate and finished to a very high standard. The location is great, you can walk out the front door and get lost in the beautiful streets of Florence. Great Café / Bar over the road and its a 15 minute stroll through some wonderful back streets and Piazza's to the Ponte Vecchio.

Couldn't recommend staying here enough and will definitely be coming back!!
A wonderful central location to visit the sights of Florence. Apartment is clean and spacious. Mavi is a fantastic host.
Great place in a great location! The AC worked great during the hot week we stayed and having access to laundry was very convenient. We would definitely stay here again.

Nicola is a champion and the best host we have ever had. He guided us around parts of Florence we would otherwise have missed, suggested great restaurants, lifted us from and to the airport and we did a brilliant day tour with him to Siena and San Ginignano. Highly recommended Airbnb, all in experience. Right near a market and one of the best restaurant walking streets. Close to the big attractions too, all walkable. Lovely spacious apartment. Good fans for the heat and complete blackout for the summer evenings and mornings allowing a great night's sleep. Salute!

The perfect place to stay in Florence, the photographs don’t do the apartment justice it’s very beautiful and within walking distance to all of the main sights and galleries, but far enough away from all the hustle and bustle. Nicola gave us a very interesting and unique tour with lots of sights and information we wouldn’t have gotten otherwise. Any messages were responded to quickly and we felt right at home in the apartment. Would definitely recommend and would book again if we came back to Florence.

This host was superb and was a delightful experience for these weary travelers. The home was comfortable and convenient. Each concern or question we had was quickly answered and solved. We recommend this host explicitly!

Amazing apartment , great location, super friendly and helpful host who genuinely loves the city and hosting new people in her home . Would highly suggest this accomodation to fellow travellers . I travelled with two young children and Simona could not have been a more spectacular host ( and brilliant English which helped me profusely) k

We had the most magical vacation hosted by the most wonderful tour guide. The location of the apartment was excellent and Nico gave us tons of recommendations on places to eat and visit. We started our week with the walk around tour of Florence and knew from the beginning it was going to be perfect. We took 5 daily tours around the Tuscan countryside, as well as visits to Pisa and Cinque Terre. We didn't do any cooking in the apartment, but the kitchen was well stocked for those who want to.   The bed was comfy and rain shower with heated towel bar was wonderful.  Also, there is a washing machine that we used for a few loads mid week.  Can't say enough about Nicola's knowledge, hospitality and friendliness. We felt like family and will be recommending this adventure to many of our friends.

Amazing stay! Nicolas is very helpful and gave us a lot of tips of great places to eat, his mother was very nice and gave us best check in experience ever! The place has a lot of space, amazing location and I will recomend to my friends. 10/10 superb!
The apartment was great and had everything we needed. It was just a 15 minute walk to the centre along a pedestrianised road.

Beautiful apartment nicely situated a little outside the bustling heart of Florence. The neighborhood is quiet but cool with restaurants, shops and bars--all teaming with students--just a few blocks away. It's a 10-20 minute walk to most of Florence's major sights. Simona is helpful and easy to communicate with. The apartment is brand new, clean and very nicely appointed. Highly recommend a stay here in this amazing city!
Perfect place and great host.  Will recommend it to others and will stay again if we ever make it back to Florence!
Simona’s place was amazing! Simona made everything very easy. The appartment was beautiful & had everything we needed. There was even a wii for our 2 boys. The location was fabulous! Perfect stay!!
Sonoma’s apartment is fabulous. It is clean, well appointed and in a great location. You will not be disappointed.

Simona's apartment felt home-like and was a great place to stay.  She had a lot of nice touches and amenities there for us.  Her place is very clean and updated, and the kitchen has all of the necessities.  We also enjoyed the restaurant next door, which was frequented primarily by locals and that was a treat.  Many of the attractions were within walking distance.  We would definitely stay there again!
A lovely modern third floor apartment (no lift), with plenty of towels and pillows within walking distance of the city centre

The best apartment I have stayed in in Italy! It is absolutely beautiful and stylish. It is also in a quiet location close to the main square (about 15-20 min walking distance). We absolutely loved this apartment! Host had great communication and even had a book she created with local restaurants and places to visit. I would stay here again in the future.

This was the best Airbnb experience we have ever had. We stayed almost a month. The apartment is bigger than it looks in photos. Building is so pristine and clean, neighborhood reminds you of sophisticated upper east side but is still only 5 mins walk to all the landmarks including duomo and from there 5 mins to Ponte Vecchio. The photos on the site don’t show how sunny the apartment is. It’s bright and happy. The ACs in every space make it so fresh and happy. The towels bedsheets mattresses kitchen  washer dryer are highest quality. We absolutely loved it. Simona is available and responds within minutes. The self check in check out was so easy. Simona even has Wii video game in the 2nd bedroom which we used for kids. We brought our own but she even has hotel like soaps and shampoos conditioners lotions and velvety cotton slippers! We loved it.

Second time we’ve visited this property.  Great location, nice, modern apartment.  Nice shower and bathrooms, comfortable beds, proper glassware for drinking wine and equipped kitchen.  Wish we could have stayed longer.  Definitely our go to accommodations for Florence.
Very nice apartment.   Many restaurants near by.   Also small carrefour supermarket very close.   Washer and dryer was easy to use.   All instructions in clear English, thank you.

Fantastic experience, the unit was exactly as described. Very well kept felt new and looks it. It is near the central part of the city and everything is walkable. Has a kitchen, fridge, washer & dryer. Was worth it! Do not hesitate and.book it!

Very easily located such that it’s away from the mass crowds while being very walkable which is the way to go in Florence. 10 minutes and you can be everywhere. Also, the air conditioning can match the standard in the US which was quite refreshing in staying with other locations before here. Simona was great to communicate with and the stay was amazing.

Highly recommend Simona’s place in Florence. beautifully presented and is in a great location and totally accessible to all the great locations.
Nil lift and you do need to walk up stairs but the apartment is worth it.
Outstanding property and would book again when back in Florence.

Simona’s place was a delight to stay in. Tastefully decorated, clean & an excellent washing machine & dryer. Easy to find - Less than 50m to the bus from the station. Lots of great restaurants, shops and supermarkets nearby. Simon’s was a responsive host but also had a great folder of tips which was helpful!

Absolutely beautiful apartment! Everything was clean, stylish, and felt very welcoming from the moment we arrived.
Pros:
• Comfortable beds for a great night’s sleep
• Luxurious shampoo, conditioner, and soap—such a nice touch
• A washer and dryer, both of which worked great (a rare find in Italy!)
• The easiest check-in and check-out process I’ve ever experienced—smooth and stress-free
Cons:
• The four flights of stairs were tough after a long day of exploring—but definitely manageable and worth it for the apartment itself.
We truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely return if we’re ever back in Firenze!
Simone’s place was fantastic. Beautifully decorated with all the amenities you can think of, 15 mins from the center yet, away from all the tourists. We will definitely come back!

Awesome place and very nice and kind hosts...the apartment has all things you need and especially a very nice terrace to relax ...it is near all the lovely and impressive places in Florence, by feet in a very short time ( you need 8 Minutes to the Duomo Santa Maria del Fiore ! ) Great place to stay and we enjoy every single day...

This is one of the best Airbnb's I have ever stayed in! The hosts were helpful and incredibly accommodating (letting us come before check-in time to drop our bags, helping find great restaurants, etc.). The apartment itself was lovely, clean, and a great retreat after a long day of exploring Florence. Dinner on the patio was incredible!

Giulia and Alessio have been very nice hosts during our whole week in Florence. The apartment is very clean and lovely. The kitchen is very well equipped, the air conditioner is very convenient in summer and most of all the terrace is amazing!
They also gave us a lot of tips and addresses with some of the best restaurants and places to go during our stay :)

Me and my friend love Giulia's place, specially the balcony, the view is pretty awesome! The location is really convenience, you can go to the mostly places by walk. I will stay at Giulia's place agin if I come back.
This was a great place, walking distance to IL Duomo and great restaraunts and shops . Awesone view from the outdoor terrace

A lovely place in FLORENCE
We spent a good Time and Giulia mothers was great during the Check in to help us for discovering the city
Many thanks
Vincent

Beautiful apartment in a perfect location. We loved the the small bar on the piazza San Marco and the gelateria on via Laura was better than any other we found. The beds were incredibly comfortable and the details like linen showed extra care. The kitchen is equipped like a home and the terrace is stunning. Very responsive hosts.
This place was amazing in a great location. Giulia was easy to commicate with. The apartment is very spacious and the outdoor terrace was very special. Wish I had more time to spend there.

Giulia and Alessandro’s place is a true gem. You truly can’t get a better location - less than a 10 minute walk to all the main attractions. The space was clean and beautifully decorated with an amazingly soft bed and the terrace had a beautiful lookout. Would recommend this place to anyone looking for a great space in Florence.

Guilia and Alessios place is small  but perfect for a stay for a couple or with one child.  We loved the central location, the terrace for a drink in the afternoon or evening and the proximity to all the amenities you need when staying in an Air BnB.  The hosts provided us a great list of restaurants and other amenities that really helped.   Loved our stay.

Wow! The location was unbelievable and the space just perfect for our four night stay.  We loved the view from the terrace each night! Before the trip, we asked for some local suggestions for our anniversary dinner. Giulia quickly responded and we enjoyed one of our favorite dinners there our last night. We highly recommend Giula’a Great space and wonderful hospitality!
The location was ideal. The deck has a beautiful view and you are steps from the center of town. The beds were super comfortable and the kitchen and bath were excellent. We loved it.

Beautiful location and exceptionally helpful hosts. They provided an extensive range of recommendations and were always available to help when needed. This place is perfect for a person looking to be in the centre of the City with food, museums and transport all within walking distance. Would highly recommend

Perfect apartment out of noisy streets in the historic downtown. You can just walk and enjoy all the historical places after breakfast in the kitchen and cap of coffee on the terrace with a nice view.

Great location. About 20 minutes walk from train station and about 10-15 minutes to most sites.  Very quiet at night. Very comfortable bed.  Handy kitchen with fridge. No washing machine. All went smoothly and Guilua kindly let us have late checkout to leave our luggage until our train was due in the afternoon. Would stay here again.
Fantastic location!!!! Walking distance to Duomo, David statue, great restaurants, shopping, etc. I would definitely stay here again. Also, loved the terrace!!
Giulias apartment is located 5 minutes from the kathedral and has an amazing view over florence. Small but precious!

Great airbnb for a citytrip to Florence. If you step outside the appartment, you can see the Duomo.
In addition: the elevator, the quietness, airconditioning, and the view from the terrace, were aspects of the appartement that made it a good getaway.
The apartment is incredibly nice. The location is great. Giulia and Alessio are nice and responsive. Highly recommended !
Great stay at Giulia’s place which is well located in Florence. Air conditioning was a life saver during the bad Italian heat wave while I was there - thank you!
I had a great time staying here, Giulia was super responsive and gave me so many great recommendations. This place was located right in the center and close to everything!!
A wonderful place to say! Beautiful and quiet. The balcony has a gorgeous view. Close to everything but also quiet, because the windows face an interior courtyard rather than the street. We loved it!

Room with a wonderful view! The balcony in this Airbnb overlooks the rolling green hills of Tuscany and is simply amazing. We sat outside for hours and admired the view. The apartment is a quick walk from the Duomo and Mercato Centrale, which is quite convenient. Additionally, it is a quick walk to the tram, which helps with navigating the airport or the train station. Many good cafes and restaurants in area so you do not have to go far. Guila was very responsive to our questions and quite helpful to us in finding something very specific from the Tuscan region (Carrara marble mortar) which I am extremely grateful for!  Thank you for being such an accommodating hostess! We truly appreciated your hospitality ❤️

Wow, this is an amazing find! It’s in the middle of all of the action but quiet and serene inside the apartment. The private terrace is a lovely added bonus. The apartment looks just like the listing and nothing is missing - we had everything we needed. The bed is super comfortable and the shower has fantastic water pressure! 10/10 would absolutely stay here again in the future.
Beautiful view of Florence, close to everything. Quiet, though some nights there were fireworks :)) Happy there was an elevator!

Fantastico apartment and host!! I would definitely recommend everyone to book with Silvia. Her place was extremely nice - clean, spacious and super cute! Silvia was also really great! She recommended places for us to visit and eat. She also helped book a taxi for us to get to the airport. I would book again if I'm ever in Florence again
The stay at Silvias place was awesome! She is so kind and helpful. The appartment was so clean and is very good located! Thanks a lot!!

Highly recommend Silvia’s apartment for your stay in Florence. She is indeed a super host, attending to your every need. The location is excellent, a close walk to all attractions. The space is clean and most comfortable. And don’t forget to grab your affordable, delicious cappuccino and croissant across the street, a perfect way to start your day. Can’t wait to go back!!

This apartment is exactly what we were looking for- super clean, good location and had a washer.  On top of that it was beautiful, the bed was comfortable and Silvia was amazing and very sweet.  She gave great recommendations to restaurants.  I searched and searched for places and  I’m so glad we picked this one.  We would definitely return and highly recommend!  Florence is the best!
A great home base for Florence.  10 minutes from everything (including train) and stay within 4 blocks for the best local places to eat!

Very well located and clean.
Good bed.
That is just bad that there is no natural light.

This apartment was PERFECT! Great location, safe neighborhood, friendly welcome, great communication and overall a great stay. We traveled with our 14-month old daughter and other than having to keep the bathroom door closed, it was a very baby friendly place. We could even close one door to separate the rooms and have her stay with us while we cooked or watched TV with no worries. We walked everywhere! We even walked here from the train station- it is very accessible. House was very well-equipped.  More shower gel will have been nice but we had some and there was a bit of dust under the bed and in some corners but not a big deal. Will definitely stay here again!
Great location, very beautiful  apartment and friendly host. The city centre is in walking distance. Highly recommended!
Lovely apartment that is in comfortable walking distance to all of Florence's attractions. The host was also very accommodating when our flights were delayed which made things nice and easy!

Great stay. Very tidy, with any appliances needed if you’re self catering. Location is great, away from the super-touristic area, but only minutes away. Friends staying in the tourist mix preferred this neighbourhood after viewing. Some good restaurants and bars very near. Good communication, efficient and friendly. Would stay here again

We had a nice stay at Edoardo's place. The location was perfect -- walkable to all the sights and many restaurants, but not in an overly busy part of town. The apartment is quite small, but it is laid out in a very functional way. We had a bit of trouble finding it because we did not realize that there are two types of street numbers in Florence, ones for businesses and ones for residences, but otherwise everything else went very smoothly!

Loved this place! Highly recommend for someone traveling on a budget who is looking for a place that is walkable to just about everything you want to do in Florence. You could get anywhere you wanted to go between a 10-30 minute walk most of which you could do on the river. The property is on a quieter street which was nice at night. It looks just like the pictures and was a great size for one to two people.
Lovely stay. Close to all amenities and a short walk to the centre. Edoardo, gave lots of recommendations and answered questions we had. It was lovely a clean and just right for what we wanted.
We had a great time here exploring Florence on foot. Close to a great pizza place, coffee and scenery. A good spot to come back to and unwind after a long day.

This place is beautiful, comfortable, and the hosts make you feel like home. We loved everything but the location was our favorite thing. It’s easy to walk to the main areas of the city but you are also in a super lovely street with many great restaurants, bars and shops just a few steps away. Would definitely recommend.
Silvia’s place is absolutely beautiful, clean, and in a great location. She is very responsive and helpful which made my stay very easy. I would definitely come back!

Monica was very helpful when we reached the Concierge. She gave us ideas for places to eat and even made us a reservation for dinner. The actual apartment was about a block away from the Concierge building. Perfect location. The apartment itself was a perfect size for a couple days or I'm assuming for about a week. Has a small kitchen, its own fridge and a small TV. The wifi is good and the bathroom looks new. You are so close to the Duomo its well worth the money. From that location you could walk anywhere in 10min or less. I would highly recommend the Concierge and this location is you are visiting Florence. I will book with them again since I'm only 3 hours away. Thanks again for everything and see you soon.

We had really a nice stay in this appartement. We were nicely welcomed by Roberto the brother of Chiara.He explained to us all what we need to know. The appartement is big compared to the pictures and well equipped. I really recommand it. Thanks  Chiara &Roberto.

The apartment is really in a quiet area, and by 10 min walking, you can reach the tram who takes you into historic center. We arrived by car so it was great to leave it near the apartment and move by tram.
It's a cosy place, bigger than it seems in the photos. Thanks to the advices of Chiara & Roberto, we had a delicious dinner in a little restaurant near.
3 days were not enough to profit of the terraces ! I hope to be back :) Thank you Roberto & Chiara

The apartment is great and in an amazing location! The one thing I do note is that if you have 3 people the sofa bed is not ideal especially for a taller person. Also, the checkout time was miscommunicated. The listing says 11am, but the guy knocked on our door right at 10am and was confused. Otherwise, we had a great time!
We really loved the location of this apartment, everything within walking distance and perfect for a few days in Florence
Central, smaller than photos, the uncomfortable couch, comfortable bed. Good for two visitors not for 3, clean, tidy.

I’ll say it how it is, the apartment isn’t as smart as the photos, as with all Airbnb these days it’s all about expectations versus reality. The reality steps too far from expectation, coupled with a cleaning fee of 59 pounds this just isn’t worth 148 pounds for 1 nights stay.  I haven’t echoed the comments about the street refuse noise.  If you are looking for peace also this isn’t it.

Highly recommended- great stay. Location is super - very walkable to all key sights.
The rooms are comfortable, clean, spacious. Would stay again.
Very nice appartment in the center of Florence. I stayed here for 1 month and  Andrea was very helpfull.
Lovely apartment in very central Florence. Conveniently located for the city centre (10 minutes) and the main train station (15 minutes) taking you to and from Pisa.

We were very grateful for our stay with Andrea as he was helpful in guiding us to the accommodation and check in, as well as it being a great locality to walk into the main city centre with ease every day. It had all the amenities we needed for a week long stay, and were grateful for the support if needed.

The apartment was beautiful and everything we had hoped for ! Francesco's associate Elenora greeted us with open arms and showed us everything we needed to know about the place including a listing of restaurants grocery stores and points of interests in the area She was delightful!

Francesco's place was amazing! From the amazing view of the Tuscan hills to being super close to everything. Restaurants, grocery stores, museums were all within walking distance only a few blocks away. Loved the view. Loved the host, she sat down and point places out to eat, shop, and site see. Was so amazing, I would recommend to anyone.

Great location. Lovely clean and well appointed apartment. Air conditioning is great in hot weather. We were were met and given helpful tips about shopping, eating and sightseeing. Thoroughly recommend.

Great place, clean and well located, close to everything.
If we return to Florence definitely would stay on this place again.
Eleonora was very nice.

Super great flat and super great host. The Apartment are nice and  large.  Lovely view from  balcony. The apartment is walking distance to everything, close to the center of the city and the district is very quiet, so even late walk will be safe for you. Really enjoyed my stay. Warmly recommended!
Francesco’s place is wonderful, great location and Eleonora who checked us in gave us the best local recommendations to make our stay special! Communication was spot on as well! :)
We had such a great time and a perfect stay at Francesco’s place. Walkable to everything, with a beautiful balcony patio and all the amenities and comforts we needed. A beautiful home!

If you want somewhere to stay in Florence, look no further! Francesco and Elly were the perfect hosts - friendly, welcoming and left us plenty of clear instructions and a long list of local recommendations. The apartment is in a fabulous location and it is simply stunning - clean, comfortable, homely and spacious. I cannot recommend it enough!
The apartment is great! Central location, comfortable bed, kitchen for cooking. Tommaso kindly met us at the train station and gave us tips on where to eat and visit.
We had a great time in Florence and Tommaso's place is in a very convenient location. Highly recommended :-)
First of all,Tommaso is very kind. Great location,clean appartment,everything was just fine :) Thank you,Tommaso ;)
Great dude, easy to reach. Delivered just as expected and provided some good food suggestions like italiantapas, which was great
The location is good and the accommodations is clean. Tommaso was excellent in his communications and hospitality!
Great host who met up with us and shouted coffee!  Really nice to stay with a helpful host ! Recommend thanks

Tommaso's apartment is very welcoming, with all necessary equipments. The bedroom is big and confortable and the extra bed in the living room was confortable too. The living room is quite small but we didn't stay long at the appartment. The kitchen has all we needed such as oven, espresso machine, microwave, ... It was nice to stay there!

Great place in Florence - the photos undersell the place! Amazing location, just a few minutes away from an amazing wine bar (Il Santino) and restaurant (Il Santino Bevitore) and walking distance to the other sites. The apartment was well sized for 3 friends, and the sofa bed was very comfortable.

The apartment was small but tidy and just what I expected in the historical district of Firenze. I love that neighborhood near Santo Spirito, it's very close to the best gelato place - Gelateria La Carraia and near sights like Palazzo Pitti.
One issue I ran into: no cell phone signal inside the apartment, also the WiFi was not strong and we all could not connect at the same time.
One warning: Via Maffia has two different street numbering systems so be warned that a google maps search lead us to an address 1 block away!

Location is great! Appartment has everything that one needs. (I’d change a frying pan, it is pretty old :)) Bed and sofa both very comfortable! Apartment very clean and cozy! Sara gave us some pretty usefull hints about the surroundings. Tommaso was in contact before our arival and wrote answers to all our questions.
The apartment was great! We enjoyed our two nights in Florence. The neighborhood is super wonderful, especially at night! The place is walking distance to so many attractions.

Pros: Great location. Quiet neighborhood.
Cons: Not very cozy. There are better options for that price. We had problems with the toilet tank, which Tommaso promised to fix.

Tommaso was a very kind, friendly and flexible host.
He was very reactive during all our stay and received us super well.
The AirBnB was cute, convenient regarding devices available and very clean.
It is located in Santo Spirito district, both an animated neighbour and a calm one since the flat is located in a very quite dead end street.
Many cool places close to it for hanging out and 10min walk from city center.
I highly recommend this stay and its kind hosts.

The location of this apartment is amazing, 15 minute walk to the Ponte Vecchio and the city centre. The communication with the hosts was easy. However, the bedroom is close to a kitchen of a food place where they clean at night, earplugs were absolutely necessary for us.
Great part of town which made you feel like you were in a rustic part of town with great restaurants

We had a wonderful time at Luca's apartment in Florence!  Luca was very proactive and flexible with accommodating our arrival times.  He showed us the place, and also left us two copies of the keys so we could go around and do different things.  The apartment itself was modern, comfortable, spacious, and located next to a lot of restaurants, cafes, bars, and close to all attractions.  I loved the upstairs loft / relaxation area.  The overall experience was awesome, and can't wait to come back here the next time in Florence.  Thank you Luca for all your hospitality in hosting us.

The apartment fully met our expectations. Not far from the city center. We liked to walk for 10-15 minutes to the city center.
We recommend Luca's apartment. The apartment is fully consistent with the price/quality.
By the bye Piazza del Mercato Centrale is not far from the apartment. We had lunch there several times. Average prices, average quality.

Had a great stay at Luca’s. The place was wonderful. Perfect location. I could not be happier with my choice to stay here. Super clean and quiet with a lovely park across the street. Walking distance to all the major attractions

Great Airbnb. Very well located and walking distance from all main touristic places. Newly renovated with a lot of amenities. I highly recommend this Airbnb. The host was very fast to answer and a super easy check in process!

This is the only place I will stay in Florence .
Beautiful ,contemporary, clean apartment with all amenities necessary.
Fantastic hosts
The flat is very central, close to basically anywhere. Everything was cleaned and ready. I can absolutely recommend it.

The appartment is clean, the host Luca made a pleasant wellcome and it's located close to the railway station (5 to 10 mins walk). The only thing is that the appartment is not in the heart of the city center and ypu need to walk 15 to 20 mins (depending on whwre tour are) from the city center back to the appt in the evenings. But it's acceptable and we already knew it.

We enjoyed staying in this apartment; great location, close to many restaurants, shops , museums and close to train station.
Definitely we recommend and we would like to come back. The apartment it’s has been updated and very clean. Lucas was a excellent host, very flexible ; THANK YOU LUCAS.
Luca's place was the perfect spot for two of us to use a a homebase. The park outside was pretty and it's super close to town! Great, cute spot and in a central location. Thanks, Luca!

Really nice place, quiet and within walking distance from the city and bus stops and the tram. It was cold in Florence when we were there and we couldn’t get the heating going. After a quick message to Luca he came over and fixed it.

Everything was as described and pictures on point! Clean, nice secured neighborhood. There were 8 girls and security was number one on our list, close to everything, restaurants , ponte vecchio, only a short walk to Mercado Nazionale! Lorenzo was Awesome! I texted him his response was immediate! Good Trattorias and Osterias within a block away. Bakery and pizzerias same block.  We will return!

Lorenzo's place is a home away from home! The place was exactly as it were in the pictures- clean, cozy, and homey. The location is great! Just few steps away from piazza pitti. Easy to check in and out. Lorenzo's dad met us at the door and showed us parts of the house, left some travel tips and wished us a good stay. We highly recommend this place. :)

Excellent apartment 5 minute walk from Ponte Vecchio. Very clean, spacious. A little noisy from the street but that is to be expected given how close it is to everything. Lorenzo and Marco were great with communication before and during our stay. Would highly recommend
This is an amazing apartment. It is modern and centrally located, yet you feel you have your own little neighborhood in Santo Spirito. Highly recommended!

This apartment was fabulous!  Beautifully decorated, well located (just over the bridge on the less crowded side of the Arno), and graciously hosted with restaurant recommendations, a bottle of wine, etc.  Chiara greeted us and answered all of our questions.  Lorenzo arranged a day in Tuscany with wine tasting, and Stefan and his daughter, Pam were the perfect hosts!  Plenty of room and privacy for our group of 5 and highly recommend!  Steps to loft bedroom were fine for us but could be tricky for small children, elderly, or very large folks.

This was a great apartment in a great location with great hosts. It was a very comfortable place to stay in close proximity to all the major sights (the small downside to this being that it could get quite noisy at night). Chiara was very helpful in supplying us with extra linens and utilities; if you need anything you need only ask. One minor complaint was that the floors and some of the rooms were not as clean as I had expected, but if that is addressed then the place will be practically perfect.
Great location, very clean, modern and comfortable....Hosts were gracious & professional,  5 Stars all the way.....Hope to stay again in the future

A wonderful apartment. My family of 6 adults and 2 children stayed for 3 nights and loved our time at the apartment. Location was great as it wasn’t smack bang in the centre of city buzz but close enough. The only flaw is the windows in the front 2 bedrooms are not sound proof windows hence we could hear traffic noise. Other than that, the entire apartment was clean, very well equipped, large enough for a comfortable stay for our family, prompt communication with helpful hosts and smooth check in/out. Thank you very much Lorenzo and chiara.

This home was the perfect choice for our party of 6.  It is comfortable, clean and spacious, and in a wonderful location.  So easy to walk to everything! We would highly recommend this home for your stay in beautiful Florence.

Chiara and Lorenzo’s Airbnb is easily the best Airbnb we’ve stayed at. It’s very close to Ponte Vecchio and an ideal location for walking to most of the interesting sights in Florence. Except for the cab from the airport, we were able to walk everywhere including the train station when we left for Rome.
Chiara and Lorenzo were very responsive and helpful hosts. Chiara was able to accommodate our off-hour check in so it was an easy process. They were also very hospitable. This included leaving us a bottle of wine at check in--a nice touch.
Overall, I'd highly recommend this Airbnb.
This was such an amazing place to stay in for me and my family. Right next to Piazza Santo Spirito, where a lot of locals hang out, and in such a charming neighborhood.

A wonderful place in a very trendy part of town. The apartment was perfect for our family, including kids. We loved the multitude of shops and restaurants around the apartment. Lory met us at the apartment, showed us around and gave us local tips. Highly recommend this apartment.
Lorenzo and Chiara were absolutely wonderful! They met us there to check us in when we got into town very late at night. The apartment is adorable and unique. Would 100% stay there again!

Great location, clean, verycomfortable beds and nice touches throughout.  Chiara met us on check-in to show us around and then came by on checkout to collect the keys. There was five of us and the bedroom lofts were great for us, my husband and I in the loft on the kitchen/living room side and on the other side of the entry my Sister and her two teens had their own space with two rooms and bath.  Kitchen had all the things we needed including dishwasher and we made use of the washer/dryer. Wonderful space and great extra touches (plenty of towels, converters, books). Would definitely stay again here when we come back to Florence.
Excellent location, big apartment with everything you could need for your holiday. All in all a great place to stay!

This place is beautiful and the bedrooms are super cool lofted suites. I loved it here. The location is especially fantastic - step outside and you'll have all of Florence at your foosteps. I would love to come back.

Chiara and Lorenzo are thoughtful, communicative and went above and beyond in ensuring we had a great stay. The apartment is spacious, all amenities (including laundry, AC and elevator) and great location. Will definitely book again on future trips!

Our family had a great stay in the apartment. It’s well equipped and centrally located in a nice neighbourhood of Florence.
Bedding and bed linens could be improved. Otherwise great place!

We thoroughly enjoyed Lorenzo and Chiara's apartment.  It isvery comfortable with all needed amenities and within easy walking distance of all Florence attractions.  We had a wonderful time and hope to return soon!

We had a wonderful stay at Lorenzo and Chiara’s place. The location is perfect for exploring Florence by foot, with lovely cafés, restaurants and shops near by. Could not recommend more!
Lorenzo has been very communicative and helpful the whole time, helping us with a lot of things, like taxi and train schedule, really fantastic!
The weather was cool but the apartment stayed fairly warm, and the heater worked well when I needed it to. Would love to stay here again!

This was our first trip to Florence. We came to visit our daughter who was studying abroad. We loved the location just a 5 minute walk from her apartment. We enjoyed the short walk to many beautiful sights. We especially loved eating at La Buchetta. Also, cappuccino at Gilli was an enjoyable experience. I thank you for your hospitality and hope to visit again.

Beautiful, clean apartment. Our favorite of the few stays we had in Italy on this trip.  Situated steps from the Pitti Palace and within walking distance to most of the major attractions. There are good restaurants nearby. There is a nice lift for your luggage or your older guests and the apartment is right at the door of the lift. The hosts were very communicative and left us a bottle of wine, water, and snacks- Also the nicest touch of all the places we stayed. There were 5 of us and we were all very comfy.  This is a great home base for Florence.

Although I arrived late at night, there was a key box so I was able to check in smoothly. The room was also clean and big. However, since I slept on the first floor, the heating didn't heat up and it was cold. The location was great and convenient for sightseeing and shopping.

Our stay was so lovely, it was super spacious for 6 people and in a great central area close to all the main tourist attractions while being in a more quiet area near fun bars and restaurants. Our hosts were so helpful, our hot water wasn’t working the first day and they promptly fixed the problem. Thanks for a great stay!

We loved our stay here! It's in a great location that it's tucked away enough from the hustle & bustle of the city center while being extremely accessible to everything. Bonus that gustapizza is right next door! Lorenzo & Virginia were extremely communicative and helpful as well. Would stay here again!
Great location across the river from the Old Town but walkable to everything.  The Hosts were very helpful and the apartment was spacious.  I highly recommend, and we hope to be back soon.

Lorenzo and Virginia are awesome!! They truly care about you and your experience from the moment you finalized the booking. The property is exactly as advertised and in a great location. The property comfortably accommodated 10 adults!

Our stay in Florence was great.  Lorenzo and Virginia's unit was exactly what we needed after arriving after a long flight.  There was lots of space, bright, clean, central, cool (A/C).  Would highly recommend!
Great visit! Location could not have been better. Our family of 5 felt right at home!
This was such a gem! Plenty of space. Responsive to all our questions and lovely people. Highly recommend
Felt like home. Apartment always smells good. Host is very kind, helpful and responsive. Thank you

Nicole was really friendly and super helpful! The place itself was more than we expected and was perfect for our stay! So close to the station and a short walk to the main sites with many food options to pick from! We had a really great stay - grazie mille Nicole! :)
The flat is very nice and clean, and has a walking distance to all main attractions.  High recommended!

This is a very central place, easy to arrive by car as much as you can call it easy in Firenze.
It is a clean location, comfortable and you can check in and out very easy. Internet is working well. So, very good value for your money.

Such a great place. Close to everything! Super clean and very comfortable beds.
We were 2 couples. We were not aware that we were getting two entire apartments. That was a nice surprise. Good value!

Thanks! Nicole. We enjoyed our stay in your apartment. The place was clean and had all the amenities. The house is centrally located in Florence and is close to all important, historic places. We were 7 of us and all of us had a great time in Nicole's house. Will definitely recommend to my friends

Amazing location and a cute little apartment. One WC was not functional and the air conditioning is not great. Another drawback is the 2 stories you need to climb to get to the apartment- people with heavy luggage need to take this into consideration
Otherwise a fairly pleasant stay mainly as we saved on transport costd with the apartment being centrally located. The host needs to get the 2 points corrected for a perfect 5 experience

Nicole and her husband were very helpful, accommodating and quick to respond to all communication.
The apartment is a great size, comfortable, nicely decorated and well equipped, it had everything we needed. As two families travelling together we loved the split apartment concept. If you stay in the front apartment you do get street noise during the night, I’m sure ear plugs would help but it didn’t bother us or our two year old son. The back apartment and rooms are very quiet.
Location is great! A few blocks to the train station and all the sights of Firenze within walking distance. Plenty of restaurants and shops right outside the door.
We would definitely stay here again.
Good location and very clean.  Needs some minor upkeep and downstairs bar noise are the only detractors.  I would stay here again.

We were greeted by Alfred, Nicole's husband and he was great and helpful. Their apartment is well located and relatively modern. The sofa bed in the front room is not very comfortable and is probably only comfortable for 1 person; other than that the beds are good. The one issue was the noise in the front room, there is a bar downstairs that opens until 2am and it gets quite noisy, but if sleep is not an issue for you, you should be fine. Overall, i think it is great value and would stay there again.

Location was superb :) could walk everywhere, easily. The space is tight, which is expected for location, but overall a great place to stay with peace of mind knowing that everywhere is within reach.
Thanks a million Nichole.
This place was very centric we loved every minute of it, they communicated very well and we would gladly stay here again. :)
Everything was perfect.. We have the most pleasant stay in Italy. Highly recommended. Great place, great location, great treatment.

Our stay couldn't have been better, Laura was a great host and very informative with the history of the building. The location is absolutely in the "A" spot great area with many restaurants and historic sites. Could not asked for anything more.
The apartment is great! Very close to all the major sites in Florence and great restaurants and bars. The apartment itself is very cozy and good looking.

We had a wonderful stay in the Florence city center. Our host Laura was always responsive to our questions to find the best shopping and excellent restaurants, not to mention the best gelato in Florence! The location is a wonderful city neighborhood with everything you need close by, and it is an enjoyable 5 min walk to the Piazza de la Signoria, Ponte Vecchio, the Uffizi museum and Santa Croce.
This is a wonderful location and we would not hesitate to come back again!

The house is absolutely beautiful and clean! The location doesn't get any better. Walk out of the house and there are the best breakfast, lunch, dinner and gelato places. Not to mention all the great shopping.
We were able to walk everywhere.
Laura was extremely helpful with recommendations of restaurants as well as helping me get my haircut.
My husband, 2 teenage boys and I can't wait to come back again.

We stayed for 4 nights in Laura's  apartment, Laura is wonderful, helpful, informative and a lovely host. She helps a lot during our stay. The house is tidy, clean and comfortable which located in the centre of the city. We definitely will book again in next visit.
Great place to stay. Laura was great, the apartment was wonderful. We were only two but could have fit much more. Perfect location!
Laura checked us in and was the perfect host. So full of information and just a call away to help with anything we needed. We would highly recommend you stay here.

We have just returned from a fabulous weekend in Florence.  Gianfranco's apartment is very centrally located, but quiet and tucked away.  Laura was very hospitable and informative and we were not disappointed by any of her recommendations.  We would definitely recommend staying here.

Perfect location...perfect city.....Laura is precious...so happy to give us all the information about her beautiful city and so gracious with her time.  An exceptional host....an exceptional place.   If you are traveling to Florence, this is your place!    .....  Ahem, ....  unless we are there!   haha....

First, Laura was a great host! She was promptly at the flat to welcome us and took the time to offer up her recommendations.
The flat is well maintained with large rooms and is very clean. The history of the building adds to the experience in Florence. Main bathroom is spacious and beds are comfortable. Location is hard to beat as most things of interest are within easy walking distance.
Would absolutely recommend staying here!

Five star experience!! Laura was great at communicating with us before our stay. Upon arriving she sat with us and went over all the best places to go. The apartment is immaculately clean and beautiful. The location could not be better, minutes away from everything we wanted to see. This was our favorite place we stayed in Italy, thank you so much Laura!!
Highly recommended comfortable accommodation in a central location. Easy walk to restaurants, supermarket & attractions. Our host, Laura, was very knowledgeable & extremely helpful.
very beautiful and big apartment in a residential palazzo right in the middle of the old town. friendly reception and nice tips for tourists. grazie mille!

Really beautiful apartment in an fabulous location.   Laura is a warm host who clearly loves her city and appreciates this beautiful apartment.  Thank you Laura to you and your family for sharing this beautiful, historical apartment with us.  We had a fabulous stay.

Gianfranco's place was perfect! We were met by Gianfranco's daughter, Laura, who gave us many great recommendations. We were able to see most of the sights that she recommended and we also went to the restaurants Laura recommended. They were all great! Laura was a truly wonderful host. She even provided a recommendation for where to get a hair cut when I asked! The location is spectacular so we were able walk to all the places we wanted to see. When were were done seeing the sights, Gianfranco's apartment was a refreshing place to come back to with its air conditioning and beautiful decorating. If I return to Florence I would try to pick when I visit based on the availability of Gianfranco's and Laura's apartment!
Rosa was a great host!  She made us feel welcome and was very helpful with all of our guestions.  Neighborhood was safe and convenient.
This was my first time staying at an Airbnb and I was a bit skeptical but this place was amazing, Laura was very helpful. The place was very clean and centrally located. Definitely would recommend!!!

Incredibly gracious hosts. Truly went out of their way to make us feel at home.
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
Rosa was great to deal with and gave us loads of recommendations in Florence. The room was comfortable and clean. lovely stay all round.

Excellent stay. Room is air-conditioned which is great for the height of summer and is as advertised. Rosa the host is fantastic with flexible check in times and we were able to leave our luggage on check out due to having a late train. Rosa has a plethora of helpful recommendations which improved our trip! Would definitely stay here again.

Great location and great place to stay. Lots of space ! The photos are realistic to the apartment. Our host was great and we enjoyed the local knowledge and tips of where to enjoy our meals.  Our time wasn’t long enough, but if we were to return we would not hesitate to stay again . We had left some important documents in Venice and Laura was so helpful in helping organise them to get to us.  Loved our stay and would not hesitate recommending it!

What a phenomenal host Laura is! The local tips and advice were invaluable and it led us to have an experience in Florence that would be unmatched in a hotel. Laura's passion for her city and support of local business was inspiring. The apartment is beautiful and very central, allowing us to feel like locals ourselves for a short time! Little touches like shampoo, conditioner, straighteners , tea , coffee etc were all fantastic  to have available to us. We all felt truly welcomed in Florence.

Everything was pristine.  The cleanest most well thought out home we have ever booked on airbnb. I found it by the reviews on airbnb and the home is even better.  We were so excited to sleep in these most comfortable beds. The only possible draw back is the 1.5 flights of stairs typical in Italy.  If you are unable to make the stairs would be the only concern.

This place is amazing! The location is perfectly situated in the heart of Florence, yet still quiet and spacious. The apartment is better than the pictures and the host was throughful and communicated well. She met us at the apartment, spent an hour helping us develop our itinerary and thought of every little amenity to make our stay more comfortable (milk, orange juice, pastries, tea, coffee, snacks were all waiting for us). She loves her apartment, Florence and hosting and it shows.
Our host was extremely helpful (with local tips on food and sights and also called us a cab at the end of our stay) and the apartment was in a great location
It was great staying at Rosa's place and she was super responsive helping us whenever we had problems!

Highly recommend this place to stay in Florence. It is perfectly located to walk to all the places we visited. The apartment is beautiful and very clean.  The host was so helpful, spending time giving us recommendations on places to visit and where to eat. She was also a lifesaver helping with lost luggage!  If you are visiting Florence this is the place to stay!!

Gianfranco could not  be a more amazing host! She was  excellent in communicating and so very informative! Her help and guidance assisted with our full stay! She recommended a local restaurant that was not only delicious...but the host and owner, Fabio showed us the Roman remains that are just steps below our feet. Gianfranco - you were gracious and kind...the whole experience was beyond memorable! We cannot thank you enough!

This is a beautiful place and in the middle of all the action at Florence .. easy to walk around , the home has all the required amenities to make you feel comfortable. Laura was a wonderful host and very helpful .. we would definitely stay here again.
Excellent quiet location, gracious, helpful hosts, comfortable beds & pillows, plus thoughtful amenities! We would absolutely stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay in Firenze. The apartment is in a fantastic location with Piazza Signoria and Santa Croce in easy walking distance. Many restaurants to choose from as well. The apartment is a home away from home. Very comfortable, well appointed kitchen and bath with lots of maps/books to help you discover Firenze. Laura is very responsive, helpful and shares many local tips with you. We would definitely stay here again on our next visit.
Lovely place in a great location! Laura provided lots of great recommendations and the apartment was beautiful, spacious and well-appointed. We felt right at home and would definitely stay again.

Thanks to Laura, her kindness and her great apartment we enjoyed three incredible days in Firenze. The location of the place, its cleanliness and Laura’s services and attentions makes it more than a simple « place to stay » : the greatest place to rest and sleep in Florence !

You could not find a better location. The best cafe in Florence is 30 seconds from the front door. The best spicy spaghetti is just 1 minute from the apartment. All the sights are 15-20 minutes walk.
The apartment is historic and beautiful, with plenty of space. But the best thing about this apartment are the hosts. They went above and beyond to ensure our visit to Florence was the best it could possibly be. Not only did they recommend parks & gardens, art, sights, and the best restaurants in all of Florence, they also took the time to explain and map out where everything is; I’ve never had such a gracious host.
You absolutely must stay here!

Hi.We stayed at Gianfrancos apartment for nine days and we have to say it was amazing.
Great location. Beautiful apartment with everything you need and more to make your stay here memorable. Laura who was on hand to greet us on arrival and run through how things worked in apartment also gave us recommendations of places to eat. The ones we tried on list were 100%. Laura was amazing and we really appreciated her unexpected kind gestures.
We have been to many fine Airbnbs in different countries but we have to say Gianfrancos
is in a different class 10/10.
We will return in the future for sure.

What an amazing experience we have had! This spotless apartment is fabulous with every comfort anticipated by our hosts! We felt completely at home and pampered as well. We were welcomed with delicious cookies and bottle of vin santo. Soaps, shampoos, hairdryers, lots of towels were provided as well as kitchen goodies like oil, vinegar, spices, tea and coffee. It was fun to be able to watch Netflix movies in the evening! Our host was outstanding and always available for any information we might require like restaurant and shopping recommendations.
The greatest plus is this apartment’s location in the heart of the Santa Croce district. We were close to the Arno for relaxed strolling, as well as near wonderful restaurants many within a five minute walk. We can’t wait to return to our florentine home away from home!
Perfectly located for whatever you are wanting to see and do in Florence with wonderful street food takeaways near by.

Laura is the best host and quick to answer all your questions. The place is very convenient location within 15-20 min from major attractions. It was nice to come back to apt in the afternoon to cool off with the air conditioning since it was unusually hot. You have everything you need to make meals and do laundry and it was good to have 2 toilets for 3 women. Don’t hesitate to book this place if you have the chance.

This is a beautiful flat in the heart of Florence. Very convenient location. We were met by our host Laura who is delightful. She initially greeted us, helped us with our luggage and sat and chatted with us about Florence. The apartment has all the amenities you could ask for. The beds were very comfortable, the bathroom was spacious & modern. Plenty of storage and closet space in the bedrooms. The kitchen was well stocked. The AC worked great which was a necessity since it was 90 degrees in Florence.
Convenient location. Great cafes and restaurants in close proximity.
Laura, our host was great! Greeted us upon arrival and sat and chatted with us. She gave us restaurant and cafe suggestions. She made dinner reservations for us one evening. She responded quickly to our text messages. Arranged a taxi for us to to the train station upon our departure.
I highly recommend Gianfrancos place.

Laura is the best host. The place is clean and very good location. We love the house which is her grandpa’s house and the building is over 200 years . The communication is very quick. Every famous place is walking distance. Laura just like a tour guide. She told us where local people go for market and food.
I highly recommend her place.
Wonderful house, excellent location, we tried many of the host’s restaurant recommendations and they were all delightful. Can’t beat the location.

Absolutely amazing experience. Laura was not only very helpful and extremely kind, but also so knowledgable about her beloved city of Florence. Restaurant and gelato recommendations were excellent.
The apartment was incredible; clean, specious, and had everything that you could ever need on vacation. I would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone. It was walking distance to the centro storico, train station, and all the delights of Florence. A real gem!!!
An incredibly comfortable and clean apartment with a great location. Laura is a very generous host. We will definitely stay here again when we come back to Florence.

Laura is a really good host, nice and amazing place feels like home, I recommend this place for every family. One thing to be noted that there is no lift in the building so keep in mind if you have lot of luggage.
Beautiful apartment, extremely clean, great location. Laura was just lovely and made our stay extra special! So sad we couldn’t stay longer, hope to be back!

We very much enjoyed our stay in this carefully renovated and cozy apartment with a personal history. The home is exactly as described and left nothing wanting. Gianfranco and Laura's tips were very helpful. We plan to come back!

Beautiful apartment, in the city center but very quiet as it doesn’t face the street. Very safe location and building. Laura was an extremely responsive and kind host. The apartment was pristine and had everything we might need.
The apartment is up a couple flights of stairs, but very manageable. Loved staying here.

We only stayed one night in Florence but would definitely book again/ recommend. Host responded immediately to questions, was very helpful and booked a taxi to the airport. Apartment was as described, spotlessly clean and very comfortable .  Nice touch and so aporeciated was the coffee pods/ cakes , especially after a tiring day travelling. Also washing tabs/ conditioner allowed ys to use the washer/ dryer which was an unexpe ted plus!Within walking distance to all the main attractions and close to lively shops/ restaurants. First class attention to detail all round!

Laura met us personally and her warmth and hospitality really made our stay memorable. She was very responsive throughout our stay and quick to attend to any queries. Her place is so well equipped that we felt right at home and sad to leave. This is our best Airbnb in Italy!
Would highly recommend if you wish to stay in a cosy place in right in town. Close to everything.

My family and I had an amazing time in Florence. Gianfranco’s house was fantastic. Right in the centre of Florence and walkable to everything. The house was perfect with lots of little extras that were above and beyond. I would highly recommend this airbnb to anyone travelling to Florence!
We had an absolutely lovely stay. The host is amazing so kind and thoughtful. I cannot say enough good things about this place. It was fantastic.

Laura was a delight. The apartment is beautiful and charming.
Right in the heart of all the action.

This was an amazing property, centrally located in the beautiful town of Florence. Laura was such a kind hostess, and there were many thoughtful details included with this property that I hadn’t seen before. We loved this property, and hope to return in the future!

Our family of 4 had a wonderful time in Florence and staying at this ideal property is one of the reasons. The location is great, the place is spacious, and the building has incredible history and character.  The host, Laura, has thoughtfully attended to many details and extras, and she went out of her way to provide recommendations and make reservations for us. When a minor maintenance issue arose, she managed it quickly and discreetly while keeping us updated. We were impressed! When our friends visit Florence, we will recommend this gem of a place!

Wonderful host and amazing property. Host was very welcoming and provided helpful recommendations. We had a lovely stay in Florence. Excellent location.  If you are visiting Florence highly recommend staying at this property!

Gianfranco & Laura we’re wonderful hosts! So responsive, helpful and kind! The restaurant recommendations were great! And the property was so beautiful and clean. Such a wonderful and relaxing experience. Highly recommend!

Laura was a wonderful host. She was very responsive and very thorough. She has thought of everything with regard to amenities and gave us great recommendations both for restaurants and things to do/see. I would definitely stay again if back in Florence.
Wonderful host, thoughtful and helpful. Gave lots of great recommendations.  Nice and very comfortable apartment. We loved our stay. Highly recommend.

Gianfranco and Laura’s historic place felt just like home. Laura greeted us at check-in and explained everything clearly, booked us an unforgettable dining experience and proactively reached out to us about transportation. We felt very well taken care of, like we had an instant friend in Florence. Their place offers many thoughtful amenities, like razors and hair ties in the bathroom and plug adapters. The showers were strong and hot. She also provided some treats which helped with the late-night munchies in front of the tv, watching Netflix. The location can’t be beat, we were right in the middle of everything Florence had to offer — museums, shops, cafes, gelaterias. Nothing was more than a 10-20 minute walk. I highly recommend their place to anyone, and it’s especially great for families and young couples. We plan to come back to this beautiful city and will be renting from Laura and Gianfranco again!

I highly recommend Gianfranco’s place!
We would definitely stay here again. It’s a historic but beautifully updated and spacious apartment that was perfect for our family of four. Gianfranco’s daughter was so friendly and helpful from the time of booking
through checkout. She made us feel at home, and the apartment had everything we needed.

Laura and Gianfranco’s space is immaculate, comfortable, and in an excellent location. The space is wonderfully appointed and so thoughtfully stocked with all the little things you wouldn’t even expect but make the experience so welcoming. Our host met us upon checking in and showed us around, gave excellent local recommendations, and checked in on us throughout the trip - even helping us get a taxi when it was time to leave. You should definitely stay here when visiting Florence.

Our travel agent was nervous about us renting a property but we took a chance and we were so glad we did!!  Laura instantly became our local best friend, meeting us in person for check in, arranging taxis for us, and checking to make sure we were ok.  The apartment was immaculate with so many thoughtful amenities such as toiletries and kitchen supplies and even snacks!  We cannot say enough good things about this place.  After a busy day in the city, this felt like our home away from home!
Fantastic flat, fantastic location and a host that went the extra mile to make your stay easy. Would definitely recommend it.

Very nice apartment! It is in the city center, close to the main sight spot. 1 minutes walk to the Galleria degli Uffizi. Salvatore and his mother are very nice to welcome us. The two apartments are clean and cosy, even prepares food and drink for us. Perfect apartment to live in for group or family in the trip!

Just a gorgeous spot - perfectly located, and with plenty of space to spread out!  Each bedroom is well designed and appointed, and the living spaces are beautiful.  Plus the terrace is very special, with an herb garden and essentially total privacy.  Highly recommended!

We visited this Location with thirteen people and were very satisfied with everything. The appartments were clean and the vintage interior suited the building perfectly.g Also the location was situated very well, which made the exploration of Florence uncomplicated.  A supermarket, bars and restaurants are accessable within short walking distance.  The hosts were very sincere and helpful with questions and Problems. All in all we can only recommend this airbnb.

Ludovico’s apartment went above and beyond our expectations. Truly a flawless experience. For starters, it was in a great location in a beautiful, historic building. The elevator was perfect for the elderly individuals and the kids in our group (as well as our suitcases). The apartment itself was gorgeous, and had plenty of space for all nine of us to spread out. The terrace was also gorgeous, my only complaint being that we did not have time to dine al fresco on it. We appreciated having a laundry machine as we are abroad for three weeks; and with the housekeeping every day, every room having its own full bathroom, the toiletries, and the pages of info and tips they thoughtfully left for us, we felt like we were staying in a glamorous hotel — only better. Our experience here could not have been better.

Ludovico's place is truly amazing. My favorite part was... ah! so many! The outdoor patio was amazing to have -- plants that are well taken care of, the sun! There's so much space for each person -- we were only 2 and it was serene.... Love the high ceiling, love the luxury bath salts provided. I also love the bath tub upstairs that is Japanese/Scandinavian feel. The building itself is like a museum it was truly breathtaking. The living room was very cozy for us to watch Netflix in. The kitchen was great as well. Truly we have no complaints! Tigge was very kind and she can help you with your laundry and groceries! Last but not least, the location and elevator! Truly you can't find a better Airbnb than this. Shower pressure was great, hot water was always plenty enough for everyone. Thank you again!!
Beautiful apartment leaving us with nothing to do but relax and enjoy Florence. Perfect location, plenty of room and well equipped. Highly recommend you stay here when in Florence.

Great place to stay, close to all attractions, restaurants and shops.  Ludovico was always responsive and flexible, great host.   We met the cleaner and she was absolutely delightful, helpful and accommodating.   The kitchen had everything to cater for, a big family, it was lovely cooking there.  Highly recommend this place, happy to stay again.
Amazing stay!! We had 5 couples stay here and there was plenty of room. Perfect location and incredible Airbnb. Highly recommend for groups traveling to Florence!

Ludovico was a great host. Very responsive and flexible. The apt was very large for the 10 guests that stayed. Everyone felt like they had their own space. The pictures don’t do it justice, the space itself is more beautiful in person. Also, location is wonderful! 10 out of 10.

The flat was awesome, right in the center of Florence, where you can walk and explore for hours. It was the perfect location and set-up for our group of nine!
In addition, Ludovico and his assistant were super responsive and answered all my questions during our stay.
Sofia's place was great! The apartment was beautifully decorated and very spacious, plus a great location. We really loved our time in Florence and Sofia's place was a huge part of that.
Sofia’s place was perfect and had everything we required for our stay. Would recommend and would happily stay there again.

Sofia is the absolute sweetest.
She went above and beyond to take care of us.
The flat is exactly as described in the photos, so much space.
Perfect location, very convenient to everything we wanted to walk to.
Would recommend for someone who wants to enjoy an authentic Firenze experience.
Lovely apartment for our family to explore Florence. Very spacious and the children had a great time :) it was also easy to communicate with Sofia

We were the first guest in the apartment. Luisa was a nice and helpful host, easy to communicate with. The place is newly renovated, but has a real toscan atmosphere. The wooden ceiling and the nice balcony is plus. We would recommend it to everybody.

The flat placed great spot, has enough distance from crowded pup and restaurant but easy to access, not much noise and reachable to main station, supermarket and tour sites.
Cozy flat has quite and relaxing atmosphere with most of kitchen utensils.
Also kind and prompt support from Luisa will definitely help you to have valuable memories from this flat.
I would love to recommend this flat for anyone.

Casina Guelfa is perfectly located in the heart of the city. The apartment is cosy, quite and well equipped.  I really loved the balcony surrounded by trees. Luisa is a wonderful host.  Highly recommended!

This apartment is the nicest I have ever stayed in! Just perfect. Nice size rooms, stylish furnishings, lovely little patio, and QUIET. Unbelievable in the middle of busy Florence. Ideally placed, too.
Great location and beautiful place. I found it difficult to sleep at times but what do you expect being close to the piazza. Wonderful view and terrace

My husband and I stayed here for 3 nights and we loved the location of this apartment. We were able to walk to everywhere and uffizi is just 1 min away or a 5 min walk to Santa spirito where you would find many wonderful dining options. The apartment is kept cool with air con so it was wonderful to come back to the apartment after walking in the hot weather all day long. The view from the balcony is amazing and we love to wake up in the morning and watch people strolling along the piazza when it is still calm and not crowded with throngs of tourists yet. Would definitely stay here again when we visit Florence again.

The location was wonderful. In the plaza with caffés and restaurants, very walkable, and the view and balcony were just beautiful. Stefano was helpful and greeted us with a map and suggestions for the area. Highly recommend!

We stayed 5 nights at Stefano's place and it was great. Very clean exactly as described. Balcony overlooking the Piazza where you can sit and act like a local is very cool. Steps from everything you are really in the middle of the action. Fixed taxi fares to and from the airport is the way to go. Definitely the place to get a real sense for Firenze. Stefano was a great host. Highly recommended.

Beautiful apartment centrally located. Comfortable bed with nice clean bathrooms. Bring earplugs if city noise is a problem for you as there are constant streams of people passing through Piazza della Signoria until early morning.
Stefano's apartment is absolutely spectacular.  I felt like a queen!  We had such a great time.  The apartment is stunning and such a convenient location. Would love to come back.

Spectacular location, beautifully furnished in period pieces! We used the balcony for reading, eating gelato, and even listening to a free concert in the piazza one evening. We felt like Ljung calls as we moved around our beloved Firenze. Stefano was very helpful, and we hope to return.

Very nice space in the heart of Florence.  Just steps away from all that Florence has to offer.  Located above the piazza, it does get loud but is definitely a trade off being in this location. I would stay here again.

Wow! Such a treat to stay in the very heart of Florence. One could not be closer to the action. Very central to everything. Steps to the Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio, The Duomo and amazing shopping.
Stefano was a terrific host. Great communication throughout the process, check in was super easy and he left us with great tips.
Don't forget to bring your toiletries and especially earplugs for light sleepers. The location is prime and the square noise is a by-product of this. Worth the trade-off for us.
Thank you Stefano!
The apartment was perfect.  Excellent location, beautiful, very clean.  Stefano was extremely prompt in responding to all of our messages.  Couldn't have been better!

One of the nicest flats I have been to in Europe. Fantastic location, great style, and lots of room. Such a nice stay. The AC in the bedroom is really nice to have when it is hot outside. Stefano was also a great host!

Stefano’s apartment is outstanding- stylish and in an incredible location overlooking the main square. It is surrounded by excellent restaurants. Close to shopping and a short walk from many of Florene’s Icons- highly recommended. He is a great communicator and made check in a breeze!
As described, fantastic location, stylish space. Felt like we were a part of the city, not tourists (we were tourists)

A very special home, in a very special piazza; the place is perfect for a couple; well equipped; and in the center of everything important in Firenze. I cannot recommend it enough. Everything was seamless...

Stayed here for 5 nights and loved The Central location. Did not find any issues with noise from the restaurants downstairs at night but probably because it’s not a peak season. Communication was good as Stefano was quick to respond to some minor issues during our stay. Just thought maybe some extra touches like more toilet rolls or a proper knife and cutting board  in the kitchen would be good. But overall was a great stay!
Place is great, the only problem for us was there weren’t any shampoo but not to worry there’s a pharmacy right on the corner. Still gets 5 stars the place is beautiful and location is perfect.
One of the nicest Airbnbs that we've done, really characteristic apartment, in the most amazing location.

Well what an amazing apartment ! The location was incredible. Check in was great. Good communication from the host. I felt like a Princess in Florence for a few days.
Everything so close by, and even the walk up into the hills to the best view of the City was only 20 minutes walk. Florence is an amazing city so it’s only fitting to stay in an amazing building. So much history.
There are little supermarkets near by if you want to eat in too.
The bed was the most comfortable bed I’ve ever slept on and I’ve travelled the World !
The square can stay quite lively until the early hours of the morning, so there will be some noise, but it’s exciting !
I would definitely stay here again

Outstanding location! Flawlessly smooth check in.  Beautiful comfortable space.  Be aware of Italy’s comprehensive recycling program- you will be taking your recycling several blocks away as needed. Stefano provided excellent guidance.  Grocery store and pharmacies nearby for coffee, fresh produce, bath soap, shampoo etc.  you’ll need paper towels and dish towels.  Be sure you get the instructions on using the stovetop and Moka
We had a great stay at Stefano’s place. The location was perfect! Close to everything and beautiful. We will be back! :)

With a small terrace over looking the Piazza, you feel right in the middle of Florence life. When crowded, the Piazza can be a bit noisy, but that is life in the big city. Great views and walkable to every key destination in the city. Second toilet is a real bonus. Space is large and well equipped.

This place had the best location, close to everything. Spotless clean! Only observation is at night gets loud til late due to people walking around Piazza della Signoria. That’s the only observation, I had a great night sleep since I don’t wake up easily. But don’t get this keep you away from this place since it is fenomenal! Cosimo was very helpful and his restaurant recommendations were on point! Please give it a try to his list of restaurants, you will not be disappointed!
Great location. The balcony was perfect. Got a little loud late at night but that is to be expected given it is right on one of the town’s main piazzas. Would stay here again.

We had such a lovely stay. Check in and out was very smooth and flexible. Amazing location in the heart of such a historic square. Relatively quiet given the location but some noise (as expected) in the evenings. Would definitely recommend to stay here.

This apartment is so amazing, it greatly enhanced my overall perception of visiting Florence. So beautiful with all the little details, clean, spacious, insane location!! Staying on the square was iconic and romantic. Host was super responsive, friendly and helpful. Definitely recommend this place!

Great, very spacious spot in an excellent central location. A bit noisy in the evenings and early mornings, but to be expected with staying in the city center and was nothing out of control! Overall would definitely stay here again and  it was the perfect spot for our first visit to Florence.
Great apartment and an even better location! Couldn`t be more central! Cute little terrace, perfect to have breakfast or a drink. Fluent communication and perfect service.

Very nice appartment ideally placed in the centre of Florence.
the only downside was the lack of flat-iron
The location of the apartment is great for exploring Florence and is spacious and light. Was perfect for two couples.

Our stay was great, the place is located within a two minute walk to the Ponte Vecchio. We didn’t spend much time in the building as we were exploring most of our time there, but everything we needed and required was in the living space. Check-in was also pleasantly smooth.
