Beautiful and spacious. Fully equipped and perfectly located for your stay in Florence. Spending a night in the single bed up in the tower and waking up to the church bells of the city was incredible.
This is a well-located place with easy access to the river and all the piazzas where all the main sites are located.

The apartment is in a safe neighborhood and it's a walking distance to pretty much every tourist attractions and train station. The apartment is clean, comfy, and newly renovated with most of the vital amenities included. Highly recommended. I'll definitely book with Benedetta again the next time we visit Florence.

This place was great. 8-10 min walk to the train station, the Duomo, and the Accademia Gallery. There is a grocery store nearby (and a little shop that sells drinks next door). Place was very clean and host was responsive to messages.

My wife and I stayed here for 3 night. Everything was very clean and almost brand new. Espresso machine and w/d machines were a huge plus. The apartment is within 5 minutes walking of major attractions (the David, Duomo, etc.). Quiet little spot in town which makes the balcony nice (no view of the Duomo). Only suggestions were for her to add a mattress pad (hard bed) and a couple extra pillows and blankets. The mini a/c systems were great! You could set each room to their own temps. We would definitely stay here again!
Benedetta’s apartment was absolutely the perfect place to stay in Florence! It was clean and quaint. The terrace was a lovely addition. We would definitely stay here the next time in Florence.

Benedetta’s place was more than we could have expected! The location is amazing, close to the Duomo and Uffizi and tons of lovely restaurants. The quiet balcony at the back was perfect for our morning coffees or to cool down after a long day of walking. Plus the bed was so confortable!! I would higly recommend this place to anyone looking for a perfect spot in Firenze :)
Very nice apartment. We particularly liked the Mercato Centrale which is around the corner. Great food corner! Best place for lunch in Florence!

We enjoyed our stay very much. The location was very convenient and the apartments had all the amenities of home. The heating worked really well during chilly days and the apartment was very clean and charming.
Great place with great view. Location is 10 minutes from Duomo, not a bad choice!

We loved staying at this airbnb! It was centrally located( close to the train station), amenities were perfect (washer, dryer, comfortable bed, nice big bathroom). We definitely recommend this unit to anyone traveling to Florence!
The apartment was very cozy.  We enjoyed the balcony in the morning for coffee and croissants.  The location is fantastic.  Bernadetta was very accommodating.  We would definitely stay again!!

The location is between the train station and the Duomo. Inside, the apartment was very quiet. We didn’t hear a sound once inside. The terrace was also very quiet. Having a washer and dryer was a game changer for us. We packed two small carryon bags and needed to do laundry due to the heat and sweat it created. Florence was awesome!

This place was amazing!! The host met us outside and gave us a full tour of the apartment when we arrived as well as recommendations. It was the perfect size and the stairs were not too bad! Would definitely recommend and stay here again!
Best Airbnb ever! So spacious, and in a really great area. Check in was super simple.

Mari and Luca have a lovely home in Florence. Although it is a shared space, when my sister and I stayed, no one else had booked the place, so we had the whole apartment to ourselves!!! It’s fairly close to the city centre - you can reach all of Florence’s main attractions within 20mins by foot. Public transport is nearby however unnecessary unless you’re carrying your luggage. Upon check-in, we were welcomed by Luca’s friend who went over everything we needed to know in detail. (We also got some complimentary water!)
Luca messaged often to ensure everything was going well and provided us with some good tips on local restaurants, supermarkets etc... We really enjoyed our stay here - thank you!
The room was exactly like the shown photos. Big room with TV and A/C. It's a pity that we missed the exceptional cleanliness..
Apartment is good, but a bit noisy cause of restaurant on the ground floor. The bathroom is too small. The location is perfect, around 30 mins from Duomo by walk
Great place to stay, though it is about 20/25mins walk to city centre. Luca was very friendly and helpful during check in.

We stayed in the apartment in Florence.  Everything is as described.  Mari and Luca were attentive at all times, they made absolutely everything easy.  I have no doubt that I would stay in a Mari and Luca apartment again!

Stayed here for 3 nights, was a nice comfortable stay. Hosts made it very easy to get in and had helpful recommendations. In a bit of a quieter area compared to downtown Florence but still lots of amenities nearby.
Gave great recommendations, allowed us to store our bags post check out, and the Airbnb was clean and lovely. Will definitely stay again!
It’s an awesome place to stay. Lorenzo is so nice and responsive to all our queries. We are very happy with our stay at his place. We’ll definitely stay there again.

The location of this unit is perfect for touring all around the city, very central.  The rooftop patio was the pearl of the unit, we spent a lot of time up there at night or when coming back to relax in the afternoon.  The unit is very clean and fixtures like new, and it's very quiet, even though it's in the heart of the city.  The bathroom is small, but serviceable, we just took turns!  Gabriel and Nic were very responsive and helpful.

the best one for us during our whole stay in Italy. The landscape of the terrace is very attractive, people can see the church from a very good view. The location of the apartment is perfect, 5mins walk to the church, and you can find a lot of shops around the apartment, including some convenience store. we arrived Firenze by train, from the railway station to the apartment is also very easy for us, it takes around 10mins to walk from the railway station. inside the apartment, also very clean, everything in room are very easy to use. We will be back if we were going back to Firenze.
It's a very beautiful apartment in a cool neighbourhood. I had a great stay. It was also immaculately clean.
Had a wonderful stay in Marco’s house. The place is central but somehow very quiet. Perfect for a few days in Florence!
Great place, super stylish and a great location, everything is a walking distance, also good restaurants and bars near by.

I worked in Florence for 3 weeks and stayed at Silvia's place the entire time. I could not have picked a better location in terms of value, location, and comfort.
Some worthy mentions:
- Hosts are super helpful with any questions you may have/recommendations
- The apartment is just beautiful with its high ceilings and large windows
- Location is on point: right by the water, but not too busy with tourists
I would stay at Silvia's again if I find myself in Florence.

Nice host.   Gokhan and Claudia are great. A warm greeting and gave us good suggestions. Silvia prepared some good info sheets to explore the Florence.  The interior is definitely top-notch!  We enjoyed our journey not only in sightseeing but also in living like a local.

A little gem of an appartment, great living space,  comfortable, highly functional kitchen, ideally located close to everything but just a little ways away from more touristy streets. Seamless communication the whole way through which made this experience very pleasant. Would stay again.

This is the perfect place if you want to stay in the city centre. Everything is in walking distance.
The studio was bigger as I thought it would be. Very comfortable, with all you need for your stay. I stayed for 6 weeks and could easily have stayed longer.
Claudia is a very helpful host, just one phone call or whatsapp message and she will help you with anything. During the Covid time she updated me with the newest restrictions.
I would absolutely recommend this studio and hope to stay here again in the future.

Location was perfect!! We had never been to Florence before and wanted to make the most of our time there. The location was perfect for walking to everywhere we wanted to go. The room was exactly as depicted. Would definitely stay again.

The apartment was very comfortable and we definitely enjoyed our stay. The location was very central to all the best attractions and restaurants. The host was very responsive and the the stay went smoothly with no issues. One thing I want to note is that it can be quite loud outside the apparentement at times so it may be a good idea to bring earplugs or play some white noise when sleeping. Otherwise, no complaints!
Our room was quite warm during our stay, which made it challenging to sleep.  The air conditioner wasn’t able to get the room to a comfortable temperature.

Great location very close to everything ...the museums, restaurants, etc.  The views from the bridge are amazing.  The studio apartment is very eclectic and cool.  The host is super communicative and responsive.
Perfect location, just a short walk to all the highlights of Florence.  Extremely clean and a unique layout.  I was very comfortable and felt at home.
Amazing place!! Really friendly and easy to communicate with. Made my check in very easy. I stayed in Florence for a week and this place was perfect :)

I stayed here for nearly a week and had no issues.  It was a perfect spot location-wise to explore Florence without being in the chaos of the touristy areas.  The Oltrarno neighborhood ended up being my favorite place to explore so it was super convenient.  Check-in and check-out was super easy, the place was clean and matched the description.  I would recommend Silvia's place for any solo travelers in Florence!  Grazie Silvia.

A great place to live for solo travel! This studio has everything you need and feels spacious. I especially appreciated the washing machine and all of the various toiletries that made my longer-term stay really comfortable.
Absolutely amazing location! The apartment was very quite at night and stayed cool. Very easy getting in and out. Definitely recommend!

Good location. Right beside Uffizi Gallery/museum.  15 minutes walk from Firenze station and you will see Santa Maria Basilica on the way. Definitely needs Googl maps to reach. Otherwise, you will be lost. 3 Restaurants are literally one floor below the apartment and many shops are nearby.  Opening the door may be little tricky. After turning the key, pull the door to your side and then push. Otherwise, it is a nice place to stay with a great bathroom.
Place was exactly as described. I’m a beautiful, central location of the city. Marialura was extremely responsive and is an excellent host

We absolutely loved this airbnb right in the heart of Florence! The location is perfect for travelers and close to everything you want/need. Marialaura was a wonderful host and was always easy to reach. Thank you for a great stay!

Our short stay in Florence was wonderful thanks to the convenient location of the Airbnb. We were able to comfortably room with two people, however it was smaller than expected so it’s perfect for couples. I appreciated the cleanliness and strong AC to help cool down after a full day of being outdoors.
This was a great apartment in an amazing location. It’s right in the heart of Florence close to monuments, restaurants and shopping.
Best location! We were able to walk to all of the places in Florence we wanted. Would stay here again.

So enjoyed the location away from the Duomo side crowds. Lively days and quiet nights. The space is beautifully arranged and comfortable, with art books and clever touches everywhere. Fun to share a comfy space with so much acclaim!  The AC helped so much on toasty evenings. Grazie Silvia!
Beautiful and comfortable apartment with 2 bathrooms and nice kitchen. Excellent communication and warm greeting from our host. We loved staying here and would highly recommend to other travelers.
We had a beautiful time at that apartment! Everything was clean, the kitchen had everything we needed and the communication was easy and always very nice! Definitely recommend!

I liked that the place was in the more quite part of the city but still walkable (or bus stop just right the corner) and with some amazing restaurants, bakeries and ice cream spots nearby.
The place had all amenities needed and even more. The host was was very nice and helpful.

Francesco is a wonderful host. He was great with communication and replied right away. He gave me a lot of information about his place even before we arrive. We met him in person the day we arrived and he showed us around his place. We enjoyed his quick story about the Palacio/Apartment rennovation. He also had a bottle of wine to welcome us. Overall an outstanding host.
The apartment itself is very spacious, clean and luxurious--it is definitely a Palacio! The artwork on the ceiling throughout the house is so beautiful. The house had everything we needed. Definitely an Airbnb stay that out whole family will remember. The place is so Central to everything. A couple minutes away from Duomo and right next to capelle medicee. All interesting sight is also walkable. Good restaurants close by as well. Highly recommended. We will certainly book Francesco's place again when we return to Florence.

Palazzo D'Ambra is wonderful!  Our family stayed there for 5 days during our recent trip to Italy and we were amazed by the beauty, size and attention to detail that went into the renovation of this 16th century palace. The pictures on line don't even come close to showing what a gorgeous place this is.   Francesco is a gracious host and made the reservation and check in process so easy.  The location of the property is great as well - very close to the Duomo and we walked everywhere.  We've recommended this property to friends and would definitely stay there again if our travels take us to Florence!!!
My second stay at Francesco's Palazzo. Once again I had a great time. Communication was excellent and the ceilings and interiors are spectacular.
The location of this apartment is just perfect! We loved it! The hosts very nice and helpful, couches and bed very comfortable. Definitely recommend this place!
You need to stay here!  The pictures do not do this apartment justice!  It has everything our family needed .

This place was perfect! The location, space and hospitality was more than we could have asked for. Francesco and his team were so kind and efficient. DEFINITELY RECOMMEND!!! There were 5 of us including an infant and we were very comfortable.
It’s a must have apartment in Florence. Absolutely stunning. We were over for my sisters wedding. Fabulous time spent in this apartment.

This apartment is located very well and a really unique experience in the heart of Florence. The cleanliness was excellent and it had many creature comforts like an up to date Nespresso machine and TV with a sound bar. The beds were very large and comfortable, making for a good nights sleep. The early morning bells from a nearby church woke us early (around 7am) but we guess this would likely be the case with any centrally located apartment.

We had a wonderful stay at Franceso’s beautiful apartment located in a historical palazzo.  The decorations were very nice and the ceiling frescoes truly amazing.  The apartment was very lean.  The location is ideal, minutes from all of the major attractions.  We will definitely stay there again.
Excellent host, excellent location, definitely worth its cost - and more. You wake up in the morning, open your eyes, the first thing you see is the ceiling fresco - a great beginning for a new day.

This is our second day in this magnificently lovely apartment. It is truly a gorgeous, safe, comfortable place to stay. The decorations and frescoes are jaw-droppingly beautiful.
Everything has been recently renovated in a very high end manner. The washer and dryer, for instance, are new and large.
The location is incredibly central and convenient, and there are three different locked doors between the street and the apartment. We always felt very safe staying here!
I had a very minor issue this stay with a slow running drain. It was very easy to text our contact, and he worked on it just several hours later. I appreciated that it was taken care of so quickly!
We love staying in this apartment and would be thrilled to return again someday!
Beautiful spacious apartment with room for everyone. Very convenient location. Helpful to have reception office right there. Church bells berry loud but that is part of the charm.

We stayed in the largest apartment and it was like waking up in a Palazzo!!
Impressive and large apartment.
Host was responsive and helpful.
A great place to relax after a few hours exploring Florence. I loved the mattresses (firm). Wife thought some rugs would have been nice (host did provide slippers).
No hesitation to recommend.

Family of 6. Francesco greeted us at check in. His place is incredible … spacious, clean, beautiful and the a/c was great too. The location was ideal! We were walkable to everything. One of the best airbnbs we have ever stayed in. Thank you Francesco!
We had a very pleasant stay. Everything was as expected. Host was very responsive and helpful. Ceilings had beautiful paintings and everything was walkable.

If you choose to rent this place, you will literally be staying g in a palace! We felt
like royals here, never have we been is such an opulent place! The location is near everything while providing complete privacy. It was an absolute test to be here where you can enjoy Florence in the best possible way!
The location could not have been better. Very close to Duomo. Very spacious and comfortable. Francesco and Fillipo were terrific.
Spacious and comfortable apartment. Well appointed and clean. Great location. Gym is a bonus. Shower in 2nd bathroom is too small.

Francesco apartment is exactly what you dream of when coming to Italy - things from the movie... a fresco overlooking in each room is just divine and lux... i will definitely come back for this listing. it is a diamond in the rough
Loved this apartment. Very close to everything, beautiful, has everything a traveler to Florence could want. I had a terrific trip.

The flat was cozy, clean, and air conditioned.  It was in a perfect location, just far enough away from the center of Florence that it wasn’t too busy, but close enough to be within walking distance of all the major attractions.  Overall it was a fantastic place to stay!

Great accomodation - comfortable and with everything needed. Many thanks to Lara and her brother, they are very friendly and nice hosts. The flat location is also awesome - right near Piazzo Pitti, 5-10 minutes walk to the heart of Florence (Duomo, Uffizi, etc), plenty of shops/caffes near.

Nice spatious room in an authentic apartment, literally 100 m from Palazzo Pitti. You can walk to all interesting locations, whether it's touristic sights, City Centre or train station. Lara was a gentle and helpful host, we followed all her advices for places to eat and it was fantastic.

Lara's apartment offers travellers a bright and comfortable place in which to begin each day in Florence, and a restful place to come back to in the evening. Lara was a wonderful host and made me feel immediately welcome. She provided excellent suggestions for where to eat, enjoy a view of the city, and which museums to visit. She was very thoughtful in considering what might suit my budget and mood best, as well as the best routes for getting there and when to go. Many places were within a few minutes of her apartment, which made it very easy to come and go during the day and take a break from the tourist-packed streets. Her guest room is decorated with Florentine photographs and paintings, and it was a pleasure to see the sights I had toured during the day reflected on the walls around me. Thank you, Lara!

Lara was a perfect host. She gave us great advice for parking our car and going out. She knows Florence very well and shared her experience with us. Her flat is lovely and beautiful, clean and central. It's just a few minutes from Lara's place into the old town. Very recommendable. Thanks again Lara!

Lara is a young and super kind host that gives lots of useful advises for the city.
The flat's location is super central and it is walking distance to all major restaurants and museums.
Definitely recommend it!
Very nice student but the apartment is on the 4th floor and it is very noisy. We were well informed and everything was clean.
This was the perfect place for us in Florence. Great location, a clean and comfortable room and Lara is super nice. Lara also had great tips for places to go during our stay.
We had a perfect stay in Florence. We only stayed for one night so the location could not be better. The room is nice and cosy and Lara is a really lovely host.

The appartment of Giovanni and the hospitality we received was first class. The location was amazing, central to everything making access to all the incredible sites minutes away. The ponte vecchio being in view. Having the little kitchen was a bonus enabling us to make our own meals when we needed to, the supermarket is literally around the corner. Manfredi was always available to help when we needed it. A wonderful experience.

Excellent location and an even more incredible host. A must to stay when in Florence.
Of note the apartment is on 4th floor so you have to take stairs. Great workout but for people with handicap or other health issues which may preclude climbing stairs.

The location is amazing. In the center of the city, and really safe, with several options to eat quality food.
The room itself is big, with all what you need to stay in Florence.
And Lara is so kind, and gives you many useful tips that will help you in your stay in the city.

The location of the room was perfect. It’s a lovely size place, the bed is super comfy and also Manfredi was very quick to respond to any issues we encountered (ie. the door buzzer continuously buzzing). However, the bathroom was not the best, there was no shower curtain and the shower holder aimed the water out of the bath. The whole place, the bathroom in particular, was a bit tatty and parts of walls and doors were falling apart.
This aside, it was a great space and perfect location for a good few days exploring Florence.

Great location and a bright clean apartment. We loved our stay here and our hosts were wonderful answering all our questions and meeting us at the apartment early so we could  drop off our luggage before check in. We highly recommend staying at Giovanni's place.
Lara was so incredibly helpful! We loved staying with her. Her recommendations for what to do in Florence were really helpful and allowed us to plan our 24-hours in Florence easily.

Lara is highly regarded by all of her guests and for good reason. She provided detailed, excellent tips on local activities + dining. Extremely responsive with all questions without making you feel like an obligation. The space was very stylish with lots of bright natural light with beautiful windows and a great local experience. 5 minute walk to Ponte Vecchio and 15 min. from Il Duomo; ten steps from Piazza Pitti. The fan in the room was a great touch. Highly recommend!
I highly recommend to stay at Giovanni‘s place. Perfect location in a quite area and short walking distance to all sightseeing places. We really enjoyed our stay!

Giovannis place is in a fantastic spot right in the middle of everything. its very quiet and good for a rest after lots of walking!  Giovanni responds quickly and is proactive with helping his guests, making sure that your stay is the best it can be!
Wonderful place, Lara gave me and my brother plenty of great recommendations for things to do around town and was such a kind and attentive host. Highly recommend this place!

Lara, is an amazing host and she went above and beyond with her hospitality by not only making sure our check in went smoothly but gave us a list of things to do during our stay! we went to just about ever place she recommended and loved it!
THANK YOU!!

This was one of my favorite stays. The host gave me the best local tips I could have asked for. The place is charming and  was situated perfectly for my stay. Walkable to everything in Florence. Enjoy!

Such a beautiful apartment, photos don't do it justice. In the best area of Oltrano. Lots of great bars and restaurants nearby and just next to Boboli gardens and Piti Palace which are lovely. Would stay again in a heartbeat. Thanks Lara and Giovanni :D

The co-host Lavinia was very helpful, meeting us early so we could check in sooner. She also gave us a list of wonderful restaurants to try as well as other things to do during our few days in Florence.
Very nice place in a central location! Bed was a bit uncomfortable and shower is extremely small, but place was very nice!

Lara and Giovanni offered a quaint, stylish apartment which we very much enjoyed. The location was great; close enough to multiple different attractions, as well as some incredible food spots. Giovanni made sure to point us towards his own favorites, and they did not disappoint! Highly recommend!
A lovely location and stylish apartment! The recommendations and corresponding map were incredibly helpful. Very warm welcome and helpful correspondence. Thanks again!!

Location was great; right next to the Piazza Pitti to check out some of the culture in the city and Santos to experience a little of the typical nightlife. The host was great in communication & pleasant to me during my stay. The space was nicely decorated, great and clean. Lara is a perfect host!

We had an amazing time in Lara’s apartment. It’s beautiful, cosy, clean and in a fantastic location that is close to many different parts of the city.
Can only highly recommend to stay here!

The Room is quite small but pretty and clean, there is everything you need for a few nights. Perfect for a short city trip. For longer stays or if you plan to spend a bit more time inside your appartement it might be a bit too small though.
Very nice place to stay in Florence! The apartment is lovely and the location is great 😊 Also Lara gives good advice on the restaurant. Really worth it!!

Lara is really nice and the place is very convenient, clean. Recommend!!!!
I really love it

This rental was hands down one of the friendliest, most accommodating, clean, comfortable places we've ever been to. its literally right in front of the Pitti Palace and right beside the best pizza restaurant in Florence (gustapizza). Lara was wonderfully responsive and made sure our stay was perfect! we will definitely be back

Lara's place is a great and cute apartment near a lot of good restaurants and nice places. you can walk anywhere from there. I would gladly recommend it to anyone.
Thanks Lara for your hospitality! :)

Lara's place is so central, yet it feels private at the same time!! The room was bigger than I imagined & overall I felt comfortable.
Lara was also on vacation during my stay, but she was still super responsive the couple times I had questions. I would definitely stay here again. I loved it so much!
Thanks Lara!

We spend with my husband 2 days in Florence in our trip to Tuscany. It was beautiful time makes us wonder to come back there some day. Lara's apartment looks exactly as on her pictures, very cosy, has many decorations so looks like small art gallery. We saw artistic soul of the host.
We checked her recommendations where to eat and drink in a city and it was all perfect. Thank You Lara.
Firenze amore mio!

Lara’s place was fantastic! Perfect location in one of the best neighborhoods in Florence, a clean, well-kept, and beautifully decorated apartment and Lara was accommodating, friendly, and responsive. Will definitely stay here again!
Lara’s home was clean, cozy and well located. She was flexible, a great communicator, and provided options for our bag storage before our departure. Would definitely stay again!

Lara was brilliant, really proactive with messaging which made checking in really easy, always responded really quickly on the app which was very helpful. Her apartment is stunning in a lovely part of Florence with really short walks the pretty much all of the key must see areas and many quaint restaurants that Florence has to offer some of these are quite literally a couple minutes away.
Lara had a great list of recommendations on the desk in the room on our arrival of both places to eat and things to do which is helpful in a new city.
The apartment was homely and you can tell it has been well looked after and looks even better in person than it does in the picture. A big thank you from the both of us and we cannot recommend it enough.
Cute apartment in a great area of Florence! A bit away from the city center but very easily walkable!

It is a delightful place. It is close to the train station, the bridges, shopping and most of the sights. Cafes, restaurants are close. The apartment is cool, so an extra sweater can be helpful. There are many tourists. For those not from Italy, most restaurants close about 3 pm, and open for dinner around 7pm. It was nice to have a place to fix some meals for ourselves. The kitchen is well stocked.
Lara is a great communicator. If you have any questions, she is very quick to respond. We asked to drop our bags off early so we could sightsee without hauling things around. It worked well.
Thank you Lara, for a delightful time!

Lara’s place was amazing! she was extremely responsive and flexible. she allowed us to store our bags early, check out late, and store our bags after check out. she was extremely responsive and everything was smooth. the apartment itself was beautiful and the surrounding area was exciting but not too chaotic. would stay here again!

stop looking and book here! super cozy, authentic flat right in the middle of florence. it is on the fourth floor and that could be tough after all day of walking! but worth it. peep the duomo from some windows. so close to two favorite piazzas and amazing food. best of all, lara includes a copy of recommended food ,  activities and sights.  she gave me some excellent tips about taxis etc. We are are somenifnrecommeneded places and they were amazing!! very comfortable, light and airy. I loved everything about this space and felt a little bit like a local staying here!! thank you so much for sharing!!

Lara was an amazing host! The apartment was super clean and cute. Perfect location in a wonderful neighborhood. A lot of street noise at night, but that’s the trade when you are very centrally located. Lara helped make me feel right at home! Highly recommend.
Spectacular, lovely place and Lara was so nice and welcoming! So glad I had the chance to experience Florence from her place!

Lara’s apartment is exactly like the pictures and description. It is very spacious and in a great area of town. The apartment is very comfortable and has all the amenities you would need. I would definitely stay here again.

This was a wonderful stay! Lara was so helpful and her space was beautiful. Although the listing says the airbnb is a shared apartment, no one else was there during my stay and it was a very restful few days. The apartment has great vibes and is very comfortable (the bed was huge and I slept great!) Unfortunately, there’s no AC, but there are windows on both sides of the apartment and if you open a bunch of them and turn on the fan, you can keep the space fairly cool. It’s in a wonderful location, the streets below are a bit loud during weekend nights but nothing too crazy. I wish I could have stayed longer, this place feels like home!
Lara's place was such a comfy and cute stay in a very hip neighborhood. I love her style and would definitely stay again!
Lara was a fantastic host! Her apartment was so clean and homey! Very convenient location! Everything was walking distance.

It was our first time visiting Florence and we were looking for a location in the heart of the city - and we came across Lara's listing. Needless to say, the listing had everything we were looking for - cleanliness, ease-of-access, proximity to establishments around the area, and most importantly, a great host. Lara's place was a true gem, and Lara was fantastic as a host - friendly, responsive, helpful and informative! Check-in was smooth, location was easy to find and accessible to everything in the area - restaurants, bars, shops, historical areas, etc. Lara gave us great recommendations (her coffee shop choice was our favorite!) and left us a map and a guide on what to explore in the city. We have a wonderful experience and time during our stay.
I would absolutely recommend anyone who is looking to enjoy Florence to consider Lara's listing as a top choice to stay at!
We had a perfect stay in Lara’s beautiful apartment. Lara was a wonderful host who went above and beyond. Thank you!

Wonderful stay at Lara’s. Very kind and responsive host - quick and easy to communicate with and let me check in early. Wifi was decent, and was able to work from the apartment including video calls in between sightseeing. Recommendations on things to do were on point. An easy and convenient twenty minute walk from the train station. Would definitely stay again.
I really loved Firenze and Lara’s apartment made me to move there. Spacious, clean, artsy and a very patient and responsive host. Bravo! and see you soon!

Such a cute little apartment that really fit the vibe of Florence! The reviews aren't kidding about it being a hike up the stairs, with the way the flights are it feels more like 8 flights to climb but a nice calorie burner ;)
There is no AC and it can get quite hot if you are there in the summer like we were, something to keep in mind. Lara was super flexible with letting us hold our bags there both on arrival and check-out. Overall highly recommend!

I had a wonderful time at this location. Lara was extremely helpful and responsive.
The location is right next to everything you need to see, and the place itself is very cute.
Would highly recommend

Lara was a superstar host- kind, communicative, helpful and more. Her place was absolutely stunning, and very clean. It was also in a perfect location in town, with cute cafes nearby and close to everything. We will definitely stay here again next time we’re in Florence!

Nadia’s apartment is very clean and decorated with taste, Nadia was very easy to communicate with and very arranging. The apartment is approximately 15 min away from the city center by walk.  I recommend this host and this place :)

Nadia and her son provided such great hospitality to us. The apartment was incredibly stylish and up to date, within walking distance of the city! The place was immaculate and so well kept. We felt safe and had everything we needed!!

Fantastic home. It was adorable and well appointed. Lisa met us and gave us a tour of the place and also left us a bottle of wine and delicious treats. This was the best Airbnb of our entire trip. You won't be disappointed.

Both the host, Lisa, and her place were lovely. We received a very warm welcome and felt very well taken care of, which we're very grateful for. The flat was very clean and cosy, we've been provided with bed linens, towels (also a change of these, should we need it) and even some toiletries. As we arrived in the evening Lisa kindly made sure we also had bottled water, juice and fruits in the fridge and some breakfast for the next morning.
The flat is in the walking distance from all major monuments and not far away from the opera house, should anyone fancy spending an evening there. There are lots of small eateries in the neighbourhood (pick from Lisa's listof recommended ones) and at least two small supermarkets perfect for shopping for home cooking.
A great place to stay :-)

Lisa made us feel so welcome. I highly recommend this as a place for a couple to stay, and feel lucky that it was available. This apartment is a gem, it’s very well redecorated and walking distance to the sights in Florence.

Lisa is a super host and the apartment is very close to the train station and all the sights in Florence.  Easily walkable to all locations in town.  Apartment is beautifully decorated and very clean.  Lisa made us feel at home and greeted us with a bottle of wine, fruit and biscotti.

Lisa is a great and thoughtful host. From the wine and cookies at check-in and the fruit, juice and pasties for breakfast, to the thoughtful suggestions for local restaurants, to the lovely apartment, all the little details were looked after. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would recommend the place to other visitors.

The apartment is just as beautiful as in the pictures with all amenities a traveling guest will need. The location couldn't be better. The train station is a 7-8 minute walk. We were able to walk to all landmarks easily even with an 18 month old and stroller in tow. There are plenty of good restaurants just around the corner. There's a small supermarket down the street and the market square about a block away. Lisa was very thoughtful to provide necessities for my toddler son and even went out of her way to make sure the apartment was baby proof! She had a breakfast basket with some bread, cookies, water and fruits. She even had milk in the refrigerator for my son and a bottle of Chianti wine for us as a welcome gift! Loved our time in Florence and staying at 'Margherita's apartment' definitely made it extra special.

Lisa’s flat is centrally located which meant that we could walk to all the sites. The flat was cozy, comfortable and very clean. Lisa and her family were waiting for us when we arrived, and her daughter went over everything we needed to know. She also left some fruit and wine which was appreciated along with recommendations for restaurants which was very helpful. A very enjoyable experience!

Lisa was an excellent host. Her apartment is in a perfect location to see the major sites of Florence. We really enjoyed staying at her apartment and the washer+dryer was especially helpful. We would absolutely stay at her place again the next time we are in Florence!

The apartment was very modern and nicely decorated with many little extra amenities that made it feel like home. It was light and cheerful with comfortable furniture and a lovely library of art and travel books. It was a good location for tourists in a quiet building.
Lisa's place was fantastic. She was very helpful before the stay and check in was a breeze.
Lisa was so easy to deal with and her apartment was in a phenomenal location, very clean, and well appointed. I would highly recommend it for your stay in Florence.
Lisa's place is a short walk from the train station as well as the art, architecture, and cathedrals of Florence.  We had a great stay.

I recently stayed at this amazing place and I was blown away. It's incredibly spacious and the amenities are exactly as described, the high ceiling adds a magnificent touch. I couldn't believe how close it was to the market and landmarks, making it a perfect location for exploring. With lots of great restaurants just a few steps away there was plenty to do around the area. I would highly recommend this location to anyone looking for a perfect holiday getaway.
Lisa was an amazing host and always responded immediately! Her place is super nice and is also super centralized! Hard to be beat!
The perfect place to stay when you visit Florence - super close to everything, lovely apartment, great host. We loved staying here. Don’t think twice about booking!

Lisa and her daughter were welcoming and let us know about what was happening in Florence during our stay.
Easy to walk to attractions, bars and restaurants.

Loved staying at Lisa’s place. Lovely bright accommodation with lots of room to move. Separate bedroom, with a walk in robe and ok size ensuite. Kitchen is pretty tight but we actually cooked for three nights, first time in 6 weeks, and all amenities worked well. Always a lovely touch to be provided with milk, juice, some brekky items and, most importantly, a bottle of wine.  All tourist sites are in easy walking distance, and several restaurants are just down the road.

The apartment was just like the photos, it was rather large and very clean. Lisa gave clear instructions and provided many recommendations for our stay. It was within walking distance of all the attractions and the train station.
Lisa was very hospitable. She was flexible when our train was delayed and she was super responsive. The apartment is in a great location and close to all of the museums and cultural attractions.

We really enjoyed our stay in this apartment. The location is excellent- close to the central market (and a terrific Indian restaurant around the corner), easy walk to the major sights. The guide book / recommendations are the most complete I've ever seen - packed with useful information. The apartment is very comfortable. All in all, we'd recommend it to anyone visiting Florence.
Very close to the train station, 7' walk. Center but quiet at night which is important. Spacious place, amazing coffee for breakfast! Nice candies and wine! Lovely stay!
Very well located. A bit of street noise, but I expect that this is common in Florence. Great place to stay. Thoroughly recommended.

Martino & Emiliano were the PERFECT hosts, once our booking was confirmed M&E gave us clear instruction on accessing the apartment and how to use its facilities, they also provided a long list of great recommendations of where to eat and drink (which were all ace!).
The apartment itself is beautiful and unique - a palace conversion no less! The furnishings are elegant and it had all the amenity you could need in a great location. I will most definitely be staying here again when next in Firenze and highly recommend 'Numeroventi'.
Everything was perfect, a real pleasure to be staying there.  The hosts were super helpful and very charming.  I will be happy to come back.
This was one of the most beautiful spaces I've ever stayed in. The photos don't do it justice!

This is a fantastic Airbnb. The location is perfect for walking everywhere in Florence. The design of the apartment is gorgeous, and the bed and linens were extremely comfortable - we instantly felt at home. The hosts were very easy to coordinate with and provide a list of fantastic recommendations for places to visit in Florence. We had a great time working through their list of recommendations and discovering places outside of the usual tourist spots. We hope to come back soon.
The loft was extremely tasteful, clean, and it made our trip particularly memorable! Communication was seamless, and we would definitely stay here again.

If you’re looking to stay at a mansion with history and modern twist, like coming straight out of kinfolk or monocle, this is it. Also great to work from here for an extended period of time. Very delicious breakfast (freshly cooked, fruits in season..etc). Great location too.

A wonderful value in a perfect area of town for first time visitors! Irene was incredibly hospitable and left us some nice gifts when we came to check in. The apartment was clean and cozy. Definitely would come back to stay here again.
Irene’s place was amazing! Great location, about a 10-15 minute walk to everything. The smart TV was great and wifi was amazing! We would definitely recommend!

Irene's place was in a great location you can walk to every destination. bottles of water and wine left for us as well as a little momento of our trip.  She had maps and advice of areas to visit local supermarket ect. very quick response time and smooth check-in and checkout. if I visit Florence again I will most defiantly be staying in irenes place again

Dario's apartment is in a central location. You can find everything you need for living.
The flat is really nice and everything is clean. You have everything you need for living. The apartment is perfect for two people.
I really enjoyed my stay here.
The next time again!

This apartment was located in a great location in Florence - everything we wanted to do was in walking distance. We had a smooth check-in/check-out process and everything in the apartment was as advertised. We enjoyed our stay here and I would recommend it to others!
A quite nice house and it is only 5-minute-walking from house to the train station.
Clean and accommodating as advertised. Great place to relax after a long day of sight seeing. We enjoyed our time, had a greet host, and would return.

We stay 3 days in Guilio's flat and everything was perfect ! The flat is very clean, convenient and confortable. The flat is very well located, in the city center just a few minutes walk from main tourist areas. The street is although very quiet. We can enjoy breakfast there, thanks Guilio.
Sunny apartment. Nice view of the Florence rooftops. Great host. Dario was helpful and on time. Smart tv. Breakfast cereal was a nice touch. Good location. Close to train station and central.

We had a nice stay in Florence in this Airbnb where everything was on walkings distance away. everything in the Airbnb was fine and especially the air conditioning units were very appreciated in August with 35°C!
Good location. Amazing flat for a couple. Classical house with big windows. Fast communication with the host. Everything is near - must-see places, shops etc.

Everything was perfect ! The communication was great and we were able to adapt the check in and out at times that were convenient for us, which was really nice.
The appartement was super clean, very confortable and had everything one needs, + a few attentions (for breakfast for example), that we really appreciated.
The location is also great, really close to the train station and the main touristic sites.
We would definitely come again :)
we had a very good stay. check in was smooth and the apartment was in the center of rhe city.
The apartment is very well located, all was cleaned and it is very comfortable. Recommend to stay here it will be worthy.
Simple, clean and well equipped for our short stay in Florence. Check-in was easy and the hosts communicated well throughout the process.
A nice apartment in a beautiful city. We were able to walk to all places we wanted to go, restaurants and local markets were nearby for all needs.
The apartment's location is great. Everything is easily reachable by foot. Everything was as described. The communication with Dario & Giulio was perfect, helpful and friendly.

The location of this place is great!
Very close to the train station and to the tram to the airport.
We were able to walk from Dario & Giulio’s place everywhere in Florence.
The AC was great since we were visiting in August.
I will definitely come back here.
This was a great place, close to everything we wanted to do in Florence. It was beautiful with the big windows that open and very quiet location.

This apartment is beautiful and the location could not be better.  The hosts did a great job of being flexible with my check in arrangements and were very friendly and responsive.  I would definitely stay here again!

I highly recommend a stay in Geppi’s house.
The appartement itself is very lovely, clean and with every equipment needed. We’ve loved the decoration too. But the main point is the location, in the very pleasant neighborhood in central Florence, close to famous places, monuments and parks.
Gianluca and his family welcomed us as a real guests. They are very talkative, always ready to answer our questions, suggesting good restaurants or places, which has made our stay unforgettable.
As we were having problem to book a taxi to go to the airport, they helped us doing so, enabling us to go back home. So kind from them.
We had an amazing time and are grateful for that.

Gianluca & Family's place was the perfect apartment for us during our stay in Florence. It is perfectly situated in an area that is in easy walking distance of all the tourist attractions but not in the middle of all the madness. Delicious restaurant options, gelato, coop, etc were all close. Communication was easy and prompt.  We would love to stay here again the next time we are in Florence. Thank you!

Great location - best for those who plan to stay out for a fun evening in Florence because of the nearby nightlife. We loved the nearby gelato spot and check-in was quick and easy. 10 min walk from the train station and easy walk and bike ride to all the best spots.
Gaia was nice and reached out and ready to help even when we only stayed at night, the house is cozy with a lot of character

We loved staying in Gaia's apartment. All instructions, we received, were very clear with all recommendations. Gaia was very helpful with arranging the parking spot. The apartment was central located, the red wine is a welcome drink was very appreciated. We would choose it again and again.

Excellent location in a lively part of town with lots of good places to eat and drink. The famous wine window is literally at the end of the street.  Very close to ponte vecchio. All main sights within a short walking distance. Gaia gave lots of recommendations for ice cream, coffee and restaurants which were all excellent and saved us lots of time. The apartment is well equipped and has everything that you need for a short stay. Due to its lively and central location you do hear people passing by on their way home from a night out. This didn’t bother us too much and is what I would expect from a city break.

We had a great stay at Gianluca and Gaia’s apartment. The flat is close to all the action of Florence but hidden away on a quiet street. The apartment was exactly like the photos; clean, spacious and comfortable with lots of personal touches. It had everything we could need, and a very easy check in process.

Great apartment and location! Lots of space and cold AC. Easy check-in and check-out. Hosts were easily reachable and provided great recommendations for around Florence. Would definitely stay here again!

The pros: the location is great! Easy to access many parts of Florence and a private entrance. It’s also nice that it had a washer (no dryer) and lots of drying racks. This washer was easier to use than others in Europe if you are traveling for the States because you can YouTube instructions.
The cons: There are two ac units but we were a little nervous to run both since the house instructions mentioned some breaker issues. We traveled to a few cities in Italy, and this apartment felt more like someone lived in it than a short term rental. It was more cluttered and had a lot going on.

The appartement was totally perfect . It is a great location in Firenze , it was perfectly property and so charming. Angelica is a very good host and a personn too. The communication was very easy , and she was here when i need help in Firenze . She s an amazing person . We recommand higlhy at all airbnb family .

Central place, very clean , great hospitality.
Highly recommended.
will come back for sure.

Being first time in Florence Giorgio's place feels like a perfect choice that allows you to explore the city. Located near the city centre and yet quiet, it soon becomes your home and one looks forward to come back again. Most important, the ambience is great and the host friendly!
This place is absolutely amazing. Everything was more than expected. The location is perfect and everything is at walking distance. 10/10 recommend! Very friendly and helpful host. Don't hesitate!!

Everything about this place was perfect. Great location, great recommendations on things to do and where to eat, comfortable bed! Just an easy 15 minute walk from the train station. Would recommend for anyone. Also, hot shower! Was appreciated after an exhausting week.

Linda was a very accomodating host . Very helpful with information. A gracious host with a clean and well appointed suite!
Angella and I would recommend her suite to anybody!
Craig

Everything about the apartment was just as described on the Airbnb site. While we were there, it was pretty hot but, thankfully, the apartment had several windows, one of which looked out on a pretty back yard with several tortoises walking among the vegetation. It also had a great bathroom and shower. We would come back again.

We had a great time in Florence and this this gorgeous apartment contributed a lot to our enjoyment. It is thoughtfully equipped with all essentials (including a welcome bottle of wine!), and was a wonderful home in Florence. The bathroom was spacious and well equipped, and the bed was very comfortable. Location was central, within walking distance of most major attractions. After a day of sightseeing, it was a pleasure to walk in the door! We have no hesitation recommending to other travelers.

Ludovica & Sandro are wonderful hosts. Sandro was very helpful in guiding us about Florence and gave us great tips. The apartment was very well kept and the little touches were amazing. There is a beautiful little tortoise family in the backyard :-). A very nice experience. Will come back if we are in Florence again.
Very nice appartement close to the train station and the city center. Everything was really nice and a eye for detail. Really recommend to stay here when in Florence
The apartment was perfectly located, very quiet and pleasant ! Giorgio’s daughter was reactive and nice and the autonomous arrival convenient.
We had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is very well situated and clean. There is a nice and calm garden view and there are many good restaurants and places nearby.

Nice apartment for single travellers and couples! The neighborhood is lively but not so touristy like the other side of the Arno ;) Every thing you need for your stay is nearby or easy to walk to! Ludovica is a great host!

Loved the neighborhood.  Great resources very close to everything.  Within walking distance of some of the major historical sights.  Our host was amazing.  So helpful going of his way to help when we needed it!
The location of the accommodation was very good close to the train station and tram to/from the airport and the tourist spots but in a true Florence neighborhood. The apartment was very clean.

This place was clean, comfortable and close to lots of great places.  It matches the description and is just darling! there are two fans and we did not need AC in June. Large windows and bright yellow colors made it feel like home. A coffee shop and many restaurants are nearby. It's a short walk to the bridge to the busy side of the river.  This side is quiet, and you can experience locals buying from the market and dining.  The kitchen had all we needed.  There were hangers to unpack our clothes.  We loved our stay and will be back!

Recently stayed here and absolutely loved it! Great location with easy access to lots of shops and amenities. Beautiful apartment that was very clean and spacious. Great hosts with quick responses:) would definitely recommend and stay again. Thank you again :)
This is a bright and comfortable base for enjoying Florence.  Good value and easy to get around from here.
Great location and lovely apartment. Giorgio was very responsive and made sure out stay in Florence was fantastic.

Such a lovely place! The location is very good, you can go anywhere on foot and it’s also more quiet than other crowded areas but still has a lot to do in this part of town.
The apartment was so beautiful and the hosts were so friendly, kind and helpful. Totally recommended 😊

Stayed here on my visit to Florence ! The place was in a nice neighborhood . The check in was smooth with clear instructions. Also, it was very clean ! The host did have fans in the rooms but it was still a bit warm and I did have a hard time with that . Since we had to leave windows open that also meant prone to more mosquitos . Overall, maybe with different weather conditions I would not hesitate to stay again .

Spacious comfortable apartment. Flexible self check in. Welcomed with a bottle of wine which was a special treat. Centrally located, easy to get around by foot. Lovely recommendations and tips close by from the host and co host always responsive to any queries.

Lovely home, very large and a lot of space. Good airconditioning and the neighborhood is quiet at night but also vibrant during the day! It is accessible by public transport (bus) dus to multiple bus stops in the area. This is handy to acces the historical center, as it is a 30-minute walk to this area. Had a very nice stay!
It's an ok place, not ideal but you can go by for very short term. Great host though, communication is not a problem.

A really nice place quite close to the center (30min by foot, 15min by bus), Francesca and Christian are really available and kind. The place is clean with all facilities you need except maybe the air conditioner.
I completely recommend the place you will feel like home.

Place was great. 20 min walk to the main station and there’s a grocery store a min away. Nice quiet area. House was very clean, nice bathroom and kitchen had all the basic utensils you need to cook if you want. We stayed here in summer when it was hot so having a fan in the room was amazing. Totally recommend this place!
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We had the whole apartment to ourselves for 2 days which was nice!

Easy access to bus, restaurants, markets and even the train station and airport!  Comfortable beds.  Very responsive host and kind.  Florence is a very expensive city so I appreciated the affordable rate and value.
We had a very nice time. Just a few stops with the tram from the airport and also just a few stops to the city center. Good price, nice location and easy communication with our host.

Jacopo apartment it's unbelievable!
Perfectly clean with a superb view!
He welcomed us with a bottle of wine and he give us lot of city information!
Highly recommended!

A house right in front of Duomo with a perfect view from the terrace, we didnt even have to use any public transportation, walkable from Santa Maria Novella and to any historical place.
Very nice stay overall.

This place was in a great location and had a wonderful balcony (and shower!) view. Jacopo was very communicative and helpful. He had a list of restaurant recommendations (which were wonderful) and ideas for things to do. As a special welcome for our honeymoon, he provided a bottle of wine and a small gift. Everything was wonderful! Thank you, Jacopo and family!!

This place is great. The view from the balcony is stunning. The place was very clean and and had a lot of thoughtful and stylish touches.
The host is very nice and helpful and even allowed us to do an early check in.
The steep climb up a dark staircase to his third floor apartment was well worth it.
Jacopo is absolutely a "super hoster". The extra touches, the dining and sight seeing tips, the location of the apartment - you will not find better in Florence. Top notch in every way.

If you want to enjoy Florence from the perfect spot, then this is the place. You can wake up and admire the Duomo from the terrace, go see all of the sights on foot, and walk to the train station. With the Firenzecard we were able to hit 8 museums even though it was Easter and rainy, which meant the museums were crowded and the lines long.
The home was clean and spacious, with plenty of nice touches such as Tea and Espresso. Plenty of small reasonable restaurants right outside the door for breakfast.
We will return again and stay with Jacopo.

As 2 female travelers, we felt extremely safe staying in this apt. The view is definitely breathtaking and perfect and the apt itself is so cozy and has everything you need! 5 star- highly recommended!

Jacopo was amazing in addition to his spacious apartment! The view is totally unbeatable and the apartment is walkable to all the great sites of Florence. As well, Jacopo provided us with amazing dinner recommendations which we appreciated greatly. The wine was a perfect touch! Thank you!

If you want a brilliant, central location, we cannot recommend this place enough. It is right next to the Duomo. The pictures do not do the view from the balcony justice - perfect place to sit with a bottle of wine and cap off a night out in the city.

A perfect stay! Jacopo is a fantastic host, helped with booking a beautiful restaurant. Checkin process flawless, and the apartment is super cute, with so many little thoughtful touches.
Wine on the terrace overlooking Duomo is just beautiful.
Amazing - Grazie Jacopo!

THAT VIEW!  It could possibly be the best view in Florence. The only issue is we wanted to stay and enjoy that view rather than going out! It is in a very convenient and easy location.  Check-in was easy and simple. They kept checking in with us to make sure we have everything we needed.
This place is amazing! I definitely would come back again! The view is beautiful and all of the amenities are nice.

Jacopo's apartment was incredible. The photos of the view don't do it justice — the Duomo was remarkable and so close you felt like you could touch it! The apartment was spacious and had two private bathrooms (one with a view, one with a huge walk-in shower). Jacopo made us feel so welcomed and generously offered us some great local recommendations for Florence. We can't wait to come back soon and will definitely be staying here again!

This home is in a quiet little corner of Florence near the Porta Romana gates to the city. We heard no traffic noise at all. The view from the balcony was lovely and felt provincial. The apartment is true to the photographs! We were all blown away by its charm. There was plenty of space for all four of us. Lorenzo was a perfect host, he gave us lots of local tips and made himself available to assist us if required. We would definitely re-book in the future.

We cannot fault our stay at the 'Greenhouse'. The apartment was spacious and charming and everything we needed for a short stay in Florence. The host was amazing with communication and gave us some great recommendations. We enjoyed staying in the neighbourhood, away from the bustle of the main centre but within easy reach with good restaurants and cafes nearby for a morning coffee and pastry. During our stay there was even a little fruit and veg stall at the end of the street. I would definitely stay here again if I was in the area!
The location was very good and the veranda where the Duomo was seen was also good.  The hostel was modern and well equipped and there was no discomfort.  It was just so hard to open the door.

It’s a great apartment. Super clean, A/C was very strong, the view is unbelievable. The two TV’s are huge and are smart TV’s, so apps like YouTube and plex worked great. Two bathrooms is terrific, the two rooms are huge, the bed was huge. Jacopo allowed us to check in early and was extremely responsive to messages. The location is great and was within walking distance of everything. And since it was so close to the Duomo, after we climbed the steps, we just walked back a block and were able to get into the cool air and take a quick nap :) there can be some shady places on Airbnb but this was not one of them. I highly recommend this apartment and Jacopo.

Great location in the heart of Florence with a stunning view of the Duomo from the comfort of a private balcony. Place was freshly renovated with very nice touches to bring out character in the apartment. Everything is within walking distance of the apartment. Food, groceries, alcohol.  Jacopo left me with a lot of great recomedations on what to check out and eat. Highly recommend staying at Jacopos place !

Best host! Jacopo was so helpful and even made reservations to a nearby restaurant for us. The view from the terrace is incredible!!!! We were close to so many things to do. Great, clean space. 10/10!
Our host Jacopo is super nice and helpful. The check-in is smooth. The location can not be beaten.  Enjoyed our stay! Thank you.

Lorenzo's place was perfect for our family of five. He met us at the door to let us in and give us a personal tour of the house. We really appreciated that the house was away from the crowds of the city center but still very walkable, close to a grocery store and some fantastic restaurants that Lorenzo recommended.  Do not hesitate to book this home as you will not be disappointed.

Very cozy, cute, and clean! We loved this place and finally felt comfortable to use the washing machine because it’s very clean as there are mold in other places we stayed in Italy this past week. 5 star and highly recommended!

Roberto & Paula's place was beautiful!  It was in a prime location minutes from both the train and the Duomo.  Paola was extremely accommodatingwith our timing.  They had great amenities as well as let usnow ssme of their favorite places to eat.  We would both stay there again with no hesitations!

We had an absolutely perfect stay with Jacopo & Simona in Florence. The attentive and always swift communication made the arrival (finding parking, checkin, things to look out for) super simple and very accommodating. The flat is mordern, loft-like, tastefully furnished and decorated and has the most gorgeous view on the Duomo. The central location makes even a very short visit very enjoyable as everything is easily reachable on foot. Thank you so much for having us - this experience will be hard to beat. Thank you so much Jacopo & Simona - we will be back!

It was a pleasure to stay at jacopo&simonas appartment. A newly renovated place with awesome view on the dome! I expected the stairs to the appartment to be worse. We came with our 2 year old son... it was no problem! Great recommendations for restaurants and so on! There is a parking facility just 30meters away (very expensive: about 30euros a day)... all in all we loved it to be in the middle of the city! Thanks again!

Amazing location and advice on local spots. Simona and Jacopo’s response time is very fast and they went above and beyond to make everything go as smooth as possible. It was the perfect stay and we highly recommend!

A very nice apartment with a beautiful view of the dome of the duomo from the balcony. It was particularly nice at night. Well situated central location and very clear and timely communication from the hosts throughout our stay.   The washer and dryer was also helpful to have during the stay.

Great location in the center of many attractions. Host was great with communication and helpful when we had a few small issues with the air conditioning in the middle of the night. Hope to book again soon.

It is such a wonderful stay in Florence with good location. The whole apartment is very stylish and comfortable. and the most important thing is that host is quite friendly to introduce the apartment. we are pretty much enjoy living here.

Absolutely quite and cosy flat with the best location, comfortable bed and nice terrase, fully equiped kitchen and bathroom. Perfect and timely communication; we recommend this place and Paola as a very nice host, who took time to meet us in person.

This place was amazing - the views, the space, and the timeliness of communication with simona and jacopo. The Airbnb is located right outside the duomo which is a very busy area but puts you right in the center of the city so it was great for walking to our destinations. This place had two bathrooms as well which was a bonus! We would definitely recommend this Airbnb!

Can we give 10 stars?  My daughter stayed here for 3 nights before starting her study abroad program.  Simona & Jacopo made her feel welcome even before arriving by recommending restaurants and giving advice.  They were extremely communicative and helpful.  The apartment is beautiful in a perfect location.  Clean, bright and what a view!  Stay here if you can - we will definitely be back!!
The apartment was very clean and centrally located.  We enjoyed the view of the Dome from the windows and balcony.
Very helpful and accommodating. Gave us good recommendations for food and events. We were a little late with checkin and this wasn’t a problem for them.

Excellent Airbnb. The apartment was exactly as advertised. Very comfortable and spacious with a lovely private patio off the kitchen. The bed and couch were very comfortable. The location was ideal, just a 5 min walk from the Duomo. During the heat in July the apartment AC was amazing and much appreciated!

My husband and I loved this airbnb! It was easily accessible to everything in Florence, comfortable, and has a wonderful terrace. Paola met us for any early check in, which was very appreciated after a long flight, and she even left a few welcome snacks for us. We would definitely stay again!

This place is wonderful! It's steps away from the duomo. The interior is in perfect condition. The bed is very comfortable and the air conditioning works very well. The hosts communicated very well. It was one of my wife's and my favorite AirBnbs of all time!

The view is exactly like it is in the pictures. I was so tired from the first day visiting, but I was determined to sit on the balcony and take it all in. The location was great. We literally walked everywhere. You could even walk to the train station. We took a day trip to Venice and walked back from the train station when we returned. Simona and Jacopo were great. They checked on us to make sure we had everything we needed. They made us feel so welcomed. They had several recommendations for us to try. Take them up on the offer to book a reservation to Martarè. We would definitely stay here again.

Simona’s place was beautiful and my fiancé and I had a wonderful stay. She checked in on us daily and made sure we had everything we needed which was very thoughtful. The balcony was breathtaking and it was so nice to have a gorgeous view even on a rainy day. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Florence.

LOVED our stay here. The location and view are perfect! On top of that, the inside was even better than we imagined. It’s a very nice place, super modern. The bed was comfortable, and the apartment as a whole was very large. Highly recommend.

Roberto & Paola’s place had all the amenities for a lovely stay in Florence. Paola was quick with communication, very friendly and accommodating. Their place is walkable to all the main attractions yet located on a quiet, more peaceful street. We would definitely stay again!

A beautiful apartment right in the middle of everything. We enjoyed our stay and all the recommendations from our hosts.  Great instructions on how to use everything in the apartment. We had a lovely stay. Thank you!
Perfect stay in the best part of the city with easy access to restaurants, shops, and everything else. Accommodating hosts made it easy to check in. Highly recommend staying here.

We LOVED this place! I think it’s the nicest place we have stayed in Italy so far. The terrace was beautiful! The place was fully stocked with everything you need. It is way more spacious than we imagined. The only con is the walk up 4 flights of stairs (not for the weak haha) but we didn’t mind it. Paola was super helpful and accommodating! Also, washing machine?! Unheard of! Highly recommend.
We had a wonderful stay in the heart of Florence. The apartment is the perfect base to relax, explore and enjoy.
The place is gorgeous, and clean, couldn't be a better location.  We had a fabulous stay and hope to return sometime.

The most perfect stay I could’ve ever imagined. Tons of space, super comfortable bed, two large bathrooms, and that patio and VIEW! You just cannot beat it. If I’m ever in Florence, this is where I’ll stay! The host was simply amazing, so helpful and went above and beyond to make our stay perfect. Wish I could give more stars!
Perfect location to stay in Florence.  Close to everything and a view that is the envy of others.  I would recommend for any couple that wants a romantic place to stay in this beautiful city.
A wonderful stay at a fantastic location with a very warm and responsive host. Highly recommended location for a very memorable Florence stay!

As the description said experience once in a lifetime was truly magical that you could not stop staring at the Doumo. The host is really hospitable with a warmth welcome and kind consideration.
We were honoured to have stayed in your property as it creates memories for us to reminisce in the future.
Thank you.

The view! We couldn't stop staring at the beautiful Duomo. I can't imagine anyone else in the city has a view as amazing as this! The stairs are very manageable (only a bit tough with heavy/bulky suitcases as you arrive and leave....but every other trek is completely fine). The apartment was super clean and had every amenity needed. The bed was very comfy.  The hosts were beyond perfect: answered every question very promptly no matter the time of day or night. Highly recommend!
Amazing views of the duomo - absolutely beautiful apartment in the heart of the city. Simona was one of the most responsive hosts I’ve ever interacted with. Great experience in Florence!
Everything was perfect—quick communication and easy to find. The apartment was spotless and everything worked well.
The view from the balcony was absolutely incredible and totally worth it! The place was also really nice and had the best location! Everything was in walking distance and we loved it!

Great place with a view of the Duomo. Enjoyed having 2 bathrooms for two people and a washing machine that has a wash/dry cycle all in one. Simona was extremely communicative and helpful. Definitely go to the places she recommends — the gelato place and Martare restaurant, which we will recommend to friends. The steps are no joke, but we liked having them as exercise. People should know that the Duomo bells ring at 7am every morning, in case you are planning to sleep in. Otherwise, it is quiet. We were there during the second week of March, so we didn’t have mosquitoes, but apparently there are a lot in the spring and summer in Florence. Beautiful city!
Beautiful apartment, felt like home. There’s lots to do in the area and Simona provided tons of suggestions and was very responsive.

Well located and smartly renovated apartment combining both old world charm with modern convenience. Views of the Duomo are terrific. We especially enjoyed the terrace with retractable awning on a rainy day for both morning espresso and evening aperitif. Wonderful host who responds quickly to any request. Very comfortable mattress and luxurious linens. We would gladly repeat our stay.

Great home in a great location - close to everything. Communication was excellent. The home was beautiful with a great view. It was spotless and the bed was very comfortable. The stairs were not an issue and check in was easy with clear instructions. We would definitely stay here again in the future.

We had a very pleasant stay at Simona and Jacopi’s place. The central location of this apartment was super convenient and a view of the Duomo every morning that was breathtaking.
Simona was super communicative even helping us with local suggestions. Would definitely recommend this place if you’re planning a visit to Firenze.

We had a great time staying here! We loved all of her recommendations and she was great at responding. The place was beautiful and spacious; perfect location for our trip to Florence. We will definitely be coming back.

This stay was just fantastic! Unbeatable location with tons of local restaurants and grocery to go to. 5/5! Looks just like the pictures!
Thanks for hosting us Simona!!!

It was the perfect spot for us. Close to the train station so we walked with our luggage. Host was amazing, always communicating and very fast to answer.
The place was beautiful and the view of the Duomo was amazing. Lots of steps but we knew that and are used to that. Perfect location to walk everywhere. Would def book again!
Expect a lovely stay, the apartment has everything you need and it’s in a great location.
Fantastic space, the outdoor courtyard was amazing! Fairly central to everything. Pictures show exactly how it is!
Location was perfect. Apartment was lovely and well decorated. Only problem was the very damp bathroom. Meaning wet floor and wet towels unfortunately.

Overall a great place to stay in Florence. So close to everything, you have a market and pharmacy nearby and it's close to all the attraction. It was nice to have the jacuzzi at the end of the day to unwind. I highly recommend.

We had a fantastic time in Firenze!
Thank you Elena & Oliver for having us stay at your place - we found it stylish, comfortable and well located.
Recommend all to stay here, especially if you plan to do lots of walking like we did - the spa was appreciated to rest outlets worn out feet.

Elena’s place was so perfect for our stay in Florence!  Location was even closer to everything than we expected. The space is simple and exactly what you need, every amenity makes sense and works well.  We adored the hot tub!!! Best way to end our long days of siteseeing, walking and climbing. Especially in the cooler weather.  Highly recommend!!!
Nice place in the heart of Florence. A few issues with power loss, but the breaker is in the kitchen, and the problem was easily fixed.

Modern and cozy apartment, with a beautiful patio. Everything was very clean and well prepared.
The host was very welcoming. The location was perfect, you could walk everywhere and was sorrounded very nice restaurants and party.
Thanks for everything!

We had a wonderful visit to Florence and felt very comfortable at Elena’s home. The apartment is in a central location, so we could walk around the city easily. The apartment was spotless when we arrived and there was complementary food and drinks. The jacuzzi had been cleaned with fresh water. Elena was quick to respond to our messages and help with any questions. We highly recommend this apartment for a visit to Florence!
The appartement was perfect , it was close to everything ! Elena and Oliver were really nice and available ! I highly recommend !

This place was absolutely beautiful, and right in the heart of Florence! The check-in and keys can be a little tricky, but instructions were incredibly clear so we didn’t have any troubles there. It’s on a quiet street and the jacuzzi was absolutely heavenly after a long day of walking, and we had a few cozy breakfasts out on the patio. The only things to be aware of are early risers making noises upstairs, though that wasn’t much of an issue for our sleep, and the fact that the flat may flood during heavy rains - so if rain is forecasted, keep electronics away from the windowed back wall! Lovely stay, highly recommend.

The apartment was excellent. Clean, spacious, fully stocked, and the hot tub was excellent. The hosts were gracious and helped us check in. The location is perfect -- 10 minute walk to the Duomo and less than 5 minute walk to Santa Croche.
This is a great stay! We spent a bit of our honeymoon here and it was lovely. It is in the perfect location to walk every where you need to go in Florence.

The perfect stay for your trip to Florence. Fantastic location in the heart of Santa Croce. Elena and Oliver were a pleasure to deal with and helped us out with recommendations.
