The apartment itself was very clean and the jacuzzi was delightful. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to stay in Florence.
This place was amazing! It was perfect for our stay in Florence. Centrally located, well stocked and the hot tub was very enjoyable. Would love to stay here again.

The accommodation is lovely and spacious for two people and beautifully presented with great amenities in a peaceful location as well as being within walking distance to everything you need. If we needed anything at all, the hosts were most accommodating. I would definitely stay there again!

It was a very nice place to stay while in Florence. The house has everything you could need and it’s very much worth the price for the amenities that they offer.
The accessibility by foot to the city centre and other tourist attractions was also a big plus.

Perfect apartment walking distance from the beautiful piazza's, river and restaurants. Really well designed with a nice clean and comfortable design. No stairs to climb which was very nice after a day of walking all around the city and steep streets.

Great location in Florence. Less than a 10minute walk to the Duomo. Quiet inside, which is a huge plus for light sleepers! The hot tub was wonderful after running a marathon. Highly recommend this bnb to anyone looking for a getaway to Florence.

We had a wonderful stay. The patio and hot tub were amazing. Walk to everything. No need for a car. Lots of restaurants and attractions close by. Grocery store around the corner. Outdoor hot tub was lovely after a day of steps.

The apartment was in a great location and on the first floor which made it easy with the bags. It was very nicely decorated and the interior was modern and very clean. The size of the apartment was perfect and the free wine and water we received on arrival was a lovely touch which made us feel welcome. Federico met us and was very friendly and helpful. We enjoyed our stay and had almost everything we needed to feel at home. Thank you for your hospitality. We would come back again.
Great location, very clean space! 10’ walk from D’uomo. Excellent space for business trip!

Amazing location, with just steps away from the Duomo and other major sites in Florence. The apartment was very nice and comfortable with all the necessities for a comfortable stay. Check-in was smooth and contactless, which was very appreciated in covid times. Oliver was a wonderful host and was very easy to communicate with.

Great location, walking distance to everything we wanted to see. Host was really lovely, meeting us at the apartment and very helpful with restaurant recommendations. Very nice touch with a bottle of wine on arrival. Really beautifully decorated and comfortable apartment. Definitely recommend.

This is a nice, comfortable apartment in a bustling neighborhood with lots of good restaurants and other amenities. Although the streets could be noisy, when the windows were closed, the street noise was not an issue.  The bed was comfortable, and the bathroom and kitchen had what we needed. The bottle of wine was a nice touch. Thank you!

I visited Florence together with my girlfriend and it was very nice.
Andrea did everything to make our stay comfortable. As a present, he gave us a bottle of wine and some grapes upon arriving. He also prepared a sheet with some restaurant-suggestions in the neighbourhood and in the whole city. Very good!
Unfortunately, we had a small car-accident before we arrived and Andrea helped us to get everything straight. He was very caring and we can recommend his appartement.

Andrea's apartment is superbly located just south of the Arno river and within easy walking distance to both the train station and the city centre.
If you're looking for a clean and simple base from which to explore the beautiful city of Florence, I'd highly recommend Andrea's apartment.
Moreover, as a host, Andrea was incredibly helpful. For instance, Andrea took time to meet us at the train station upon our arrival, and back at the apartment, he presented us with a map and guided us through the main attractions, as well as a few local secrets, that we may have liked to visit during our stay.

Andrea is the greatest host you could find, he welcomed us the best way possible, explaining us everything we had to know about this beautiful city. His apartment is well located, very close to the city center. It's confortable and functional. I recommend deeply !

Andea' s place has a great location... very close to all sightsings and quite. Ideal for a couple. The apartment is clean and cozy. Andrea is a wonderful host, we were welcomed with a bottle of great local wine and some fruites and even things for breakfast...Andrea is the best host ever!

Andrea is just the nicest. He greeted us in person and spent about 20 minutes giving us recommendations and showing us the dos and don'ts for the city on a map. He recommended some awesome hidden gems. His place is off the beaten path enough that it's quiet and not too touristy, but still walkable to everything you want to see. I would highly recommend Andrea for your trip!

Andrea was a great host : he gave us all information needed, some tips, he was here when we arrived to welcome us. The appartement is very well located in a lovely neightbourhood. It is fresh, clean and perfect for two. Merci encore Andrea, et bonnes vacances européennes

Andrea is very nice host, with serious approach to the details. Apartment was clean. Kitchen area well-equiped to any dishes. You will get all relevant and useful information about city, places to go and cafes and trattoria. We enjoyed family trattoria Sabatino recommended by Andrea and located nearby. It was unforgettable! San Frediano and Oltrarno are cozy and cheaper part of the city, with many hidden pearls. When we come to Florence next time, we stay in Frediano's Nest!

I have stayed at Andrea’s apartment and it’s definitely an amazing place in Firenze!
Andrea is a really nice host, the communication with him was perfect. He gave me recommendations of everything I had to do.
The house is equipped with everything you need to have a great stay in Firenze. It’s well located so you can reach to every main attraction just by walking.
Grazie mille Andrea! I highly recommend this place to everyone!

Andrea was a great host who welcomed us at the apartment, showed us into our room and explained all the features of the apartment, and gave us great recommendations for our stay in Florence. He also left us a bottle of chianti wine! The Air conditioning was a must have for Florence. Andre was also very responsive when we reached out Everything was wonderful and I would definitely recommend the apartment.
Great stay. Andrea was super responsive and clear with instructions. The apartment was exactly what we were after - comfy bed, little kitchen and privacy away from the busy city.

It was so nice meeting Andrea he was extremely helpful and gave great recommendations for the area. This place is perfectly located and we enjoyed our stay here. I would definitely recommend this location.
Was a lovely place! Andrea was a very receptive host! Had lots of recommendations for what to do around the city.

We had a really pleasant two nights at Andrea’s apartment. The room is like a comfy hotel setup, with all the necessary amenities.
Andrea was very nice and accommodating, guiding us through the use of all appliances and taking a lot of time to advise us on the local attractions and restaurants. This made our stay much better than we anticipated!

Eléna was incredible! She was very helpful both before, during and after our stay. She met us with keys and recommendations as soon as we arrived. The place was even more beautiful and quaint that expected. We were able to do laundry, there was a nice bottle of wine waiting for us and the place was overall comfy in a nice location. I would definitely stay here again!
So easy to deal with, very polite, nice people, replied to messages quickly, good apartment
Beautiful and cute apartment with a lovely courtyard.  Walkable distance to the centre of the city.  Nicely presented and clean.

Outstanding, world-class accommodations. Beautiful location within walking distance or a short ride to the prime Florence destinations. Excellent price, amenities and very comfortable designer furnishings.  Highly recommend this extraordinary home!!

Excellent location. Close enough to walk downtown, but less busy than most of the city. Very near several restaurants and a beautiful overlook of the city. Mauro and Elena were friendly and helped us get our bearings of the city when we arrived. The apartment was clean and tidy with several nice touches to make us feel at home.

The apartment was centered in a great location. We were able to walk easily to any location and landmark we wanted to go to. The apartment was nice and spacious. We were greeted in the apartment by someone that works for the couple. He was nice and friendly. The only thing is that we did not know about that in advance and were expecting Mauro & Elena. We experienced small glitches with the apartment the first day (Wi-Fi and stove). Mauro was able to assist later in the day and things were resolved.  We had a good communication with both of the hosts. The garden was very nice and just as described in the post. We were very grateful that they allowed us to check-out an hour later and helped us set up transportation to the train station. We came to Florence to celebrate our honeymoon and we would definitely recommend the apartment to others.

Very nice house in a nice area! The garden is great to have a couple of drinks before going out or a lunch/dinner outside with a sunny weather.
We found a lot of things such as olive oil or cafe in the house. Elena was always reachable during our stay and was very nice with us.
The place is in a nice area with bars and restaurants easily findable and reachable by feet. And less flooded by tourists than the center, but still very convenient (bus station to the center at 5min). We were a family of 4 people + a baby and it was the perfect house for few days in Firenze!
Thank you again Elena for your hospitality! We’ll come again :)

We loved our stay at Mauro & Elena’s place! The location was great and near restaurants, while being outside the very busy tourist center. The apartment was spacious enough for four people, and was very clean. The only con was that the WiFi wasn’t fast/often wasn’t working for more than one device at a time.

Great location and the accommodation clean and spacious. Bars restaurants and shops all within 5 minutes walk.
Piazza Michelangelo nearby for a great view of Firenze at dusk and the Giardino di Boboli 10 minute walk
Elena fantastic host met us upon arrival and checked in with us via text during our stay to make sure anything needed
Definitely recommend as a base for exploring Firenze.

Spacious and comfortable appartment at a great location in Florence. It has everything one needs and the host gave us a very warm welcome. We stayed 4 nights and really felt at home in the appartment. Can absolutely recommend it!
This is a great place,  comfortable and in a great location. Nice and central, but not too noisy. I can thoroughly recommend it

I love this apartment and always try to stay there when I go to Florence (I work as a wedding planner and am tired to stay at hotels).
I like very much this area of Florence, the absence of the stairs (I can't deal with heavy luggage) and the space, which includes a small garden.
Everything is simple but charming and efficient. And the kitchen is well-equipped in case you want to cook something.
An ideal place for 1-2 people or even a family traveling with children.

Close to the center, in he very nice San Niccolo neighborhood, the apartment is perfect for a stay in Firenze. Restaurants, gelateria, bars, etc. are located at the very exit of the appartment. Cool for the evening when you ve walked all the day !

The apartment is a great place to stay in Florence for a short or long stay. It is super spacious with a modern bathroom and kitchen and a lovely garden - we wish we’d had more time to spend out there! It is in the lesser known but buzzing area of San Niccolo, with lots of restaurants, bars and shops nearby while not being too touristy. We will definitely be back and recommend to friends and family!

If you want to stay in a beautifully designed and appointed place near the Piazzale Michelangelo, this is it.  Whoever designed this space was a true professional who saw its potential. It was very comfortable, well equipped, clean as a whistle, and well lit - as well as being very nicely designed.  We really enjoye the terrace with its blooming peonies, roses and camillias. We had lunch and dinner on the terrace as  often as we could. Rama, the co-host, was very helpful and did everything to help us, especially in our check-in. Be sure to check the house rules regarding check-in. Rama worked so hard to accomodate us. Thank you Rama!

Great location, nice apartment with cozy terrace!
Near to city center, and still quiet!
I would definitely recommend!!
My daughter and I had a wonderful time at this apartment in Florence! It was situated so well, and surprisingly very peaceful at night. Would definitely recommend :)
Great spot South of the river with easy access to everything. Rama was there to meet us for an easy check in, and everything went smoothly. Strongly recommended!

Great location away from the main tourist areas but walkable. Lots of little bars and restaurants at the bottom of the street. The outside terrace is a bonus. Sadly we had a few days of rain so only managed to get out once it eased off. The apartment inside is clean and comfortable with everything you need for your stay. Would definitely recommend and stay here again.
This is a very spacious place. The bedroom is quiet and the AC works great. Of course, the garden is the highlight. Absolutely peaceful and even better than advertised.
it was a great place to stay in Florence, a little removed from the busiest parts of the city but close enough to not make walking places difficult

lovely apartment (with a nice outdoor area) in a lovely area of Florence - on the quieter side of the river with local bars / restaurants nearby and close to Piazzale Michelangelo and the gardens (but only 20min walk from the centre). Not an issue for us but worth noting that coming from the airport it's quite a way (30min+ walk) from the central station / tram, particularly outside of peak times.

Had a wonderful stay! A quieter area outside the bustle of Florence but way to access the bus back into town. Hosts were so helpful when our flight made us late for checkin. Restaurants and bar nearby would recommend Bepe Fioraia.
The court yard garden was perfect to rest after a busy day.
Would recommend this stay :)

Silvia's place was beautiful and so close to everything we needed! Carlotta, who helped us check in, was also amazing and so helpful - she pointed us towards the best gelato place on our trip and even surprised us with a bottle of wine for our honeymoon! We will definitely stay at Silvia's during our next visit!

One of the cutest spaces I’ve experienced via Airbnb. Silvia’s place was clean, functional, and within walking distance from all of the major sites in Florence. Highly recommended for one or two guests!

We stayed at Silvia’ for a couple of nights: the place is tiny but perfect and has everything you might need. It is close to nice restaurants and close to the city center. Silvia and her friends were really helpful and everything went smoothly. We highly recommend this place!

We absolutely loved staying at This Air BNB.  We loved the flat.  It was cute, great location, and a wonderful , comfortable atmosphere.  We were very happy here.  This would not be a good choice if you are unable to climb stairs because there were many but on the bright side, we ate tons of amazing food in San Frediano and didn’t have to worry because we got a ton of exercise!  Beautiful place to stay in Florence.

This flat is perfect for a solo traveler or a couple! Exactly as pictured, maybe even better in person! Paolo welcomed me on arrival and gave me a map with some wonderful recommendations on where to go in Florence! Very happy with my stay here!

The location was fantastic and checking in was very easy. The host gives you plenty of recommendations for food and locations to visit throughout the city of Florence.
Highly recommended!!
In a great neighbourhood, great restaurants and coffee shops nearby and very walkable to all the sites in Florence.
Comfortable and cute flat but a bit dusty and the fridge had a weird smell and had no water. But overall we liked it!

Would 100% book here again!! We absolutely loved the flat, it was exactly as described, clean, warming and perfect location. Just keep in mind that there are a lot of stairs up to the flat  but we had no issues with it and would recommend this to friends and family. We will book here again when we come back to Florence! Thank you Silvia for a great place that felt like home!

We were glad to find Silvia’s place. This is absolutely a gem. Great location close to the old town but far enough to be quiet and free of many tourists. Everything was spotless clean and the stay was very confortable.

The location is amazing! A lot of things to do around and you can walk to everywhere. The studio is very nice and Silvia was very helpful during our stay. I would definitely at Silvia’s studio in the future.
A beautiful loft that’s walking distance from a lot of food and attractions. Our host met us outside the building and gave us a map and list Florence recs for our stay!

Great place and great host. Wish we stayed longer. Felt very welcome and very helpful hosts.
Great location close to the trendy part of town.

really enjoyed our stay at Vanna’s place - was an ideal location just a short walk from the very centre with lots of hidden gems nearby. check in /out was super easy and there was great communication from the host throughout! would definitely recommend & stay again ! :)
Great place to stay. Location is perfect, just outside the inner city in a calm area, and with all main points of Florence in walking distance.

We loved our stay at Vanna’s! So beautiful from the location to the decorations and Vanna herself. It was so close to the bus lines and very walkable to all of our destinations, while still located on a quiet and peaceful street. We will definitely stay again during our next trip to Florence!

We loved this stay in Florence!
Vanna was very kind and thoughtful as a host, the stay was restful and the bed comfortable. It was nice to have a place to relax at the end of busy days and we found some amazing places to eat and drink within walking distance.

Warmly recommend Christina and her apartments! The location is very good, the apartment looks exactly like the pictures and the courtyard is an oasis. We stayed for two months and we will definitely stay here again when we come back to Firenze. Christina and her husband are very friendly and professional. Thank you for making our stay the best!

We had a great time at Christina's apartment. We did not meet Christina but her husband was there to greet us and gave us lots of helpful tips about where to go for dinner and drinks. The apartment is really well designed - simple but elegant - with everything you need including a fully equipped kitchen and a lovely dining area in the courtyard outside.

Salvatore, Christina and family are absolutely wonderful and very charming! They were beyond welcoming and were so very helpful during our stay. They even made the arrangements for our taxi to the airport. Their apartment is beautiful and newly renovated with all the amenities you'd need for your stay. They even provide 2 bikes which came in handy. We absolutely loved this hidden gem and our stay in Florence.
Really nice and friendly! Close to supermarket and buses to city center. Perfect for a stay in Florence ☀️

This place was my favorite place we stayed during our small tour of Italy. The apartment is cozy and spacious with the cutest backyard area to relax with a glass (or a bottle) of wine. Christina was super helpful during check-in, and offered tips on places to go or restaurants to try out!

This apartment is lovely! We wish we actually had the time to stay inside and hang out there longer—we were too busy exploring the city! Great location; you’re about a 15-20 min walk from all of the central sights and restaurants. Christina and Salvatore are absolutely wonderful. So kind and helpful. We appreciate them immensely! If you are coming from the train, you can take one of three bus lines to get to there home, just make sure to buy your ticket prior to boarding the bus. Otherwise you get fined! Aside from that, Florence is wonderful and you will love this air bnb :)
We really enjoyed our stay. The neighborhood is quiet but close enough to all the major attractions that you can walk. The apartment was comfortable and perfect for 2 people!

Lovely stay in a quiet neighborhood! Christina was a wonderful host who was extremely responsive and provided great recommendations during our stay. She was very proactive and her place had it ALL - Highly recommend! Will be back again. :)

Great location. We walked to the station one day for a trip to Pisa. The main sites in Florence are within a 15 minute walk.
Good recommendations for local restaurants and Christina was very flexible with regard to our arrival and departure.
The apartment is comfortable and quiet so sleep quality was good.
Large outside area although the weather wasn’t too kind to us!

I recently had the pleasure of staying at this breathtaking at Christina's house, and I can't say enough positive things about my experience. From the moment I stepped foot into the stunning property, I was captivated by its charm and elegance. The host went above and beyond to ensure that every aspect of my stay was exceptional.
The accommodation itself was beautifully decorated and immaculately clean. The attention to detail was outstanding, and it was evident that the Christina and her assistant had put a lot of thought into creating a comfortable and cozy environment. The bed was incredibly comfortable, and I woke up feeling refreshed and rejuvenated each morning.
I also highly recommended the restaurant nearby( 5 mins walk) call Edi house, the host and his crew were incredibly friendly and the food, oh my god, beyond words delicious.
It's your best choice when visiting Florence. It offers the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and hospitality.

Christina is a wonderful host & made us feel very welcomed, as if we were staying with a family friend.
20 minute walk from district 1. Around the corner from several bus stops. Great backyard. Would stay again.

This apartment is in a great location, it’s an easy 20-25 minutes walk to the very centre and has fantastic local restaurants and cafes. The apartment is beautifully presented with everything you need for a relaxing trip and an abundance of towels, toiletries, tea and coffee. We really appreciated the flexible check in - and the bottle of wine our hosts left as a welcome gift!

Lovely apartment with nice garden space for sitting outside and having a drink. It's located on a quiet street located around a 15-20 minute walk from the centre. Christina was a very helpful host at check in and more than happy to help with any other questions.
I would happily stay here again when visiting Florence.

This place was BEAUTIFUL. We didn’t want to leave the airbnb because the window and terrace were so lovely. It had everything we needed and was very comfortable and clean. Communication was great too. About a 25 min walk to the city center.

We absolutely loved staying in Christina’s apartment. The pictures didn’t do it justice. The host was responsive, kind and welcoming, and the place was beautiful. We particularly liked the neighbourhood, which was quiet and a nice walk into the much busier centre. There’s a good sized supermarket nearby as well as several cafes. I would absolutely stay at Christina’s place again, and have already recommend it to several friends. Thank you for a lovely stay!

We loved Christina’s place.
If you are looking for a quiet location with easy train access to the student square or train station in Florence, then this place can’t be beat.
The apartments itself is fantastic and decorated impeccably. It is easily within a few minute walk from groceries and some really great restaurants.
I highly recommend this location for travelling to Florence!
Christina and Salvatore were extremely responsive and accommodating during our stay. They were easy to contact and very kindly accommodated our late arrival. I would 100% recommend staying with them!

My kids and I loved our stay! We were warmly welcomed by Mavel, the housekeeper, and her sweet son. It felt like visiting family. The apartment was cozy and well-equipped. It was hot due to a heat wave, but Christina quickly sent a quieter fan which helped a lot. The thoughtful touches like a bottle of wine and pantry essentials were appreciated. We didn’t use the patio much because of the heat, but it looked lovely. Overall, a wonderful and welcoming first experience in Florence!

Staying at Ludovica's home was an absolute pleasure.
Her place was spotless, comfortable and everything we hoped for. The master bedroom has a king size bed which we heard it's not very common around, soft sheets and the sweet touch of a mint on your pillow. The bathroom had a good size shower and great water pressure which is wonderful after walking and exploring all day.
Location is perfect for walking around town and super convenient if you are coming to Florence by train and bus.
Ludovica was available anytime we had a question or needed help, with a quick response time and friendliness.
We'll definitely come back to Florence and stay with her again!!

The apartment is in a great location and an easy walk from the train station. The host was very responsive to texts and was able to quickly call us a cab to the airport when we needed it after having told her the day before we would not need her help (thank you!)  Even though the street can be busy the windows are good sound barriers. I would've preferred more comfortable mattresses but they were like almost every mattress I've slept on in Italian hotels and apartments for 5 weeks now (Italians seem to like extra firm, hard mattresses!) so I can't really count that against this property.

This is an older appt on the second floor but with a good lift (free). Secure building. It is noisy - next to the markets with vendors storing their carts next to the building and the leather shop across the road putting his door up and down at all hours.
Modern bathroom, small shower, lots of hot water. Fly screens on all windows. Washing machine in kitchen. 3 air conditioners worked very well during very hot weather - all a little noisy.
The beds and pillows were not comfortable.
Good TV with Netflix. Internet did NOT work well with our iPhones.
Location very central. About 12 mins from railway.
On a more positive note, Michaelangelo’s David is only 2 blocks away, the Duomo 3 blocks and the Uffizi about 10mins.
Fabulous place to stay in a great location- near lots of great restaurants and leather market. Inclusion of a lift was also great. Beds were like clouds so comfortable Would stay here again
Tommaso was a great host.  He met us at check in and spent 30 minutes showing us the apartment and answering all our questions about Florence.
Tommaso's apartment is perfect in every way. Perfectly situated with a short walk to many of Firenze's most important sights.
This airbnb was fantastic! On our trip we were in Paris and also Rome, but this was the best place we stayed. Amazing apartment, fantastic location, and Tom was great to work with.
Tom’s place is awesome! Perfect for exploring the heart of Florence, and he is very responsive/helpful. Highly recommend!

Great location, quiet street adjacent to Ferragamo store and museum.
Short walk to the train station, Ponte Vecchio and Duomo.
Discovered our new Favorite restaurant for pasta one street below - Mangia Foco
Clean apartment and well appointed with all the comforts.
Great communication with Tomasso!
Very enjoyable stay!

Tommaso's place is wonderful; so tastefully decorated and immaculately clean. It is better than as described on AirBNB. Tommaso went out of his way to provide extra touches like leaving us a bottle of wine from Tuscany and helping us arrange parking right next to the apartment. The location is incredible. We hated leaving.
It’s location is excellent, close to all the sightseeing spots, restaurants, and supermarket. Suitable for short stay travelers who doesn’t have much time.
Tom was a great host and his apartment was fantastic, in a great location too, very central. Would definitely recommend!

This is a wonderful apartment in a great location. Walkable to all major attractions and close to some great restaurants. It is spacious and clean. And Tommaso was a great host! Easy check in/check out and helpful tips about the city. Would highly recommend!

Tom’s place is perfect for 4 guests. With a large pullout couch and a private bedroom, the size of the apartment was perfect. The apartments location was terrific, as the surrounding area could not have been nicer. On top of Tom’s place, he is a very dedicated host. I could not recommend staying with him more!
Amazing place! So clean and spacious and in a perfect location. Tom was also super accommodating with check in and check out. Would absolutely stay here again if/when I come back to Florence!

Lovely and spacious apartment very well located, right in the center of Florence near all main attractions and a few steps away from the Ponte Vecchio. Tomasso is a very kind and caring host, he welcomed us at the apartment upon our arrival and explained in details the apartment and provided very useful information to visit de city and Tuscany. Communication with him was very easy.  The place was very clean and well maintained, we quickly felt at home and very much enjoyed our time spent in the apartment. We highly recommend this place.

Beautiful place with amazing walking location to everything. The apartment was very clean and we felt so comfortable there. Also great A/C! I would definitely stay there again! Host gave great local tips and transportation advice too! The only only thing I would change would be to have a comforter on the bed instead of just a sheet. Amazing Airbnb you won’t be disappointed!

Tomassos Place was fantastic . So clean, well thought out amenities and excellent communication. Ironing board , washer (with detergent !!) , comfortable , close to everything . Highly recommend! Tomasso is an excellent host !!

Absolutely LOVED Tommaso’s Airbnb. He was such a wonderful host - helped with all recommendations, helped get us around and was in constant communication to make sure we were okay at all times throughout our stay. This location in incredible. In the heart of shopping and a 5 minute walk anywhere you want to go. It’s a beautiful place. Would certainly stay again!!

Tommaso’s place was an excellent place to stay at! He greeted us himself and helped us with anything we needed. Also gifted us with a bottle of wine! Definitely the best location to stay at and very clean and spacious!

Florence is beautiful and this apartment puts you minutes from Uffizi and Ponte Vecchio. The train station is 15 minute walk.
Apartment is cozy, very clean, and has good amenities. Tommasso is a great host.
If you drive a parking garage is just below on Delle Terme.
This place is an amazing find! Super quiet street but only 10 minutes from all the major sites. Check in and check out were a breeze - can't recommend more highly!

Tom was so great to chat with, very friendly! It’s clear he loves his city. He provided us with several recommendations to check out while we were in town. We took his advice and had some really fun experiences, like a rooftop restaurant and also a speakeasy for a drink - two things we would not have done otherwise. The apartment itself was very clean and in a great location.

Nice location and place. Overall the Airbnb was nice but we struggled with the check in process and overall host communication and consistency.
Check in was not automated and host was overly communicative about requesting our arrival time when we had already said afternoon and had uncertain travel plans. He was trying to figure out when to bring by a welcome gift which never happened and we just wanted privacy once there.
No coffee at the place but host brought some after we requested on first morning.
When we asked about late check out the night before departure to him and his staff (via Airbnb app & two different Wha*sApp #s he asked us to use), no one even responded.
He did give good restaurant recs.
The joy of Airbnb is privacy and ease of check-in and responsiveness- none of which were consistent with this host.
This place was in a great location. Could easily walk across the river or towards the Duomo. Lots to do and a great space to stay.

The stay at Tommaso’s apartment met all of our expectations and then some. A vibrant neighborhood with so much to offer! A bit loud at times but to be expected given the location. Tommaso was an excellent host - very responsive,  met us for a personal walk through of the apt and many recommendations! Definitely recommend!
Tomasso was very responsive and met us at checkin. the location was great and the apartment was very nice and down a cobblestone side street. would recommend!
Great location, great tips from Tom on where to eat. Felt safe in the area. Street performers right around the corner in the square every night.

Very much enjoyed our stay here! Tommaso was so helpful and customer service was excellent!! He greeted us and showed us around the AirBnB and recommended really good spots. This location is ideal! So close to all the main piazzas and attractions! Highly recommend!!
Greate place to stay. Perfect location. Tommaso was a greate host. Very responsive and friendly.
The apartment was beautifully decorated and had everything we needed. Amazing location  and Tommaso’s recommendations were spot on!

Naike is fantastice, polite and communicative host. Stay at her place was nothing but pleasure. The room I stayed in had some amazing paintings on the ceiling, bathroom was clean, functional and spacious. Thank you Naike, that was fantastic experience. :)

All was great! Beautiful apartment in nice quiet area. We had a room with the small balcony which was great. Very clean and new. Naike is a nice host, we met once upon check in only but she was helpful in finding the house. Thank you!
Apartment is really nice and comfortable. Naike is good host, she is doing her best to fell welcome in her apartment. But street behind the window is really noisy during almost whole night.

Clean and well located apartment. It was easy to get around Firenze by foot. Naike and her family were very helpful and gentle. The heating system of the house works really well. We were very satisfied during our days there.

Naike is very kind person. She has beautiful house. We stayed in room with fresco on the ceiling :) There is bus stop next to house. Bus no 4 is going to Piazza San Marco every 20min, I believe. It's taking circa 20 min. 5 min away is giardino orticoltura with amazing city view. Nice kitchen, stylish interior. I recommend.
Nice place noisy location is the best way to describe it...if your a light sleeper it will be hard but if not worth the price and is a beautiful historic building

I’ve been here for 8 days and I really enjoyed while I was here. Naike and her mom were very kind and good for me.
Florence is not a big city, so I didn’t have any problem to get to central, even though the accomadation doesn’t locate at central.

Naike is absolutely a kind and helpful person. The place was really clean and cute. My only problem was sound proofing of windows which is a bit annoying especially during the night while cars and trains pass. In general, I recommend this place since the value is so fair.

Great location. Pictures are exactly what is in the picture. Communication between the host was very lacks and he did not notify us about the air conditioner not working in the room. The patio is a shared patio so you will have people walking up and down sometimes. Great place if these areas are fixed.

This apartment is very close to the city center, with great view on Duomo.
It was clean and well equipped, suitable for 4 people, definately worth its price. I can recommend this place to everyone.

Highly recommend! the location alone was fantastic and great to get to everything. The view was great from both the living room and the bedroom. The terrace was shared but most of the time people just came out to take a quick photo so we usually had it to ourselves and the screen helped for privacy. There was a book with a lot of helpful information from the host we tried a few for meals and loved them. Would highly recommend going to Acqua al 2 for dinner and getting the pasta and steak samplers to share.
Fantastic experience and wonderful hospitality !! Very informative especially coming to a country I have never been at . Definitely would come back to stay there

The place was easy to find and Naike helped us to find it. If you need parking also ask... there is free parking in a park less than a minutes walk from the apartment. The place was cosy and clean. You will have a private bedroom and a shared toilet, bathroom and a kitchen. It's a bit more than 30 min walk to the city centre. Mike was very pleasant and helped us with everything we needed. Would recommend the stay.

The appartment was great in the center and not so far to the end of ZTL by walking or bus to let car in the parking. The rooftop is great with the view on the Duomo. Nice day in Firenze. Everything is in to pass a good time in this appartment
The location and view can’t be beat!! It was a dream to stay here. Would definitely come back!
We had a wonderful time staying at this location. it was centrally located and within walking distance to everything we wanted to see. The views were amazing.
The view of the Duomo really is breathtaking. This was a fantastic location, everything is a 10 minute walk. And the balcony is the perfect spot for a glass of wine at the end of the night!

The view of the Duomo from the bedroom patio was spectacular! We hung out there every night. The apartment has an A/C in both the bedroom and living room, which was a big plus. Very nice amenities-everything you need for a long stay. Really worth the $.

It was truly magical waking up every morning to this view of the Duomo. Literally the perfect location close to everything. Christina allowed us to check in a bit earlier which was helpful for us. A simple, clean, and convenient space for what we needed for a great stay in Florence. Bring your own toiletries, as this is pretty common through Italy. Nic who let us in was wonderful and helpful and patient with our questions and recommendations. Grazie!

Great apartment to have as a base in Florence - fantastic view and location. The only thing missing is some basic kitchen essentials, so not the best if you’re wanting to cook….. but there are so many amazing restaurants on your doorstep it really isn’t a problem :)

You must stay here! Open the patio doors, and the Duomo is right there. It was truly breathtaking. We were greeted by the host and they shared many tips and restaurant recommendations. We felt very safe in this area and will absolutely be booking here again.

The location was perfect for our first visit to Florence! Walked everywhere, check-in was easy (let us do so a little earlier), communication good too. The balcony is really nice- it is shared though, with your own private section- and it seems to be an overall vacation/rental building. Overall, happy with our stay!

Stay here!!! The view is incredible and location is ideal. We had a blast spotting the balcony from the top of the Campanile! The apartment is just as wonderful as advertised. Cristina is very communicative and made our arrival a breeze. Her brother Niccolo welcomed us and made us feel immediately like we were home. He gave fabulous recommendations and advice for making the most of our trip to Florence. The apartment is spacious and comfortable. If we are ever in Florence again, we couldn't imagine staying anywhere else!
Great location in the heart of Florence with an exceptional view of the Duomo! We would not hesitate to stay here again.

This was a great location! The size worked for three of us. Cristina’s brother greeted us and was helpful with places to go to eat and Cristina was very responsive. Walking distance to everywhere we wanted to go. Loved the little vino and panini place across the street! Nice to have the air conditioning and washing machine.
Superb location, with view of Duomo. Host was extremely helpful, great recommendations. Beautiful historic building
The view from the terrace was amazing, the flat was very clean and spacious. The host was very friendly and offered recommendations. We would love to stay here again.
Cristina was a warm and gracious host. The Duomo view was incredible and so close. She provided very helpful instructions upon arrival and in writing for us. Look forward to staying again.

I can’t imagine a better place to stay in Florence. Clean, spacious, incredible terrace view of the Duomo, and Niccolo helped check us in and gave excellent recommendations. Having laundry on site was a huge plus, we packed much lighter as a result. Cristina was always responsive coordinating our arrival time. We will be back!
An unbeatable place for the price Naike and her mother were very kind and attentive. My stay was very pleasant ☺️

Beautiful home in an awesome location and a super helpful host. Being able to have a morning coffee or evening wine on the patio in the backdrop of the Duomo right in front of you is an experience to be lived!

This Airbnb was in a perfect location! We were walking distance from everything we needed. They also provided a book full of recommendations, tips and information for us to use. It was super helpful.  We had issues with our train prior to arriving that prompted us to be late for check in. Cristina was super responsive and worked with us to figure out a solution. We were very happy with our stay!

Cristina is a wonderful host, and the apartment is even more beautiful in person. The view of Duomo was incredible from the terrace, and the location made it so easy to walk and see everything we wanted to in Florence. Amazing experience!

Can't beat the location/view at this place :)
Check-in was super easy & the host was very responsive.

The apartment is very well located to visit florence. It is incredibly bright and very spacious.  The design is very nice and you will find everything you need. The bed are very confortable and the place is very quiet even if it can become a bit loud in the late evening. The noise stops however at a decent time. We highly reccomend this apartament and would surely consider it again for our staying in Florence.
Would stay again.  Silva as and Vanessa were superb. Great location. Wonderful space. Thanks so much.
Cute place in walking distance of everything. A bit noisy at night, but if the windows are closed, it wasn’t really a problem.  Check-in and communication was super!

Had a great stay. Silvana was very responsive to our needs and Vanessa was very helpful when we needed assistance with anything urgent. Her place was clean, spacious and walkable to all the main attractions in Florence including the station. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay!!
We had a wonderful stay at Silvana’s apartment. She was so kind and accommodating. We highly recommend her and her apartment and hope to stay there again.
Highly recommend!  Great apartment in a great location. Very clean and host was very communicative.

Great place, exactly as described!  Our flight from Germany was cancelled and Silvana was great about being flexible for us.   The place was in a great location, clean, and very nice!  We would absolutely stay there again!
Our 2nd stay was just as wonderful as our first! Our kids love the play room, especially the tiny bike! We hope to return!

Unit was in a great location - in the city and walkable, yet quiet at night.  Temperatures outside were in the high 90's, but AC units kept the inside comfortable.   CLEAN, CLEAN, CLEAN!  Absolutely great!

Great spot. Amazing location, great check in. Main room and main bedroom are awesome.
The only reason this isn’t five stars is that the other bedroom is photographed rather deceptively. The beds are smaller than they look (they seem somehow smaller than single beds, if that’s possible) and the ceiling is 4 feet in some places. Sleeping in there was a little claustrophobic and you will hit your head a lot.
The second bedroom might be good for children. It is not fit for adults.
Davide welcomed us kindly when we arrived and showed us the flat, which is amazing! Very tidy and cosy! We really liked the tuscan- touch
Allessandra and Davide's place is amazing. Beautiful decor and details. Lovely host and quiet neighbourhood. Cute breakfast included. Would love to go back again.

Alessandra's and Davide's apartment is located less than a kilometre away from Aldo Moro tram station, in Scandicci. You need around 5 minutes to walk to the tram station, and from there around 15 minutes by tram to Florence city centre.
The neighbourhood is quiet and nice, away from the crowded centre of Florence but still very close to it. There is a supermarket in walking distance and a nice bakery to get breakfast from less than 100 metres away.
I liked how the apartment looked like in the pictures but it looks even nicer in reality. It is modern and traditional at the same time, reminds you than you are visiting Tuscany and has everything you need.
The owners are very friendly, they just let me enjoy my stay there without any problems whatsoever, I really felt like the apartment was mine for those days.
Thank you Davide and Alessandra!
Alessandra and Davide are the most accommodating, kind-hearted, detail oriented hosts! Stay here if you want a relaxing, cozy, home away from home!

Alessandra and Davide are wonderful hosts! Very friendly and welcoming.  The apartment was beautiful and clean.  Our hosts were very helpful in giving us useful information and communicate quickly. We recommend them for future travelers that want to visit Florence but stay at a nice and quiet area not too far from city center.

Quiet location, tram is 10 min walk away and takes about 25 mins to the centre of Florence. Our host Davide was very helpful and met us on our way to the Airbnb. We found it to be very homely and had everything we could possibly need, including thoughtful touches such as cooking ingredients (olive oil, herbs, salt, pepper, even pasta and sauce), tea, and most importantly - coffee. We recommend getting a rental car for at least a day so you can drive out and see the beautiful tuscan landscape. Free parking on the road by the Airbnb!

Very Beautiful and cozy apartment! The apartment is located away from the center of Florence, which was ideal for us. Davide and Alessandra are great hosts and provide you with a completely list of restaurants and places to visit. Would definitely love to stay there again if I come back to Florence.

Alessandra & Davide were such welcoming hosts, their apartment was beautiful and very well located - only about 20 minutes from the centre by tram :) We had all we needed in the apartment and more! They thought of everything - we had milk, orange juice, yogurt and lots of bits and bobs in the bathroom! The bed was super cosy and they have us lots of tips for local places to eat and things to do!

Alessandra & Davide’s place is amazing. I stayed here because of the great reviews and they didn’t disappoint. They go above and beyond to make your stay so wonderful! Thank you guys so much for such great hospitality. It’s a bit far from the tram station but we managed ok. I’d stay there again in a heartbeat! So beautiful and an actual comfy bed!!

The location is perfect, you can reach the centre of Florence in no time, but still come home to a quiet setting. The apartment was absolutely beautiful, and had everything we needed and more! So many thoughtful touches. If we ever visit Florence again, we’ll be staying here!

The property is beautifully maintained. Everything you see on the listing is what you’ll expect and more. The city centre is easily accessible by the tram. A very comfortable and clean space that makes you want to come back again. And last but not least, awesome host where language is not a barrier.

Location:★★★★★
(Free Parking/Walk 5 Minutes Ground Train/Within 20 Minutes to City)
Cleanliness:★★★★★
Facilities:★★★★★
Satisfaction:★★★★★
Travelers are very lucky to meet these accommodations. Host will be sincerely kind and you will feel really happy during your stay here. The host also provides the necessary information for travelers to Florence.
David and Alessandra’s place was exceptionally clean, had a very modern yet Italian vibe. It was cosy and we had a great stay in Florence.

Davide is a very friendly and accomodating host! The apartment was perfect as a base for a trip through the tuscany and especially for discovering Firenze. It is located in a quiet area and is super well equipped. Would always come back to Davide.
Davide’a place is lovely and unique! He is so hospitable and helpful! One thing to mention was there is no a/c, but there fans provided! We really enjoyed being right outside the city!

We had a lovely time staying at Davide & Alessandra’s Airbnb. The location was quite close to a tram station and it took about 15 min to get to Florence. There’s quite a lot of local shops and restaurants. Davide was quite responsive and helpful as a host. Highly recommend! Thanks for having us 😊

Exceptional location, everything in the apartment like-new and perfect, reasonable price, and great host with great communication before and during the stay.

This would be where we would stay again in Florence and I have stayed many places in that city.
Fantastic clean and newly renovated apartment, perfect location, best ever bed and pillows. Would highly recommend.

Great apt in a safe neighborhood. Very comfortable, close to all the historic sites, train station etc. Martina is a very good host. Definitely recommend to family & friends. Thank you Martina to let us stay in your apt 🙏🙏🙏👍👍👍

Martina’s apartment is in a great location - a short walk from the train station and walking distance to the Duomo, Uffizi, and other major sites in Florence.  Even though it’s in a bustling tourist area, once you enter the gates of the complex it’s calm and quiet.  The apartment is spacious, clean, and well appointed for travelers; we especially appreciated that laundry facilities were available.  Martina also provided a lot of information about neighborhood restaurants and local resources.  Highly recommended!

Martina’s place is a 5 minute walk from the SMN train station. It’s also a close walk to the Duomo, shopping, supermarkets, and great restaurants.  Her place is clean and stylish and was comfortable for our family of 4. Newly renovated and in a gated community the location is superb. Washer and dryer facilities are available within the community, a big plus after walking all day in the hot summer sun! Highly recommend for a couple or family with small children. Martina was quick to respond to all our questions and provided great restaurant recommendations. All and all, a great host for our stay in Florence!

Martina was quick to answer any questions we had and even gave us some local tips of places to eat! The apartment location was great because it's an easy walk to the train station but tucked away in a quite area.
Amazing location and place to stay whilst in Florence, a short walk to the market, duomo, train station and accademia. I would highly recommend to anyone visiting to stay here.
Great location near train station. We walked everywhere and caught the #12 bus nearby to Pizza Michelangelo.

We had a great stay at Martina's place. We arrived by train and found the property to be within easy walking distance. Our arrival time was not firmly scheduled, as we did a stop at Pisa while traveling from Cinque Terre. Despite that, Martina worked with us for a late check in (thanks, Martina!).
We found the property to be large, modern, clean, and very well appointed. There is access to a pay washer and dryer on the property. This is a great place for a short or long stay. In addition to the convenient location to the train station, it is an easy walk to all of Florence's major sights.
Everything was great! I will definitely choose to stay here again for the future trip to Florence. Thanks for all arrangements by Martina, the best host and the best bnb I have ever met!

Great location! Mathias called us and coordinated to meet us at the apartment right after our train got in. He provided us with a map of the city and showed us where all of his favorite restaurants were. We took advantage of his recommendations and were not disappointed! We loved our stay in Florence and would definitely recommend this location!

Very nice apartment tucked away in a small gated community but with a great location close to the train station as well as the dome. Very clean and well appointed and host Martina was friendly and communicative. Only thing that wouldve made it better is if the washer was in unit (there's a separate pay per use laundry room in the complex). Would recommend for a comfortable stay in Florence!
This is the 3rd time we stay at Martina's place, it was as perfect as usual! We will definitely be coming back!

If you see this place available don’t think in others options just book it, you won’t regret. This place have anything you’ll need not just for a short stay also a long one. The location is strategic with access to the main attractions easily and because you have the metro station close by the farthest attractions are easy to reach. Other great dot to highlight is the hosts, she and her mother were so helpful, easy to work with and quick response. Without a doubt I stay in this place again!

Martina was a great host. Excellent and safe location. Walking distance to most of the must see sites. Carpark was perfect for travel outside the city. Siena is a must visit.
Thank you Martina.
Beautiful apartment in a great location. Very clean and safe. Martina is very helpful and friendly as well! We would love to come back to Florence and stay here again

Everything as described on the page. Great location, 5 mins from train station. Spacious and cosy apartment, felt safe too. Martina was a great host and provided tips on location places to visit and restaurants recommendations.
Martina was very easy to communicate with. She was very detailed and made everything easy. The location is excellent. We liked staying there, would recommend it!

Loved staying in Martina’s apartment in Florence. Her place is located in a great central area and decorated so stylishly! She was a great host with thoughtful recommendations and she helpfully booked us a taxi to get to the airport. We highly recommend staying at Martina’s apartment!

Wonderful place! Wonderful location. Super close to great attractions like the central market. Not a far walk from all the museums and sights. Martina is super kind and helpful. I would stay here again!

Fantastic location! Super short walk to the train station yet in a quiet street and right in the heart of florence. The apartment itself is clean, bright and just as described. Very comfortable stay. Highly recommended!

The apartment is spacious and clean. It is located in a quiet street yet close to all main Florence attractions. We walked everywhere and never had to walk more than 15 minutes to get to a main attraction.

Martinas place is spotlessly clean and in an excellent location. We were steps away from everything! Martina was extremely responsive and communicative with all of our questions. Would definitely stay here again!
Great location, so close to the train station and walking distance to all you want to do. Very good host , fast at responding

Look no further, just book Martina's place. It's in a perfect location, right by the Santa Maria Novella train station and within walking distance to all attractions. Raj's wine shop is right across the street along with a number of restaurants less than 5 mins walk away.
The apartment is located in a secure complex and the parking spot is a great feature. It is decorated beautifully and we had everything to make our stay comfortable.
Martina was amazing to interact with, before booking, after booking and for check out. It was such a great experience. I cannot recommend it enough! I will definitely be back next time I'm in Florence. Thank you Martina for an amazing stay!!
Great location and great host - would definitely come back and recommend. Martina is a great host and gave the best tips for my short stay.

Martina was very quick to communicate and was waiting for us on arrival and was very helpful, showing us around the apartment, giving us a map and recommending places to eat which were excellent. The apartment is very well situated, very close to the centre, within short walking distance. It was perfect having a garage for our hire car. The apartment was beautifully decorated and extremely clean. the cooking facilities were good so we had two nights in and cooked. We would definitely return if coming back to Florence. Thank you Martina!

Martina is a great host. Responsive, offers a lot of advice, detailed instructions on moving around the city and access to the apartment. The apartment is beautiful. Spacious, tastefully decorated and one of the cleanest we have ever lived in. It is equipped with everything you need, dishwasher, coffee maker, microwave, basic necessities such as coffee, oil, vinegar ... The garage is a big bonus. The car next to the apartment in the old town is a luxury. The apartment is located in the center. 10 to 15 minutes walk to all sights. There are restaurants, cafes and despite that, the apartment is quiet. I highly recommend it.
Beautiful townhouse in the center of town, just a minutes walk to the train station and major landmarks!

This was a great place to stay in Florence. In the heart of downtown, walking distance to all the major sites. The place is tucked back from the street so it was also a great place to relax from a long day, and quiet at night to sleep!

This apartment has all the facilities it advertises.  The balcony view is lovely and it is generally comfortable.  It is a very short distance from the Duomo and close to the train station.  I would us this apartment again.
Nice location, close to everything in the town, including the train station. As some minuses - there are steep stairs and bathrooms & shower's cabins are very tiny.

Apartment in great location close to train station.  Easy enough to walk with large bags from train station.  Also close to walk to main attractions like the Duomo.  Easy to communicate with the host.  Great checkin process.  Provided with local map and many recommendations.
Martina‘a house was great and exactly as described in the listing. It is close to all major attractions. Best of all, Martina was a great host and was very accommodating.

I’d highly recommend Marina’s properly. The location is perfect and has car parking which is very rare for that area. Martina is also lovely and incredibly helpful! The bed is slightly firm so do take note if that bothers you.

This accommodation was lovely, clean and spacious. Martina provided a check-in video that was excellent for finding out way around and into the complex.
The location was exceptional. We weee able to walk to everything! And we were right near the train station, which meant being able to walk our luggage to the accommodation rather than catching a taxi.
We would absolutely stay here again. Thank you, Martina!

This is one of the nicest airbnbs I've ever rented. The place was big, beautiful, quiet, cozy, and unique. We especially loved the living room and the patio furniture just outside the door that looks out into the courtyard. It felt like our own little oasis.
The location is also perfect. Some of the best restaurants, bars, and cafés in Florence are a 5-10 minute walk away. The main tourist sights and museums are also only 10-20 minutes away.
Martina was super helpful and communicative. We had everything we needed and she gave us clear instructions for our self check in. We had no issues.
I highly recommend this airbnb.

Martina’s apartment is located close to the central station. As described 5 mins. Has many eateries in walking distance.
The instructions and recommendations were one of the best we have come across. Would definitely recommend for a safe, convenient & pleasant stay at Florence.

Prompt and helpful communication. Thoughtful video showed how to enter. Notebook inside provided information on everything one needs to know from laundry to grocery stores to great restaurants to sightseeing.
Clean with everything one
might need - pots and pans, blow dryer, lots to towels, drying rack.
Great location - walking distance to everything - train station to tourist areas to restaurants.
Safe location. Quiet. Bright inside which was nice - very cheerful.
Highly recommend.
Great deal, wonderful location for my wife and I during our time in Florence. We easily walked to all the major sites and it always felt great coming home here!

Great location which is central and walkable to most major locations. Was as described and Martina gave excellent recommendations to local restaurants and places to see. Would highly recommend this place

The apartment was clean and close to the Duomo. There were great restaurants and it was very close to most attractions. The check in was easy and Gian Franco was very responsive and helpful. The beds were comfortable and we were able to wash some clothing which was very nice.

Amazing location with a great view from the balcony, located right in the heart of Florence 5-10 minute walk to popular restaurants, museums, and attractions! Gian Franco & the rest of the team were all super kind, professional, responsive, and accommodating especially when we asked if we could check in earlier than originally planned. Lots of great recommendations from the host & team for authentic restaurants & great views of the Duomo! The place was extremely clean & had a washer for clothes which is something that we cared about since we only brought backpacks. Felt safe walking in the neighborhood at night. Overall 10/10 place, would recommend & stay again!

It’s a great place that’s close to the basilica and the train station so we can easily move about and find food. Check in was smooth, Eduardo helped check us in and showed us around the apartment as well

Can’t fault the location. Very central and very reasonably priced.
Needs general maintenance and a freshen up. Generally clean and tidy. Smaller than photos would suggest.
Very responsive host, easy to communicate with and answered all questions, very useful tips and places to visit whilst here. Overall had a very good stay.
Apartment was in a fabulous location and very walkable to everywhere. Many great restaurants nearby. Having two bathrooms was very helpful (though one was tiny). Matias was very responsive.

The place was in a great location and was walkable to and from the train station as well as the main tourist attractions. The apartment is in an older building so as expected it is a little bit run down and dated. Despite this, it was a great size for 3 adults and a bonus that there were two bathrooms! As we were out during the days it was perfect for what we needed.

Possibly the best AirBnB in Florence. Not kidding. It is in the HEART of everything but totally peaceful, even has a garage parking spot and an excellent washer and dryer room (shared with other apartments). The interior is classy and new, powerful a/c, just needed a toaster to be perfect. A little confusing to drive to with avoiding restriction zones, but just navigate to the Burger King by the train station first and then to the address.

The host was amazing, she met us outside to let us in and after arrival everything was smooth as silk. A bit stressful with city traffic getting to the place but hosts instructions are clear and precise. Host is extremely organized and has a booklet of suggestions and problem solves if any issues arise. 100% a place i would stay again

Stayed 4 nights in Martina's place, had a wonderful experience. Surprised to find a nice place in the middle of the city that's private and not in an old building, and comes with parking! The place is clean and modern with all the amenities you need. Martina provided clear instructions on how to check in and navigation. She even had a baby cot and high chair available for us to use!
Everything was as stated and very nice and clean. We felt very safe and were thankful to find this listing.  If I come back I will be staying here.

I was very impressed with this apartment. It is spacious, modern, and beautifully designed. The kitchen is large and convenient, and every room is well-arranged and spotlessly clean, which made the stay very comfortable. The property also feels very safe, with both a locked main entrance and a secure front door. Overall, this accommodation made my trip to Florence truly enjoyable and memorable 💖

The position of apartment was excellent, having 2 toilets was a bonus.
Great position for the price.
Had air conditioning
The only issue was need to upgrade pillows, not comfortable

Location is perfect, right in front of bus stop that can take you to anywhere.
Room was clean and big.
Near cafes and shops
Thank you very much.

We had a wonderful stay at Anna's charming place! Anna was a kind and attentive host, making sure everything was perfect throughout our visit. The house was clean, cozy,  and charismatic with all the essentials needed. Anna’s warmth and hospitality made me feel truly at home.

Paola's apartment might seem a little bit off the strict center of Florence, but still everything you'd like to see is pefectly walkable from there. The neighborhood is nice, quiet and very local. There are local bars, restaurants and shops. The building is new - there's an elevator, stable internet, good heating etc. The apartment doesn't have the charm of antique Florence, but everything inside works better than fine. Good safe option, recommended!
A lovely and clean place, with some great restaurants nearby, that's a pleasant walk away from the centre. Paola's also a great host!
Paola was so welcoming and her place was great! Best shower I’ve had in over a month of traveling, and most comfortable bed! Wish this place was available our entire stay in Florence!

A must stay if you are wanting a modern, clean, comfortable and very central apartment in Florence.
The bed was very comfortable, great facilities and safe and secure. The apartment is close to some lovely local restaurants and cafes and a supermarket. It is also very central and we were able to walk to all the tourist attractions. Paola was always contactable and was there at the apartment to greet us for a very late arrival.
Highly recommended.
Paola's studio apartment was very clean and within walking distance to many of Florence's main attractions. My daughter and I had a lovely stay!

Paola is a superb host, she provided the most detailed instructions to find the place. She was also very understanding of our check-in time change due to unexpected circumstances, and she acommodated her schedule to welcome us. The flat is cosy with very smart use of space. I loved the blinds make the place as dark as you want when pulling down. Air conditioning was also a highlight in such warm weather. Thanks for a great stay!

Paola’s place is in a lovely neighbourhood in Porta Romano vicinity. The streets leading into attractions such as  Piazza Duomo are lined with great clothing stores, bars and gelato. About a 30min walk. Paola’s place was immaculate and we appreciated thoughtful touches - breakfast, maps/guides to Florence etc. We would love to have stayed longer! Thank you Paola and Simone!
It's very good place to stay, great location and parking, apartment is new and clean! Recommended!
The apartment was clean and had all amenities needed. Location was good with about twenty minutes by foot to the city center. Definitely recommend staying at Paola's apartment.

this wonderful place is surrounded by wonderful restaurants and shops. a bus stop for the 36 or 37 is just a few steps away, and the 11 is a few minute walk. the apartment itself is very cute and neat. There are enough pot to cook breakfast and a good store about 5 minutes down the road.  Highly recommend!

A great place. Super clean and comfortable. If you like walking, you will love it. It is not that far from Ponte Veccio and we found many interesting stores and nice restaurants in between. Paola is great, nice, kind and helpful. Perfect place for a single person or a couple. Getting there toĺand from the train station is super easy, just one bus and it leaves you right in front of the door. I would stay there again without a doubt!
My husband and I enjoyed a lovely few days there! The apartment was just what we needed and perfect walking distance from all the beautiful sites!

Paola’s place is lovely. So clean and organized for a comfortable stay. Very secure. Very easy use of bus system literally right outside your door. Paola gave very simple instructions on how to use the public transportation, too. Super easy!

Paola is a nice host even we didn’t meet each other. But she explained all details how to get into the apartment , also replied on time. Just the location is a little bit far away from downtown, but it’s not problem, Florenz is a small city. Recommend this Studio .

It is a very cosy apartment in which we felt secure from the start. Walkable distance to City Centre but also with a bus stop in front of the house. Paola gave us perfect recommendation which bus to take👍We loved our stay in Florence🥰Thank you Paola ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had a wonderful stay at Giovanna’s place. Cozy centrally located apt with great check in service with Matias who gave us great tips about the city. Highly recommended!

This is a wonderful place; clean, stylish and in an excellent location. Matias made us feel very welcome and was super helpful with cabs and local tips.
Make sure you visit the nearby gardens behind the Villa Bardini (quieter and more interesting than the Boboli) on the way to watching sunset from the monastery above Piazza Michelangelo. We also loved long lunches at Il Maggazino and Al Tranvai (get the beans with shrimps and the gnocchi) - both in Santo Spirito and both packed with locals.

Wow. What an incredible stay in Florence. Giovanna & Matias’ place exceeded our expectations in every way. What a gorgeous apartment in the perfect location - walking distance to everything! We were sad to leave! Can’t recommend enough.
Adorable, clean, and beautiful place to stay. Top floor with a view and a lift as well. The host was  very friendly and attentive. Thank you for all the hospitality!

Great location, within walking distance to sights + restaurants! Communication was prompt, check-in experience was easy, and the space was clean, well-maintained and comfortable. Would highly recommend!

Nice cosy accommondation, 5min away from the Boboli Garden, 7 min to Ponte de Vecchio. Supermarket also closed, a brilliant location to get to know Florence. The accommondation was clean and cosy, well equipped. For a next trip to florence, we would book it again. Thanks!
Wonderful airbnb in the heart of the city. One of my favourite locations I've stayed in Italy - perfect place to explore from and return to. many thanks to the helpful people running this airbnb!

HouseFlo was a wonderful place to stay while in Florence. The view from the windows was beautiful and the location convenient for the things we wanted to do. Oscare met us to give us the keys and spent at least 20 min giving us recommendations on restaurants, Florence specific foods and attractions, shopping and more! He provided a map with all his recommendations which was really helpful.
Great location. Great communication. The host was very helpful and responsive. The elevator was much appreciated after long days of exploring Florence in the heat.

Cesare was prompt, friendly and helpful. The location is right next to the Palazzo Pitti, and easy to walk to from the station. The space is beautiful with lots of character. I had a very enjoyable stay.
Matias was very helpful before, during our stay and after. He was kind enough to book a taxi for us for an early checkout and train connection.

I happened to stay here on an usually hot week in the summer, and the two AC units in this suite were greatly appreciated. The host and his associates were very friendly and helpful with their walkthrough of the condo and recommendations for places to eat, drink, and just chill in the walkable area.
Taxis are able to come to the building entrance but may need to temp park up on the sidewalk while they wait/load.
There are a few grocery stores in easy walking distance with all the things you'll need. The kitchen pantry was stocked with a couple basic essentials like olive oil, balsamico, salt and pepper.
I had a wonderful time staying here on this side of the Arno!
Matias and Caesar did a fantastic job checking us in.  Place was perfect for us.  Thank you for being great hosts.

A beautiful apartment in the heart of Florence.  The space was amazing - very comfortable for two couples to share and plenty of extra room.  You can get to all the sights of Florence in just minutes from this location.

Outstanding property! Great location, beautiful and stylish space that is well appointed and very clean. Located in an excellent location to explore unique areas as well as all of the attractions! We felt as if we had our own amazing apartment in Florence! We loved our stay!
Apartment is really great! It’s perfectly located in cosy neighborhood, but close to the city center. Window view is amazing!

Giuditta's space is excellent. It overlooks a beautiful square that is not too crowded even in tourist season. It's very close to the center of Florence. The apartment itself is very nicely designed with plenty of space. It's in a nice building. Check-in and check-out are very easy, and Giuditta responds very quickly and helpfully to questions. We strongly recommend this place and will definitely stay here again if we come back to Florence.

The apartment is amazing.  Beautiful and very centrally located.  Unfortunately, this very central location makes for somewhat noisy nights.  Also, the Wifi at the apartment never worked for us.  Though the host attempted to contact ISP, and visited the apartment to test, we were never able to connect to the Internet.

Stefano’s place was wonderful. It was right by the Duomo and very conveniently located. Everything was a short walk - Iike really short walk.
Apartment itself was wonderfully decorated and beds were very comfortable. Bathrooms were very nice and clean. We had a little hiccup with the DSL WiFi but Stefano was very helpful and provided us with alternate arrangements immediately. I would recommend stefano’s place to anyone without hesitation. Check in and check our were a breeze and Stefano was excellent in communication.
We used the washing machine too and it worked perfectly.
We were a family of 4 (two boys 15 and 11) and it was very comfortable.
We loved it!!

A fantastic apartment in an amazing location. It was spacious and extremely comfortable. We loved being so close to the Duomo.
Highly recommended.

We had a wonderful stay at stephano’s. The location was exceptional, close to everything. The place was extremely clean, beautiful and very functional. Check in was very easy. Would definitely recommend!

We stayed at Stefano’s place for 4 nights while in Florence. The apartment was located in a great area in the center. We were able to walk to all places to eat and do activities.
Pros
- the apartment is very nice, clean, and maintained very well. We felt comfortable in this place.
- The host left a notebook with WiFi information, recommendations and other important information that was very helpful.
- Good communication from the host. Very responsive and pleasant.
- Located in the perfect location.
No Cons
I would highly recommend this place if you’re visiting Florence!

Excellent location and great space. Communication was really good from the host throughout the check in process too. Stayed with my partner and found that pretty much everything in the city was in walking distance. Oh and the bed was very, very comfy!

Absolutely wonderful place. Prime location if you're interested in feeling like you're in the center of Florence city living! The plaza downstairs is wonderful at all hours for a coffee, meal, ice cream or dinner and the apartment has some of the best people-watching views you could get in that square (which is actually a triangle) :)
Great location. Piazza is a nice place to relax in the evening. A bit loud, but the street noise mostly sounds like white noise.

I really enjoyed my stay in this beautiful apartment, everything was perfect, the location (I really love Oltr'arno - and the Schiacciata-place just at the piazza is just yum!), how the apartment is set up, and Andrea and Giuditta were very welcoming. I'd love to stay there again!

I was traveling alone and had a nice stay at Giuditta’s appartement. It was my second time in Florence so I knew already that the location is great. You can get a delicious cappuccino right around the corner and the best ice cream. The appartement is beautiful and light. Can definitely recommend it.
Perfect apartment- it was very easy to find after a long day of travel and in the best area of Florence. Santo Spirito is perfect, could not have had a better experience

The place met our expectations, very spacious and well-equipped. My family and I had a great time there. The only inconvenience was having to climb four floors with heavy suitcases, which is something to consider if you plan to stay at this accommodation.
Very good place and ubication, the only con I can think of is an nail polish scent every time we arrived at the place.

Mamo’s apt was great. Close to everything. Would stay there again.
Keep in mind, there’s no lift. I don’t read the profile thoroughly. My fault. I traveled too heavy. Very cute loft. Thanks for the stay.

The accommodation was comfortable, located in a central but less touristy area, great location. The owner was helpful and the apartment was spacious and comfortable. The bed was comfortable as well. Would recommend this apartment
Lovely place in the centre of Florence. Loved it here and would recommend to anybody to book this place. Excellent.
The location of this appartment was amazing! A stone throw away from ponte vecchio, palazzo pitti, boboli gardens, and lots of great places to drink & eat. Would highly recommend staying here!

Location perfect, a little noisy at night but ok.
