Stefano is really understanding and answer quickly. Flat is clean.
We loved our stay and will come back for sure !

This is a stunning apartment in an incredible location. There’s a convenient elevator for the luggage. Cosimo was greatly accommodating and helpful. My only heads up is that this is a highly trafficked tourist location and, if you’re a light sleeper, you’ll be listening to people party into the wee hours of the night.
Stefanos apartment is amazing! The location, the cleanness, the price, the apartment itself, everything is perfect. We can highly recommend to go to his place.

Stefano's place was exactly as described, and the location could not be better. Everything we wanted to see in Florence was just a few minutes walk. I cannot recommend it highly enough if you're visiting this historic city.
An incredible apparent literally a few doors from the Duomo. Two great size bed rooms with comfortable beds. Couldn't have been any happier here.

This apartment is perfectly located near the Duomo and the city center. It was just a little walk to the train station and perfectly sat amongst lots of shopping and restaurants. The apartment was clean and Stefano was very good to communicate with. Just be aware that there are many stairs to climb to get to the apartment. There is a lift to use for luggage, which was very helpful.

Best place to stay in Florence! It is walkable to all the major sites and great restaurants. I would 100% come back to stay with Stefano when I return to Florence. Important note, because it is on a major street you may hear some noise at night. It didn't bother us but is good to know in advance.
The apartment is just steps away from the Piazza del Duomo. It is a walkable distance from the train station. The apartment is very nice and spacious. I would definitely recommend it to anyone.

The location of the apartment was absolutely perfect. You are situated on a main road between Palazzo Vecchio and the Duomo. You are easily in the center of everywhere you would want to go. It was nice to go out in the mornings come back for a break and then head out again.
The only thing I would suggest is that if you are a light sleeper, bring some earplugs because the noise from the street does filter in but well worth it with the location.

A wonderful location and perfectly matched the description. Would have liked to have soap in the bathrooms and a bit clearer address location for the place. Overall would highly recommend staying here and the communication was fantastic and very responsive. Thank you!

We enjoyed being in the centre of historical Florence. The suite lacked common staples ie extra toilet paper, dish washer detergent, coffee, paper towel and wash cloth. When we brought this to  the host attention, he only supplied the extra toilet paper and washing machine pods.
This is a great place to stay in Florence. It is within steps of Il Duomo and hundreds of restaurants, shops, museums, etc. The place is spacious and very clean. I highly recommend it!

His place is as the pictures and location is a dream. I agree with some of the reviewers on the noise but with the location, I think it is unavoidable. We had a good stay. My complain is that host can provide little more amenities such as wash detergents. there is a washer but no detergents and very tight on toilet papers and no additional pillow or towels.
Excellent apartment right in the Piazza! So spacious and clean. It was such an amazing find, highly recommend! Host was amazing as well, and very accommodating.
This location was fantastic!  Just a minute from the Duomo, and everything within a short walk.  I would highly recommend this place.

Outstanding apartment with all you need for a glorious stay in Florence. A/C works great. Washer was very handy after 10 days traveling. Nice neighborhood feel while close to the sightseeing core of the city.
Very stylish apartment with all necessities and more. Only regret is we didn't book for a longer stay!
We really loved this place it was sparkling clean and had all amenities included. It was a perfect amount of space for two people. Grazie!
This is a good experience to enjoy this apartment, good location and safety place, quite and nice. The decoration is very good and the mattress is comfortable so the quality of sleep is very well.
Lorenzo's place was very cute, clean, and exactly how it looked in the pictures. It was in the heart of the city and perfect for a trip to florence.

The apartment is a perfect spot for a quick trip to Florence. The neighborhood is convenient to all of the sights, but the street itself is quiet, which we preferred. The kitchen and bathroom are quite modern. Self-check in is incredibly convenient. We had a lovely stay and would certainly recommend to others!
Lovely place in a well located area. The host were great responding really quickly to anything we needed! I highly recommend it.
This air bnb is amazing with 3 air conditioner units which give you a welcome break from the hot florence weather! Well located and very clean!

This place was a great location in Florence.  It was extremely tidy and neat and the hosts were so easy to deal with even though we were English speaking.   It was very close to a few great squares, and a short walk to everything else.   I would recommend this AirBnB to anyone traveling to Florence!

The stay at the scalette was perfect! Lorenzo was always in touch and texted back within 3 minutes in case of a question. Very very helpful and friendly. The location of the apartment was perfect and the interior very tasteful and clean! We felt very much at home! Thank you so much Lorenzo!

We had an excellent stay for our overnight in Florence. Beautiful place, central and quiet. Lorenzo was very reactive and helpful when we had a question. The flat was immaculate and is tastefully decorated, with everything needed. We enjoyed the automatic heating in the bathroom: it was warm when we woke up, a nice feeling for a november morning!
This place was amazing! Great location and design. The flat was spacious and well equipped. Lorenzo was always available to help us. Very Italian and trendy flat.
We had a great stay at Lorenzo & Paola’s place. Everything was clean and we had all the amenities we needed. The flat is in a great location and we’d definitely stay here again.

It was a perfect sanctuary for a quiet month - during which I had to spend most weekdays working from home. It is light, calm, and quiet. Very handily located for good food market (San Ambrogio), and just far enough away from historic centre to feel lived in.  It was notably brighter for being on one of the 'new' streets rather than medieval. Nearby Piazza Azeglio a great amenity as a relatively rare bit of greenery in central Florence. You are staying in a familly's apartment rather than in a commercial let: the personal touch was evident and appealing compared to many 'professionally' run / commercially operated properties. Hosts very accommodating and personable.

Great accommodation, stylish but also very comfortable, feels like home. Close to the historic city centre, allowing to navigate easily between the Duomo to the west, the river bank area to the south and the restaurants and food market area closeby to the east. Communication with the owners was perfect, clear and comprehensive instructions, quick & helpful responses, made me feel like I was taken good care of ;)

This is a very nice listing with nice amenities (especially the AC in the hot summer) and the location is also great as it is close enough to the tourist centre yet far away from the noise. Since the loft is on the top floor of an apartment building with no elevator, be prepared to be sportive with the stairs.

La Scalette was a great experience we felt very comfy here, it has been refurbished recently and it is very well eqquiped (air conditioning, netflix, amazon prime etc).
The restaurants they recommanded were very good (specially largo 9 for the pizza).
This was an absolutely lovely flat. Plenty of space to spread out and an excellent location for all the sights in Florence. The check in and out process was super easy!

Everything was perfect for us. We stayed two and a half weeks and we’re able to discover from this comfortable apartment. Great location, very fast WiFi (we were working and it was no problem at all), fast and easy communication. We would definitely come back and can only recommend the apartment :) thank you! Julia and Jasmin
P.S.: for dog owners: there’s a little park just around the corner with an area where the dogs can play and run.

Great location though just a little far from central Florence. However easy to get around on foot. The apartment is super clean and beautiful and had all the amenities required. Just take note of the 3 floors of stairs to carry your luggage up, might be a challenge if they’re heavy.

Highly recommend- I would definitely stay here again! The hosts had a welcome booklet with recommendations for restaurants close by, check in and out was very simple and easy, clean, felt safe, apartment was very cute and had lots of character - no complaints!
We loved our stay in Florence! The accommodations were the perfect size for four people, and the apartment was walkable to everything in Florence.

A lovely & memorable stay at Le Scalette. It’s the area you want to be in as tourism is picking up again—close to many local, authentic restaurants and some of my favorite markets. It was a lovely return to Florence and I would stay here next time I visit.
My only comment on the apartment is wishing there was more privacy on the windows. There were external shutters but it was unclear whether those were operable, or not.

Really loved my stay at here. The apartment was very clean and in such a perfect location, easy walk to everything you’d want to see in Florence. Lorenzo E Paola we’re even flexible and let us drop off our bags prior to the check in time. Highly recommend!

We were in Florence for four days and had the most beautiful stay here. The apartment was clean, tidy, welcoming and a great base for exploring. It was clear how much thought has gone into making the apartment feel like a home. And the A/C in every room was perfect for the hot weather. I would recommend Lorenzo and Paola’s place to anyone visiting Florence.
We had a great stay here! The location was great, and the street was quiet. The apartment is clean and spacious. We had a wonderful time in Florence!
We loved our stay here!! The place was so clean, spacious, well decorated, and we felt right at home.
Good stay - apartment was in a convenient location, easily walkable to all attractions. We did find the apartment block a little noisy but on the whole we enjoyed our time.

Definitely a great place to stay. A beautiful apartment and easy to stay for a longer period. Bedding was fabulous, bed & pillows super comfy.
Quiet street, just note no lifts & 3 floors of stairs if you have lots of heavy luggage.
Would highly recommend 🙌
Lorenzo and Paola were quick in the response when we had questions for them. The place is in a great walkable location. Easy to get in and to find. We enjoyed staying at their place.
Great apartment in a great area. We loved the closeness to the city center and access to some great restaurants.  We highly recommend!
The place was lovely. Walkable to main tourist attractions. Lorenzo was very responsive. Overall great experience.

This is the perfect apartment for those keen to get the most of their visit to Florence. It is incredibly central, no more than 15 minutes from anywhere in the city and perfectly located with a supermarket and cafe only moments away. The location also means it’s perfect if you want to escape the hustle and bustle and have a break in the afternoon.
Beyond the location it is clean, safe and well appointed. Overall highly recommended!

Centrally located and near many shops and restaurants. We found the place very hard to find at first. We definitely recommend using google maps. There is a small bus that stops in front of the apartment. We wish we knew about that when we arrived. The apartment is about a 14 minute walk from the train station. The apartment is on the 4th floor and it is brutal walking all those steps. The place seemed out dated but people we met on tours described their hotels the same way so it seems that’s just how the area is. If you send a message you do get a speedy response and very helpful.

The apartment is incredibly well located, in the city center near to everything. You can go by walk to the bus or train station. Also cozy and nice, well equipped. Better go with few luggage because it's in a 4th floor.

Her place was amazing the location was perfect:) cozy bed lovely place

Our stay at Silvia’s was great, she was very accommodating even when we came earlier she had a friend waiting there to check us in. The place was bigger than we expected and it was a comfortable and cozy place to stay.

Location of the flat is amazing, right in the historic center so that you can do everything by walking. The apartement is nice and authentic and Silvia is a super friendly host! I can highly recommend this apartement!
Silvia was a great host! She provided great food recommendations which made my days in Firenze very special

beautiful apartment in an amazing location in the heart of Florence. a min away from a grocery shop and many restaurants. the apartment was really clean and cozy. Silvia was a lovely host, sharing recommendations and being extremely accommodating. Will definitely stay here again next time I'm in Florence.
Silvia was a fantastic host with an unbeatable location in the very heart of Florence. Highly recommend this location to anyone interested in seeing all the major locations

Great place to stay! Perfect location and close to just about everything you could want to do in Florence. Plenty of great restaurants nearby. Silvia was very responsive when asked about recommendations as well!

Beautiful glamorous apartment in a gem of a palazzo.  The cafes and restaurants and gelato just outside were welcoming and great places to hang out or meet strangers.   Very close to the sights and high end shopping.   Do know that the acoustics of the square amplify into the apartments open windows.  That said we never had a problem sleeping in the loft.  The service to get into the apartment was perfect.   Loved our stay here.

Our stay was AMAZING! We loved the modern and spacious feel of the loft, and took advantage of the full kitchen during our last night and cooked a 3 course meal that we won't forget. The location was perfect and had a local feel with the buzz of the plaza right outside our windows! We hope to visit again!

Stylish, very light and airy flat in a great location - just around the corner from Ponte Vecchio and overlooking a small square with a couple of nice cafes & restaurants. The place was clean and comfortable, and check-in was fairly easy, with a colleague waiting for us outside the building at the agreed time. On the downside, we weren't provided with the password for the WiFi until the evening before we checked out (after being in the flat for 3 days). The host was apologetic, but it did add a dampener to what was otherwise a really enjoyable stay.
Thank you for the great stay in Florence! We really enjoyed our stay and loved all of the recommendations that you gave us. Until next time!
Absolutely wonderful place to stay! We will be coming back. Perfect location, and in such a neat historic building.  Clean and cute! We loved everything about it!! ❤️
amazing location, walking distance to everything. Silvia is very communicative and the stairs really aren’t that bad
The place is perfect.  Near ponte Vechio and close to Uffizi.  No problems with anything other than the check in. No response from the host and then claimed to have left only to show up 20 mins late.

This is the best looking place we’ve stayed in our trip! There’s plenty of space to lounge around or pack/unpack. The lift was helpful given all our luggages. The location is very convenient as it was steps away from Ponte Vecchio! The bedroom just had a lower ceiling than usual so if you’re tall, you’ll need to bend down a bit. Will definitely stay here again!
You won’t find a place in Florence that has a better location, a better vibe, or a better host. Absolutely worth every penny!

Silvia’s apartment is located in such a fabulous spot - central to absolutely all the major Must see icons of Florence.
Great communication and directions to set us up from the get go!
Thank you so much Silvia 🙏

Silvia’s home was perfect for our short trip to Florence! The apartment was in a great location with lots of restaurants and shops around to explore. We felt very safe and comfortable in this apartment! Would come back again!

Perfect place for a stay in central Florence! Walking distance to main attractions and areas. Silvia is a great host, she is very responsive, accommodating and helpful! Only trouble was getting our heavy suitcases up the stairs in the heat however the property had a great air conditioner which was amazing in the hot weather
I would highly recommend this property

The location of this place was AMAZING! Very close to everything and right in the heart of the city by the Duomo. The inside was cute and charming and everything was comfortable. Silvia was very communicative and made our stay great!
5 stars for everything! Such a lovely property and perfect for traveling in this area. We only we we could have stayed longer. Highly recommend to any future host

We loved staying at Silvia’s place. It is very close to almost everything in the center of Florence. We recommend Caffe Mingo directly in front of the apartment.
She was very responsive and even allowed us to check in early.
The description is accurate, there are lots of stairs, but the view from the apartment was lovely.
We definitely would stay here again.

We had a lovely stay at this apartment, Silvia was very friendly and helpful. The apartment was adorable and accommodating, and had a nice view from the windows. The bed was comfortable, the shower was hot. The location was perfect, right in the middle of everything, very close to all the attractions. We would stay here again.
Great location, close to great food and gelato. Apartment was clean and spacious for two people. Would stay here again.

Lovely accommodation, and GREAT location! We would definitely stay here again! Only think I would like to make the place 15/10 would be air conditioning. It was very warm in the evening and this made it sometimes difficult to sleep fully! But we knew there would no aircon and otherwise it was perfect! Would recommend!

Great stay in a perfect zone to visit the city center. The loft has a beautiful design and it’s been a great place to stay during our long weekend.
Highly recommended
Very nice apartment in excellent location , walking distance to all of the sites. Lovely bars in the square which the apartment overlooks and a great gelato shop.

Fantastic location and the apartment is very spacious - bigger than the photos make it look. Functioning kitchen and washing machine were also helpful. It is worth noting the stairs to the loft are steep (as you can see in the photos) and there is a support beam on the roof above the bed so you need to be careful getting in and out of bed. That aside, I highly recommend staying here
Silvia's space was great. Nicely located and very clean. Silvia was responsive and was a great host. I would highly recommend booking with Silvia if you are in Florence!

Fabulous stay in Florence in Silvia’s beautiful apartment! Location was incredible, so close to the Duomo, shops, great bars and restaurants. Check in was super easy and Silvia was an excellent host - great communication and tips for where to see/where to go. Would definitely recommend.
Amazing airbnb at the heart of the city. The building was once the home of Dante Alighieri. Inside is very comfy and Silvia was really nice host!

Great location, easy to walk and get anywhere! The place is very quaint and cute, giving you the authentic florence life experience:) Enjoyed my time at this place, host is very friendly and helpful too!

Great stay overall with a truly unbeatable location. Right in the heart of Florence with tons of shops, restaurants, and sights nearby. The apartment was clean, the air conditioning was a lifesaver in the summer heat, and check-in/check-out was seamless. Silvia was super friendly, flexible, and quick to respond, which made everything easy.
A few things to note: as mentioned in the listing, there are a lot of stairs to climb and the shower is quite small. The layout of the apartment is a bit quirky, and there was some construction happening outside during our stay—not ideal, but totally outside the host’s control. The building is older, which comes with both charm and oddities.
That said, the location alone makes it worth it, and I’d happily stay again for that reason. I’d recommend it to anyone who’s okay with a few imperfections in exchange for being right in the center of it all.

Central location, close to main piazza and caffès.
Sylvia was friendly and a great communicator . She allowed us late checkout and early access.
Great location but located on 4th floor which might be a challenge for older less agile couples.
Btw for historical buffs it was apparently located in Dante’s family residence.
Everything was perfect in your house.I like your house and Florence very much.Hope i will be back one day！
nice place to live in. you can walk to every place in the city. Matteo is great. He gives us good advice on traveling
Awesome place! Matteo is incredibly helpful and the room is just lovely. Definitely recommend staying here!
People who are planning to stay at Matteo’s can expect the best treatment ever! My cousin and I were very happy with every single detail! We strongly recommend!
Great location to downtown and train station. Room was great and nice to have access to kitchen and two bathrooms in a common area.

The room was beautiful and spacious, although it did get quite warm. Shared bathroom and kitchen were fine and the snacks provided gave it a warm and homely feel. The host was very helpful and kind and we would highly recommend staying here!

This was my first time getting a private room, instead of an entire place, and it was amazing, the room was so stylish and the bed was comfortable. This place is couple minutes away from the bus where you can get to the center! And also it is only 15 minutes walk and you are in the heart of Florence. The host was very helpful he gave me tips and showed me everything on a map, and most importantly he gave me some advice on places to eat and they were amazing. Thank you for everything and will definitely be back here when I’m back in Florence.
I had a really cosy experience for staying at this room. Classic italien decoration. Location is 3 station to the center, I just walk to the appartement every time, really convenient. Thanks!
The room where I lived is far more fantastic than the photos！！Good smell，old furniture，delicious brunch！！And the host is really nice and welcome！！！Highly recommend！！！！

Nice room which was absolutely clean. The bathrooms were cleaned as well every day. The light from the floor is possible to see in the room and a little bit disturbing but not a big problem. In general: good place for a short visit!

Everything you need for a stay in Florence: quick and clear communications, a good looking and clean apartment and a central location, which is easy to reach with public transport and from which you can easily walk to the city highlights
Everything was fine, prompt communication with Matteo who helped us with everything needed. Thanks again, we will return one day!

It was wonderful stay with Matheo. He recommended us huge lots of restaurants and must-do-things in Firenze, and it was helpful . Bedding was clean, two bathrooms were useful with other guests. Great stay!

It was clean, large, and beautiful room.
Marco recommended nice places and restaurants, and it was really helpful!

Very clean and quiet apartment with a really good fan - also nice during summer time. Host is very friendly and helpful and responds quickly. One shares the kitchen and bathroom with others but both were really clean as well.
Great place , great location , just a little bit of noise from the Tram , but very tolerable.

We were very glad to stay at M&B appartement. At first we were a bit nervous to stay there with other people as there is 4 other rooms but we barely met with each other and everything was super clean the whole time ( clean bathroom everyday) and it was really calm place.
10-15min from city center and 7min from train station.
We highly recommend!
Grazie:)
We had a great stay. Highly recommend. super close to train station and right on tramline.

Matteo's place was amazing, the room was really spacious and comfortable. It was a short walk from the station, and the instructions to enter the home were very clear and detailed. The location was really convenient because I could walk to all the attractions by foot.
Although the bathrooms are shared, at least one was available whenever I needed to use it. I also noticed that the bathrooms were cleaned daily, and thus any messes made by other tenants would be cleaned quickly.
Matteo was also really responsive, checking in on arrival times and even providing a great list of local recommendations even before I arrived.
Although the room faces the tram stop and you can hear it in the day, it's not an issue at all when you sleep at night after the services end. With the AC turned on and windows closed, the sound was definitely acceptable.
It's definitely a great place to stay if you do decide to visit Florence!

We stayed for two nights. When we arrived, the building was under construction, we had trouble with the lock procedure, and the shared bathroom felt a bit tired. But the room was cute and clean. We were happy to have a welcome drink and a wide selection of homemade snacks. We also felt that the host was very kind. On the second day, the host washed and hung out our laundry for us. We were a bit worried on the first day, but by the last day, we were glad to have stayed here.  I didn't have any trouble with other people in the common areas. If something happens, you can immediately contact your host via the app, so you don't have to worry about that.

Matteo is a fantastic host. Easy to find from the train station. Check in was simple and we found our apartment right away. Such a beautiful home. Kitchen & bathrooms very clean.
Apartment is accessible to the main town center of Florence.
Thank you so much.
Highly recommended.

This has by far been one of my favorite Airbnb stays we had while in Italy! The location, size of the apartment and comfort it provided while we toured Florence was perfect! Highly recommend staying with Michela and or Stefano.
A great place in a good location. Clean an spacious, and the whole city centre is reachable on foot. Some really cool places with fantastic food nearby. A strong recommendation from me.

Fantastic location. Communication was excellent throughout and Michela went out of her way to help us settle in and enjoy our stay. We were met by Stefano who was really helpful and pointed out best places to eat. The apartment is in a traditional old Florence building, exactly as described with everything we needed. We have a three year old and a buggy, we knew about the stairs but this didn't put us off and would recommend for kids. The location is great, 15 mins walk to all main sites and in a nice area.
Fully recommended and we would definitely stay again.

Michela is a great host. She took the time to see us at the apartment to show us her place and also gave us info about the area. Her place is perfect for families needing space. Beds are comfortable. Her place is much better than the pictures so we were pleasantly surprised. Everything worked perfectly inside the apartment even the washer once we figured out how to use it! Just the wifi was spotty, something that she needs to look into. All in all a great stay at a good central location.
Michela was a good host and she made our trip an amazing stay in Florence. Location was amazing and she was very responsive by email. Would stay here again. The place was great!

Michela's place was perfect for us. It is right in the city center but the bedrooms are very quiet. Fully equipped and clean kitchen and cosy living room. Definitely recommend this place to anybody who wants to visit Florence by foot.

The apartment is fantastic and Michela is a wonderful host! I visited with my sister, mom and aunt, and we had plenty of space to spread out. The place is very clean and is in a great location. Michela was very responsive to all requests and provided great restaurant recommendations. Note that the area outside the apartment can be loud at night, but the bedrooms are in the back so that didn't bother us. This is a great choice for a Florence trip!
A terrific location near Santa Croce, with very comfortable beds and living area.  Well equipped and very helpful advice and restaurant  recommendations.

We had a great time staying at Tea’s place. It is a spacious two bed room flat in the heart of Florence, great amenities and very clean. Tea always responded to our messages very quickly and also helped us to book a Taxi to the train station when we check out.
Great location, beautiful clean place...we highly recommend this airbnb...read the rules to know in advance about the cash cleaning fee...it is a bit steep...but the place is clean and lovely

Convenient, large and well appointed flat In buzzing Santa Croce district, only ten minutes from the Duomo. Michela was a considerate and generous host. The only downside was that the central heating could not be adjusted. It was on all the time which meant it was on all night but sometimes dropped during the evening. We would have preferred to have been able to turn it down at night but have it hotter in the evening.
Michela made us feel right at home for a couple days in Florence! Great location, really great places right on her street.

A great apartment in a brilliant location. Great size for 4 people. Full kitchen is a bonus. The only negatives are the air conditioning and lack of lift in the building. The living area doesn’t have any and it gets very, very hot. The stairs can be a challenge with luggage. Other than that we loved our stay. The location is perfect and has a bus stop right out the front. Thanks Michela.
Great location, on a lively street. Noise is not an issue however as the rooms are at the back. Clean facilities.

Our stay was amazing! We arrived early and Michela was very accommodating allowing us to drop our luggage off early so we could explore Florence. The apartment is in a great location, spacious and clean. Would recommend to all
Great location the host was very friendly she explained everything so well and she responded promptly to my messages,the place is amazing.

Location is perfect! So close to everything. Very spacious, including the kitchen, bathroom and living room. As others have noted, AC is only in the bedrooms. The front common rooms are on the street, and are hotter and louder, but no noise in the back bedrooms. Very good communication as well with the host and her team.

Great space and great location! It’s about a 20 minute walk from the train station and that’s the farthest walk we had. Air conditioners are in the bedrooms only so it can get a little hot in the living spaces but sleeping is comfortable and cool. Overall this place is fantastic and would recommend to anyone! Communication was fast and friendly, book it!
This apartment was perfect for us. It had all of the necessities and was in the perfect location. We would definitely love to stay here again. Michela was a great host and very responsive.

Good location, easily walkable to sights and restaurants in city center.
Nice, clean apartment. Michela was very responsive.
Michela is an amazing host, and her apartment was just perfect. We especially loved the location, right next to key sites but didn’t feel too touristy.

Donna's place was amazing. It is right across the street from one of my favorite restaurants that I experienced in Italy. The location is amazing and the apartment was clean and incredibly comfortable. Everything about our stay was lovely and I will be sure to stay there again when I return to Florence!

The flat it's in a really good location to visit Firenze, almost all the attractions are a short walk away and there are a lot of good restaurants around.
The apartment it's bigger and better than what you can see in the pictures and communication with Donna was always great.

Such a fantastic apartment and the location is perfect. Florence is walkable from the apartment and a short taxi ride to the train station. We were greeted by Donna's son Lapo at the front door. He assisted with move-in flawlessly.
The apartment has a washer and dryer which is very handy when you are in Italy for 12 days, we packed light. A supermarket is right across the bridge, we ate dinner each night at the apartment, which saves quite a bit of money. There were four in our party, me, my wife, daughter and niece. All fit comfortably.
I highly recommend Donna's apartment. The street it is on is a typical picturesque Italian sight. So charming. You can not go wrong staying here and with Donna as your host.
Perfect location, very nice and clean Apartment - so it's ideal for a city trip to Florence. We would definitely stay there again!
Donna is a great host and her place is lovely. It is in a prime location, close to everything! I highly recommend her place to those staying in Florence.

We stayed in florence for 3 nights. Donna’s apartment is perfect, located at the city centre and at a walkable distance to every tourist spots. The apartment is inside a historical building, which is really stylish, clean, and big. Donna and Lapo also helped us to settle the garage and provide a lot of local restaurant tips. I would like to give a big thanks to them. We definitely enjoyed our stays in Florence and her apartment.

Location, house condition, host, style, convenience... this place has it all! You can’t go wrong and Donna is an outstanding host that makes your experience a unique and formidable one. The style of the place is fabulous and is literally steps away from Uffizi. Best street in town and so close to everything.

This was a beautiful place in an absolutely outstanding location within walking distance of major Florence sites and great restaurants.  Donna and her son were also very accommodating in meeting us after our plane arrived three hours late.  We highly recommend Donna and this place!
The apartment is on a lovely street in a perfect location. It was clean and comfortable and more spacious than we anticipated. We would love to return one day!
Wonderful stay in Donna’s beautiful apartment, so central. Donna was such a kind and helpful host

This place is slap bang in the middle of the old part of town. 2 mins walk to Uffizi or Ponte Vecchio. While in the middle its a nice quiet street with some great places to eat. Donna was really helpful in getting us settled and oriented and pointing out the main attractions. The apartment has beautiful light and nice big windows to let the afternoon air in. We had an amazing time here. Highly recommended.

My family of 4 stayed 2 nights. Everything u need  is there. Unobtrusive hosts Donna and Lapo who were just a text away. U cant beat the location and convenience. Pics are as depicted.  Fast wifi. Recommended!

A beautiful place perfect for a couple.  Located right in the City Center next to all the sights. Donna was very helpful and the check in was easy.  We opted for the parking close by (2 min walk) for a reasonable extra cost of 15 euros per day.

We loved this Air bnb!!!
The apartment itself is beautiful! You feel at home immediately, the bed is so comfortable and it has every amenity possible.
Location: It was on a quiet street but close to all the attractions you would want to see while exploring Florence. The restaurants on her street were all AMAZING!
Donna: very responsive, communicative and helpful! Definitely recommend this place !!

Donna’s home is an oasis within the walls of Florence’s Uffizi gallery. When we realized we needed to be in Florence last munute, she kindly made arrangements for us with detailed instructions. Upon entry, we were swept away by the high ceilings, and lovely decor, and every thoughtful detail she has placed in the apartment. We are now sharing this lovely jam with all of our friends whenever they come to Florence we tell them they must stay here! We hope to return soon! Thank you again, Donna!

Donna truly is a good hostess. The  location is great,  and the place was clean. I would stay here again. Everything worked. No surprises. Donna made sure our cab was there to pick us up when we asked. A great value for the money.
Donna’s apartment is incredible. It’s tucked away in the most ideal part of Florence. The location really doesn’t get any better and Donna is the sweetest. 10/10 would stay here again.

This apartment could not be more perfectly positioned to nearly everything you need in Florence!
It is large and well appointed.
A little learning of the heating system was needed but once engaged kept the place cozy.
And be sure to provide advance notice if driving as Host needs to make accommodation with the nearby (about 2 blocks) garage for parking the car.
I highly recommend this lovely apartment for either a short or long stay.
Donna’s place is beautiful and in a perfect location. Check in was easy and I would certainly recommend staying here, I look forward to returning!
Beautiful apartment in a fantastic central location minutes from Uffizi, Ponte Vecchio and piazza del la signoria.  Nice restaurants nearby. Everyone we met were helpful and friendly.

This a lovely apartment in the perfect location.  It really is two minutes walk from everything. The place is well equipped with bedroom and small loft space for extra bed. But it the the living space with dining table and high ceilings  that give the feeling of space. It is a very comfortable  apartment to spend time in. So after walking through the fantastically beautiful  streets you can enjoy restful downtime in a home away from home. Thanks Donna and Lapo!

Perfectly located with attractions and restaurants nearby but at the same time very quiet. Easy check in. Pictures accurately depicted the apartment. Nice and clean. Home feel, private main bedroom with a little extra studio that kids will love to climb in !

Great host and lovely location, near to historical places. The apartment is well equipped including washer/dryer. It’s a second floor unit (for americans) with no elevator, so keep in mind if carrying luggage.

The house is situated at a convenient location which is beside the Uffizi Gallery. The surrounding is peaceful and safe to walk in the night. There are street artists performing as well. Wonderful atmosphere! but please take note of two important points:
1. The house is located on the second floor and there are no elevators. It may not be accessible for those with mobility issues or with large luggages.
2. The second bedroom is a loft space with a small hidden stairways in concealed cabinet. Children should find it interesting.
Last but not least, Donna is a helpful and responsive host. She helped me to get a parking garage and the ZTL permit. She was very accommodating to my requests as well. Wonderful Host!

We had the best stay at the house of secrets! What a charming spot, and perfect location! Donna was the best, easy to communicate with and very helpful. She even called us a taxi for the train. We hope to be back again soon!

This apartment is in a perfect location, right next to the Uffizi gallery on a street that is a little quieter than some others nearby which was nice.  Great restaurants right next door.  The apartment is lovely and has a nice collection of travel books and magazines.  We enjoyed our stay.
Donna’s house was perfectly located right in the middle of everything in Florence. The inside was sparkling clean and very comfortable.

We loved our stay in Donna’s place. She is amazing host. She recommended a lovely sea food restaurant and she assisted us with the parking of the car.The place is tidy and as you see at the pics. She had made our stay relaxing vacation. Tnx dear Donna!

I cannot say enough positive things about this beautiful apartment a block from the Ponte Vecchio Bridge and Piazza della Signoria, but tucked on a small street away from the crowds. The apartment had beautiful high wood ceilings, and a really cool hideaway loft bed near the ceiling (wich my son absolutely loved). The large windows looking over the roadway was one of my favorites, sipping wine andlistening to the opera singer perform.in the street, truly felt like an out of body experience. When it was time to go to the airport Donna even helped us arrange a taxi to the airport which alleviated that stress for us. My entire family was so sad to leave this beautiful apartment, but we will certainly book here again.

such an impressive experience! We were wowed by the place, to be honest. Spacious, clean, comfortable, well-located -- all understatements! Donna was extremely helpful and responsive. This place does not disappoint!

Highly recommend staying here. It has everything you need. The furniture and bed are very comfortable, and everything is of high quality. The location is simply perfect. Right in the middle of all of the tourist sights of Firenze, and tucked away in a beautiful alley (so it's quiet at night). Donna, the host, was very helpful in organising parking for us, and was very responsive to messages.
Highly recommend staying here!
Amazing place in an amazing location - we loved our stay and appreciated how central it was to everything.  We would definitely recommend this as a great place to stay!
Great little flat in an excellent location. It has everything you need for a few days in town. Comfortable beds. Plenty of storage.
Beautiful space, but the location is the difference maker.  Right in the middle of it all.  Perfecto!!!!
Donna was a wonderful host and was very accommodating! She gave a great restaurant recommendation and helped us with advice on transportation! Would love to stay at this location again!

What a great little place in a wonderful old building right in the heart of the city. It had everything you needed from the well equipped kitchen to the comfy beds! Although we could only stay one night we’d definitely recommend it.
Very cool apartment right in the heart of Florence. Step right out into restaurants, shops, and historic sites. Donna was a great host. We would highly recommend!
This stay is a must!!! A few minutes walk to major monuments, cathedral and museums. Beautiful apartment in a beautiful street.

Comfortable and clean apartment in a phenomenal location.  Everything in Florence is at Donna's doorstep! As mentioned in the listing, the historical building is without an elevator, and guests should  be mindful that there are two large flights of stairs before reaching the front door.  Our stay in Florence was wonderful. Thank you Donna.

Perfect location, steps from the Ufizzi and lots of sites. It was very hot our first night and the ac unit didn’t provide much relief. The second night was much better after a day of thunderstorms. Laundry was a nice feature.
Beautiful apartment, extremely convenient to all of the tourist spots! Having a washer and dryer in the middle of our 2 week trip was super convenient!

Everything about this place is perfect!!!  Donna is a great host and very responsive.  Everything is in walking distance and is surrounded by shopping, sites and great restaurants. We will definitely be back.
Everything was exactly as described.  Exceptionally clean.  It also had a very nice modern feel to it.  Would definitely stay again!
Very good. Had a small issue When my key stopped working, but Emmanualle fixed it within minutes. The room looks great, and is quite close to the city.

It's a great place to stay! It's a modern and new accommodation, close and in walking distance to the city Center and the central station. The hosts are really friendly and helpful! We had a great time and I can highly recommend it :)

wifi was not working, but room condition was great.
Breakfast was awesome and cappucino was great.
Everyone was kind.

My wife and I loved our stay at the B&B. It was comfortable, well-located, and the shower was great - which can't be understated after 3 straight days of backpacking. Everyone we interacted with was kind and helpful.
Outstanding hospitality. Walking distance to train station and land marks. I look forward to staying there again.
This place was great. I hate I only stayed one night. It’s got the river right in its backyard. Truly beautiful. And so so clean.

This room is located in a quite and pretty part of the city and very walkable to Florence centers. The breakfast was very generous, arrival, checkout, coming and going and picking up my luggage after checkout was free and easy and well communicated.

My husband and I were pleasantly surprised by how clean, modern, and conveniently located this place is. It is within 10-15 min walking of the historic center and there are many restaurants and shops nearby. It was super easy to check in and out. They also had a wonderful breakfast in the morning. We would definitely stay here again.
This is an amazing spot, highly recommend it! Very clean, spacious and breakfast was delicious!

camille who manages the place responds very quickly and super helpful. i had a private room with smart cards for opening the door and room was very clean. breakfast is simple but good value for money overall. recommend!

This really is a gem! So easy to get to from both the train station & bus station. Only 20 minutes walk to the tourist areas of Florence but situated in a quiet and safe part of the city. This is my second stay here travelling alone en route to Chiusi Della Verna and couldn’t recommend it more. Camilla is great at communicating and is hugely patient as each time I have arrived late due to delays at the airport!
Thank you! I recommend to all! X
Camila was a great host! She gave us plenty of space and facilities to make our own schedule in Florence. We highly recommend the place and we hope to be back soon.
Clean and newly renovated modern place in a classical Florentine corner building in a calm neighborhood with quick access to the Cassine park and the historical town center.

Great place! I only stayed one night but it was the perfect bed/bath for a short term stay. First floor with no windows but it was so clean and modern. Host was so helpful with my last check in/early check out. Highly recommend & I would stay here again

Very nice room in a good location just down from the river, this means it is only a short way from the centre.
Clean, easy to find, lovely staff.

This place was very nice. It is greatly located, we could walk towards all of our points of interest, and the hostess was super nice, replied very fast whenever we had a question, and was overall very attentive.

We had a great stay! Friendly hosts checking us in. You could hear concersations from the corridor but the host provide you with ear plugs (which we did not end up using, it was calm and quiet). Everything work as expected.
Camilla was great at communicating the instructions for a seamless check-in. The apartment is very clean and modern. Comfortable bed and nice shower. Great hosts and great value for this Airbnb.
The place is good for just sleeping! It's a little confusing to find in the beginning but once you're able to locate it, it's nice.

The room was clean and comfortable.
Emanuele , the host was really very kind and easy to communicate with.
.
Emanuel is a great host, the place is clean, the bed was comfortable and in a quiet neighborhood

We had an absolutely lovely stay with Tatiana! Her apartment has everything you need plus a lovely little balcony terrace to have a glass of wine on, the breakfast was DELIGHTFUL and very filling, and Tatiana herself made us feel so at home and welcomed. She was very accommodating to very late/early check in/out times and even gave us some breakfast to go when we had to leave early. She was absolutely lovely and we were sad to leave.
good location,good breakfast,kind host,the only problem is she can not speak English ,you may communicate with translation app or body language.
Good place for short stay near main attractions of Florence. House had good kitchen amenities and breakfast material. Only problem was wifi speed which was below par.
The apartment is very nice and in a great location for visiting all of the sites in central Florence.

An amazing apartment!  A highlight of our travels through Italy.  Very clean, comfortable, lovely beds, beautifully decorated.  So spacious!  The location is wonderful too, right in the middle of everything.  Lovely hosts who are helpful and quick to reply to communications.  We wouldn’t hesitate to stay again - it will be our first choice.  Thank you so much for a fantastic stay!

Luca is a very nice , friendly and quick responded. The tips and advices provided are very helpful to the travelers like us. The apartment is clean and well-equipped,and it’s well located in the city center of Firenze, so that some noises from the street might be the cost to bear for its convenience. The apartment is on second floor and has steep stairs, so traveler with big or heavy luggages should be reminded. Overall, it was still a great pleasure to stay at Luca’s house.

Lucas's apartment is a great place to stay in Florence. It couldn't possibly be better located than what it is, at the great of Florence only a few steps away from Ponte Vecchio. It is very nice thar the apartment is all for yourself without other apartments on the building, so it gives a nice, secluded retreat style still being in the heart of Florence.
We enjoyed our stay immensely. The apartment is in a great location and we were able to walk everywhere.  Luca  was easily reachable for any questions or concerns.
Amazing location, beautiful apartment and very confortable beds. Luca is really helpful and available. We had a great stay !
Wonderful place! Beautiful interior - excellent location. Luca was a perfect host! Would absolutely stay here again!

This apartment was absolutely adorable and in the most perfect location! Close to absolutely everything you want to go to. Lots of street performances right in the square by us. My only thing was I got a little hot in the back room because the air conditioners are in living room and by the kitchen hall way but I get hot easily so no one else had any issues. Beds were comfortable but on the harder side.
Great Location.  Ample space.  Great restaurant recommendations from Luca.  Also really nice restaurant right across the street.
An amazing apartment, perfectly located. We loved the high, wooden ceilings! Luca gave us amazing food recommendations and we loved our stay. Definitely recommend!

The apartment is very well situated with many attractions, good restaurants and cafes at walking distance! Luca was very responsive to all our requests! We shall definitely recommend the apartment to friends and family when they visit Florence!
Very friendly and responsive. The location is perfect! He gave met us at the apartment and gave us recommendations. We would stay there again!

We had a great stay at Luca’s accommodation. It is very well situated and central in Firenze. Good restaurants around and in the central of the shopping district.  Think Fendi, Rolex etc.   Most sights are only about 800-900m walk.  The unit was very clean and well presented when we arrived.  Everything was clearly explained.  This was a great find overall.  The airconditioning was bliss! ( it was >36deg outside)

Luca’s place was great. Excellent and tired and location, especially the AC. His restaurant recommendations were also helpful and exactly what we were looking for. Would definitely recommend and rent from him again.

Luca's place is in a pretty great location. Close to the Ponte Vecchio, Uffizi and the pitti palace is just across the bridge. Not a far walk from most sights within the  old city. There are some great resturants right down the street. Ristorante Nella has amazing lasagna!  The flat itself is nicely layed out and has 2 nice sized bedrooms and a roomy bathroom that has a washer too. The kitchen is nicely updated with a dishwasher. It looks like the pictures!  Luca is very helpful and available and has some great recommendations . You probably want to close your windows in the evening because they do have mosquitos in Florence. There are quite a few cars that go down the street so stay aware.
The apartment is in a fantastic location, close to all the major sights.  The hosts were very welcoming and communicative.
This was a wonderful, very convenient location. Luca was helpful and responsive. The space had everything we needed.

The apartment is in a great location. The beds are not comfortable and it was very hot in the apartment. Florence was experiencing very high temperatures, and the apartment was not cool at night.
Luca provided good directions and suggestions. Location convenient to everything. Very clean.

Right in the heart of Florence, and a short walk to everything. It was very easy to navigate and get away from the crowds when you needed to. A little oasis of quiet and rest with relaxing and large spaces. Luca was generous and responsive to all our needs - a real delight to deal with. We would love to return!!

Luca is a great host and his place is awesome! The space is clean and in a prime location. He was very responsive. The shower drain was not working properly and he solved the problem right away, sending his assistant over to help. The check-in was flexible. Would definitely stay here again. Thanks Luca!

What an amazing find. Centrally located with everything you could possibly need. Made our trip with a 5 year old stress free.
The apartment is right in the centre of the town close to all the sights. Street entertainment close by, as well as great restaurants.
Luca was amazing, dealing with our delayed flights without issue. And was great we could leave our bags until lunchtime while we finished our shopping.
Thanks for an amazing time.

The Novella House was a wonderful place to stay while visiting Florence! The location was fantastic as it was close to everything-shopping, eating, tourist attractions and of course drinks!! Thank you for the great hospitality!!
Alex was helpful.  We contacted him to request for toilet paper and soap. They didn't have napkin (paper towels) in the kitchen.  The location is convenient but very noisy during night time

Very convenient location. Crowded area while we were there, but it was so nice to step right out near Ponte Vecchio. Spacious for our family of four and nice to have two bathrooms. Loved Gino’s Bakery around the corner.

Beautiful apartment in fantastic location. Photos true to actual place. It was clean with comfortable beds & good linens. Alex offered a fast, clean, and efficient check-in, and communication with host was excellent.  Thanks for a wonderful stay and I will be back :)
Fantastic all round. Clean, tidy, comfortable beds and good shower. Plus great location without being noisy.
Excellent location - just minutes walk from all the major sites. Loads of restaurants and cafes right at your doorstep. The rooms were huge and beautiful.
This place was really comfortable for our family of 5 people. Amenities are nearby and you can walk everywhere. Our hosts communicated clearly and gave us great recommendations. 10/10 experience.
Amazing stay even just for a night!I wished I had more time!It has hotel standards, perfect housekeeping and checking in. Location is the best in Florence. Thank you and will surely return again!

What a beautiful family this is and what a great house they have! Although I haven't met Alexandra, she was extremely quick in answering my questions and both her husband, Simone, and their lovely daughter, Emma, made me feel at home straight away! Oh, and I forgot their sweet dog, Buia. I will certainly repeat the experience next time I visit incredible Florence!

I stayed at Alexandra's place for 2 nights. Although I haven't have the chance to meet Alexandra, the communication is very good. Her daughter, Emma is so sweet, friendly & helpful. The room is cute and the house is beautiful. Buia, the little dog is so cute.
Thank you :)

Alexandra was the best. The room was perfect for me traveling solo, also her house was near (2 min walking) to bus stops and to a good place to have breakfast called Dolci Pensieri. Everything was very clean and comfortable. I definitely would stay there again if I return to Firenze.
Alexandra is very nice, I felt at home. The house is very nice, a very good option.

Alexander’s room was perfect. I slept so well the two nights I was there. Silence as well.
I loved the colours and the ambiance. Everything was for me perfect.
Even providing the little mosquito machine just in case.
I have stayed twice at Alexandra's place and have enjoyed their hospitality. The room is cosy, clean and welcoming. Highly recommended! The neighbourhood is very nice, too.

Perfect location for me and how I enjoyed exploring Firenze. Easy to walk everywhere and the lovely coffee shop at the corner was perfect for breakfast. Sadly I got completely bitten by mosquitos after a great 1st night.
Alexandra was a great host, 5 minutes walk to a 5 minute train to city centre. Lovely and peaceful neighbourhood
Alexandra and her husband have been extremely nice and friendly. They are a wonderful host and I definitely will recommend staying at their place. Thank you very much!
The room is nice, clean and cozy, and the host and her families are very considerate, makes it feels like home during my stay☺️✨
Filippo and his father were great hosts and the home is located in a beautiful part of Tuscany.

Such a lovely place, very Tuscan, we were made to feel very welcome! Lovely homemade wine was a very nice touch. Unbelievably close to Florence, we were at Porta Romana to park the car in 10mins, yet while you’re there you feel you are in the middle of nowhere - a must for families or couples looking for peace and quiet. The house has everything you need and more, thanks Phillipo, wish we had stayed longer!
This place is great if you like a spacious place where you can relax and cook and enjoy the Italian life. The host is very nice and welcoming.

A really lovely, traditional house with stunning views. We loved our stay and were well looked after. From wine as welcome gift to a couple of eggs from the chicken which our daughter got to a lot of excellent recommendations from Filippo - we had an amazing time staying and exploring the area.
A truly wonderful old farm house. I wish I had booked for a longer stay. Everything was perfect. I would highly recommend to anyone staying in the area.
Super nice place, surrounded by nature and yet close to the city. Filippo is extremely friendly and helpful. 100% recommended.

We stayed at Filippo’s for 4 nights this spring and it was great! Filippo’s father welcomed us and was really helpful during the entire stay. The location was beautiful and peaceful, yet still very close to Florence so that you can get there quickly.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking to visit Florence!
Antonio was extremely helpful and welcoming. I spent the time there with my 3 kids and they had a great time. Florence easily accessible, and this rustic cabin was the perfect choice for our family.
This place is peaceful and amazing. The family is beautiful and very kind and friendly. Can not wait to stay here again!
Me and my family of four enjoyed our stay in this beautiful Tuscan home full of character both inside and outside.
We had an amazing stay. The host is so warm and welcoming. I highly recommend it for the true authentic Tuscan experience!
The privacy, peace and security was perfect! We felt right at home and will definitely be back again and again! The host could not have done a better job. The family are great people.
Great stay in the beautiful countryside close to Florence. Filippo and his dad Antonio were amazing hosts, and Antonio even took us to town when our rental car failed. Thanks!!

Fantastic location, with a huge apartment. The host that welcomed us was very good, even called us when we yet to arrive. Patiently explained the keys, amenities in the house , local tips.
Defintely will stay here again !

This apartment is perfect. It is close to all the sights, museums, shops and restaurants, especially Mercato Centrale. The pictures are accurate. Davide met us as planned and gave us a run through as well as recommendations for restaurants and sightseeing. The place is clean and spacious. It was better than any hotel. Thank you!
If you're looking for convenience and great location with a helpful host, then this is a very good option.
This apartment was amazing. Had enough space that we were not on top of each other and within a few minutes walk of most of the big attractions in Florence.
nice apartment in a good location but very loud! i would not recommend you coming here if you are a light sleepwe
Great location, but can get quite loud at night from the street, recently renovated and nice interior design, overall great for a city trip
One of the best experiences I've had in AIRBNB. Everything was perfect. Location was perfect, house was very clean, cozy apartment, amazing communication woth host. 10/10

We were very happy with the location and our stay. The place looks like the photos. Comfortable bed. Close walk to everything you’d want to see if you’re on a quick trip through Florence.
The check in was easy. We recommend and would stay here again.
If you are a light sleeper, you should bring earplugs because the bedroom is on the street side, so you’ll hear everything going on out there.

Very nice apartment, perfectly located to walk to all the main touristic places. A lot of restaurants nearby. Very spacious, modern and had everything we needed.
The only thing that was a bit unfortunate was that during the night it was loud due to drunk people shouting in the street.
Other than that, we had a very pleasant stay.
Wonderful host, fabulous location. The suite was comfortable and just what we needed for a two night stay. Unfortunately we couldn’t get the wifi to work but other than that, the place was amazing.

We loved it here! The location was perfect and walkable to all the tourist attractions. The AC was amazing to cool off after a hot day. The bed was comfortable and we felt very safe there with many locked doors! The host was very welcoming. Would definitely recommend!
Best place to stay in Florence , very clean, easy to get there, location cannot be better , bar downstairs great for morning coffee and very quiet at night to sleep

Great location!
Great apartment!
Loved it!
I would stay here if I come back to Florence!
Right next to Medici Capelle and next to the Florence Doumo!
You will never regret!
Great location with everything in walking distance. The place was nice and secure and exceeded our expectations. Would recommend to others! 😊

Even better than the photos and super spacious! We loved staying here and being able to walk to everything in the city. Super easy to get to from the train station. Greeted by our host and gave us a tour with instructions on how to use everything in the apartment. Highly recommend!

Good and comfortable place room.. near the bus stops to reach city centre ( 2 mins walk ).. it would take about 20 mins ( by bus ) to reach the centre...
Bed is a little woody and uncomfortable to sleep .. they have a nice spread of breakfast with yummy jams and tea..
Small miscommunication in the bus direction to reach the place made it little difficult to reach , but host kept in touch with us and helped us reach..
Everything apart , good place to stay and worth the price..

The room was very comfortable and very beautiful. Andrea & Francesca let us arrive before the check in time, thanks a lot for that! The bathroom was also nice and everything was very clean. There is an office in the next room, however after work hours the whole space (including dining space, bedroom and toilet) become completely private for guest, which is great!
The only downside is the location (a little far away from the city centre), but there are many bus lines nearby so you can travel to the city centre and around the city very easily.
I really recommend this place!
Our time in Francesca’s house was totally amazing! Everything was very nice and clean, good bedroom and shower. We really recomend it!

We enjoyed our stay in Florence very much. The location of the apartment was perfect and we were able to get to most of our scheduled destinations with enjoyable walks and there are so many wonderful restaurants and shopping right at the doorstep! The view of the Duomo at night from the bedroom window is spectacular.
One thing to note; there are several flights of steep stairs to the apartment, so that was a bit of a struggle with our luggage. But, this was expected as it was explained in the description, and I am guessing the situation for most of the buildings in this ancient area.

Beautiful flat a stones throw away from the Duomo. Perfect for a long weekend in the city. All the amenities were exactly what we needed and we felt really comfortable staying there.
A lot of the reviews commented on the stairs so we were a bit concerned but if you can climb 4 floors you’ll be fine - and it’s worth it for the view! Hopefully we will be back in the near future!

They aren't kidding when they say the views of the Duomo are outstanding!! Two of the rooms and the main bathroom have just marvelous views and the lounge area has another lovely view to the other side of the city. The location is excellent!! Close to so much!! It is worth noting again that the apartment is on the fourth floor of a very old building...it is close to 70 steps up eight flights. Pack very light!!:) Also, it would be a trial to stay here with young children or anyone with mobility issues of any kind. That's just a basic fact and should be considered. But if you are fit and energetic, the stairs just become part of your daily workout:) Communication was excellent! Francesca, who checked us in, could not have been more lovely! Had a wonderful time!!

Wow what a property, great location, lovely spacious apartment with spectacular views, very clean, only slight downside is the stairs which weren’t an issue for us but worth being aware of for less able people. Would definitely recommend and we will be booking again for our next stay in Florence
Great location in Florence! A minutes walk from the Ufizzi, Accademia, and of course the Duomo. We had a great stay!

We were very satisfied with the accommodations at Elena's place for our recent visit to Florence.  The view of the Duomo was fantastic from windows in apartment and having A/C was a big help with the heat.  The rooms were very comfortable and we all had plenty of space.   Neighborhood very easy to walk and felt very safe.  Plenty of restaurants and shops within short walking distance.  Any messages sent were quickly responded to which was very nice so we could get needed info quickly.  We will definitely look into staying here again for future trips to Florence.  Highly recommend it.

Although we knew it was close to almost every place we wanted to see around the centro storico, the view from the bedrooms was quite a pleasant surprise. It is located just behind the Oblate and within a walkable distance from SMN. The apartment was clean, well-decorated and had all the amenities we needed. The communication with the host was easy and fast. Totally would recommend staying there.
the house is super cozy and well located. they answered us quickly and the check in was super organized! we had a great time there :)
Great location with accurate pics. The Mamo team was very responsive with messages. The only complaint was the internet in the room. It was intermittent & there fore difficult for working and such.
Perfect location. Small but nicely done. Shame the second bedroom en-suite is just a (not very useful) bath rather than a shower.

We stayed at Elisabetta's place for 2 weeks. The surrounding was spectacular, we made lot's of walk around, to the historic center it was just 40 minuts walk. The apartment was clean and interesting. Just one surprise for us - one neighbour who knocked at our door twice - one to told us we can not leave umbrella outside the main door, and second time was wrong something with ring bell ( we guess ).

Elisabetta's flat is very well located in a very quiet location.  It is appointed in a charming way.  The bus stop for travel to the center of the city is very close by. A large super market is located down the main avenue in a 15 minute walk with bus stop across the street.  We would choose this location again on any return trip to Florenz.
They were very kind and quickly responsive. Nearby, the pizza restaurant is the best place in Florence! The house was incredibly cozy and quiet; we woke every morning to the sound of birds.

Great location, beautiful apartment.  The images are spot on, modern, spacious and clean.  Short walk to the local supermarket and about 15min walk to all the sight seeing spots in Florence. We walked everywhere with 3 young kids and it was perfect.  We were close enough to go home for lunch and a rest before heading out again in the afternoon for more sightseeing.
Amazing apartment. Super clean and stylish in a fabulous building. Not far from the city centre but far enough away from the crowds of tourists. Super clean and amazing amenities. 100% recommend.
The home is beautiful. Super clean with a great view. The house was nice and clean. They had everything there if you forgot something. Even provided us with restaurants! Great place to stay!
Nice apartment with good neighborhood restaurants within walking distance. Bus access is good. Nice and clean and apartment. Lots of stairs so plan accordingly. Thanks for a nice stay.

We enjoyed our stay in Florence. This apartment is beautifully decorated and has everything you need for a wonderful stay in Florence. The owners have gone above and beyond to ensure that the apartment is comfortable. Our children loved having their own bathroom, the terrace and the ice and water machine (fridge). We parked our car (medium sized) onsite and while it was tight, we appreciated the onsite, free parking option in such a busy city. There are some great cafes and patisseries nearby. The city is a 10-15 minute walk (with children) and this was the only slight downside as they grew tired of walking (a general complaint when exploring a big city). Thank you for a wonderful stay.

Very nice appartement, stylish and very comfortable. We loved eating or having drinks on the balcony. Although it was very hot in Florence during our stay, the A/C kept us cool. The parking was convenient, the location is close enough to the main sites to walk. Supermarket is 10 mins walk away. Hosts communicated frequently with us and checking in was easy.

The casa Elena was well decorated as it is described in reservation info. It is spacious and clean.  All the necessary facilities are well  equipped. It was easy to go by walk to main well known sights such as cupola dome. The best thing on this house is that it has a private parking space for travelers using cars. However the space is not good enough for 7 seated car. I would definitely recommend this house.

We had a great stay at Lucia’s apartment. It was very spacious and light. We absolutely loved hanging out on the roof top terrace with amazing views of Florence. We really appreciated how helpful Lucia and her son were on check in and during our stay. We recommend.

Best airbnb I ever stayed in!! The apartment is gorgeous and the balcony gives you a great view of Florence! I was in a group of 5 and it was perfect! Wish I could give more than 5 stars! I would love to come back and will definitely recommend to friends :)
Beautiful home. Large space. Amazing view from balcony. Easy check in. Lucia was very helpful and friendly. Would definitely stay here again!
Lucia's son greeted us right when we arrived, and the apartment was great for all 4 of us, with A/C in each room. There's plenty of buses to go to the city center as well.
Outstanding host, they make you feel more like family than a guest. Thank you Lucia for everything and making our stay in Florence special.

Wow - the view from the rooftop was amazing - the hills of Tuscany, the Duomo lit up at night - just beautiful.  This was the perfect house for our group - with the loft for the teens. Everything was clean and it even had a washing machine so we could do our laundry.  Thank you for a wonderful stay!
Fantastic hostess.  The place was perfect for our family.  We thoroughly enjoyed all the amenities.
One of the best Airbnb experiences! Sparkling cleaning apartment,great location,super cozy and friendly staying! I would stay there for sure again! I recommend it if you wanna visit Florence!

Really nice apartment in Florence. Everything in top shape! Lots of interesting art and decorations. We had great family fun talking about the different pieces. Nice and well equipped kitchen. Great terrace with view of the Tuscan hills. Private parking it awesome, though we just left the car there and walked. Easy access was appreciated as driving in Florence is for the brave! Walking distance to city centre (15 min). Helpful check in from IStay. The place is amazingly clean - as in 100% perfect!
Amazing apartment near everything!  We loved the artwork and enjoyed the terrace.  The host was perfect and helpful!  Would highly recommend for anyone visiting Florence!

Excellent option for my family's experience in Firenze. The apartment is very nice, comfortable and clean. I feel like at home!
The communication went very well, so I really recommend it!
Thank you for having us!
See you in our next visit to Firenze!

The apartment was spacious and roomy for the two of us.  The view was great, you could see the mountains that are north of the city.    The bathrooms were large enough and the showers were hot.  Plenty of room to relax after a day of being a tourist.
Very clean apartment, lovely host. Very communicative and flexible with check-in and check-out times. Apartment was lovely and roomy. Felt at home immediately!

What a nice apartment! Perfect location for us to discover the amazing sight s of Florence by foot. Check-In worked well and communication with our host was very easy. Would be glad to return at any time! Thank you!

We loved this space and the eclectic art and home decor! We met the owners at check-in and they were so sweet and accommodating. We were very surprised at the size of the home and had so much more space than other metro homes around the area. Highly recommend!

Lucia's place is an amazing apartment that's complete with everything you need for a comfortable stay.
We didn't pack light so had to endure going 4 floors up by stairs, but we went in knowing this. We were lucky that her son was there and helped out even though he didn't have to.
Thank you once more asbit added to a wonderful experience in Firenze.

My family of four had such an amazing stay at Lucia’s! It was so spacious and clean, and the rooftop was beautiful. You can hear the trains go by, but the sounds will muffle with all the windows closed. There are quiet a bit of steps to get up since there is no elevator, but it wasn’t a problem with us. The host was very helpful and accommodating. Definitely would recommend!

Really great apartment with a lovely decor! Well located and close to many transfer options.
The hosts were super kind too!

This home was absolutely perfect for us. It is in a quiet neighborhood right next to the tram that can quickly and easily take you all over town. Lucia was amazing and made our stay feel extra special. The view from the rooftop terrace is unforgettable and I cannot recommend this place more.

Lucia was very accommodating with our check in. Be aware there are 65 steps to get up to the apartment so keep that in mind if you are not physically able. It was worth the steps to see the beautiful view on the terrace with 360° views of the duomo and sunset. The train station next door is a little loud but it Felt very homey and was nice to be off the beaten path. This was just a quick tram ride away from the city center.

We had a fantastic time staying at Lucia’s place. The train is right next to the apartment, but if windows are shut you can’t really hear it at all. Otherwise, very close to train station to head downtown, as well as to/from airport.

We had a fantastic stay at Lucia’s place. It was close enough to walk anywhere we needed in Florence and was accessible with a car with parking nearby. The balcony was great for an hour venting aperitif and view of the city and the space comfortably fit the four of us. Would definitely stay again.
Location is directly opposite the trains and is very noisy at night. The apartment needs to be updated, painted and cleared.
A very nice place and super friendly hosts. Nice to have a roof terrace. Close to the trains which made it a bit noisy. Overall a great place to stay in Florence!

Ivano was an amazing host, greeting us upon arrival. The bottle of wine for us was a great touch.
The apartment is in a great location on the north side of Florence, easy routes to trains and trams. The rooftop area is amazing for looking out across Florence. Beds were very comfortable and all the essentials you need for a relaxing stay were provided.
Would recommend to anyone looking to visit Florence.

The apartment is in a perfect location next to all the major sites, easy walking distance to train station and everywhere else. Carlotta (she and Claudia checked us in) gave us great extra information and is an excellent source for anything you need. I highly recommend this 2bd place (its as nice as the pictures!) and would love to stay here again the next time in Florence

Beautiful apartment in the heart of Florence... exactly as described and better than appears in photos. We were staying in Italy over two weeks and this was the best sleep we had on very comfortable beds and quiet location.
Neighborhood charming and many good trattorias and ristorante nearby that were suggested by Claudia upon our arrival.
Thank you Luca and Mary for the delicious homemade preserves

Anyone interested in visiting Florence and looking for a great place to stay...look no further!  This apartment is in a great location, close to EVERYTHING!  The taxi station is only 100 feet away which makes getting from to the train station to the apartment (and vice versa) so easy!  The neighborhood is amazing from the Santa Croce Church to restraunts and shops.  The apartment is extremely clean and Luca & Mery were very responsive along with the hosts (Claudia and Carlotta).  I'm so happy I reserved this apartment and will be going back in the next six months!  Book it!  You will not be sorry.

Lovely apartment in a cozy and quieter location. Sparkling clean and spacious.
