Claudia was very accommodating to allow us to drop bags prior to check-in. Beds were super comfortable and we were given excellent local restaurant recommendations. Grazie!
We had a wonderful stay here! It’s a great apartment in a good location. I would recommend!

We chose this apartment because of its location and its unique style. However, we were pleasantly surprised that it was exceeding our expectations in many ways. From the first time we came into the apartment, we were greeted warmly by Laura, our host. She explained everything thoroughly and answered our questions in details. She even gave us maps and recommendations for nearby restaurants, supermarkets, landmarks and shops. She was very quick in replying our message and very helpful. The apartment itself was very comfortable. It was squeaky clean and had everything that you need. Last but not least, it always smells good! We will not hesitate to recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to visit florence.

The apartment is in a perfect location. Super close to everything. Inside, it has amazing frescoes on the ceilings and some very cool art. If you arrive by train - the place is about a 10 min walk from Florence Train Station and you can easily make that walk. Don't get a taxi - you'll walk by El Duomo and many other priceless arts on your way. The five of us (myself, spouse, and three kids 12, 10, and 8), rolled 5 bags with 5 backpacks and it was great. The apartment is on the 2nd floor, so you'll have to walk some stairs, but it's an advantage - you barely hear any tourist noises up there. The place was quiet. We all slept great. The hosts are very responsive. Claudia met us in the apartment when we checked in, showed us everything, and gave a few local tips. Highly recommend this place.

Luca and Mery's apartment was absolutely wonderful! The location, near Santa Croce, was perfectly situated to see all the important parts of Florence by foot. The apartment itself was very special and unique, with the beautiful frescos and lighting. Would definitely stay here again.
Luca & Mery's place is beautiful and located in a perfect area to explore entire city. We really enjoyed staying at this place.

What a beautiful apartment right in the heart of Florence. We really enjoyed staying here as the apartment was spacious, very clean and the amenities were fabulous. Really loved the Nespresso machine and the beautiful gift of a local jam.

Luca & Mary’s place is amazing. Close to everything, very clean and comfortable.  We walked everywhere  the apartment is quite large with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a large kitchen and living area. You won’t be disappointed if you stay here.

Roberto gave us the warmest welcome with food and wine for us as we arrived late in the evening.
Location is fantastic and the apartment was comfortable.
Wonderful stay in Florence. Great location close to the center of everything but just across the bridge of Ponte Vecchio so away from the hustle and bustle. Would stay again!

Lovely quiet and warm (in February) apartment in an excellent location close to the main things to see in Florence. Spotlessly clean with good facilities and a friendly, responsive host. Would highly recommend.

This was a great spot. The apartment is bright, clean  and spacious with lovely details like wood beamed ceilings and a well equipped kitchen. The location is excellent- away from the tourist crowds but easy access to everything. A couple of lovely parks right up the street. Roberto is a fantastic host - warm, kind,  communicative, and helpful. A terrific value.
It was the perfect location. It had all the old world charm we were looking for. And an extremely kind and helpful host and hostess. I would recommend this place to anyone.

What can I say? Roberto’s place was perfect in every way. First of all, it’s beautiful. But it also offered lots of space for our family of 5 (three teenagers), 2 bathrooms and an amazing kitchen. There are two little courtyards you can sit and read or have breakfast. The two bathrooms are a big plus with older kids. There is a washer which I appreciated and fans to keep us cool. The location is unbeatable in the center of beautiful Florence, literally a 3 min walk from Ponte Vecchio. Lots of stores, restaurants and places to get good coffee and ice-cream. A well stocked grocery store is 3 min away (on foot). I arranged multiple day parking before arrival at Garage Lungarno, which is a 5 min walk from the apartment. Roberto was super nice and very helpful and answered my many questions quickly all the time. Definitely recommend.

The apartment exceeded our expectations, when we arrived the apartment was way bigger than we thought :) so clean and spacious and so well equips. The hosts made the apartment so welcoming with lovely touches (such as wine and sweets) and gave us a tour on arrival so we knew where everything is!
5 mins walk from the Ponte Vecchio bridge , so ideal location and close to all shopping/supermarket. Loved our stay and would 100% come back again. Thank You.

We loved staying at Roberto and  Giovanna’s place on our first visit to Firenze. The place is exactly like the photos, very spacious and clean. Great neighborhood, super quiet and very walkable.  Thank you Roberto and Giovanna!
Stayed here with our two kids. Everything was great and comfortable. Pretty apartment and nicely decorated. Great city location and Luca was responsive and very helpful. Would absolutely stay again.

Big, bright, clean apartment with all the amenities needed. The apartment is extremely close to all of the major sights (nothing is more than 1km away) which made walking everywhere easy. There are also plenty of shops and great restaurants close by. We had an amazing time in Florence, thank you!!

Great hosts, great location and wonderful apartment. Exactly as advertised. The location proved to be even better than we expected. The apartment was spacious, stylish and perfectly located. We would definitely book this again.
Wonderful place. Roberto and Giovanna were incredibly helpful and amazing hosts. The location was perfect! Would definitely come back.

Three of us stayed here for 3 nights and we LOVED it! The initial drive was a little intimidating as the taxi driver kept going uphill, but turned out it was fine. There are stairs nearby that cut through and it was alright. The local restaurants on this side of the Arno were plentiful and tasty, the bars were fun and we felt so much less crowded over there. Just perfect! We could walk to the uffizi in maybe 5 mins., or probably less.
The host was so helpful too trying to call us a cab. I was having challenges since I don’t speak Italian and although the cabs didn’t work out, he was quick to help and call and set up one for us.
We were greeted upon arrival and shown around.
Really all of us slept well when we were there and rooms could be very dark if we wanted that.
Anyway I’d highly recommend!

A great stay. The apartment was spotless, well located and aircon worked v well.
Thank you Luca
It was in a great location and the rooms were plenty big. The property was clean and we enjoyed our stay there.
We had a wonderful time in Florence staying at Luca's place.  The apartment was clean and had plenty of room for our family of 5 to spread out.

Lovely, spacious, modern, clean and well appointed apartment in an awesome location, right in the center of all important sites, restaurants, shopping....Luca was a great host, extremely helpful and very prompt with replies to requests. We were warmly greeted by Luca's assistant who provided us with a map of Florence with handwritten tips and suggestions that were very helpful. Our stay was enjoyable and we wouldn't hesitate to stay there again.
Excellent apartment located seconds from food, shops, history and more in Florence. Everything you could need or want is seconds from the doorstep.
Luca is very professional and he was extremely helpful, as well. He gave us a map and made several suggestions that made our first trip to Florence a blast!
Luca is a great host. He gave us great suggestions for restaurants and things to do. The place is just perfect.

Luca made us very welcome and we followed his suggestions for places to see and eat. All good advice.
The apartment is lovely with the most comfortable beds and good amenities.
The location is perfect being just a short walk away from the main attractions of Florence. Try the sandwich shop next door for a fantastic lunch.
Highly recommended on all counts.

From the moment we walked into the apartment we felt at home. The clean and stylish apartment was everything we had hoped for. There was everything we needed and more. Salt, pepper, olive oil, and coffee were already in the cabinet. There was even Tupperware for the time we wanted to have a picnic in the Boboli gardens. There also was detergent for the washer. The food recommendations were fabulous! Our family of four (2 teenagers) had more than enough space. The lighting was also wonderful and calming. The location was great as well. A five minute walk in each direction took you to all the major landmarks and shopping with many restaurants to boot! I met up with a friend who works for a company unifying the best hotels in the world, Leading Hotels, and is Italian. She was very impressed with the space and said she would be sure to recommend it to friends. So will I! Book this place now!

This apartment has everything you could possibile need. it is light, spacious, tastefully decorated and well equipped. It is right in the centre of Florence, with a mini market just round the corner. Luca the host is ready to satisfy all your needs. I thoroughly recommend staying here.

5 stars all round. We loved our stay in the apartment. It was clean, cozy and quiet. Lovely restaurants and shopping right on the doorstep. We only wish we could have stayed longer. Thank you Elenora and Luca :)
The location is fabulous, everything was perfect. The beds were so comfortable, the apartment was quiet at night and we couldn't have asked for more.

The location of the apartment was amazing! It was close to the highlights in Florence especially the Duomo. My family and I truly enjoyed our stay. The recommendations (restaurants and gelaterias) were also helpful in making our stay enjoyable in the city. I love Florence and would definitely stay here again!

Luca was a fantastic host!  The communication was fast and accurate.  The checkin was a breeze and the apartment was fabulous.  Everything was spotless and very comfortable!  The maps and local help was fantastic.  We would definitely stay there again!
This location is excellent! Very central to all the major attractions.  Luca was very helpful and responsive to our needs.  100% recommend the location of this apartment.
Luca’s airbnb was convenient and well-located. The only complaint was that the hot water was intermittent (working for one minute, then cold water the next).
Easily one of the best apartments I’ve stayed at. Luca was very accommodating and responsive. Check in was a breeze. Location was amazing. Will definitely stay here again in the future!

This place was perfect for our 2-night stay in Florence. Luca was very good at communicating with us and was so kind to let us leave our luggage past our checkout time! He was very easy to get ahold of and his apartment was clean and well thought-through. This was a great spot in the heart of Florence about 4 blocks from the Duomo.

Luca was a fabulous host. He helped us to check in early which gave us more time to explore Florence without dragging luggages around. His place is in a great part of Florence, only a very short walk to the cathedral / Duomo. There are shops, restaurants and cafes all around. Definitely recommend!
The accommodation was excellent: clean, spacious and in a perfect location, and Luca and Nico were very quick to respond to questions. Thank you!

Luca’s place was located in a perfectly central location. Close to everything we wanted to see. It’s blocks from markets and great restaurants and food! Luca met us personally at check in and showed us around the apartment. When we had questions he was helpful and responded quickly. I would highly recommend staying here. No complaints! Heat host!

Great place.  Comfortable and clean. Looked just like the pictures. Central and perfect location.  Leonardo was easy to communicate with and very responsive.  Tons of nearby food options/restaurants, stores attractions.  There’s a fantastic Florence sandwich store that’s literally just next door.
Wonderful apartment was large clean and bright lots of room. Perfect location close to everything  within walking distance. Great communication by hosts. Highly recommended!!
Lovely stay at the Renascentia Apartments! Perfectly well located amongst the sites of Florence. Thank you to Nick and Luca for all your help, we had a great stay!

Great location, close to many shops, restaurants, local attractions. Luca was extremely helpful our entire stay. Responded quickly with questions or concerns, shared many local recommendations. Space was clean and comfortable. Would highly recommend staying here in Florence!

This apartment is charming, well equipped and in the heart of everything Florence has to offer.  Just steps from the Ufizzi Gallery, shopping, and great restaurants! It was so quiet and the beds were comfortable.  We will definitely stay here on our next trip to Florence.
Great place to stay, centrally located and next door to the best sandwich shop in all of Florence!

This is a beautiful apartment right in the middle of Florence. Close distance to everything you’d want to see! Would definitely stay here again. Nick was super helpful in getting us checked in and offering recommendations.

Veronica's place is in an absolutely great location. Her co-host Roberto is extremely friendly and helpful. The place was spacious and clean. I would definitely recommend it to friends and stay there again if I return to Florence.

Location location location!!!
Roberto was amazing he checked in everyday the apartment is so close to everything it was amazing definitely staying here again for my next trip to Florence.
Roberto was an awesome host. Responded to messages right away. The location of the apartment is perfect and walking distance to everything.
Roberto and Veronica’s place is in a great location very close to the shopping areas but still quiet at night. Great communication and would definitely stay again - thank you!!!

Roberto was so helpful and quick to respond whenever I had a question. The location can not be beat - it is literally in the center of town and so walkable to everything you will want to see in Italy. The space is very big and comfortable for 4 people. We loved our time there and appreciate the opportunity to stay!

This air bnb was absolutely gorgeous great location walk able to all Florence tourists locations near by restaurants, shopping, and the leather markets we absolutely loved having two bathrooms and the kitchen is fully supplied. Definitely would stay again.

A very nice stay at Bianca’s place.
Paola who received us was very helpful and nice and communicating with her was fast and easy. The house is in a perfect location in Firenze! A walking distance from everything!

The apartment is very closely to the center (10-15minutes to main attractions). The big benefit is private parking. Apartment is very nice and very well equipped. Frederica prepared for us some fruits and small sweets for breakfast. She also recommended us a good restauration near the apartment. We can fully recommend this apartment

Federica’s apartment is fantastic, its location is great and made for a wonderful base for exploring Florence. Her communication, kindness and helpfulness were second to none in addition to the little touches such as milk, orange juice and nespresso coffee machine which made our stay even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!!

Great, stylish apartment in a secluded courtyard. Good aircon in the bedroom and great to be able to park in front of the door. It is walking distance to the centre, but far enough to feel you are not in the middle of all the tourists. Would recommend for sure!

Very cosy and nice little house. Very well equipped and pretty well located. We didn’t have the chance to meet Frederica but it was easy to communicate with her, she helped a lot. I definitely recommend her place!

Perfect. Every detail was created thoughtfully and with good taste. From the Nespresso pods to the orchids in the dining room. A very well remodeled and decorated space. Federica is straightforward, practical and effective ! Thank you for creating this wonderful spot and experience for visitors to your lovely city !!

Why can't I give 6 stars? Federica's place far exceeded our expectations, and her hospitality went above and beyond. Proactive communication, accommodating (we stayed with our toddler and the crib was already setup with linens), and amazing location. If you're reading this thinking about booking it for your stay in Florence, do it, you will not regret it.

I love Federica’s home! The place is very clean and homey. All amenities are available and she even provide some snacks and juices for us. Its also within walking distance to historical landmarks and city center - locations is superb! Federica is always very responsive and provide us with info on anything we ask. Surely will stay at her place next time we’re in Florence! Thank you so much Federica! ❤️

Federica received us in person and was very hospitable. The apartment (located 12-15 mins walk from the city centre)was located in a quiet residential district and was stylish and very clean. We liked the fact that that the apartment has a private parking pouch and there was a very nice cafe which serves good coffee and pastries just outside the apartment.

Very nice house with everything we need. We parked the car in the guard, very safe. The house is in central but not so near to the view points. So it is very quiet and you can go to wherever you want by foot or bicycle. Warm and comfortable, recommend to all vositors.
Fantastic place in superb location - especially if parking is important for you.  Host is very responsive and accommodating.  Would certainly stay here again.

Myself and my husband stayed here for 3 nights on our honeymoon. This place is spotlessly clean, very good amenities and in a great location! Away from hustle and bustle, but a short walk away! Checkin and out was easy with a coded key box. Had a great little courtyard which was perfect to enjoy a red wine! Good value - highly recommend!

Great quiet spot on the fringe of the old town, close to several bus stops which made it easy to get in and out of the centre of town. The host is great at communicating everything and was also nice enough to let us have early check in and late check out if we needed it as the place was vacant either side of our stay. Recommend if traveling with children.
We loved our stay! Federica was very helpful with directions. The home was perfectly located! short stroll along the canal to everything possible. Would highly recommend and would definitely go back!

Fantastic place to stay! Frederica was extremely helpful in answering my queries quickly. The apartment was conveniently located within a close walking distance to the main city center. It also offered free & safe parking, which was very important to us. Will definitely visit again

We absolutely loved staying here during our week in Florence. The home was beautiful and the location was secluded enough to feel quiet but very easy walking distance to everything. Federica was a wonderful host and we’d love to stay again!
Fantastic spot walking distance to downtown Florence! There’s a great little cafe around the corner as well.
Federica’s place is everything you  would want in Firenze close to the center and the river, clean ,  stylish and with an amazing outdoor space. I highly recommend this place!
it doesn't get any better than this.  would definitely stay here again, and would highly recommend anyone else to not go past this apartment.  we were very pleased.
Excellent communication prior to arriving (and even during our stay). Close to the main sights. We enjoyed our stay! Thanks!

Federica's location was great! Definitely close enough to walk everywhere in Florence but still quiet and secluded with free parking outside the ZTL. Federica was a great communicator and we had everything we needed, would absolutely recommend this location.
Fantastic stay with Federicia! She was extremely welcoming, friendly and responsive throughout! We had a lovely stay here, and the location was fantastic. We would highly recommend!

The cottage was far enough away from the touristy sections of Florence. It’s about a 30 minute walk to popular sites and the garden outside the cottage is very nice. If you have a car it would be easy to park inside the gate. The only negative is the construction noise across the street which was ever present in daylight hours.
Best spot to stay in Florence for privacy but so close to every spot on your checklist. Highly recommend. Thanks so much for the amazing stay!

Great little spot in a convenient location. Loved the gated area with space to park. Stayed here before flying out of Florence. Got in super late from Umbria but self check in made it easy. Thank you!
Highly recommend especially if you have a car due to private parking . And there’s supermarket in walking distance too. Overall pleasant stay!

This place is located in the heart of Florence, just seconds away to all the attractions and restaurants. The place is very nice, clean, quiet and comfortable. Bianca's son Alessandro is a wonderful host, very friendly and nice, always response quickly and help to fix any issues. The shower is very nice too! Highly recommended.
Great location and accommodations. Perfect place to park your car and walk to all the sites of the city.

A great guest house, private parking was a bonus and we were able to park before check-in so we could explore Florence in the morning. Easy walking distance from Florence. Very clean and tidy, a high chair, cot and bedding was provided for our daughter which was great!

Perfect location. A bottle of wine awaited us at arrival and was really appreciated. The airconditioning was perfect. No windows except skylight. A nice restaurant next door with tasty food. We hade 5 perfect days here.
The apartment is very clean and convenient. It's extremely well situated, in the pedestrian center of Florence. Bianca is a very nice host, she answers really quickly to any questions asked.
Great place, super kind host. They let us check in early and asked us if we needed to leave our luggage after the check out.
Thank you, Paola (and Bianca), for your lovely place and for your attention. I've had a great time in Florence. Raquel.
Bianca was great. Communication was excellent and always asking if we need anything. Location was perfect!! Thanks for being our host!
Location, location, location! Can’t be beat! Great ac which you need in the summer. Also, very useable kitchen. Would definitely stay here again.
Bianca was amazing to communicate and was very responsive. She was flexible and accommodating and I am so glad I booked with her. I loved the location and the place was cute! Will book again.

I recommend this apartment to anyone looking for a great stay in Florence.  It is in a perfect location, and easy walking to most of the area attractions.  It was quiet for sleeping and we appreciated the extra pillows. Thank you for a wonderful stay.

The flat was located in a central area of Florence. Easy walk from the train station and to the main attractions of the city. The apartment was clean and included basic things needed when staying away from home. The hosts were responsive to all communication and provided detailed instructions on how to get to the apartment from the airport and how to get in. We would stay in Bianca’s place again in future visits to Florence.
Wonderful location a few minutes walk from the Duomo. The airbnb was spacious and clean.
Great location and everything we needed for our stay. Loads of hangers for drying clothes. Washer worked great. The bed was quite comfortable and quiet at night. Good communication and support!

I was very close to everything.
after walking the entire city I would rate this location as very very great. would book again.

Bianca’s place was perfect for a quick visit to Florence! It is located in the middle of everything and felt super spacious. It was very clean and had everything we need! Check-in and check-out were super clear and easy. Highly recommend!

We loved our stay here, clean, comfortable and well equipped. The apartment is only a few minutes from the Duomo, ten minutes walk from the train station, yet inside it you don’t hear the noise from the city.
We didn’t meet Paola but she was so friendly and replied really quickly to any messages.
I would book this apartment again.
Great place to stay in an ideal location. Lot’s of eateries, shopping, and sightseeing around the area. Absolutely loved Bianca’s place. Would definitely recommend and look forward to returning.

Paola is an excellent host, very proactive and responsive. The place is right at the centre thus all important places are walkable. The apartment is very spacious, clean have most amenities you need as a tourist (missing microwave). I would highly recommend this place 👌👌
A place to stay, great location we had a wonderful time. Really clean and with lots of space.

Such an amazing airbnb!!! So beautiful and updated. The shower was glorious and the location was perfect. The only thing to keep in mind is walking up 7 flights of stairs with heavy luggage. Thank you Marco and Patricia!!!

The communication was fantastic from Marco and he was there to greet us on our arrival. The apartment is beautiful and Patricia has put a lot of thought and love in to renovating it. It was very clean and had everything we needed and was situated perfectly. It was everything we had hoped for and more and we loved our stay. Thank you Marco and Patricia

We loved our stay at the apartment. It was an A+ location,  very beautiful and stylish, very well stocked with everything we might need, comfortable and quiet and safe. I would certainly stay here again and recommend to anyone (so long as you are able to climb stairs and carry your bags up several flights as it’s on the top floor). We loved it!

Matteo met me at the apartment which was an easy, quick walk from the train station. The apartment was large and clean and had everything I needed for my stay. I really enjoyed that the apartment was outside the beaten path of the crowds, but very accessible to all the museums and sites I wanted to see. I would definitely stay here again and recommend staying with Patricia and Matteo who were great with communication leading up to the stay and when I arrived. Thanks!

I loved my stay at Tango Loft. It is centrally located and I appreciated the design aesthetic very much. The design is modern, yet traditional Tuscan. The sleeping loft comfortable and soothing with the sound of raindrops on the roof. The bathroom and shower were the best I’ve experienced in a vacation rental. Best of all Patricia is an amazing hostess. Highly recommended.

Everything about the loft was perfect. It was clean and decorated nice and in a perfect location between the train station and everything else. Patricia and Marco were very nice and helped us with everything we needed.
Patricia was a great host! The apartment was fabulous and in a fantastic location. It was full of light and the bathroom was particularly lovely.

I really recommend this aparment for any stay in Florence ! It was perfect for us to discover the city (and also to travel through other cities of Tuscany ). The appartment is lovely, spacious, well equipped, quiet… we had everything we could wish for. It’s close to several famous monuments of Florence, so we could visit the city by foot. It’s also close to the train station and a supermarket.
And Patricia and Marco were perfect hosts : helpfull and available ! Thank you again for everything !

My husband and I loved staying at Patricia’s loft in Florence! It was walkable to everything we needed/wanted. The space was clean and cozy. Perfect for two people. The one little hiccup was the shower drain kept clogging. I told Patricia about it and we tried our best to take quick showers so the bathroom wouldn’t flood. Other than that, the bed was super comfortable and the air conditioners worked very well. We would definitely stay again!

A beautiful little loft with the extra touches to make it special. Set in a good, quiet location and  walking distance to everything. Quite a few flights of stairs to get up to it and instructions on how to get in weren’t clear. The cleaner checked us in and didn’t speak any English so it was hard to communicate and didn’t get any recommendations about our stay. Apart from this, the place was perfect for our stay in Florence!

Patricia’s airbnb is a must for your visit to Florence and surrounds! We stayed for about a week and it was the perfect home to relax in! The location is fantastic as everything is walkable and the train super close. The airbnb was beautifully clean and tidy and Patricia was great with communication throughout.
100% recommend!

Patricia's place is amazing!! as others have said there is no lift and you need to walk up three flights of stairs but it was well worth it. The loft is big, bright, and very clean. We felt right at home and the apartment is very close to the Arno river and a 10-15 minute walk to main tourist attractions. Also very close to the train station which was great as we didn't have to walk too far with our luggage. Patricia was very helpful and responsive throughout our stay. Would recommend to anyone visiting Florence :)

Patricia’s apartment was excellent! Spacious, beautiful and situated in a great spot: mere minutes from the train station and a lovely, brief walk from shops and historical sites. There is a lovely bar just downstairs to start off your day with a coffee and a grocery store right next door in case you need anything. We honestly could not have asked for a better host or place to stay; we very much recommend this space for your next trip to Florence! We cannot wait to go back!

Patricia and Marco’s place was a fantastic find for our 5 days in Florence. Great location for exploring the city and really handy to the train station for our day trips to other places. The apartment was very spacious and the kitchen, bathroom and laundry had everything you might need. Best part was the bakery next door - the most delicious treats. It’s a third floor apartment so be aware of the climb, but there is a lovely view from the apartment to enjoy. Communication with Patricia and Marco was excellent. Would highly recommend this place.
Very responsive and friendly. Place was exactly as expected and AC washing machine was a major plus. Easy 5 minute walk to train station and to the river
The loft is gorgeous. Beautifully decorated, very comfortable and great location easy to walk to attractions, supermarket and bakery next door. We loved it!
Such a cute apartment in Florence! So close to train station which was great and close to everything in the city. Apartment was very charming
Patricia’s flat was beautiful! It was so peaceful and had all of the amenities we needed. We especially appreciated the chance to do some quick laundry. The shower was also lovely with a view!

Tango Loft was a great spot to stay for our trip to Florence - a convenient walk from the train station and all the sights of the city, including both sides of the river. Having an easy to navigate kitchen made it that we could cook half our meals at the apartment, which we loved, and having the ability to do laundry and use AC was a game changer in the heat. We also appreciated the flexible check-in, and Marina was so kind in telling us about fireworks our first night and making us feel welcome.  A wonderful experience and lovely location right above a bakery and grocery store- would definitely stay again!

Had a great time in Florence and Patricia’s loft made it so. Easy to find and only minutes away from both the train and bus station. We utilized both so that was awesome. Loft was super clean and upscale updated. Lots of little special details. Stocked kitchen and plenty of space. And the bathroom was special. The shower was huge!
Be aware there are stairs but it’s worth the climb.
Great place and host. Would highly recommend.
Pancho’s place was awesome! Very spacious, clean, and in a great location. Lots of great recommendations and very responsive to everything!
Absolutely sublime living space central to most Florentine attractions. Pancho's nephew Juan helped us immensely with getting around and was very quick with local tips. 10/10

Lovely appartment clean and modern in an old building near the City centre. Good beds and facilities due to the location, some street noise in the early morning. Parking nearby is available in Pay Garage. Driving throughout Firenze takes time. We enjoyed our stay very much.

Perfect location with via del Corso not far as well as a Conad supermarket a few meters away. Also, communication was great and the apartment was extremely comfortable for 4 adults and 1 newborn. We will definitely return and recommend Pancho's place to friends and family.
The apartment is placed close to downtown and is very comfortable.Pancho and Juan were very friendly. If i’ll go back Florence, I’ll repeat!
Pancho’s place was amazing!! Very cute and stylish! Perfect location, too! We’ll definitely stay there again!!

The host is very thorough, very easy to deal with. Location is great for exploring the city. We didn’t have to get a driver at all. Within walking distance of almost all major sites. Would definitely stay here again if we come back to Florence.

Apartment is fully equipped and located in the good area which can easily reach to the tourist attractions by just few minutes walk. The communication with Pancho was very easy and her recommendation was great!

Smart, clean modern apartment in lively neighborhood. Close to everything. Small square outside can get a little loud, but not too much to keep you up. Host Pancho was attentive and gave great directions.
A wonderful place to stay if you’re in Florence! Directly next to a playground that is perfect for relaxing with the kids and escaping the crowds. We loved our stay here!
It is a lovely apartment, very up to date. No living room so you gather in the kitchen. Excellent location.

Really spacious, clean space located with walking distance of a vibrant section of Florence. Rooms / beds were very comfortable and the AC worked wonderfully as it was 105 degrees so that cane in handy!!
This was place was great! The host worked really well with our group to accommodate a last minute change of plans for our trip and it worked out great!
Quaint apartment near the Duomo. Pizza place on the corner and a nicer and bigger supermarket.

The place was perfect as it is located close to the downtown area, and it is near many restaurants and places to shop. We went as a group of 4 and the place did not feel cramped and had enough supplies for everyone staying there. The host was nice as he connected us to his nephew Juan who kept up communication and care for us. Would definitely stay here again.

The communication with the host was very friendly and responsive.Every question was answered straight away.
The apartment is clean and equipped with everything needed to enjoy the stay in Florence.

Pancho was amazing and such a big help. The apartment was exactly what we were expecting and was stocked very nicely so we were able to cook without having to buy too many necessities. We were very close to everything we wanted to see. Pancho also let us check out a little later than we were supposed to because of our train and I am very thankful for that! Overall, a great experience!
It was nice place to stay :) in city center. Good restaurants are near and caffes. A lot of mosquitos so i recommend to take something in socket.
My family and I had a great stay at Pancho’s place. Everything was as advertised and the apt is very well located. I would recommend it to anyone visiting the city!
This place is great and it’s location is very close to some important places that are a must to visit in Florence…!

We really enjoyed our stay in this lovely BNB. Check in was super simple, the location could not have been better seeing as it is in the middle of everything, and the BNB was equipped with all of the essentials that we needed to have a wonderful stay. We would definitely stay here again!

Wonderful apartment in a great location! We were a group of 5 and the space worked well for us and was very quiet and comfortable. The host was extremely responsive, communicative, and provided excellent and detailed instructions and information--also let us adapt our reservation as needed when our group grew at the last minute. Highly recommend!

Caterina is really nice and always willing to help if anything happens. The place is comfortable and clean. It's really close to a bus stop that takes you to the city centre or you can even walk over there if you like.

Pros:
The apartment is very central, walking distance to all attractions. The checkin was easy and the host was responsive.
Cons:
The heating was off when we arrived and it took a whole night for the place to heat up (in December). Overall, the place did not meet our expectations in terms of hospitality as it was listed 'Airbnb Plus'.

This was a great place to stay. The beds were comfortable and there was plenty of space. Lots of things to do around and very walkable to lots of places. Francisco made us feel like we were at home. Thank you for everything!
The apartment was great . Good walking distance to everything (10min walk max to most things to do / restraunts) . Big bedrooms , very comfortable. Massive apartment overall . Our stay was wonderful
Francisco’s place was fantastic! There were some nice shops close by and the area was beautiful! A great place to stay in Florence!

We had a lovely stay at Francisco’s. It was exactly as advertised and Francisco was a great host. Always responded immediately to any questions we had and allowed us to store our luggage early which was greatly appreciated. Location is close to everything yet quiet at night. Apartment is very spacious with ample room for our family of four. Grocery right downstairs and an excellent pizza place steps away!
This place although nicely renovated and placed, needs a bit more attention from the owners. Whoever is cleaning the place, is not doing their job. Too many things were missing or not done at all.

The loft was so charming. Caterina was so resourceful and communicative. We really appreciated how quick she was to respond and how helpful she was with any questions we had about directions and recommendations in Florence. We would stay again! :)
Francisco was a very friendly and nice host. The apartment was very clean and tidy and was in a great location to walk to all the sights and nice restaurants.
The place was in a great location and was super nice. The only downside was it was ground level so people could see into the living room and kitchen areas. Otherwise a great Airbnb!

What a nice stay in your home! The direct access access to the tramway (2min by walk) is perfect in order to visit Florence (20min Tramway) Roberto and her daughter are sympathetic and able to help you. I highly recommend their flat!

This is one the best airbnb experiences for me. The flat is 5 minute walking distance from Tram station. You can reach the center in 15 minutes by tram. The host is amazing. She is full Of energy and smiling all the time. she also recommended restaurants. Strongly advised!

Roberto and Elena were very helpful to us.
We had a super late flight arrival into Florence and Elena came to the airport to bring us back to the apartment and show us
We only had one night stay, but it has a beautiful long balcony and all the features however probably more suited to 2 people, we were group of 3 and it was a little small.
However all in all great experience.
Great place to stay when visiting Florence.  it was a quick walk to the train to downtown.  Quiet neighborhood.  Elena was a wonderful host. Thanks again!

Elena was wonderful. Our first time in Florence, Elena arranged to meet us and gave helpful tips to get around. the apartment was just as described. Great value for money. Really close to the tram stop.

Elena was kind and responsive. She even allowed us an early check in and worked hard to get the place clean and ready for us! She greeted me with open arms (literally)! Tram stop was 5 min walk and easy to use, about a 15 min travel to the city center so was super easy to get around. The apartment was perfect for 2 people and has stove, supplies, fridge, and of course an adorable balcony. AC in the room worked great as well! Thanks xo
The a/c kept bedroom nice and cool.  This place was very close to tram that took us to airport.  Also bed was pretty comfortable.

Elena was a very nice host, warm and forthcoming and always available if we had any questions.
highly recomended, we had a lovely time.

This a perfect central location literally seconds away from the duomo. Furnishings were all very comfortable including the king size bed. There is nice quiet shop on the corner for morning pastries and coffee. We had a great stay. Thank you Andy!

Andy's place in Florence is wonderful. The location is the best for tourists as it is right in the centre of the city almost next to the Duomo - you really can see it from the windows and it is just a few steps away! The apartment is clean and beautifully decorated and all the major sites are within walking distance. Andy met us and was very helpful to get us settled in.

Wonderful place in an excellent location in beautiful Firenze. The apartment has a super view of the dome, and it is centrally located and within walking distance to all major sights in Florence. It is clean and quiet. Air conditioning works really well, which was important when it was 39 Celsius outside. I'd definitely recommend it to friends and I'd stay there again.
Great place to stay in the heart of Florence.  It is a bit noisy at night sometimes, but being so close to everything is worth it.  Great host - very helpful.
This apartment made our Florence experience. Andy was great and super helpful along our stay! We will be back.
We had a lovely stay! Beautiful apartment in the heart of Florence. Quick walk to all main attractions.

Fantastic location in the heart of Florence. Clean, nicely furnished, full kitchen (though no table wear).  Nice view of the Duomo. Andy was very responsive and kind enough to be flexible with checkout. We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Andy was very communicative and quick to respond, it was easy to meet up with him, and his apartment was spotless and in a wonderful location. I would definitely stay here again!

Highly recommend this place!  You can't beat this location and view of the Duomo! It was nice to have all the main tourist attractions nice and close to where we were and to be right in the middle of it all. Thank you Andy! We  enjoyed our stay very much.
Andy was great,  very helpful on check in. Place is great, very nice, a block from the Duomo. Perfect for a couple and maybe a kid or third wheel to crash on the couch.
Andy is a great host and the location of the apartment could not be better. Close to everything. The apartment is spacious and very comfortable. Will stay here again when we return to Florence.
Andy was a terrific host and made us feel right at home! beautiful location and it was the perfect apartment for us. Would definitely come back again!
Amazing space & location! Andy was very welcoming, kind, & helpful; I would definitely stay here again!

This apartment is the perfect home base for Florence! The view can't be beat. The apartment was nicely furnished and very welcoming. I loved staying here and would definitely recommend it for others looking for a place to stay for a visit.

Amazing location! A simple walk to all the main spots - Duomo, ponte vechhio bridge, food market. Couldn’t have asked for a better location. We checked in on a Saturday - and the evening was very loud as you’re on the Main Street. If you’re a light sleeper bring ear plugs. I would still stay here again despite the noise. The unit was clean, hosts were responsive and the location can’t be beat !

Wonderful location with great AC, very helpful hosts gave us suggestions for restaurants in Cinque Terre, our next stop. Lovely to hear the church bells in the morning. I suggest BEN block away for coffee, breakfast and such, a hidden gem. Would stay here again.
Absolutely amazing location. It’s such a loud area but you can hardly hear any noise from the unit as it’s on the top floor. Would definitely stay again.
This apartment was an amazing space- great view, great location (above a chocolate shop- which the smell filled the apartment all the time), great kitchen too if you needed to cook!
We loved this apartment. Perfect location, beautiful view and lovely apartment. We would definitely stay here again.
This AirBnb is such a great find especially for the price. The view of the duomo is gorgeous and the accommodations are perfectly located and quite comfortable. I could not recommend this stay more!

we returned to Firenze 5 years after our 1st visit. I selected Andy's place for the view of the Duomo from the living room and when we got there, there it was.
Andy was helpful with directions and recommendations as we looked for a market. we used to kitchen for breakfast and a great meal.
everything you need is at the bottom of the stars and out the door, Firenze is the Star!!

We absolutely loved our stay in Andy's place. Everything was better than described. The location couldn't be better and was central to every place we wanted to go. The kitchen was really nice, the closet space was generous and the living space was really comfortable. The AC worked great when needed to cool it down in the late afternoon.
It does have some stairs before the elevator, as described, but Andy met us and took the heaviest bag we had and helped us up to the room. Even if he couldn't have met us, they would've been manageable.
It's on a main pedestrian street that stays active pretty late at night, but once you close the shutters, it gets very quiet. We ran a white noise app on our phone and it easily drowned out any excessive street noise like garbage collectors, etc.
Andy is a very helpful and responsive host and this is a gem of place to stay. We highly recommend.

Andy’s bnb is VERY close to the duomo, with all the other sites within walking distance. There are many good restaurants and supermarkets around, so this place is more than ideal for tourists. The place is spotless clean and equipped with many useful appliances. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends who plans to visit Firenze.

The apartment was clean and spacious, and contained everything we needed. Beautiful location yet very quiet! We enjoyed the low murmur of the pedestrian streets below, which only added to the experience of being in Florence. Highly recommended property and host.
Had a great time. Great location although it can get a little noisy at times but it’s to be expected given the central location. We highly recommend this place.
This place was cool and in a great location but the second bed in each room was a rollaway cot which we weren’t really expecting.

The apartment presents exactly as described and is in a great location. It is close enough to everything without getting all of the noise, etc. The apartment has many stylish fittings and furnishings and we loved relaxing there after a hard days sightseeing. The weather was quite hot during our stay but the apartment still stayed relatively cool and the air conditioning coped very well when it did warm up.
We would definitely stay here again.
A wonderful five nights in Florence! Couldn’t have asked for a better space and location. Cannot wait to come back!
Perfect location. It had a lot of unique touches that added to the cool decor. Would  highly recommend for 2 couples traveling together!

Stay was wonderful and very much as pictured and described. We would return. What would have made it amazing were the little things that make it more difficult for tourists like insufficient supplies including too little toilet paper, no hand soap, no dish soap, no paper towels, and not enough bath towels for four nights. Bring your own supplies for a better stay. But the Velvet Loft is a great place. Love the location.

Great for most aspects!  The bed was one of the most comfortable ever in Italy, crisp comfortable linens and lovely pillows also!  The Loft style is very cool!  Rooms large and interesting decor.  Apartment was very close to everything, but on a small, quiet (for Florence) street.  A few minor issues.  The people we were supposed to call to obtain access did not answer after several tries.  Their mother, Monica, did, however, call me and told me someone would arrive in about an hour.  We had too much luggage to go have a snack, so we waited until someone arrived.  Also, even though amenities listed microwave AND also oven, there was only a microwave that looked like a conventional oven.  We like to cook, and had purchased food that needed a regular oven.  We did find a way to cook it on the stovetop.

The location was great and Moni was very welcoming. We asked for the heat to be turned on and it was done the same day . No complaints … lovely apartment and beautiful City . Would use same place again should we have opportunity to return to Bella Florence…
Our experience with Bethsabe was incredible! She was very helpful with communicating how to get to the flat, and was very kind and accommodating. Beautiful home

The place was very clean and had great amenities, however there were some things that made our stay less pleasant. The path to the parking spot is very tight and with our car is not possible to fold the side rear view mirrors so this was very stressful. Also, the WIFI in the apartment was extremely slow, we work online so this was not ideal for us. Andrea's place is stylish, the location is great if you don't mind paying for a bus to take you to the center of Florence, it took about 25 minutes.
We stayed at Andrea's place to be close to the airport for an early flight. It was a good choice for this, with the tram to the airport just at the end of the street

We had a lovely time at Andrea's home. She was quick to answer when we had a question, and was a very gracious host. The apartment is lovely. Comfortable, with lots of homey touches. We appreciated how close it was to public transportation, making it very easy to get into the city center. We were sorry to only get to stay one night.
Wonderful host. Wonderful home. Great location and very smooth check-in/check-out. I will certainly stay here on my next visit and highly recommend it to others.

Bethsabe is a wonderful host. She was very responsive and helpful. The apprtment is beautiful with a charming garden. The locaion was excellent, not in the center but accesisble by bus only 10 minutes to the center. I travelled with my parents and sister, and our kids. We felt like at home and had a great time there. I defintitly recommand this place.
Away from the madness-of-crowd, but close enough to walk or bus to all the touristy areas. The garden was a pleasant surprise. Bethsy’s the perfect host.

We had a really pleasant stay at the appartement. It is just a 5 minutes drive by car from the airport. The self check in and out is easy and the free parking place is great. The appartement is nice and clean and the bed is comfortable. The only thing we did not like was the cigarette smell.
Andrea really helps you with lot of hints for shopping, restaurants etc. - good service!!

The apartment is good equipped and exactly like the photos, can be for 4-5 people with no issues and comfortable sleeping places. The location is great with easy access to the tram. Andre was very responsive. We have enjoyed our stay. Thanks Andre..

Nicely decorated flat in a residential area, fit for a family.
Two rooms with fan and A/C is the living room.
Possibility to park a car for free is valuable, nonetheless, it is very tight for a 5008 peugeot or equivalent.
We felt at home as we cooked, used the washing machine and even went to the haidresser down the building !
Thanks Andrea for making our stay easy, and early check-in doable.

This apartment is perfect for tourists who want to stay in Firenze for one or two nights. It is modern and the owner made a very detailed list of how to check in, check out and many other useful tipps of the city. The only minus point was the missing air conditioning as it got very hot in the night.

We had a wonderful stay and it was very comfortable. The kitchen was equipped with everything we needed and more! It’s a very convenient spot to tram straight into the city center. Also, not a far walk to a full grocery store. There was also tons of free street parking right around it in addition to the parking on premises.

A comfortable, spacious, well-equipped, clean and well laid out basement apartment in a quiet building. It would be a very good base for families for a multi-day stay in Florence. The location is convenient for the centre by bus, being on a main bus route to the centre. Santa Croce is walkable in 20 mins. The local neighbourhood, being outside the city walls, is peaceful and pleasant in itself. The bakery is wonderful and you can easily reach Fiesole from there as well.

Great location.  Right next to convenient tram stop only 10 stops from city center.  secured parking spot is extremely tight but there is paid and free street parking available all around.  AC works great in main bedroom.

We had a very nice stay at Andreas place. Everything was as described, it was clean and comfortable and we very much enjoyed the private parking space. The communication was also very friendly and Andrea always replied very quickly.
Andrea was a great host by letting me drop my bags off early since I didn’t notice checkin was at 4 o’clock. Great clean house right next to the tram station!
The place is nice and clean, it has all you need to have a nice stay. The neighborhood is quiet and the communication very fluent
Andrea was a great hostess. Very detailed check in instructions and recommendations. Easy commute to city center on the metro. Great location!

Very nice to stay here.
Clean, not to far from doumo,
And she always answer quickly
Recommen you !!
Great host and beautiful apartment. Felt very clean and super close to the tram station that took you into the city center.
The check-in instructions were comprehensive and Andrea was always responsive and helpful. The apartment was clean, well-equipped, and cozy.
Nice place, clean, good restaurants around and really close to the train. The host really friendly and commutative. Thank you for having us at your property

Simple, good apartment. We found everything we needed for 1 night stay, clean. Good location, 20mins from city centre by car. Air con needs upgrade in the living room and missing in the second bedroom.  One thing I didn't like is how many notes stuck to the walls of rules and what not to do. If I am getting Airbnb and not a hotel for the night or more is because I want to feel like at home, and not to be reading handwritten rules at every possible turn.
The rooftop deck was literally one of the highlights of our trip to Florence.  Fantastic view, and fantastic location.
The terrace was amazing (pictures do NOT do it justice!) and the location was perfect to see everything we wanted in Florence. Thank you for making our trip fantastic!

Alessandro’s airbnb was probably the best Airbnb I have stayed at. The terrace was amazing and the location is in the perfect spot. Walking distance to everything you would want within florence. He was also a great host who responded quickly.

The location was perfect. You could see Pitti Palace and the Boboli Gardens from the terrace. The host was very helpful in letting us store our luggage in the air bnb prior to check in while the apartment was cleaned. We were so appreciative of that! The only issues we had were that the locks jammed easily and it was difficult to get into the apartment at times. There are 4 different keys and 4 locks to get in the apartment. It took 10 minutes for the host to get one of the doors opened with the key while we were checking in. The apartment also could use some updating inside (example: the cloth covered bed frame). You could tell that the pictures in the listing aren’t quite updated.

We LOVED our stay…it was everything we hoped for and more! Beautiful space, beautiful atmosphere and location
Can’t wait to come back and stay💚🤍♥️

This was elegant as B&Bs are concerned. Large well furnished and decorated rooms, bathroom was new and my 6’6” husband really appreciated the shower. Amazing deck area and you could see anything that was important to see when relaxing out there. We loved the location on the piazza. We had coffee and croissants at our favorite place each morning and there were 4 excellent restaurants right there. In addition, the streets were filled with great places to eat, little shops for treats, and lovely stores. If we return to the city, I believe we would schedule it around availability of this apartment.

Beautiful apartment, right across the river from central Firenze. Be wary of the 4 trattoria right outside as they are all very tourist trappy, however other than that the apartment was amazing, outdoor terrace was gorgeous and a great spot to enjoy the evening or morning. Would definitely recommend!

Great host,super available,lovely. The house is pretty new,just refurbished,super cozy and clean.
A bus stop just 50 meters far from the house brings you in the city center in 20 minutes,depending on the traffic and 15 minutes by walk there’s the Parco delle cascine.

We enjoyed our time at Paola's apartments.  It is a great solution for two couples traveling together.  We enjoyed the innovative lighting in the one apartment.  The location is close to all attractions, restaurants, and shopping.  I would stay here again.

Laura’s Flat is perfectly located to explore Florence. With everything you need to enjoy a great trip - I highly recommend a stay. Laura offered great advice on the local area and the communication was exceptional!
Beautiful home in beautiful neighborhood.  Short walk to everything.  Tall ceilings, great windows,  beautiful mural on ceiling, ac worked great, I could live there forever.

Very happy with my stay. I could not have asked for a better spot on my Florence vacation. Everything was very clean. The home was spacious, and the location was wonderful. I loved the surrounding nightlife and restaurants.
My stay at Massimo’s place was amazing. Perfect location within Florence to be within walking distance of pretty much anything. Overall was a great experience with the place.

Massimo’s place is perfectly situated on a great street, close to the great restaurants and easily walkable to the sights. The street is busy but Massimo’s place is tucked away on an internal courtyard so beautifully quiet. There were quite a few mosquitoes but the place had the other advantage of having a screen on the window. All in all the perfect place for the two of us in a great spot.

Loved staying here! On a super fun street right near the city center. Everything was walkable from here. The place was clean and easy to get into. And Massimo always responded within minutes. Super helpful and a great experience!
Great location! Massimo was super helpful and responsive. Seamless check in. My only complaint would be having to take the trash to another location. Other than that the place was great!

Absolutely gorgeous brand new flat made an ideal base to explore the city. You will not be disappointed. Hosts were lovely, flat was lovely and clean and made for an excellent holiday. Wish we stayed longer!

Leonardo and Ilaria’s place was hands down the best place we stayed in Italy. The home was absolutely beautiful, perfectly set up, and made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. The hosts were incredibly kind and welcoming, and the location was ideal—close to everything we wanted to explore. We wish we could’ve stayed longer!
The villa was even more beautiful than the photos. We had private chefs make dinner, that were recommended by Ilaria and it was delicious and such a great value for how much food they provided.
Very cool to experience living in a real Italian villa!  Illaria was very easy to communicate with and gave great instructions.

This apartment is beautiful. The care and attention taken by Laura in decorating and making the apartment feel like a home makes this such good value for money. It really is a home away from home. The location is convenient, only a 10 minute walk from Duomo, a 10-15 minute walk from the train station and is surrounded by numerous eat and drink places. When we visit Florence again, this will definitely be our first option to book!!
Definitely a must stay! The host is fantastic and so accommodating. She had the best local tips and the house is gorgeous. I will definitlu return to this location. You won’t be disappointed!
we had an absolutely magical stay! thank you so much for sharing your beautiful home, and wonderful hospitality!

If you're reading this review BOOK NOW because you won't be disappointed! Laura's studio is beautiful, sparkling clean, comfortable and perfectly located. Laura has really thought of everything to ensure you have a wonderful stay in Florence. The breakfast items were such a treat too. I really felt at home. You won't be disappointed staying here.

Laura's place is a beautifully decorated ground floor apartment, very clean and in an excellent location, within a 5 min walk to the Duomo.  The kitchen amenities were great if you wanted to stay in and cook a meal.  There was also a lovely patio area to sit and eat your breakfast.

Laura’s apartment is a perfect place to stay if you want to visit Florence.  It is located right in the hub of the historic district where you can walk everywhere....and yet it is a quiet oasis from the noise and busyness of all the tourists and city life.  It is beautiful, very comfortable and spacious.  Laura and her father restored this apartment in a historic building and Laura has added so many nice touches!  We found the bed extremely comfortable and we were tired at the end of each of our sightseeing days!  Laura is very friendly and helpful and is a good communicator.   You will love this place!

Everything about my stay here was amazing! Laura met me at the apt. and showed me everything! The place is beautiful and felt like home. She even had breakfast rolls or toast with espresso and tea set out for you. She gave me great ideas where to eat as well. The place was walking distance close to everything. I will for sure stay here again.

Central location (less than 10 minutes from Duomo and Markets). Perfect space for a couple. Even offer breakfast!! Adorable patio area to enjoy a snack or drink. Would definitely recommend and visit again!

I would stay at Laura’s again and I’d recommend it to everyone! Once we arrived - she exceeded my expectations! She’s an amazing host, very informative and the apartment is very clean! She even had a defuser for the hair dryer for us curly haired women who need this while traveling! Thanks again Laura! Ciao
Laura’s Place is very close to the Duomo and the major sights. Very compact and clean place. Laura is delightful; extremely helpful. A real joy.
I stayed at Laura's apartment for 4 months for my study abroad, everything went well! Would highly recommend it!

Laura’s place is certainly Home Sweet Home.  Beautiful decor, location is within walking distance to shops, restaurants and major attractions.  Very quiet at night.  Laura responds almost immediately if you have questions and she arranged our transportation to train station.   The home is well stocked with essentials and the AC worked great.  Recommended to anyone looking for a wonderful place to stay in Florence!

We had a very pleasant stay at Giovanna's place, which is large, with big volumes, ideally located and well renovated and equipped.
Giovanna is reactive and careful to its hosts comfort, and everything was simple and efficient.
We truly recommend this place to those who aim to discoverthis wonderful town !

We really enjoyed our stay at Giovanna's home. The location was in a lively part of the city, called San Spirito. Which made for some fun nights with locals drinking and eating some excellent food.
Giovanna provided an extensive list of restaurants to eat at, which proved to be very valuable.
Lookng forward to our next visit!

Thanks Giovanna for a lovely stay and local suggestions.  We had a fabulous week catching up with our daughter who is lucky enough to live in Florence.  I travel to Florence at least 2 or 3 times a year and Giovanna’s place is my go too.  It never disappoints.  See you again in a June and thanks again for everything!
Giovanna’s place is wonderful.  Close to everything.  I stay here all the time.  It’s my go to place in Florence.  Highly recommend.  Thanks again for hosting me.  I will be back next year!

If you're going to Florence and are not staying at Cecilia's place, you're missing out !!! Not only the place is fantastic in every aspect, including the location, which is walking distance to all the major point in Florence; but Cecilia and her parents are the best hosts you can wish for. They even left food for us to prepare our breakfast !! They are amazing people, and will make sure your stay will be a memorable one. Take my word, you will not regret.
Thank you so much for everything Cecilia !!! :-)

Our hosts were so very accommodating. The apartment was gorgeous. Just like the pictures. Spacious and comfortable. Perfect location for sightseeing, restaurants and shopping. This place was a gem. Our highest recommendation for anyone looking for a beautiful loft in Florence.

Cozy, beautiful, and incredibly clean apartment right in the heart of the city. Cecilia’s apartment was the perfect place for our family to stay when visiting Florence. She was responsive when I asked questions before arriving, sent me a list of local places at which I could grab a bite and even greeted us at the door to tour the apartment and show us where all the amenities were located. So glad we stayed here!

This place is spacious, clean and central. Communication leading up to the stay was excellent. The place is open, airy and beautiful. Her mum was a great host on our arrival. Air conditioning was a saviour. I would stay here again. Great value

Cecilia’s apartment is just as she named it.....elegant! Very lovely property that is well stocked with everything you could need while on vacation. Her parents checked us in and gave us wonderful tips for restaurants nearby. They were the best meals of our trip through Italy! We highly recommend Cecilia’s apartment!

The apartment is beautiful, bright and sunny located in a great area, with many restaurants nearby and the santa Maria novella train station just a 10 minute walk away.
The apartment in itself was sparkiling clean and very well furnished and we had everything we needed.
We met Cecilia's lovely parents who were very warm and gave us good tips and suggestions. They were also kind enough to have a snack basket in the apartment for us, when we arrived. It was very thoughtful of them.
All in all it was a great experience, with the hosts paying attention to every small detail for the comfort of their guests and I would definitely stay here again and recommend this to everyone.

Fantastic and very spacious apartment all round. Great location by the river on the quieter side of town, still very central and easy to get around. Exceeded expectations, Cecilia and her family were all great to deal with. Highly recommend.

WOW. Cecilia’s place was fabulous. A beautiful, well-appointed apartment near the best of Florence, this place was the best AirBNB we’ve ever experienced. Plenty of room to spread out, lots of nice touches, even breakfast goodies were included. We absolutely loved it here! Perfect for a family of four exploring Florence for the first time.

Fantastic location, great host and beautiful apartment. What you see is what you get and it is better in real life. Fantastic host and extremely helpful. Awesome restaraunts in the local area - if you want real authentic Itralian then try Carbine which is 200m from the apartment around the cornr - turn right at Dantes across the road.
Beautiful apartment super close to everything you want see in the middle of Florence. Also really close to the train station if traveling to other cities. Just Perfect!

This is a great home away from home in Florence.  It was very comfortable and welcoming. It was a fifteen or twenty minute walk to the attractions in Florence. I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone.
Amazing appartment to stay with family of 4 to 5. Close to all the attractions.

Our stay in Firenze was wonderful. The apartment has all of the necessities needed for a longer stay.  The location is excellent, easily walkable to many sights, train station and multiple restaurants.  The host was easily reachable for any questions. Highly recommend Cecilia’s apartment in Florence

I sent our hosts a message that we had landed and the minute we got to our new home Dominico met us.  Took us through the apartment and showed us around.  It was beautiful, clean and was exactly like the pictures.   Perhaps even bigger than we expected.   The perfect location.  We walked 10 - 15 minutes to get wherever we wanted to go.   Best coffee and gelato right across the street. Tons of restaurants minutes away on foot.   There was a welcome basket of food, juice, milk and coffee❤️☕️    Both of the hosts were warm, helpful and lovely.    We had a few chilly nights and they dropped off extra duvets.   I would highly recommend!   We will be back !

Perfect location, spacious and airy. The fridge was stocked with a few essentials and that was a nice touch. Quick and easy walk to everything we wanted to see, very clean and comfortable. The elevator for the bags was welcome, host met us at the room and showed us around. Very relaxing stay.

Cecilia was very helpful with recommendations, and getting us to the place. Apartment is 2 levels- a small note for anyone with mobility issues, but really was perfect otherwise for our group. Great location, walkable to all the main sites in Florence.

We were greeted by Cecilia’s dad and immediately felt welcome and comfortable in the spacious apartment. The two bedrooms and full and half bathrooms were perfect for our family of four. A nice touch was the treats Cecelia left us  - perfect for our breakfasts & afternoon snacks. We were also able to leave our luggage on site while we spent the morning in Florence before we left the city. Very walkable - perfect location with great restaurants & gelato nearby!

This apartment is excellent. It is as beautiful as the pictures show, and it is extremely clean, comfortable and spacious. Our host was wonderful and made sure we had everything we needed. The apartment was really well stocked, and the host graciously provided nice snacks and even some pantry items we used when we prepared meals. The location allowed us to easily walk to and from the train station, to bus stops and to all of the sights we wanted to visit in Florence.  If you get the chance, you should definitely book this!
very comfortable accommodation,  close to everything . very handy having a washing machine. easy to communicate with.

The place was Amazing. The location could not have been better. The local suggestion box was perfect and we were able to add to it and agreed with the ones in it. Cecilia was very helpful and welcoming of us.
Spectacular location and Lorenzo was right there to greet me upon arrival ! Best location in Florence and the balcony was a bonus.
Great flat for a Short stay in Florence. The private balcony was amazing boh in the morning and in the evening.

"Sara's apartment was very clean and comfortable. It is on the 6th floor and has a very nice view. The location is good,15minute walk from the center of the town and only 2minutes from a bus stop that can take you downtown! I totally recommend this place for a couple because you feel like you are in your own home. Thank you Sara for your hosting!
Sara is a host very helpful ; the flat is clean, well equiped and confortable for a short stay.

Great apartment with an incredible balcony. Three restaurant zerozero around the corner is a must go to. It's a solid walk to downtown through the train station Florence so be ready. Very nice and responsive host!

Handy little apartment for 2 people. The roof terrace is the highlight.  Lovely pizza restaurant just 2 minutes away. It’s about 15 minutes walk into the hustle and bustle of Florence. Great 3 night break . Thank you

Lovely apartment on outskirts of Florence. Nice little kitchen with hob and plenty of pots and pans. Lounge has sofa bed and doors to outside area. Books and maps available with plenty of space for clothes if you're staying a long time. Outside area is massive with table and chairs to eating and lounger chairs for relaxing. stunning views. Great apartment for exploring Florence. There is a supermarket, wine shop, pizza place and fruit shop all within 3 minutes. if you do stay here learn some Italian, it helps in all the shops near by :)

Amazing location, directly in front of the duomo.  You literally can't ask for better. Lorenzo was so easy to talk to and he checked us in at whatever time we needed.  Everything was fantastic.  Highly recommended!
Sara was quick to respond and was accommodating. It was extremely hot, so the air conditioning was wonderful. It was very relaxing to sit out on the terrace after walking around all day.

The apartment fully matches it's description. Terrace is amazing and elevator in the building is super cozy. Sara sends clear instructions very quickly. Air conditioner is a saver after hot summer day
Sara’s apartment was beautifully decorated and maintained. She was so sweet, thoughtful, and timely with her responses.  I would stay here again in a second!
The view is outstanding! Bus routes and tram made this a very convenient place to stay. Very cute and quiet neighborhood. Sara was a great host and quick to reply to any questions during our stay

It was as advertised. The rooftop was Amazing. A few added amenities would have made the place a little more welcoming. Be ready to walk a lot if you don’t rent a car. Taxi service is hard to come by and there is no Uber in Florence.

Very nice and cosy place. The roof terrace is amazing. If the whether is not great then the place is maybe a bit small if you are staying for a longer period. Communication with Tomasso was very good!

Clean, cozy, and modern! The space is small, but is utilized in a great way. The view from the balcony is amazing. We had a problem with the wifi on day 2 of our stay, but Tommaso responded quickly and got it fixed within an hour. I highly recommend to anyone traveling to Florence!
Great place to stay, easy to get to the main area and plenty of good places to eat nearby. Deck is excellent as well!

The apartment is in a great location and is in a very secure building. Lorenzo was a wonderful host, greeting us on the street and providing thorough instructions on the apartment with lots of great tips. There’s a shared washing machine with the other units and it worked out great!

This was my second time at Lorenzo's place.  As it was last year, it was clean, the communication and check in were prompt; and Lorenzo had great suggestions with a very nice booklet in the place.  I feel very safe and carefree in Lorenzo's place in Firenze. I plan on returning here again and again.

Fantastic Airbnb with an ideal location next to the Duomo and within 10-15 minute walking distance to many great restaurants and attractions. Exactly what we needed for our five night stay in Florence. Enjoyed the beautiful Terrace and the AC was quite refreshing to come home to after a day of touring. The elevator in the building was helpful to bring up our big luggage. Shower is quite spacious as well. Lorenzo was quite helpful and accommodating with a couple requests he had for him, thank you!
Would definitely recommend and come back!

This apartment could not have been better. It is decorated beautifully and is in the perfect location: walking distance to everything we wanted to see, but in an area next to some of the best restaurants and nightlife frequented by locals.
A very big apartment in a nice neighborhood. It was a pleasure to stay there. Also the owner provided plenty of classic and opera vinyls to listen.
My stay at Lorenzo's place was great. The apartment is very charming, and super well located. The check in/out process was a breeze. I would definitely stay there again!

The apartment was wonderful and exactly what I needed. Although the entry code didn't work at check-in, Lorenzo was extremely responsive and was able to quickly solve the problem. The apartment itself was clean and comfortable and matched the description exactly. The neighborhood is central, easily walkable, and full of wonderful shops and restaurants. Highly recommend and would absolutely stay here again!

Lorenzo was a great communicator with the best instructions and local recommendations I have ever received at an AirBNB.  Lots of great restaurants within walking distance.  Very clean.  Highly recommend!
You will not be disappointed with your stay here. An excellent location, the doorway is literally steps to the Duomo and some of the most beautiful art and architecture in the world.

We strongly recommend this place! It’s a brilliant, quiet apartment with an excellent terrace in the heart of the historic part of Florence- just 30 seconds from the cathedral Santa Maria del Flore, and with many shop, restaurants and other attractions around. The hosts are great, very responsive, flexible and eager to help.  It’s an outstanding place worth visiting :) We will come back for sure!

We had a great stay here! The bed was very comfortable, the room looked just like the pictures, and the location can’t be beat! The recommendations for shops and restaurants were also appreciated. We would definitely stay here again if we were back in Florence.

This is a perfect apartment for a few days in Florence. It is spacious and comfortable and has everything you need when away from home. The terrace is great for relaxing. As for the location, it is metres away from the Duomo! Communication with Lorenzo was easy. We had a lovely time here and can thoroughly recommend a stay here.
Beautiful place at the very best location. I felt safe here and the balcony was dreamy. Steps away from the duomo. Very clean with everything you need. Can’t wait to come back!
Fantastic location, close to most major attractions. clean and private apartment with a balcony overlooking the street.
