Amazing little gem with a private rooftop patio right beside the Duomo. Perfect location, bustling but inside is super quiet.  Major Sites, restaurants , coffee shops, shopping, are all within a short walk. Lorenzo was very responsive and very helpful with recommendations. Highly recommend!
Lorenzo's location was great Lorenzo was great, served all our needs. would definitely recommend staying there again
Lorenzo was wonderful! He was a very supportive host, offered flexible early check in, gave great recommendations. We loved the location being so close to Il Duomo and other landmarks.
Amazing location and amazing host!  Lorenzo gave us so many great recommendations that did not come up in our research! Would highly recommend!
We had an amazing time! The location was perfect and such an easy walk from the train station. The balcony was huge and beautiful, perfect for an evening hangout. We highly recommend staying there!
Great location to be in the middle of it all yet apartment is still quiet and having the balcony/patio was a nice plus. Bed was firm and comfortable. Appreciated AC as it was hot in Florence.

Lorenzo’s place was great, perfectly described and in an even better location that what could be described. Easily walked everywhere we wanted and had access to lots of great local restaurants and cafes. The place was clean and perfect for a couple, with a great terrace. Lorenzo was always helpful. Had a great time!.
Lorenzo’s place was amazing!! So close to everything, we couldn’t have asked for a better spot, and the patio was perfect for relaxing and having a glass of wine. Definitely recommend!

We had a great stay at the apartment. It was super nice, clean, with a great view. Sara is a really friendly host who offers help in every situation. We would definitely stay there again. Firenze is just perfectly beautiful.
Jacopo went above and beyond to accommodate our needs and make our stay as easy as possible! A great apartment and a great host.
A nice little apartment for two with a great location. A solid base from which to explore the city. Bright, comfortable and had everything we needed.
Overall a great place in the center of town and the host recommended tons of amazing places to see and eat!

This apartment is perfectly located in Florence. It has everything you need, and you can easily get to all the best food and tourist locations. Additionally, the hosts provided great suggestions for places to eat and visit. Can't recommend this place enough!

The location was perfect, everything was easy to reach. It’s not far from the train station, market, and various other sightseeing places. The host’s son checked us in and gave us instructions on house rules and also had a personalized map showing his favorite restaurants and various places to visit in the city. My only complaint is, and it’s not the host’s fault, the building itself had a lot of mosquitos. Every night i was bit all over (including my face) and it made it difficult to sleep. I couldn’t find them during the day in the apartment (only saw them in the hallway) but at night while we slept they bothered me terribly. Overall I enjoyed the stay, just wished the bugs left me alone.
This Airbnb was perfect! The location was amazing, the communication was outstanding, and the view was incredible.

The hosts are amazing with lots of recommendations and information. The place itself is fine but the bathroom had a bit of a smell and after taking a closer look needed a deep clean. Also, there was a ton of mosquitos in the apartment (I have 30+ bites) so we needed to buy a can of bug spray and that seemed to help.

The apartment is located in a very central area, very confortable to reach the station or any other point within the city center! It is just like the pictures, and it has a small kitchen that is handy in case you dont always want to eat out. I would recommend it!

Warm welcome to the apartment that had everything one needed.
It is very close to the central station and a great place to explore florence by foot!

Jacopo’s place is a great option for two people visiting Florence. He greeted us at check in and provided excellent recommendations for things to do in the city. The apartment matched the online description, was clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Thank you!

Perfect place for a few nights. The small kitchen, fridge, washing machine were so helpful to have. Beautiful big windows with lots of natural light. Air conditioning was strong although it did not cool down the whole place. Also beware the bed is only a pull out so if you are light sleeper or trouble falling asleep might have issues. Other reviews had mentioned mosquitoes but we did not have any at all. Right next to train station and very walkable to everywhere we went.
Convenient to all sights...we arrived a bit early and was able to leave our luggage and go explore! A lot of stairs, but supper nice.
Cozy place at good location. We really enjoyed our staying in Firenze thanks to thier support.
The location was great and the space was generally comfortable for a short stay. That said, the unit could use a bit more care and attention to cleanliness and overall upkeep.

Kore is a very helpful and responsive host. The apartment is conveniently located—within walking distance of the train station and close to the main attractions. Kore also provided great recommendations for restaurants and other local spots, which made our stay even more enjoyable.

Lovely sunlit flat with high ceilings and a very comfortable bed - it was clean, well organized & well located -
perfect for a solo traveler/or a couple that can manage in a compact space. Jacobo and his co-hosts were kind, helpful & accommodating - they responded promptly/graciously to all my requests. Very hot in Florence in summer but the AC & standing fan kept the space comfortable.
Much recommended!

Great location, about 7 minute walk to the train station & bus which is perfect if you’re doing any day trips from Florence. A little outside the hustle and bustle of the immediate city center so it’s quieter. Studied abroad in Florence and lived in this neighborhood so was specifically looking for an Airbnb that was around here for its convenience!
Wonderful place to stay right in the heart of Florence! Clean, quiet, and everything is just as advertised. I would highly recommend!

What a beautiful small room. In the terrace is a great feature. Right in the heart of Florence the entrance is literally 30 feet from. Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore commonly known as the Duomo of Florence. The room is within 15 minute walk out so many sites. The three days we stayed was not enough to see them all.

We had a wonderful stay at Lorenzo and Lodovica’s loft in Florence. They were excellent communicators and provided clear, step-by-step instructions that made everything easy from check-in to check-out. The loft itself was beautiful and perfectly located in the heart of Florence—close to everything we wanted to see and do. We truly enjoyed our time here and would absolutely stay again!
Francesca let us check in early which was nice. Good room only a short (20 minute) walk from the centre of Florence

Francesca is very nice host. Communication was good at every time of our stay. There is an option to leave baggage at the last day and take it later. The room and bathroom is nice and clean, and the apartment has everythig you need. I reccommend it!
The room had all amenities listed, the broken hair dryer was replaced very quickly when asked. However, we visited during winter months and the heating was off, thus we got really cold at night.

This place is excellent for a short stay. Close to the city centre, yet free from any noise and disturbance.
The kitchen is always stacked with some items that are easy to cook and convenient.
Beautiful apartment. Francesca welcomed us at the door and gave great suggestions for the town around us. Great place to stay.

Perfect place to stay while in Florence, it was peaceful and convenient. Francesca was very helpful with recommending which tram to take which isn’t needed but is convenient if you have heavy luggage or just need to get to the station or the centre of town. Thank you Francesca for a wonderful stay!

Salvatore is the best Airbnb host I have ever had. Great hospitality and great local knowledge. The apartments were both gorgeous and much more spacious than I expect. The location is absolutely perfect. The terrace was a huge addition and made our stay even better.

Beautiful spotless apartment, in a very quiet neighbourhood. Fully equipped with everything you would ever need for a trip to Florence. We really enjoyed the complimentary bottle of wine sitting on the balcony.
We would definitely stay again.

Great spacious flat, truly furnished with everything you’d need to live there! We found the place better than on the pictures. Compared to many commercial let’s there was things like laundry detergent etc. 5 min to the tram or you can get bikes into the city (ridemovi app). Also there is a gigantic Coop (supermarket) around the corner. Free on street parking all around. First floor with balcony so great for having a coffee. Key thing it does not have aircon (which was mentioned so not a surprise). For us coming from the UK we found it hard to sleep  at night due to the temperature even with fans, when temperature got over 30C during the day. If you’re used to it then this will be a dream.

This place was very well appointed, quiet, and great restaurants with near by modern grocery store. In one day we learned our way around and felt like locals. Everything was so easy and the host was always just a phone call away. She was very responsive with our questions. We loved it and would have loved to stay longer.

My wife and I had such a great time in Florence and it was made that much better by the accommodation and the professionalism of our host Melania. The apartment is perfectly located, it was exceptionally clean and we especially loved the outside terrace. We would definitely stay again if or when we return. Many thanks
Wonderful place to stay in Florence! Melania made things easy for us to find parking and get to the apartment. Gorgeous view of the Duomo. Easy access to great parts of Florence.
Absolutely and highly recommended. Giovannis place is perfect! Thank you again for sharing your home to us. We will definitely be coming back!

Giovanni was kind enough to check us in much before the actual check in time since we arrived early. He was quick in communication and responses and also suggested some restaurants around the place and gave tips on how to reach tourist places. Thanks for everything 👍

The house is in the heart of the city!
It’s very close to the train station, and the room is clean and cozy!
Definitely recommend it!

The Giovanni Ap is really amazing. Great space, very well equiped , great location including the Ap street where we can stop the car for free. Very close from Train station and the main atractions of Firenze. Was my 4th time in Firenze and Giovanni ap was the best place where I had stayed . For sure I'll come back to stay there if I can. Thanks Giovanni and see you next time.
The size is quite big, which is quite comfortable to live with.  But the kitchen is a bit dirty.
We did not stay in this apartment due to unexpected problems with its facilities. But Giovanni was quick to solve the situation and everything worked out fine. We would definitively stay here again.
Good location, only about 10/15 minutes from central city. Away from all the crowds and noise. Large kitchen. Check is was very easy. AC worked well too.
Great accommodation! Super clean with all the necessities plus a very comfy bed which was definitely appreciated after long days walking around the city. Would recommend :)

We LOVED our stay at Galatias. Lovely host, she was super responsive and friendly. She even had great food recommendations for nearby. There’s a tram right around the corner, the neighbourhood felt very safe. Everything was exactly like the photos.
Had a lovely time at Galatia’s place! Easy to get to the centre and smooth process to check in and out. Very clean and comfortable
Great apartment to rent ! Very clean and comfy ! Located in a calm area and at proximity of the center of Florence by walk . I would definitely recommend it
Giovanni was a great host.  His place is in a great locations a close walk to everything you would like to see.  The place was clean and comfortable.  I would definitely recommend.
The flat is located near all the touristic attractions. The communication was good and Giovanni even gave us good adresses
Friendly and polite host. Apartment is clean with all necessary goods. 10 min by walking from SMN. Good recommendations.
Beautiful spacious apartment and in a great location. The apartment is amazing for groups of friends as there’s a double bed in the room and a big sofa bed as well.
Nice place, close to train station and most major sights in the city. Giovanni was there to check us in and show around. We enjoyed the stay and would like to come back again.

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment. It was clean, well-kept, full of great amenities like a coffee machine and kitchen essentials and most importantly - safe and in a wonderful area. It was very walkable to everything Florence has to offer. What a great home base for our explorations of the city. Giovanni was responsive and helpful.

Great apartment close to the city center and everything you would want to do in Florence. It’s a first floor exterior apartment, but it is very quiet at night. Many restaurants and cafes nearby, so it’s easy to find food in the neighborhood the apartment is beautiful and very well equipped with everything you would need
Great place to visit Florence! Highly recommended! Parking recommendation was very helpful and close by. Stayed in the flat for business trip to Florence, will come back for vacation!

Giovanni’s flat is located in the heart of florence. All main attractions are within walkable distance, which is extremely convenient. The place is huge, while being newly renovated, the decor is quite stylish and looks like a local home without excessive glamours. I truely enjoyed my stay, thanks to Giovanni and his team. Recommend!
I will definitely recommend this to a friend! It was exactly as the description, I will return in the future!
The place is well located! Its close to main attractions and train station. Neighbourhood is a bit busy in the evenings, but not too much noisy. Overall good experience
Its a great place and Claudia is a awsome host! The breakfast was very good with lots of stuff (fruits, yogurt, cokies, toasts, etc...) it was awsome!

Claudia was very friendly and helpful with local tips. She had a nice private patio. The location was great, close to a very nice park and a ten minute walk to the main tourist area of Florence. I would recommend this place!

Claudia’s accommodation is really well-presented, spacious and charming.  Breakfast served on the flower-scented terrace was tasty and plentiful.  As a solo female traveller, I was a bit anxious about getting around Florence, but Claudia gave me great advice, a useful map and the confidence to head out happily.  The location of the rooms was perfect, being south of the river, away from the bustle nearer the centre, yet everywhere was within strolling distance.  Lovely to be staying in a traditional villa in this amazing city and to soak up the atmosphere.  I’ve already been recommending it to friends!  I would stay there again without hesitation.  Thank you, Claudia!

Amazing place to stay! Realy confortable,
Claudia was extremally helpfull with us and super gentil and kind and generous.
We realy loved the room, great shower, bathroom, was just perfect for us.
We recomend it with closed eyes!!
We loved Antonio, who helps her too.

Our stay at Claudia's Airbnb was simply amazing! The location was peaceful and not far from Florence's main attractions. Claudia was a wonderful host who made sure we had everything we needed. The apartment had all the essentials and was clean and comfortable. We highly recommend Claudia's place for a great experience in Florence!
Wow! Loved this place…wish we had more time at it…our favorite of our two weeks trip

It was such a beautiful place. We even had breakfast brought outside to us in the garden. The host is absolutely lovely and very responsive. She even gave us an umbrella for the day it was raining in Florence!
We loved this little apartment so much. It was safe and comfortable and the view from the terrace was amazing. Thank you again!

Amazing location, great hospitality, easy check in. Only thing I can say is the street is very loud at night but we were so tired we didn’t let noise bother our sleep. Great stay, very much recommend!

This place is worth every $!
Location is incredible, super clean apartment, and the rooftop is the best part of the apartment!!
We recommend it and will stay here again when we com snack to Florence ✨

This AirBnb was absolutely incredible! The beautiful feel of the home makes you feel like you are actually in Florence. The rooftop had spectacular views that were unbeatable and the close proximity to everything in town was incredibly convenient. 10/10 would absolutely recommend and will definitely rebooking should I return to Florence in the future! Thank you!

Really cute apartment. Has all the essentials and most importantly, a private rooftop view of the major sites of Florence. The location is great as well. Easy walk to restaurants and sites of Santa Croce as well as the more central historic sights. Would definitely stay here again.

Sveva’s place was fantastic! The terrace overlooking Florence was such a great way to watch the sunset and have a glass of wine after a day of wandering the city. The location was wonderfully located, and the AC was mighty powerful (a lifesaver for Florence summer).

The apartment is very well equipped and the location is superb. The apartment is also roomy and has a quaint, old Italy feel.  The upper balcony provides an great breakfast area that is a treat with the views.
The apartment was really nice. It was bigger than it looked in the photos, the air conditioning was great, and the view from the terrace was also really good.

Beautiful apartment! A little noisy at night from nearby bars, but if you play some white noise on a phone and close your window shutters, you should be fine. Otherwise, lovely and amazing. So impressed by the elevator and decor and the view!

Can't beat the location!  Staying at this place makes you feel like a local because you are on one side close to all the Florence attractions and tourist sites, but do a 180 and you are among the locals; for instance you are 10 minutes from the Mercato di Sant’Ambrogio so if you think you have the skills to cook up a Florence meal on your own, shop where the locals shop!  The rooftop has amazing 360 views of the most historic sites of Florence.

This flat is comfortable and beautiful and has everything we needed. The upstairs terrace was so sweet. The location is central and everything was walkable. There’s an elevator to get you to your floor and AC in the apartment.
So happy we stayed here. It was a great place to come home to at the end of the day.
We truly enjoyed our stay at Sveva’s place. The location was great and the apartment was wonderful, especially the rooftop!

The apartment and its location were great. The air conditioning was VERY nice and the apartment was nice and clean. There were just little things for me that would have taken it from a 4.5 {which the app won’t let me give) to a 5: the balcony on the roof is amazing but hard to enjoy in the summer without a shade.  Some of the appliances were hard to,figure out without directions (Ie coffee machine-why there were wrong sized coffee pods left behind.) Communication-we were staying for over a month and left with one key (because of previous tenets) this would have been fine if we had been told right away but it took asking on two apps and then 3 days before hearing anything. So if you are there for a short visit is great if you are there a little longer there are a few hick-ups. That view on the balcony is quite special!

Amazing location, beautiful terrace and responsive host. Great place for a group of 5 looking for a centralized location. Bus stops nearby. Self check-in was very easy and the lift is a godsend of you have heavy luggage.
Enjoy your stay at this beautiful apartment.

This apartment is super. Pictures are totally accurate. Very comfortable, and spotlessly clean.
Only about 5O0 metres from Uffuzi and centre of Florence.
Hosts were excellent and I would definitely stay here again.
The apartment of Andrea and Nastya is very good on all aspects : location, cleanliness, arrival and departure procedures, hoste disponibility and price/quality ratio...
Spacious place with all the necessary stuff. Will need to take a bus to get to the center, the stop is pretty close. Overall, a great bang for the buck, would easily rent it again!

We loved Paolo's appartment and felt at home right away. He welcomed us with open arms and we appreciated his patience, effort and kindness. His appartment is gorgeous and the photos on the Airbnb-Website don't even live up to how the rooms look in real life. The interior design is lovely and the beds are comfortable and clean. The kitchen is perfectly equipped and the location couldn't be better.
If we visit Florence again we will be sure to stay at Paolo's appartment again.

Kim’s place was the perfect location to stay in Florence. It was near everything but felt away once walked up the street to get to her place. It is on a quiet street. The linens were exceptional and the beds comfortable. Overall tasteful design, comfortable, and roomy. A plus is the washer, and laundry racks, did one load to hold me over for the rest of the trip. Kim was great host.
Fantastic location out of the way of the hustle and bustle of Florence. Easy walk to great restaurants and scenic spots. Apartment was clean, roomy, and had everything you might need!

Lovely place in a perfect location.
We could walk to the almost any famous places in the city.

We were extremely happy with the location of this place! It’s out of the busy part of town but easily walkable to everything. We also were able to take a beautiful walk that felt far away from everything. The host was extremely helpful and a great communicator before and during our stay.
Great stay! Good location in the city, and the place is very comfy and clean. Our arrival got delayed and Altea was very understanding and accommodating. Thanks! :)
We loved this apartment. The beds were comfortable with crisp sheets and the bath towels were large and fluffy. Kim was always available with any questions or assistance.
Great location!!!! It is close to almost everything in Florence. The host is amazingly responsive and goes out of the way to make you feel like home.  Highly recommended.
The place was very clean, appreciate the presence of an airco. The location was very good, so for someone looking for a private room, then this is it.

We stayed 3 days at Altea’s place and enjoyed our stay.
Great location and sparking clean!

This accommodation was truly great! It was our second experience in a private room and it couldn’t have gone any better. Our host was really flexible with our arrival time and helped us with our parking situation. The communication was very quick. We had our own cute bathroom and there even were books on Florence & Italian phrases in the room! The WiFi was perfect and the location was in walking/stepping distance of all the highlights. I would 100% recommend this accommodation if you are ever in Florence!
Great place in a perfect location in Central Firenze, walking distance from everything including the train station. Checking in and out was super easy.

I had the most amazing experience. Paolo is wonderful and made himself available during my 3 week stay. The apartment is well appointed and in a great location. The AC works great, the WIFI is super speedy and the building is quiet. There were no surprises as the listing is exactly what you get. I will be coming back to this Airbnb for future stays.
Incredible location. We stayed here with our 3 small children, and there was plenty of room for all of us. We were very comfortable and slept well. Cannot stress enough how perfect the location is!
Host was extremely responsive. Easy check in and check out. Perfect location for walking and touring  Florence

We had a great stay in Altea's place! The bed was large and comfortable and the bathroom was very clean. Altea was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay. The neighborhood was another highlight, especially a panini restaurant named Semel. Would stay again!

Nice, comfortable, clean and well located apartment. Altea was very responsive and flexible, letting me keep my bags in the apartment after check-out, though I wish check out would’ve been later than 10am.

Paolo was extremely helpful and friendly during our check in process. He made sure that he gave clear instructions and greeted all of us. We had 2 elderly people with us and he went out of his way to make them comfortable. They were very happy with him.
Talking about the place, it’s a beautiful well situated and decorated home. Very good vibe exactly as shown in the pictures. It has a well stocked kitchen. The sheets on the bed are as clean as they can get. Really not a single issue with the house. We will recommend this place to friends and family for sure.

Paolo is a great host. Even though we arrived at night and our plane arrived late, he was very welcoming and patient. He was very kind and friendly. He booked us a dinner reservation at a really nice restaurant and walked us over to make sure we were all set. He checked in with me regularly to make sure we had everything we needed. The apartment is in a great location and very comfortable. It’s everything we needed and I would definitely book it again.
This is a fantastic place in a great location. Short walk to many restaurants and shops. Steps from Duomo.  I would stay here again for central Florence.
We loved staying at Tommaso’s place! The apartment had everything we needed and it was perfect for our family. You can’t get a better location, just steps away from the main attractions of Florence!

Incredible location - had an elevator, which made bringing our infant & toddler up to the apartment manageable. Really big space - perfect for a family traveling with friends, multiple families, or a bunch of friends!

Fantastic apartment right in the middle of town and yet also felt private and quiet.  Paulo was great to communicate with and gave us recommendations for restaurants a few blocks away.  The apartment was clean and child-friendly.  Thank you!
Paolo was excellent. He was so attentive the entire time and always ready to help out! Even booked us a reservation at a fantastic restaurant. Happy to have booked

Paolo was extremely helpful, particularly with arranging taxis and making reservations. The apartment is bright, cheerful, and comfortable. The neighborhood is nice with a grocery close by. I highly recommend it!
Lovely, clean place, very central location, good communication with host, Altea was very helpful..

Place was as described, ideal for solo stay. Clean room and bathroom. Location is also near the important tourist spots and some great restaurants.
Altea was quick to respond on messages about any questions. She also was very flexible in letting me check-in early and also let me leave my baggage in the apartment till my train.
Great location and place to stay! Felt safe and clean. Altea was so helpful and responsive with anything we needed. Recommend!!
Excelente location in the city center, close to everything you need to see in Florence. Altea is very responsive and good host.

Gracious host & quick to respond & offer suggestions for things to do. There is a bus  line ATAF from the train station which stops just a block away which makes getting there with luggage much easier. Instructions with this info would be helpful.  Otherwise about a 20-25 min walk from train. Taxis are expensive. Generally good location with easy access to attractions. There are 3 flights of narrow stairs to go up so be prepared for that. Home was a good layout for our group, but really could use a good deep cleaning.

Great place to explore and enjoy Florence. Positioned perfectly near St. Croze, 10 minutes to the dome. The terrace is perfect for a long breakfast, provided the weather is good. but everything comes at a price: the stairs are steep and many, so dont forget your wallet when goung out, otherwise you get some free workout:-)
Alderighi is a great and generous host, we couldnt expect more!

The apartment is located in a superb location, within a few minutes walk of restaurants, cafes, shops and the main sights. The apartment is also very clean, bright, well equipped and accommodated really well our group of 5. I have no words to describe how thoughtful and helpful the host Paolo was during our stay in Florence, he was very responsive and went above and beyond helping me to organise a birthday dinner for my mom, an unforgettable experience all together.
Grazie mille Paolo! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Great place to stay. Easy to walk to a bunch of great places. Quiet during the day and at night. Paolo was very responsive to messages. The air conditioners worked great. The ceilings are a bit low so if you’re over 6 feet tall you might have issues. Otherwise, a great experience.

Paolo is a gracious host who greeted us on arrival and made check in very smooth.
He also booked us dinner for the first night as he knew we were arriving late.
The apartment is central and close to everything. We walked only 15 mins at most to get to all of the major sights.
The train station is only a 20 minute walk.
The kitchen is fully equipped which made it easy for us as a family with allergies to cook all our meals and there is a huge supermarket just downstairs along with a butcher and fruit and vegetable stand.
We loved our time in Florence.
Thank you Paolo.
Amazing location just a few minutes' walk from the Duomo. I extended my stay in this place because I liked it so much. It has a rustic and charming feel that makes guests feel cozy.

Alderighi is a great host - he was flexible regarding check-in even when our train was late, gave us a quick tour of the apartment then left us to enjoy our stay. It quickly felt like home and was plenty of space for a couple. The terrace is the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee or watch the amazing sunsets!! We cooked dinner one night and found enough equipment in the kitchen for our needs. The location is INCREDIBLE! Close enough to the action but quiet enough to feel private and safe, plus being right next to the Santa Croce basilica and square was a real bonus
absolutely brilliant location and amazingly spacious - very comfortable and everything works well and the stairs help work off the effects of dinner !
Great apartment with a lovely terrace. Super central location right next to Piazza Santa Croce. Alderighi was also very nice and did the checkin in person.

Paolo was an amazing host, super attentive. He even made a dinner reservation to a local restaurant for us. Everything was organized and clean, the location of the airbnb is excellent, close to all the main attractions but the area is not super touristy. Overall a great experience. 5 stars for Paolo!

Super charming apartment directly under the wooden roof with a nice view on the towers of the city. Nicely decorated, comfortable to live in and easy to feel at home. Alderighi was always kind and helpful. Total recommendation.
This place is clean, well taken care of, in a perfect location, and near great restaurants.  Cozy with a nice view.

Quiet place, very central to everything. What you need in the kitchen. Awesome balcony but really to hot to enjoy at the end of June. Haha. Very easy communication with host and easy check in. 80 steps up to the apartment, but it’s good exercise. Will recommend.

Excellent Airbnb in a great location in Florence. Communication with Alderighi was great, he was very accommodating and he met up with us for check in.
A few flights of stairs to get up, not a problem for us and so worth the rooftop deck. This place is such as great value and I would recommend it to anyone staying in Florence.

We love this place everything was close for our convenience.
We definitely will comeback to this beautiful city and spend a few days in this beautiful apartment.
Thank you so much for been so patient with us.
This place was fantastic!! Location was amazing, apartment was clean and host was extremely nice/responsive. If we ever come back to Florence we will definitely book again!

Thanks for a lovely stay Tommaso! Can’t beat this apartment for location, right near to Santa Maria Novella and a quick walk to lots of great restaurants. Tommaso was accomodating enough to allow us to check-in early, the only hiccup we had was organising bedding for the sofa beds (which had an extra charge we weren’t expecting) and getting this sorted out - we needed our Italian friend to help translate to get all the bedding sorted to be able to make up full beds on the couches. Otherwise, a perfect stay!
This is a great apartment with a great location, super clean and great for my family. The host is very helpful and responsive.
Great location walkable to all Fiorenze main places to visit as well as restaurants and train station.
Perfect location. Easily workable to the tourists’ places and lots of bakeries and restaurants nearby. They are very responsive and the rooms are clean and nice! We enjoyed our stay here.

Alderighi’s place is in a great location, away from the summer crowds but walkable to everything you want to see, with plenty of restaurants and things nearby. The apartment is spacious and the patio is a beautiful place to enjoy coffee in the morning before exploring for the day. We had an issue with the hot water but Alderighi was very responsive in efforts to fix it. The apartment has AC which was great! The linens could use some updating but overalll this place is a great stay and Alderighi is close by to assist with check in and anything else you may need.

Great stay in this very unique space! Loved how walkable everything was while still managing to be on a quiet and peaceful street - the perfect combo! Much thanks to Alderighi, who was always helpful and even brought my large suitcase all the way up that very intimidating staircase - so kind of him! Thank you for everything and I hope to be back soon!

Location is good and the terrace was perfect for afternoon and evening sun. The apartment has everything you would need. Lots of stairs but that makes it quiet and private. Nice cafes and restaurants right outside. Worth a heads up that the flat certainly feels 'lived in' but homley. We would come again as it feels like a great deal for the terrace and location.
Fantastic host who met us early and ran through the essentials, even carried our bags for us up the stairs.
Lucas place was phenomenal! The apartment was sparkling clean and at a perfect location. Luca was very accommodating to our schedule and let us check out early. He was wonderful to work with!

Wonderful location in a quieter piazza very close to Duomo. Small elevator available or two flights of stairs. Very comfortable for our group of 4 adults, 4 children and an infant. Luca was incredibly attentive and also arranged a very detailed self check-in and allowed us to drop our bags early. Great stay!
Amazing location! Close to lots of sites!  Host was super helpful with arranging a parking spot very close to the b&b.  Also, very responsive!  Would totally stay again!

Great location, walking distance from everything I wanted to see in Florence. It is also super close to the station only a 5-min. walk there when going places outside Florence. The place was clean and looked great.
The apartment sleeps great for 8 people. Perfect location, very clean and beautifully decorated. Thanks again for the stay!

A nicely decorated, spacious, fresh and very clean apartment really easy to access in a great location.  The host, Luca, made it very easy to check-in, gave a great recommendation for dinner (Za-Za) which did take-out also, and was very accommodating with cleaning time and leaving our luggage.  The beds were so comfortable and I slept so well.  It was also nice to have a bathroom for each bedroom.  Everything we needed was easy to find: iron, ironing board, corkscrew etc. Highly recommend.
Really nice host and apartment, I definitely recommend it. The location is very nice and the host was always replying very quickly.
Beautiful, clean apartment with amazing location. Check in was easy and the host was very helpful. thank you for everything.

Very large bedrooms and bathrooms. Easy access from train station and tram to airport. Next to Cappelle Medici which was closed during our stay, apparently for restoration. Close to the Duomo as well. Fine shops around including a dollar store where we got our water and soft drinks. Luca was very ready to respond to all our questions.  We felt very secure in the apartment. We would come back again.

Alderighi’s place was the perfect pit stop for a couple days in Florence before my husband and I went to spend the rest of our trip in the countryside. Despite being conveniently located near lots of the city attractions, it was quiet at night and we had a lovely stay. The bathroom could have been a little cleaner but nothing major at all. The air conditioning was much appreciated in the July heat after long days of walking!

We had an exceptional stay at Luca’s place. Perfect location, about a 7 minute walk from the train station and central to everything you would want to see in Florence (a 5-15 minute walk to most attractions). The rooms were beautiful with a splendid view, beds comfortable, bathrooms sparkling clean, and very spacious. Loved having a washer while we were on a 2 week trip. Luca was an excellent communicator and the check in/out process was easy and seamless. Would definitely stay here again. Cant recommend this place enough!
This apartment was in the best location! Can't get any better. A few minutes walk from the train! It was big, comfortable and Beautiful. Thank you!
Apartment is in a perfect location and was furnished beautifully. Had an issue with the boiler but that was not the hosts fault I understand things break.

The location is very optimal and in city center. Very optimal for walking to all the main attractions that Florence has to offer. The self-checkin process was also very streamlined and easy. The hosts also makes a very comprehensive guide for how to checkin and what to do.

Luca’s place is amazing!! Aesthetically pleasing to the eye, spacious and most comfortable for the few nights we stayed there. It’s central location makes it a breeze to walk around the city. Luca was most helpful with all our enquires and responds quickly with a friendly demeanor. Don’t think twice about booking..  just do it! You will not regret it.
Luca’s place was wonderful. It was spotlessly clean, spacious, beautiful and in a great location. He was very good with communication and helped to organise the bed configuration that we needed.
Great location in the beautiful city. The apartment was clean and organized with everything you need. Luca is a great host. His guide was extremely helpful and easy to follow.
Great location! Walkable to everything local. Close to the train station (5 minute walk), quiet, cute, and clean!

This apartment is so cute and the decor in each room is beautiful.  Like out of a magazine.  With 2 spacious bedrooms and bathrooms, this place was perfect for our family of 4.  Minutes from the Duomo and lots of restaurants in walking distances.  Thank you for a great stay!
What a fantastic place! The location is perfect for everything Florence!  It was very clean, the host was very accommodating, and it's definitely a 5 star stay!  Perfect in every way!

Very clean, had all the amenities we needed and more. They also provided useful information to get around, places to eat, where to go.
Very prompt to response for any questions we had and quick to fix any issues we encountered. Definitely will stay here again.

We really enjoyed our stay in Florence in the apartment, it was very well located, very clean (freshly renovated!) and had everything one could need. The shower was awesome. Dania and her Husband were super warm and kind hosts, really helpful with all the questions we had and after we missed our bus back to Venice it was no problem to spontaneously stay for one more night. I would happily come there again anytime! :)
Thank you for having us!

Beautiful apartment, right next to the train station! Definitely check out the Indian restaurant downstairs. Easy check in and out! This was our favorite stay of our trip. Apartment had all the necessary amenities and AC!! Would stay again. Dania and her father were the best and very hospitable. Thank you for letting us stay in your wonderful home!

Dania was an amazing host! She gave us such a warm welcome and ensured all of our questions were answered. She also gave us tons of food recommendations and was always available for any questions we had! Would definitely come back again!

The place was beautiful and super cozy. It was perfect for both relaxing and visiting all the beautiful places in Firenze. And Dania was very kind and made it easy for us to check-in/out. Also a huge thanks for the late check out! I wouldn't hesitate to be here again when I visit Firenze :)

We enjoyed our stay at Dania's place. She was super nice and allowed us for a late checkout which came in handy on the rainy day (literally :))
We'd stay here again anytime....

Dania was a wonderful host. She gave us so many ideas and information to help us make the most of our visit.
She greeted us at check in and was easy to reach if needed. Bed was very comfortable for us, and space well equipped and modern.
Thank you Dania for your kindness:)
It was a very neat and cozy hotel. It was the largest and most comfortable hotel in Italy, and it was nice to have many amenities. The host was so warm and friendly!

We had a great stay at Dania’s apartment. A home away from home, lots of sunlight and thoughtfully furnished. I had a pleasant sleep thanks to the comfortable pillow and bed. Dania was very friendly and easily contactable for anything. Definitely recommend!

The apartment was spotless and had everything you need to feel comfortable.  The location was a short walk to the centre.  Dania was a wonderful host, great communication and was very sweet. I would definitely stay here again!

The place was exactly like the photos, it was cozy, very clean and very well located, plus Dania, our host, was helpful, attentive and super friendly, which is why we will definitely stay here when we visit Florence on another occasion. 100% recommended
Dania was a wonderful host and her apartment was spotless and felt spacious. We were very comfortable there and it as an easy walk to and from the train station.

We had an amazing stay at Dania’s place! She met us upon arrival and gave excellent recommendations for area restaurants. The place was clean and great access to all the sights! Close to the train station which made travel easy. It was clean, well stocked amd in a safe area. We will definitely be back!
Dania was very friendly and responsive, and her apartment is very nice —clean, comfortable, and tidy

Dania’s apartment is very comfy and lovely. Everything is perfect and we couldn’t ask for more. She is so friendly and helpful. She allowed us to store our luggages prior to the check-in time. Also, she provided a room tour and detail advice for things to try in Florence. We enjoyed the stay so much and would definitely recommended!

Dania is a great host, very friendly and accommodating, she made sure we were all fine and feeling as at home. The place is just the BEST one throughout our trip in Italy.
The apartment is very close to Florence train station and is at walkable distance to all tourist spots! It is spacious, spotless clean and equipped with everything we need! All the fixture and hardware are in high quality and we just didn’t want to go out and to enjoy the apartment instead.
Couldn’t ask for more and will definitely staying at the same place if we are returning in the future! Highly recommend to everyone who are visiting Florence!
It's really nice house. Bus stop is so close so it's easy to go to city center. Also, you can find supermerket near this house. Everything was perfect.

If in your price range, this has to be one of the best Airbnbs in Florence.  Beautiful apartment, more than enough space for us and our two grown children. Outstanding soundproofing (you're in center of Florence, after all) and appliances.  Roof deck alone makes it worth it.  Host met us at the property, with his family, and gave us great local advice - a nice old school touch I find lacking with many Airbnb rentals these days.

Emiliano was wonderful.  Only thing which he could not control or avoid was the noise level on the streets at night.  Only other difficulty was the 4 flights of stairs were tough.   Otherwise, we had a wonderful time and we were close by everything!  We loved our stay.

Would totally recommend this place!  It’s right in the middle of Florence and everything is walkable.  The place is beautiful, felt very luxurious with a lot of effort put into the finishing.  Emiliano was very accommodating.  Was a great place to stay if you want to stay in the central Florence area.  Place was comfortable and very clean.

Emiliano was a great host! He helped us with our bags! Both coming and going. He gave us great recommendations on restaurants and things to do nearby. His place was perfect for our group. The rooftop patio was our favorite spot! Would definitely stay there again! Great location! Great space!!

This was an amazing location, right in the middle of everything yet quiet and peaceful for an evening of relaxing. The terrace was the perfect place to enjoy our panini and a hope cooked meal one night. Emiliano was the perfect host, including helping us get a dinner reservation and guiding us to the best pizza around! We look forward to booking again next time we’re in Florence!

The apartment is exactly as listed. Emiliano was incredibly responsive and kind. He met us and walked us through everything upon arrival. We stayed with two adults and 14 teenagers and the layout was absolutely perfect! I would highly recommend this apartment. We loved the rooftop terrace. The washer worked great and was nice to have. Emiliano also included laundry detergent, which was so nice! Emiliano goes above and beyond to make sure that your stay is absolutely perfect!

Emiliano was the best host - super responsive, helpful and provided great recommendations. The apartment was fantastic. Even better than it looked online. Spotless, beautifully designed and meticulously organized. Bathrooms were spa-like. Location was convenient to everything (with a popular sandwich shop across the street that our kids loved). The rooftop terrace was beautiful as well. SO glad we found this gem of a place!
Emiliano was an excellent host. The location was perfect and the apartment is beautiful. Emiliano gave great local recommendations. Loved it!
Super friendly host and a great apartment right at the centre of the city, location is amazing as is the beautiful view from the roof terrace.
Great place, great location, quiet at night for a good night's sleep! Made our stay wonderful and we'd stay again.

You can't go wrong staying here. If all of Numa's properties are this nice, you'll be satisfied wherever you stay with them. It's beautiful, spacious, they leave amazing gifts for your visit, and great at communicating. I'll be looking to book with them in the future! :)
High end apartment in an amazing location near the Ponte Vecchio!  The terrace overlooking the city was the perfect place to end the day!  Would highly recommend to any couple .

Great location and wonderful host. we've visited Firenze many times but this will be our new goto rental. The apartment is clean and includes all the amenities. Pictures are accurate and the patio is wonderful for coffee in the morning. the location is only a 5 minute walk to the heart of the city.

The Airbnb had beautiful architecture, an amazing view of the Duomo from the private patio, and was walking distance from the Ponte Vecchio (although you have to walk up/down a pretty steep hill). It felt very private, like we were living in Florence. The biggest negative was the AC. We had it set to the lowest setting (18°C) and the temperature never went below (25°C). It was very hot and difficult to sleep. If we would have known this, we probably wouldn’t have stayed here (especially for the price).
Cinzia’s communication was incredible! She gave us tons of restaurant recommendations and was extremely responsive.

this place was exactly as described. minimalist, elegant with many thoughtful touches.  we had some treats ready for us upon arrival and there were all the amenities we needed.  the location was peaceful with a great view.  it is tucked a little out of the way but close to things you want to do especially Ponte veccio bridge.  our only critique was that the mattress was quite hard but that is also personal preference.  the host was a great communicator and there for all we needed.

Cannot say enough about the view from the flat. Cleverly configured with a modern feel. Though it is a little up a hill, that’s what made for the view!  Cinzia was responsive and helpful. We will stay again hopefully!
Everything was perfect: spacious and clean room, hosts attentive and always available and great location. Thank you guys, very great surprise with high-quality services, I strongly recommend it!
One of the best B&Bs I have stayed in! Andrea is very kind and helpful and the rooms are great and very clean.
Very clean and convenient.  WiFi was not working which was a major bummer.  Lights flickered in room and AC blew warm air.
Clean and very comfortable, spacious room with life saving air conditioning during an unusually warm June.  Walkable to all Florence has to offer!
It was a nice place. Very close to the inner city. The bed was pretty uncomfortable though. All in all it was a good stay

Great room plus you get a small breakfast in the morning. If you’re a light sleeper the noise from the street is relatively loud but earplugs were provided by the host. It’s about a 20-30 minute walk to get to all of the historical sites. All around, it was perfect for us.
Nice location to the center , nice room, and nice host! Andrea specially waited there for me to receive me and introduce me about the room, thank you.
Nice little spot close to a parking garage which comes in handy if you travel by car. Excellent location to explore Florence.

A nice journey of two nights!
Well located, between 20-25mn from the train station Santa Maria Novella.
Everything was very well explained, an easy self check in, a spacious room (with some information about the city of Firenze) and a nice breakfast!
Andrea is very responsive :)
Grazie per tutto!

Andrea was an excellent host!! Highly recommend. Communication was great and the place was neat and tidy. Andrea was always there if we needed anything and made us feel at home. Would definitely stay there again!
Andrea went above and beyond what would ever be expected of a host. If you need anything he will do whatever he can to help you out. I’ve not met a nicer host than Andrea.
Great stay here! It’s a bit of a walk to the main center (we never tried the bus) but worth it. Nice to be not in the very touristy area

The room was super nice and clean. Self check in was also easy.  It is located close to the city center - like 20 minutes walk. The room was a little noisy because it’s right next to the road. But ear plugs are provided so it worked really well for me. I slept very well. Very nice stay overall 😊

Lele was a great host, we have an easy communication with him. The room is just as it looked on the pictures. Everything was super clean and quiet. The grocery store (alimentari) in front is amazing to buy fresh artisan Italian foods

Very nice room in Florence! It was waking distance from the train station and to the main sites of the city!! Host was super nice and we had to be let back in to the building after checking out to retrieve a forgotten item and he was very friendly and prompt in helping us out!
Clean, bright, spacious, and wonderful location! So close to everything you need but on a street that is relatively quiet at night. We would definitely stay here again.
Really excellent location and great communication by the host. The place had everything we needed for a short stay.

Luca was so kind, and the apartment was perfect for my boyfriend and I to share.
very convenient location as well! definitely recommend!

This apartment is perfectly located between the train station and all of the major city sites of Florence. Luca, was a very accommodating and responsive host, when I had many flight and train issues getting there he was flexible with timing and helped me get situated after a long day of travel. Would recommend this spot to anyone visiting Florence. Thanks Luca!
The place is great. Absolutely recommend! The host is helpful and responsive. Fully enjoyed my stay.
Luca greeted us upon check in. The place was clean and spacious. The location is great. Easily walkable to all the major sites. Would recommend.

Our stay at Luca's was wonderful. Luca was an incredible host, extremely responsive and helpful. The location is right down the street from two major sites in Firenze but still remained peaceful for us. Thank you so much for your hospitality!

What a fantastic location for exploring Florence!
Very close and walkable to the Academia (which houses the David), the Duomo (more impressive outside than in), and the Uffizi (strongly recommend a small group guided tour with CiaoFlorence!).
While there is a three floor walk up... once inside the apartment, it is basic, but an excellent use of space, and comfortable; everything one needs is provided. We loved opening the doors onto the quiet courtyard, and enjoying hearing the ringing of cathedral bells each morning at 7 am.
Luca was very patient and accommodating as our travel plans shifted our intended arrival time. We would absolutely stay here again!

If you plan on staying in Florence, this Flat is an absolute must.
It is a real gem. Big, clean, perfectly located, and astonishingly beautiful.
As I'm sure you already saw on the pictures the Flat is a beautiful combination of real, original frescos and modern design elements. The location is perfect, as it is about an 1 minute walk to the Dome.
Communication with the owner was very uncomplicated.
All in all a perfect stay. I'm definitely going to come back.

Excellent location only yards from Ponte Vecchio. Very close the the Pitti Palace and the Santa Spirito Square!
Great studio apartment and lots of very useful tips for places to eat from host on arrival!
Would highly recommend!
While the space is small, it is very stylish, clean, and in an absolutely fantastic location just a few minutes walk from Ponte Vecchio, the Uffizi Gallery, and other sights to see.

Simona was a great host. Super responsive to all
Messages! Had great suggestions in the host book. Apartment is truly unique with the frescoes and very spacious!!
Simona is very responsive and had tons of recommendations to help make your Florence stay wonderful! Apartment is spacious, clean and in prime location. Would definitely stay again!

We stayed in this incredible apartment for four nights. It is described exactly as we found it. Even more impressive in person. There was everything we could have needed in the apartment and top quality appliances. It was so nice to wash our clothes after five days on the road. The bed was large and super comfortable. The location is close to the Accademia Gallery and the Duomo. And only an 8 minute walk to Uffizi and Ponte Vecchio. We walked to everything. And the apartment was incredibly clean.
Simona, our host, was fabulous. She was proactive in communicating with us before, during and after our stay. She provided several great recommendations—trust her opinion, you can’t go wrong! If we had a question, Simona responded back to us within a few minutes. She has been the best host we’ve had on our 17 day vacation to Italy! She made our stay perfect!

Simona is a fabulous host! Very responsive and thoughtful. The apartment is just as described, very spacious and quiet at night. Centrally located to every site you’d ever want to see in Florence!! Highly recommend staying in this lovely unit!!
Great location! The hosts were super helpful and great communicators. The apartment itself is very cold, not very cozy. Certainly feels un-lived in.

Simona’s place was amazing.  Perfect location, very clean and it had all the amenities.  Her recommendation of Martare was impeccable as well as her other recommendations.  Would definitely stay again

I highly recommend Simona’s place. I have nothing but amazing things to say,  everything was as described, Simona is an amazing host, and the location is conveniently close to everything. Simona is very responsive and attentive, she made sure everything was going smoothly. The location is amazing and I found it to be peaceful and quiet. It is less than a 5 minute walk to the Duomo and less than a 10 minute walk to the train station. What can I say, the location was perfect. Lastly, the apartment is great! The bed is comfortable, the temperature inside was great (we visited in February) and it has all the amenities. I would definitely stay at Simona’s place again!

Simona’s home was spectacular. It’s located perfectly to many restaurants and super close to the Duomo. It’s about 10 minute walk from the train station and the house is very modern. The gelato spot that was recommended by Simone was the cherry on top. We visited 3x because the rest does not compare! Thank you for being a great host and so attentive.
Very clean, complete and compact studio at fantastic location! Everything was there, even more than we were expecting. Very good place to stay.

The location of the studio is amazing, literally two steps away from Ponte Vecchio and all the other must see's in Florence. It was really clean and well equipped.
Communication with Lorenzo was great, we had a small issue with heating and he reacted right away.
Highly recommended for a short stay in beautiful Florence!

Where to start! Simona was an amazing host! Very proactive and responsive!
The location of the apartment was exactly as described with quick walks to restaurants, shopping and the train station. The Duomo is one street over!
The apartment was modern and up to date on the inside, yet maintained the charm of Florence.
Highly recommend.

The location is amazing and the apartment has everything you need for your stay. Very clean and comfortable!
Lorenzo was very kind and let us in late after our flight was delayed and had great suggestions for places to eat!!

Perfectly located, beautiful studio space! If you’re a very light sleeper like me, bring some earplugs for sleeping as there is sometimes pedestrian / occasional zooming scooter at night. Lift is teeny tiny but perfect for 1 person! Loved staying here and Lorenzo was great :)

Perfect studio for a short stay in Firenze. Was like a small hotel room but with cooking facilities. The studio had everything we needed. Good communication with Lorenzo, easy and swift check in. Perfect location.

We really loved our stay here. It was so comfortable, and the location was perfect. The bed was comfortable, the air conditioning was effective, and Lorenzo was extremely helpful throughout our entire stay.
Location was perfect for our stay. Liked being able to eat breakfast at home before heading out for the day.

Lorenzo's studio was a great choice. the location is perfect- right next to Ponte Vecchio. Lorenzo is very friendly and will give you great recommendations on restaurants and places to visit. the studio itself is very cozy and comes with everything you need
The apartment was in the perfect location for exploring florence, and the space was comfortable and clean. The kitchenette was very small and a bit difficult to use but it did the trick!
We enjoyed a lot being in Lorenzo's place. The location of the apartment is perfect and his restaurant recommendations were amazing!
Unbeatable location! Stylish and squeaky clean, this rental was a wonderful stay in a city full of wonders.

Simona's apartment was not only beautiful, it was spacious and very comfortable. On a quiet street, it was the perfect location for walking around Florence and getting to all of the major sites and train station. We felt right at home! The apartment was clean as a whistle, the beds were super comfortable and it was easy to get in and out when we needed to. Great place to stay!

We loved our stay in Florence. So many reviews have talked about living among the frescoes and brick treasures, and we loved that too. The bed and pillows were such a welcome to come back to after exploring all day. Best sleep in our two week stay throughout Italy! We think having access to Simona set this place on a different higher level. Her suggestions for food, transportation, sites, more food…..priceless. Such a great host! Don’t hesitate to book this beautiful place, if it’s  available you want it!

We really enjoyed staying in this spacious and open apartment that although in a busy tourist area was private and quiet.  The proximity to the  Duomo was awe inspiring and we were able to walk about and see many delightful sights from our doorstep!
Great location, super clean and spacious, and had everything we could need. One of their restaurant recommendations was our favorite meal in Florence❤️
Lorenzo was a wonderful host and was willing to assist us with some unexpected changes. Thanks for a great stay!

We stayed at Lorenzo's for a few days. He was really helpful and gave us loads of great recommendations (the gelato places were particularly good!). The apartment is perfectly located so you can walk to most of the main tourist attractions within 15-20 minutes. It was very clean and well kept and met all of our expectations. I would definitely recommend it to anyone who wants to visit Florence.

Perfect place to stay in Florence, location is everything.. is 1 min walking from Ponte Vecchio which is one of the main attractions in Florence, but the apartment is located on the “not so tourist” side of the bridge which is perfect. You’re close to everything without being in the crowded and more expensive areas. You can walk everywhere you want. The apartment is small but roomy enough, you have all you need in there but even if you don’t, there’s a little market and a laundry place right downstairs across the street.
I would totally recommend this places! Lorenzo was beyond incredible, really welcoming and gave us a few recommendations. Checking in was really easy and flexible since I got there a little earlier than expected. Book this place, you won’t regret it!
Lorenzo was wonderful! For anyone looking to stay in Firenze, this is a great location. Thanks for everything!!

Excellent location and Lorenzo very good host.
Check out very early at 10am, linens not professional - above bedsheet was bedcover instead of normal. Bed was small for 2 people. Iron not existing as mentioned .
There was no Soundproofing.
In general, was not an apartment, was like a student bedroom with apartments facilities.

A great location for popping into during the day for a breather. Located perfectly at the south end of the Ponte Vecchio.
Top floor location with a handy elevator.
Simona's place was great. Unique, clean, and full of all amenities that were needed. Simona was so proactive about communication, we felt like she was so concerned for us during our stay. Thank you!

Simona was a great host and very helpful with all informations we needed! This place is so nice and it is even more beautiful than on the photos. Location couldn’t be better! Would totally recommend 👌

My wife absolutely loved the mirror in the bathroom that had a light built into it. The frescoes on all of the walls were beautiful and made you feel as though you were living in Renaissance times in Florence the street below is lively, but totally shut out when you close the windows. This Airbnb had more room than most of the ones we have ever gotten in Europe. Directly down the street from the Duomo and so close to anything you could want to do in Florence and I truly can’t express enough how big the actual space is me and my wife are both above 6 feet tall and felt dwarfed by the size of this apartment. The TVs were awesome, especially the huge one in the bedroom where you could lay down in the bed at the end of the night and watch a little bit of TV. We are already planning on coming back to Florence and when we do, we hope to stay here.
Great location. It’s pretty much a hotel room. Walls are kind of cool. Checkout isn’t flexible but they were helpful with getting us there with a car.

Had a great stay at Lorenzo’s place! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in a great location. Lorenzo was responsive and helpful throughout. Would definitely recommend to anyone visiting Florence!
very nice quirky apartment with everything you could need. huge comfy bed and all things provided. great location although a little noisy

A stunning place to stay in a stunning city! Location was perfect and the apartment was sensational. Great communication and local tips from Simona
Highly recommend!

What an incredible place and equally incredible hosts. We loved our stay at Simona & Jacobo’s wonderful apartment. It was everything described and more. The location couldn’t come much more central to all the main attractions of Florence, we enjoyed our time so much here. The check in process was straightforward, communication was so easy and your recommendations were so greatly welcomed.
Thanks so much for making our stay so enjoyable, we’d love to come back. 😃

The best place to stay in Florence!!
Simona & Jacopo’s place is a beautiful blend of ancient history and smartly designed, clean modern comfort! Great neighborhood, spacious place, wonderful sleep, excellent restaurants & everything Florence has to offer is so close! We loved our stay! In such a cultural city, their place made it all the more enchanting!
Simona & Jacopo’s communication was what we needed, when we needed & more. Excellent!
We’ve stayed in some great Airb&b’s. Their’s is truly a standout! We’ll be back on our next visit to Florence!

This was a perfect trip from
Start to finish! So responsive, such a great location, and proactive and kind in her messages. Even little touches like having chargers for USA ports, ponchos and umbrellas for when it rained, and step by step clear instructions - all was fabulous!
Laura and Leonardo were extremely helpful. They went out of their way to make sure our visit is a remarkable one. They succeeded in meeting our expectations and we’ll definitely visit again.
Beautiful, clean, safe apartment. I would 100% recommend. Only problem was the AC did not work.

Flat is very new and with brilliant design. Every flat has its own theme, So comfortable and clean. Leonardo is very good host. He is super kind and make us feel very welcome. On the check out day the parking garage was in construction, but Leonardo know we are leaving in the afternoon and he try his best to help us to negotiate with the construction team and make us leaving on time without any delay. I will highly recommended Leonardo’s flat. Thanks again

This is an apartment that is almost at a 5 Star Hotel Level. It is a hotel-apartment. The amenities, welcome gifts and furniture were all of top quality. Located at a comfortable location, all the landmarks you need to visit is within a 15-25 mins walk. It is also a safe neighbourhood. However, occupants need to take note of the door opening technique (pull inwards), the jacuzzi cleanliness etc. It would also be better if Leonardo and his co-host could at least reply me with regards to changes in public transportation routes due to constructions and the Calcio Storico. Otherwise, this is a place absolutely worthy of it’s premium price tag!
Great apartment walking distance to main attractions in Florence and in a beautiful and safe area. Attentive host, left us some coffee and prosecco as a welcome! Best place!

We had a great! It's a great place with a clean and cozy atmosphere. The location is perfect, with easy access to shops, restaurants, and key attractions . The host was incredibly responsive and caring, making sure all my needs were met throughout our stay. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient stay in Firenze.
The location of the apartment is great as the center is easily reachable by walking or busses which leave right outside the building. At night it can be a bit loud due to bars and traffic.

This location is excellent and we cannot recommenced it enough. If you have the opportunity, snag it!
It is about a 15 minutes walk along the Arno to the Ponte Veccio and nearby sights. The cottage itself is modern and spacious. The staff are super friendly and willing to help. Definitely recommend!

Many thanks to hotel Orcagna for having us. My wife and I were looking for a place to stay for a few days as we explored Florence. The hotel staff were warm and helpful. The hot tub was a added bonus and a special treat at the end of an evening walking around Florence. We were also able to hire some bicycles from the reception for a very decent price. I would recommend.

This place is wonderful! It’s within a hotel property, but have its own entrance, very secure. Nice furnitures and bathroom. Lots of restaurants and shops around. Communication with the host was very easy and smooth. I would stay here again!
The room was spacious, clean, and nice. The location was also good! Only problem is that there is no private parking, so we had to find a place in the street for the car. Anyway, I recommend!

Great location as 10 minute walk to town center. In nice area with high end grocery store close by. Building was very nice, high ceilings, lots of room, modern kitchen, and all amenities felt like staying in W Hotel. Leonardo was also very nice checking us in, showing apartment, and stopping into make sure all was going well.
Excellent apartment. Very close to local attractions. The host made us feel welcome and was easily reachable if we had any questions.

Beautiful. Close to everything you want to do in Florence! Would have given 5 stars for everything, but minor things (no dishwasher det, soap, etc., very few towels - there is a washer but no det and very smelly because front loader left closed smelled up bathroom). The kitchen had everything, other than clean up stuff, that you would ever use. Beautiful rooms and and a ton of space! Would stay again.
Best location , very comfortable king size beds, tons of space  , huge closets & storage - amazing showers , SAFE, secure, clean and will stay again!

Beautiful building in a great location.
Check in was a little shaky, but language barrier, train schedules, etc. make check in tough.
Great people here.
Only real negative was that washing machine in the unit was broken the whole stay.
We would ask to stay here again.
City is fabulous.

Had a very comfortable stay in this really huge and spacious apartment. The location is just amazing - just couple of minutes from the Ponte Vecchio.
The host was also very accommodating and arranged for an early check in for us.
All in all a very recommendable place.
stylish and large apartment in walking distance to everything.  Deanna is a great host. we enjoyed the home very much.
Great place!  Is larger than it looks in the pictures. Easy to walk to main spots, great rooms. The smaller doesn’t have its own AC but it keeps cold
Lovely apartment. Would love to stay here again in the next time we visit Florence. Fits 5 comfortably. Til next time ciao!

We had a fabulous day at Casa Cozi. This place was really above and beyond our expectations.  It was one of the best places we stayed in Italy. We were beyond impressed and felt at home.  Highly recommend!!!

We had a great stay at Casa Cosi and it provided us with exactly what we needed for our time in Florence. It’s walkable to all of the main Florence attractions and neighborhoods, and provided a wonderful space and comfortable bedrooms for our stay. It was easy to find, and we would definitely stay here again! The apartment itself was very clean and as described.
Great, big apartment in Florence. 20 minute walk to the city center. Would definitely stay there again!
Great place and very close to the train station. Thank you for hosting me, definitely would book with you again next time I am back in Florence.

The highlight of this apartment is definitely the space and location. It was walking distance from the train station, supermarket and there are many eateries in the vicinity.

Do review the items in the listings on what this place offers. The fully equipped kitchen did not come with a kettle but Andrea, who was extremely responsive, provided with a brand new one right away. Andrea was also very flexible with allowing us to leave our bags in the apartment ahead of check-in time.
The furniture in the living space amd bedroom and bathroom were a little dated. Not a huge issue for short stays.
To mention a few points: The wooden chair in the bedroom had fine cracks and pinched your skin when sat on. The wardrobe hanging rod was unconventionally high, and the vanity cabinet and ceiling in the bathroom would do better with an overhaul.
Overall, our stay was generally pleasant.
Was an awesome place to stay with great recommendations for food and sightseeing. Would recommend and stay again in the future.
Andrea was a great host! The place was clean and in a perfect location. Would definitely recommend :)
great location, 5 minutes to the train station! We were never more than 20ish minutes away from home. Nice and cozy, felt like home
Such a lovely house, with a great location. Salvatore was very nice to us .lovely experience

This place is amazing. Without any second thought, if you see this place available on airbnb during your dates of travel, GO AHEAD AND BOOK IT IMMEDIATELY. Salvatore is a great host and his place (and amenities at his place) is impeccable. Me and my girl friend, we had a great time staying at his place. We will definitely return.
Salvatore is very welcoming and had lots of suggestions what to visit in Firenze. His place is very comfortable and spacious.  I happily recomend it to everyone. Thanks again Salvatore.

What a great apartment! We loved our stay with Salvatore. The room is in a great location and it is much larger than I expected. He also left us breakfast snacks and a bottle of wine! We would definitely stay again.

This is the best Airbnb that we have had. The place is bigger than it looks in the picture and it is so clean. The location is perfect within walking distance to everywhere. We would stay there again next time in Florence. Thanks Salvatore for your hospitality!

It is perfect house for stay Firenze!!
Location, housing, and Host' kindnesss Everything is so nice and so good. If I back to Firenze, I will book here again! Thx Salvatore!!

The airbnb is well equipped and the location is unbeatable! It's literally 2 min from the Duomo, Galleria dell' Academia, San Lorenzo etc. Salvatore met us for check-in and also gave us some great recommendations regarding restaurants. The apartment itself was also very cosy and super clean!
Perfect place and location to stay in Florence. We loved how close it was so all the hot spots. Also great aircon and was very quiet during the night. Wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again!

Loved my stay in Salvatore's place. It was clean, close to everything (max 15-20 minute walk), and the check in process was clear and straight forward. Salvatore went above and beyond to answer all my questions before I arrived and was very responsive during my stay. The wifi worked great and supported video streaming for anyone working remote and I did not find myself wishing there was anything more.

Salvatore was easily a 5-star host! He was so welcoming and offered many tips for the city. He even hand drew a map of all the things we should see and eat. The location could not have been more perfect with many attractions minutes away. The place itself was much bigger than expected, clean and comfortable. Highly recommend!
Salvatore is a great host and the place very nice and in a perfect location, right near the duomo and many restaurants and stores.

Salvatore's place is just the perfect stay in the heart of Florence. Everything is at a walking distance. Salvatore and his wife are very accommodating and really sweet.  The appartment is beautiful with all amenities and has a beautiful view of the cathedral from the window. If you're looking to explore the city of Florence, this is a must stay. Thanks, Salvatore!!

A lovely cool apartment so conveniently located. The duomo is 3 mins away and you can walk to the uffizi in under 15.
Very comfortable bed , very good communication and we actually met Salvatore which was an added bonus.
I walked there from the tram and it took 10 minutes.
There are lots of nice restaurants on the actual road so don’t need to go far looking for food.
We didn’t cook in the apartment but you definitely could if you wanted to.
Great apartment in the heart of Florence! It was super spacious and a perfect place to spend a however many days. We could walk everywhere and everything needed was in the apartment.

Salvatore and his apartment in the middle of downtown Florence were absolutely wonderful. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Florence. It is about 15 minutes walk from the main train station and only 2 minutes walk from the Statue of David. You can see the Duomo from the window as well and it's only 5 minutes walk. It is perfectly located and next to some happening squares. There were some events in the square right next to the apartment and that was fun to check out. I would ordinarily be worried about some noise being so close to everything, but the bed is set away from the street and has an extra door that separates the bedroom so that further reduces noise. It was absolutely fantastic. Salvatore was very friendly and helpful and very responsive as well. Highly, highly recommend his place!

Great stay with Salvatore. The flat was well stocked with amenities.  Easy to access the flat and very close to the Duomo, a great location! Salvatore met us at the flat and showed us around the space which was a nice touch. The space was very clean and exactly as described. Having a grocery store down the street was a huge plus. I would definitely book with Salvatore again!
