Salvatore is a fantastic host and has a charming home. The location is great with about a 5 minute walk to the duomo and the home was in impeccable condition. Salvatore was always quick to respond during my stay and provided me with great recommendations. Stay here if you can!

Would absolutely recommend staying here. It was a central location right near the Duomo that was very walkable to everything you would want to get to. Apartment was clean and exactly as described and Salvatore was a great host. Would definitely stay again!

We had a great stay at this appartement! Very clean, all basics are present and location is very central, close to a small supermarket and all highlights in the area. Depending on your top appartement (tourist) neighbours, it can become a little noisy :-)
Salvatore was a wonderful and responsive host. His apartment is very centrally located while also being quiet, which is a hard balance in a busy city like Florence. Highly recommend!

We loved this place! The hosts were very kind and helpful. The location is amazing! I've never seen a more stylish and cute airbnb apartment. Everything about the experience was great. Totally recommend this place in Florence!
Everything about this stay was great. Sad we only had one night there. But the apartment was extremely clean, comfortable , and centrally located. Will stay again on our next visit!

Very stylish and clean place with hotel like feel. Location is central and within walking distance from main attractions in Florence. Everything was great including the bed, the sofa, the interior design, the bathroom and etc. The slight negative about the apartment is that sound proofing from the street is not good and the unit we were staying is facing the street. Fortunately the traffic along the street is not heavy.

Our stay in Florence was great, thanks to Francesca and Floriano! Their place was beautiful and perfect for a couple staying in town for a few days! We were less than a mile from the train station and not too far of a walk to the busy tourist areas. It’s also a block away from our favorite pizzeria “Fuoco Matto” and our favorite cafe “Simbiosi”. You will not be disappointed by this place! We will definitely be visiting again!

Property is as advertised...very stylish and looks just like the pictures. Major tourist sites are about 15 min walk (duomo area). Floriano is very kind and welcoming. He was available by WhatsApp for any questions and replied promptly. Great stay!
Beautiful, stylish apartment as advertised. Hosts were easy to reach, responsive, and check in/check out was fuss free.

Amazing appartment, exceptionally clean, very stilish design, quiet area but 5 to 10 minutes to everything downtown, plus Francesca & Floriano are just great people, perfect communicators which can give you very helpful informations about everything in the city! Definitely the place to be in Florence, we'll be back for sure!

The Airbnb was stunning. It has a very romantic feel. It’s great for pictures and it feels very safe. The host are amazing, they were very responsive. It was a little loud in the evenings but quiet at night. We had a pleasant stay.
This is a really great space… We loved staying here. Very close and walkable to everything you would want to do in Florence.
We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is really nice and as described. The hosts leave detailed instructions for check in and also provide helpful information about Florence.
Great location, friendly hosts.  We had a wonderful time.  Thank you Francesca & Floriano😊
The perfect location to explore Florence. Beautiful modern interior in a historic building. Comfortable bed and apartment. Supportive fast-replying hosts.
Such a great stay! We loved how cozy this air bnb was and how close it was to town. Thanks for an amazing stay!

This was our favorite stop during our ten days in France and Italy. The location was an easy walk from the train station and quiet at night. The hosts are quick to respond to questions and are most pleasant! The apartment is spacious and beautiful. I cannot recommend highly enough!

Fantastic apartment, everything was perfect. Not only apartment itself, but super friendly and kind owner helped us a lot for good restaurants etc. Highly recommend one when you stay in Firenze. Grazie mille Francesca and Floiano!!
I really enjoyed my stay. The home was in a great location and close to the square. I look forward to staying there again in the future.

Beautiful Property, even better location and absolutely Chic! My perfect stay in Firenze.
Will come back without a second thought.

This stay was one of the better ones I've had in Italy.  Clean spaces, great showers (hard to find) and comfy comfy beds.  The pictures don't lie, you're literally staring at the Duomo out both bedroom windows. Could not have a better location in the city.

Just an amazing place, in a perfect location. You really do get the view of the duomo from both bedrooms’ windows.
The place is clean, stylish, and nicely furnished.

We had great time staying at the apartment. it's nicely renovated and perfectly situated. At night it can get noisy as you are near the square but we were able to sleep through the noise.  the rooms are separately temp controlled which is great. we'd highly recommend the place!
Absolutely a great place.  Everything was about it was amazing, location, layout, condition and amenities.  Would absolutely stay there again.

Amazing apartment. Very clean and spacious. Beautiful views of the duomo in Florence. Right in the middle of everything and very walkable. Only thing to consider is it’s quite loud at night. We used ear plugs and a white noise machine which helped, but you should consider this as you book.

The apartment was very bright, spacious, and newly-renovated. The location was outstanding and the communication was excellent. There were a few very small things in the house that became loose or fell off (cover for the toilet flush buttons/trash can cover) -- they offered to send someone to fix these right away. Would definitely recommend staying at this apartment and it would even be nice for longer stays given the fridge, microwave and washer/dryer. Looking forward to next time!

We’d been to Florence many times and this is by far the best accommodation we’d ever stayed at. Just steps from all of the main attractions, the apartment was absolutely perfect with stunning views of the duomo from not one but both bedrooms. We were literally immersed and didn’t feel the need to leave the apartment to take in the beauty of Florence. It was an exquisite find and we’re so pleased that it was available for our stay.
The accommodations were comfortable, clean, and spacious, and the beds were super comfortable—what one would expect at a five star luxury hotel. We were also happy that amenities were pristine and accessible, including a washer and built in dryer, fully stocked kitchen, coffee and tea, and dining ware.
Check-in and check-out were seamless. The hosts were very quick and responsive in their communications; we felt cared for throughout our stay.
We hope to stay at AJ Duomo again in the near future.

What a wonderful experience. Better than pictured truly. The apartment is spacious, extremely well appointed and in the best location w a stunning view of the bell tower and duomo. The hosts are responsive and friendly and go out of their way to accommodate your needs. I highly recommend this modern oasis in the heart of Florence.
Highly recommend. Location was incredible, and the apartment itself was beautiful. Would love to rent it again!
My 3rd time at Silvia's Place.  Always clean and never any problems. Conveniently located.
The unit was fantastic.  Great location, easy access to walk to everything in Florence. Would stay again,

Sylvia was so helpful and responsive. The location can not be better - it felt like a sanctuary in the hustle and bustle. Walking distance to everything. Wonderful air conditioning in a heat wave. Fantastic pillows (this is important for me!) and clean bathrooms.

This apartment exceeded our expectations and was the highlight of our Italian holiday! The apartment was exactly as pictured, clean, well appointed and in a perfect location.  Sylvia was responsive and provided lots of helpful recommendations for things to do and restaurants to check out.  I would stay here on my next trip to Florence and highly recommend it!

We absolutely loved our stay here. Wonderful apartment and in a great location. All was clean and beautiful. Highly recommend Silvia’s place. Great communication with her as well. Thank you Silvia! We had a wonderful trip.

Fantastic apartment well
Equiped and great host easily reachable and accommodating. Please be aware that due to location it is noisy at night and in the early morning

Extremely central and comfortable apartment. Very spacious and nicely decorated with many amenities. The building has a small elevator and check in was smooth and professional. Would recommend and stay again.

Clean, spacious apartment in a central location that is walking distance to Ponte Vecchio, Duomo, train station, markets, shopping and restaurants/bars.  It is located on a busy street so expect foot and vehicle traffic all day and all night long.
Great apartment.  Lots of room and it's in a great location. Three was some noise at night and early morning,  but was worth it for such a great location.

Location was excellent for major attractions. Easy walking distance to major sites and even train station . Neighborhood feels safe.  Elevator came in handy as we were on the fourth floor. Would stay again. There is noise from the street at night but didn’t bother us.

Hottest day of the year found us trudging through the streets until we made it to Lorenzo's place and SWEET SWEET air conditioning of Lorenzo's Florence apartment. Great layout of two bedrooms and two bathrooms and air conditioning in both. The updated styling in the old part of town was wonderful. What a great location. And the rooms were quiet due to the newer windows. The pictures are what you get. Will try to stay again when we return,

Lorenzo's place was spectacularly clean, was in an amazing location, and the check-in was fantastic. We were given excellent local dinner ideas. Everything was close by and we could walk everywhere. We were able to leave our bags early, which was nice. When our 10 year old son left his glasses behind when we checked out, Lorenzo met us there to retrieve them quickly. Service was great and the place is well worth it!

Lorenzo's place was overall great - nice interior, 2 bathrooms, and has a ton of space! The building had an elevator, but do note that there were a few steps (maybe 3-4 steps) leading up to it. The location was good as well- very central to a lot of attractions: about a 10 minute walk from Firenze train station, less than five minutes from the Duomo or the Uffizi gallery, and very close to shopping and food options (try All'Antico down the street).
I also appreciated how easy and detailed the checkin instructions were. Lorenzo was also very accommodating as a host.

Location was awesome, all places of interest were just around the corners.
We just love the location of this property.

We stayed here and we really enjoyed every moment..the apartment was so beautiful and nice..very convenient..everything is just within walking distance..the apartment is very clean, tidy, cozy and spacious for the 6 of us..thanks again.
Beautiful place in an excellent location. Very  spacious with amenities.  Loved our stay for our family of 5.

Nice apartment. Matteo was excellent dealing very quickly with water/heating problem. Great location.
Would use again.

+ Great location: everything that you want to see, need or want is in walking distance (sights, shopping, food, supermarkets)
+ Spacious apartment: huge living room, 2 bed & bathrooms and a mini balcony
+ Very responsive & helpful host
+ Easy check-in process
We enjoyed our time in Florence!
Everything in Lorenzo's house is fantastic but even more the beds, extremely good and comfortable. It was a pleasure :)

Matteo and Lorenzo's place is location heaven.  It's the best place you can be in while visiting Florence.  The space is big, great for a family, two couples or just by yourself.  The check in was smooth even though it was a hands off check in.  Easy to find.  If I can find it available, I'll book it again.
It was located in a busy loud area and the checkin process was a little complicated. Big house.

Extremely spacious apartment right in the heart of Florence. A short walk from all the main sites (10mins max) from the Ufizzi, bars, restaurants and other key tourist hot spots. Is a 12min walk from the main train station too. The check in instructions were clear and easy to follow and Lorenzo and Matteo were quixk to reapond when we had any questions. Highly recommend this place.
Outstanding location, spacious and private.  Large public spaces to share but having the two private bedrooms and bathrooms made our stay especially comfortable.  Would stay again!!!

Very nice location, strictly close to Palazzo Vecchio and Ponte Vecchio, Orsanmichele... Apartament clean, big, with all the necessary. Only the children coudn't sleep in the night because the noises in the street, until 4 a.m. and before 6 a.m. For us was very difficult, all the day tired and children too.

The rental was as advertised.  Close to Signoria Square. Easy to walk to all major sites. Good air conditioning. My son appreciated that he could log onto Netflix. Lots of restaurants nearby.  Some noise from street at night overall a good stay.  Would recommend.

Lovely, spacious 2 bedroom apartment, incredibly centrally located which was wonderful. Quite noisy, but being serenaded at night by people singing opera is never a bad thing. Ear plugs are helpful if you’re a light sleeper. The beds were a bit hard, but we’re getting older and the bones suffer a bit more, so just a minor quibble.
Location is perfect. Very central, great coffee place downstairs. But be aware that the street noise is very very loud and very few hours of actual silence.
Good in general. Big space. Very centra location, and noise like other review says. Sofa bed a bit old not very comfortable.
Fantastic stay. Easy self check in. Lorenzo was very helpful and responsive when the power was not working and helped to turn most of it back on. Highly recommend this place!
Great location. Able to walk to a lot of great restaurants and sites. Only downfall is it is very noisy at night.

We had a wonderful couple of days in Rome and Lorenzo's place was in such a perfect location. Taking the metro was so easy and helpful, especially since the entry to the subway was just outside our front door. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in this part of Rome.
I would highly recommend this place. The location is perfect, and the elevator is very useful for those that have problems going up stairs.

Just in the center of everything around
We parked the car and we done everything and being everywhere just walking from home!!!For sure suggest it

Lovely large place with two nice size bedrooms and clean good sized bathrooms. Washing machine very appreciated. great location close to everything .
15 min walk from train station.
street noise can be loud after midnight.
On third floor with small elevator.
The place was in a great location to walk to everything we wanted to see.  If you have trouble sleeping with noise, this may not be the place for you.

My friends and I really enjoyed staying at Lorenzo’s Airbnb. Our host made everything was so easy from getting in to recommendations/tips and check out. The location was incredible too. Thank you so much!
The apartment is quite nice! It’s loud at night until after 11:00 p.m., not quiet until late. Close to everything!

Cozy, central (because of that, its noizy durring the nights) get earplugs, lots of space.
We pretty much enjoyed our stay there. Thank you!
good location with elevator.  I liked the dishwasher and the washing machine. was easy to find.  I liked the 2 bathrooms, perfect for 4 people

We had a great time for New Year in this apartment. There were six of us and it was ideally located and spacious.
Thanks for a good stay!

+ nice appartment.
+ 5 mins walk to Duomo.
+ clean and spacious.
+ very secure.
- sparse furnishing and a bit tired
- 1x large towel each for 4 nights
- Irish pub is close by...so can be noisy until 11pm
overall a good place to stay

Great location, great host. Glad there’s an elevator, especially with a child and stroller.
Had issues with constant hot water, but the host responded help figure it out. Had issues again with the hot water but decided not to contact the host and just take the cold shower. If had reached out, I know they would have helped.

Lorenzo's apartment was great! Super helpful to be in an elevator building and there was plenty of space for our group. The common area was a huge plus. Will just note that the area is very noisy. I'd bring earplugs if you can!

It was a nice stay! Super central and accessible to all major sites in Florence. With that, the noise at night was a bit loud but that’s expected as it is in the heart of Florence. Also, self check in was good but make sure to follow the instructions from the host. Very straightforward and clear.
Nice place. Away from city center but can be hard to get a taxi to come and get you.
Great place. Easy access into the center with lots of bus stops near by. The big supermarket opposite was very helpful. Very clean and tidy, we enjoyed our stay very much

Everything was perfect in the apartment. Spacious, clean and very well equipped. Simona was also very flexible, respectful and understanding. The only comment I have is that it was a bit far from the center on foot but still feasible by bike or two buses before 8pm but I will sill give 5 stars.
Thank you Simona :)
Can only recommend for a stay in Florence. Is well connected to local transit and very nice place!

Basic but rather small room, with a confortable bed. No kitchen available, we only had two cups im the room and a kettle.
The room was mostly clean, although the floor could have been cleaned a little better.
The location was great, close to the train station and the city center

The place is nice and central. It has everything you need. Sadly the check in with the app took us super long and it was a bit frustrating because we had some wrong codes sent. Things like this happen.

Fantastic apartment, beautifully finished with an excellent location! Monica is a wonderful host offering lots of info and amenities. Bonus: washer/dryer, stairs/elevator, heat/AC
We would definitely stay again on our next visit to Florence

We loved staying in Monica’s flat! The flat is newly renovated, very well appointed, and centrally located. It is clean and well cared for. We were able to stop back home for a break in between our itineraries during the day. Monica was so helpful and such a a great host. We would absolutely stay again!
A wonderful apartment, very tastefully decorated with high quality fittings and furnishings. And some lovely art, too. Not to mention the short distance to all galleries and restaurants.

We fell in love with studio Duomo Michelangelo! The apartment is centrally located near the  Duomo,  restaurants, museums and shopping.  Monica is the perfect host, her attention to detail is amazing. We hope to go back in the near future.

What a great home! It was a convenient location, right in the middle of everything! The place was sparkling cleaning and had all the amenities! This was probably my favorite Airbnb I have stayed at so far!
Beautiful apartment and perfect location! No complaints about anything— had a great time visiting Florence and staying here!

Look no further if you want an amazing stay in Florence! This studio is perfect and equipped with everything you need! It is the perfect location and within walking distance to all of the popular attractions. Monica is the perfect host with a great response time. She provided complimentary samples of Chianti wine, chocolates, tea and Nespresso! We didn't want to leave and I can't wait to come back to stay again!! You will be very happy staying here!

Monica’s studio was amazing. The apartment is in a quiet and clean building just steps from the duomo. The location was close to everything and was a perfect place to retreat to after exploring all day. The studio had everything we could need including Nespresso pods and tea. Monica greeted us upon our arrival and gave us many of wonderful recommendations. We would stay here again!

Monica is an awesome host who was always very responsive and thorough in her communications from the beginning of booking the flat to our exit. We had one issue through no fault of hers and she immediately had it addressed. She provided great recommendations for places to see, restaurants and places to shop for specific items I was seeking. The flat was very comfortable and clean and nicely decorated with art of Florence. The flat had everything we needed with extra touches to make us feel welcome. Quality bedding and luxurious towels. The location is fantastic, everything is very accessible by walking including the tram to and from the airport.  And the view of the Duomo when we would set out for our adventures every day never got old. Love this flat! Fantastic host!

I would highly recommend staying here. This place is beautiful and the host was amazing. We felt right at home and extremely comfortable. After walking all day around Florence it was the perfect place to come back to relax with a nice glass of wine.

Monica, the host, was amazing! From the minute I booked the reservation, she was in touch, giving suggestions for making our trip to Italy a breeze.  Extremely responsive and the accommodations were wonderful! She was so kind in letting us drop off our luggage when we arrived in Florence.  Wonderful host!!!
We had such an amazing stay. Monica’s place is beautiful and extremely clean. The location is perfect and we couldn’t have asked for a better stay. Thanks for being a great host Monica!

My wife and I had an amazing stay at this apartment! Location was awesome - steps away from Duomo and great restaurants. Apartment was perfect! - clean and spacious. Monica was a wonderful host - responsive and helped us through every step of our visit. Wish we could have stayed longer!

We had such a wonderful stay at Monica’s place! She made the check-in process seamless and easy, and the location was even better than expected. The apartment itself was incredibly clean,  so quiet, and offered exactly what we needed. We wouldn’t hesitate to stay here again next time we’re in Florence!

Monica’s place was beautiful!  Spacious, clean and well appointed with amenities for international travelers. Location is safe and walkable. Loved the patio. She responded quickly to my questions which was helpful.  Thank you Monica!    We found a favorite lunch place around the corner and enjoyed their panini’s and spritz all the days.

We loved this stay in Florence. The apartment is absolutely spotless, beautiful, and in the best location. Monica gave us lots of recommendations that were close by. It is very walkable to all the attractions in Florence. We would definitely stay here again!

Monica was a great host! Very responsive and friendly! We loved the location as it was only mere meters away from the duomo and a short walk to other historic sites. The Airbnb itself was clean, modern and the air conditioning in summer was like coming back to an oasis after exploring the city.
I’d definitely stay here again!

This Airbnb was beautiful! It looked exactly like the pictures! It was perfect walking distance to the train station, Duomo, Santa Croce and everything really! Monica was super friendly and responsive whenever I had a question! Check in and was very easy and everything was amazing! I’m already looking to book with her again next summer! Thank you Monica!!!
This apartment was beyond our imagination! Beautiful, spacious and close to everything! we didn't want to leave

Monica’s place is spacious and well taken care of; description for Airbnb was true in all aspects.Monica was a wonderful host. She explained everything we needed to do. She even left us a welcome gift.
Beautiful stay! Wonderful location and so peaceful! Monica is a very response and friendly host and was very proactive. If we are ever back in Firenze again, we’ll be staying here!

Monica's Studio Duomo Michelangelo was amazing. Monica was very thoughtful and attentive. The studio was upscale, and we would definitely recommend this studio to family and friends when visiting Florence.
Had a great stay at Monica’s place. It is very clean and spacious and is so close to the Duomo while still being quiet. Would stay here again!

Monica’s place was incredible. From the most pristine accommodations with many added extra amenities such as washer/dryer and even a flat iron for my hair and a  great  location! Monica is a super host! She was very responsive and such a kind and considerate person. We couldn’t have picked a better place. We loved our stay!!

The apartment is very well-located, comfortable, and quiet.
Communication with Monica is easy and she responds timely and always in a friendly manner. She’s a wonderful host.
We always feel at home in this apartment and we can’t wait to stay here again!

My husband and I had a wonderful one week stay here. It was very close to everything yet very private, which made it perfect for a relaxing stay in the heart of Florence. Monica is also a wonderful host and we appreciated all of her recommendations and knowledge of the city. We will definitely come back.
The apartment was quiet and serene yet close to everything.  It's a perfect place to spend a few days in Florence because everything you would want to see is easily walkable.

A great, well organised campsite that has everything you need. The staff is super nice. We also enjoyed going to the on-site restaurant.
Even though it is a bit out of the way, you can get to the city centre quickly with the shuttle service. You can also rent ebikes and join excursions. I recommend this place to anyone who values the simple things and wants to spend time in Florence at a reasonable rate.
I will be happy to come back.

The camp is very beautiful. Everything is clean. The staff is very friendly and willing to help immediately. In the camp you will find everything you need. They also have their own Shutle bus that runs to and from the city, very affordable. Definitely recommend.

- Bad service
- Mold in bathroom
- Smell was terrible
Can’t recommend.

This is a wonderful place to stay in Florence. The apartment is clean and has a washing machine, a great shower and a comfortable bed! Tina was quick to respond and was a wonderful host! Close to the train station and not too far from the Duomo. We really enjoyed our stay

Personal and easy check in process. Host met me at the location and showed me my room and common areas. I arrived early but was able to leave my bags there. I walked to all of the major locations and never needed to use any public transport. Short distance from the train station
Really nice and clean room in a great location, with super friendly hosts! Thank you Tina and Diego!
Really chill spot easy access to the train that takes you straight to central definitely recommend this spot with friends!

it was nice and clean, accurate for the price. the obly downside was that it was super cold. there was a fan (AC) where you can set the temperature on 30°C. it was on all night and the room temperature was only 17°C. there was no proper duvet, only a bed cover and a b3d sheet to cover yourself. they have a restaurant and a grocery shop on the premises so that was handy. overall 4 out of 5 stars.👌

I had a great stay at Tina and Diego’s place. The place is pretty close to the city center, it takes only 10-20 minutes of walk depending on how fast you walk. The area is safe to walk. The room is described as it is. I loved the room I was in. I usually have troubles with sleeping on different bed than mine, but I had no troubles!
Tina and Diego were both really nice and fast responsive. They gave also nice local recommendations to check out. I would totally stay there again 😃.

We really enjoyed our time at the appartement of Tina & Diego. They were very friendly, patient, interested and helpful. I felt right at home. At night the surroundings of the apartment are nice and quiet. The airconditioning worked amazing and was a real gift in the heat.
Great location, check in process was super simple!! Diego and Tina were great hosts and made us feel super welcomed. We also were able to use the laundry which was a huge plus.
Tina and Diego were great hosts, they were very responsive and helpful. The place is easy to find and close to the Piazza del mercato centrale.

Spent two nights here at the end of a month in Italy. While it is right in the city center it is actually very quiet. The room was simple. My bed was comfortable and the shared bathroom was clean and well  supplied. It was a VERY hot weekend 98 degrees. The AC was a life saver. It was also a short walk to the T2 (airport tram) I caught it in the Piazza San Marco, where you’ll find The Gran Caffè my favorite pasticceria in Firenze. I’d come back.

I stayed at Tina and Diego’s place for a week. My room was clean and comfortable, with a nice air conditioning system. I was in one of the rooms, and there were two other rooms in the apartment for other guests. Tina and Diego were super friendly, quick to respond, and very cooperative.
The location of the apartment is also excellent—less than a 20-minute walk to the city center, Uffizi Gallery, Accademia Gallery, and many lively areas that are absolutely worth visiting. The bus station is very close too, though I walked everywhere.
The apartment is on floor 2.5, with some stairs to climb. It wasn’t a problem for me, but if you’re traveling with elderly companions or have heavy luggage, it’s something to keep in mind.
In summary, I really enjoyed the place and would probably choose it again for future visits.

Our family of 4 stayed at Gabriele's for a week and loved it. There was plenty of room and the location is fantastic. We walked everywhere we wanted to go and liked being on the less touristy side of the river. Gabriele was a very responsive and accommodating host. We would definitely try and stay at his place again if we were visiting Florence.

My friends and I booked this place for a quick day trip to Florence, the night before we left. Despite the quick turn around, the host accepted our booking and was able to get the place ready for us! It was very clean and cozy. The pictures do not do it justice, it is a very charming space. The location was great, quiet and not in a super touristy neigbblorhood, but also just a quick walk from the main attractions. If you are taking the train to Firenze, I especially recommend this place, as it is a mere 10-15 minutes walk from the Santa Maria Novella Terminal! I would definitely book again if I was coming back to Firenze!

Nice and clean apartment with walking distance to city centre and still just outside the restricted ZTL-traffic zone, making it possible to access the apartment with the car.
Tiziano was for us a superhost.
the place is better than the photos, is cute and comfortable. close to the train station and an easy walk towards the touristic zone. would definetly stay there again.
It was a really nice stay in Florenze. The flat is spacious, well equipped and good located. We would come again

Very great apartment in a historical palazzo ! Well placed compared to the historical center of Florence, in a nice area filled with small trattorias and wine bars. Vittoria and Andrea are really helpful when you have questions. So thank you for having me as a guest  and see you soon !

This apartment is perfect.  It is very comfortable, stylish and new made.  It's in a great location within walking distance to all important things.  The hosts are very responsive and answer all questions you might have.

Carapelli apartment is very beautiful and in a great location. I have stayed here many times.
Federico is a great host and kept the apartment available during the pandemic. I highly recommend this apartment.

Pergola 35 is a very nice, charming and cozy place.
And very comfortable!!!!
Very well located, very clean and organized.
Lorenzo, our hostess, is always ready to help and make us feel comfortable.
We'll come back for sure!

Great appartment in the centre of Florence. Everything at walking distance. Large, clean, cool the temperatures are high outside, nicely renovated with a lot of storage space! Great view of the Duomo!
Everything you need for a perfect stay.

Very nice, bright and clean apartment, in a quiet neighborhood, but close to the city centre (20 mins walk to the Duomo, maybe even less). Check-in instructions were very clear. A lot of cafés nearby and really nice Chinese restaurant. Would definitely recommend)

Exceptional. Really a wonderful place, with everything needed. Very quiet, comfortable, 2 bathrooms is a real plus with 2 kids! The flat is located barely 10 minutes by bus from city center and is walkable. The flat is super well equipped, with AC, dishwasher and beds are great. Communication with Martina has been great. We will definitely stay here again.

Place was beautiful and very well put together. For the price, it was worth the stay. About a 20 minute walk from the train station. Amazing restaurants near by. Minor issue with the back shower as it was not draining, we just used the other shower without incident.

The Dome house was a great home base to tour Florence. It was spotless with plenty of space. We enjoyed sitting on the balcony after grabbing a coffee from the cafe right down stairs. Martina was responsive and helpful.
The Dome house was great. We felt at home during our stay. Martina was a terrific host and was always available to chat. Definitely recommend the Dome house for travelers to Florence!

Absolutely loved our stay at this Airbnb in Florence! The apartment was great with all the amenities we needed. What made our experience even more special were the fantastic recommendations provided by Martina. Their local insights led us to hidden gems and authentic eateries that truly enriched our trip. The central location was a huge plus, making it easy to explore all the wonderful sights Florence has to offer.
The flat is clean and good looking. chiara is a very nice host. We enjoyed the days in Florenz and this flat. Thank you chiara ☺️☺️

Everything you read in the reviews is true; the flat is great, very clean and it’s also quiet. A short walk to the tram stop and ten minutes later you’re in the centre of Florence.
Chiara always answers almost immediately and is very helpful if you any questions.
Tip: be sure to start your day with a lovely cappuccino at the pasticceria around the corner. They also do great cakes and cookies.

Fabulous stay for 5 days, highly recommend. Clean and well set up apartment only 10 mins walk from attractions, with excellent cafe over the road. Loved the balcony to sit out and relax. Great communication and helpful recommendations - thank you Martina, we hope to be back one day!

Martina was a wonderful host. She is very helpful and responsive.
Her apartment in Florence is perfectly located and came with all of the modern conveniences needed to be very comfortable.
I will definitely stay here again when I come back to Florence.
Great location. Felt safe. Great restaurants and cafes in the local neighbourhood. Very clean apartment. It has a balcony which was great for us to have a little outdoor space and a view.

great place. perfect location. flat equipped perfectly for everyone. comfortable pillows. helpful host and very quick contact. there are mosquito nets in the apartment. parking space. 100% as described.

Apartment is on a great location and very close to the center. So easy to find. It was very very clean and you have everything what you need in it. Chiara was so helpful and answered on all of our questions and gave us so much recommendations for local restaurants and activities how to have the best experience in Florence.
Thank you so much on that! 🥰
We definitely recommended this apartment to anyone who comes to Florence.
Eliza and Tatjana
The apartment was really clean and good localisation. It´s easy and fast to come with the tram to the city center. I enjoyed the stay in Chiaras Apartment a lot!

The apartment is very comfortable, functional and cozy.  Close to the metro station, in front of bus stops and next to two supermarkets.  The neighborhood is full of restaurants, pizzerias and pastry shops.  It is a 20-minute walk from the city's historic area or 7 minutes by metro.  Chiara is very attentive and always responds quickly to messages.  The apartment is an excellent option for a stay in Florence.

Very good location. Parking directly in front of the door. Very good communication via WhatsApp! Highly recommended. The room looks exactly as in the photos- new and with plenty of space to store suitcases. The walk to the city was only 10min. You really can't go wrong with this room. We liked it very much.

The room was perfectly clean, the shower was great and the bed was very comfortable. Check in was very easy. The walk from the train station felt a little long carrying luggage but there is also a tram that takes you very close. It was definitely more of a hotel vibe as opposed to a personal Airbnb experience and they charged for snacks and coffee in the room.
Everything was perfect! Good place to stay if you visit Florence. It's clean and the bed is really comfy. I recommand!

Great place, clean and tidy. Easy to check in felt like in a hotel room.
20 min walk from the city center
It was a very good experience and the space was very welcoming and corresponds to the photographs and good communication with host
Best Bnb since I’ve been in Italy ! The location really made it enjoyable to walk around Firenze!
The Appartment location was great .. nice area and close to historical center... Appartment is clean and well maintained .. great for 4 people

Fantastic apartment!
Don’t think twice about staying here - really is so so lovely.
Everything you need and more. Excellent communication with the owner, which was useful.
We will definitely return :)
Location was awesome, place was bigger than expected, and the air conditioning was excellent.  Great time for our family of 7 in Florence!

Adriano’s place was great and close to MANY of Florence’s beautiful sites. Shopping was great as well. The apartment was VERY comfortable and clean, except for the floors. They didn’t look dirty at all but our feet got dirty at the apartment. Every other detail was on point!  Be sure to try the pistachio croissants(heated) at the cafe to the right of front door! They were heavenly!  Warning, finding parking was  very difficult. Be sure to pick up a bunch of water at the corner store!

Adriano’s place was exactly what we needed. It was close enough to be walkable to all the major sites, but was a very peaceful environment, slightly away from the noise and bustle a few blocks away. Everything was very clean and the beds were comfortable. It was perfect for our family. We will definitely come back.
Adriano’s place was fantastic! The place was big, having two bathrooms was helpful and the AC worked great. Adriano was responsive and we had no problems with our stay. Grazie!

Our stay in Florence started with some unexpected travel woe's. Adriano was understanding and responsive. Once we made to Florence, getting to the apartment and checking in was a wonderful experience. The location is amazing as we walked everywhere in the city. Coming 'home' was definitely a major part of the enjoyment of our trip!

It was a lovely place for 3 couples to stay. Very clean, excellent location for food and shops, sunken living room was lovely and views were pretty. Beds and pillows were very comfortable. Antonio and Christina were great hosts.

Antonio and Christina, they are great host we had a wonderful stay in their apartment.
Antonio waited for us for check-in and helped a lot.
After long flight, he is taking care of us.
The location is also great.
I really recommend their place.

Beautiful spacious apartment and the location is perfect! Well equipped with everything you need. Great for a family of six!
Quick response from the host Antonio & Cristina as well as Erika! Thank you!!

Beyond its convenient location and amenities, the special touches put this stay over the top.  Antonio and Cristina (and the equally attentive Erika) have mastered the art of hosting. We will undoubtedly visit again.  Bravo!

Great location in Florence, easily walkable to all the main sites to visit. Well furnished and very cozy yet spacious. It provided a great escape for our group in the city. The hosts were extremely friendly, helpful and organized. We couldn't have asked for a better stay.
We needed an ideal launching spot for two couples to explore Florence--Christina's place was perfect in all respects.  And she was very responsive.  Highly recommended.

Best location to stay in Florence. Nothing more than 10 min walk through beautiful little streets. Access to lovely local bars/restaurants that are not too touristy. Close to supermarket, Ponte Vecchio, duomo, galleries….everything!!
Apartment is top class 5 star- comfy beds with fresh linens, well appointed kitchen and very clean throughout. Perfect space for our family of 2A & 2teens.
Host was both extremely helpful and responsive. Even around new year holiday.
Recommend this place if you are looking for space and quality in a central location.

We loved our stay!  The hostess met us at the apartment and helped us get in and showed us around.  She was extremely hospitable.  They even included water and a bottle of processo in the fridge!  The bedding was comfortable and clean.  The bathrooms were very nice and clean.  We loved our apartment in Florence and the location was perfect to all that the city has to offer!

Beautiful apartment in perfect location. You can easily get to the train and the major local attractions, and also explore quieter spots in the Oltrarno. Hosts were incredibly helpful and made great recommendations. I would book this place again without hesitation.

This was a great stay for our family. 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms were much appreciated. It is in a wonderful location and very close to sites and restaurants. The place is exactly as pictured, very nice! Beds were comfortable, nice bathrooms and everything is updatedThis was the best stay of our two week trip.

The location of this BnB is really great - close to the train station, down from the square (our toddlers loved chasing birds here!)! The elevator in the building is also welcomed at the end of a long day. They hosts are lovely, leaving nice refreshments on arrival. It was quiet in the building too.

An amazing apartment right in the heart of beautiful Florence.
Antonio and Cristina were brilliant hosts. Loads of great recommendations.
Thank you - we had a wonderful time.
We loved our stay! Everything we wanted to do was an easy walk. The apartment was spotlessly clean and just lovely. Highly recommend! A++++

Our stay in Firenze was absolutely perfect! The apartment was fully stocked and beautifully decorated. Check in was so easy. Would recommend staying here again!
Ciao!
Great location, beautiful apartment and lots of easy communication with the host - would recommend to my friends. Great base to see all of Florence

Marialaura is an excellent host and our weeklong stay in her flat was truly the highlight of our trip.  The exquisite decorations, cleanliness and attention to details made for a uniquely wonderful stay.  You won’t be disappointed!
I recommend Camilla’s home to anyone looking to stay somewhere central but not too loud. The stairs are a bit of a killer, but worth it for the view :) thank you again!
This place is amazing. From the balcony you have the best view across the city center, the layout is modern and spacious. Perfect for both work and holidays.

This a very stylishly but practically designed apartment which is perfectly located for visiting all the attractions of Florence. We were very comfortable and slept well in surprising quiet. The host is very responsive and helpful. It would be very hard to think of any possible improvements. We are a retired, well travelled couple. We appreciated the design of the space and high quality of the fittings. Highly recommended!

WOW! Do you need to know more? The reality is better than the photos (and they are great;) We enjoyed every piece of the place, and it made our Florence experience even better. And trust me, Florence is amazing in itself, so staying at a place that complements it, really is like hitting the jackpot. And on top of that Cristiana is very friendly & helpful. So I give it 10* - Thank you.

There are not enough words to describe how much we enjoyed staying at the apartment! The best view, impeccable design, and the most gracious host. The location is top notch and easily accessible to all the major hot spots without feeling crowded and busy. Truly a magical experience and we cannot wait to come back!

This was a wonderful stay in Florence. The apartment was beautifully designed and the balcony was incredible. Location very central for shopping and sightseeing. There was a hiccup with an appliance that was out of our host's control and she went the extra mile for us to make up for it, which was incredibly kind. I highly recommend anyone to stay here while visiting Florence!!

Camilla is an outstanding host, she answered very fast and kindly.
She gave us really good tips and helped us during our journey.
The house is very spacial, one of a kind and in an amazing position, we felt from the first moment like home.
I really suggest it!

Lovely place in the middle of the old town. Best thing about it is the roof terrace! Great place to enjoy the sun and get away from the hustle und bustle of the town. Also Camilla gave us some good tipps for restaurants, which were really good. I highly reccomend this place. Thanks for having us!
Camilla was a great host and her place was clean and super close to so many great things to see and do in Florence. Very much enjoyed staying at her flat.

The apartment is beautiful and in the best location. Very clean and pleasant. The balcony was the absolute highlight. The hosts are very friendly and the communication is very good. We would definitely come again!

Lovely flat on the last floor of a building directly on Piazza Santa Croce.
Well located for anything you may need to do in Florence (and with a few taxis always around the piazza in case you need to go further away)
The flat is tiny but very cosy and well thought with a spacious bedroom area, good size bathroom and a small practical kitchen. The terrace is just great. Lovely to just sit around and watch Florence all around you!
Ideal place for a couple.
There are many staircases to reach the flat, and two also within the flat, but it’s worth the “hike” in my opinion.
Amazing location at the Piazza Santa Croce! Camilla is responding really fast. We could self Check-in so you can go in the apartment right away! Thanks for the wonderful stay at Firenze.

I had a great time at Camilla's place. The location is beautiful, just by the gorgeous churche in the beautiful piazza. Just few minutes walk to every main point in Firenze. The apartment si very nice, beautiful, cozy and perfect for 1 or 2 persons stay. I recommend it and I hope I will be back some day!

Camillas place is lovely! The view is stunning and the terrace is even bigger than on the pictures. Great communication all along and the location is perfect right on the square.   Grazie mille Camilla!
Wonderful! I would HIGHLY recommend this stay with Camilla, she is a wonderful host and an unbeatable location and the price is unheard of! Don’t think just book!

Check in was super easy and appreciated Camilla’s flexibility. Steps are definitely steep but we had no trouble getting our bags up. Very clean unit and condition of the facilities was great. The terrace was amazing to sit out on! Wifi was very slow but if you are here for a leisure trip then shouldn’t be an issue.
Fantastic location, easy to get to, and about 100m from at least one good restaurant. Really nice terrace. Camilla was a great host.

We loved our stay! The location was perfect! Santa Croce is lively but also not as hectic as Duomo area. Camilla was a great host and communicated nicely. The terrace was beautiful and we enjoyed wine up there. Highly recommend! We will be back!
We loved our stay at Cristiana’s place in Florence! The location was perfect. Would recommend to anyone

Stayed here for our stay in Florence on our honeymoon. Cristiana’s place was amazing! You cannot beat the view here!! Place was close walking distance to everything, clean and beautiful.
I would recommend this to anyone staying here!
This loft is in an awesome location and includes an incredible balcony that makes all of the stairs worth it! We loved this space for our stay in Florence!

This place is the perfect location and room to stay in while in Florence! My husband and I couldn’t have had a better time and Camilla’s place is gorgeous! The view is unmatched and Camilla was very communicative prior to and during check-in. Loved it so much!
Camilla is fantastic and the apartment is special and a cool design with a super deck at the top

Easy and fast check-in, really good communication and nice recommendations for gelati and restarants.
Absolutely lovely appartment, definetly recommend Camilla as a host.
the apartment is lovely and the views from the terrace are beautiful. Camilla was very helpful and communicative.

Amazing place, matches the description! A lot of stairs to go up lol the others said in the reviews, so make sure you pack light! The toilet didn’t have a seat or a cover, perhaps it’s just for our stay or it’s a thing for these airbnbs. But overall a great location with great views!

Me and my partner loved our stay at Camilla’s place! It was centrally located to everything we wanted to see and a little less than a mile from the train station. Be prepared for a lot of stairs, especially if you have big suitcases. It just burns off those pasta calories though ! :)

Camilla was a fantastic host, she was extremely friendly, attentive and responsive. The apartment is beautiful and is in a fantastic location. Could not recommend enough. Thank you so much for our stay! We will be back 😄

Camilla was really friendly and gave us some great tips and recommendations. The terrace has a beautiful view plus there was a balcony which made it feel spacious and bright.  The apartment had a few basics such as coffee and Camilla also left us a bottle of wine which was a thoughtful touch. The stairs up to the apartment once you are inside are a little steep and narrow - we didn’t have any issues but something to bear in mind. Overall the apartment was the perfect base from which to explore Florence.
Great location and a very convenient self check-in. The terrace has a great view, apartment itself is very quiet and calm. Would definitely recommend.

Had a great stay here. Good location for exploring the city in foot. Lots of stairs to get up to the apartment but worth it for the views from the terrace. Great local recommendations from Camilla! :)

Clearly a passion project of Cristiana's: from the architecture and design, the chosen artwork and unifying themes, the local recommendations, the books/magazines/articles available to read, and so much more! We loved staying here for our honeymoon and can't wait to return for much longer next time. We still feel there is more to explore in Cristiana's apartment, nevermind all of Florence. Cristiana is also very kind and welcoming, and helped us find parking last-minute as we forgot about Florence's ZTL! Many thanks and see you next time 🙏🏽
Fantastic balcony overlooking the river and bridges. Landlord is always quick to respond and offers good recommendations to restaurants and trips.

Extremely tasteful, stylish and well-appointed apartment right on the Arno, just steps from the Ponte Vecchio (note that you can hear the buskers, etc, but it adds to the ambience). We had a great stay and Christiana was a great (and super responsive) host with great recommendations. We'll be back again the next time we're in Florence (if only to dive into the interesting art and literature books).
Absolutely awesome apartment in the perfect location with incredible views of the Ponte Vecchio. Cristiana is a wonderful host. We enjoyed our time!

The apartment is fantastic, spotless, with great taste ans the location is right in the heart of the city. Cristiana is a great host, ready to help you with everything . I definitely recommend it for a great trip in Florence.
Camilla was a fantastic host of a beautiful stay! The terrace was lovely and the bed was so comfortable!

This place was amazing such a cool cozy home I wish I can live here for an entire year I felt right at home. I already saved this place for when I come next year.
Thank you Camilla you are awesome
Loved staying here! Was in a great location with amazing view from terrace! The bottle of wine left for us was an extra nice touch!

This Airbnb was everything I wanted in Firenze and more. It was right in the middle of all the action but also tucked away for privacy. The view was unmatched and beats any 5 star hotel. I would absolutely stay again!

Camilla’s place was great! beautiful view and a nice central location to just about everything. It had everything we needed and Camilla was a perfect and quick to reply host, will definitely stay here again!!

The apartment is great, super comfortable bed and bathroom and very spacious. The only thing to take into consideration is that is located on the 4th floor with no elevator and it was a surprise to find another stair inside the apartment which was VERY small and made it very hard to bring the suite-cases up.

Camilla was a very friendly and responsive host. The apartment was nice and in a great location, but be aware if you have heavy luggage there are many flights of stairs and no lift (including stairs in the actual apartment), so I had some difficulty with that. Overall it was a nice experience

Such an amazing little apartment in the most perfect location. There are lots of stairs up to the apartment which we were made aware of beforehand, but it is absolutely worth it for the lovely balcony and the views. We really loved sitting and eating our pizza on the balcony overlooking the square taking everything in💓 we had a couple hiccups with getting the shower warm however Camilla was very responsive and ready to help. We were able to walk eveywhere we wanted to see and really enjoyed our stay. Really recommend you stay here if visiting Florence, made it that extra bit special 😊

Camilla’s place was great for our stay! It has an awesome terrace where you can look down at the piazza below. She left us a bottle of wine for our stay & was very responsive with all communication. She included plug ins for the wall to help with mosquitos, which was VERY helpful. Although it is listed on the listing, I do want to emphasize that this listing is on the very top of the building, only accessible by stairs. Once you get to the listing, there is another set of stairs/ladder to get inside, which might be difficult for someone with a heavier suitcase. Overall, great location and would definitely recommend!

I stayed at this AirBnB on 20th of June to the 22nd of June. The apartment was infested with bedbugs. I receive multiple bites that have since blistered and become infected requiring medical attention and strong antibiotics causing gastrointestinal pain. I’m still suffering the effects. I have attached pictures to AirBnB support and the host. The host did not suggest to compensate upon receiving notice of my support ticket claimed to AirBnB that they found no evidence of bed bugs. I am currently discussing compensation with Airbnb and their offers have been manifestly unacceptable. As a family we have had a number of issues with Airbnb. The standards have dropped and they seem to have no sway with the hosts. Stay away and go back to hotels like many are choosing to do!
Great apartment right in the centre. Everything within a 20 min walk. Nice apartment and roof terrace with views of the city.
The apartment was absolutely lovely and the terrace with its view wonderful. Camilla was very helpful, open and proactive with communication. I can only recommend the place!
Lovely loft converted apartment with a special terrace. Camila gave great recommendations for all needs! Shower was a little weak but not a problem for us. Love Florence!
Perfect apartment for my trip to Florence. Everything I needed and I loved the roof terrace 😎♥️ Camilla is a great host!
Loved the flat, great location with a nice terrace. Camilla was very very responsive and flexible. Would always stay again. We had a fantastic time! Thank you Camilla
Perfectly located apartment in the centre. When we stayed it was very peaceful. The views from the terrace were worth the price alone!

Absolutely spectacular! Cristiana was proactive and very accommodating. The view was even better than expected. The home was spacious and clean. We are looking forward to recommending this host to friends. And we pray to be back one day. It has been the highlight of our honeymoon!

Me,my boyfriend and another couple we visited Florence for Easter holidays!
This apartment was perfect for us!Very clean,with a tasteful decoration.Located right in the center and only 5 minutes walk from the train station. The communication with Eva was perfect.Very reasonable price!We highly recommend this apartment:))

Thank you Eva for being a great host! We were given lots of top tips of things to do, see and eat. The accommodation itself was in walking distance of everything and it was stylish, clean and welcoming. I would 100% recommend staying here.

Lovely apartment in an amazing location very close to the station and the centre of town. Perfect for a group of friends, plenty of space. Eva was a very attentive host - when we struggled to find the apartment initially she replied immediately!

The experience I had staying at Eva's apartment was my best with Airbnb yet. The apartment is very conveniently located, clean, stylish and has everything you'd expect it to have and more. Furthermore, Eva is a very friendly and responsive host.

Thank you for the great stay Eva ! The clear arrival instructions, combined with an impeccable and fully equipped apartment ideally situated in the heart of Florence made for a most enjoyable experience. Furthermore, the internet connection is very good and allowed me to work remotely with ease, when needed. I strongly recommend Eva's apartment.
Eva’s place was perfect for us. She was clear on communication and location was amazing. I would recommend the place if you want to get something great with good value for money.
Perfectly located Appartement near all the must-see locations in Firenze. We've had a superb night and Eva helped us very friendly to find a parking space at the garage vis-a-vis. thank you!!

The place was very clean and comfortable, located very close to everything which was super nice, beautiful area. The place answered all of our needs and we definitely recommend it (for those travelling in the winter, the heating is super!)
Eva is amazing too, very easy check in and she was always available for our questions
It is a great space and fabulously located for walking to everything. Self check in was smooth. Though we ate out for every meal, there is a grocery store at the corner. Everything was  super.

Amazing place to stay while being in Firenze. Very close to all monuments and museums, the train station and bakery’s/supermarkets/restaurants.  The flat is cozy and spacious and we had  great stay there. We will definitely come back one day!😍

The apartment in Florence is very cute, with multiple comfortable beds and an amazing spacious bathroom and shower. It is walking distance to everything you want to see in the city centre and also close to the train station. A note if you are staying with multiple people - the bathroom is only accessible via the downstairs bedroom. Eva was very communicative and even helped with some additional questions we had about Florence. I recommend staying here and would return.
Great location, busy street but the windows kept the noise out well. AC was cold. Close to everything you need. Mahalo!

This place is wonderful. The beds are comfortable and there’s lots of room to spread out. The kitchen area is spacious and the bathroom is large also. The stairs are somewhat difficult but we knew that going in. The location is great and Eva was very helpful and responsive always. Would definitely stay here again if in Florence!
Perfect Location but top floor. Long way to clime up to reach this house. You will see why Italians are healthy
Great location close to train station and as many shops and restaurants, cafes etc you could ever want. Easy walk to everything we wanted in florence. We’d stay there again.
Great location and very clean! Eva was flexible with check-in which was appreciated. Very walkable to all the sights in Florence.

Had a great stay here during a 2 day trip to Florence. Within walking distance of lots of restaurants and attractions. Eva’s instructions were very clear and the space was very clean and homey. Highly recommend!
Great place to stay while in Florence. Close to many great restaurants and a great way to experience the local “feel”. Eva’s place was nicely decorated and clean. We would definitely stay here again
Is a clean place perfect location just yo many stair to climb with luggage, was 5 full floors to climbing!!! Awful with luggage
Beautiful place. Right near everything. The stairs are definitely the biggest challenge there. Loved the design and being able to open windows and hear the busy street.

Cute.. comfortable and clean! Also very well located  from the train station restaurants and historical monuments..You will be in great shape doing the stairs to get to the apartment!  Really nice place! We recommend!
We loved staying at Eva’s place! Had everything we needed and was only about 10 minutes walking distance from all of the major attractions!

We had stayed only 1 day, but this room was very comfortable. Especially this apartment has 3 air conditioners, so we could slept comfortably and refreshed from very hot and humid.
If I have a chance to stay again in Florence someday, I would like to book here.

Perfect for a solo trip. Great location, seems far on the map but actually under 15min walk to Centro Storico that was perfect. Well equipped, it has all you need.
Very accommodating too to organize arrival.
Thanks much Emma
Great location, very close to many bars and restaurants but also quiet and walking distance to the train station and the sights of Florence. Was very satisfied with everything.

This is a super apartment in an excellent location. I had a few issues re cleaning initially but this was rapidly sorted and the apartment was then extremely clean.
Communication with Emma was excellent. I would recommend and definitely stay here again.

Such a great place and a great host!! I will say, it is very dim inside and the light fixtures are very harsh. Additionally, there is quite a few stairs to trek through with little lighting in the hallway. Other than those minor inconveniences, this apartment was such a perfect stay for Florence!

Qin’s apartment was perfect for me. I stayed there on my own for two weeks and it was very convenient. The location is good (~10’ from the station). It was not in a too touristic area so I enjoyed the neighborhood a lot.
I would recommend this apartment to anyone who wants to come to Florence.

Emma was a great host! She was very responsive and helpful. Her place is at a great location, lots of nice restaurants, close to the attractions but outside of the busy tourist area, especially fun at night. I felt at home and safe! I would definitely book again if I return to Florence.

It was a real last minute booking to Emma’s place and she was so kind to accommodate us in such a short time.Her place was very close to the central railway station at Florence and we could walk to it with our luggages.The important attractions were  easily accessible from her place. There also lots of restaurants extremely close by for a quick meal.Emma was not in town and had a local friend help us out with check-in.Her friend Giovanni was very warm and kind and co-ordinated with us perfectly for the check-in.He was close to the station during our arrival and personally led us to the apartment and helped us settle.Emma’s place is a charming 15th century apartment and it brought us back memories of our childhood at our grandparents’ place.Her house is very clean and comfortable.She’s decorated it very well with some Chinese decor too which goes very well with the old apartment.We highly recommend Emma and her place!
A simple, quiet apartment in a very old house with big walls and narrow corridors, not too far from the SMN railway station. Everything worked well.

The apartment is in a great location, easily walkable from the train station and in what some locals referred to as a “vibrant neighborhood.” There are lots of cute around which are more relaxed than the intense tourist areas across the river. I found a few local art spots too.
Qin was very polite and attentive to deal with!
Anna’s place was a homey place away from home. I ended up staying longer than expected and really enjoyed living across from the river yet close to everything. Anna was very responsive and helpful.
Very pretty, light-filled apartment. It was quiet and peaceful at night despite having a few restaurants right downstairs. Anna was communicative and helpful with anything we needed.
What an amazing place, would definitely recommend!! Great location and great interior, the pictures absolutely do it justice.
Very nice apartment, even nicer than the pictures indicate. Everything is new and in order. Temperature could be easily controlled and beds were comfy. Can absolutely recommend this place.
Great location and apartment. Away from the crowd, true local feel in all the aspects of the stay. And the hosts are quick to respond to any need.
We had a very good experience, we were 7 and there was enough space for us. Very well located and clean
Fantastic place, location is ideal and super clean apartment. Also great value as there is a ton of room in the apartment. Overall very happy , zero bad things to say

Great location, amazing beds and sheets. Very interesting and modern layout of the apartment. Very accommodating hosts, they let us check out a little later and great communication.
The building is old, but once inside apartment all good :)
Great location and place. Lots of room for everyone. Some issues with resolving issues as multiple people manage the property depending on hours etc. otherwise great

Anna was extremely kind, helpful and patient. Her apartment is absolutely lovely and perfect for a solo traveler. I would definitely stay there again! The location is wonderful and everything you need is right there. I loved it.
The place is very nice - only bad thing is that there are no big pans/other kitchen utensils for 10 people. Cooking there was real challenge. Other than that the place is very good and nice.
It was pretty good the only problem was there was quite a bit of clutter and the floors were really dirty but the amenities were good and the rooms were as describe d

Luigi’s place was ideal for our trip! Had everything we needed and was a completely private room. We felt comfortable and were able to come and go as we pleased. Complementary breakfast treats were provided and Luigi was flexible and accommodated our check in/check out times. Really friendly and warm man with brilliant recommendations for our time in Florence. Many thanks :)
Very nice and clean . Very responsive host and lovely . Will recommend this place to stay if u in time
Subina was a friendly, kind and respectful woman. Always trying to help and provide your needs. The room was clean and comfortable. I highly recommend staying in her house.

Sabina is a great host. She proactively got in touch even before we reached Florence. Her instructions were clear and it was easy to find the house. The house is well maintained and spacious. Florence is a wonderful city and this house is at a walkable distance from Florence city centre.

Perfectly situated, on a walking distance to most major sights of Florence.  Clean, organized with functional yet eye-pleasing decoration. The easy self check in option was really helpful. A small private garden offers a place to reset an organize the day. The list of recommendations for shops, cafes and eating options in the neighborhood was a nice touch (and the ones we chose out of them exceeded our expectations). We    would happily return sometime.

This place is walking distance from all the must-see sights and there’s a generous terrace with a view of the Duomo that is quite spectacular - unfortunately for us it was an unseasonably cool May so we couldn’t enjoy it.
The sleeping area and bathroom are up a flight of (relatively steep) stairs that are open so keep that in mind if you have mobility issues.
Otherwise, this was a great flat and Nicola was a wonderful host.
We loved the flat and the location, it was very quiet despite being right by the dome. Thank you for your hospitality and kindness, we really hope to see you again soon ;)!
Nico and Caterina make a brilliant hosting team. Great tips for where to eat. Location can't be beat - central but quiet. And waited up for us as we got in late. Highly rated!

The place is amazing! It is even better than the pictures and staying there is absolutely worth it. The hosts are super nice and understanding. Our stay there was perfect and there weren't any troubles with anything. Great location, comfortable and clean apartment, outstanding view, friendly hosts. If you're looking for a place with an incredible view and reliable hosts, then that's definitely the place for you!

Caterina's place was wonderful. Nicola, her co-host, was very responsive, communicative, and helpful. We had a few questions during our stay and he responded very quickly, even coming to address an issue just an hour after I told him about it. The location was perfect, and the balcony view was incredible. There is AC which was very nice on a warm Florence day in November. Overall a wonderful stay!

If we could give 5 more stars, we would.  It was such a wonderful and comfortable 4 night stay. The location is unbelievablewith the most spectacular view of the Duomo in Florence! Everything you need is there. The bed was very comfortable and we slept very well. Nico and his mother Patrizia were so warm and welcoming.  They are genuinely very nice people and Excellent hosts. The terrace was the ultimate Florence experience! We miss it already.

The place was great. Perfect for two people in a great location. You are so close to the duomo but it is still quiet at night. You are in an apartment building which is super safe. The patio has views of the duomo which is amazing to sit on at night and drink some wine. Great communication. They gave us amazing recommendations. The bedroom is in a loft up a flight of stairs that are narrow so if you can’t do stairs you might want to find somewhere else. We would definitely stay here again!
Amazing place! The view is well worth it! Nico gave us some great recommendations as well. If I come back I will look to book this place again.

Amazing views of the Duomo! The apartment is right in the city center (1 minute walking to the Duomo). Nico was very helpful. He sent us not only detailed instructions for the self-check-in (which was very smooth), but also recommendations about places to eat local food. We really enjoyed the place and its great terrace. Highly recommended!

Luis & Estrella

The place had an amazing view of the Dome and was at walking distance for the most iconic places in Florence. Nicola was very responsive and provided clear instructions on how to get there and move around. His dining suggestions were spot on!

Caterina and Nico were amazing hosts,
Gave plenty of local reccomendations and really helped out.
The place itself is beautifal witj amazing patio, right in the middle but really quiet

The location of the apartment could not be more perfect, and the co-host Nicola was a great help. We also did a private tour with him, and he is just a fantastic guide. We highly recommend this apartment

Thank you Nico! Walking onto the terrazzo and seeing Brunelleschi’s dome right there for us was breathtaking. The flat is perfect as is the area. Nico is very knowledgeable and a great tour guide. Grazie Nico!!!

The location is perfect for walking to all the sites in Florence. while it's quiet inside, we loved sitting on the balcony and listening to the bells. We were texted all the check in information and restaurants and check out information.  I would definitely stay here again.
Nico was such a friendly, responsive, and helpful host! The view was absolutely amazing and I would definitely recommend these accommodations!!

Absolutely ecstatic with this stay. This is the type of Airbnb that you book more than once. Lovely view from a spacious balcony. Nicola greeted us as well and was very friendly and cooperative. The recommendations from Nicola should not go unnoticed! Great restaurant suggestions!
The place was very tidy when I arrived and the view from the private terrace was phenomenal.  Very responsive host and great recommendations for food etc provided.  Would definitely stay here again!

If this place is available, I highly recommend you book it. Beautiful apartment, excellent location, great host. We had some trouble contacting prior to our arrival since we could only message while on WiFi, so I wasn’t able to tell her that we were running late. However, once we got to the apartment and was able to call, she was there waiting for us. Amazing experience overall.

Alessandra and Monica's place was clean and tidy. The location was great and we really enjoyed the style of the apartment and the complimentary tea, coffee and drinks were a nice touch. There were no issues with noise or with comfort. The only minor issues we had were that the bathroom was a bit too small, and that the buzzer was not labelled at the front of the apartment building - we needed to call/text to get the door opened for us. We would be happy to stay here again
We stayed for four days in this lovely apartment. It was all very clean and the location was perfect. Hope we can come back one day!
Great place in the middle of it all and most importantly for us, accessible via the train station. The place was clean and very easy to communicate with the hosts.

Fantastic stay, would highly recommend! The location is perfect, the accommodations are comfortable and clean. The area is a bit noisy but nothing that you wouldn’t find anywhere else in the city. Thank you Alessandra!

Alessandra's Chic Green flat was perfect for our stay in Florence.  The location was perfect--quiet, but convenient to the train station, the tram to the airport, and the center of town.  The flat was unusually well-equipped; we appreciated the tea kettle, tea bags, and essential bathroom supplies (shower gel & shampoo).  The bed was extremely comfortable & the AC was a life-saver.  We only had to run it briefly to keep the whole flat comfortably cool.

We loved our stay in Florence! Alessandra was quick to respond and very accommodating with our check-in and check-out times. The apartment was perfect for what we needed, and it's location was amazing. Everything was within walking distance (including the train station), and we were surrounded by cafes and restaurants. We would definitely stay here again!
We had a great stay! Perfect location and Davide always checked in on us to make sure all was well. Perfect for 2 people.

Davide’s place was perfectly situated for visiting Firenze, a few minutes walk from all the main attractions.  Restaurants and cafes on the doorstep.  For being so close to all the action we were pleasantly surprised at how quiet the apartment was.  Davide always responded very quickly and was there to greet us on arrival.  It’s a small apartment but worked perfectly for the two of us.

Officially one of our favourite air bnbs, a gorgeous little flat with it’s own private courtyard really made the atmosphere of the place perfect for our relaxed stay in Florence. We were allowed to leave our luggage at the home before check in and was greeted by Enri who was lovely and accommodated to our unexpected early arrival. We would definitely recommend this place and thank you to the hosts!

We had a wonderful stay here. We only stayed a night, but immediately agreed that we would stay again if we come back to Florence. The terrace outside is so nice and dreamy and the kitchen had everything we needed (i.e., wine opener, glasses, bowls, etc.). It also felt very secure and safe, even though when we came in, the street was quite busy with vendors by the entrance door on the street (which wasn't an issue at all, we just weren't expecting it). Hope to be back one day!

The location of the apartment is great. Both a close walking distance from the train station and from the Duomo, also surrounded by restaurants. The amenities are good and the place is comfortable. The hosts are great, they give very good recommendations and advice on attractions and food. Helpful and responsive.
we absolutely loved our stay, super cute space, loved the outdoor courtyard. very convenient and fun spot to stay. clean and tidy
This was a perfect place to stay in Florence. A short walk from everything we wanted to see. We were surprised by how quiet the apartment was being in such a busy area.

Edo and Rita’s place was wonderful, I only wish we had gotten to spend more time there. They had a wonderful little patio and was exactly as described. They gave us wonderful recommendations and were very responsive. Very gracious hosts and we would love to stay here again when we are back in Florence.
Perfect spot for 2. The hosts were very accommodating and made our stay a breeze. Would definitely stay again.

A great apartment in great location, in the beautiful palazzo, very spacious . It is central, but on the quiet street, with lovely shops and restaurants, few meters from the river Arno and Ponte Vecchio. My son and I stayed for 4 nights and really enjoyed it: apartment equipped with everything that needed. The air conditioner, Very fast Wi-Fi, coffee machine/coffe, olive oil/ salt/ pepper, toasters, microwave, all the utensils. All the little things that make your stay really comfortable. Definitely recommend and would stay again myself.

We loved our stay in Florence. The apartment had everything we could have hoped for and more. It was truly an amazing experience. This is one of the best locations in Florence, steps away from Ponte Vecchio and all the museums and sights.
