From this location, it’s a short walk to anything…restaurants, shops, basically all of old town.
The apartment is quite large, with beautiful high ceilings that make it feel even more spacious.
This is a beautiful place and perfect for anyone who wants to stay in the heart of Florence. We highly recommend it.

The locaton of the appartment ist perfect. Just half a minute from the cathedral, and some minutes to the tram station. While the main room only has court yard view, the little room upstairs offers 360° view over florence.
Unfortunately we diden't like the furnishing. Nothing fits to each other, it's just a combination of random furniture whitout any style in comon. The AC in the main room is very datet and loud.
What a pitty. I think that place deserfes a better interior.

The location was perfect. The appartement was clean, tidy and had all the facilities you need. Furthermore, the communication was quick and we could check in earlier then initially agreed upon. But the main reason for booking was the view, which was totally worth it.

This was one of my favorite places I’ve stayed in Florence. The location is in the heart of the town square. It is walking distance to everything. Raffaele met us out front and walked us into our Airbnb. The room was a perfect size for 2 people. They even had adapters for all our electronics. The view from the loft area was gorgeous. Pictures didn’t  even do it justice. It was our favorite place to sit and have wine for sunset. We can’t wait to come back to Florence to visit.
Lovely apartment. So close to everything. Communication with the host was great  - we had a lovely time. Would definitely recommend!
This Airbnb is beautiful! So wonderful and perfectly located. We had an incredible time! We loved the upper room with the incredible view!

The best location and views! We loved our stay here in Florence. A/C unit did an awesome job of cooling, even in the middle of August. In-room washing machine was nice as well (drying racks provided) with plenty of hangers.
Best Airbnb stay we have ever had. Crazy value for Florence. You have your own air conditioned tower with an AMAZING view!! 70 yards from Duomo.
Incredible location and such a wonderful building! We spent every afternoon and evening up in the private tower. Loved it.

This apartment has to be one of the coolest in Florence. The pictures don’t do justice to the view from the private rooftop that has an amazing view of the city. The apartment was very clean and well equipped with everything we needed. We highly recommend this stay!
The view from the upstairs room is truly incredible. Much better than we were hoping to get. Location was spectacular. We will be booking this place again.
This Airbnb is just absolutely fantastic! I enjoyed every minute of my short stay, and am looking forward to a future visit! Magical place!!

It is all about the duomo. This space had the most breathtaking and peaceful loft perched next to the beautiful dome. We sat in the comfy couch and watched in the evening and in the morning. The bells were heavenly.
The rest of the flat was efficient, clean and comfy. It was perfect for a day of exploring Florence.
Highly recommend.
Spacious.  Stylish to fit in with the Florentine aesthetic. Central to everything.

Wowwwww. This air BnB was amazing.
Our host was very responsible and helpful.
The apartment was beautiful and squeaky clean!
The kitchen had everything we needed. Having our own washing machine was fantastic!!
The view from the tower was spectacular!!!
And what an amazing location! Close to everything. Delicious restaurants, supermarkets, pharmacy.
We highly highly recommend to stay here. Thankyou Christina and Nicolo we loved your city and your apartment ❤️
What a view! Great place to stay if you want to walk right out your door and see it all. Nice and quiet too. Perfect place in Florence. Absolutely breathtaking.

The location and view could not have been better. We loved the 360 degree view from the upstairs. The place was very private, with an amazing view and very quiet. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitley come back.
Our stay was amazing and Cristina is a wonderful, welcoming host. The apartment was in a beautiful area with astounding views of Florence. If you get the chance to stay here, don’t pass it up!

Anna was amazing at responding to our questions.
The apartment was absolutely beautiful it was so central and easy to find. The ambience of the apartment was so wonderful. I would absolutely recommend this beautiful place to stay whilst in Florence.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay at this perfectly location in Florence. This stay provided a comfortable and peaceful environment as well as a beautiful yet simple aesthetic. Anna and Nina were very responsive to our questions and Nina provided great local recommendations as well. The neighborhood was wonderful for shopping, dining, and particularly for strolls and adventures. We were lucky to be here during mild spring days- we enjoyed the sound of the horse drawn carriages by day and sweet arias in the piazza in the evening. Really lovely, safe, and welcoming. Grazie mille for your kind hospitality!
The place was lovely! We really enjoyed. The rooms aren’t very private, so it’s important to travel with people you know well. Otherwise, no complaints!

Excellent location! The host was extremely helpful with check-in/ very accommodating to our schedule.
Bedrooms on the upper level are very small, and there not many places to hang or put clothes.
Beautiful home with a great location!  The upstair rooms did get a little warm in the hot weather. The washer was very convenient and there were plenty of places to hang clothes to dry.

This place is literally down the street from the duomo and has a couple of really nice restaurants/gelato just steps away. Amazing location. Apartment itself is beautiful and suited 5 of us well. Note that AC worked fine but we still got quite hot upstairs overnight. Host was great and very helpful.
The apartment was difficult for me to find.  Not what I was expecting - the pictures must be old.  Overall disappointed.

The place was really close to the center of Florence and all you need to see there . As expected from other comments the only issue in the appartment  was the smell coming from the toilet , but we noticed that this a pb in a lot of place in Florence... I suggest you to always shut the door of the toilet. Beside of that everything was great , the apartment is the same as the photo and the communicationn with the owner was very clear and easy :)
Giovanni is amazing we needed it a place to leave our lodge after checking out for a tour and he did arrangements for us to leave it at a hotel

Great place overall. Looked just like the photos, was spacious and comfortable. Very close to the Duomo.
I had some trouble finding the checkout instructions, so we left the keys in the same lockbox where we found them and the host was fine with that.

A great apartment, great location near the duomo and the street is full of bars, restaurants, and bakeries.  Also, mini supermarket is a few doors down so really convenient for whatever you may need. We enjoyed it and it was perfect for our stay.
Great apartment, has everything you need. Very clean, very organized, just great! Highly recommend!
A great apartment with plenty of space, nice touches and a warm and helpful welcome! Thanks for a great stay!

Lovely modern apartment, great value. Nice bed, bathroom, kitchen, coffee machine. Easy access to Florence on tram. Supermarket a few minutes walk away. I did find it a bit stressful arriving by car in rush hour, check in instructions weren't very clear and host a bit slow responding. If message had said it is the red apartment building pull up to parking barrier and I will let you in that would have been easier than following a sat nav in heavy traffic. I had received no message from host after booking despite asking days before to check in instructions. Parking garage a bonus, but very tight if you have a big car. Overall great value and nice apartment for visiting Florence, would stay again now I know how to find it.
Perfect in every way. Gianni was quick with responses, super friendly, place and location was great. I had 5 Airbnb stays in my trip to Italy - Gianni's was the best by far.

The apartment is great and very clean. The big terrace is really a plus. Gianni gives you also a lot of information about the city (maps, books). He is very nice and helps you out immediately. The location is perfect to visit Florence.

Perfect place to stay. Big balcony. The apartment has evererything what needed ( coffe, tea, plates, pans, towels, linen, shampoo, shover gel and many more). Clean and modern.  20 min by tram to historic center. Parking space. The  best place where were staying during our 2  weeks trip around Tuscany.

Our stay was very good. Gianni is super nice and helpful abd helped us to find a free parking slot not far away from the apartment because our car was too big for the garage. The Apartement is lovely and close to the tram which makes it easy to get to the coty centre.

Great host, amazing place! Gianni is truly a super host and took care of everything so we could have a wonderful stay. The apartment itself is very comfortable, modern, with all amenities that you may need during your stay. It is very well connected with the city center, you can get to the cathedral and other tourist attractions within 15 min. by a direct tram. Around the flat, there is a supermarket (Lidl) very close, open 7 days a week (including Sundays), a great bakery, a gelateria, pizzeria and all the stuff you may need. We highly recommend this place and hope will be back soon :)
Amazing location!!!!! Very clean, everything you need. Gianni was very helpful and nice to us.

This is a perfect place to stay. Communication is excellent. The place is exactly as described (and not lacking one thing (and even better in my opinion). The added bonus was the underground parking and the location of the tram stop. We didn’t use the car while we were there.
Also there was an excellent restaurant (Da Tito) about two doors down. Best meal we had in Florence. Enorme grazie to Gianni!

I have travelled globally, with Airbnb, about 70 times....and there is no question that Gianni ranks at #1 as a super host! There was nothing he could not do to make my stay enjoyable and easy. The flat is about a 5 min walk from the tram, the tram 10 or 15 mins to Centro. The flat is exactly as shown, super clean, large balcony, a wonderfully comfortable bed, and lots of hot water for showers. Firenze is so amazing on many levels. Thank you for making my 3 weeks in Firenze so special.

Our stay at Gianni's apartment was outstanding. Upon arrival communication was fast and responsive. Gianni met us at the entrance and helped us check in which was extremely helpful after a long drive. We parked our rental car in a private secure garage which was great to have because driving in Florence can be hectic. The apartment was clean, cozy and fully stocked. Bed was comfy, and shower had plenty of hot water and great water pressure.
Very quite neighborhood, surrounded by restaurants, and grocery store with easy access to the tram and center city Florence.
Overall a perfect stay. We would highly recommend staying at Gianni's place.
A+++

We really enjoyed our stay. The apartment is so close to the tram and east to get into the heart of the city. Gianni met us to help us get checked in and was always helpful and responsive.  We loved the apartment and would stay again.
Beautiful home and well maintained. Gianni came personally to pick up from the tram station. Recommend to stay if you are visiting Florence. SMN station about 15-20 mins only
The place looked exactly like the pictures, felt very safe and is close to the bus stop. The host is very friendly and helpful and answers messages quickly. Would stay again.

My stay here was great! Very close to the tram which provides easy access to the city center. The apartment is very large and clean. The bed was comfortable. Gianni was very communicative and he was right on it when I had an issue with the key. I would definitely stay here again.
We had a great stay here. The host was responsive and helped check us in to the apartment. The place was clean and the AC worked great. Having a parking spot was nice.

Very friendly host who showed us round and was very kind and communicative. Safe underground parking was great and we were allowed early check in which was ideal. Only things which weren't perfect was a problem with the door and the immediate surroundings were a bit loud and not the prettiest.

Great place well located 5min walk to the tram station direct to the city center.
This apartment have all necessary things you need, exterior is extra and safe parking place underground really practical.

Great place!!  Very easy to reach Florence city centre via train which is a 5 minute walk away.  East parking if you are driving your own vehicle. Restaurants and a grocery store close by. Very helpful host!  Would recommend to all and would definitely stay here again.

Giammaich was the best host. He was very kind and helpful. He welcomed us kindly in front of the building and answered all our questions. The house was very clean and neat. When we got home, there were even some snacks left for us in the kitchen. He informed us about the local events. I recommend his home with peace of mind.
The appartement was in a perfect place, and Zarina very helpful and friendly.. Highly recommended!
This apartment is in a great location, very clean, spacious and beautiful inside.  Francesca was extremely helpful with anything we needed.  I can highly recommend a stay here. Jane
Very beautiful and clean place. The location was perfect! Near everything and transportation. I recommend this place to anyone that wants a remarkable experience!
well equipped modern unit. beds were comfortable.  great location but main bedroom a bit noisy at night. stairs up to apartment were quite steep

Very convenient location and great price for stay but the apartment is write above a busy street where hawkers setup shop early in the morning. There is an out of the world bakery right below the apartment that makes super tasty treats. Market Centrale is a block away.

We had a great time staying at your place ! It’s a beautiful apartment in a fun neighborhood. So close to all the historical sites we planned to visit. Love the decor of your place ! Thank you for hosting us !!

Francesca was a fantastic host, always responsive and very helpful! The garden was lovely and the ceilings were incredible. The area is easily walkable to anywhere you want to go, but tucked away on a quiet street. Would definitely recommend!

Communication was prompt and friendly. The location is amazing, as it's right in the heart of the city. Although, because of this make sure you plan ahead for parking. The apartment had the essentials and was a quiet comfortable stay.

Apartment was right in the center of all the attractions and restaurants. The bed was comfy and the shower fine. The kitchen was more of a kitchenette/cupboard so difficult to cook in. The bathroom was extremely small. Jacopo was very friendly and helpful and waited for us to arrive.

As described in booking, A1 location can’t ask for better.
Accommodation ideal for a few days stay in Florence.
Host really friendly and accommodating
Amazing stay for visiting in the summer, strong AC and very close to everything you want to see!

Great place to rent if you want to be close to all the attractions. Host provides a great local guidebook with many great restaurants. Apartment is small but enough for two people. AC works great and was a lifesaver in the high heat.

The apartment is ideally located, with all the main attractions and restaurants just steps away. It's also conveniently close to the railway station. While the space is compact, it was perfectly suitable for two people. The weather was exceptionally hot (34C), and the air conditioning initially struggled to keep up, but the owners eventually resolved the issue after much effort.

I recently stayed at Renzo’s place and had a wonderful experience. The location is fantastic, being close to most popular attractions, which made exploring the city incredibly convenient. The accommodation itself was very clean, and the bathroom was spotless, which I greatly appreciated. Renzo was a great host, ensuring everything was in order for a comfortable stay. I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting the area!
Amazing location. Was so great to be able to walk everywhere. Apartment is very small but does the job if you are wanting to explore all day and not spend much time there.
Great location in the center of everything but not too loud. Host met us outside and had a whole book of local recommendations. Best airbnb!
The host was lovely and welcoming at check in. Bedroom is a reasonable size but the rest of the place is a weird layout/small. Would recommend for the price.

Well maintained and run apartments in a beautiful building in Oltrarno. The space was very nice. Modern and timeless with appealing architectural details. The location was perfect too. Not too far from Ponte Vecchio and it is en route to Piazzale Michelangelo.
Would definitely stay here again!
The apartment, location, check-in/out, and stay was wonderful. Highly recommend and would stay again.

A wonderful apartment in a beautiful historic building near Ponte Vecchio. Quiet and calm. The apartment was brilliantly clean. The air conditioning worked well, although we slept with the open windows; there were mosquito nets!
From the windows we had a great view of the neighbors' gardens.
Sara took care of very thoughtful solutions for her guests.
The apartment was equipped with all necessary things. There was really everything what you need in different situations.
We arrived in the evening and we were very pleased that Sara prepared for us water, fruit and wine in the fridge :) pasta and sauce for dinner, as well as croissants, nutella and coffee for breakfast - thank you very much.
There were also spices, oil, cleaning liquids, toilet paper, shampoo - just everything what you need. It was our best equipped apartment on airbnb!
It was a great stay - thank you Sara.

Awesome place! The location is perfect, nearby every point of interest in Florence. The apartment is really cozy, clean, beautiful and quiet. the communication and the hospitality of Sara were also perfect. Totally recommended!!
It was a wonderful stay! Sara was always avaible to answer our questions and she was very helpful. The location is perfect and close to almost everything. Very much recommend

Beautiful apartment in a calmer part of Florence. Everything within walking distance. We felt very comfortable and safe. Sara was a kind host who greeted us little cakes. The air conditioning was a huge plus. Would love to stay there again.
The Oltrarno is definitely the area to stay, and this pleasant apartment is right in the middle of a great neighbourhood. The street it faces certainly gets lively at times, but the area is terrific.

Absolutely gorgeous and quaint apartment! We felt right at home and loved every moment of it. Everything was very walkable and close to some great restaurants. Sara is an amazing host. She was very kind and made sure we had everything we needed.

Sara's place was close to most attractions. She responded quickly and was very helpful. Her home was comfortable and well equipped with everything you needed. Snacks, coffee, tea etc which was a nice touch. She also helped us book a taxi.
We were very happy there and would definitely recommend her.
This place was amazing!  The location was super convenient to everything!  We also thoroughly enjoyed the patio, having our morning coffee out there most days.
Great Central location for exploring Florence. However be prepared that the street can be a little noisy.  Very welcoming and accommodating hosts.

Mari is a very good host, he introduced in details about Florence to us.
The location is excellent. It is close to the train station and major attractions.
Five star to the host, and five star to the apartment.

The place was very clean, very well looked after and had everything we needed. Great location close to the centre and walking distance to everything!! Mari and her husband were very attentive and helpful with great recommendations

Location was great, Mari was very helpful with directions to arrive and suggestions of things nearby and in Florence. The apartment was very nice and a great base to explore Florence. Only slight negatives were the shower being a bit inconsistent and the air conditioner in the lounge not working that well (the aircon in the bedroom worked great!), these weren't really issues for us and overall it was a very good stay. Thank you!

This is a gem. Comfortable and neighborhood close to the Mercado Central. Luca was extremely helpful with restaurant recommendations and what is available in the area. Also booking a taxi for our departure to the airport at 5 AM. Highly recommended.
A perfect place to stay. Only a small walk from everything a tourist wants tosee and do.
The house was cute and cozy. The host guided me very kindly, so I had a comfortable time.

Great location, nice size, comfortable.
If you plan to be at the Airbnb anytime between 8am and 11pm, it is noisy and may not be the place for you.
Otherwise perfect place!
Great hosts and location. Space was cute but a little dirty and extremely paper thin walls. Wi-Fi was also inconsistent.

Awesome location close to train station and shopping market. Air conditioning was excellent and needed those hot June days in Florence. Communication was prompt and clear. Checkin was easy! YouTube videos explaining things are fabulous!

Having been our first time in Italy, we were so lucky to have stayed at this Airbnb. From the easy check-in, amazing central location, great food/landmark recommendations, and a very comfortable and safe stay, we highly recommend staying here for the best experience in Florence! At the end of each day, we were so happy to come back to a place that felt like home and let us recharge to explore the city again the next morning!

We had a great stay at this apartment in Florence. The location is very central- a block away from Mercato Centrale- and a great spot to get around Florence from. The hosts were very responsive and friendly via message.

The location of the Airbnb was really good for our stay as it was close to a lot of attractions. Everything was within walkable distance if not there are some bus options. The host was also really responsive and accommodating, with many recommendations for things to do/eat within the vicinity. The place was clean and spacious. Be careful if you have any heavy luggage as the stairs can be a narrow making it harder to carry up big luggage even if it was a relatively short walk up
The home was lovely. You can hear the noise from outside pretty easily so I recommend earplugs for sleeping. Overall it was a pleasant experience!

Nicely decorated! Close to all the sites in Florence. There was an issue with the key but Francesco was so responsive so it wasn’t a problem. We were prepared for this so we didn’t mind: It’s in the city so it’s going to be loud and there are a lot of stairs. Would stay here again!

Great place, well stocked, great big towels, and very clean and quiet.  Air conditioning on main floor was fantastic. It was 97 degrees when we were there and the sun lights made the upstairs an oven.  With the bedroom door shut the one room cooled off after a little while.  But the bed in the hallway and bathroom remained very hot.  It was not a big deal for us as long as the bedroom was cool.  Sometimes I felt like my questions annoyed the host, but it could just be the translation.  And he did give me happy emojis, ha. He also gave a good list of local recommendations.  And responded right away when we requested a second key.  Overall it was very positive stay and I recommend the place.

Nice and clean airbnb. Exactly what was listed. Hosts were very responsive. We had a late checkin so we were instructed to pickup the keys from a hotel which was not too far from airbnb. Had a little hard time looking for the place and hard time using the key going in the building but hosts were very responsive and nice enough to come and help us in during late hours. Would definitely book again when we come back. Highly recommended!

We had a lovely stay in Florence and the location of the apartment is excellent. The beds were very comfortable but there were just a few things lacking.
For example:
Extra pillows
Tea towel
Kitchen towel
Oven glove (to lift the kettle)
And a very dangerous chair which was broken prior to our arrival. The coffee table has bits of metal sticking out of it and likely to cause injury. There was a lack of glasses, on complaining they brought a few more but left us with only 2 wine glasses between 4 of us. Surely if it is advertised as a 5 person accommodation there should be 5 sets of cutlery, crockery and glasses.

Everything was amazing. Laura always responded quickly. The apartment is even bigger than in the photo. The house is fenced, it's quiet around. There was everything you need, everything that is described in the ad. Walking to the center takes about 1 hour, or you can use public transport. Unfortunately we had to leave much earlier and didn't use the pool. We will be happy to stay here again in the future.

Beautiful location and outside of tourist area - but still pretty accessible. Absolutely loved the recommendations from the host. They have thought through each and every need and it's prefect for your stay in Florence.
Great and clean apartment with great design, it includes everything (towels and kitchen equipment). Awesome host with great advises and recommendations for visiting the city.

One of my all around favorite Airbnb’s. Perfect location for what I was looking for-very walkable and right next to the river, but surprisingly quiet building at night. Would stay again if I’m ever back in Florence.

Teo’s lovely flat is perfectly located for the bars, restaurants and sights of Florence. His apartment is bright and spacious with great amenities - a perfect place from which to explore the city. Teo gave great recommendations and was a friendly and communicative host - we couldn’t have asked for any more. Thank you Teo!
Had a very pleasant stay at a clean apartment with everything I needed from a responsive, friendly host!

Stayed here for 5 nights with 2 friends. Everything was excellent, great communication from the host and lots to do in the neighbourhood. It is great, it's so close to the tram which gets into the city so fast. Excellent value for money. Would highly recommend. Many thanks 😊

We loved our stay here! This flat was in an absolutely perfect location! You walk out and you are at the central market. We bought pastries and fruit here for breakfast and then came back at night and ate at the restaurants in the upper level. It took about 15 min or less to reach all of the things we wanted to see (Uffizi, Galleria, Ponte Vecchio, Florence Cathedral) and we were very close to the train station. Definitely recommend staying here!

The apartment is in a fantastic location directly next to the Central Market, however the room itself does not get any of the street noise.
The check in process was easy and communication with the host was great.

Enis is very helpful and super responsive. This is a perfect place for someone who like to be close to all the tourist spots. There's a laundry mat very close by and many cafe for quick breakfast. We were able to store our luggage at Enis's listing and the location is super convenient. Highly recommended!

Edoardo's & Michela's humble abode was an incredible place to stay. The house was clean, spacious and in great location. My family of 6 really enjoyed the place. Lot's of restaurants, coffee shops, grocery stores and landmarks in the area. The only thing we had a problem is the wifi. It can barely reach 2 of the rooms but we're mostly out of the house since you can do so much around the area so it was okay.

Apartment is in a great location, close to everything. It does get loud in the early mornings but tolerable. The bedroom and bathroom doors don't have locks. The apartment does not have a microwave, but everything else is available in the kitchen.
This is a wonderful apartment. It's a beautiful location and our hosts were attentive and so helpful. I highly recommend this apartment!
An excellent location for a group staying in Firenze to see the city sights. Approximately 10 minutes walk from the  Duomo di Firenze and from the river.

Would highly recommend staying in this Airbnb when visiting Florence. It was located in a less touristy, but still close to everything part of town. We really appreciated the host's communication style and it was super easy to check-in/out. We also slept really well on the comfortable beds!

This place was in an excellent location and the hosts were wonderful!
To note: If you have big luggage, you’ll have to carry it up many stairs. This was out of the host’s control, but the upstairs neighbors were quite loud. Just a heads up for any light sleepers!

Amazing place, great deal. Right in downtown area very walkable to all popular tourist attractions, yet just far enough away for some quiet away from the action. All great size bedrooms to support a full family. Outdoor patio was perfect and quiet for hanging out. Iacopo and Tatiana were easy to communicate with and provided ample flexibility in checking in
Great place. Nice having bathrooms in each bedroom. Balcony was a nice space to hang out. Lots of stairs which was hard for my older mother.

Location is further from highlights and the train station than we expected. The stairs were difficult to manage with suitcases since we were on the 3rd floor with no elevator.  This was described as such.  The kitchen was a bit tight for 6 people.  The bathrooms were nice however one bedroom had the shower in the hallway outside the kitchen.   The upstairs bedroom was large and had a beautiful view and terrace to enjoy.  We were early and the host did allow us to check in earlier which was great.  The place was clean.  Taxis are difficult to obtain at this location even when calling ahead.
What a great apartment in central Florence.  Great rooms, very clean and charming.  Close to everything!  Thank you so much!

We had a wonderful stay in Florence, the apartment is brilliantly placed in the city. it was spotless, has all the amenities and looks identical to the photos. Check in was easy, the small issues we had with the apartment were not problematic and the questions asked were quickly answered. We were very happy with our stay, thank you!
We had a great time, be aware there are lots of stairs (it’s on the top floor) that’s how you get a terrace 🌞
Great location. 4 flights of steep stairs but we expected that so it was no problem.  It was within easy walking distance to Santa Croce which was fabulous!
Lovely flat in the heart of downtown. Yes, there are stairs, but it’s also Florence.  So be prepared to walk a lot anyways.  Wonderful layout and perfect for a few days stay while exploring the city.

This was a very clean and comfortable apartment. It was a cool oasis during a summer heatwave. The hosts were very thoughtful and we really appreciated the little touches they left for us. The location is a little way from the main attractions and we needed to catch one or two buses to get anywhere. It was too hot and far for us to walk in summer. The buses were frequent and easy to use.

Me and my girlfirend had a very pleasant stay in the appartment of Massimo and Carlotta. The appartment is extremely tidy and clean, very well equipped and nicely decorated. The communication with the host was very pleasant and quick.
Location is perfect, the city centre is reachable by foot (30 minutes), but we enjoyed using the electric city bikes which can be picked up on the streets (you have ot use an app on your phone).
If you come by car, there is usually a parking space in the neighbourhood although there are parking costs, but it's cheaper than the parking garagers in the city.
The only recomendation for the appartment is to make the wifi signal a bit stronger so there is also a signal in the master bedroom.
All together a very good experience, the appartment is well recommended!

If you are reading this review you should stop and BOOK this asap. This is the best place we stayed during our 2 weeks trip to Italy.
The host helped us with everything we needed, fast response, helpful tips and instructions.
The location is great only a short bus ride from the train station. There are restaurants, drug stores, supermarkets nearby.
There’s even free overnight parking which we used one night.
Book this now or you will regret later

We had an absolutely fantastic stay at this Airbnb! We can't recommend it enough to our friends and family. The host went above and beyond to make our stay unique and tailored to our needs. The apartment was exceptionally modern, impeccably clean, and well-equipped with everything we could possibly need. With the bus stop just a few minutes and the convenient Bus 17 connecting us to the city centre in no time, the location was perfect. We were thoroughly impressed and would eagerly return to Florence just to stay here again.
Very cool apartment in an amazing location. The unit is spacious, beautiful furnished, and extremely cosy. The views and rolling hills outside are immaculate. Easy to get to and from downtown by bus.

GREAT location. Clean and charming.
Highly recommend for anyone. It is lovely.
The listing was centrally located and the host was always available. The host also provides really good recommendations and instructions. Thanks!
Fabulous apartment in the heart of Florence. Close to all the wonders of the city within easy reach of the train station. We loved every minute. Both check in/ check out went without a hitch.
GREAT location. The only issue was noise late at night and into the early morning hours. People partying, not always pleasant exchanges.

Location was perfect and Giampaolo was a great host. Only issue was the noise level. The windows aren’t sealed so you can hear everything from the street level. Construction was happening every day when I was there so did not get much sleep 😅. Otherwise great apartment.

We throughly enjoyed our stay. Giampaolo was very helpful and responded quickly whenever we had a question. The apartment was clean and had everything we needed. Great location, would highly recommend this stay 👌

The apartment has everything you need. It is very convenient to have an elevator, ac, full kitchen and nice bath. I used the downstairs bed, and it was very comfortable.
The location cannot be beat. Two blocks from the Duomo, with wonderful church bells.
I highly recommend this apartment. Just bring earplugs as the street noise can be loud at all hours. I had no problems, though, because I used earplugs.
Our stay was fabulous! Giampaolo was super responsive! Loved being so convenient to all the attractions.

We very much enjoyed our stay at Susy's casa! It was exactly as described and so much more. It felt like home away from home. The property is accessible to the centre of Florence via Bus 37. We enjoyed this more than staying in the city centre. Susy is an exceptional host, always responsive and her home had every amenity you can imagine. Book this place! We look forward to our next stay with Susy. Grazie Mille, Susy!

Susy’s place is the perfect place to stay if you wish to be just outside of Florence with peaceful, quiet, and beautiful surroundings. You can easily take the bus into the city. Susy’s place is comfortable, home-y and full of character. I really enjoyed my short stay.

Niccolo is a fantastic host. He is very communicative and quick to respond. The apartment couldn’t be any closer to the duomo unless you were sleeping at the steps. The apartment is clean, very spacious, and the air conditioning works great!
Great apartment that met our needs of a family of 4 for a nice weekend in Florence.   Cute and clean and great location.

Niccolò was a fantastic host who went above and beyond to help us settle in to his accomodation, responsive, flexible and helped with local tips and recommendations. It really feels like a home and is a credit to Niccolò.

Right in the heart of everything! Wonderful location! You can walk to so much! The evening had such a nice feel! Perfect Italian feel in the apartment! You can hear lots of voices and any emergency vehicles so if you’re a light sleeper you may want to bring earplugs. We were so tired it didn’t bother us at all!! We slept great. The host was so kind and flexible with our arrival time!

Niccolò’s apartment was absolutely wonderful for our stay in Florence. The location is perfect right near the Duomo, in fact you can see the dome out the windows. The apartment is spacious, clean and comfortable. The traditional wood and brick ceilings and decor give the apartment a beautiful authentic old Italian vibe. Niccolò was very helpful and responsive as well. Would highly recommend the apartment for a stay in Florence!

Niccolò was a fantastic host and was extremely helpful and responsive, even when becoming a father the same morning! Congratulations again and thank you for the wonderful stay. Great location and amenities.

Pros: quiet, clean, comfortable
Cons: 4th floor NO elevator made the climb SIGNIFICANT. Not appropriate for people over 55.
Entry/exit and lights/ac was through a complicated pin and card system. We had several failures during our 1 week stay that left us lucked out, or without power. Unacceptable.
Note: this apartment is 2 separate bedrooms joined my a very small entry room/kitchen. You will not spend time in the common room.
Extremely friendly host who greeted us on arrival, left goodies, and was attentive to our every need. Can't fault the location, quiet with easy access to the centre and santo spirito.

Amazing stay at Fiorenza’s apartment. Great location to base yourself from. I worked remotely from here for a month and had no issues with the internet connection whatsoever - highly recommend it as a space to work from.

Great apartment in an excellent location, just near Piazza Santo Spirito, and easy to walk to all main attractions. Apartment has everything needed, including large fridge, freezer, gas hob and king size bed, and was spotlessly clean. Host is friendly and very helpful. Highly recommended.

start to finish this was a great place to stay. Fiorenza was wonderful to communicate stuff before we got there and that continued through our visit.
The apartment is lovely. has everything you could want.
We loved the neighborhood. It's wonderful to stroll though, get lost, find a local restaurant or take one of Fiorenza's wonderful recommendations.
We were there for liberation day. an experience we won't forget. Felt lucky to be in this neighborhood for it.
hope to come back some day!!!
Clean, modern, and spacious place I would love to live in for an extended period of time. Hosts were excellent!
Great location,  be sure to fill out/email the host your details prior to day of arrival because there is some communication involved there - can't just show up!

Soak up the beauty and buzz of Firenze from this beautiful Oltrarno apartment with its excellent central location, rustic-luxe design, luxurious beds and helpful tips on places to eat out. The sound of street life drifts into the front apartment, but that just adds to the atmosphere. We loved our stay here - a perfect sanctuary to retreat to after hours exploring the cathedral or Uffizi!
The apartments are a beautiful blend of old world charm and modern convenience - they are even better than the photos. My family thanks you for our lovely stay in Florence.

The place was amazing, great location, Andrea was very friendly. The only reason I gave it 4 stars instead of 5, was check-in was terrible. We met the check-in person at the agreed upon time, but he was having trouble with the keys/cards to get inside, and we were stuck waiting in the stairwell outside the door for about 40 minutes with all of our luggage while he tried to figure it out. However once we finally got in, no complaints and we loved the place.

Do not hesitate this home was so worth it! so beautiful you really got the Florence feel so much beautiful detail and still preserving the 200 year old architecture. I would diffently stay again everything is a walking distance. especially if you have a large group this is the place to stay at. 10/10 thank you so much for having us we loved it.

Room was beautiful!
Sav answered all questions I had very quickly!
Close to train station, which was amazing!
Thank you Sav, would recommend.

Thanks Sav for being a great host. Being very patient with me as I wasn't sure how to get to his direction. Place is spacious, clean and convenient. Checking in and out is very simple. Thanks for providing an amazing place to stay! Florence is amazing, sav house is amazing.
Helpful host! Location is only 5 min train from city center. Train station across the street. Great sunset/sunrise view

Very nice apartment with modern equipment. The house is quite modern, so the apartment is well isolated and not very hot even with +40 degrees outside.
The apartment is close to the Refredi train station and the train is definitely the best way to get to the centre. The area is nothing special, a typical residential area.
The bed creaks when you move, that was disturbing. The balcony itself is very nice, but it could be a bit more lovingly equipped.
The lights in the bathroom are not enough, it is a bit dark. And the bathroom door creaks as well.
Simply amazing experience. Beautiful appartment, fair price, excellent communication. If you have the chance, definitely stay here.

One of the best Airbnbs I’ve ever stayed. Well located, only a couple stations away from the city centre. Totally cleaned and good welcoming gift. Claudia was always kind and helpful. Hope I can return.
A very well located apartment, finished to a very high standard. Antonio is a fantastic host. The apartment has a wonderful view from the balcony. We would love to return!
This is a good apartment and very close to a train station. As long as you don't mind the strong smell of cigarette smoke, you will enjoy it.
Cute and cozy clean apt with a nice view ! Felt like it was home ! Gotten great sleep and rest there ! Host was amazing ! Super friendly and sweet.
Great apartment and great location! Easy to find and easy to get to central Florence! The apartment made me feel right at home and was super comfy! Would definitely recommend 😊

This was one of the best air b&b’s we have stayed in! Super clean and well-equipped with an amazing view of the duomo! We had wine on that patio every night to soak in the view. Antonio, the host, is always available and responds quickly if you need anything. Not to mention the full guide he gives you of any kind of recommendation you might want. Highly recommend you stay here, as it’s also walking distance to everything!
The location was in a nice area, and the apartment was pristine. Antonio was exceptionally helpful and had a lot of great recommendations. I would definitely stay here again!

We stayed for 5 Nights and everything was perfect!! We met Antonio on the first day and we were in contact via WhatsApp! He gave us a lot or tips. It was Great. The Appartement is amazing, as well as the area.
Absolutely perfection- we adored the apartment, and the hospitality was unparalleled!!! 10/10 would recommend and we can’t wait to come back!!!

Excellent Airbnb close to everything you want to see in Florence.  Antonio was the best Airbnb host we have experienced.  He gave us lots of recommendations for highlights to see and places to eat.  The Smallest Pizzeria in the World experience he helped us book was outstanding.  The apartment itself is very comfortable and has everything you need to be comfortable.  It was recently remodeled and is very new and comfortable.  The views are outstanding.  Highly recommend Antonio and this Airbnb.
Beautifully renovated apartment in a resident’s part of Firenze. Calm and peaceful with tons to do in a short walk. Loved the proximity to markets as well as the highlights of the city. Great stay!
We loved our vacation here in Florence! We couldn’t ask for a more beautiful or perfect place to stay! Antonio was incredibly helpful and so friendly! We can’t wait to come back!

Antonio was an amazing host! He had so many great recommendations and was always quick to respond! His home is beautiful and in a great location. We would definitely book again if we visit Florence in the future!
Big neat flat at perfect location. Adrian is very quick in answering any questions and made check-in / out very easy. Would definitively stay there again.

Great apartment, very good size for the price, two full sized bedrooms, only one short flight of stairs. The location is perfect, very central, just a few steps away from Uffizi and piazza della Signoria...and from Vinaio. Enjoyed my staying
Adrian was very communicative and the place was in a great location in Florence. The air conditioning was welcome at the end of a hot summer day playing tourist. Quiet and safe area.
Adrian was very helpful and communicative, we loved the place and it was a great location for us to walk and see all of the attractions!

Antonio was an amazing host and we loved our stay at Casa degli Allegri! It was perfect for our needs and the best airbnb we’ve ever stayed at. The place was spotless and very comfortable. We enjoyed the balcony area with amazing views of the Duomo and rooftops of Florence. Antonio sent us many local recommendations which was very helpful and much appreciated! Would stay here again in a heartbeat should be lucky enough to return to Florence in the future!

We stayed at Antonio's flat in Florence for 4 days, and it was fantastic.  Easy access and wi-fi connection, clean, and stylish...plus a view of the Duomo! He was a wonderful host who reached out regularly to check in and offer recommendations.  He was responsive and had great ideas for local activities that were off the beaten path.  We highly recommend a stay here!

Antonio is a great host.  The apartment was described perfectly. The location was in a perfect place to walk everywhere. We even took in a soccer match which wasn’t far.  His recommendations for restaurants were spot on also, plus the coffee shop next door was perfect for another cup of coffee to start our day. Antonio also had coffee in the unit as well.  We would definitely book here again on our next trip to Florence.

The apartment was beautifully appointed and had everything we needed for our stay. The washing machine was a bonus for us to do laundry during a week of traveling. The location was excellent! Incredibly walkable to local spots and close to tourist attractions. We loved sitting on the patio taking in views of the Duomo. Antonio gave us so many unique recommendations which we took advantage of and were always surprised! We would absolutely stay again!

We absolutely *loved* our stay in Florence, and this Airbnb was a big reason why! From the moment we booked, communication with Antonio was top-notch—super responsive, helpful, and genuinely thoughtful. He truly thought of everything to make our stay comfortable and memorable.
The apartment itself was stunning—full of charm with beautiful handmade wooden touches that gave it such a warm, authentic feel. Everything was spotless and exactly as described (if not better!). The location couldn’t have been more perfect: easily walkable to all the must-see sights, delicious food spots, and lively nightlife.
What really stood out were Antonio's trusted recommendations. Every suggestion, from restaurants, to charming walks, to all the best local spots, was spot on. We got to experience Florence like a local thanks to his guidance.
If you're heading to Florence —this is the place to stay. We’ll definitely be back!

Antonio is amazing! His place is beautiful and is in a great location. Feels so comfortable and the decor is so nice! Antonio goes beyond expectations to make your stay a great one.
Highly recommend!!

This was probably our best experience on Airbnb. I will start by saying that Antonio's apartment is very well thought out, in terms of comfort and design. The apartment has everything you need for a stay of any length: dishes, a washing machine, a clothes dryer, an iron and a coffee machine. An additional bonus is the balcony, with a great view of Florence and the sunset. Nearby there is a market with vegetables and fruits from local producers, as well as a large supermarket. In addition, a large number of restaurants and cafes are available. All attractions are within walking distance, the apartment is centrally located, and at the same time it is quiet at night. Antonio himself is an amazing person, very responsive and gave us good local recommendations. Thank you for the bottle of wine on the last night, it was wonderful 😉

Antonio's apartment is so spacious and clean. The place is near many delicious restaurants and the little terrace offers a special view. But the most impressive part of this house is Antonio himself!! He is so considerate and helpful I was always amazed by his thoughtfulness. Thank you Antonio!

Highly recommend Antonio’s place for your visit to Florence. As a host, he was the best of the best - great recommendations, eager to help us, booked taxis, extremely quick to respond. The place was perfect, and the view from the balcony is better than pictured. If we find our way back to Florence, I hope I can stay here again!

Antonio is the greatest airbnb host I’ve ever interacted with. The apartment is fantastic - perfectly located, with major attractions walkable, excellent restaurants and cafes nearby, and Antonio’s recommendations were personalised and terrific. Couldn’t recommend staying here highly enough.

We loved staying here! It’s in a fabulous location - so easy to walk to everything and also very quiet. The AC is nice and cold and though it was too hot for us to enjoy the balcony we can see how it would make for a lovely evening! Antonio had tons of Florence recommendations which we really appreciated

Amazing stay! Couldn’t ask for a better location. Great communication, very clean too. Only suggestion would be pretty minimal amenities, make sure to bring your own shampoo, conditioner, coffee, etc.
Nice stay in Florence. Perfect location. Just needs better cleaning, the sheets were a bit dirty.
Clean and spacious place, perfect location too. Marco is a great host too who responds pretty quickly. Definitely would stay here again!

Perfect place to stay in Florence, would stay again without any second thoughts. Everything is in walk distance, lots of restaurants around. Pretty silent at night, slept like a baby. Host is very responsive, we asked to check one of the AC units and the master came very same day. Perfect price/value ratio.

The location of this place is absolutely a 10 out of 10! It’s right in the heart of everything — just steps away from historic sites, major attractions, restaurants, shopping, and public transportation like trams. The area is always bustling, but it felt very safe and welcoming at all hours. Whether you’re sightseeing, dining out, or just exploring the city, everything you need is right around the corner.
Marco, the host, was fantastic. There was someone waiting to welcome us when we arrived, and Marco provided very clear directions and instructions ahead of time, which made everything super smooth. He also gave us plenty of great recommendations to help us navigate and enjoy the city like locals.
The apartment itself was cozy and just right for our short stay — comfortable and equipped with everything we needed. Would definitely recommend it for anyone looking to stay in a vibrant, central location with a helpful and communicative host.

The place is beautiful, location was perfect, only minutes from all the hot attractions.  Check was easy as we had someone meet me there and show me around.  We loved spending time in the unit, we were 9 of us and felt it was very spacious.  Also, the unit gets a wonderful cross wind, which is nice during the hot days and nights.  I would highly recommend staying here. This place is literally just a few minutes walk from the train station and minutes from the local market.

This apartment was absolutely amazing, and very spacious for my family of 6. Everything was very clean and we'll stocked. The location is very convenient with it being just a very short walk to the tram or even only about a 10 min walk to the Dome.
Out host were very friendly and very communative.
I would highly recommend staying in this lovely home and would gladly stay here again for my next visit in Florence.
Very clean and comfortable accomodation for large group/ family. easy access to public transport to all major attractions and proximity to the station. large rooms.

It was great !
The apartment was clean and comfortable.
We were a 9 adults and 2 kids and the place was suitable for us!
Thank you !!!
Great place for a large group of people! Although being close to the downtown, the location is comfortably near train station and isn't so nice.
The airbnb is close to the Firenze train station, and the house is big! It is a great experience!

We had a wonderful stay in Florence. The airbnb was very well located and had everything we needed. The host was very responsive especially when our plane got delayed and our arrival was later than expected.
Ginevra’s apartment is spacious, clean, and modern, perfectly located near Sant’Ambrogio. ideal for work or holiday. Highly recommend to all!

The flat was ideal for a couple. The bed was comfortable. The two toilets were fully equipped with showers and else, and clean. We were able to enjoy and appreciate the city, in part, due to the wonderful accomodation provided by Ginevra!
Great place, clean and lots of space. Was perfect for us! They gave us good local recommendations and made sure we had everything we needed.

Ginevra’s apartment was beautiful and exactly what what we expected from the photos. It was steps away from a local market which we loved! So many great restaurants in the area too. We had a great time- thank you!

We had a great stay in the apartment, I've stayed in many air bnb's in Florence and this has by far been the best. The location is fantastic, a short walk into the shopping area and the duomo. I worked from the apartment during the day, the WiFi was brilliant, with video calls etc.
The apartment is clean, and all newly renovated so everything is all tidy. Having two bathrooms was great, and with the apartment only being on the second floor, there were stairs but they are wide and even. Something of a rarity in Florence.
There was a fire stick, so my young son had loads of TV shows/films to choose from.
I would definately stay here again. The host was extremely responsive too.

Great place to stay in Florence!
Very clean and with all you need for a short stay.
Emmanuel was a great host. Thanks

Can’t fault a single thing about my stay here. The apartment is beautiful! Lovely decor and one of the comfiest beds I’ve ever slept in. It’s peaceful and quiet in the evenings.
The location is a short walk into Florence but on that walk is some of Florence’s top spots for food & gelato so no complaints there. There is a lovely cafe just at the end of the road for breakfast too.
No regrets at all with staying here & I would recommend to all, you won’t be disappointed!
This apartment was perfect for our stay. The kitchen came fully loaded with the appliances that we needed, and the apartment overall provided more than enough space for us.

It was a beautiful apartment, well equipped, very clean, surrounded of local artisan stores, close to the major attractions. We enjoyed the place and the amenities. We would return and stay again there. It was always an oasis to return after long walks and warm weather.

Nora’s apartment is beautiful! It’s located on a quite street that is close to bus stops to take you closer to the center of Florence. Check in was simple and easy. I would recommend staying here! It was wonderful!!
Loved this place.  Unique.  A little far from the center but still easy to get to everything.  Lots of great restaurants around

We had a nice stay. The apartment is located 30 mins walking distance from the city center, which didn’t bother us as we enjoy walking and knew that in advance. The bed was quite comfy and I was happy to have a real blanket. In general we would recommend if you like a place which is a little more on the vintage side. Only thing that we didn’t expect from the description is that it has no own parking slot, but you can park in an alley nearby for free if you are lucky enough to find a space. We had at least after re-parking.
Great place with a great host, very helpful and fast at replying. Smooth check-in and the spot in perfect! Enjoyed our stay at Emanuele!

Emanuele’s apartment was great. It was in the perfect location, and it was easy to walk anywhere in the city from the apartment. Emanuele was an excellent host, easy to communicate with and very hospitable! We would definitely recommend staying here!

Look no further for a place to stay in Florence. You will not be disappointed- from location, to cleanliness and design this apartment has it all Emanuele is also a great host, very responsive and communicative.

Great location with easy access to everything. Unit is clean and stocked with various essentials.
FYI - there is a steep staircase going up to the unit for those with a lot of luggage.
Had some issues with the heater/electricity but Emanuele was quick to resolve them! Great communication overall.

Perfect stay, location, communication and space
The only problem is the stairs
I Really recommend it

Emanuele‘s place was amazing! Great location, extra heaters during the cold winter months, open lines of communication, and delicious espresso and snacks ready upon arrival. Would book again in a heartbeat.

Emanuele is a wonderful 5 star host! He is so responsive & helpful & made my stay so easy. As an English speaker with novice Italian skills, he was great. Very clean & chic apartment in the perfect location… can’t get much better!

We had a wonderful stay in Florence. The apartment is only 5min from the train station and walk-in distance to all the sights in Florence. Emanuele was a great host and spent time orienting us to the city. Just be aware that the apartment is on the 4th floor with a narrow stairway and no elevator.  It is located on a main square but is very quiet. Would highly recommend.

I highly, highly recommend this Airbnb for your trip to Florence!! The location was perfect being just a 5-minute walk to the Florence train stain. It's also located in the Piazza di Santa Maria Novella, but the apartment itself is very quiet! The bed is SO comfortable and we slept so well. All of the amenities were excellent and the decor inside was perfect. Emanuele responded to all of my messages very quickly. Just note, the apartment is on the 3rd floor so be prepared to climb some stairs! Also, there are blinds outside of the windows that you can close so that the apartment is dark at night. 10/10 Stay here for your next visit!

Gorgeous apartment in a perfect location! A block from the Santa Maria Novella train station and literally across from the gorgeous Santa Maria Novella itself. The apartment was well decorated and had a wonderful AC system/general amenities. Ginevra helped us check in, and she was very kind and very accommodating regarding letting us check in an hour early and stow our bags there the next morning after check out until our train departure. Would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient home base while exploring beautiful Florence.

Great stay, a block away from train station and decently close to everything without being right in the middle of it.
Excellent t access with no keys involved, great windows and everything about the charming place is just that, very charming.
Would stay again for sure.

A lovely flat for 2, though it would be cramped for 4 (and would need more mugs and glasses). Noisy if youhad windows open but there is aircon.
We would have liked instructions for disposing rubbish e5c.

Amazing location if you want to be close to the train station. Other air bnbs in the city can keep you up at night due to street noise but the windows here really kept it quiet so you can sleep well. Overall solid.

No complaints at all
Checkin was really straightforward, the flat was really nice & quiet.
Easily walkable to any site in Florence.
I’d stay there again
We stayed in Florence for a few nights while traveling through Italy and couldn’t recommend enough. Very convenient to the train station with lots to do!
Very clean and great host communication. Great location close to the train station and duomo. We had a great time!
The apartment is in a very convenient location, close to the train station and tourist spots. It has all the amenities for our stay. The washer is a plus. Emanuele is very responsive on our request.

We were in Florence for 5 nights as a home base for our first trip to Florence/Italy. This apparent was a perfect place for our time there. It is very close to the train station and the city center. There is plenty of food all around and we felt safe the whole time we were there. Would definitely stay here again!
I had really great stay in here, apartment was close to everything and they let me early check in, only downside is the narrow stairs but it makes it up with location

We had a great stay in this apartment. It was clean, spacious for our need, and felt in a great location just outside of the busy areas. The apartment was quiet in the evenings despite being adjacent to restaurants and foot traffic, and contact with the host was brilliant, available via phone messenger or AirBnB. Thank you for a great stay!
Brunella was a wonderful host! She was quick to reply and very friendly. The apartment is beautiful and located in the heart of Santa Croce. Highly recommend!
Stayed here for 7.5 weeks. The location was very central and convenient for all the sites and for transportation. We had a comfortable stay.

Amazing location walking distance to everything.
Host was very accommodating we checked in early and had a great time. The space was big enough for my wife and I and our two adult children (20s) and the layout still allowed us some privacy.
Restaurants, grocery stores and all the attractions just a short walk.
We would definitely book again.
Everything was just great. Amazing house, beautiful air, nice location and very hospitable host. Certainly will consider to rent this property again.

Amazing location and amazing host. This was by far the best Airbnb we stayed in Italy. Paola was very friendly and informative. She gave us great recommendations during and after our stay. Would definitely come back.

Paola is very nice and gives a lot of insider tips where to eat and where to have a drink with a wonderful view. The apartment has everything you need for a stay in Florence. It is also very clean.
Can highly recommend to stay on her apartment! :)
This place is great! It’s in a good location however is still quiet. Highly recommended! Thanks Paola x
Wonderful central apartment in the heart of Florence with a nice view. Close to train station and all of the main attractions in the city.

Great apartment and location, we really enjoyed the balcony area.
The air conditioner was broken for our stay, which made the nights unbearably hot, hope they can fix it soon for future guests.
If you have mobility issues sleeping in the loft might not work for you but there is a pull out bed downstairs. It is in the best location in Firenze.

This apartment had everything we needed and more for our stay in Florence. Set in the most beautiful location within the old town, with only a 10 minute walk from the train station and to any of the main attractions like the Uffizi Gallery, Ponte Vecchio  and Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore. Walk out into the street and pick from the 100s of restaurants and cafes available nearby. The apartment itself comes with a functioning kitchen with inspirational views, a comfy bed and a decent size living / dining area. The absolute highlight however was the balcony with views of Florence rooftops and the dome of the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore. Miriam was a fantastic host who met us in person and gave us a tour of the apartment. He was especially helpful in allowing us to drop off our bags early and made us feel extremely welcome. We plan on coming back and staying for at least a week next time.
This was a great apartment with a lovely terrace. It is seated in a perfect location and has a lovely interior.

We had a fantastic day at Miriam‘s. You can’t beat the location, it’s walking distance to all the sites. The space was clean and as described. The air conditioning kept up with the extremely hot temperatures. Having an elevator was a nice perk, it was not working one morning, but was back on by the afternoon. The bed is in a loft up a tight flight of stairs and persons over 6 feet tall run the risk of bumping their head on the ceiling. The gorgeous view from the balcony and nightly music drifting up from the Piazza made for a magical end to each day.

Perfect location to explore Florence, close to the river and major attractions. We loved sitting out on the terrace and enjoying wine while hearing the music and church bells. Excellent communication and recommendations. Thankful for the elevator. Great apartment for two people!

The place was walkable to everything and the elevator was a lifesaver for my dad who had a bad knee. The stairs up to the bed may pose a challenge to some as well as the smaller shower, but the place is very clean and comfortable! Would stay again!
We had a great stay! Perfect location within great distance to all major activities and attractions. Miriam and the cohosts were very friendly.
The most beautiful views. Wonderful balcony. Night view is worth a mint. Everything you could possibly need.

Top 3 reasons this apartment was FANTASTIC!!
1. Elevator from ground floor .. no lugging suitcases up a flight of stairs to get to the elevator
2. Two A/C units to keep the entire apartment nice and cool during a heatwave!
3. Huge terrace for morning coffee and evening wine with cheese. Loved the opera singer on the corner who we could hear each night
So glad we booked this. Very responsive hosts who booked a taxi to airport for 05:00
Thank you so much !!

Lorella’s apartment is absolutely beautiful. It’s on a great block where we always felt safe coming home late at night. The place made us feel at home in every sense. She takes care of the small details: fresh, plush bath towels, impeccably clean, a great shower head, functioning coffee machine, toast and honey for breakfast, plush, clean bedding, and even a bottle of wine to welcome us when we arrived. Without realizing it we were about 2-2.5 blocks away from the Ponte Vecchio and several major points of interest. The neighbors are quiet and seem like friendly families that keep to themselves. If you can, be sure to check out the restaurants one or two doors from the apartment. They were excellent. Thank you, Lorella! Excited to book your apartment on our next trip.
Lorella’s apartment is well-equipt, clean and charming.  Any issues were promptly addressed by the host.  Three fabulous restaurants near the apartment.  Memorable stay!
Very lovely apartment. Perfect location!The bed could have been a little more comfortable, but other than that we loved our stay!!

My stay in Florence was amazing and I loved every second at Anna’s house. It was just as the listing showed and described. Lorella was super responsive and replied to every question I had. Definitely will recommend to friends and family visiting Florence in the future!

Nice apartment in a great location. The elevator was a lifesaver for my knees after walking over cobblestones while exploring the lovely location. I did have to wait to get my luggage inside after asking for an early entrance for my luggage. Fortunately someone leaving let me in so I could leave the luggage and go explore and get lunch. It was almost 2 hours before I got the entrance code. But the unit is lovely and has all the amenities. The bottle of Chianti and treats were a nice surprise.

Super location! In a few minutes you are everywhere.
Nice place, some food and beverages for breakfast are offered in the kitchen + a bottle of wine.
Thank you, Lorella!
Highly recommended!
Lorella was incredibly responsive and helpful! The apartment was so clean and in a great location! We loved having the little elevator to get our bags up and down!

Wow, this is truly a gem among places to stay in Florence! We loved every second of it, and our only regret was not staying longer! It was an absolute prime location, right off the busy street but the road to get into the flat wasn't travelled heavily.
The amenities were amazing, and such a relief to be able to wash our clothes and dry them (on an electric dryer no less!) Shower and bathroom were superb, as was the kitchen (fully stocked!) and bedroom!
Speaking of the kitchen we loved having the option to make food there (breakfast and lunch especially), as there was coffee, tea, some break set up and all kitchen utensils needed to cook meals!
My girlfriend absolutely loved this flat, due to its central location, amenities and layout of it! Totally wish we stayed another day just for the apartment as it was so relaxing!
Lorella was the best communicator and helpful at any time I needed something. The place was spotless. The bed is so cosy and it’s really quiet. I would definitely recommend this place.
Lorella’s place was super clean & in walkable distance of great restaurants, shopping, & sites. She and her family made me feel right at home.

Absolute perfect location. Walked everywhere during our stay here given how nice the area was. It's super close to the station, was super clean, and the host gave us recommendations on where to go and what to do. Excellent communication and overall a great experience with a beautiful view

Grazie Diana e Roberto!
Appartment was brand new, clean, and our host was very welcoming
Great location and perfect city to spend 2-5 days in and live the dolce vita

Wonderful Airbnb steps from everything in Florence. Entire apartment has been remodeled with a beautiful outdoor space.  We loved the full size refrigerator and washer and dryer. Hosts were perfect! Highly recommend:)

Alessandro’s place was fantastic. It is in an ideal location, right in the middle of everything. The place was very clean and had everything you would need for a stay. I would absolutely recommend staying here when visiting Florence!

We loved this apartment! Perfectly located in the center of Florence, with plenty of restaurants, cafes and shops close by. The apartment is pristine, incredibly clean and well-designed with all the things you need for comfort.
Pasquale was welcoming and friendly, offering great advice about places to eat and visit.
It was perfect for a family of 4! I highly recommend it.
Perfect location! This apartment is perfect, we feel just like home. Thank you Pasquale and Alessandro, they are extremely friendly and helpful! Highly recommended

The apartment was beautiful!
The views from the top were stunning!❤️. Great locations central to everything. Will be back. Thank you so much for all your help in finding restaurants ❤️🇮🇹
Amazing host amazing location amazing apartment. Could not ask for a better stay and would def stay there again when in Florence.

Wow! One of the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in.
My sister and I were there with my mother and the place couldn’t be any more perfect. It was clean and spacious with all amenities needed to have a pleasant stay. Mostly communicated with Pasquale once we arrived. He met us at the door to help with check in. He was gracious enough to book a taxi for us to take us to the train station.
Communicated with Alessandro before coming and he had great suggestions for restaurants and gelato place. We ate at all the restaurants he suggested and it was delicious.
Would definitely stay here again.
Thank you Pasquale and Alessandro for a wonderful stay.
My family and I had an amazing time staying here. The apartment was beautiful and very clean. We were able to walk to all the attractions easily.
Wonderful place in central Florence.  It was perfect for our family of four.  The hosts were very helpful and informative.      They had AC unit each room.  The place was clean and beautiful.

We loved our stay here! Absolutely perfect location with a great view of the Piazza and Palazzo, and luxury accommodations. AC throughout the whole apartment was a lifesaver during the hot days, and the hosts were great. Definitely would stay here again!

Beautiful apartment in the heart of Firenze. Very helpful hosts (even helped us book taxis for our departure). They're very easily accessible and available for questions. Probably some of the best AirBnb stays available out there. Highly recommended.
Note: the building is under construction but it didn't bother us since they start work while we're away wandering around the city.

Excellent location, right on Piazza della Signoria. Could be a bit loud if you go to bed early, or like to sleep late.   The noise typically dies down after 22:00.  The carts rolling across the square early in the morning could be a bit loud in the morning if you are a light sleeper. For us, this was not a problem, just something to be aware of. The apartment is fantastic, and the location can't be beat.
Fabulous, fabulous, fabulous!!!!  Wonderful place, location is perfect and communication by hosts was exceptional.   Thank you!!

Great location if you’re looking to be in the center of all the action! You will be surrounded by a lot of tourists, but as tourists ourselves this was ok. Beautiful views in a great apartment. The host was also very responsive the entire time!

We were a family of 4 with 2 kids ages 10, 11. We were in Florence for 3 nights. This location is as good as it gets in Florence. Corner apartment overlooking the piazza and no street noise. Would have been good to have 2 bathrooms but otherwise the apartment was perfect. Would absolutely stay here again in the future and recommend to friends for future trips.
Beautiful place in a wonderful location.   Loved that we could walk to all the places we wanted to go.  Would definitely recommend to others.
What an amazing location! This was a great stay. The hosts were very responsive to any of our questions and were very helpful.
Absolutely perfect location and beautiful apartment. Will definitely come back!!!!! Thank you so much for having us!

It was really amazing stay in Florence, very good location, very clean place, exactly as described.
I stongly recommended
Monica’s place is nice and well located. It was spacious and clean and the hosts communicate well. Thanks Monica!

We enjoyed our stay in Monica's apartment, especially the following amenities:
- Great dining area, with a well equipped kitchen (including dishwasher and seasonings/tea in the cabinet)
- Comfortable beds with pleasant decor & lighting
- Great location, 15 min walk from both the Duomo di Firenze and the SMN train station & very close to a bus stop
Some things that didn't impact our stay, but are nice to be aware of:
- The building has no lift, and the apartment is on the 2nd floor.
- As the building is older, the bathrooms haven't been updated as recently as the rest of the apartment. They were still quite clean and everything worked smoothly.
Thanks Monica & Roberto for a great stay.
We had a great time in Florence and the apartment is located perfectly to explore the city by foot. The apartments had all we needed and felt at home.

This apartment is a true gem located in a very chic and central location of Florence. Apartment is upscale and even lovelier that the photos. Communication with Laura, the host, was simple and efficient. Highly recommend!!
Outstanding apartment in the heart of Venice! Laura was delightful and the location was walking distance to everything! Great for a family of 4!

This place is beautiful. Laura takes great pride of her home and it shows. The location is great but it can get loud at night from the neighboring businesses. The noise level was kept to a manageable level with the beautiful and large double-panes window glasses. The home is modern and well decorated. Laura paid attention to details such as nice bed linens, feather comforters and newer towels. One of the best AirBnB home I have ever been.

We thoroughly enjoyed our visit in Florence!! Laura made our stay simply beautiful and amazing, the apartment has the most beautiful view right outside of the square and is in walking distance of the most popular attractions and shopping. This place looks exactly like the photos but even better in person, we felt right at home. I would definitely stay with Laura again when visiting Florence!!

Fantastic place to stay! This was my second visit to this apartment because it’s in a perfect location, beautifully furnished, in a quiet neighborhood but five minutes from everything. The two bedrooms are very private and have a nice amount of space between them. Can’t recommend this more highly!
Accommodation is new, well equipped, very clean and on excellent location, between Ponte Vechio and Palazzo Pitti.  Andrea is caring host looking forward to help. I recommend this place.

The best hotel in whole Italy! Friendly english speaking stuff, various high quality breakfast , pristine cleanliness.  They even allow us to keep our suitcases till evening in the checkout day. Great location,  5 minutes fom train station and hop on-hop off tour, and 10 minutes from  downtown, a lo of restaurants nearby. Greatly recommended!
Overall great. Just got a different (smaller) room and had a little challenge changing into the right one! But I did in the end!

Cute hotel with a great location and one of the best breakfasts! Highly recommend, just note there are multiple rooms presented in the picture which I didn't realize until later so don't be alarmed if the one you get looks different. I liked it all the same!

My husband and I were in Florence for 4 days for our honeymoon. We loved our stay here! Our room was spacious, the location was amazing and the staff was super friendly. We appreciated the recommendations they gave us and the breakfast came in clutch! This area is also a little bit away from the main tourist chaos and along the street you can find amazing trattorias. We would definitely stay here again!
Exceptionally great family owned hotel in a great location in Florence. The staff is very professional and caring. I thoroughly enjoyed my brief stay here. I highly recommend.
This was a difficult review because it was a different hotel than what was booked do to hotel problems…
Great communication with host, she was very caring. The place it self is beautiful and clean ☀️
