Very nice mini hotel arrangement, has everything plus the location is walkable to center of old beautiful city, also the Spa was nice relaxing evening, thanks.

Great accommodation :) The flat is really bright & charming, very central, close to many shops & restaurants. Communication was easy, I felt at home & it was a pleasure to stay there, I’ll definitely book it again ;) I highly recommend!

Absolutely perfect accomodation! Clean, sofisticated designed with full equipment, good location near to train station for trips out of Firenze, excellent communication with owner, we can fully recommend!

Great place to stay. Excellent communication. Thank you Camilla!
A couple things for folks to consider when booking: 1. There are a lot of stairs so if you have any mobility issues or large luggage, it might not be ideal. 2. There is no bath soap so make sure to bring that with you.

Excellent location in the less touristy area of Santa Croce, much quieter but also a very pleasant walk into the centre if Florence. The apartment was perfect for me as a solo traveller! Thank you Bernardo and Camilla x

Beautiful apartment to stay in Florence. Lovely location on a quiet street but still close to restaurants and bars for the evening. Silvana was waiting to check us in and gave us great recommendations! Would stay again!
This is a lovely apartment in a great location and Bernardo is very helpful and easy to communicate with.

Lovely apartment, has everything you need and is placed perfectly in Firenze. The neighbourhood is really beautiful and authentic, and you can easily walk on foot to all the places you want to visit in the city.
Camilla and Bernardo are great hosts and were flexible on checking in.

We enjoyed our stay in Camilla‘s apartment. We would recommend it if you‘re going to stay only a few days in Florence and if you‘re able to climb a lot of stairs because the apartment is on the last floor.

Perfect location for a city trip. Great accommodation, simple and effective communication with Mamta who was always available for any kind of question and very helpful overall. I would book it again. 👌

We had a great experience being welcomed by Mamta. She was lovely. She helped us when our luggage was lost by the airline. The flat was VERY CLEAN! The location was perfect. It was close to shops, food, and various churches/cathedrals. There was a small laundromat on the next block which was extremely useful. If I travel back to Florence I would most definitely stay here again. Thank you for your hospitality Mamta!
We really enjoyed our stay here. It was very clean. The location is also really nice, couple blocks from the train station.
Great location in Florence. Comfortable, modern apartment, flexible check-in and great host response sharing bar and restaurant recommendations. Highly recommended

Great place to stay, away from hustle and bustle of central Florence.
Close to all the main sites and very close to the gay bars!

We were really happy to stay in Jacopo's place. Mamta was interested in check-in. She replied quickly and kindly.
The room was pretty clean like the picture and everything was so new. Just 10 minutes away walk to Duomo. Near the train station, If you have luggage you won't tired to come to room. It's been sooo quiet around and that is such a beautiful. definitely good choice without thinking!
Jacopo’s place was all the value of a five star hotel for bargain Airbnb prices. He and his team were great, professional and friendly to deal with. Great service and recommendations.

Mamta was super helpful, friendly and responsive. The apartment was fairly big and looked exactly like the photos. One day the power on the street went out and Mamta was super proactive and responded quickly to messages to let us know what was going on. Overall a great stay, I would come back.

It was a really nice and clean apartment located close to Florence Central Staion and walkable distance to city centre. Mamta (the co-host) was really helpful and friendly. I really recommend this apartment.

Great location close to all the sites we planned to view. However going up and down 5 floors without elevator after walking all day was not something to look for. Bathroom was weird as you shower next to the toilet.
Again great location, easy check in, Peter was very nice and helpful, good restaurants near the condo.

Lovely lovely stay in Firenze! We were here for 5 days and it served us well, I will mention the bed isn't the comfiest, and the pillows could really do with replacing, and there is alot of dust. Apart from these minor things it's a super pleasant and peaceful stay and I would stay again

Jacopo place was a great location to stay at.  It is really close to the train station which did not require us to get a taxi to get to our Airbnb. It was also walkable distance to many restaurants. The room looks nice and modern. Honestly one of my favorite places that I stayed at during my trip.

Mamta was absolutely amazing!! She is such an incredibly personable person, extremely friendly and helpful. She made my experience in Florence 100 times better. I would absolutely recommend staying at this Airbnb, I look forward to coming back and staying here again. THANK YOU SO MUCH MAMTA you are AMAZING!!!!

Absolute great stay at Jacopo’s apartment! This place is exactly as it looks in the pictures and as described. The place was exceptionally clean and comfortable and has everything you need. The security into the apartment was a nice added touch. Mamta was lovely and very responsive to all queries. One of the best Airbnb’s I have stayed at and will definitely be back. Highly recommend.
Friendly co-host welcomed us to the apartment and was very helpful. Apartment was beautiful, clean and comfortable. Our stay was very short but enjoyable.

This apartment was such a short walk from the tram and main railway station. it was so easy. Very good location. The host was really lovely and friendly. Check in was very flexible and they let us leave our luggage. We were very happy and we felt the host was very professional.
Really convenient location and the place was private, clean and walkable to the main attractions and to downtown. It looks like the photo and the check in process was easy to follow.

Very secure location, quiet with plenty of space, well appointed and within close proximity to the main train station. Easy walk into the centre of Florence. Good local cafe’s. Good value for money. Thanks
Very nice apartment, not far from the city center, the train station is nearby. The area is calm and safe.
We really loved this place. There are several locked doors between the street and the private entrance, so we felt very safe. the place was quite clean and comfortable. Would love to stay here again!
Location was great. Lots of stairs up to the property but it didn’t bother us. Comfy beds, shop nearby, air conditioning. Everything was great, and they let us check in early which was helpful

Thank you for turning on the air conditioner in advance for us checking in on hot days! The accommodation was the same as the picture, and the atmosphere and location were the best. After checking out, he took care of my luggage, so I came back from a comfortable tour of Florence. Thank you. ☺️

Great location— near train for easy access for day trips but also close to main locations by like 10-15 walking distance. The home theater was so cool and a great to relax after a long day. They have a spa attached, which after travelling for weeks was such a nice way to relieve muscles and unwind. Also, the hosts are so genuinely kind. If I’m back in Florence, I’d 1000% stay here again!
Very beautiful stay! Would highly recommend, convenient location, very beautiful decor and everything in the room was very modern.

I've never stayed in a place like Emiliano's, and I'm really glad I did. A super romantic room with a floating bed, a theater screen and a mini bar, this is the perfect place to stay if you want a  romantic night in Florence or want to stay near the train station, which is a short five minute walk away.
Excellent place to stay! Place was even better than advertised and the communication throughout the booking process was superb. Highly recommend to all!

One of the highlights of our trip! What a wonderful, clean, and perfect location. We used the projector but fell asleep since we were tired from our travels. A little traffic noise but nothing crazy. Amazing place at a fantastic value.

Very lovely stay! The home theatre was great to come home to after a big day of walking. Also located so close to the centre so it was very easy to get to places! Would definitely stay again and recommend!

Such a cute bnb! It was very clean, the bed is comfy, a/c is great! Hosts were friendly and helpful with early bag drop.  Walking distance from the train, sights, shopping, and a ton of cute bars & restaurants.

stunning, beautiful, and very clean apartment with great location, everything is in walking distance. The hosts were very accommodating they let us leave our luggage before check-in time. I would definitely recommend this place.

Great place and host!
It is noticeable how much effort is put into this place.
The place is very clean, would recommend to anyone.

Emilano's listing in Florence was one of the best Airbnb experiences I have had so far on my trip. My wife and I had no issues locating the building and everything looked exactly like the photos. The bed was comfy, the location is prime, the AC was GREAT and Emiliano provided all the check-in details and additional information in a timely matter.  This stay will forever be in my bookmark when I visit Florence again. Thank you so much for such a pleasant stay Emiliano!
Location is wonderful, unit is also awesome. Only minus is that towels smells a bit, in all other questions- beautiful
Everything is just ok, but there is some noise in the morning that may disturb you. And the hot water supply is finite, you have to wait the boiler to boil the water.

The theatre room in Florence was the perfect place for a romantic getaway. We stayed in the Accommodation for one night. It was a spacious room with en-suite and breakfast bar area. There was a projector media system and plenty of lighting options throughout the room. The furnishings were lovely and comfortable. The room was decorated so lovely for when we arrived. The entrance area is also decorated just lovely , with a gate. The property felt very safe and secure. The location was great for us , with many restaurants within walking distance. We really enjoyed our stay in the property. 10/10.
Really loved this Airbnb, would 100% recommend! Host was extremely friendly and quick with responses.
Amazing stay! Very cool room! Fun to be able to chill out and watch a movie on the big screen! Very easy to get in and out

we really loved this apartment, perfect area to stay in Florence - near lots of restaurants, right near the river, next to the best gelato place (always huge queues, but moved quickly and so worth it!) The walk into the centre is quick and pleasant, just cross the bridge. A very comfortable place to stay and nice and clean - great to have an apartment with coffee machine and dinner table. Comfortable and clean and right near a laundrette for anyone that needs it!

The apartment is situated a great location close to everything. It’s also very quiet. We enjoyed our stay and the place is comfortable for two or three guests.
Alessandro is very responsive if you have any questions he’s very responsive.

My family and I stayed 2 days in this apartment. The location was very good in the heart of the city. The staff was responsible and answered our phone calls and we found the location . Apartment was clean. A little bit cold at night . The apartment should have more shampoos . Everything else was great.

It’s awesome place to stay at, your right in the middle of everything and makes it feel like your part of the city, the host is incredible, ready and waiting to help in any sort of manner. Highly recommend!

The Mamo group was great. They were extremely responsive and made everything easy. The neighborhood was wonderful. A great respite from the busy streets of Florence. The kitchen was fully stocked, allowing us to prepare dinner at home on a few occasions. The bathrooms are new and modern. The furniture is a bit tired and new towels would be amazing but not a deal breaker.

We loved our stay in this charming apartment! It was very clean and perfectly spacious. The full kitchen allowed us to eat breakfast "at home" every day, which saved time and money. Everything we wanted to see was within a short walking distance. Mattia was really hospitable and made the check-in/check-out process very clear. This apartment is an incredible value for the money!

We spent a month in this wonderful, charming apartment! It is perfectly located; we walked everywhere and took day trips using the bus and train stations which are very close by. I highly recommend Mattia’s place in Florence.
Thank you! Winnie & David

The AirBnB is in a great location and close to everything. The space is comfortable and clean. We were able to save some money by using the kitchen to make breakfast and it was nice being able to come back to rest in the middle of the day when it was super hot out.
Great place to stay. Walking distance to everywhere, would recommend. Mattia is also an awesome host.
Great location very close to Santa Maria Novella station and just 10 mins to the main attractions. The apartment was spacious, nice, clean and Mattia was kind and always quick to reply.
A lovely little apartment with responsive and caring hosts.  The location was great for both walking and public transportation.
Mattia’s place was great in Florence. Super close to the train station. We had no issue with noise or walking distance anywhere. It was clean and exactly what we needed for a 2 night stay!

Great location. Very close to Il Duomo and all the shopping. Temperature control on the shower was laughable. It was either too cold or scalding hot. I really hope they fix this for the future. Garbage can was a paint bucket and they weren’t ready with bedding for the sofa bed.

Very comfortable and well situated location, Alex was prompt to react on providing dish towels.
A/C was a definite nice to have and towels were very plush.

This was a great location to stay at!  I gave it 5 stars in everyway except cleanliness.  Couch and chairs definitely are a little dirty, shower could have been cleaned better, and bed cover was a little stained.  But location was phenomenal and perfect access to many famous locations all within walking distance.  Alex (co-host) was super friendly and a great help for all our questions during our stay!

Many thanks to Mattia and Alex! We were welcomed and given lots of insight on local restaurants and attractions. Also, Alex was very helpful and responsive when asked questions even after we checked in. The apartment was super charming and clean as described. The apartment definitely had the Tuscan vibe and look!
Had a great stay!
Grazie!
Charming little apartment in a perfect location! Mattia and Alex were both very kind, helpful, and flexible with our check in. We LOVED our stay here!
The airbnb is just as described! It was clean, spacious and a really cute place to stay while in Florence.
I’ve stayed in many Airbnbs, but I have to say Mattia’s spot may be my favorite. Felt very cozy and ideal after a long day of walk around in the hot Florence summer heat!
Mattia was very responsive and Alex gave a very thorough orientation. The apartment was very spacious and clean. Very short distance from the train station and the river.

Our stay was incredible; Mattia was such a responsive, helpful, and friendly host, we felt right at home immediately! Not to mention, the apartment is stunning, with close proximity to the train station and other parts of the city center. We hope to return soon, this was definitely a highlight of our trip. Grazie mille!

This was a wonderful, homely stay in Florence. Which was our first time visiting Italy. It felt like we were a part of the city.
Thank you Mattia for sharing your special space with us.

- Excellent location, near train station, restaurants and major attractions in Florence.
- Very charming. You feel in a real Tuscan home.
- Very clean and comfy. It needs maintenance in the shower faucet.
- Noisy in the main bedroom. We had noisy neighbors and you could listen everything they did and said.
- Mattia was very attentive to any question we had.
Mattia replied our message so quick when we couldn’t open the door.  But the water pressure of the shower head is a bit low and also broken.
The condominium was so pretty and clean and perfect for two days in Florence. Mattia was very responsive and helpful!

Mattia was an excellent host. Her place was conveniently located near so many things to do in Florence. It is a peaceful home base in a busy, beautiful city. The home is clean, has all of the Tuscan feel you could want and the bed was so comfortable. Mattia was available quickly for our questions and gave amazing recommendations - the best lasagna, tiramisu, and limoncello I have ever had! We would absolutely stay here again ❤️

Great apartment in the heart of historic Florence. Place was very nice- better than the pictures show. Host was great, made checkin/out very easy and even held our luggage until it was time for us to catch the train.  Very close and easy walk from train station- no need for cab. Highly recommend!

Francesco was great and the apartment was beautiful and very clean.  Our boys loved having their own level and we loved having some privacy.  The windows also blocked out the noise really well.  Absolutely perfect location in Florence.  Less than 10 minute walk to train and 5 minutes from the Doumo.

We had a wonderful stay. Francesco and Filippo are wonderful hosts. The apartment is clean, open and the location is great. Could not have asked for a better place to stay in Milan with such wonderful, kind and helpful hosts. Thank you for your incredible hospitality!

This was such a perfect location. Check in was easy and the host was always responsive.  Very helpful in providing local information. The place was perfect for our family of four. Will stay here again!

Amazing Find!! Our host was wonderful and made us feel comfortable right away. The flat is beautiful, and you can tell they were thoughtful to the people who are staying there. The flat also had small touches to make us comfortable, going well above a lot of other places we have stayed. Next time we are in Florence we will try to stay if available!

Excellent location, walkable to everything, yet quiet and peaceful. Comfortable beds, all the amenities in working order, friendly/accommodating hosts, easy check in, early luggage storage, clean, would definitely recommend and stay again!!

My family and I visited Florence and had a great time staying at Francesco's apartment in the city center. The apartment is in a great location, walking distance to almost all the historical sites. While the downstairs is dotted with delicious restaurants and cafes, the rooms are cozy and quiet We slept well .Francesco was very helpful, coming downstairs to greet us on the day of our check-in and help with registering the car and finding a parking lot, and kindly allowing delays at check-out and storing our bags. We hope to stay in his apartment again on our next visit to Florence.
Great location, but the layout is kind of odd and not really super comfy.  It is Florence.

One of the coolest places I have ever stayed.  Everything was perfect.  Smooth check-in with great communication.  Very comfortable furniture and beds,  very clean and air conditioning a plus.  Close to everything yet very quiet.  Will absolutely stay here again when we return to Florence.
Great all the way around.    The location, the building with semi  private entry,  cleanliness and the master bedroom is fantastic.   Love hearing how the place has always been in his family.

Super little studio right in the centre of the old town!
Comfy bed, lots of nice touches and freebies on arrival and Alina was really helpful with directions etc!

This place was AMAZING! Close to everything you need and a short 10 min walk from the train station.
Alina was very quick to respond and provide instructions for check in. Everything was perfect. Highly recommend!

Very quiet, clean, and close enough to walk from the train station. Alina was kind enough to leave extra umbrellas, slippers, and snacks/drinks. The Statue of David was a short 5 min walk from the apartment as well as a ton of other sites! Overall, we had a comfortable stay!

Booked Alina’s place last minute as we were driving to Florence. Alina immediately communicated and coordinated with us. Instructions were very clear and self check in was easy.
Everything is exactly as pictured and Alina provided water and snacks which was very thoughtful. Alina has organized everything very tastefully and provided a comfortable stay. Location can’t be beat just a few steps to Duomo, restaurants and other sites. It was also an easy 10 min walk to the train station.
The only downside as others have mentioned is the street noise down below. I had a hard time sleeping with the late night crowd, street cleaning and garbage pickup.

Florence is easy to walk around. Having Il Duomo at the end of the street made everything simple to navigate.
The apartment is small but fine. The information from
Alina was perfect and timely.
Very good option for your Florence adventure.
Matched the photos exactly. Very clean and central location to everything. Alina was very responsive and helpful.

This was an awesome place to stay! The location was amazing… located next to the duomo and just outside the Airbnb was a really great gelateria & cafe.
Everything is within walking distance with lots to do and discover. Everything matched the description and very clean.

Bonus: Included in the Airbnb were local drinks/snacks left on the counter and in the fridge for us to enjoy.
AC worked phenomenal, TV worked nicely as well with access to Netflix etc.
Great airbnb, would definitely consider staying here again next time we visit.
Alina’s place was perfect for our quick trip to Florence.  Super close to the cathedrals and center market.   Easy access into the unit and very clear instructions.    Thanks again!
This was a great location and Alina was very helpful. It was a wonderful place, would stay again!
Barbara was very responsive, and I felt very taken care of the moment I came in to the moment I left.
If you’re thinking about booking Alina’s air bnb, I highly recommend it. She is a wonderful host who really wants you to have the best stay possible. Unbeatable location. Thank you Alina!

Alina’s is amazing! Her apartment is clean and beautiful in a very safe area! Very close to big sites and great restaurants!! Alina’s is very friendly and responsive. We enjoyed our time in the apartment! Would definitely recommend to others to book here!!
Amazing place, close to everything. Smelled so nice and was so clean. Host was very reponsive !

Alina’s place was wonderful! Super clean, comfortable and had everything we needed for our stay. The check-in was smooth and Alina was really easy to communicate with throughout. Great location too! We’d definitely stay again and recommend to anyone looking for a lovely, hassle-free stay.
We enjoyed our stay at Alina’s place! Very nice location near the Duomo. Thoughtful touch of leaving snacks. Would recommend!
Great location and unit was good. Its on a noisy street or it was just noisy when we were there during Spring Break time.

Absolutely perfect appartment to spend a week in Florence. The location is 2 minutes walking from major tourist attractions and the river, while still being on a quiet street.
I would love to come back in the future!

We had a wonderful time at Edy’s place, the location is amazing and walkable to everything! The apartment was homey and exactly what we needed!Edy was responsive in times of need and was so kind and helpful! We will definitely be back!

This apartment was BEAUTIFUL! One of the nicest places we’ve stayed in… ever! The decor was stunning, the location was perfect and the amenities were exactly what we needed! We would definitely stay again in the future! Thank you Tom for your fantastic communication and recommendations!

Tom was an excelente host.
His help in Firenze made the difference for us!
The department is beautiful and perfectly located.
Don’t doubt it, go ahead and book these gorgeous place.
Whenever we come back to Firenze we for sure want to stay here again!
Thank you very much Tom!!!!
Karla.

We very much enjoyed our stay. The apartment is beautiful, and the balcony a nice outside space to watch the world go by.  Tommaso was a great host, returned our messages promptly, and gave us many suggestions for eating, shopping and enjoying some good wine.

Possibly the best Airbnb I have ever stayed in! The space is LARGE and beautifully furnished. The beds are comfortable and every amenity you could need is provided. Centrally located making it easy to explore the city. Also, Tommaso is a wonderful host. Take advantage of his recommendations regarding dining - you won’t be disappointed. When I return to Florence, I will be looking to book the apartment again!

Tommaso apartment is wonderful. Very well located with a lot of very good walking distance restaurants, cafes, wineries, etc. The apartment is very well decorated, very confortable, with everything we need. Tommaso was a superhost helping us with the checkin, checkout, giving us great tips os restaurants. I highly recommend Tommaso’s apartment. I use to stay in airbnbs and Tommaso’s apartment was one of the bests.
Wonderful apartment right in the middle of everything.  Fully stocked with all you need to make the stay perfect.   Tommaso was excellent during the welcoming process as well.

Tommaso was great and the apartment was beautiful. He was super flexible with us allowing for a late check-in and took extra time to walk through the unit and provide recommendations in the city. The location is perfect - just over the bridge to get slightly away from the tourist crowds, but easily walkable to most places within 5 min. Overall great experience and would rent again without question the next time I am in Florence.

We had a wonderful stay, the space was well designed, comfortable, up-to-date and very, very spacious.
The location was perfect, with the Ponte Vecchio a stone’s throw away and yet on the calmer side of the Arno, with lots of options for Trattorias, Enotecas, Gelateria’s and Cafés to choose from.
Tommaso was one of the top 3 hosts we’ve ever had..He was very responsive and proactive with different recommendations and set up a car service to and from the airport. He met us at the apartment and gave us a thorough walkthrough to kick off our stay, then checked in every few days to see how we were doing.
We wished we could have stayed here longer! Tommaso was so helpful and the place exceeded our expectations!
Great location, my family had a wonderful stay at Tomaso’s place.  Tastefully decorated and close to all the attractions.  Highly recommended.

I absolutely loved everything about my stay here! The apartment is absolutely gorgeous! Every room is spacious and the location can’t be beat. We were within walking distance to anything we needed, shops, restaurants, and more! Tommaso was wonderful and gave us several recommendations for places to eat and helped us with anything needed. 5 stars all the way around!

A great stay, beautiful apartment. Great location, a few steps from Ponte Vecchio bridge.
Very clean, great decoration, great spaces. Well equiped.
Host very helpful and responsive.
A great place to see Florence.

What a wonderful place to stay in Florence! I loved having a beautiful apartment so close to the Ponte Vecchio, it was so fun to walk home across the bridge and to arrive in our lovely home away from home. I would definitely stay here again! Our hosts were so responsive and helpful from the very beginning.

Great location, there was some construction in the area during my stay, so that was a bit disorienting and loud. But other than that. It was a great spot to stay. Definitely an older building, but the character was appreciated.
Except for the keys pick up point which was 300 mts away, during rain n with family this was a discomfort n problematic
My parents thoroughly enjoyed their stay in the suite. They found the location and comfort of the room to have made their time in Florence all the more enjoyable and relaxing.
The apartment was excellent, very clean and has an fantastic location.  I highly recommend this place.
This place has a great location. At the heart of Firenze, just 3 minutes from the Duomo! It feels extremely cozy and super clean!!

This place was great. The host was very responsive and gave easy directions. The room was clean and very nice. Bed was comfortable and peaceful. Had a minor mosquito issue and the shower drain was clogged but besides those issues, this place is worth the booking!

Great location near the station where excursion meeting points all are and between 5-20 min walk to reach everything. The main door lock to get into the flat is super stiff and a slight challenge so worth trying a few times.

The flat was in a great location, with easy access to F SMN Station. Making it great for day trips out of Florence. The host was also very helpful and gave us all the information we needed for a smooth check in.

Great location. The company that runs the Airbnb were very responsive. Easy to get in. Comfortable beds, very quiet, excellent AC. But furnishings were lacking. For accommodations for 6, a single 2 seat sofa, and a few small hard chairs for the dining table. Sitting around as a group of 5 in the living room did not happen as a result. I’d hunt for a different place next time that has better, comfortable and adequate quantity of seating in the living room. Very little toilet paper, no dish towels, etc. Big company hosts don’t do a very good job.

We had a good stay and the Airbnb came with basic amenities that you will need for your stay in Florence. I love the fact that the house is super centralized and walkable to train station and nearby attractions.
Great space perfect for a family! 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 nice bathrooms. A little hard to get into the space.
great place, convenient, clean and cool (AC). perfect for us and near train station and Marceto Centrale

The hosts were the most friendly and the check in was seamless. The location is fabulous.
Thanks for the memories!!

Wonderful location and communication! The train station is about a five minute walk and a supermarket is right next door downstairs. I highly recommend this place! I was able to drop off luggage  earlier than my check in time which was a huge plus. Hosts were very nice and welcoming too.
Easy to find.  Lots of room for our family of 5.   Felt like home.
Exactly how it is described. Ideal location, Francesca and Mum were so friendly and helpful! Highly recommend!

Francesca’s place was amazing. Its a beautiful traditional Italian home, which was very cosy and at the best location. Thank you very much for your hospitality. We truly loved your home and would love to come back on our next visit.
Great place and location! We love our stay at Francesca’s apartment. Perfect location to enjoy florence. Francesca was a great host  and helped us when mended.

Loved the location! So much to do right from the front door. Loved having a convenient store right next door. Great for last minute needs. Great amount of space. Our four adults-one couple and 2 singles each had their own space to escape to if needed.  We had plenty of towels which was appreciated. Beds were comfortable. The AC worked well.

Our family of four enjoyed our stay at Francesca’s place. We are very particular about cleanliness and her place was spotless!! We arrived earlier than expected and  were greeted warmly by Francesca. She provided us with a place to store our bags until the home was ready. Location couldn’t have been better. We were 3 minutes walk to the Duomo and about a 3-5 minute walk to the train station. Francesca recommended a fabulous restaurant and anyone visiting Florence should stay here!!

This location was perfect - walkable to most things we wanted to do or see. With a wonderful restaurant just across the street and a grocery store practically downstairs. Even walkable from the main train station, where we came in from. The check-in instructions were clear, check-in was a breeze and Francesca's customer service was top notch. They went above and beyond when I thought I left behind a sentimental piece of jewelry. Recommend them very highly! A delightful stay.

Fantastic place to stay near the Medici Chapel. Walkable to all of Florence. The apartment is much larger than the pictures show and very nicely laid out. It’s a wonderful feature to have the hotel around the corner to store bags and get the keys before check in. Francesca is a responsive and wonderful host with a lot of excellent site seeing tips. We’ll be back for sure!
The apartment is very spacious, clean, comfortable and conveniently located in central Florence. We really enjoyed our time there and Francesca was an excellent host.
The space is just as it is pictured. Very spacious. The location is exceptional. Walking distance to everything!

The location was perfect as we were coming in and out from the train station. Having the hotel involved is a plus so we can get the key even when we arrived late. The apartment was a very good size for a group especially with 2 separate bathrooms

We enjoyed our apartment in Firenze!
Spacious and clean apartment… more than enough for four people.
Thank you Francesca!! We had a great time in this place. Very conviniance to access all the needed places!!

The apartment is in the best location! You can easily walk to the Firenze Santa Maria Novella train station and the Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore. There is a small grocery store next door and so many restaurants and cafes nearby. The apartment itself is very clean and check-in was very smooth. The apartment was comfortable for our group of 6 people. Be advised one of the bedrooms has a loft which requires climbing up a ladder which was fine for us adults. We really enjoyed our 3 night stay and would definitely rent this AirBnb again if we ever return to Florence.

Loved this place. Excellent location, with 5 mins walk to train station. Almost all major attractions are at walking distance. Plenty of restaurants nearby. A super market right outside the main gate was very convenient.
Apartment was very spacious for a group of 6 people. Rooms are pretty good size and beds were comfortable. My kids loved the bunk bed.
The apartment was great. We arrived an hour or two early, and our hosts helped us leave our bags in the apartment while it was being cleaned. We were very comfortable.
Great location and beautiful apartment, would definitely recommend! Responsive hosts and easy and flexible check in process 👍🏻

i really enjoyed my stay at Isabella’s place , the location is great if you’re not trying to be flooded with tourists. it’s really close to tourists attractions. Isabella was a wonderful host , very attentive , checking in to see if everything was okay.
Beautiful apartment in Florence. 20 minute walk from the city centre with everything you need within walking distance. Isa was really helpful and responsive. would highly recommend.

The appartment was in a nice quiet location, it was so clean, had everything we needed for our stay, we were a group of 4 and we were very comfortable.
We would definitely recommend this place!
This place was beautiful, market across the street which it was really helpful with a toddler , bus stops on every corner and the host was amazing .
We had a very pleasant stay at Giosafat‘s. Definitively worth a recommendation.

Ksenia supplied clear instructions and was always quick to respond to queries. I greatly enjoyed the twenty minute walk along the Arno to the centre of the city each day. I bought bread and cheese to prepare in the simple kitchen in the evening and ate out at nearby restaurants during the day. The apartment isn’t in the most fashionable part of town, but is handy for the station. The rooms were spotlessly clean and towels were provided. Despite staying during February, I felt comfortably warm. The apartment has charm with artworks painted on many of the doors. I felt extremely at home. I look forward to staying again.
Very intimate and nice apartment. Close to walk to the city center! Me and my husband spent some very beautiful days in Florence!

The location of the apartment was quite close to the train station and central places. But I must add that we like to walk.  ☺️Ksenia even left a bottle of wine for us.  And he also made it possible for us to enter the apartment before check-in time.  We had a great time in Florence.
Ksenia’s apartment was very clean and we loved the view from the window. Check in went smoothly and it was located very close to the main attractions!

This place was little and cute, perfect for a few days in Florence. We loved how close it was to everything, we could walk to all the places we wanted to visit. There were great restaurants in the neighbourhood and we felt safe walking in the evening. The art in and around the apartment really made the experience, it did feel like staying in an artist’s studio!
We lived this apartment it was very cute and close by to a supermarket and some restaurants short walk I got he city centre very convenient stay we really enjoyed our time here thank you

We enjoyed our stay here! Easily walkable to the train and all major sights. Apartment was clean and was a great size for two. Check in and out we’re both very simple. Thank you for a great stay in Florence!

Ksenia is a great host! We loved the apt and the location couldn’t have been better. We had some queries after our arrival which Ksenia answered very quickly. Overall, a fantastic stay which we hope to repeat very soon.
Ksenia’s place was beautiful! Just as described. The view from the window had me in awe :) We had everything we needed. Loved it overall! Thank you for having us!

I had a very pleasant stay in Ksenia's apparemment, it was really easy to access coming from the train station, everything was easily accessible by walking, lots of little shops and restaurants nearby. Overall very satisfied by my stay 😊
The location is near to the train station, which is convenient for travelers👍 A small but cozy place for having a relaxing night!😊

Antonella‘s home is a cozy Italian home so close to the Mercado.  You would never run out of fresh ingredients!  The Location was so ideal to walk around Florence.  Our week here truly gave  us the authentic Firenze experience.

Beautiful apartment and an amazing host! Thank you so much Antonella.
Perfect location and everything you could want in a trip to Florence.

We had a wonderful stay in  this beautiful apartment. The location is fantastic and the apartment was very comfortable and had all the amenities you would need. Antonella is a fantastic host. She was extremely kind and flexible and gave us lots of really useful information about what to do and see in Florence.
Antonella is one of the best hosts I’ve ever had. She was super helpful when we were in need and gave great recommendations for things to do in Florence!

Our time at Antonella’s was great.  The location was perfect!  Close to everything. We loved being able to walk across the street each morning to pick up fresh pastries and fruit for breakfast. Coming back to the apartment to sit and make coffee was a great way to get the day started.  The separation of the rooms made it very convenient for some to sleep late or retire early.   And the beds were so comfortable!   Wonderful after a long day of walking. The photos of the apartment accurately reflect the space.   We are so glad we chose to stay at Antonella’s
We had a wonderful stay at Antonella’s property! We absolutely adored her apartment. Location was a plus too! We were able to explore the San Lorenzo area with ease. We definitely recommend!
Antonella was amazing in helping us feel at at home, gave wonderful recommendations to do In Florence.

Nice place. Apartment is fully equipped with everything you might need.
Clean with a great design and nice balcony.
Antonella helped with everything.
Unfortunately, we left one of our items in the apartment that was not found by the cleaning staff:(
Antonella was an Excellent host. The apartment was exactly like the pictures, well equipped, centrally located, and clean. We would stay there again.

We had a wonderful stay at the Antonella’s in Florence. Amazing location close to everything you need-train station, restaurants, market, and lots of tourist points. Antonella and her team were always responsive. Would definitely stay again.
Absolutely beautiful apartment (which smells amazing!) in a great location - station and all sights within walking distance. Great communication and welcome from host. Thanks for a wonderful stay!

Our stay was great, comfortable, and the location was very convenient for food and exploring. The host was very communicative, shared some great restaurant recommendations, and left a nice bottle of Chianti as a welcoming gift. Access to a washing machine was a huge benefit! The toilet was a bit strange to flush, but we ended up getting the hang of it :)

Giulio's home was fantastic for our short stay in Florence. The home benefits from its central location, which you can reach all major sights within a 20 minute walk. It also boasts being located outside a very popular (and delicious) food store that sells focaccia bread sandwiches... a must go to; the place usually has queues stretching 30-60 minute waits, so getting down early for a late breakfast/early lunch is beneficial for a great treat. The apartment is clean and has the basic cooking utensils for some home cooking. Giulio was a fantastic host, who clearly prides himself on being ultra responsive and ensured we were ok with our trip. The colleague of Giulio who showed us the apartment also gave us some tips and places to use and go, which were both really helpful. Would happily recommend this apartment to anyone staying in Florence.
Great location. Quiet inside the apartment. The Airbnb was comfortable. The host was always very helpful whenever we had questions.
located at the center of Florence. 2min to Uffizi Gallery!! It's very hard to find another place if you're an art lover and plan to visit the museum multiple times.
Nicoletta was a great host and has an awesome studio apartment. It was in a perfect location.
Wonder place to stay, very convenient since it was close to the Duomo. The apartment was very clean. Would stay again!

My wife and I had a great stay here for a few nights. It was our first time in Florence and we can’t wait to come back and stay here again. The location is very central to everything we wanted to see and do, which is a huge plus. Every night we sat on the balcony and had a glass of wine and cheese. The style of the place felt very old Italian, but at the same time modern. Was clean, and equipped with everything we needed. AC was a bonus! Highly recommend this stay to others.
Lovely flat, felt very authentic - in a great spot but surprisingly not very noisy. Giulio was also very friendly.
Giulio is a great host. This air bnb was very quaint and comfortable. It's in a very nice location just off the river and by a lot of the main attractions in the area. Would recommend.

10/10! The apartment is nicely decorated, well organized and fully equiped. It felt like our own home. Also, being in the middle of the center, you’re close to everything, without having any noise problems. Highly recommend!
Location, location, location.  A wonderful combination of location, great host, and a really nice place to stay.  would definitely recommend this apartment.

I would highly recommend staying at this apartment! It's clean, spacious, and safe (behind 2 locked doors). It's also in the center of downtown, 5-10m walk to the cathedral, piazza, and the river Arno. This apartment also has AC!! 10/10 would recommend any traveller staying here. I also want to mention how kind and responsive the host was. Any question I had was answered within 10m. I was so grateful :) I won't stay anywhere else when I come back to Florence!

Great stay! Great location, clean, instructions were clear, lots of nice places to eat nearby, incredibly comfortable mattress. It was quite warm in the apartment in December, there is heating that can be adjusted by the host. It is an old house in an old part of Florence, the stairs are steep and narrow in the building, but this did not cause any difficulties.

Giulio and Veronica provide a wonderful place to stay in a prime location in a beautiful city. We enjoyed our stay with them, and we found the information they provided for activities in the area to be a great help in making the most of our stay. They were very easy to communicate with and helpful at all times. I highly recommend!

Location location! Highly recommended. Great place, it’s tiny, true, but you have everything you need and beyond (example: iron, sewing kit, washing machine, etc). But above that, the location is awesome, just a few minutes of main sightseeings. The host was very attentive, super fast response. I think it’s one of the best places I have stayed lately (considering money value, description match, host, location).
Thanks guys.

This property was in the perfect location for a few days in Florence with the goal of packing in as many sights and activities as possible! Walkable to everything in the heart of Florence and the countless restaurants and cafes that come with it. The hosts were extremely friendly and responsive. The space was clean and secure. 1000% would recommend!
Great place to stay! The location was amazing and we were always able to get in contact quickly. Definitely recommend staying here!
Wonderful studio in the heart of beautiful Florence. Everything was 4 to 6 minutes away; super walkable and a juliette balcony that opens out into the streets. Great stay; and nice host.
We had such a great time- the apartment was so clean and cozy and the host was great!
We really enjoyed our stay in Florence. The place was lovely and comfortable, and the host was very responsive and friendly throughout.
This is a very nice 2 bedroom apartment, just a half block from the tram that takes you into the city square. Stefan’s place was perfect for a weekend visit!
Annoying to have to take the trash after stay when we paid a service fee but overall highly recommend!

Good value Central location with decent amenities
We stayed for a few weeks and it was very accessible to Florence downtown and nearby ristorante
The owner  is very nice. But the house is a bit old. The lady who cleans the house doesn't speak English at all, which is a bit inconvenient.

We had a lovely stay - it was a great location and perfect for seeing the attractions and finding good food. The apartment was amazing - clean, comfortable and the hosts couldn’t have been more helpful
This has to be the perfect location in Florence.  The Airbnb was nice, quiet, and close enough to everything but private enough to relax.
Beautiful and quiet spot, very convenient to the city! The host was really helpful with Florence's tricky parking and driving issues.
Great stay! The location is fantastic, walkable to everything. Great neighborhood. Apartment was very quiet and dark, a wonderful respite from the city. Donna was very responsive.

Donna her place is really beautiful and comfy to sit and rest after a day of sightseeing in Firenze. We slept lika a Dream in the big and comfy bed.  Donna is really Quick To respond! She also helped us with finding a cheap parking garage for our car not far from the appartement.

Absolutely great apartment in a great location! We were able to experience Florence like a local with the accurate vibe.
This apartment made us fall in love with Florence and it’s hands down our favorite destination in Italy.

This place is a gem in a FANTASTIC area. This was our first time in Florence, and we were a little hesitant to stay on the other side of the river but it ended up being the best location - quiet when you’re ready to end the day, and VERY close to shops/restaurants and bars. Only note for other visitors: the stairs getting up to the apartment are 2 pretty steep flights and there are 2 doors to get into before getting into the apartment (very safe, but takes a minute). Donna was a wonderful host and easy to communicate with. Would recommend to anyone!
The apartment is adorable and in a great location! Easy check in and lots of communication. I highly recommend this place!

Beautiful space with lots of amenities. very walkable. Bed was very comfortable. Washer was a huge plus if you are on a longer trip.
Donna was very responsive. Great place to stay.

Perfect location.
Comfortable.
This place has all the comforts of home in a magical location where you can walk to everything!
We wish we could have stayed longer 🤩❤️
We had an amazing stay at Donna’s place! Beautiful quiet street but walkable to restaurants and shops. Donna was very helpful and responsive. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

Donna's place was in the perfect spot. Tucked away in a beautiful corner or old town and very close to all of the sights. Lots of great places to eat nearby, and the space was amazingly beautiful and quiet.

This is the perfect Airbnb for a trip to Florence!! Great location, walkable to everything. Donna was very responsive and helpful. Pictures looked exactly like the unit. Highly recommend staying here!

Donna’s place is beautiful, well located and easy to get to and from and explore the city from. Little bit noisy at night, but for how great the location is, that is to be expected. Building is very safe and secure.
Donna is a great host. She was very flexible with our check in and check out. The place is awesome. Smack in the middle of all Firenze has to offer. Highly recommend.

This was a great spot for our two-night stay in Florence. The amenities were just what we needed, and the location was perfect. My partner and I were able to walk everywhere - the more touristy spots are across the river which made this neighborhood still lively but not overwhelming, or loud. Plenty of cafes and restaurants within a few minutes walk!
Donna’s place was perfect for a few day stop in Florence. The location was close to everything but just tucked down in a side street so it was quiet. I’d highly recommend.

We loved our stay at Donna’s Airbnb! The location was perfect and we thought it was great to be able to experience crossing over the river so often, which you may not experience staying on the other side of the city. Donna is a wonderful host who was flexible, responsive, and very friendly! Definitely would recommend staying at her place if you are traveling anytime soon as a solo traveler or couple

This place was just what we needed in a great area of Florence! It was very comfortable and clean. Parking ended up being extra money and was a little stressful  because we didn’t know where we were parking until the day of and you have to drive through a busy area to get to the garage. If you are an anxious driver or uncomfortable driving through the city, might be worth considering another spot. We ended up being fine with it and everything else was great!

Donna and her apartment are equally amazing. She goes the extra mile with the touches around the unit, is happy to assist with any issues and recommendations. It is also very well placed making everything easily walkable. Would stay here again

We had a great stay at Donna’s place. Tucked away in the back streets just a 5-10 minute walk away from the heart of town, it’s a perfect location in Florence. The apartment itself was a good size to base yourself in. Keep in mind it is up a couple of flights of stairs in an old building so if you have bags, it could be challenging.
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay, the location is fantastic and easily walkable into the centre of Florence.
Great place to stay in Florence so close to great restaurants, sights, and everything you need! Host was responsive and the apartment was very nice. Would stay again!
location and flat's comditoin is very good. Nice to stay there. Host is very friendly.

This place is beautiful. We totally liked the set up. The host is very helpful and did his best to solve some small issues that we had.
He was always responsive and very helpful.
If i had to suggest something, but this does't involve the place or the host is that the taxi system in Florence is a joke, Could't get through the phone or even the app nothing worked.
The host also tried to help me with this issue.
I will definitely come back.
Thanks

Interesting place, access i through the courtyard of Shake Cafe (great upscale health food cafe) and the cafe closes early so very quiet.  Location is just in the edge of the crowds of the city (so perfect in my opinion), was like a mega suite with two full bathrooms and two mini kitchens, we appreciated the separation from our teenagers 😁.  Great place and good value

Great place to stay right in the middle of Florence. Exactly like the description. Samuel and Paolo were incredibly gracious and helpful with advice for things to do and places to visit during our stay. We would absolutely stay here again!

Excellent location for staying in Florence - so conveniently close to the train station, and only 15-20 min walk to almost anything in the heart of Florence. The hosts were very communicative and helpful - Ely in particular was very responsive, and helped guide us to getting Covid tests for travel!  Very happy we found this place for our first trip to Florence!

We only stayed for one night but it was the first night in Florence and was so comforting. They sent instructions and places to check out in the nearby area well before check-in, and we’re flexible meeting us for the check-in time. Would have bene happy to stay multiple nights! And a great location, easy to get everywhere in Florence. The rooms were as described, even larger than expected! Very clean.

Stayed with my family of four. Diego meet us and was so friendly and helpful. Place is unique and spacious to say the least , very clean and the beds were amazing . Minutes from the main square. Totally recommend it 👌

The location was very good. There was enough space for six people. The beds and couch were comfortable. The aircon was ins working very well as well as the Wifi. Everything one could need is definetly there.

The flat is perfectly located close to the central Station and the historical City of Florenz. grocery shops, restaurants, Cafés and Bars can be found really close by. The flat is perfectly as described and has some nice Decorations and paintings. Check in was on time and the communication in english was really good. thanks a lot. I can highly recommend Edoardo E Michaela a a host

We just stay in this appt. We are a family of 5. Two adults and three kids. The place is very clean and spacious. Alessandra did our check in and explain everything to us. We are very happy to be close to the train station and to the academia and the basilica is just 10 mins walking.
If we returned to Florence we will definitely stay in Eduardo e Michaela’s place.

Great apartment, close to the train station and easy walking to all attractions. Some good restaurants nearby.. It is on the top floor so be sure you can carry your bags up stairs but otherwise worth a great place to explore Florence from.

The location is very good. The shower is small, if you are big you will have a hard time moving in the shower. There is air conditioning in the bedrooms so if you are a party of 4 you will be good but if someone has to sleep on the couch during Sommer, the air conditioning outside might be not enough in the hot days.
I did not use the kitchen, but it has everything you need, and you have a supermarket super close to the apartment. Overall I had a pleasant experience and the hosts have a very good system in place to get in contact with them.

Only the one room was ok to sleep the couch and the single beds were terrible!
We paid 80€ for cleaning services and we were asked to throw the trash! I don’t recommend this place!

Friendly reception. They let us drop off our bags early which was great! Place was clean and close to train station which was very convenient. Had all the amenities we needed. There were a couple of very minor issues. It rained during our stay and there were a couple leaks from the roof. Also there was construction on the lower two levels of the building so a bit dusty coming in but not something MMega Homes had control over. Regardless of the issues, overall it was a pleasant and cozy stay.
A very nice place.   Communication was excellent.   When our travel plans changed due to the impending train strike, they were very helpful and allowed  us arrive to arive early and drop our luggage.

Absolutely loved the place. It is a very spacious studio fit well for 2 people. The bed is comfortable, and the bathroom is very modern! The kitchen has all that you need, even though we mostly ate out. The location is PERFECT! Everything was just a short walk away. There is no washer/dryer but we went to a laundromat super close by just down the street. Beatrice is also very kind and very responsive.

Very caracteristic studio, in a old traditional Florence style, but with a brand new bathroom and kitchen. The location is great, in walking distance from all the main palces, right in the center. Would definetely stay there again – this time I was alone  but it is a perfect place for a couple.

I had a wonderful stay at Beatrice’s place. Upon arrival I was promptly greeted and given the run down of the amenities as well as a detailed list of things to do, places to eat, etc. in Florence. It was clear that Beatrice put a lot of thought into everything. The studio was wonderfully clean with a lovely bathroom. The bed was cosy. I would love to stay again. Thank you Beatrice!

Beatrice's place was the perfect base for exploring Florence. The apartment is light and airy, and stayed cool in the 38 degree heat.
Comfy bed, well equipped kitchen that we cooked lunches in and a spotless bathroom.
You're located right in the centre of the city without overlooking any noisy spots, it's two minutes walk to great coffee, restaurants and a supermarket, and five minutes from the centre of town and the duomo di Firenze.
Beatrice was super friendly and communicative, she helped arrange a checkin when it was convenient and let our guest in for us when we didn't hear the bell.
We loved our stay here!

The place is perfect and close to all the places worth visiting in Florence. Beatrice is very friendly, hospitable and in general a great host. We were very pleased to find this listing and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a nice apartment to stay at when in Florence.

My stay at Beatrice’s place was perfect. The location was great, the apartment was clean and had everything i needed, and Beatrice and her husband were very kind, welcoming, and attentive. I would highly recommend staying here.

We had a wonderful stay in this incredibly well located apartment. Within a 10 minute walk of almost every gallery, church, museum and restaurant. An absolute gem with incredible views out over the city, from the dome of the Duomo to the hills beyond.
Place was great, centrally located, spacious, great view! Check-in requires phone and data access in real time so be prepared for that.
What a great place! Perfect location with beautiful views of the cathedral and all of Florence. The space is very smart and spacious. Highly recommend!

A fabulous apartment in a great location with outstanding views. The hosts were exceptional and communication was excellent .
Would highly recommend.
Perfect for our family of 4.  Centrally located and clean.  Communication by host was prompt and accurate.
We loved our stay!  Eva and Camillo were so accommodating and responsive. All we needed was in the apartment and the view is amazing.

This was a great apartment in the center of Florence. Only a few minute walk to key sites like the Duomo or the Uffizi, and walkable from the train station. Although the street outside was bustling, the apartment itself was very quiet. The apartment is on an upper floor, so the elevator is strongly recommended. The elevator travels inside of the staircase and is very tight, even for 2 people. The host was very responsive and helpful, and we were able to restructure our checkin time even after our flight was significantly delayed.
Everything was super nice! Location top. Few steps from Sta Croce. The apartment super nice. They live on the next door. Super nice time. Completely recomended!!!!!

The airbnb was so lovely! And the host was extremely kind and helpful throughout the stay- would absolutely recommend this airbnb to anyone looking to stay in an spacious, clean, and well located Florence apartment!
A beautiful place to stay, we loved the location. We got great recommendations for food. We were able to go for night strolls down to the river that was very close by.
Perfect location and beautifully clean and spacious apartment. A/C worked great. Maria allowed us to check out later than the usual time.
Maria’s place is a great value and adorable/secure set up. We loved our location along with our amenities and large bathroom! Definitely recommend.

Excellent central location for all attractions and night life, arched ceilings, XL bathroom, casement windows with plenty of light when needed, and very cosy apartment. We stayed for 3 days and I would certainly stay here again. Thank you Maria, great host!!

Maria was lovely and very helpful and responsive! The location of the apartment was perfect! Walking distance from all the sites and lots of restaurants nearby. The apartment was also spacious and clean and very nicely decorated.

We had a lovely stay here while in Florence & I would book again! The apartment is beautiful & exactly as described. The location was very walkable and more peaceful than other parts of the city. Plus, Maria is a very kind and responsive host. Highly recommend!
We had a wonderful stay in Florence! Maria and her mother warmly welcomed us and were really quick to answer any of our needs. We’ll definitely come back!
This air bnb was absolutely beautiful! Exactly as pictures showed. We were in a great location and it was the perfect stay for our short trip to Florence.

Absolutely PERFECT stay! Was a great location next to so many things without it being noisy or unsafe. We were also very thankful for the AC on hot nights. Highly recommend booking with Maria (:
We hope to be back one day!
This flat is just wonderful.  It is spacious, comfortable and so convenient for wandering the streets of Florence. We just loved it.

Loved my stay here. Felt safe and comfortable traveling solo, and the unit has the gorgeous bones of an old Florence apartment building. Walkable from the train station and all of the shops, restaurants, and attractions

Maria was an amazing host! She worked with us when we had delays getting to the accommodation. She gave us local food recommendations and was super sweet when she met us. The apartment is so cool and in a fun area.
Thank you for sharing this beautiful space with us!  Florence was amazing.  The location was perfect!

This is a very small studio with a bathroom located in a less touristy but still convenient part of Firenze. We liked the location and neighborhood. The room is quite small; the bed takes up most of the room, and it is a little tricky to get around, especially at night and if you are a larger person. There is no street noise, but you can hear other noises from the building, like doors, walking on the floor above, and water flowing. There is a bright blue light that flashes randomly in the room, which we found distracting for sleep. If you are a light sleeper, bring ear plugs and an eye mask.

Superb location and very clean room. AC worked great and I was comfortable. The room was slightly smaller than I thought but since I was alone, it wasn’t a problem. Communication was great the whole time and I was even able to drop off my luggage a little early which was a big deal as I had a huge suitcase I didn’t want to haul around the tiny cobblestone streets of Florence. Very happy with the stay!
My daughter and I had a wonderful stay and we’ll certainly be back! Thank you Edoardo! 🙏🏼💕Anita xxx

Great place at perfect location, within walking distance from many sights and shops. The host was very friendly and answered all my questions timely and clearly.
Highly recommend this place.
this place was great! the location was very convenient and near several good restaurants and was right around the corner from pitti palace and ponte vecchio.

Douglas’s apartment was ideal. Communication was excellent. The location is prime, both for touring and for finding good meals. The place was very clean and well supplied. The bed was very comfortable. I will stay here again.
The only problem was the bed, it was two single beds next to each other and not a double bed. Douglas tried to solve the situation but it didnt work, otherwise we were really enjoyed

This place was terrific—warmly decorated and quiet, but still in the heart of the city, easily accessible to everything. The amenities were ample. Check-in and check-out were easy. The hosts were very responsive and helpful.
Apartment was as described, nice and quiet in a great location. Host was super helpful, responsive, and friendly. We really enjoyed our stay!
Everyone and everything was lovely, Ranieri, Giulio and Fnan were super nice and always very communicative.

Great apartment in perfect location. Stocked with little touches so we felt welcomed (washing powder, dish soap etc). Only issues were that the ensuite bathroom smelled quite bad and the bed was quite firm.

We enjoyed our time at Douglas's apartment. The apartment is well located. The kitchen is well equipped for longer stay. There was a comfortable mattress in the bedroom. Douglas and Fnan are great at communication. Overall, the apartment is peaceful, well decorated, comfortable and cozy. Thank you

If you’re after a central position in Florence, look no further. It’s clean, cool and comfortable. Don’t expect a view but do expect a peaceful retreat from the hustle and bustle of the city.
It’s located in an authentic Florentine building and hosted by people who communicate swiftly and helpfully. If coming to Florence again I would look for availability here first.

This is a great apartment in an amazing part of Florence! You are a 15 minute walk away from any of the sights, but are out of the busy areas giving it a more authentic experience.  It is a very nice space, good bathroom, and the host is very helpful! Would definitely stay again
We had a great stay. The location was absolutely fantastic (3-4 minute walk to the Arno River) and the apartment had everything we needed. Highly recommend.

Our stay here was great! Excellent location, easy check-in and the host was super responsive, friendly and flexible (they let us check-in significantly early which was greatly appreciated). The room is exactly as advertised. The window is high and frosted so it isn't the brightest room but we were only there for one day so we didn't mind. The toilet was a little slow to flush and required pressing the button a few time before it would go but keep in mind Florence is an old city with old plumbing and once we figured it out it was not a problem. Overall it was a great stay!
Definitely enjoyed our stay. Easy to find walkable restaurants, activities, coffee, etc. Host was helpful, kind, and very responsive. Would recommend stay to others without hesitation.

This place is wonderful! Everything looks new, clean and modern - fresh paint, nice fixtures and appliances (but they also preserved the historic features of the building). Eduardo is very responsive and present. You can walk to anywhere, but this side of the river (Oltrarno) is a little less crowded. Also, 2 of the best schiaccia and gelato places we experienced in all Florence are on the corner at piazza da pasera. We highly recommend.
This stay was perfect for my husband and I. Some great restaurants and gelato right down the street. And is super walkable to other tourists attractions.

We loved this stay!! The check in was SO easy and the place was in an amazing location. We loved its proximity to a beautiful courtyard with restaurants and drinks. For anyone staying here, you MUST try the sandwich shop that is next door. We definitely fell in love with Florence and this stay as well. The stay is a 20ish minute walk to the train station and was very accessible for day trips. Cannot recommend it enough!! Please book this Airbnb if you want an amazing time in Florence.

An absolute delight in the heart of Florence. Andrea and Alessandro were keen to help us figure out the parking situation with the ztl driving in from France. They not only gave us great advice to park but also went above and beyond with local recommendations for apperitivo and dinner. Their instructions and friendly advice is what a true airbnb experience is all about. The place is pristine, extremely clean and beautifully designed. It was just what we needed and what we miss dearly in our recent Airbnb experience. Book it without hesitation, your mind will be at ease and you’ll be few steps away from the most beautiful area in Florence. We will come back for sure!
The location was great. It was really easy to self check in. The room was very clean and with all listed amenities. The bed was very comfortable. Great place!

Absolutely lovely apartment, super well organized and clean. The host was really helpful and kind and even left us with a bottle of wine. I was able to bring to my dog as well and there were no problems. Great location and would recommend.

We had a great stay! Really really great location within walking distance of everything and a short bus ride from the main station. The appartement is very nice and has a cute private terrace. It's also above a restaurant which is nice and convenient. The only thing is that we asked Elena if we could leave our suitcases at the Airbnb after check-out and never got an answer even after reaching out twice. Other than that everything was perfect!
A lovely apartment and host. It was in the perfect location but still nice and quiet. Would recommend!!

This apartment was well placed to visit all the sites within Florence. It has many bars and restaurants very close by and a handy bus to get to the station.  The apartment was well equipped and the garden was lovely. Thank you.
Lovely accommodations, outside the main city center but very walkable. Nicely laid out and comfortable beds. Would definitely stay here again!

Great location. Practical check in and no keys needed.
The apartment smells of humidity.
Checkout was a constraint due to policy check out is early at 10h or an extra fee is applies.

10 ⭐ out of 5, zero problems over a 3-night stay
• Beautiful, clean, bright, airy, comfortable apartment (as pictured)
• Wonderfully friendly and quick-responding hosts
• Great location a short walk from the station, almost in a straight line
• Would definitely stay again
• The wine for purchase is a convenient bonus
• Don't waste your time trying to find something better, book it before someone else does
Alberto’s AirBnB is in the perfect location for anyone visiting Florence. A short walk from the train station and very close to many of the historical landmarks and museums. 100% recommend!

Alberto’s apartment is a great find in Florence. It’s easy to access from the train station, and about a 20 minute walk to the square.
The apartment was clean and inviting.
We recommend his apartment to other guests.

We had a great stay and would definitely book again! Alberto and Ziba were extremely helpful and responded quickly whenever we had questions. The apartment is in a quiet area, perfectly located close to the train station and also comfortable walking distance to the city center. The apartment had everything we needed during our stay, was clean and spacious for two people!

What a great place to stay if you want to discover Firenze! Spacious feeling, clean and cozy appartment. Location was superb, everything you need is in walking distance. The airconditioning was really welcome with the unforgiving city summer heat. Would totally recommend this place to anyone wanting to stay in Firenze.

Wow this Airbnb was beautiful! Only 11 min walk from the train station and there was a market and cafe right across the street. It was in a very nice, safe and quiet street. The apartment matched the photos and was very clean! Alberto was also extremely kind and very communicative. Would 100% recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Florence!

We enjoyed our three night stay at Alberto’s loft! Check in was very easy. We were greeted at the Airbnb, shown how to access the building and was given a quick tour of the loft. The loft itself is spacious and comfortable. Wifi was very fast. The location is quite convenient, about a 12 minute walk to Piazza del Duomo and other tourist destinations. Washroom is a bit small. Overall, recommended place to stay in Florence!

Everything was great. We were welcomed by the host, who explained every detail about the apartment. The location is perfect for exploring the city, close to many wonderful restaurants,  museums and the train station. The only issue is that the area is quite loud at night, perhaps it’s a price of staying at the city centre 😉
Very good and safe location. It’s just 8mins walk from the station. Very beautiful and modern apartment. There have everything you need inside. 100% recommend
Alberto gave us a warm welcome upon arrival. Great part of town to easily access everything. Clean cute loft, comfortable bed. Highly recommend!
Alberto's loft is very spacious and comfortable!  Ziba kindly greeted us when we arrived and the location was walkable to most major attractions!
Salvatore was an amazing host! We stayed for 3 nights and it was located right in the heart of Florence! Super clean and I felt very at home! Would highly recommend.

Salvatore was a great host who provided in advance all necessary information on how to find the place and how to check-in. In addition Salvatore send me a msg 1 day later to ensure everything was going well. That was very nice on his part. My husband and I really liked the place and will probably return to stay here whenever we return to Florence. We highly recommend it.
A clean apartment with a modern interior in a super convenient location. Walkable to all of the major tourist attractions in Florence, as well as the train station.

This apartment is gorgeous. It is beautifully designed with high ceilings and feels spacious. Previous reviews have commented on noise. It does get loud at night but if you shut the door to the bedroom it is COMPLETELY SILENT. It is a perfect location. Very central for cultural sites and very quaint and tasty local restaurants. Salvatore was flexible, thoughtful and very responsive. We highly recommend!
A comfortable apartment located in the middle of the city, beautifully decorated and convienient supplies throughly prepared, really enjoyed the stay.

this shelter made our trip to Firenze just cozy and wonderful.
the location was perfect that your can reach evert sights of Firenze by walk,
and its not deep inside the ally regarding safety!

Great little apartment within easy walking distance (15min) of main sights. Newly renovated, clean, very comfy superking bed, quiet. Open plan kitchen/lounge with microwave and hob (no oven) and TV (terrestrial only). Good WiFi. Jacapo was very responsive and friendly.  Apartment has two small windows only that overlook inner roof/other apartments of block so no views if that's what you're after (we didn't mind as were barely there).  As previously mentioned the shower easily overflowed onto the bathroom floor (poor design) so care needed but water was hot and plentiful.

The place was great it’s a quick walk from all the main attractions and the train station without being in the middle of the most hectic and touristy areas. The apartment is a good size for a couple and is very well kept. Our one comment is that the shower is a bit small so water leaks out but this is fairly common in Europe.
Good. Easy to access to the viewpoints. Very very quiet at nights. Jacopo was so prompt to respond.

Jacopo was an excellent host! He was very responsive and attentive. The place was super clean and comfortable. The location is great since it’s safe and away from the crowds but still walking distance to everything.
Great location, the place was neat and well organised. Jacopo was very friendly and check in was smooth and straightforward. Apartment was pristine.

Jacopo’s apartment was nice and clean. The apartment is perfect for two but three is manageable as well. It is quiet at nighttime and is a walkable distance away from the center of the city. Jacopo was friendly and very responsive. When we didn’t have something available, he came right away to bring it for us. If we ever stayed in Florence again, we would love to return here!

Spacious 3 bedroom for our family of 5, washer in unit and walking distance to everything. Restaurants and groceries near by as well as train to and from airport. Good rental and you won’t be disappointed.

My family and I had a wonderful stay at Gregorio's place.  We fell in love with Florence and it was because of all the recommendations he provided.  We look forward to retuning again.  I would not stay anywhere else but at Gregorio's place!
Highly recommended as the place was perfect for our trip to Italy. Will be happy to return when back in the area.

A great location in a quieter part of the city that is still no more than 10-15 mins from Duomo and the sights.
The apartment was very spacious as were the rooms!
Would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Florence

We enjoyed our time here! Great location right next to the Ponte Vecchio and within walking distance of pretty much everything. The elevator was nice to have, too. Everything was clean upon arrival and the hosts communicated well leading up to arrival.

Excellent location with easy walking to all major sites. So much to do, and on a busy and vibrant street but yet the shutters and soundproofing made it very dark and quiet for sleeping. Very clean, and my son found the pull out couch to be comfortable.

Great location. We stayed here with our toddler and it was a prime location, walkable to all the major sites, lots of great restaurants close by, and easy to access taxis if needed. Space was large enough to accommodate 3 adults and 1 child comfortably and we enjoyed the living room area. Additionally the pack n play that we were able to use for an additional charge was spacious and comfortable for our son !
