The location was perfect and the it was great for what we were looking for and for value. Started off rocky due to poor communication when we were told we could check in early but it quickly turned around once we were able to check in.

The apartment is in the heart of Florence. Located next door is the Uffizzi Gallery and the Pechio Bridge. Lots of cafe and supermarket.  Everything is within walking distance to Doumo or shopping to any art gallery lovers. The apartment is 15 mins walk to the SM Novella Station.

The apartment was great! Very well equipped, clean and very spacious for two people. Location is pretty good too, it's close to the Santa Maria Novella station and there is a tram stop near which you can use to move around easily. Communication with Emiliano was spot on as well. I would come back next time I travel to Florence.
exactly as described, fan was okay for the nights thought it could get quite warm but great place overall
the apartment was very nice and in a great location. a bit loud sometimes, but we did not have a problem with it! great stay!

This beautiful spacious place exceed all of our expectations. It is beautiful, elegant and comfortable  one thing that might be understated is the location. You are within 5 minutes of church in Santo Spirito, Pitti Palace, Picteau Bistrot (an incredible place for a sunset cocktail overlooking the river), excellent boutiques, it's just perfectly located. You're even less than a 15 min walk to the train station so you can travel to other cities with ease. I'd give this place 6 stars if I could.

Very nice place
Lots of care for the details
Elegant
A good "harbour" to stay in Florence

Great host, try his best to help us. Recommend shops and also remind us about the city festival
Great location and also full function of the house

We loved our stay at Paolos, it was our little Florence dream come true. Bathroom had extra amenities ,, the apartment was in a quite area , in a really busy neighborhood, which made it really distinctive,,
Loved everything about the space & paolo was vey responsive and flexible
We enjoyed staying at Paolo’s place! Super central and walkable. Paolo was a great host, he was flexible with letting us check in early and provided us with local recommendations!

Paulo’s home was very walkable and close to all major attractions and restaurants. He was very responsive and ensured we had all instructions prior to check in. My husband and I would stay here again.

Paolo’s place was great! He was very responsive and gave clear instructions as to how to enter the building/unit. The location was also perfect as it’s close to the river and many other attractions. The room was clean and comfortable

The location of Paolo’s place couldn’t be beat! Made our trip so much more convenient. As is noted in the description and other reviews, the location means that you will hear plenty of street noise - this was expected and definitely present. Also to be expected but good to be aware of - the bathroom is very small. But neither issue impacted our stay much and we had a great time.

GREAT location!! Paolo was great to deal with. Friendly and a great sense of humour….
Small unit and tricky to find (what isn’t in Florence) but all you need to see the beautiful city of Florence…
Worth it for sure.
Great location for this comfortable studio. Paolo was very responsive to our requests and the place was clean and accurately described. We enjoyed it very much!

Fantastic location! My husband and I had a wonderful time. This Airbnb is private, yet, right in the heart of Florence. With one street back, Piazza della Signoria, the Uffizi, the Duomo is to the right and Ponte Vecchio bridge to the left with amazing shops and restaurants along the way. The small space has everything you need and the central location is perfect for sightseeing and exploring Florence! Paolo was very helpful, kind and responsive. Thank you for our stay!

Lovely spacious room with modern and clean bathroom .
Really enjoyed the close distance to the Termini station. (3 mins walking)
Garden was a great touch to have some outside space in Firenze.
Room was well equipped with coffee machine for espresso.
I highly recommend this place.
This apartment was perfect for our family of five. Easiest check in ever. Lorenzo answered any questions as soon as we asked. He provided us with amazing restaurant recommendations. Perfect stay.
We had an amazing time in Florence and in this place. Everything was just as described and the place was perfect for our stay. We would come back.

Lorenzo’s was great! Just what we needed after long hours of walking around beautiful Florence. There is a little cafe about a block away (beside the parking) where everything is great and service is great as well. Lorenzo’s made our stay in Florence overall very easy!

Lorenzo was very responsive to our issues and questions. Location wise it’s great, the parking garage was also reliable charging a rate of 35 per day. The flat does require some maintenance, for us laundry, kitchen was key reasons for staying in an Airbnb so when the machine was rusty (on the outside) and the kitchen cupboards and general cleanliness was lacking it became an issue for us.  As the flat is on the ground floor with traditional windows, it felt cold due to draft from the windows and nooks from the doors. The property would be great value for non picky travellers.
Fantastic location, comfortable base & great amenities for a long weekend seeing the sites in Florence. Lorenzo was a helpful and responsive host. Lovely place to stay.

We had a wonderful few days at Lorenzo’s apartment. Very easy arrival with accurate and detailed directions for check in.
The apartment is located in a quiet area with very good walking access to restaurants and central Florence. We were in Florence during a very warm period and the air conditioning was a major benefit after a long day seeing the sights.
All in all we would highly recommend Lorenzo’s apartment and would love to stay again in the future.
Comfortable.  15 min walk to all main tourist attractions.   Ran by a company so not as personal and nice as when you rent directly from owner.  Very strict check in check out.

Federico is an excellent host. Responds to texts almost immediately. He is super helpful and very friendly. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay there. The only problem was that we didn’t want to leave! Don’t hesitate on this one. Amazing location and Airbnb and host are spectacular!

This is the perfect place to stay in Florence. A beautiful apartment with river view and great access to all the highlights as well as proximity to hidden gems. The space was well appointed, comfortable and Federico is an amazing and helpful host. Wonderful!

Thank you for such a lovely stay in one of our favourite places in the world. Such a lovely apartment in a great location. We loved sitting by the window people watching and looking out at the hustle and bustle. It’s a very spacious apartment with everything you need, although we couldn’t find any coffee pods but I wasn’t sure if they were provided or not. It didn’t matter though as we headed out for coffee every day. The communication was great throughout and we would love to stay again. Thank you!

Federico’s place is beautiful and spacious. It’s in a great location for restaurants, sightseeing, and shopping.  Between the apartment and the view you really feel like you’re in high end place. Federico was very responsive and helpful. I’d recommend this listing to anyone heading to Florence!

LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION! In addition, Federico was professional, pro-active, and helpful.
This is premium Airbnb that won’t disappoint. Highly recommended.
great apartment, close to everything and with washer and dryer in unit which helped me a lot with my long trip tru Italy.
Totally lovely apartment. Nice design of all the finishes. Excellent neighborhood with easy walk to the center of town.
The host is super helpful, he had recommendations for us. The place was clean, we had everything we wanted and could walk to our activities within 15 minutes. Would recommend

The apartment was in a perfect location to be able to easily explore Florence.
It was ideal for 2 people to share, clean, tidy, good closet space and easy to access.
Would highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay here for 2 quick nights in Florence. The area is pretty much in the city center with shops and restaurants very nearby. It is also very easy to walk to from the train station when we arrived from Rome. We were able to leave our bags before check in and the place was pretty much ready with just a few last minute details. The host is very quick to respond for any concerns. We couldn’t find any glasses to drink a bottle of champagne we brought along but there were some coffee mugs available. Also the beds were quite stiff and springy but after a long trip of traveling we could sleep almost anywhere. Quite some flights of stairs but that can be expected. Check in was easy and the kitchen/living area was spacious and comfortable. Would definitely recommend for a short stay in Florence.
Wow what a location and a great apartment in a beautiful part of the city.  Easy walking distance to everything Florence has to offer!

The apartment is centrally located, making it a convenient spot for exploring Florence. Apartment itself is modern and very clean. The host is responsive and online check-in was easy. Highly recommend.
Close to everything, walkable. Enjoyed the gelato place around the corner. Place was clean and as described!
The place was in a great location, very close to the train station and cafes. Communication with the host was smooth, easy, and clear. Highly recommend!

Great location with super view of the square. The room and bathroom were very spacious. Great value.The host was very friendly and helpful and we were able to use luggage store before and after check-in/out. Would recommended a stay here and would definitely go back, we had a great time.

The room is great! Clean, comfortable and has everything you need for a few days in Florence. The area is amazing with plenty of local shops, bars and restaurants. Gregorio is a great host as well! Highly recommend it!

Wonderful stay. The place was super clean and had everything we needed. The double glass windows make the room so quiet, even if it’s above the piazza! Great AC and amenities - definitely a gem in Piazza Santo Spirito. They were so accommodating with our baby and made our stay comfortable for him as well. Filippo was really helpful and called us taxis, gave recommendations, and made sure to check in with us every day asking if everything was good. We really appreciated it and will definitely be back! Grazie!
This place was perfect. Great location, a large clean room, and great host with flexible bag drop off and pick up.

Our fav stay on the Italy trip as a family of 3. The room is perfectly located and walkable to various sites in Florence. There are great restaurants right under the building. Slightly tucked away so not super touristy.
Now the rooms- it’s perfectly furnished with an espresso machine, comfortable bed, clean towels and the greatest shower with water pressure.
Gregorio also included a free cappuccino and croissants to make out stay comfortable. Highly recommend
One of the best places I have stayed at! Dani was a great host as well, offering help and tips around town! I recommend this place

This amazing apartment has an unbeatable view right to the Duomo! Very spacious, clean and carried the charm of the historical city of Florence! We felt absolutely at home! Very easy check in and checkout process! Very responsive and helpful host! Would definitely recommend to stay here. At some point we didn’t even want to leave the apartment - that’s how much we enjoyed it!
Fantastic apartment! The location is amazing if you want a once-in-a-lifetime experience of waking up in front of the Duomo. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout.

This place is truly one of a kind.   The opportunity to have sustained panoramic views of the Duomo complex was truly exceptional.    The location could not be better and the decor is an art and history lover’s dream

Dani was an amazing host
She was helpful and quick in her response
The apt is beautiful clean and spacious
Great location
Great views
It does get loud at night but location makes it worth it
Great experience!!!!

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay! The space was as described and very comfortable, close to everything. Dani war incredibly responsive to all of our questions and could not have been more helpful. I would not hesitate to recommend this space to anyone traveling to Florence.
This place is exactly as described.  Very convenient / central location!!!  Host is very helpful and responsive. ❤️

We really enjoyed our time at Dani's place. The location was ideal—right in the heart of the city, steps from the Duomo, museums, shops, and plenty of great restaurants. It made getting around super easy.
The apartment itself was spotless, stylish, and comfortable, with thoughtful touches that made us feel right at home. The host was incredibly responsive and welcoming, offering great local recommendations that really enhanced our stay.
Overall, a great place to stay if you want to be close to all the main attractions. We can’t recommend it highly enough and would absolutely stay here again!

Words and photos cannot describe this place.  Dani was the most accommodating and responsive host of our trip and her property is beyond words.  From the deck overlooking the duomo, to the windows, to the layout, to everything.  You can tell there was thought and care put  into each room.  Unlike some BnBs this also felt like a home.  100++/10.  Cannot recommend enough

This location and residence was nothing short of perfect! Walkable to every sight and beautiful surrounding restaurants.

We would definitely return!
Great hosts, super clean.place, easy enough to access tram to town, would  book again!

Antonio is a great host and we felt like home in his unit. The unit is about 15 mins away from downtown by tram and about 10 mins walk from the tram station. We are impressed by Antonio’s precise instructions for tram station and grocery store nearby etc.  The kitchen was equipped with all possible utensils and saved us $$ from eating outside. The pictures on Airbnb do not do justice for this property, it’s beautifully decorated and loved looking at all the collectibles he has around the house. Last but not least, so far the best Airbnb we stayed is Antonios’s place. He was very thoughtful and kept welcome snacks and a water bottle for us to use which we never experienced in any of the airbnbs we stayed. I highly recommend this unit for your stay In Florence .

Antonio was remarkably communicative, helpful, and demonstrated incredible flexibility by accommodating our late check-in without any hassle.
Highly recommended for anyone seeking an accommodating and attentive host.
Perfect apartment. Great views. Spacious and uncluttered. Ideally situated. Nothing about the apartment was less than superb.
This place is located in a perfect spot to visit all tourism spots. Surrounded by great food and a lot to see. When in Florence, we will be back to this apartment.
Very easy to walk around! The place is very safe and very clean. Best place for staying in the Florence!

By far one of my favorite stays! Not incredibly fancy but what you receive in care and warm welcomes is unmeasurable! First East away from home and they made my final hours at breakfast there feel incredible special! So many smiles, treats, and care. One of the highlights of my trip. I will definitely be back.

It was perfect for us because i booked it very last minute after having to change plans… I probably should have went to the website to book directly through there and possibly save some money but nonetheless it was perfect for last minute changes

Recently renovated apartment and building. Super clean and fully equipped. Beautifully decorated. Really good location. Quiet area during the night. The host truly deserves the 5 stars. Would come back without any doubt.
Luce is a great host, with a  beautiful home in Florence. Highly recommend staying here!!
Short walk to the center of Florence. Spacious and very comfortable! Luca was very helpful and responsive. Definitely would stay again.
It was great, super clean and spacious. It did get a little cold but overall it was a great stay:)

Absolutely perfect and Luce could not be kinder and more attentive. This apartment is a real jewel, so well placed at the heart of Florence in a most quiet and beautiful street and close to all services one could need and dream for. The wonderful, modern lift is a great assett and so is the high level of comfort and tranquility of this space. There is no better option in Florence, close or afar. Once you discover it you value it and Luce as the true gems that they are.

We had a wonderful stay at Luce’s place in Florence! The apartment was clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed. The location was perfect—close to many key attractions, yet quiet and peaceful. Luce was a fantastic host: kind, responsive, and thoughtful, and made us feel truly welcome. We would definitely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Florence.
We had a wonderful stay! Elena was helpful in assisting us with recommendations for local restaurants and helped organize our taxi to the airport.

Andrea’s place is exactly as described and as pictured. I stayed with my husband on our visit to Florence in early September. The apartment is easily walkable (30 min max) to most main attractions in Florence across the river, but we also loved exploring the neighbourhood of San Niccolo and Andrea gave us great local recommendations. The apartment is air conditioned and very comfortable. We will definitely be returning in our next trip to Florence!

What a great place to stay whilst in Florence! Away from the touristy rush, but close enough to see the sights and right next to the amazing MichelAngelo Piaaza! Comfy , clean flat, with enough room for two and sufficient amenities to get by.
Andrea is also a very helpful and responsive host … was always quick to reply to my messages and left us useful tips about local restaurants etc…
We will definitely return

Gabriele proved a great host and his flat as comfortable as he was helpful and cordial.
Location is downright perfect (a literal few steps from the train station and the city center). The flat is large, comfortable and my friends and I found it lacking nothing.
Perfect for a group stay, especially if you're looking for an accessible and comfy base to tour/sightsee the city center.
Heartily recommended.

Gabriele is a great host and his place is amazing! It is in a great location, and was very clean, spacious, and comfortable. Gabriele is quick to respond to messages and very helpful! Would definitely stay here again.
Host was extremely responsive and helpful. Comfy beds. Perfect location- steps from both train station and tram, Central Market and cathedral!
Great location, easy to find. Quiet during the night, construction noise during the day from a nearby building. Responsive host, very comfortable bed, too. Recommend!

We had a very enjoyable stay at Gabrielle’s place. It was exactly as described, including the detail about the stairs which we found easy enough to manage.
The place was very clean and really felt like a home away from home.
There were lots of restaurants near by and most of the things we wanted to see were within easy walking distance.
We would definitely recommend Gabrielle’s place to others!

We like to stay at Gabriele's place. It was workable to most of the places. We didn't take taxi or subway at all. We planned our trip based on this location after we booked from airbnb and stayed at this place for 3 nights. Went to most famous places in Florance. Highly recommended. it has many restaurants around this location. 10mins. by walking to Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore.
Gabriele and Francesca are amazing hosts! The place was perfect and very well located. Would definitely come back again!

Gabriele's place is exactly as decribed, has everything you'll need for comfortable stay. It is very close to the train station-we did lots of day trips! Both hosts are very responsive, provided clear instructions and made sure our stay was comfortable. They were also very flexible regarding check-in. Gabriele provided us with some wonderful local recommendations!

This place was excellent!! It was walking distance from all tourist attractions, the train station, shopping, grocery store, and so much more!! The air bnb is very clean, spacious, and beautiful! Our welcome was so nice… the parents welcomed us and also gave us a bottle of wine upon arrival. It was very sweet and they made us feel at home. On the plus side, the washer and dryer combo was perfect! There are plenty of kitchen appliances and everything you need for a short or long term stay. I will recommend this location to all of my friends back home when they plan to visit Florence!

My grandmother and I stayed at Claudio’s home and it was incredible. Perfect location, warm welcome by the family with explanations on how to use the entire flat. The flat was so clean and multipurpose,  fantastic location. It can get a little loud during the night due to being so central but it is 100% worth it for the convenience. I would 100% recommend Claudio’s apartment!

Really well equipped and clean apartment. Recently renovated. Very friendly and helpful host.
Right next to train station which was the key driver for us as we had a 6am train to Rome.
Only negative point of note is that the area is noisy at night
Very nice newly renovated apartment which was great for a week long stay. Easy access to the train station and all the old part of Firenze. Would recommend.

Lovely place, just as described, close to all the sights, and also to the train station so day trips to Bologna or Siena are very easy. Great communication, clean flat, very good and reliable, fast WiFi. You should book this place of available!

Amazing stay in Florence right next to the train station. Claudio was a wonderful host and went above and beyond to ensure we had a great stay. Bed was comfortable,  showers had hot water, toilet was clean, and kitchen amenities were great! We didn’t want to leave beautiful Firenze! Thank you Claudio

A beautiful, very well cared for unit. The unit is pristine and clean, with every amenity you need beautifully organized.
The unit gets great light as well.
We enjoyed the unit, location, and the hospitality provided by the hosts immensely.
Thank you!

Claudio and Nunzia greeted us upon our arrival and give us detailed step by step instructions on how to get in and out and all the appliances in the house.
Excellent location just less than 5mins walk to both train and tram, amenities like restaurants, cafe and a supermarket right below. Excellent excellent excellent.
Highly recommended !!

Nothing but great things to say about my stay here. Claudio and his wife were very nice, went over everything with getting into the apartment, how things worked, and pointed out convenient grocery store next to place. They were quick to respond to questions through the app. Great location near train station if you are taking the train or tram in or out of location. Easy to walk to so main site from location.

Claudio and Nancy are very friendly and passionate to introduce their place . They gave us a warm greeting when we just arrived, even though we were a bit late because of the delayed train.
The location of their home is extremely convenient. You can find a supermarket literally next to the apartment! I prep my meals for a few times because of that. It’s easy to access different spots of Florence from their place too. It’s a few mins walk from their place to The Central Market. I enjoyed a lot during my stay in their home :)

Our stay in Claudio and Nancy’s home was fantastic. The location was great, a few steps away from train station and 10 min walk from major attractions. The house is clean, fully equipped and well designed. Everything works well. Claudio and Nancy are fantastic hosts, they are friendly and helpful and this is one of the best if not the best airbnb I have stayed before. Highly recommended.

Great location across the street from the train station! The building felt very secure with multiple locked doors. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and walking distance to all the major attractions. Claudio and his wife were very welcoming and friendly! Thanks for a great stay!
Claudio’s place is clean and well maintained. The location is convenient and the neighborhood is safe. Claudio is kind and gave us a detailed walkthrough during check-in. We had a good time here.

This was my favorite accommodation on my trip. The location was great, across from the train station so not needing to haul luggage far was perfect. Plus, quiet at night but very walkable to everything. The apartment itself has absolutely everything you need. The bathroom was luxuriously large and felt like a nice hotel! Everything felt new, well-maintained and worked well. They even had international plug adaptors to use if needed. They go above and beyond to make  this place a nice retreat for their guests! Claudio and Nunzia were both so extremely kind and welcoming! Would definitely return!

Claudio was a great host and very welcoming and helpful at check in.  The location is perfect for walking to all of Florence’s sites, restaurants and the train station.  Highly recommended for your stay in Florence!
Claudio and Nancy were wonderful hosts. Their place was close to the train station, market, restaurants and walking distance to everything in Florence. A wonderful stay!

We used this modern newly renovated apartment as homebase touring Tuscany and Venice, railroad station near by. Food supermarket next-door. Felt extremely secure behind three security doors. Most popular Florence attractions within 10 minute walk. I recommend this apartment to travelers to Florence.

Claudio is a wonderful host. He explained everything in detail when we met. The apartment is in a perfect location and his instructions were clear and accurate. It is really just across from the train station and also across from the Santa Maria Novella church. It was easy to walk to many points of interest, restaurants, shopping. The convenience of having a supermarket just downstairs was appreciated by us. This is one of the best Airbnb’s I have stayed in and should I return to Florence it would absolutely be my first choice again.

Very convenient and easy to get to location from the train station! Claudio was very responsive and waited for us even when our train was delayed by almost 2 hours! Everything was as described and the check in process was easy. This location made everything easy and walkable - would definitely stay here again!

Awesome place to stay, really close to the train station, they even helped us personally check in and explain everything to us. Claudio was amazing. AC was good, there are two units. One in the living room works well, the one in the bedroom is not as strong. Washer/dryer unit was easy to use and a huge help. This is a high traffic area, but we felt safe and secure in the Airbnb. Close to everything, highly reccomend this space. Also a huge shower which I loved.
Claudio was a terrific host from reservation to check-out.  Had a marvelous stay at his wonderful apartment right near the train station.
This is hands down best Airbnb experience this hostess has ever experienced! Claudio and his wife set the standard!

We had the most amazing stay here. If you like architecture or design, there is a lot for you to appreciate! The house is extremely well equipped with everything you could need (even a shopping cart!), which makes you feel like you are at home. There were some food and bathroom items which are much appreciated when travelling. When we arrived, the apartment was absolutely spotless. Claudia and Gokhan were helpful and flexible with check in, and always available during our stay if we had any questions. There is aircon in three of the rooms which work extremely well. The location of the house is perfect if you want to be away from the tourists. However, it’s only a short tram ride from the centre (and about 7 min walk to the tram stop), plus there are a lot of local amenities nearby (including an amazing bakery). We cannot recommend this place highly enough. Thank you so much to the amazing hosts!
Location is the best! Very close to santa maria novella station and city center  They just renovated entire apartment. I liked that every room has own bathroom. Highly recommend!

Mattia's appartment is an excellent choice for groups or families wishing to stay near close to Santa Maria Novella station (3min walk) and the center. It is spacious, spotlessly clean and very well equiped. The three bathrooms and the espresso machine heavily appreciated.
The only not perfect thing has been that we have been asked to pay extra money to use all the three bedrooms, even if at the time of booking it was not mentioned. Still, the price is ok for what you get.

Very closed to the train station, this comfortable, quiet, safe, 3 large bedroom 3 bathroom apartment does not have a lounge, unless you convert one of bedrooms. You are greeted by one of the agents so be clear about time of arrival. Very helpful people!
Small corredor kitchen, tiny eating area, wi-fi, washing machine and air conditions worked very well( specially on humid nights). The local small supermarket (carrefour) makes AMAZING fresh sandwiches at the deli (best I ever eaten in Italy!). Also is good idea to note there are be some flight of stairs, if you have large luggage and /or have mobility issues. Otherwise gosh is convenient and the beds are comfy!
We had to cancel at very late notice due to our sick son and Mattia was very accomodating
Great location, confortable beds. The hosts are responsives. There are no windows located in the main street which is perfect due to the high traffic area.
Great location, close to train station and walkable to all the top sights in Florence. Modern, refurbished place.

Great location, everything is walkable, so close to the train station. Good for sleeping and getting ready to explore Florence. The rooms were nice and spacious but there were energy limitations, can’t run multiple large appliances at the same time.
Shower door missing in first bedroom, which we were not advised about so water ended up all over the floor. We we’re told to use the mop to clean up. They did give us extra floor towels. The coffee machine was also not working and we were told another would be provided but never was. Ok stay, the location was unbeatable though.
Coulda been cleaner, and the flat had a bad odor, but the hosts were quick to meet and location was primo
This place is extremely near to the train station and there's a lot of great restaurants just below the apartment. Rooms are spacious with bathrooms attached.

My family had a great stay here. There was plenty of room for a group of 5. Everyone had their own room.
The place was clean and has all the amenities you need. The view was amazing. There is a grocery store across the street, a bakery near by, and a just a few steps from the Ponte Vecchio.
The host was very responsive with easy check in.
This was a great stay!

This is amazingly clean, newly remodeled apartment. The location is perfect. Very walkable to almost everything, even the train station. The view is probably the best you can get in Florence and it is perfect for a large family to spread out in and have their own private spaces. They can accommodate a baby very well, but you need to be very specific with them when listing your bedroom preference. If you don't list a 'crib' in one of the rooms, you will be charged when you ask for one on arrival.  I just said we had a 4 couples and a baby and assumed they would know I wanted a crib for it to sleep in. Our family made some incredible memories here.
nice and spacious place in central Firenze. we liked it, stayed 4 people in the apartment.

The place was super clean, top location, +5€ for the towels in cash the arrival day. Issue: during the night the heaters are switched off and they turn on automatically around 6am. Was really cold, no blanket and no chance to increase the temperature. Above this the stay was nice
We really enjoyed our stay here. Good location. Extremely close to the bus that takes you the trains station. Very clean. We enjoyed our stay here a lot.
The perfect spot to walk around Florence. It seemed like just about everything was a 20 minute walk away from here. Lovely place.
Great value for money. Beautiful, authentic and spacious apartment, in a great location. We loved our stay and Antonio was very flexible and responsive which was hugely appreciated.
Perfect place to stay when exploring Florence!  Walkable to the Duomo and safe, private neighbourhood location. Antonio was great with communication, thank you so much!

A lovely air conditioned retreat from a very few hot days in Florence. Beautiful historic apartment with a lovely combination of tasteful modern decor blended with original floor tiling and timber ceilings. Walking distance to mostly everything including great trattoria and cafes and a supermarket very close by. The bed was super comfortable. Antonio was great with communication very clear instructions for check in and check out. Thank you Antonio.
We loved this place so much! We were able to walk to everything in Florence. We said it was our favorite air b n b of our Italy trip!! We will definitely be back!

Great location, walking distance from the train station, close to all attractions. A lot of restaurants, gelaterias around the apartment.  Inside the apartment was very clean. Enjoyed the artwork in the hallway.

Andrea’s apartment was perfect and Andrea was the ideal host. The apartment was very comfortable- it had everything we needed (including excellent air conditioning for the 90+ degree days). We felt totally at home. Andrea was a perfect host. He met us at the apartment to help us check in. He gave tips and suggestions for restaurants and getting into the city. He was very responsive.
We would absolutely stay here again.

Andrea was a super awesome host and was a quick responder. His place is more beautiful than the pictures. It's near Piazzale Michaelangelo. We had an amazing time staying at their place. Thank you Andrea for the wine and everything.

Very nice and thanks for the wine. It takes 40 minutes to the center by walk, around 2.6km, and maybe fix the fan in the bathroom, very noisy and small washing basin and easy to get wet. Anyway, it is recommend to stay and will come back again
It was truly a fantastic place to stay at which gave a feeling of being at home.. The apartment was very very clean and very well placed in a peaceful community

If you are looking for a wonderful stay, look no further, this is the place to rent. This was the best stay we had In Italy or anywhere else.
Andrea is a very helpful and kind person. He took care of small details to make us feel at home.
He welcomed us with a bottle of wine which was a very thoughtful thing to do for your guests. On the last day he took care of our bags which was so helpful.
Thank you, Andrea. We enjoyed our stay in your wonderful apartment.
Andrea was a fabulous host. He was very friendly and helpful and the apartment was excellent. It was an easy walk into town and we enjoyed our stay tremendously.

Andrea is an awesome host. He was waiting for us before we got there, helped us with all luggage during both check in and check out. Left us goodies, bus tickets and was always available to help recommend local areas from parking to shopping and in between. Highly recommended!
Do not hesitate to book this place! Central location but you don’t hear ANY street noise. The place is gorgeous and the support team is amazing.
Amazing location. Private and quiet apartment right in the center of Florence! Recommend for anyone who wants to stay in Florence!

Had a great time in this cute appartment! It had everything you need in it and the location is absolutely fantastic! Sightseeing, shops and restaurants are all within walking distance. Perfect for solo travelers like me and couples. I hope to be back here someday for a longer visit!

Fantastic location with great hosts. The apartment itself is simple, clean and has air conditioning which was invaluable with the oppressive July heat in Firenze. It is right above the Mercato Centrale so it's easy to get to all public transportation. The apartment is on the 4th floor with no elevator. We had a terrific experience with everything. Highly recommend.

This is a fantastic place to stay in Florence. It is centrally located to the central market to the train station and the major sites. We were so blessed to be in this cool and comfortable accommodation. This is a good choice for any visit to Florence. It has the highest rating possible.

The property is absolutely outstanding with a great location. Niccolo and his dad communicated the entire time with us and we felt really at home in their property. I can honestly recommend this property to anyone visiting Florence and am definitely staying here again when we return.
Thank you for a wonderful stay. The apartment was beautiful , well appointed and is an amazing location within walking distance to everything. Highly recommended
Nice！The apartment is in a great location, and the host is very friendly and helped us solve many problems.

Niccolo was a lovely host, flexible and responds right away. He always checks in on us, making sure that we are ok. The place was convenient, we walk to everywhere. A great place to stay when you are in Firenze. Thank you Niccolo!!!!!

This might have been our favorite Airbnb in Italy out of 4 we stayed. So much charm, very clean. Nice to have a little elevator and be up so high and have a little view. Great location near everything. Electricity did shut off but they had instructions if this happened and it was fine, we got it back up. Cool ac (we were here in summer so that was key). Really lovely. Easy check in not having to meet up with someone was nice.

This listing was like a home way from home. It was spacious, with good separate rooms for internal privacy. It was also clean, comfortable, with conveniences that allowed for a very effortless stay. The climate control was fantastic as you could control different spaces within the listing to suit different temperature preferences. The washing machine was extraordinarily helpful. I highly recommend.

Marcos place is perfect! The location is great for walking everywhere in Florence. They recommended an amazing vegetarian restaurant called Brac that is tucked inside of a really cute book store. There is also a really great organic coffee shop right on the corner called SimBIOsi. The apartment is spacious and the terrace is unbeatable. We loved our stay and wild absolutely stay here again.

Perfect location, beautiful apartment and worked well with 2 couples sharing.  I recommend this place if you want to be close to the main attractions and want somewhere you can feel at home when not out exploring.  ☺️☺️

Such an oasis in a wonderful part of the city. Everything is in walking distance and the apartment is very comfy, clean and has everything you need. We loved breakfast on the terrace and the welcome by Laura was perfect. Highly recommend and we can’t wait to come back! Thank you ☺️

Fantastic  apartment in a perfect location. Elena met us at check in and was very welcoming and helpful. Lovely bottle of bubbly I’m fridge for my daughters Birthday  which was a lovely touch. Can’t wait to return to Florence

We enjoyed staying in this apartment. Easy to walk to areas we wanted to see.  Great restaurants. The stairs are a bit if a hike but what you generally find in second floor apartments.  We would stay there again!
Great apartment with great location! Macro was very good with communication as well as his coordinator Elena! Highly recommend booking a trip to this place!

We loved our stay! The location was fantastic, within 10-15 mins walk of all the major sights. A wonderful bakery on the corner and supermarkets nearby. We particularly enjoyed sitting on the balcony having breakfast

Wonderful spot. Close enough to walk to plenty of restaurants. Everything was superb! Apartment was spacious and great rooftop terrace. Easy to communicate with to coordinate check in and excellent facilities. Would definitely recommend!

The flat was easy to find and accessible. The design was clean and modern but remained beautifully authentic, with exposed wood and a large window which lit the apartment well. The location was fantastic, and it was very nice to have a gym.
We had a small fault with the power, but within 5 minutes of messaging our hosts, the problem was fixed.
Would happily stay again!
Marco’s place was the perfect location for our trip. 5 minute walk to The Duomo, and lots of recommendations.  Comfortably slept 4 people. Would stay again!

Location, communication, and recommendations were excellent.
Thank you Marco and Family. And, thank you Elena!
K&G

Had a fantastic stay, the apartment was in a great location with lovely bakery, coffee shops and restaurants surrounding us. Took minutes to get into the centre of Florence. The apartment was quiet when inside.
Would be good to mention that there are a number of steps to get into property and carry a suitcase up could be tricky for some.
We hope to come back. Thankyou marco and Elena for a great holiday accommodation.
This is a wonderful unit in a perfect location for our first time to Florence…super communication with host as well. I would highly recommend and hope to return soon!

The apartment was clean, but needed maintenance. Additionally, the warm water lasted only about 10 minutes before the boiler needed time to reheat, making it inconvenient for us, given that we were four guests. However,  the apartment was situated in a great location, with all major attractions within walking distance.

We had a great time at Marco’s listing! Perfect location and in easy walking distance to everything. Our travel plans changed and we were able to check in early which was a huge help. Terrace was the perfect addition to an already amazing stay, so nice to sit out and enjoy the Florence weather. 10/10 recommend to other travelers. Also right near a tram station which is helpful for transit to airport!!

Lovely place to stay in Florence. Location is ideal, 5 minutes from the galleria dell'accademia and walking distance to the duomo and uffizi Galleries as well as loads of great restaurants. Marco was a great host, making checking in and checking out very easy.
Charming apartment in a great area of the city. Seamless self check-in/out. Unfortunately quite noisy throughout the night despite high floor.
The apartment was clean, spacious, and in a great location. It was also beautifully decorated, and had a very pretty corridor.

The flat is gorgeous and super clean.
Close to everything but away from crowds and tourists.
Definitely recommend this place.

Fantastic location, close to main streets and also plenty of beautiful restaurants nearby. Communicative hosts and exactly as pictures show including plenty of room to move around. Would definitely stay again and highly recommend!

This is a little gem.
The location is amazing! Just outside of the crazy tourists but so close to everything! You walk outside and there are plenty of restaurants, shops and the bridge that takes you right into the center of town
The building itself is beautiful w nice elevator. It’s a wonderful experience like being in a really nice home.
And the service was absolutely incredible!!!! They helped me so much and went the extra mile on several occasions.
I left feeling like family.
Would highly recommend!!!

I loved my stay here and I loved the apartment. The instructions they gave for check-in and check-out were really easy to follow. They were wonderful to communicate with too. The bed was really comfortable and the pillows were great! I loved how easy it was to open and close the windows for fresh air. The apartment was nicely heated  everything worked well and the kitchen was well equipped with everything one would need. If felt more like a cozy home then an Airbnb. And it's really well secured and the area is so safe and so much fun. A ton of cute shops, wine bars, and restaurants nearby. It was nice to stay on the other side of the river from the city center but still able to walk to everything. I loved the Oltrarno neighborhood. I highly recommend staying here.

This place is an absolute gem! The host, Francesca was also very helpful and delightful to talk to! Locations is brilliant, apartment is better than it looks on photos! Would absolutely stay here again.
Elly was awesome. She helped us when we were in a pickle from one Airbnb to another and always quick to respond. Super sweet!

What a wonderful choice! It was a great advantage to me have someone to provide advice and to offer real help with local arrangements. Nothing was too much, Monica was a wonderful host and I plan to return soon!

The pictures m, while great, don’t do this place justice. A fairytale stay, far enough away from the big crowds of tourists in Firenze, but close enough to have nice stroll or taxi ride into the city center. Nigel, is great too :)
We really enjoyed our stay, the apartment is lovely and feels very safe and secure, and it was nice to be greeted by the host upon arrival. Highly recommended!
The place was incredible! The terrace was phenomenal and location was perfect. We felt safe and the host was great at communication. Absolutely recommend this place. Grazie!

We loved that there was ample communal space and really liked the balcony.  Having each space on its own climate control was great.  The dryer is not vented so things take hours to dry - better off just hanging to dry.  If you plan to catch up on laundry then I hope you are staying a few days.  The non vented dryer seems to be the norm in Europe.  Hostesses were responsive.  Wish the beds were a tad softer but at least they weren’t sagging and the linens were clean, in good repair and basic white which is appealing to me.  All in all a good stay.
Enjoyed three nights in Florence. The apartment was well appointed and was described accurately!  Goods restaurants nearby! Perfect setting.
This space is very cozy and comfortable, aside from the stairs. Highly recommend if staying in Florence.

Margherita’s bnb is very well designed and has a very nice view. Everything was clean and the communication was fast. The only thing is if you drive to Florence you should check with Margherita for a pass in advance as the bnb is in an area with limited car access. If you have many luggage and you don’t have the pass you have to park 10 min away then walk up to the third floor where the flat is located (no elevator). We also had a little problem in the beginning with the door that got stuck but eventually the situation got solved. Overall I liked this bnb.
Everything was perfect, just one night we didn’t have electricity but they resolved it the next morning.
Excellent house and beautiful apartment - even better than the photos. We loved our stay here and Margherita was really helpful. I would definitely stay here again if I was in Florence.
Had the best time at this place!! Such a great location and everything was perfect. Would definitely stay here when we visit again 😊

The rooms that Newtopique have are absolutely beautiful -- extremely high ceilings, clean, comfortable, well stocked.  Most of  the buildings in Florence are very old and so natural lighting is something that could be better, but that's what you get with being in a historic place like Florence!

We loved our stay! Great for our family, including a young toddler, with plenty of space to move around. We especially loved the neighborhood and the lovely patio in the evenings. Would recommend for anyone!

We had the best stay, it was in such a convenient location and the double paned windows made it very quiet for how central it was.
It was beautifully decorated. We really enjoyed the terrace. The kitchen has everything. Comfortable beds and the AC was life saving. Would stay again!
We had an excellent stay. The location was perfect, the apartment immaculate and all amenities provided were fantastic. I highly recommend this apartment.

Stayed 4 nights & was absolutely amazing. Walking distance to everything. Just be mindful that there are 3 flights of stairs to get to the apartment but it's worth it! Once you are up there the view is just Wow - Amazing! Margherita was very responsive & very easy to deal with.
A wonderful place - even better than the pictures. Great location, very comfortable and quiet. Loved waking up and having coffee while enjoying beautiful views across the city!

Newtopique’s apartment was amazing! To start, it was stunning with super high ceilings and beautiful finishes! The apartment is also in a great area and walking distance to all the sites you’ll want to see! The staff was super responsive and helpful during checkin and let us drop off our luggage in advance!
We would come back to this Airbnb over and over. We could have stayed a month. There was plenty of room for the whole family.

Adelaide & Francesca were excellent hosts!  They were very responsive and provided local restaurant and shopping recommendations.  The apartment is beautiful, just like the photos.  We wish we could have stayed longer and would definitely recommend.

Excellent apartment in the heart of Florence. This was the perfect place for our family of five. We enjoyed having a seating for our family and a big tv for us to gather and watch a movie together at night.
The place was the perfect location for walking around Florence. It was clean and the host provided excellent communication. Highly recommend!

Thank you Adélaïde & Francesca - we had a wonderful time and were so impressed with the beautiful apartment and incredible location. Even better than the pictures. Clear communication and hospitality throughout our stay, and we will definitely recommend to others visiting Florence!

Wonderful stay! Adélaïde & Francesca were very friendly and helpful, The location was close enough to restaurants and in walking distance to most attractions. Highly recommend this host and their apartment.
I would stay here again.   And I would recommend it to others.   Beautiful living room and great location.

It was the perfect location.
We were in walking distance to everything we wanted to see.
We enjoyed everything about it. Our only complaint were the mosquitoes. We were aware about mosquitoes before booking.

One of the best Airbnbs we’ve ever stayed in! The apartment is in the perfect location, across the river but just a few minutes walk to the Florence train station, the Duomo, the Ponte Vecchio, and more restaurants than you could possibly go to in one trip. It’s also near a wine bar and wine window! The home itself is historic but so comfortable, the beds are soft and the ACs work great! We’d love to stay here again!
Wonderful AirBnB in the center of Florence. We felt very comfortable and would choose this place again any time we come back. Just be aware that there are a few stairs to climb.

The Flat was just as described. It was clean and had a great view of the Duomo from one of the bedroom windows. The kitchen was great and there was lots of seating. Lots of storage and good amenities. The only thing I would be weary of is that it is on the third floor with no lift. Other than that we had a lovely stay, Thanks you!

The apartment was perfect for our stay and had everything we needed. Beds were comfortable, everything was clean and the location was very convenient. There were a lot of stairs to get to the apartment on the 3rd floor but once our bags were up, we got used to them!

Loved Margherita’s Firenze apartment! Very clean, beds are so comfy and the air conditioning is next level good and there’s one in each room. The stairs are very hard to climb, 3 floors of steep steps, easy going down, hard coming up especially after a day of walking around, drinking and eating but probably good exercise and just a small thing, could you please get a non slip shower mat for the bath tub, when having a shower the bath was really slippy and I slipped a couple of times, I was ok and thankfully I had the first shower but my mum is almost 60 and if she had slipped she could have really hurt herself or worse if she fell out of the bathtub since it has no walls or anything to hold onto when having a shower.

On a recent trip to Florence, my extended family of six needed a comfortable place to stay for a two-night visit—and this home exceeded all our expectations. The location is about a 20-minute walk from the train station, which made it easy to reach. Since we arrived early, we used Luggit to store our bags and it worked flawlessly—we simply dropped them off with a representative at a nearby hotel and were free to start exploring the city without hassle.
The home itself was fantastic. It’s incredibly spacious—perfect for our group. My parents had plenty of room to relax, and the twin room was ideal for my daughters. The real luxury, though, was having three full bathrooms and an additional half bath—it made a huge difference with six people!
My only regret is that we didn’t have more time to enjoy the house. I would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone traveling to Florence with a group.

This place is an absolute gem. The space had everything we needed to feel at home. The hosts were extremely communicative and sweet. The location is perfect with a beautiful piazza right around the corner and all the shops and restaurants you’d need. It’s just far away enough from city center for some peacefulness, but everything is only a short walk away. If you’re very sensitive to sound when sleeping, be mindful when staying anywhere in Florence. Check in was easy and the app made it very easy to get in and out of the apartment. Could not recommend this place enough! Perfezione!
This apartment is in a great location in Florence, the owners are so helpful and always responsive to questions. The apartment was clean and perfect for our stay. We hope to return soon!

The apartment is place in a great location, which allows to be in the center of the city in just a couple of minutes. Although cleaning wasn’t flawless, it wasn’t a major problem either. It is listed at a very reasonable price. They always answer my questions and had the nice detail of receiving us with a bottle of wine.
We had a great time during our stay, so I completely recommend it :)
Great apartment in a great location. It’s a little smaller than the photos but since we were in such a good location we were always out exploring.

It was a perfect stay for our family. Easy check-in and check-out and the Hosts were always available for any questions. We received all the essential communication ahead of time to prepare our trip to Florence.
The apartment is in a great location of the city.
What a wonderful apartment, great location and super responsive host!  They checked in on us a couple of times and was so helpful for all things!  You won’t be disappointed!
Apartment was very clean and well located! Very easy to get around but not on such a busy street that it was too noisy.

Very special place to stay at, and the location is perfect. You can walk everywhere you would want to, you're around the corner from the river and there are fabulous places to eat and drink virtually next door. The apartment has everything you need and there is a very useful information binder with local information and tips. The apartment is above one of the only parking garages in Florence so I would say if you're a light sleeper then bring earplugs as sound did travel up, but other than that opening up the shuttered windows and looking down into a small, cobbled alleyway of Florence was stunning.  As it says in the listing, you will need access to the internet on your phone to access the doors to get into the building but Barbara is extremely helpful if you need help with that. We really enjoyed our stay, thank you!
We had a wonderful stay at Barbara’s apartment.  She was very responsive to our needs.  We would stay here again and recommend her place to anyone traveling to Florence.
The stay was amazing! Apartment is in good central quiet place. The apartment is big and includes everything what Christina wrote in description. Thank you very much ❤️
A very clean, spacious place. Easy and flexible check-in. Good distance from the main atractions, quiet, but also close to everything.
amazing apartment, super clean, clean, clean!!! too bad, we only stayed for the night.

Excellent location right in the middle of everything. Great food options nearby. Good sized room, adequate common rooms and responsive host. Generally noisy (as explained in the description) but more than offset by location for us.
great location if you're trying to see the city. You are at proximity of everything, including public transportation.

such helpful and attentive hosts. Had an amazing time and felt so at home in the air bnb. such an amazing place especially for the price. despite being on such a busy street the room itself was quiet and i was able to sleep perfectly every night. highly recommend. Super central location , right in the heart of everything

We greatly enjoyed our stay at Angelo’s home and especially loved the location. The room was clean, spacious  and comfortable, and placed in the centre of attractions. This room is perfect for a lively stay in Florence.

Very cute place. Near to a lot of authentic local Italian restaurant. Everything is walkable distance. Lorenzo respond to msg really quick. The only thing is the bed is not really comfortable for us but if you are good with hard bed then no problemo.
We had a really good time!

Nice place and good location but it is a PRIVATE ROOM in a shared space. One other room and each has its own bathroom, but they are both disconnected from the rooms. Not a big deal but just a heads up if you like your privacy. Lorenzo is very quick and attentive and great pizza place just down the street.

Lorenzo's apartment is nice and cozy, there is everything you need. Great location- all major Florence landmarks are in walking distance from the building, with eateries and supermarket close by too. Lorenzo was responsive throughout and gave us local recommendations too.
Lorenzo’s place was very nice and we felt right at home !! I would definitely recommend staying here !!
Everything is great, good location nice rooms clean. Bathroom of the green room is a little outdated but otherwise very nice.
My stay here was ok. I have a problem but lorenzo was able to solve it. I will be honest, the place need some maintenance. recommended for short stays.

Great place. Our host was very accommodating, she let us check out late which was very much appreciated. She also gave good local recommendations and responded to us very quickly. I would recommend the place to anyone who wants to be in a great area, with a great host.

Great location. Outdoor space is great. Inside space is smaller than expected. We found it a bit cluttered with a lots of personal stuffs that are dusty.
Recommend if travelling alone but not good for family especially with a baby and kids

The apartment is in a great location and the outdoor patio is spacious. but as previous guests noted, the place is filled with a lot of random clutter and is a small studio (not a one bedroom) — the bed is a sleeper sofa that takes up a lot of the space when expanded. i think the photos could be updated for accuracy.
some nice touches to consider adding for future guests: a printed guide to the apartment and neighborhood, a paper towel roll, a clean sponge between guests, making sure salt is replenished. decluttering would make a significant difference. i would stay in this neighborhood again, but not at this apartment.
Excellent flat in the heart of Florence. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend. Annie was a great host!
Location is fantastic. The twin beds are very narrow (smaller than North American twin beds) and VERY noisy. The washing machine stopped working while we were there.

Lovely spot for a short exploration of Florence. The location is perfect, if you want to find local cafes and small stores, parks and other slightly less touristic attractions. Even though everything is pretty close in Florence :)
The place had everything. Hamilton was very easy to communicate with and his hospitality surprised us multiple times while enjoying our stay ☺️
Great location and close to everything. Easy check in and responsive the whole time. Apartment had everything we needed!

The airbnb is quite good. The location is easy to find and near the tram station, also walkable to popular tourist attractions. The host is really nice, supportive and always respond to us very quick. Everything about our room is great, we all satisfied during our stay in Florence☺️

The location of the apartment is unbeatable. It is surrounded by some of the best cafes, restaurants and bars.  It's a bit away from the touristy mess but still very close to everything.  The apartment is great. I had originally booked the apartment with the terrace but before I arrived, the boiler in that apartment broke so Mirko and Katrina offered me the apartment just next door with a discount. It was great!   Very clean, has everything you need.  Mirko has been very responsive so it's been a pleasure all around.  Highly recommend.

We loved staying in Mirko’s condo! The views were stunning, the neighborhood was quiet but a short walk from all the major sights, and he was a great host! From check-in to check-out he was quick to respond and met us in person to get us into the condo and give some recommendations for the city. Would highly recommend!

This is a nice spot — the location is excellent, surrounded by restaurants and shops, and the apartment is spacious.
It’s just across the river from the most busy tourist areas, but only a 15 min walk to the packed center of Florence. It faces the river (so quieter than if it faced the street). I’m told locals generally live on this side of the river, but there’s definitely a lot for visitors here (like one of the most popular gelato spots about a block away). Balcony was very nice, can see a lot of historic buildings from it.
There was a washer in the unit too, which was great. Bed was comfortable. While the location is very quiet, I visited in late June and needed the AC unit to sleep, which goes on and off in a somewhat dramatic fashion. So light sleepers may want earplugs in summer months.
This was a wonderful place to stay (for the neighborhood and the residence) - Mirko made check in a breeze and the whole thing made for a great experience . Would recommend!
Great place, large space, terrace was beautiful with beautiful view.  Great eating places very close.  Easy to walk every, great location.

Mirko was a great host. He was accommodating and communicative around check in time and early bag drop off. The house book had great local restaurant recommendations. The linens were crisp and the bed was comfortable. We found this place to be more well insulated from the sound of the bells than another location we visited in Florence. The balcony is large and the view is good!

Perfect spot for our trip to Florence. The apartment is located in a cool neighbourhood with shops, restaurants and cafes at every corner.  Katya and Mirko were amazing hosts and arranged a taxi for our early morning flight.  Highly recommend!!

The apartment is amazing! Lovely, traditional Italian decor with everything you need. The terrace was a lovely addition too - great for enjoying a morning coffee or evening drink! Lots of nice bars and restaurants around, and a short walk to the main attractions of Florence. Thanks for a great stay!
Very hospitable and helpful host. Very easy to communicate with and the place is very clean and good size.
Spacious and superb location. Clean, bright & airy. Would highly recommend and stay again. East check in and responsive communication from host. Sean

We stayed for two days and highly recommend this wonderful flat centrally located in the historical center of Firenze. The flat itself is so nice with nice open sitting areas and plenty of place to relax. Airconditioning in all bedrooms keep the cool on hot summer days. Lucia even surprised us with sparkling wine and some snack - all free of charge.
We would love to stay here again the next time we visit Firenze.

Super clean and spacious airbnb home located in great proximity to everything in Florence. Would 100% stay again.
Lucia was very communicative and very speedy to answer any questions we had. The home was in very great condition :)

We had a great stay at Lucia’s place! It was spacious with a perfect location – walkable to so many tourist attractions! Lucia was an amazing host. She was very responsive and friendly with helpful recommendations. We loved the gelato she advised us to try! In fact, she gives an entire book of her suggestions.
The only real downside was that because the apartment is so big, the back of the apartment (the bedroom with the larger bed frame) didn’t get as cool as the rest of the space. Otherwise we loved our stay!
This apartment is far more spacious than what it appears to be in pictures. It’s in an amazing neighborhood with a lively nightlife but walkable to the center of Florence.

Lucia is wonderful and very accommodating.  She had something fixed while we were there that I had brought to her attention. Apartment is in a great location. Sometimes a bit noisy at night from people walking down the street but that is pretty typical for the cities. There is a large fan in one bedroom that makes great white noise for lighter sleepers. Would stay here again for sure.

Our stay at Lucia’s apartment was just perfect. We booked it based on the excellent reviews and central location and were not disappointed. Although there are a lot of stairs to climb to reach the apartment, we were aware of this and it wasn’t a problem for us. However it is something to be aware of!
The apartment was spotlessly clean, the beds were comfortable with nice pillows and there was nothing that we needed that wasn’t provided. Staying at the apartment with two teenage girls, it was perfect that the two bedrooms were at either end of the apartment so they could chat away at night without disturbing us.
The location of the apartment is perfect as all the main sights are in easy walking distance.
We would recommend staying here and rate Lucia very highly as a host. Thank you for a wonderful stay in beautiful Florence!
great apartment walking distance from bars and restaurants, the patio/private garden is amazing and the hosts are quick to respond to any query. we would definitely stay again.
The apartment was clean and huge! Marco was a great host and gave us great recommendations on where to eat. We enjoyed our time here!
Spacious apartment in an interesting but central area with the added bonus of outside space. Would recommend😀

A beautiful home in a great location, the patio outside was perfect for late night talking and watching the sunset. Marco was a very friendly host with some great recommendations for the area, Osteria del Giglio was a wonderful restaurant. Thank you!
Great place, comfortable and spacious.  Lucia is an excellent host.  The place has everything you need and she even left us drinks and snacks.  Highly recommend!
Nice place in a great neighborhood. And Lucia was super communicative and responsive.  Would definitely stay here again!

The property was way nicer than the pictures and what we expected. Had an extra bedroom, high ceilings, and overall incredible. A little sad that there was no dryer but I understand that is Italian culture
The property was clean and it was at the heart of the city . Everything was nearby and it was a wonderful stay .
Silvia was a great host and provided us with many recommendations of things to do in the area. She was also flexible with early check in/arrival and was very responsive

Fantastic location right in the heart of Florence.
Silvia was an excellent hostess, her communication was very prompt and helpful.
Highly recommend
Elena’s apartment was very central. We could walk to all of the ‘must visits’. Elena’s communication was great. A comfortable, safe and clean place to stay.
Elenas apartment was great, super clean and had everything we needed. The location was fantastic, within a 2 min walk from the Duomo and Piazza Republica. Would love to come back and stay here again.

The location of this apartment was incredible. We couldn’t have been happier. We were literally 10-15 minutes max from walk from absolutely anything we wanted to see and do. The apartment was in the heart of the shopping district and allowed us to feel so very safe as two women travelling solo. We loved the food options, coffee options and overall made our stay in Florence perfect!

Beautiful location to Duomo, gellato shops and wonderful restuarants. For an added charge, you can enter location an 1.5 hours earlier if family arrives before you.  Elena was very reliable and provided guidance to navigate with ease in this beautiful city.
Great location about a block from the Duomo and action, but yet very quiet apartment for sleeping.  Elena was agreat communicator, and everything was great!
Wonderful stay, perfect location in the middle of everything yet quiet at night. Hosts were very communicative and helpful, and very accommodating for our toddler.
Magical place at great location! We are all hoping to come back soon and stay here again!

The apartment exceeded our expectations. The location was fantastic, with easy access to restaurants and local attractions. The apartment itself was spacious and comfortably accommodated our group of four. Edoardo and Michela were incredibly responsive, ensuring that our stay was smooth and enjoyable.
Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a great stay in the area!

Loved Florence and our AirBnB! We had a great experience with this professional company, MMega Homes and Villas as opposed to my previous stay in Florence 2 years ago through Expedia which was a disaster when the rental company would not come and help when the electricity fuse blew out for 2 days in 40 degrees weather. Needless to say, will never book with the previous rental company and will seek out the services of this one in our future visits to Florence! Until next time - arrivederci! :)
A great location close to all the tourist attractions. Everything was walkable distance so we loved where we stayed!
Lorenzo’s place is beautiful and close to the downtown area. He was very friendly and accommodating. Thank you for our stay, we enjoyed it thoroughly!

The place gives privacy, tranquility and easy access to the street.  Lorenzo was very flexible with the check-in time, many thanks to his father for waiting for us.  Incredible how close the apartment is to everything.  I'm leaving in love with Florence, I can't wait to return.
Lorenzo is very accommodating and kind. He went over and above to meet our needs. Very close and walk able to all the attractions . I highly recommend Lorenzo’s flat.

Guys, in one word they are amazing hosts! they took care of everything! the check in was smooth, booked us taxi, responded to every text, helped plan the trip! If i ever came to Florence again... I'd for sure rent their place!! they rock and made our stay perfect!
thank you both
The apartment was perfect for our family of 4. Great location and accommodations. Thank you to Samuel & Paolo for being wonderful hosts.

This apartment was perfection! All new and sparking clean, this apartment has everything you could wish for. Tucked away in an adorable alley very near Ponte  Vecchio, this apartment is close to restaurants, shopping and major attractions. Don’t bother looking anywhere else. This is the one!
Lovely apartment in the heart of Firenze, two steps (literally) from Ponte Vecchio. Modern, clean, newly furnished, and communication was easy, Samuel waited for us by the door upon arrival. Top!
We felt very comfortable and safe. Roberta was so kind and available if we needed her. The location is perfect, too. The clothes washer really came in handy during our stay.
Excellent location! Walking distance from the train station and to all of the places we wanted to see in our short stay. Great places to eat around every corner.
Lorenzo ans Roberta were both friendly and responsive hosts. Apartment was comfortable and as described.
Great location for visiting all the sites of Cento during the day and the eateries of Oltrarno at night. Walkable to most everywhere.
Loved that the rental was so close and walkable to all of Florence .  Great nearby restaurants.  So enjoyed our time in Florence!

Yes, stay here!   The location is so convenient for all the main tourist sights.  Our checkin was so easy and the information provided was great.  He even indulged me by letting me speak in my basic Italian!   It was really surprising how very quiet the apartment is, even with the location being a hub of activity.  I highly recommend!

We were so thankful to be able to stay for only one night after an unplanned flight cancellation. This apartment was beyond wonderful! We loved everything about it and it was spotlessly clean…very comfortable beds.
Only thing lacking were wine glasses. But we made do, and it was just a wonderful stay.

Wonderful place to stay…great location.
Samuel & Paolo were extremely helpful. Fortunately, we had no problems so we did not have to contact them. Highly recommend this beautiful apartment
A great place to stay and walk everywhere. Perfecto. Would stay there again. The location is perfect.

Amazing host and location modern and clean.
The only thing id recommend is sound proofing street windows as the noise of people sirens cars trucks etc was loud .well for us anyway .thanks for hosting us

Thank you for the stay! Mariah Chiara is a good host, the apartment needs some work though, there is leaking in the bathroom near the toilet (the one that is in the bedroom). During summer, it’s a perfect stay, the apartment is nice and cold.

Chiara was a wonderful host!  It felt like I was talking with an old friend from day one.  She was incredibly responsive to my needs and questions.  This huge apartment is just like it is shown in the pictures.  (The frescos are so neat!!)  The bed in the master bedroom is very comfortable.  I can’t speak about the other bedrooms, as I traveled solo.  I loved the kitchen, and I was able to save quite a bit by preparing most of my own meals.  The apartment location is excellent.  It’s an easy walk to most key sites, and numerous bus transportation options are available nearby for longer trips.  The area is very safe and I felt very comfortable walking home alone late at night after concerts or shows.  All in all, a great place to stay!

Maria Chiara's lovely home was the perfect place to stay in Florence!  Everything was in walking distance.  While the streets around are noisy and busy, this street is a quiet haven, including a lovely back courtyard.
Great communication, smooth check in, very nice apartment! Walking distance to coffee shops, restaurants and main sights! Thank you so much for accomodating some special requests!
Great location and. good value. A bit noisy at night. Driving to garage a bit tricky but doable

Excellent location and well equipped kitchen for cooking at home.  Has a washer/dryer which is handy if you are staying for extended time.  Fabulous coffee shop across the road  for your morning espresso and breakfast and just around the corner from Santo Spirito Piazza.  Lots of food options on this side of the Arno.  The bed is up against the wall which I couldn’t quite see from the photos and was difficult for me to navigate my way out of in the night.
Good Location, Very nice place, responsive host! However, be weary of the noise on the street at night as you can hear it when you’re sleeping!! Great place though!

The location was convenient and the space had potential, but unfortunately, my experience was impacted by a few issues. Communication was slow when I needed help early in my stay, and I found hair in the sheets, which made me question the cleanliness. With better responsiveness and attention to detail in cleaning, this could have been a much better experience.

The apartment is clean, tidy and in a walking distance from must see locations.
Good breakfast and dinner places in the area as well as fresh fruits and veggies street stand.
The place was just as described.  Loved the high ceilings and the beautiful patio.  Would definitely stay here again!

Beautiful apartment in a great location off of the main tourist areas but totally walkable. Some great restaurants and pastry shops around the corner. Definitely want to come back! Eugenio and Marta were lovely and super knowledgeable of the area.
Grazie mille.

The location was great as it was near the central station and close to many museums and things to do! The area felt safe and was very walkable, within distance to many different sites! Alberto was very accommodating and helpful throughout our stay. Would definitely return! Thanks so much.
Alberto was so friendly!! And waited for us past 12 am to check in, he is very good with communication, would def stay here again!

Alberto's place was perfect. Just as described, clean, and a short walking distance to all the sites. Close to restaurants, and coffee shops. Alberto met us in person at the studio. He was very friendly, responsive, and gave suggestions about places to eat and visit. Truly recommended!

Alberto’s place is a few steps away from the central station. It is also located in walkable distance from many attractions and restaurants/cafés. Alberto is kind and always ready to help and accommodate.

A very peaceful flat in a great location, you can walk everywhere. I can recommend this for a lovely stay in the hear of Florence.
The only problem for me were the 3 keys & locks that I found a bit difficult to use - I'm used to Abloy locks and keys.

Great location, all the sightseeing within a walkable distance.
Train station 7 min
Duomo 10 min
Local market 3 min
Pitti palace is around 1 mile away
Great restaurants and bars around.
Highly recommended.
We loved our stay here! Location can not be beat right next to the duomo. Walked to and from the train station upon arrival and departure. Would absolutely stay here again!

No words…this is one of the BEST places i’ve ever stayed at. If you are going to Florence and this is available — look no more and book!
Amazing location, incredible space + view and awesome hosts.
I will definitely be coming back!
Wonderful home! Loved the location and how well decorated it was! Thank you for opening it up for our Florence get away!
Amazing location - central to everything. Such a nice apartment, and Claudio & Valeria were so communicative and easy to reach. The terrace was an added bonus!
