We loved our stay at Claudio & Valeria’s apartment. The apartment was exactly as pictured in the online photos. Lovely light filled apartment .. great to sip wine on the terrace on the patio !

Fantastic location to walk and explore Florence. Yes, there are stairs to get to apartment, but worth the view and we knew to pack light for Italy. Our group of 5 adults were happy to get some clothes washed, and relax after hours of exploring. Having 2 sets of keys and the lock box was a plus for our group doing different activities. What a wonderful view off the balcony. We would definitely stay here again.
Thank you.

What a beautiful balcony! The picturesque view of the basilica of Santa Croce felt like a wall paper. Definitely an amazing view to wake up to and stare out at night.
If you are a light sleeper, however, keep in mind that the place also comes with some noises from the plaza. There were some rowdy crowds late at night during our stay and the windows didn’t help that much.
Other than that, the location was great. Everything was in walkable distance and our host was super responsive and helpful!
This apartment has an amazing view and is in a great location for exploring Florence.  Checking in and out was easy and Claudio and Valeria were responsive and easy to deal with.

The hosts communicated very well. The place is tastefully decorated. Towels are good quality and large enough. The nightlife and amazing tuscan dining was basically right at our doorstep.
See you again soon, Italy.

Spotless.
The view was great but there will be loudness all night and early morning. It should be expected. It’s a very public place you are a part of. 😊

Even though we only stayed one night, we certainly enjoyed our visit to Florence. Staying in such a special artist loft was a treat. The view was spectacular and the location is perfect
The place is arty yet still clean and modern would highly recommend
Wonderful home with great views. The hosts were easy to work with and responsive. If ever in town again I would absolutely stay here again.
Great stay friendly host with clear instructions. Walkable location as well with endless food options nearby which is always a plus.
What a great place, great location. Had all you need and really quiet. Thanks very much I would definitely stay again.
Clean place. Great bath and Bed. Getting in feels like an escape room, but you're given all the answers. I'd definitely come here again.
Very nice place in a very nice city. Being able to store bags after check out was a big plus.

Felt right at home at Elio’s place. He was very responsive to all my needs and questions. The location was also very close and walkable to many of the restaurants and attractions that many visitors will want to visit. Would absolutely stay here again.
Great studio apartment close to the main station and other amenities. Very clean and had everything we needed during our short stay.

If this place is available... BOOKED IT!!
Location is great- 10 min walking from the Cathedral but the best is that is full of locals, so you get to experience what living in Florence could be. Restaurants and caffe around the corner. Top Marks!
The Flat itself has been refurbished to a very high standard, is even better in person than in the pictures. The original ceiling is stunning, make you feel you are staying in one of the Grand houses of Florence.
And what to say about The Patio and Terrace. Beautiful and relaxing and a great place to have a coffee, to read or chat.
And Marusca is amazing , such an upbeat and happy character. She was very communicative and helpful.
You won't regret booking Marusca's place.

The apartment is very clean and new. The location is great, it is close to everything and quiet. The host is very accommodating, responsive and caring. I will definitely recommend to family and friends!
It was a great stay at Eliot’s’  Just wish there was latte for coffee and a few snacks.

Marusca’s place is exactly as described and shown in photos. Actually, even better than the photos! She is an amazing host and helped with so many local recos, maps and other tidbits . The location itself was central and walking distance to many eateries , shopping and the central town square. The home was tastefully done up and spotlessly clean and also very well equipped - esp the kitchen and the bathrooms. The private garden was so pretty with the synagogue in the backdrop. Really enjoyed the stay and would recommend any day! Thankyou, Marusca :)
Loved the location. Great market and restaurants nearby. Easy walk to center of town. Great, responsive host. Really enjoyed this place

We have never been to Italy but I’m so glad we stayed here. It was amazing. Very comfortable and roomy. Coming from the states i was worried about size but we thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We will be back to stay here!

Marusca was a truly amazing host and wonderful person. Her attention to detail is second to none and she will look after you. Her recommendations were perfect and we felt she really cares about us having the best experience in Florence that we could. We will definitely be staying here again and would highly recommend it to anybody staying in Florence :)
Very nice apartment with two beautiful outdoor courtyards within walking distance to all the main attractions. Nice restaurants in the neighborhood.
Great place, great host.  Marusca went above and beyond,  even took our laundry to dry when the dryer wasn’t working!
The place was even more beautiful than the pictures.  Very quiet neighborhood with amazing restaurants and shopping.  Loved it and would highly recommend.
We loved it!  Two outdoor areas to enjoy.  Walkable to great restaurants and easy to get around. Thank you for a great stay!

Staying in this home was an absolute dream! It is spacious, clean, and so beautiful. The finishes and details in the home are astonishing, and the courtyard and garden are the most perfect outdoor spaces. The location was fantastic and Marusca is such an amazing host with the best recommendations of what to do, what to see and what to eat in the surrounding area. She made us feel at home. Would absolutely recommend staying here!

Lovely stay In Cinzia’s. She was very responsive. The place was lovely and perfect location: in a quiet area and a few minutes walk from the centre, ideal. Lovely restaurants around! Would recommend the stay! Thanks Cinzia.
Nice apartment in a neighbourhood full of great food and drink. Easily walkable to all main city attractions. Would stay again!
Super cute, clean apartment. Location is very pleasant, close to attractions but less crowded. Instructions and getting in was very straightforward.

Staying at this Airbnb was an absolute delight we had an amazing experience! Maurizio was incredibly friendly and welcoming, making sure that everything was in order for our stay. The apartment itself was beautiful and well-maintained, with all the amenities we needed. The location was also fantastic, with easy access to public transportation and plenty of shops and restaurants nearby. Overall, I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient place to stay in Florence.
Great place to stay with a walkable distance to the center. Peaceful area with barely any noise coming from the street!
The place is around 1.5 kms from the centre and was walkable. The river is just outside the apartment.

Fael was an amazing host. Had suggestions for restaurants and sights. The apartment was quiet and private. With easy access to public transportation and the main square. Would definitely stay my next trip.
We have a lovely few days in Florence at Alessias Airbnb. It has everything we needed and more and just outside the centre so it was easy for us to get around

Giorgio is a fantastic host. made me and my daughter feel welcome from the moment we arrived. he was there every morning to make coffees and offer breakfast before going out exploring. offered advice on places to visit and good restaurants. the location is perfect, 2 mins walk from the Tram stop and 10 minutes from the city center. you can see clearly that Giorgio really embraces and enjoys hosting guests in his home and nothing is too much trouble for him. I would 💯 stay here again if I return to Florence.
Great location, very fresh and clean with hotel-feeling. Giorgio is a attentive and helpful host, be ready for lots of conversation

Giorgio was the best! Went out of his way to make us comfortable. Highly recommended. Great coffee!!! Breakfast is also included (croissants, cookies). Very clean room with complete amenities. Near the tram station, with a big supermarket nearby

We had a very pleasant stay here in Florence! The apartment was spotless and only a 15 min tram ride from the city center. The host was super nice and prepared breakfast for us every morning. If we were to come back to Florence we would definitely stay here again!

Overall, the place was very spacious and clean. It is located a stones-throw from the cathedral and many delicious restaurants. With that said, we had a very hard time locating the building (multiple same building numbers) and corresponding shops next to each, creating several messages back and forth with the host. Once inside, we struggled to locate the unit as it’s mentioned being on floor 2, which is really floor 3. After many steps, and you don’t have the key yet to activate the elevator, it was a lot after a full day of traveling. The AC also wasn’t working, so the only chance of cooling down the unit was by opening all the windows. The host was responsive, but we didn’t see the AC fixed during our stay. No checkout instructions as well.
Very well located in the eastern edge of the historical centre. A beautiful apartment with responsive and helpful hosts!
It is very well located, you get to the dome in les then 15 min. The apartment is very spacious and comfortable.
very nice apartment in good neighborhood. we had a very good stay. only small remark: due to the small street and the not so isolated windows it was quite noisy in the bedroom.
I stayed 5 months in this apartment as a student. It was fantastic, bigger than it looks, lots of room, natural light & very practical. Great host & lovely cleaner.
This room is special with two porches. Besides the location is near to the museum and church. I strongly recommend this house.

We loved our stay at Silvia’s beautiful house in Florence. Entire place was incredibly clean and central location to everything. Silvia also provided great recommendations, many which we utilised. Highly recommend and if we are ever back in Florence we wouldn’t hesitate to stay again. Tao & Joelle
The walls where all dirty the floors where dirty and the laundry room was FULL of MOLD there was paint peeling off the ceiling

The location of the unit was close to the area where our tours were taking place. The unit was what we expected but the noise coming from the street and restaurants located downstairs from the unit refrained us from sleeping till approximately 2 am.

We had a great stay. It was clean, great location, working air conditioning, and Wi-Fi. The hosts were extremely responsive with our questions. We were a 1 minute walk from the Duomo and close to many great restaurants and the things Firenze has to offer. Most importantly - we felt very safe in and around the apartment. We would absolutely stay here again.
My only comment is that the room looked a lot larger in the pictures, however this was not an issue for us as we were only two people. It may be a little tight trying to accommodate more people at once.
Great host and great stay! Just a few meters from the main Cathedral and close to just about everything!

The place was as listed, clean, working AC and it was close to the train station.
There were even 3 luggage drop of places just at the corner, the hotel had the best rates and felt very safe.

Perfect location, near the station (3 min walk). Good size, very comfortable bed. Very responsive and friendly hosts. As mentioned there’s many narrow stairs so only if you’re abled - to book here.
Just note that the place was very dark, only the lamps worked in the bedroom / living area… Not bright as pictured.
So close to everything! Great space- washer and dryer was great to have in the middle of our trip through Italy.

Great place for one ore two people, super clean, great location, just lacks a little of natural light, keep in mind that the bathroom it’s a little tight and there’s not much flexibility at the check in time

Great location near a lot of good food and attractions, particular the Duomo. Responsive host. I read other reviews before booking that said it was hard to find, but I found it incredibly easy.
Two downsides (which were not worth removing a star): the sink drained extremely slowly so we could only use it a little bit at a time, and the clothes dryer didn't dry our clothes (although that may have been user error; we're Americans in Italy for the first time).

We loved our stay! The location was perfect! Walking distance to everything and super easy to go back to our room in between activities. The in unit washer and dryer was incredibly helpful! The place was beautiful with everything you could need. Wish we could have stayed longer!

Great place to stay in place proximity of the station, very convenient for taking trains in and out of Florence. Walkable to everywhere in the city, and had a lovely bathroom. The only thing I would say is that lighting was poor in the apartment, and the AC unit wasn’t very effective. Still, a good location/place to stay. Thank you
Was so comfortable and matched exactly the pics and description, would highly recommend. An extra blanket would be nice to have just in case someone feels chilly at night.

Great location, easy walk to everything. This is a 3rd floor studio apartment with no elevator.
Do turn the lights on to go up the stairs (we didn’t at first, thought we had to use our phone flashlights).
Great location, minutes away from the cathedral. Ticked away on the side street allowing for some privacy and less noise. Very responsive host with clear instructions. 10/10 would recommend.
Very lovely apartment near the duomo. The apartment was a bit smaller than it initially looked in the photos but overall very nice and clean place.
Great location!  Easy to get to from the train station and also easy to get to the center.  Photos for self check-in were very helpful.

The space was absolutely perfect here to see lots of sites, and it placed us right in the middle of everything great food, great museums great architecture loved every minute of this space, including the unique charm of the open ceiling and a comfy bed
Federico was good with communicating, the accommodation was clean, big, and has everything you need. Privacy was good.  I recommend this place completely!
Comfy home to explore or workation! Nice kitchen and dining space to cook and talk with other guests.
A must must stay. The location is perfect. The house is beyond perfect and the hosts a too kind and accommodating.

Lovely apartment right beside the tram. Only a couple of stops on the tram to the city centre. It was also easy to walk but we wanted to save our energy for wondering around Florence. The apartment was spacious and well appointed. Great communication and lots of wonderful recommendations for food.

Such a great stay at this apartment. Great location and right by the Tram station which helps you get near the Duomo in ten minutes otherwise can walk and be there within 25 minutes. Hostess was great and very responsive to all my questions and had great recommendations. The place was very clean and comfortable. Each bathroom was supplied with toiletries. Beds were very comfortable as well. Slept well but for two nights there were some young people who were loud within the building. Would definitely stay here again in the future
Sal was wonderful at check in and with questions after! The home is right near a tram stop with easy access to the city center. Recommendations were great!
Linda’s place is beautiful and stylish. Location was great and allowed us to explore all the best parts of Florence. Linda was also very kind and helpful with anything we needed :)

We are so happy to have such a nice time in Florence. Linda is so responsible and provided very clear instructions for us to walk around. We are so glad to stay in a sweet and warm house. We got everything in the house. It is also quite convenient that we could go to all of the tourist spots on foot. We will recommend our friends to the house if they go to Florence!

The apartment is so charming and located in a quiet neighbourhood that is walkable to the historical centre. Linda was a fantastic host and super helpful with great restaurant recommendations. We would definitely stay again!

Linda checked me in personally and walked me through the apartment to ensure a comfortable stay. She is very kind and gracious and welcomed me like a friend.  The apartment is strategically located in my favorite neighborhood of Santo Espirito with all the amenities and some extras (coffee pods are appreciated). The squeaky clean apartment looked much better than the pictures on the listing, especially the panoramic view from the balcony. I am already planning my next stay at Linda’s apartment. What a great find.
fabulous place, fabulous host, checked in on me during bad weather and suggested local places to eat and of interest. fantastic  place

Delightful apartment, neighborhood with great places to eat. and a wonderful grocery store. Our host, Linda, was very responsive & flexible with check in. I would highly recommend Linda's apartment. The kitchen was perfect for our needs; the entire apartment was perfect.

We had an incredible stay at Linda's apartment. It is a beautifully decorated and spacious home, spotlessly cleaned, and very well equipped with a kitchen and washing machine. We very much appreciated the style and aesthetic of the apartment. The area is very quiet yet in walking distance to the center. There is a great gelato place really close by that has to be mentioned, "La Sorbettiera", that really made our trip that much more special.
Thank you Linda for your great recommendations and your flexibility, you also really helped us make our travels possible. I would recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Florence and would be happy to return when I travel back there!

We had a wonderful 5 day stay in Linda's apartment. Linda was  an amazing host, going out of her way to  recommend local restaurants and places of interest. The apartment was beautiful with everything we needed. Breakfast on  the balcony was a real treat.The air conditioning was essential, the coffee was an added bonus! Would thoroughly recommend this wonderful place.

LOVED our stay here. Beautiful neighbourhood and the apartment felt like a home away from home. Ivana was an amazing host - excellent recommendations and helped us out when we needed it.
We can’t wait to come back!

Ivana is a top notch host. She made us feel very welcomed and at home. We never felt that we were bothering her, even though she had to call us a taxi numerous times. She was so patient. The apartment was beautifully decorated, well stocked with everything we needed, and spotless! I highly recommend this apartment and host. Additionally, Ivana's English is excellent. 😊 Grazie mille, Ivana!

Ivana is truly a Superhost. She definitely made our trip better with her attentiveness, helpful suggestions, and willingness to go above and beyond,
The apartment is also very nice: clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. Everything worked perfectly during our stay, and the space had all the essentials we needed. The location is excellent, with easy access to nearby attractions, and many great restaurants!

Ivana’s place is fantastic. It is well- located, close to main areas but positioned in a quiet neighbourhood with a lovely bakery and terrific restaurants. Ivana is so hospitable and i couldn’t recommend it enough.

We had a delightful stay in Ivana's lovely flat and Florence. Ivana's place was the perfect base to explore the city. Loved the vibe of the neighborhood and the flat and  - it was comfortable and very clean. The area had lots of restaurants, cool shops and it’s easy to get to all the sites by foot.  Ivana communicated everything really clearly and the check in/out was very smooth. There is also a great bakery/coffee shop downstairs called Buonamici where you can have your morning coffee and pastries.  Ivana gave us some great recommendations for restaurants and music venues. She even helped us to arrange a taxi on our last day! Would love to return one day.  Grazie mille!

Ivana was incredibly welcoming and made check-in very easy. She gave us many great recommendations for coffee, pastries, restaurants, etc. We loved our stay there and wish we could have stayed longer.

Mirko was super-responsive and helpful. He also went the extra mile - when the city of Florence had water supply issues, and we were at risk of having no water, he purchased several bottles/gallons to ensure we would still have a comfortable stay. The apartment was extremely clean, well-cared for, and new. We loved it.

This place was amazing!  The location was perfect with such a beautiful view, all the amenities as listed also.  Walkable to everything, even the train station.  Plenty of restaurants and things to do very close by.  Host made it easy to communicate and to receive keys and Marco was so helpful and welcoming!

Our stay in Florence was fabulous! The host met us upon arrival and even helped bring our luggage up the stairs. Very informative and kind! The apartment was super clean and looked just like the photos. The location was perfect. Very walkable to everything in the city! Check out instructions were super easy. Would highly recommend this place to anyone who is visiting Florence!

Very good, clean and quiet place.
Only 20/30 minutes walking distance to the centre, and cannot get lost as you just need to follow the river it’s straight forward,
Host is responsive and friendly, 5 stars for the place, price, host, location

peaceful neighborhood, clean and comfortable.... very easy to commute.. walkable to good cafes and restaurants... and more over good suggestions on what to do and where to eat .. thanks Francesco... had a blast in florence 😃
Worth the 5 star rating. It’s big! Two nice bathrooms. Wonderful place. Lots of towels. Beds comfy. Blackout windows. Quiet building. Attentive owner. Grab it if you can.

We had some issues with the apartment door not locking but Fabrizio was awesome! He sent us breakfast on him on our last day. It was an amazing central location and we literally walked everywhere! It was also a very nice apartment!

The location is very good, the apartment is clean and the host is nice and easy to communicate with.
Highly recommended
exactly as the pictures. Contactless checkin. Earlier check in was organised on request, great location
Great location in the centre of Florence, right next to the Duomo. Easy access to the building and Fabrizio was a great host

Brilliant location and felt very safe for wandering around in the evening, having a lift to take you to the room (5th floor) was amazing, the automated check-in was surprisingly handy just remember to keep your phone charged! Quiet at night even though right in the middle of everything. Many thanks for a great stay
I really enjoyed this location and Fabrizio was a great host!! Almost booked elsewhere but ended up booking because of Fabrizio great communication.
Very good place to live, near to the tram/bus stop. Walkable distance to everything to see in Florence (20-30 mins)
It was such a beautiful place! My friends and I loved it, and an easy walk to the center. Would stay here again! The hosts were really responsive and helpful

Our stay in Firenze was super nice! The apartment was perfect for two couples, perfect located in the middle of the centrum and our welcome was so warm and filled with a lot of specific informations and recommendations for our time in Firenze!

Brand new place, very updated. We had a great stay and they were extremely responsive. The only issue was with the AC upstairs but we let them know and I believe they will fix it before the next guests. AC everywhere else in the home was incredible. Great stay, would stay again!

The Host was very informative and available for any questions or concerns.  Apartment was very spacious and comfortable for 5 people.  Located within walking distance to most of the sites in Florance,  only 5 min walk to the Duomo.  Quiet neighborhood.  Would highly recommend.  There is no elevator to the unit.  Its 44 steps to get to the 2nd floor.
The location was great and only a block away from the duomo. However, the AC was broken the whole time we were there.
I spent an amazing time in Florence. The room was impeccable and very clean. There was no noise and the location is central, so it was a good thing.

Very well located, comfortable place, and host was friendly and easy to contact.
The place is not too big, but it's perfect for a couple. There is a smart tv in the bedroom and good wifi.
The street noise is quite loud- if you are a light sleeper it may be tough. Place was exactly as described and bed was comfortable and clean.
Check in was brutal, I thought I was playing a escape room. Everything else was great. Awesome location.
A great option in the centre of Florence, we loved the views across the roof tops at sun down.

This was the perfect spot for my solo trip to Florence! The apartment was exactly as described, and the bed was so comfy. As a solo female traveler, I felt very safe and secure. The Wi-Fi was also excellent for my remote work needs. A truly great find - I highly recommend it!

I stayed at Katia's place for three nights. It is a very nice and clean apartment in a neighbourhood with perfect access to the central train station. The check-in instructions were clear, and Katia was also very responsive and quick. I'd really recommend Katia's place!

This is a great apartment in a location just 10 minutes walk from the River Arno. It is in a less touristy area and surrounded by amazing small bars and restaurants. The apartment is well appointed and is very comfortable. Our host was very responsive  and helpful on the occasion we needed to contact her. I would definitely come back to Florence and stay at this apartment again.
We loved our stay here. The apartment was great, and the neighborhood is fantastic. So close to everything, but less crowded than downtown.

We really enjoyed our staying in the flat. The location is great, by foot to the city center. Salvatore was really kind and helpful in everything we needed. I would definitely recommend it and preferred to my next trip to the city.

The overall stay was great. Indeed you need to be ready to take on foot 3 flights of stairs. Salvatore was very helping and he even let us have a late check out. The only thing to note for people who are very receptive to noise is that you can clearly hear the loud trafic and the trains. For us it was a bit too loud given the apartment is situated on a main street. Other than that, we had a very pleasant stay.
Great stay! Bed was very comfy and cozy! If you’re a light sleeper this isn’t the place for you! We heard all the outside traffic all night but other than this great stay and great host!

Really nice place, everything is as shown just the pictures.  A really cozy place with such a perfect location in Firenze. I totally recommend Salvatore’s place and would definitely come back as well m!

This place is awesome. We found what we needed. In addition, the location of this apartment is close to famous places.
The check-in was smooth, and if I return to Florence, I will rebook with this gentleman.

Salvatore is an amazing host. We had a really late check in (1am) but it was a self check in which was very convenient for us. There were a decent amount of stairs so be mindful if you have heavy luggage. Our unit was very clean and great AC after a long hot day. Loved being able to use the washer in the bathroom and Salvatore provided detergent pods. Salvatore was very quick with responses, clear with instructions on how to get in, gave us recommendations on nearby restaurants, and is very friendly. Thank you for all your accommodations!

The apartment is closed to the central station and tramway T2. The room is very clean and well-prepared accommodations. The instructions are clear and the host is warm welcomed. The bathroom is very clean also.
Tomaas’s place was well located close to the train station, and the communication was always friendly, prompt and very helpful. The room was very modern, trendy and clean

Imad allowed us to leave our luggage in the apartment prior to check-in so we could explore the city without bringing all our belongings with us.  The elevator in the apartment was also helpful because my sister had a broken ankle and would have been difficult to climb 5 flights of stairs otherwise.
We were met immediately upon check in. Host was friendly and attentive. We had a few questions and he was quick to respond.
The place is great!  Very good for a big family.  We had 6 and it worked wonderfully.  The roof top views were top notch!  Thank you!  We would recommend.

Imads place is in a perfect location moments from the Duomo and Ponte Vecchio. Lots of shops and restaurants close by. It is on the top floor with two well appointed balconies with views of the city. Rooms were comfortable and spacious, only niggle was that one of the showers wasn't working while we were there, however we managed fine with one shower as we didn't want to wait in for a maintenance man. Overall we were very happy with our choice

Love this place!!  So close to Ponte Vecchio and easy walking to anywhere! Quick elevator ride to top floor after a long day of touring and walking around the city. Barely heard any street noise due to being so high up and the air conditioners worked so well we were actually freezing one night! Book this place! Lots of space…LOTS! Well worth it.

We had a fantastic stay at Imad’s apartment in Florence! The space was very roomy for our group of 5, and we loved that everyone had their own area to relax. The location couldn’t have been more perfect — right on the same street as the Ponte Vecchio, which made it super easy to find and allowed us to walk everywhere we wanted to go.
The balconies were a wonderful bonus and gave us such a nice place to enjoy the atmosphere of the city. Overall, a comfortable, spacious, and perfectly located apartment — highly recommend!
This place was amazing! It was tastefully decorated and service was extraordinary! Location was ideal and walkable to center.
The apartment is lovely and in a perfect location. We would have appreciated coffee and water in the apartment 😁

Gorgeous host, she was ready to help all the time when there was a problem.
She spoke english very well.

The location amazing,
Flexible check in
The co-host mihaela very friendly, very responsive and she provide us many informations
-Some of the furnitures need service
-The main power switch of the appartment drop off many times during our stay , its need to be fixed
- the locks of doors need to be replaced by smart access locks for easy access

Our stay was absolutely stellar! The location was impeccable, and the room itself surpassed the beautiful photos on the site. What truly made our experience five-star, however, was the host, who was exceptionally friendly and incredibly supportive with every request.
Absolutely loved our stay! The apartment was beautiful, clean, and well-equipped. The location couldn’t have been better —right in the heart of Florence, close to everything. Highly recommend!

Excellent location. Very clean and tidy. Host was very organised. Very nice and friendly host. Apartment was well equipped. The house is very spacious and comfortable. Walkable distance to all major locations in Florence. Great place to stay
Great location. Close to the city centre.  Many restaurants around. Big and spacious apartment. Clean and spotless. Host was amazing and responsive in all our demands.

This place was exceptional.  Several bests on our tour of Italy - best apartment by far it’s new and immaculate, best bed I wanted to take it back home, best wifi fastest internet we had in Italy.  The location is perfect, easy walk everywhere but in a quiet and peaceful area.  Stefania is a wonderful host she waited for us to ensure we checked in fine and understood the digital locks.  Overall this place is very good value for money, we are super impressed and will look to stay here again when we return.  Grazie Stefania!

Great view from the apartment! Walking distance to certain attractions, bars, and museums. Considering the location it can get noisy at times but otherwise, it is a very nice choice and a good value for money.
Spacious living space and great location. Walking distance from everything and the place was just as described! Great stay overall!

The apartment is beautiful and is located centrally. It was clean and well maintained. Stefania however is way too professional. So much so that she treats guests as business. She couldn’t accommodate any of our requests and was not flexible.
The apartment is on level 1 but the lift was not working and we had to carry all our heavy baggage upstairs. There was no shampoo in the bathroom. Additionally the air conditioner didn’t work and we had to ask the host to regulate the temperature as only she had the access.
The one major complaint that I have about Stefania’s condo is that the bed is absolutely horrible.

Stop scrolling and book Marco & Antonella's place now--you'll will be lucky to stay in such a beautiful apartment. It is quiet, and on a peaceful street, even though you are in easy walking distance from any attraction in Firenze that you might want to see. The co-host Laura treated us with such warmth from the first moment we met, and her support and recommendations for restaurants were amazing.  All three hosts were proactive and responsive, even helping with dinner reservations when my Italian failed me. They genuinely care about their guests, and their love of Firenze is infectious. Needless to say, we will be back!
Marco and Antonella's place was exceptionally central, comfortable and good value. They were very generous hosts. Laura met us when we arrived and she could not have been more helpful.

This place is absolutely amazing be very spacious. Location is perfect and you have everything you need to make your stay comfortable. We will definitely be back and highly recommend this place to anyone. Parking is close by, make sure you reserve prior to arriving.

It was really a great apartment and a good quiet place to go home to after a busy day in Florence. The kitchen was extremely well equipped for any kind of cooking and the terrace beautifully set up for relaxing outside at the end of the day.  Laura my hostess was so nice and went out of her way to make sure everything was perfect.

Domenico’s place is ideally located next to the Arno and a great base to explore Florence from. The apartment is spacious and good value for the great location. Domenico was very responsive and good to deal with.

We loved this AirBnB in Florence, a great location and the facilities of a modern apartment at a great price and value. The place is in walking distance to many great eateries and coffee shops. You enjoy the proximity to the markets and the central station. Stefania is a fantastic host and responds quickly to any questions. The apartment is safe and convenient.

It was my job to book the lodging in Florence for my wife and I’s honeymoon trip - and I ended up with the best spot during our stay. Everything is in walking distance from the Airbnb and more importantly my wife felt safe. We felt right at home with everything in the place, we really couldn’t ask for more. Lastly, Stefania was very helpful and quick to respond if I had any questions or recommendations. I would book again!

The stay at Stefania was really nice, the apartament is clean, spacious, modern and well located, pretty close to the Historical Center and all the attractions that we were interested in.
Stefania was very kind and easy to reach, also interested in our well being.
Will definitely come back if another trip to Florence comes across
We had a fantastic time. Our host was warm, kind and immensely helpful. The bed was very comfortable and everything worked well. We would definitely stay here again

This was an amazing place to stay in Florence. So many good restaurants around, and walking distance to every major attraction. Laura was extremely helpful in everything, and very kind.
We will definitely be back again the next time we are in Florence. Thank you so much !

We had a fantastic stay at this perfectly located apartment. It is a spacious, fully equipped apartment with a quain and private outside terrace. Our host Laura was very friendly and welcoming.  She went above and beyond our expectations to make our stay a memorable experience.  She was always available via text and responded promptly to our inquiries. We whole heartedly recommend staying here.
Such a great location—steps from everything and yet very quiet. The host was charming and helpful. A truly lovely place to stay.

Simply put, Domenico has a lovely apartment in an unbeatable location, in the heart of Florence’s Ponte Vecchio— around the corner from the Uffizi and Galileo museums, a 10 min walk to the duomo, 15 min walk from the S.M. Novella train station, and a stone’s throw away from all the amazing restaurants and shops. The street is quiet, even though it’s in the center of all the action, so we never had trouble sleeping. The place itself was just as advertised— spacious, charming, clean, and equipped with all we needed. Domenico was also a great host; very responsive, flexible with check in, and provided very clear instructions for the house to ensure we had no trouble during our stay. We also appreciated how he would proactively check in on us. Next time we come back to Firenze, we’ll undoubtedly look to stay here again!! Grazie mille Domenico!

Perfect location and plenty of room in the apartment.  Everything matched the listing and Domenico was a great host who always responded in a timely manner.  Only negative was the sewer smell in the bathroom as mentioned in other reviews.  Maybe it is a building problem that the host can’t do anything about but it was really unpleasant.
Very nice place with a beautiful view! Easy check-in and check-out as well! Definitely recommend staying here.

Beautiful place, great location and Domenico is a great host.
Definitely recommend.

This is an amazing place to stay, from check-in through the stay. The place is generous - much larger than the photos. There’s a view of the Arno, a private little deck, a big kitchen with everything you need, all around a great spot for stays in Florence. Laura will even get you not just resto recs, but reservarions. Superb!
The house is much bigger than expected! Very easy to get to all parts of Florence from this location, and even though it’s in a busy part of town it is surprisingly quiet!

We loved our stay at Marco & Antonella’s flat in Florence, thanks to their kindness and wonderful hospitality of their co-host Laura!
Upon arriving, Laura showed us everything that this beautiful apartment had to offer. We were given suggestions and tips to the area, and made us feel at home.
We will plan a trip back to Florence just to stay here again! Thank you for the amazing time 💕
We felt like family there. Our host Laura was fantastic and made us feel like the place was our home.
had a great stay, room was a little warm at night but no remote for the air conditioner,  had windows open so lots of street noise. didn't bother me but could annoy others

Anna was great, and her apartment was brilliant 7 stars. She welcomed us in front of the apartment and took us inside, and gave some instructions on where to go and recommended us some places to visit. She also wrote to us some good restaurants in Florence. we thank her so much for the gift she left at the apartment.

This was the perfect location for us on our first trip to Florence.  Close to all the major visitor sites.  We took two side trips to a winery and to Lucca.  We were able to walk to the bus stop and the train station.  Convenient.  Highly recommend!

We enjoyed our stay at Anna’s place very much.  It has lots of character, is spacious and  comfortable, and is strategical located to both transportation options and the city center. Anna is a fabulous host and was very responsive to our questions.  Highly recommend and would stay again.

Anna was phenomenal! The space was spotless and incredibly charming! It was stunning. It was filled with beautiful art and trinkets that were very unique. Any time I had a question Anna was responsive within 5 min. I absolutely loved this spot!! Thank you Anna!

We had a terrific experience staying at Anna's! From booking through checkout, Anna was a terrific host: very thoughtful, kind, and proactive. For instance, when asked if she would make a recommendation for a cooking course, she sent some links that she researched for us to peruse.
The condo is easy to find, easy to get into, and very comfortable. It is beautifully furnished with antiques, has a full kitchen, and Anna even has small everyday use appliances (a clothes iron, hair dryer) so that a traveler from outside Italy doesn't need concern themselves with adapters/converters and such.
The condo was very well situated for us and our needs: we could walk a few blocks and be on the sidewalk alongside the Arno. The train station was a 10-12 minute stroll. If using the tram, stops for each line are within a 10 minute walk.
We would stay at this lovely spot again!
Beautiful view, A/C worked really well and liked the privacy of the window shutters. Host was helpful and there was plenty of room for 6.

We had a great stay at Ma Maison. The location was great, just a 20 minute walk beside the Arno river takes you right into Florence. The balcony is larger than it looks in the photos, overlooking one of the main streets and the Arno river. The accommodations were very spacious, we had a very comfortable stay. The building also has an elevator, which made it so much easier with our luggage and baby stroller. The hosts were great, Cristiana met us when we arrived and showed us where everything was, including how to access the parking garage. Highly recommend this great spot!

The flat is bright and specious , well located in walkable distance to the city centre. The restaurants down the road are great especially the close-by pizzeria . Host was responsive and we enjoyed our stay!

Great area to live in. Has nice restaurants and shops in the area.
Emanuela is a great host as well. She was able to answer the questions I had and gave good recommendations
The flat is very spacious and has everything you have.

Paola & Giovanni were awesome.
They were attentive and helped me make my trip better. The room and home always Pristine. OMG that house smelled so good.
I highly recommend it.

Paola and Giovanni were very helpful and kind. The apartment itself is super clean and the AC works perfectly. It is situated on 50m from a tram stop, which leads you directly to the city center in 15min. I enjoyed my stay very much!

Although my stay was very brief, it doesn’t take away from my very positive experience during my stay at this place. Paola and her husband Giovanni were very nice to me and made me feel comfortable since the moment I walked in the house. They also let me drop off my luggage earlier so I can go explore Florence freely. They were very helpful and also gave me directions and instructions on public transportation. The location is also a huge plus, since it is very close to the train station. All in all, a very positive experience, and I will definitely be coming back if I return to Florence!

Great hosts who were very responsive and welcoming. The quality of the room and the apartment surpass the price, and I immediately felt comfortable and at-home. Perhaps best of all was the close proximity to the tram that takes you straight to the city center. Very easy access to downtown.

Paola's accommodation was spacious and clean, and foremost she and her husband were both very welcoming and nice:) It takes around 20 minutes from city centre of Florence, but the place is right across the tram station. Overall, I had great experience throughout the stay!
very kind and helpful with the directions to explore the city. also the location is very good, because there is a tram station 1' away from the house.
Paola and Giovanni are really kind! The house is very cozy, safe and convenient to both city center and airport.  Tritri is so cute. I strongly recommend Paola’s house.

Paola and her husband were friendly and helpful. They gave me local tips and made my stay comfortable.
Their apartment has lovely decorations, is clean and well serviced by public transport.
Paola was very accomodating and helpful, everything was immaculately clean too. Had a great stay!
I like that someone meets us at the apartment and explains everything. Francesco was very helpful. The apartment is a old but clean and relatively quiet. Overall we had a very nice stay
Very comfortable and beautiful apartment and very kind hosts. I recommend the place to those who need to stay close to the train station but also well connected to the city centre.

Alessandra is a super host. She responded to any query immediately, any question we had or small issue that showed up was solved quickly with her support. Nice, spacious location in the middle of the city all well in range by foot. Little loud likewise any other central place in Italy thought
Spacious apartment, very close to the train station and just a short walk to the city center. Very responsive host.

Very classy and stylish apartment, loved the architectural details! Accommodated two adults and six kids comfortably - lots of space. Everything we needed was there. 20 minute walk to the Ponte Vecchio and the walk was flat, no hills! Lovely coffee shop close by and very near the train station! We would happily recommend Alessandra’s apartment.

We had a group of 8 adults and 1 infant and this was a great place for us for a few days in Florence! It’s less than ten minutes from the train station and it’s close to tons of cool things to see. It’s beautiful inside and had plenty of room for all of us. There was an elevator for getting bigger luggage and baby upstairs to the apartment and the shutters on the windows made the rooms nice and dark for the baby napping. Whoever stays in the upstairs room needs to be able bodied to climb the cool little winding wooden staircase. The host was great at communication.

A cute spacious retro-style apartment. Lofty feelings with amenities ready for small gatherings.
The only downside is the water pressure as this is at the top of the building.
**The attic bedroom is gorgeous**

We stayed at Alessandra's place for a week, and it was beyond our expectations. The building has an elevator, so you don't have to worry about your luggage. It's in a safe neighborhood. Every room is spacious and beautiful, spotlessly clean, with speedy Wi-Fi. The only possible thing you could pick on is that you can't shower at the same time in both bathrooms, but i put that on us from a hotter climate. It's the perfect spot, especially for large groups, and we will definitely recommend it and hope to revisit!
Our group of seven were very pleased with our stay. The location was perfect for using the train and walking anywhere in Florence. We liked the spacious apartment and found the beds comfortable.

Stayed at Alessandra’s place for 4 days with 4 couples. Location was the best part of this place, we pretty much walked everywhere and it was very central and close to the train station.
Our host was very accessible and a good communicator, check in was a breeze.
Helpful to have lots of recommendations listed for us as well.
We explored the whole city and was an easy spot to line up a day trip to Tuscany for a wine tour.
Would recommend and would stay again. Thanks Alessandra.

Great value and location for a large group
We stayed here as a group of 8, and the apartment was a great value for the price. It’s spacious, with four bedrooms, and located close to the Florence train station and many of the city’s main attractions—super convenient for getting around.
There was quite a bit of communication with the host during our stay, everything was handled well. The experience matched what I had read in other reviews, which gave us a good sense of what to expect.
Overall, a solid option for a larger group looking for a central and affordable place to stay in Florence.

Without a doubt we would rent this place again! We totally loved it! Very beautiful. We had the best experience! My husband and three adult children loved every minute of being here! Very spacious. Beautiful inside and out!

Alessandra was a great host, really responsive and easy to deal with! The place was a great location, within a short walk from the train station. The apartment is beautifully decorated also and super clean

This place is in a great location. Easily walkable to all the main tourist sites and not too far from the train station. We had everything we needed. Be aware the bathroom is tiny! The bed and pillows were comfortable.

Michele’s place was very comfortable, clean and roomy. It is in a fabulous location, with many restaurants and attractions surrounding. Pls be aware that it can be loud late in the evenings, however I would still stay there again.
I would recommend this property to future guests.

Wonderful and huge apartment looking out onto a beautiful little piazza. Yes it can be noisy, because there are restaurants and bars open late in the piazza, but you really feel part of Florentine life there. Bring ear plugs and you'll be fine

Thank you for all your hospitality and clarity about check-in and out.  The place is very clean and has all you need to cook.  The location is really good but I wonder about the noise at night from the bar.  if you are a sound sleeper then this place is pretty awesome.
Filippo is great guy, his commination is polite and helpfull, he helped me for local recommendation too. Room is clean and easy to use. Definetly i recommended
Had a wonderful stay here with my wife and daughter. The beds were very comfortable and shared kitchen space was spacious and had everything we needed.

Highly recommend! Feel safe and cozy at this place. tidy and clean, convenient location, flexible check-in time and also can kept our baggage after check-out.
And the host Filippo is so nice , he meet me at the house and explain everything we need to know. I would like to stay here again if I come back to Firenze
Very central, lively neighbourhood, very friendly and helpful hosts. Really the only downside was the uncomfortable matress which is very much dependent on preferences..!

This apartment has an excellent location! Dario and Ciana were super helpful. The place look was super clean and it had everything I needed for my 7 weeks trip. I have been in Florence several times, but this apartment was the best. The location is perfect! You are 5 min walk of each attraction, and a lot of restaurants.I highly recommend it, and I know this is the place I will return when I get back to Florence!

Place was very cute, clean, and in the best location. Walkable to many things within the city but felt safe. Hosts were fantastic and provided everything you may need. Would absolutely stay here again in a heartbeat!

The apartment was perfect! Very clean, awesome location, and very quiet, even though you are in the middle of Florence. Ciana was an amazing host and was extremely responsive and accommodating. We loved having the a/c during a heatwave and the washer and dryer was a big plus (and there were great instructions on how to use it - these combo machines can be tricky for Americans!) Would definitely stay here again.

This was such a good location! We were here for 5 days and walked all over Florence. I can’t imagine being in any other area! This was close to food, drinks, museums, the square, etc! The host was so friendly and helped us with train tickets and answered all questions super quickly!
Francesca was great host. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful. The apartment was very clean and well stocked. It is very centrally located  & wonderful place to stay.
My wife and I had a wonderful stay here! Francesca was super responsive, gave detailed check-in/check-out instructions, and had great tips for the neighborhood. Would happy stay here again!

The apartment was located within a 10 minute walk of multiple museums, attractions and restaurants, as well as the train station.  The apartment was very clean and had all of the listed amenities.  We would definitely stay here again !!

Great apartment and perfect for exploring Florence! Francesca was very responsive, the apartment was very conveniently located and very spacious for two people for a long weekend. It was perfect for our stay.

The apartment just 10 min from the train station was perfect for our short (3 day) stay in Firenze. Close to many of the sights we wanted to see. Comfy beds and a well equiped kitchen and with two bathrooms, great for the four of us.
This apartment was beautiful and spacious!  It was close to everything and a lovely home to experience Florence from.  We would stay here again in a heartbeat!
Is a nice room near the train station, that makes it really useful. The only thing is that the shower is quite small. For the rest everything was accordingly to the description
Everything is amazing. He was helpful in our process and provided quick responses. Thanks for everything , if we ll come again, you will be our first choice
guido met us walked us through the apartment, access, local area, restaurants.  He was very helpful.  Fabulous location right in the middle of everytinhng.  Thanks

Clean & classic flat with convenient location. Nice little market opposite to the flat to accommodate your daily need and nice bakery shop next to the flat. Shower tower is luxurious to kiss the skin. Anna is such a nice person full of love and consideration. Nice stay :)

Great location in the middle of the city making it great to visit all the main sights. It was easy to go back to the Airbnb in the middle of the day to have a quick rest and go back out. I never had to use public transportation during my stay aside from arriving and departing from the city via the train station.
The only downside from the great location and convenience is the noise from the street and churches. Not something controllable by the host. Highly recommended to bring ear plugs.

Guido made is feel warmly welcomed, and the apartment was beautifully furnished. We had plenty of space and the view of the Bargello Museum to one side and a monastery to the other fulfilled our fantasies of staying in old Firenze.
Great location and an amazing host. It is very loud at night so important to bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.

The apartment was beautiful and was at a perfect location for my needs. There were a few small problems since the place was too new but thankfully everything sorted out at the end thanks to support by thr host. Would recommend to others.

The apartment was lovely and well positioned, around a mile or so walk into the main city centre.
There are some lovely cafe bars and restaurants near to the apartment.
We did find check in a little haphazard as we were dropped by the taxi on a parallel street, we walked around to the correct one but were left waiting as the host had gone to deal with another check in - it would have benefited from a key safe outside for self check in.
The shower is great but the cubicle is small so please bear this in mind, neither of ius are overly tall or large and we struggled.
But please don’t let this put you off staying, the apartment is very nice and in a good location x

It’s a good stay considering the budget. Flat is well maintained. You’ll get a bus to reach there from station also. Tram station is 10 ‘mins away. Very peaceful neighbourhood so that means very lonely. You won’t get bus back to the staion near the house but there’s a tram nearbuy. So overall very good.

We loved staying in a neighborhood full of locals, the market and the best little shop for delicious focaccia sandwiches right across from our front door! The only “complaint” (not really a complaint but a helpful suggestion) …is that it took us a minute to figure out some appliances and amenities as there was no instructions left for us to reference. Overall, we loved the location and would stay here again!

Alina was a wonderful host. She was extremely friendly, communicative and responsive. I would highly recommend her listing to larger groups who want to be near the heart of Florence. The apartment was just perfect!

The apartment was clean and wonderful. Very spacious and in a good location for our purposes. We were extremely comfortable there and as a large group with both younger and older couples we were able to have some space, access the apartment independently, and each room had bathrooms with amenities that made it very comfortable. The elevator came in hardy with luggage and my father who isn’t moving very well. There was a lot of coffee and a wonderful espresso maker we used while eating some breakfast treats from the shop across the street. I would return to Florence and I would stay at Alinas apartment every time if possible.
Alina was super responsive and great to work with! Wonderful spot and great direction and communication! Loved it!

I have visited Florence a few times before this visit and this is (by far) the best place I've stayed! Great location, spacious apartment, wonderful A/C...I could go on and on. I highly recommend Alina's place.

I highly recommend this place.
very comfortable And clean.
Host is always available and flexible .
within blocks you can find excellent local restaurants. never had to make a reservation.
Thanks Alina.

The apartment is close to the train station and several restaurants and shops!
Several bathrooms which is a plus when staying with a big group of people!

We needed a place for two families so this place was perfect. Lots of space and I appreciated that there was a bathroom per bedroom. Beds were comfortable and A/C worked great.
We all had to walk to and from the train station , which is very close. We were able to drop off our luggage early which was very helpful.
The apartment is right in the mix of things, but quiet in the apartment. We were able to walk to all the main sights and make the most of our short time in Florence.
Alina was responsive host and provided clear instructions for our stay.
Luciana was very responsive, easy to communicate with and flexible about checking in and out. I would stay at her place again.

The apartment is beautiful. However,  we were quite frustrated on not being able to use the sofa beds. A €100 Euros fee was requested by the host on Wsp for sending sheets when we checked in as we had not given a required 14 day prior notice on bed settings. Which we naturally refused to pay. We had registered 7 people but the two sofa beds were unavailable to us. Shockingly, the host later deleted the Wsp messages in which she requested the extra fees.

We had a great time in Florence staying in Donatella's beautiful apartment. We were a group of 7 girls and we had plenty of space for each of us to feel comfortable. Erika was very responsive and helpful. We did a cooking class and market tour with Erika which was a highlight of the trip! The location is great and very walkable to all of the sights. Everything was wonderful and we hope to return to Florence again very soon and we would definitely stay again.

This apartment is even better than the pictures! Best experience ever in an Airbnb. Host is great with communicating and very responsive to any requests or questions.  Great location, easy to walk to many restaurants, attractions, public transportation.  Apartment is spotless and great layout to allow the guest to have their own space and enjoy all the amenities.

Our stay in Florence at this beautiful, well-appointed, well-located apartment exceeded expectations!! Three generations - aged 2.5 to 70 - were very comfortable. All 9 of us would rate the apartment with 5 stars—the hosts were responsive and very gracious!

host communicated with us quickly and effectively, was kind and accomodating.
The place is right by the street and the tram rail which makes it very noisy.

We would love to stay here again. The place is exactly as described and very clean. We used the kitchen for dinner each night we were there. Besides salt and pepper, there are no other spices, but there is oil and coffee. The balconies were a great respite from getting to central Florence. Easy to buy groceries near by. Highly recommend.

Lovely apartment in a fantastic location. Close enough to explore the sights but quiet enough to relax in. Some great bars and restaurants at the end of the road and just a 10 minute walk to the Duomo and Campanile.
We did have a problem with the shower but the hosts responded very quickly and resolved the problem.
They obviously take their guests needs very seriously.
I would definitely stay here again.

The apartment is well located and equipped with every you will need.  It is on the first floor, and so there is quite a lot of noise from the street, but Janaina provides ear plugs for guests.  We found it to be a really comfortable spot to explore Florence from.
Excellent apartment for our stay in Florence. Great location in the city and walkable from the train station. The steamer was very helpful to cure wrinkled clothes from travel.
Beautiful little apartment in the heart of Florence. Jana was extremely helpful and responded well. Really enjoyed my stay!
Great stay and great location. Only complaint was there was street noise but luckily earplugs were provided and it helped

Janaina’s place was a fantastic choice for our trip to Florence! The unit itself was very clean and comfortable, it was also in a perfect location to walk to all the major sights. Janaina was super responsive and quick to answer! Would recommend.

I liked my stay at Janaina's apartment very much, it is right in the  center and close to everything (15 by walk). Apartment is very cozy and clean, all necessary was there. Janaina is very responsible and was always ready to answer if I had some questions. And a special thank for meeting me and helping with check in late at night.
Great location! The place was very nice and felt private. Perfect spot for 2 people and it has all the necessary accommodations. I would definitely stay here again.

Highly recommend Janaina's place. Great location within easy walking distance of places of interest. Janaina provided great communication and was very helpful. Apartment is comfortable and has everything you need.
Janaina was so friendly and helpful! Her apartment is calm and lovely in a great location. Would recommend and stay again!
Lovely apparemment very located to explore Florence. The host is super responsive. We had fantastic time at Francesco's place. Highly recommended!

The name itself, Sogni d'oro sul Ponte Vecchio, couldn't be more fitting.
Exceptional accomodation, providing a comfortable stay with excellent services and cleanliness. The host, Francesco, was equally impressive, friendly and always available for assistance. The location is outstanding - a central point for accessing all the must-visit spots in Florence. What can I say, the overall experience was unforgettable. Treat yourself, too.
Our host was very accommodating and responsive. The place was in the perfect location! A great place to enjoy all that Florence has to offer. Would recommend to others!

I think, this accommodation is the one of the best.
it is enough to stay with 4 members and very close to Firenze sight.
I highly recommend this place
The apartment is in great location with most tourist attractions within walkable distance. Highly recommend this place for the value and location.

Great apartment and a very friendly, helpful and responsive host! Location is beyond amazing, literally right at the corner from ponto vecchio and just 5min walk from half of the main museums! Has an elevator and all is clean, and safe. Lots of places to eat nearby, a grocery store around the corner, amazing real gelato down the street. The host, Francesco, is always easy to reach, super fast replies, very friendly, lots of suggestions and helpful information. And really great apartment, I totally recommend!

This house was comfortable, quiet, and appealing. We were able to sleep soundly, do our laundry and some cooking, and head out again each day refreshed for more adventures. The hosts were especially friendly and helpful, and even greeted us with a bottle of local wine as a welcome gift.
One of my favorite places I have stayed so far! Super cute house and decor. Bed was super comfy, and I loved the private deck. I will definitely stay here again if I come back to Florence!

5/5 great place. Giulio provided very clear instructions of how to self check in. Good location, bus and tram stop is nearby. We spend a good time at their house, which is really big. The place where you can stay for months.
ps. There is also good beer hall on the corner, with a resonable prices

We loved the accommodation. It was a very pleasant stay. The balcony was a bonus.
There was just two things to mention.
We couldn’t find a kettle for our tea and a toaster.

This apartment was perfect for my week stay in Florence! It is in a great location super close to the Ponte Vecchio. Air conditioning worked very well which was  important on very hot days! It is a quaint place but perfect for 1-2 people!

The perfect room to rest in after a long walk in Firenze ! Well equipped and close enough to city center, it is the place to be !
Above that, Alessandro has told us everything we needed to enjoy our stay the best way possible.
Our trip in Firenze was litteraly magic
Grazie Mille Alessandro
Alessandro’s place was a great location to walk to the city center. Very nice and spacious.

I had a great time in Florence. The apartment was lovely and in a great location, and Ale was a very kind and generous host who made everything easy and provided useful information about the neighbourhood. Highly recommended!

We had a lovely stay.. quiet location a short bus, tram or walk from main activities. Apartment had everything we needed and was very clean. Thorough with instructions on arrival and throughout stay. Would definitely recommend!

This is a real gem- beautiful, clean, well appointed, and super close to many amazing sights while still tucked away from the crowded areas. Mattia is a wonderful- friendly, responsive, and helpful. The self check in instructions were clear, and it was a breeze for our jet lagged brains to figure out.  The apartment was a perfect place to rest and recharge  after exploring all day. If you are planning to visit Florence I highly recommend this wonderful apartment!

The Florentine Home and our amazing hosts were a dream come true! Everything was perfect from beginning to end. We all wish we could have stayed longer.
Thank you for everything!!

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Florence. The space was clean, comfortable, and perfect for taking a break in the middle of our trip. We especially appreciated having room to spread out, do laundry, and relax after days of exploring. The host was kind and welcoming, making our stay even more enjoyable. Would definitely recommend!

This is an absolutely beautiful apartment -- very chic in it's decor -- and spotless.  The two bathrooms were well appointment and have very nice rain fall showers.  The location was down a quite little street, but walkable to the main plaza, coffee shops and restaurants.  Mattia was very helpful and friendly.  One of the nicest AirBnB's we've stayed in so far in Italy.
Perfecto. Amazing host! Very accommodating. The layout is perfect. Comfy beds. Stocked with everything you will need during a long trip, including laundry detergent! Excellent location. *****

Absolutely love this Airbnb. The place left nothing wanting. If you happen to see this and it’s still available, don’t hesitate, just book it!!!   It’s in the center of everything with all the main attractions only a 5 to 10 minute walk away. The bedrooms and bathrooms were spotless. The mattress and bedding was very comfortable.  If we are lucky enough to be in Florence again, we would absolutely stay here again.

Beautiful, modern, and comfortable apartment. Perfect for 2 couples! The kitchen had everything you could possible need. The location was in the historic area and could walk anywhere. Maria Met us at the apartment and explained everything. We had a wonderful experience in Florence. Would recommend this apartment to anyone who asked.

What you see in the picture is what you get! Nothing but perfection, it’s beautiful, the beds were comfortable. Perfect location and quiet.
The owner is very organized, quick to respond and detailed.
Strongly recommend this place.

This apartment is in the perfect location. It is within walking distance to all the attractions of Florence but it is on a quiet and peaceful street. The apartment is beautifully decorated, had all the amenities we needed to make food at the apartment, with comfortable beds and super clean. Mattia was the ultimate host: clear instructions on how to find and locate the home, and highly responsive to our questions about where best to get dropped off. The home also has a wonderful manual with helpful local information and we had a great meal at one of the restaurants he recommended. I wouldn't hesitate to visit again or recommend anyone else to stay.

An incredible Airbnb! The location is fantastic, the unit is stunning and decorated so nicely. It comfortably accommodated me and 3 others and allowed to plenty of space to spread out. It was walking distance from so many amazing shops. The hosts were very responsive and communicate and accommodating. Would definitely stay here again!

This apartment was exactly what my group of friends was looking for during our stay in Florence! Right in the heart of the city, it made everything we wanted to do accessible - all while being very private, with a rooftop porch that made the place feel quite magical and removed from the busy streets. The rooftop was really the highlight for us. It was nice to have two bathrooms as well. The kitchen was easy for cooking with all the supplies needed to eat in, though the stove was a bit finicky. Great eats and views right nearby. Great deal for the price, really happy all around.

Absolutely amazing place to stay in the perfect location! Everything was walkable from this location, the apartment was great and exactly as expected. This was the perfect choice for our stay and I would definitely recommend. The hosts were very kind and responsive, thank you for a great stay!
we had a wonderful stay here, so centra and easy to get wverywhere, while still being peaceful. highly recommend

We had a great stay! The Airbnb was affordable and in a great central location near the heart of Florence, making everywhere we went very walkable.  It is also near the train station, which made day trips easier. The check-in process was very easy and we appreciated the in-person greeting and advice. We would definitely recommend this Airbnb and would choose to stay here again in the future.
Really enjoyed staying here and had much more room than I have experienced in the other airbnb. Would definitely recommend!

We had a fabulous time! Location was perfect and everything was within walking distance! In addition, Isabelle was an attentive and gracious host. Can’t wait to return and stay again !
Bellisima!

The location is perfect for walking to everything. Right outside the door is a great cafe and sandwich shop. Just steps away from shopping and restaurants. We would love to stay here again. Thank you to our host for everything. Florence was incredible!

Modestino’s place is in a fantastic location close to every interesting site in Florence!
Communication was excellent as were recommendations for restaurants and entertainment. The apartment is clean, comfortable and any questions we had were
quickly resolved.
Highly recommend and would definitely return!
Modestino Is really helpful  and the apartment is amazing. Right downtown great location to access many places by foot

Highly recommend this stay, it’s a cosy apartment central to Ponte Vecchio.
The hosts were very helpful and gave amazing recommendations!
Recommend reading their PDF of things to do.
Would definitely stay here again.
Wow in the best location!! would totally recommend and modestino was super responsive and helpful! Also, just a beautiful apartment.

This rental should have mot been on airbnb in the first place ; air bnb should have minimum standards and require full disclosure and of missing amenities , poor access such as no elevators etc to the potential guests to help guests to make informed decisions when they book
Amazing stay, host was super communicative with any issues we had. Went above and beyond to make our stay as lovely as possible. Would definitely stay again.
Great location in the middle of the old town with the Italian streetnoise cosy on the background. Fast and friendly reaction from the host.

Good location - walkable to all the tourist spots.
Good check in- person met you at the door. Very easy and straight forward.
Spacious accommodation , with all that you need :)

We really enjoyed our time here, it’s a great location, walkable from all the action in Florence. As for the apartment, it was incredible! What a hidden gem. The layout was great and spacious. So clean and designed nicely. We were very comfortable and Nir was super responsive to all our questions. Great find!
The apartment was perfect! Amazing location and very walkable to popular areas. Nir was a great communicator and made check in easy. Highly recommend staying here.

We had a great time in Florence! The place was in a convenient location close to the attractions and fun bars & restaurants. It was huge and there is more than enough room for the two of us. Nir was very responsive and had a lot of awesome recommendations. Ray was very nice, welcoming and gave us a helpful tour when we arrived. Would definitely stay here again!

Absolutely perfect.  Within 10 minutes of anything you want to see or do in Florence.  Clean, bright, well equipped.  Be prepared to climb some stairs but this lovely apartment will not disappoint.  Absolutely silent at night so very restful after a day of exploring.  In sum: perfect location, clean and modern apartment with a nice outdoor space, this place wants nothing.  Nir is sweet and responsive and helpful.  Highly recommend!
We had a great stay here. Everything was nice and clean. The location was great. Would recommend
It was amazing stay! The flat is big, good equiped and comfortable. The location is perfect. The owner is very helpful. I would recommend it for sure!

This place was fantastic! Massive apartment with multiple living spaces and a great kitchen. The location was perfect within short walking distance of the Duomo. Nir and his team were also very accomodating with check-in time which was so helpful. Would highly recommend to anyone visiting Florence.

Excellent host and apartment. The location was incredible (close to everything in Florence) and apartment was clean and perfect for our stay. The standout feature  for our stay was the concierge service - our hosts booked amazing restaurants and taxis for us quickly which made our trip so much easier and more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

Good little apartment with all the amenities you need for a few days stay. It isn’t very soundproof through and because it is located so centrally we found it to be quite noisy all through the night, so I would recommend ear plugs.
Nice place, near everything, in the center of Florence! Matias was an exceptional host. We had a great time in Firenze. Ciao

Place is definitely worth it! So many shops and restaurants close by which makes it perfect for buying things you need without having to travel far. Everyone was helpful and greatly appreciate my request to check in early and help whenever I couldn’t turn the key. Overall, I recommend this place to anyone looking to stay in Florence.

Exceptionally clean, peaceful and spacious apartment in a fantastic location.
We chose to walk from the train station with luggage which took about 25mins, navigating narrow paths and lots of people so would recommend taking a bus or taxi.
Easy walk to Piazza Duomo, Palazzo Vecchio, Uffizi Galleries and Piazzale Michelangelo to watch the sunset.

We had a lovely stay overall. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and our host provided excellent recommendations that helped us make the most of our time in Florence. The apartment is in a great location, making it easy to get around and see the main sights of the city.
One area that could be improved was the cleanliness of the bathroom, as it didn’t appear to have been properly cleaned before our arrival. Otherwise, everything else met our expectations and contributed to an enjoyable trip.
Great stay in fabulous and spacious apartment in the heart of the old city of Florence. Perfect for our group of 7 (2 families). We would definitely stay there again. Thanks to the team at Mamo.

Everything was beyond expectation besides the rooms being a bit dark and the toilets had some minor stains. It was located in a very old building, the lift inside was tiny to fit more than one person with some luggages, we had to carry some luggages up the stairs, it was a bit tiring. Also the host was slightly late, we were waiting for him outside the building.

The location of the apartment is really strategic with a few minutes from the tram station and there is a Supermarket at the next block - the instructions for key and apartment access from Giulia and Tomassi were crystal clear .
We had an emergency during our check out , where our car was towed by municipal police due to improper parking - Giulia & Tomassi helped us to locate our car, I really really appreciate that!!
Will come again in future to their house!

Amazing stay! The condo was well equipped with washer/dryer, microwave, toaster, dishwasher, hair dryer and basic toiletries. Honestly, one of the best airbnbs I’ve stayed at during my 2 weeks in Europe. The apartment is very comfortable and conveniently located 5 mins away from the Tram which takes you into the city center in 20 minutes. We were 5 guests in the apartment which was a little cramped but it had everything we needed and two washrooms. There is a grocery store 5 mins away by foot which was very convenient when buying snacks and bread for breakfast.
Everything was great , location was very good , near tram station was 10 minutes away , but only problem was water pressure, sometimes it was so low , especially during showers .
Very clean and peaceful place to stay. It is walking distance from the city and plenty of bus options to take. The host was very friendly and responsive.
