Great place, very clean bathroom and kitchen. Near the center of Florence. Thanks Olly for the great stay.
Pierpaola was the perfect host and made us feel very welcome. Suggested places to visit. She even remembered our sons birthday and wished him happy birthday. Great place would return 👌
Pierpaola's apartment was located close enough to walk to the city center but away from all the noise.  Pierpaola was a gracious and helpful host.
Fabulous place to stay. Everywhere is accessible on foot.  Great restaurants and a super market just a stones throw away. Quiet community

The apartment is really lovely! Spacious, clean, warm in November. Good connection to the train station by public transport. The apartment is even better than on the pictures. Great hospitality. Loved it!
We had a good stay. The place is very clean and located in an area that’s very convenient. Pierpaola is a great host, very helpful to us!

Very nice and spacious two bedroom apartment, near the heart of city but in a quiet area. It is walkable to all attractions. My family stayed for three nights and enjoyed great hospitality from Pierpaola.

Amazing apartment in the heart of Florence ! We were 3 couples and the fact that the apartment had 3 rooms with its own bathroom for each one of them made it very comfortable and convenient ! Also the apartment is very modern and spacious ! I really recommend this place if you’re looking to visit Florence !
Beautiful place.  Very convenient to many different places to eat and hang out. Place was very clean and comfortable. Would definitely come back! Hosts were extremely helpful too.
We had a great stay here! Scott was extremely responsive and even helped carry our luggage up the stairs.

One of the nicest airbnb’s we have stayed in!
Hostess very informative & pleasant.
Would recommend for others & stay again.

Great stay! Home was clean and comfortable. Decorated very nicely and functional. Location was perfect, we were so close to the Duomo and yet it was so peacful onece inside.
Exept for a few stairs wich were a problem only because we had a todler and a stroller otherwise just a nice excercise :).

Great stay- cheap and cheerful.
Remember to bring 50 cent coins to use the coffee machine. We didn’t have any and was a bit annoyed when to not have coffee. No moka in the room, and no shower curtain so water goes all over the floor.

Beautiful place hosted by amazing people, we loved our stay after a long transit from Australia, the place felt very homely and was in a perfect location. only regret is we unfortunately could only stay one night. highly recommend

Do not hesitate to book this place! This was one of my favorite places I stayed at in Italy! The apartment is spacious, clean, has everything you need, and feels like your own Italian home! The neighborhood is perfect. It is located in the heart of everything with great restaurants and markets right outside your door. It was perfect!

This stay was perfect in all matters. Clean, convenient, spacious, and comfortable. Though it is in the heart of the city, it is tucked away with a beautiful view.
The hosts are excellent and accommodating themselves. I got the pleasure of meeting one upon arrival and you can tell how much he cares about the home.
I definitely will return the next time I'm in Florence!

A lovely apartment in a really good location. The place had everything and even more than you usually expect with airbnbs. We were given beer, water, breakfast, aperol, cola. Lovely decorated rooms. The host was extremely welcoming. A balcony to top it all off.

This is a great place, more than we expected! The hostess is very friendly, she prepared some finger food, international adapters, towels, coffee and water for us. She was very flexible with checking in and out which helped us a lot. The place is super spacious and has good air conditioning. There is also a separate living room which is, like the rest of the house, beautifully decorated. Additionally, the bedroom at the back has a balcony where you can sit and enjoy a nice drink. The location is amazing too. When you step outside, you directly enter a street with great atmosphere. Within a few minutes you can walk to the nearby churches and museums . All famous locations are in walking distance.  Really amazing!

would highly recommend this place, it was super clean and very big. it was walking distance to so many tourist attractions. only downside is that it's on the top floor and there were alot of steep stairs (difficult with luggage but we managed)

The place was absolutely beautiful. Federica and her husband were very friendly and accommodating to our check out time. Host was also very willing to help and offered to carry my heavy luggage up the stairs (do note that you do have to climb up few flight of stairs for the accommodation at the top floor).  The location was also very convenient, right in the heart of the city with many things to do and see. Would recommend this accommodation. We felt right at home with a warm welcome on check in.

Amazing place right in the heart of Florence. Just a five minute walk from the train station and from the Duomo. Apartment was just as described with nice amenities. Definitely recommend and will use again when back in Florence.

Federica’s home was everything and MORE we could have asked for! It was charming, fully stocked with snacks, coffee, towels, linens, etc., VERY clean, and verrrry close to all the central areas. We loved this home so much, it felt very cozy and safe. We also liked heating included, as it got pretty cold at night. Would 100% recommend for others to stay here :)

What a wonderful stay in an excellent location. Surprisingly quiet apartment right next to Santa Croce with restaurants and cafes literally downstairs. The unit is very comfortable with all the amenities provided in the kitchen. And the hosts are very responsive and helpful, gave us tips and recommendations for every question we had.

Frederica's apartment was excellent. Spotlessly clean and comfortably furnished.
Great location with many restaurants nearby.
Would happily stay here again

The most wonderful apartment in a quiet, residential neighborhood. We received a warm welcome from Daniela & Stefano, the owners. Prompt & efficient check-in. The apartment has everything you could wish for, including a fully equipped pantry and kitchen. The balcony is just beautiful! Easy bus accessibility to all of Florence's attractions. Supermarket, cafes and restaurants in walking distance. Overall, 10/10 and highly recommended!
The apartment is quite large and very centrally located.  Rooms do not face the Main Street which helps with sleeping.  Beds are comfortable and rooms were cool with a/c.

Perfectttt location! Literally walkable to everything! Travel with my husband, 2 small kids (one an infant) and my dad. Walkable from train station forenze Novella. Super close to the duomo and amazing restaurants right out the door. The host was suppperr helpful and flexible.
The Airbnb is even better than the pictures ! Very spacious and give the Italian vibe.
Tips : book a walking tour through viator. Cost $10 for all of us. Walk to the square in the evening. It’s beautiful ! Walk across the river before sunset to catch the sunset.
10/10 experience . Wish I stayed longer.
Great location right by Santa Croce. Big space perfect for family. Host was super nice and helpful and gave us good local recommendation as well.  Would stay here again.

We found Stefano and Daniela’s place as comfortable as home. This was the most well supplied Airbnb we’ve ever stayed in. They thought of every comfort. They are also very attentive hosts. We highly recommend their place and would definitely stay again.

Worth every penny! We enjoyed this place so much it was hard to leave. Host was super nice and responsive. The house was fully equipped and very well thought out. We used the kitchen everyday. Grocery store close by and in a quiet area. Would definitely stay here again when we are back.
I wish that we could have checked in earlier than 3pm. I asked for a later check out than 10am and he granted an additional half hour. Not enough time at the Airbnb for what we paid for it.
This is a wonderful place in the middle of all the shops, restaurants, etc.  Highly recommend this cute little place!

My husband and I stayed here during our honeymoon and it was PERFECT! Right in the center of everything we were able to walk everywhere we wanted to go. There was tons to do all very close. It was also great having daily cleaning services / new towels etc. We absolutely loved it and will stay here again if/when we come back to Florence!

Claudia’s apartment is very clean it is located on one of the quiet street in the historic center but also close to the other side of the river.
The apartment is compact with a vertical recessed bed which acts as a sofa. We did not use the kitchen because there was a good restaurant nearby offering great breakfasts and also many places for supper.
Very easy check in and checkout; Claudia is easy to reach and was very welcoming. Very quick to answer our queries.
We would stay there again if we returned to Florence.

Claudia was so helpful & accommodating, very quick to reply on communication.
The apartment was so well equipped & clean & tidy. Perfect location in walking distance to everything but such a peaceful street. Would definitely recommend.

The apartment was close to the tram and it was a quick ride to the center of Florence and all its attractions. So cute and so clean! Nice personal touches like snacks and water. Host answered all my questions promptly
Everything was great. The apartment was clean.  Only problem was parking. They didnt have parking lot.

Wonderful apartment in one of the best areas. Everything is very close and still the apartment is quiet. The terrace is fantastic - especially when you bought a nice bottle of wine at Signorvino around the corner.

Modestino and Eleonora were terrific hosts!  Their place was perfect for our visit to Firenze.  We loved the views from the spacious and beautiful balcony,  the comfortable bedding, and super convinient location.  They were always quick to respond to messages and easy to communicate with!

This stay was amazing! Modestino‘s place was just as described. Extremely central area, just steps from the Ponte Vecchio, restaurants and grocery stores! The terrace was peaceful and breathtaking and a great spot to enjoy a glass of wine overlooking the beautiful city. Would highly recommend this place. He was also extremely responsive whenever we had a question and was kind enough to book us a taxi to the train station at the end of our stay ☺️
This is a nice flat at a perfect location to see the sights of Florence.  The host provided excellent information and guidance to help us get out and enjoy our stay.

Nice apartment, clean with most of the amenities. Walkable to all the places, very close to academia and bus stops. Water heating has some issues at this place. Water was cold for first day of stay. The host informed us it is fixed next day but it was barely warm for rest of the stay. Getting showers with cold/Luke warm water was challenging.

We loved our stay - everything was walkable and the communication from the hosts was without fault. Lots of recommendations about the area and clear information about the house.
Just be mindful that there are a few stairs to climb to access the apartment. Our kids were 7&10 and didn’t have any problems but would be trickier with toddlers

5 stars! Host was extremely communicative and friendly. I had a question about the heating during our stay and the host responded within minutes. Check in/out was easy. The unit was spotless and exactly as described. Beautiful, clean bathrooms and the beds were very comfortable. It was perfect for my family of 4 (2 adults and 2 children aged 3 and 1). Supermarket was 2 minute walk and a lot to do within walking distance. Really great local restaurants within a few minute walk. Location was not loud at night. Had no problem finding free street parking. I would stay here again!

Such Amazingly responsive and kind hosts and the apartment was absolutely beautiful in every way. So well thought out and stylish too. Was a dream to come back to.
Infact, Made us come home to the UK and want to do many house improvements to our own home!
Only two things I’d say.. ONLY JUST big enough for 5 and we were two adults, two teens and a 9 year old. Would be better for 4 I’d say as two of the beds are the sofa bed in the living area which is very compact.
Also needs somewhere to hang clothes / no wardrobe at all.
Apart from that if we ever did Florence again we’d want to stay here! Thanks so much ❤️

Sebastian and Kasia place is the best Airbnb we’ve stayed in.
The apartment is clean and have everything you’ll need. We stayed there with a 2.5 years old and 12 months old and it was great. Thank you Sebastian and Kasia for having us.

Sebastian and Kasia apartment was just fabolous! Everything was just great: Modern equipment, quiet sorroundings, withing walking distance to Florence main sights. We really enjoyed our time so we added a couple of extra days to our stay. Sebastian and Kasia are wonderful hosts, and were very helpful and accommodating! It was the best airbnb we’ve had, would love to return in the future!
We had a nice stay! Would love to come back again next time I. Florence ! The hosts are super responsive and easy to communicate!
Great location, perfect size! Lots of stairs up to the apartment, but that’s normal for the area.
the place nice and is close to everything. there are tons of restaurants around. sandwich shop below is great.  The bed is  comfy.
Very nice room in a beautiful area, tons to see and eat within a few minutes walk from the door. Highly recommend this room/host.
Cecilia is a great host! She made sure we were comfortable and had all that we needed. We would definitely stay here again!

Perfect stay in central Florence. Beautifully furnished modern room with a great communicative host. It was a touch noisy but that is to be expected given the central location. Everything else was perfect - thank you!

The host (Ana) was great. She was really friendly and responsive and she tried to give ua the best possible experience. The location of the house is amazing, a 20-25 mina walk from so many main locations to visit. Having a car in the location is a bit of a problem because of the difficulty in finding parking spots or the kind of expensive daily public parking. The house was clean and exactly like the photos.

Loved staying here! The place is charming and spacious and the location is great, around a 10-15min walk to the major attractions and close to many bus stops. Ana was also very responsive and kind. Highly recommend!
Good location. Bear in mind that the apartment is in the 2nd floor and there is no elevator. The room with the sofa cama is a bit noisy and was a bit smelly, probably from smoking from the neighbors

Everything was really perfect, Ana was really kind and reactive ! The flat is welcoming and well equipped 🌟 The host is super comprehensive. I recommended 100 %. Only problem the acoustics insulation is really bad, so you might here the neighbor singing in the shower or his discussion on phone with his mom. Let’s say it’s the italian concept ✨
Location was great, the apartment was very spacious, the beds were so comfy! Had everything we needed

Aris is a great host. He takes extra care of everything, from check-in to making us feel right at home. He took time to give us restaurant recommendations that felt very authentic and away from the crowds (you have to try real gelatto at Vivaldi!) I could write a lot more about my experience in Aris’ home…just read all the other reviews, it’s all very true.
Thanks again Aris

Our stay was great. Aris was always responsive and available to help (even when i left my purse behind!). He made sure we knew how to use all the amenities and ensured the apartment was in pristine shape. The apartment was clean, and a great place to stay!! Couldn’t recommend it more. I would give this place 100 stars if I could.

The place was spectacular, close to all the main sites. Place is exactly as described by Aris, even better. Exceeded our expectations. Clean, great linens. Kitchen, bathroom has everything you might need. Aris was great, very helpful; even helped us with getting a taxi on the check out day. Highly recommend, you won’t regret.
Everything was perfect, pleasant apartment very well located, and easy communication with Sofia. Thank you again !

I had a great stay with Illya! Check in was super flexible and he provided a whole bunch of recommendations for places to visit which was very helpful. The bed was very comfortable and the room felt private. Full access to the kitchen and laundry too which was a great plus. Pretty convenient location being so close to the tram, however it doesn’t go that far into town, but is still nice to have regardless. Would recommend the place!

We had a great time living with Illya. He is very friendly and outgoing which makes communication easy. The shared facilities were clean and there were no problems in using them together. However the parking space has a steep ramp - you should drive in very slowly and carefully to avoid damage to your car. Overall we enjoyed our visit and the true airbnb experience.

The room was very clean!
The host gave me many tips for enjoying the city.
I had a comfortable stay :)
Exactly what was promised! Easy walk to the city center (with the option for public transit), Illya was very kind and helpful!
Better than the photos! Such a cute place to stay in, Rosaria was very kind and helped us when we needed. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone :))

we stayed with our family and would def recommend someone staying there. very comfortable and also very good location and Alessandro was very helpful in giving tips. it definitely made our trip more exciting!

We had an incredible stay at this beautiful and cozy apartment near the heart of Florence with our family. The location is perfect, with easy access to all the major attractions. The host was exceptionally kind and helpful, always available when needed. The apartment is one of the best in the area, with a stunning rooftop offering breathtaking views of the Duomo. I will definitely book this place again and highly recommend it to friends!"

10/10 would recommend! Great apartment in a great area. We found Alessandro’s place to be exactly as advertised, and super clean. We frequently use AirBnB’s for travel and this is one of the best!  Hope we can return some day!

The apartment is lovely, spacious and clean. Though located in a busy place, the moment you step inside, it is very calm, quiet & peaceful.
Beautiful views of buildings and the Duomo is right down the street.
Very spacious and clean.

Our group of six had a wonderful stay at Alessandro’s beautiful apartment. It was the perfect location to explore Florence from. Just steps from the Duomo, we were able to walk everywhere. Alessandro was so helpful with recommendations and was very flexible with our check in and check out times, which we so appreciated. We were very comfortable and loved the apartment! We wished we could have stayed longer. Thank you, Alessandro!

This Florence Airbnb was perfect—beautifully decorated and in a fantastic location near everything. The outdoor space with a view of the Duomo was the perfect place to relax after a long day of site seeing. The host gave great recommendations and made us feel completely at home. We would absolutely stay here again!

Wonderful little place in Florence! Great location, very central and easy to get anywhere. The house is beautifully appointed with comfortable, spacious rooms and the outdoor patio was a fabulous spot for a glass of wine before dinner. Washer and dryer was convenient. Host was very responsive to any questions we had and had some great dinner reservations. Try the gelato place down the street, it was our favorite of all of Italy!
The apartment is 8 minutes away from airport by car. It is very spacious and tranquil. Recommended.

she is great host I feel comfortable I love found someone things like chocolates,coffee bread,te,,many amenities help me a lot.
for you I consider to return with.her

I loved staying in this place! Great location! You can walk to all the places you want to see in Florence.
The interior was so cosy! If I come back to Florence I’m definitely staying here.

Great location! Quiet and easy to access. Everything we needed was right there. Apartment was easy to get into, the kitchen had everything we needed. Beds were comfortable and linens and towels were great. We were there in the winter so we didn’t need A/C, but we noticed the units in every room — would be really nice in the hotter months. Host is easy to communicate with and flexible. Nice that check-in doesn’t depend on host being present.
You must stay here if you are in Florence.  Location is perfect, very clean and charming.  You will have to climb stairs but it is worth it.

Great neighborhood with some excellent restaurants a short walk, a nice bakery and bar (for coffee) on the corner, and a very short walk to Mercato di Sant’Amdrogio. Also just around the corner from Santa and a short walk to the Arno (or alternatively Vivoli’s). Leonardo was always available and helpful. Nice space.

Absolutely a wonderful experience. Location is wonderful, the apartment is just as described and Leonardo is such a terrific host. I highly recommend!
Btw there is a terrific bakery about a 1/2 block from the apartment. Turn right when you leave the apartment. You will be amazed!
Leonardo’s air bnb was exceptional, clean, centrally located, and lovely. I highly recommend this apartment if you are looking for a clean, safe, and comfortable place!

Rosaria has done an amazing job with this AirBnB. Little details such as breakfast items, coffee pods, shower gel and more really helped make us feel at home. The property is super close to the bus stop and only a twenty minute walk from the station. It is clean and well kitted out - with spare towels and bedding if need be. All in all a perfect stay!

We had a great, quick visit to Florence and Lorenzo was very helpful before and during our stay. The apartment had everything we needed and also allowed us to catch up on some laundry! Very convenient to great sites and restaurants and very quiet at night!

This Airbnb is stunning! It felt like a luxury boutique hotel. Air condition and wifi worked perfectly; hosts are super responsive and have a great list of reccos. Located in a really nice and quiet neighbourhood and very close to Giardino Bardini.
The hill climb to get to the place is intense and one of the shower drains was plugged but we still immensely enjoyed our stay.
We’ll definitely rebook when we come back again!

Perfect location, still in town but just a 10-15 minute walk from all the craziness. The place was beautiful, just as listed. Veronica was very responsive and always there to help if anything was needed! Highly recommend

Very convenient location. Best feature for me was the two balconies. Very clean and fresh, plentiful supply of spotless towels. System of codes to get into the building and apartment meant no need to worry about keys or being locked out. Would recommend and definitely stay again.

Veronica was really easy to communicate with. She was very contactable and replied really fast whenever I had any questions. She was really helpful and sent us a guide on the available things we could check out around the area. Place was clean and like what was shown, just slightly old apartment on the outside but perfectly ok if you enjoy a peaceful neighbourhood. Good view.

Great accommodation. Shame there was some issue with the air conditioning but other than that I’d night recommend staying here. Nice quiet location and only a 15 minute walk into the tourist attractions.

Virginia met us at the apartment and accommodated an early check in. The apartment is very spacious and well stocked with towels, soap, kitchen supplies, etc. The location is prime, which was great for easy access to many points of interest (quick walk to Duomo, Ponte Vecchio, Signoria Square, etc) and many great dining options right out the front door. With the location on a well travelled street, we did hear noise from the restaurant below and the street throughout the night (we did not have AC on so the windows were open). This was not too bothersome but something to be aware of.
marusca is the absolute sweetest person! This spot is right in the bustle of Florence and we loved it so much! Our favorite little coffee shop is right below 😭❤️

Rosalia is just great, very supportive and sweet. The place was very clean and just as described. Optimal place to stay if you need to be close to the airport.
Thank Rosalia for your kind support!
It was a great stay. The location is great. Very close to the airport and with the bus (the bus stop is right outside the front door) you are also quickly in the city center. Highly recommended :)

It was really convenient to train station food places attraction only one thing we did not like is the stairs …. We really hada hard time to climb stairs with our luggages but over all good place to live . With good Ac system 😊
Had everything we needed, great location within walking distance to restaurants, stores and  places of interest.  The apartment was clean and nicely decorated. We would stay there again.
The place was very clean and cosy and was very close to all the major attractions.. Will book again. Grazie!!!
Amazing location. 3rd floor walk up, but it’s slapped in the middle of everything! And the famous sandwich shop All Antico Vinaiio was literally downstairs!

This airbnb was in an amazing location with lots of good restaurants nearby. The Duomo is only a 13 minute walk. There was clear communication and fast responses. I highly recommend staying here to experience the true beauty of Florence!
This location is very convenient because of its proximity to the train station. Plenty of restaurants nearby and the best sights within a walkable distance!
This place was a great location! The host was very responsive & the place was exactly what I expected

Great apartment within walking distance to the Duomo. The apartment is just like the pictures and it was very clean. The host was super quick in answering me (our previous host cancelled our booking when we arrived in Florence at 4 pm so it was a last-minute booking for the same day for a week). Can't recommend enough. Check in was in person, super friendly girl and check-out was super easy as well. Would definitely stay here again!

Santo Spirito is the place to be in Florence! This was our second time in Florence and we loved this location, we were able to walk everywhere and it didn’t feel far at all. There are a lot of restaurants in the area and the best gelato downstairs. We were very comfortable in the apartment, it was a bit more than what we wanted to pay, but having 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms for our family of 4 was very convenient. The hosts are very nice, responsive and accommodating. The apartment is very quiet, despite being in a vibrant location and has great A/C in all rooms and bedrooms.

Everything was above expectations. Eleanora was most helpful checking us in, showing the place, and helped with a taxi reservation to go  back to airport.  Communication was excellent. The place is nice, has everything, super-clean, and location is great too. Definitely recommend it.
great location in florence, close to everything. the place was spacious nice and clean. hosts we were very helpful as well.

We had an amazing stay here. Check in was really easy, our host greeted us and was very accommodating in regards to our delayed train.
The apartment was really clean, spacious, and equipped with everything you need for a relaxing stay. The location was convenient and the attractions were all a walkable distance away.
Our host was very kind and helpful. I would highly recommend this apartment and would definitely stay here again!

Amazing location, you are in the middle of everything. Nice old building, which is interesting itself. The room was spacious, with a nice comfy bed. Bathroom / kitchen is ok.
One thing to improve - cell connection often breaks once you step in the building making online key hard to use. Would be nice to share WiFi credentials before check-in, so people won't stuck.

The location was amazing - in close proximity to everything we wanted to do and lots of restaurants/bars. The apartment was small, but doable for 2 people. However, the bathroom had a horrible smell of sewage and the doors to the shower did not keep in the water so every time we showered there was water everywhere. It was also dirty and we believe may have been mold. Overall, the apartment was in great condition, besides the bathroom.
Nice central spot. Can be a bit loud but if you know that going in it’s a solid place.
Nice room in a great location. A bit of a process to get inside with multiple codes and locks, but otherwise fine.
Place was clean and just as advertised.  Host helped us get a taxi at a difficult time.  Very nice, would recommend.

Perfect apartment for my long-term stay! Location was great, very close walk to the city Center but in a more quiet street. Very modern and clean flat, with AC (huge bonus in the summer)!! Communication with Nir was great, and I look forward to staying again!

We stayed at Nir’s place for 4 nights and it was great. The washer/dryer was a nice amenity during our 2 week long trip. Location is great. Walkable distance to bars, restaurants and most tourist sites. We would stay here again
Amazing place in Florence! Very spacious and easy access to the main shopping and attractions. Definitely would book with Nir again!
Nir’s place is just as the pictures.  Everything was very clean and nice.  We would recommend it.   Very well located.

Great place to stay when visiting Florence! The location is convenient and walkable to the city center. Close by to the school of leather, and a fun street with lots of bars and gelato shops. We walked everywhere while visiting for four days. The apt was clean and had AC that kept the place nice and cool during the HOT weather. Check-in was seamless! They met us at the apartment, showed us around and asked if we had any questions. Host was super responsive! Let us check in early and check out late — so accommodating! And the apartment has a shared washer//dryer in a hall outside the apartment (super safe and secure) which was a great bonus. Overall, great stay!

We had a really nice stay here! The appartement was perfect! Everything was clean and everything we needed was in the appartement. The location of the appartement is also great. The host was really nice and gave us some good recommendations.

Absolutely amazing location.
Incredibly convenient. Just a few blocks from Ponte Vecchio, Gallerie degli Uffizi, Piazza del Duomo…
Apartment was very clean.
Bedroom is in upper level, . Bed was comfortable.
Only issue was the place is tiny, a bit too tight for two people. Especially the bathroom, small even for Italian standards: shoulders touch both walls while taking a shower :)

Really cute and cozy place! Located in the heart of the city with so much to do around. Amazing design as well! Thank you to Simone who was really nice and was always ready to help us with any questions.
Highly recommend for your stay in Florence!

Simone’s place was a great place to stay in the heart of Florence. Super close to everything and perfect for our 2 nights there. Was a little small, as marketed, but was just right for two guests - would not recommend any more. Thank you for a great and easy stay!

Awesome stay.
Only problem was air con wasn’t the strongest, however it was 40 plus

We received a very friendly welcome and really enjoyed staying in Mattia’s apartment over the weekend. Only a few minutes to walk to all the main attractions. The kitchen is fitted with basic cooking utensils, salt and pepper but you will have to bring oil for cooking & frying yourself. A small street is right in front but it’s not overly noisy and you hear very little of it when the windows are closed.
All in all, great experience and definitely a recommendation.

We had a great stay in Florence at the apartment! Teona was a great host and sat down with us and provided an elaborate list of restaurants and sights around the lovely city. The room is huge with all the cooking needs you could think as well as being walking distance from all the main attractions and importantly right near the Train station. Thankyou for having us Teona!!
Great spot! Really helpful and quick response- the only thing to complain about were noisy people coming back from their Saturday night out!

Our host responded to all our questions immediately, and was very helpful from start to finish.
The apartment is next to the Santa Maria del Fiore cathedral and walking distance from key attractions in Florence.
The apartment is very nice with 2 bedrooms and 2 baths.
Would definitely recommend it for a family of 3-4 when visiting this beautiful city.

Great apartment close to all attractions. We left our car in the car park for 3 days while we toured.
Steve was amazingly responsive and always available to assist, whatever the questions.
Thanks again, you made our trip to Florence truly memorable.
Leslie and Darlene

Great place in the middle of Florence! The place had everything we needed for our family! The apartment was very close to restaurants and must see sites! Clean, spacious and quiet! Steve was the perfect host, very responsive and helpful! Would recommend!

We only stayed for a night in Florence but the apartment was the perfect location to see all that we wanted to in the short time we were there. The host was incredibly accommodating and communicative - we asked last minute if we could check in early as our train was arriving a couple hours before the check in time, which the host accommodated and later checked in to make sure we were happy with our stay. The place was wonderful, it was just as described and was in a the perfect location! We absolutely loved this place and would happily rebook next time we visit Florence.
Perfect location in the centre of Florence. Easy to access and check-in. The hosts were very responsive and helpful. Highly recommend!

It is in a wonderful location, right at the Duomo, which is a fantastic landmark to visit and to always easy to find in the city when making your way home.   It was easy to instructions to get into the apartment.   Clean and tidy space.

The Airbnb was exactly as pictured. The 2 bedrooms were a very nice size and the beds were very comfortable. We had plenty of hot water and the bathrooms were very nice. Everything was very clean.
The location was amazing. Out the door and the Duomo was right there. We were always able to easily find the apartment. Just an easy 15 minute walk to the Santa Maria Novella train station which made our days trips easy.
The communication with the host was very easy and he responded very quickly to any questions. Instructions to check in were very easy and we had no issues.
We really enjoyed our stay in Firenze!
Great location. Host was very responsive and helpful. We only stayed one night but the house had all  amenities for a long term stay.

Beautiful place right in the middle of the action.  Clean.  There is street noise in the weekend but you can expect that when staying right in the middle of the city.  Hosts were very nice and responsive even when I regrettably had to reach out to them late at night about something.   Would stay here again.
Lorenzo's place was great!  Everything was right.  He was communicative and helpful.  The AC worked well for us.

Great location and great apartment! Everything is as pictured, the apartment is on the third floor with pretty steep stairs but easy to locate. Apartment was comfortable for a family of 5. The only problem was whoever sleeps on the sofa couch dealt with pretty loud street noise, other than that everything was perfect!
Amazing place to stay in Florence. Big apartment with 2 bathrooms (a plus for families !) and very well situated. Instructions were clear. Great deal ! Would recommend

I had such a wonderful time with Roberta and Johnathan. They were very welcoming and helpful for me to explore around the Florence. Also, they helped me learning more on Italian culture and Italian food, which I was hoping to do when I booked the place.
As a female solo traveler, I felt pretty safe and walkable around the location!
It was great to stay in the Florence with them and spend some time with the welcoming and responsible hosts like them:)
I'd love to come back for sure!

The room is large with beautiful antique furniture. Soft south-east light gently pours in through the shuttered windows in the morning. There is a welcoming warm and homely atmosphere and a kitchen with beautiful items for use. The hosts are kind, friendly and very helpful with advice or information. The best airbnb I have ever stayed in by far. A total pleasure

The apartment was very nice, everything you needed was availible. A small grocery is just around a corner, a bakery across the street. I recommend Wanda café for nice breakfast near the big arch! The hosts is friendly and answers questions fast!
Best regards
Malin
For me, this was my favorite place to stay in Florence. I absolutely loved the balcony and the views from the balcony and the rooftop. This is my favorite type of stay and I slept so well.
she was very responsive and helpful! The location was good to take a bus and walkable to the main area
We had a fabulous stay in Patrizia's place ! The appartment has an amazing location, very close to the Galeria degli Uffizi and Ponte Vecchio. Patrizia was very reactive and accomodating.
In the heart of Florence, close to pretty much everything. Easy to find, spacious apartment with brand new furniture. Would definitely stay here again!
The place is great. Modern, clean  and cozy. Close to the train station and walkable to most tourist spots. Just make sure you don’t have heavy luggage since its quite of a climb to the unit.
Great hosts that were extremely helpful and professional. Communication was excellent, wish I could give them more than 5 stars!

We LOVED the loft. It was so perfect and decorated so nicely. Amazing location for getting to and from the train station for an early morning train. Quite. The shower was amazing. Thank you so much for letting us stay at your beautiful apartment!
Second time staying at one of Siddik’s properties! Absolutely loved this location, and it was such a comfortable stay. Can’t wait to come back to Firenze and stay here again!

He is super responsive and the place is  in a great location - walking distance from everything. It is on the top floor so you get a nice little view from upstairs. If you have heavy luggage be prepared to carry that up some flight of stairs. He was very kind and welcoming. Would stay again!

Siddik’s place was good. It looked like the photos and the location is near convenience stores and restaurants, as well as train and bus stations so it was easy to roam around Florence. The apartment was spacious enough for 4 people to enjoy.
The downside to Siddik’s place is that it’s located on the 4th floor, which would give travelers with luggages an extremely hard time in carrying them up and down the apartment. Another thing is that the shower room downstairs was so small that it was hard for us to wash and move around. Also, the doorknob entering the place was a bit hard to figure out how to open. Literally took me 10 mins and all the logic in my mind that was left after carrying 6 pieces of luggage up 4 flights of stairs 😮‍💨. If you dont mind these things, then I can definitely recommend Siddik’s place!
Great location. Felt very secure and safe with the multiple layers of security. Great interior loved it!

We were living at Mattia's place in the time where we was working at the Pitti Fair, it was so nice to live there, we could walk to work and at evening we could also walk to the lovely Restaurant's.
It was nice to get home in the evening to Mattia's place and we just felt like home 🙏❤
If we had any questions we got answer asap 👌 And cool that we could check in late.
We will come again.
All the best to Mattia's
❤Maria

Great cenral location, walkable to all the main attractions. Quiet street. Good air con. Comfy beds, slept well.
The stairs to the main bedroom are narrow and steep, which might be a problem for some people.
Overall, a really pleasurable stay.
Gabri, the host, is kind and her place is cozy. The location is good enough to visit Firenze center by bus. A cool place for Firenze visitors.

Absolutely loved staying at Silvias Airbnb! The place was decorated beautifully with many useful things e.g. a fully kitted kitchen, blankets, plenty of towels, aircon etc… the whole apartment was very clean and in its own ‘courtyard’ type entrance away from the road. Location is amazing too, a short walk from pretty much all the best local restaurants and bars, and then a further 10 minutes to get straight into the city centre. Silvia was so kind and responsive, and helped us out with any issues we had, would love to stay there again!
Great stay!! Very short ride in a taxi or you can also walk to get to the city center. Very responsive and very easy access. I recommend to stay here.

We were 6 staying at Silvia’s place and we found it perfect! The apartment is of a very nice size and has all that you need for having a good comfortable time!
Although the apartment is not located in the city center I would recommend it to other solutions given that the surrounding area is calm and you can easily walk to the city center!
Great communication with the host. The apartment was really cool and clean. Great location, comfortable beds, we would definitely rent the space again if in beautiful Florence ♥️

Silvia is really kind and responded quickly. Whenever I contact her. And the place is really easy to find it and easy to get inside.
For family travel this place is worth.
Silvia was a very nice and attentive host, always ready to help. We really appreciated her hospitality.
Excellent Airbnb and location. Beatrice who we met and communicated with was excellent and a great help when needed. Excellent communication and easy check in. Would definitely recommend!

Found this place best value for money and beyond. The host is really helpful and proactive. He is very responsive in terms of addressing all doubts and supporting in other issues.
Also close to the tram station, which is 15 mins from SMN central station. Walking distance from the place you will find amazing breakfast cafe perfect for early morning quick bites and a local authentic Gelateria, which is also really amazing.
Incredible stay at Andi’s! Very comfortable and it was just as described in the posting. Had everything that we needed for our stay. Fantastic and would stay here next time in Florence.
Great place as described, very clean with an amazing view. we really enjoyed staying here me and my family

Absolutely stunning apartment with a view of the beautiful Tuscan countryside while only being a short drive to the city center of Florence. Be aware that the location is ideal for those who plan to travel into the city by car or taxi. For those who are hoping to use public transit only, it's completely doable but will take more time to walk and then wait for the bus. It's a completely fair compromise and I wouldn't hesitate to stay here again though!

Perfect location to see the sights. Walking distance from everything we needed, couldn’t have imagined staying in another part of the city. Apartment was large and comfortable enough. It was quite loud until 10-11pm which was okay for us,but something to consider. Wifi was touch and go and hot water ran out quickly. The whole apartment complex had a bit of a smell to it .Great heart dryer. Overall our rating is based on value for money for location and ease of access. We felt comfortable and safe throughout our stay.

The location of the apartment is very central but not on the touristic side of Firenze (which is a good thing!). The apartment itself is low standard and needs renovation. Also, the windows are very thin, so that it is very noisy inside at night.

I recently stayed at this Airbnb and had a fantastic experience. The space was incredibly spacious, allowing for ample room to move around comfortably. The beds were exceptionally comfortable, ensuring a restful night's sleep after a long day of exploring the area. The location was perfect, with easy access to nearby attractions and amenities. Additionally, the check-in process was seamless and hassle-free, making for a stress-free start to our stay. Overall, I highly recommend this Airbnb for anyone looking for a comfortable and convenient accommodation option.

Great place! Check in was very easy as the owners reply very quickly. Booked the same day as the stay with no issues. Located in a quiet neighborhood but still within easy walking distance of the city center.
Excellent apartment. Jacopo was very nice and friendly. No problem at all. I recommend this place. It’s huge and very well located
Great stay. Host was accommodating to the issues that we had with losing hot water. Great spacious apartment and comfortable beds.

Spacious apartment in a good location, but the late 5 PM check-in made resolving issues difficult. Despite requesting two cribs in my first message, none were provided. When I contacted the host, no effort was made to help because it was “too late.” Traveling with two babies made this especially frustrating. Disappointing experience with an unhelpful host.
The apartment was perfect! Well decorated and perfectly clean, and Giulia was very responsive and kind! Would absolutely stay again

Had a lovely stay at Giulia's home. It's at a peaceful part of the town, but not too far to walk to the major attractions. It has a modern decor and a very nice court yard. Giulia was very accommodating and let us check in earlier, which was really helpful. Highly recommended!

Lovely apartment within easy walking distance of the main sites in Florence. Giulia was very helpful and responsive. The bins  in the street were emptied during the night which was quite noisy but otherwise the location was very good.

The room is exactly like in the photos—very new, clean, and tidy. Giulia is incredibly thoughtful, considerate, and welcoming. Our whole family absolutely loves her place. If any of my friends visit Florence, I will definitely recommend staying here.

This apartment is so beautiful. It is definitely the most stunning Airbnb I have ever stayed in.  Luisa was such a helpful host. She walked us through the check in process and provided a great list of local recommendations. The apartment was super clean and spacious. It was also within a quick walking distance to the Central Market and most other sights. Would highly recommend!!
Gorgeous flat! Very spacious with high ceilings. Perfect location walkable to the train station and all the restaurants and shops. Ricardo was a very responsive & helpful host.

What a wonderful day! My elderly parents traveled with us, so I was looking for a place with a working elevator and comfortable beds and bathrooms. This apartment checked all the boxes. All of the character in the home was an added bonus. Thank you for a wonderful vacation!

This was a wonderful home-base for our time around Florence. Very walkable to the center of town...an easy walk to the riverfront...and sneaky-close to some lesser-known gems :)
Very peaceful and spacious, tasteful and comfortable throughout, with hosts who offered plenty of clear assistance and well-received recommendations!

Nice one bedroom across the river from the center of Florence. Its about a 20-25 min walk to the center (or a 10min bike ride). Close to the Piazza Michelangelo for amazing sunsets! Wifi was strong, kitchen had everything of you want to cook, air conditioner in both the bedroom and another in the living room. Small balcony with a washer for laundry. Would stay here again!

Loved this apartment!!! It was gorgeous, very clean, and in a great location. Alex was an amazing host — super responsive, kind, and very accommodating. The one thing to note is that the name of the listing is just a bit misleading because, while you do get views OF other buildings’ rooftops from the living room, you don’t get views of the city FROM the rooftop of Alex’s apartment, which is what we assumed would be the case — outdoor rooftop access. This wasn’t a negative for us because we still loved the place so much, but just something to be aware of when booking.
Alessio is as nice as he gets, fabulous, impeccable. Fast respond as rocket. Great guide for parking. Cant be better ! Super recommend

Loved the stay, right from booking to checkout.
Giuseppina is a very warm lady, and she reached out promptly after we booked the place, from suggesting local sightseeing to the way to the apartment. She also helped to keep luggage in the garage given we had the train in the evening. She also left some snacks and a wine bottle for us.
The house itself is big enough to accommodate 3 families (10 members) given 3 full-size rooms + 3 baths and sofa+bed in the living room. The location is perfect with 2 tram stops from the main station (with stop 20m from the entrance).
The flat is swanky, and clean and has all amenities including a washing machine and dishwasher. It has a view of the duommo which made the stay more pleasurable.

Giusy is a great host. The apartment is spacious and very cozy. The T2 tram is right in front so very convenient to get to the center or train station. Wi-Fi can be improved but we will definitely stay here again when in Florence!

Great place to stay for a visit in Florence. Train station directly before the apartment. Place was great with a beautiful view on the Dom. And good to reach from the city center. Either by feet or by train. The apartment itself was good with all necessary furnitures. Giusy, the host was amazing. Proactive, very friendly and helpful and quick in respond. Thanks for the amazing opportunity.
Lovely stay at Silvia's! The apartment is rustic and original, making one feel a real part of Florence.
We had a great time at Silvia's place. We had plenty of room for our family of 5. It was in a great spot and easy to access the surroundings. Would not hesitate to stay there again.

Very nice place to stay in great area of Florence.  Silvia was extremely helpful and responsive and the property is in a great location to explore all the highlights of Florence.  Note that if you are driving, the ZTL and restricted areas can make it a bit challenging to drop off and pick up guests and get to parking, so plan accordingly.

We had a wonderful stay at Silvia’s Airbnb. She is a fantastic host and made everything seamless. A member of her team met us at the door upon arrival and gave us a thorough tour of the apartment, which was incredibly helpful. The apartment itself is even more beautiful than the photos—spotlessly clean, fully equipped, and full of charm. We especially loved the historic frescoes and wall reliefs that made us feel like we were truly immersed in the history of Florence. The location is perfect, within easy walking distance of all the major sights. Highly recommended!

Amazing location in the middle of town. Very walkable to many local attractions.
Will definitely come back.

This house couldn’t have been more perfect for our trip. Easily the best thing about it is the location - incredibly close to so many things, particularly restaurants! I can’t say enough good things about it, absolutely stay here if you’re visiting downtown Florence!

This place was absolutely perfection. Walkable to literally everything, steps away from the Uffizi, and absolutely gorgeous inside. One of those places that makes you feel like a local. Set on a narrow street with adorable shops and cafes. Will absolutely stay again.

Great little studio. Felt like home and the proximity to everything was very nice. It wasn’t loud at night and check in/checkout was easy. I would stay here again. Make sure to visit the little restaurants and wine bars right outside the front door.

Clean, comfortable apartment in the most perfect central location. Great host, clear and detailed instructions. Washer and dryer was helpful. Excellent restaurants right outside the building. Don't hesitate to book this place!

The apartment was in the perfect location for our visit to Florence, right between the Uffizi museum and the Ponte Vecchio. Many shops and restaurants nearby. Apartment was sparking clean and had everything we needed for our stay. Host was good communicator. We enjoyed every minute of our stay. Highly recommend!
The apartment was lovely. The attention to detail in terms of amenities was incredible. Annalisa was super prompt. Definitely would love to return.
nice and small apartment with wifi , not far from local shops about 10-15 minute walk.

We loved our stay in this apartment! There are many personal touches within the Airbnb as well as the communication with the hosts. It is wonderfully located and we were able to walk most places we wanted to go. Thank you for a lovely visit!

This was a great spot in a great area. It had everything you would need and was close to everything. We really enjoyed our stay and the hosts were very helpful and responsive. Would definitely recommend!

Great place. Tranquil patio area. Fantastic location that was near enough to the busy part of the city to get to it on foot, but removed enough to be more peaceful in the evening. Comfortable bed. The couch was decidedly uncomfortable, but we didn't choose the place for its couch lol. Our favorite restaraunt in the city was also a literally couple doors away. It's the place with a handwritten menu. Best carbonara I've had in my life. They prefer reservations but we were able to get in with a bit of a wait.

Superb apartment, exactly as described and more spacious than the photos give credit for. Excellent location if you’re using Florence as a base for day trips as it’s very close to the main train station.
Mateo is a an excellent host, with clear, easy instructions, and very responsive with lots of good recommendations (the Piazza Michelangelo is walking distance - coming back down! - from the apartment). Would highly recommend!

Nice apartment, very close to train station, which is very helpful if you are using the trains, buses, or street car.  On a street with everything; restaurants, shops, and small piazze.  Very close to the tourist areas, and sites, but still in a quiet local neighborhood.  Small well appointed kitchen, full living room, and bedroom.  Bathroom is small but functional.  Up one flight of stairs (wide stairway.) Check in easy, Host is great, always responded immediately to our inquires, or requests.  Check out simple.  Great for get away days.

Our host communicated with us extremely well. We got ourselves a bit lost at first, but he got us right back on track. This apartment is in a great location! It is a very short walk (5-7 minutes) from the train station and super close to many excellent Michelin rated restaurants!
Great place to stay. Walkable distance from everything, well appointed flat, extremely communicative and helpful host.

Great cute place to stay. Perfect location to shop, activities, groceries, restaurants, & tourist attractions.
The front door has a lock that is tricky to open.
The host is very nice & responsive. There was wonderful cake & cookies we munched on.
fast internet, toilet flushes well, strong water pressure in the small shower.
We didn't use the kitchen much except for the electric hot water kettle. Definitely would return again!

I had the pleasure of staying at Sara's place for a month and Sara was a great hostess! She was always very responsive to any questions or requests I had, and was very thorough in setting up the apartment and amenities so that our stay was enjoyable. She made sure we had fresh towels and linens every week, and kept the apartment well stocked with kitchen and cleaning supplies. This apartment is newly renovated and is at a great location for long stays - only a few minutes walk from multiple grocery stores, pharmacies, and a bus stop. If you're looking for a place in a quieter neighborhood that is just a 10-15 minute bus ride from the Florence city center, this is a great option! Will be looking to stay here again the next time I come to Florence!

Great apartment very clean and modern. Sara is a great host.
Looked after us very well.
Location is a wee bit out of town but close to bus routes or a reasonable walk into town, which we enjoyed.
There's a decent cafe just around the corner too.
We enjoyed a lot our stay at Sara's place! Everything was clean and the appartement has all what we needed. Thank you very much, we warmly recommend this place!

Everything in the apartment was perfect: the bed, the shower, the living room, everything. The location was excellent, as the bus stop was on the corner, allowing easy access to the city center and the central metro station. I highly recommend it. I wish I had stayed longer.

Sara was very friendly and helpful and gave good recommendations on places to eat.  Flexible to leave your luggage if you reach before check in time and after check out. Sara’s place is very clean, newly renovated and near supermarket Lidl.

Our stay was perfect for what we needed, the apartment was clean and tidy. The area had very good bus and tram routes into the centre of Florence. Sara was very friendly and gave us good recommendations for food and places to go.

Very nice and clean apartment, super friendly hosts. A bit out of the city center (30-40 minutes walk) but there is a bus stop around the corner so it only takes 20 minutes to get to the center. Thank you Stefania and Elisa for the wonderful stay!

A nice oasis in a quiet neighborhood of Florence and a quick 15-20 minute walk to the sites.  The host, Elisa, checked in with me periodically to ensure that everything was okay and whether I needed anything.  Would be glad to stay there again for any future trips to Florence.

We’ve been to many Airbnb’s and have had many great experiences, but Elisa and Tania are the best hosts we ever met. The place is clean, well situated and well equipped. But the real value is our hosts: how welcoming, helpful, and genuinely nice.
Thank you again Elisa and Tania for the help, the recommendations, the aperitivo and wine. We had a great time in Florence and will stay again at your place when we come again. All the best! ☺️
So thrilled Sebastiano's Airbnb was available during my dates of travel - location was perfect, room was clean, and will be back to stay again next time I am in Florence.
This was the perfect place to stay. Perfect location, amazing apartment. And the host did everything to make it super simple. Definitely a place to go back.

Andrea’s apartment was wonderful! Right on palazzo pitti, so very easy to walk to many of the main attractions but also peaceful inside. The living room is sun filled and beautiful. There is AC, which is great in the summer, and the kitchen is well-stocked. If I ever move to Florence, I would live here.

It’s very nice stay, this house very close to Pitti plaza and easy walk to all the sightseeing points
Not too far from the station too
The shower works great and air conditioning as well
House is very clean and organized , have all the cooking equipments you need

Nice place to stay. Marta was very responsive.
Location is a good starting point to explore the city. A few minutes walking from the Duomo but also Uffizi museum and all other highlights.

It was a perfect 5 star experience ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Hospitality, service and the apartment are all extremely top notch

As an Airbnb host, we are always looking forward to staying at other Airbnbs and Marta's place was not a disappointment. It was beautifully presented. We were a family of 7, meeting up from all over the world and we appreciated the size of the apartment. Also each bedroom had an en-suite which we loved. It was very clean. The location is great, being within walking distance of the Centro Storico and the bars and restaurants of S Croce. We would recommend Marta's place to anyone looking for a quiet family retreat in the heart of Florence. Thanks Marta and hope to visit again.

We had a wonderful stay at Marta's place, the home is beautifully designed and in the perfect location. Every bedroom had its own bathroom and airconditioner which, travelling with 6 people, was exactly what we needed. The kitchen was well apointed and had all things needed to have a nice meal at the home.
Marta's mother, Eleonora, was exceptional - she met us the location helped with the check-in, provided eveything we needed to know about the home and the surrounding area. We also had dinner at Eleonor's restaurant - Toto's, and it was the best meal of our trip. We'll be back!
We had a great time.  It was super convenient that each bedroom has its own bathroom and toilet. The place was very clean and close to all must-visit places in Florence.

This apartment was beautifully decorated and it was very clean.  All 4 bathrooms worked great and it was really nice that all bedrooms had a separate bathroom. The location was perfect and the street was quiet.

We had the best few days in beautiful Florence and the apartment was amazing. It was wonderful to be in such a central spot and Marta was helpful, friendly and great to communicate with. Highly recommend - beautiful place to stay and thank you Marta once again for making us feel welcome and comfy in your gorgeous home.
Very comfortable stay for our large group! The bathrooms were super clean and modern as well. Thank you Marta for a perfect stay.
Loved everything about this special apartment in this special city. Super comfortable and walkable to everything.  Beautiful aesthetics!

Beautiful room, very clean and secure apartment.
Five minute walk to the tram stop for easy access into the city. Very clear and detailed check in and check out instructions. Great spot to stay!
This was a lovely place to stay, so close to the train station that takes you to the city center and the room was spacious and comfortable. Would definitely stay here again!
The place was great and huge! Loved how we were so close to everything and the leather market! I thought it would be loud but those shutters really kept the noise out.  Would stay here again!
This apartment was in the perfect location, central walking distance to everything! Inside, it was spotless and huge! I’d absolutely come back and stay here again while visiting Florence!

We had such a fantastic stay! The location is perfect, directly between the train station and the Duomo. The person that met us for check-in was so kind and humorous and gave lots of great suggestions for things to see. Amenities we really loved: cold AC, elevator, balcony, blow dryer, and the washer/dryer. I also wanted to note that it’s so helpful to have a host willing to store your luggage before/after your stay. That was greatly appreciated. The leather market outside was definitely very busy but we didn’t have any issues navigating around it, I even got myself a leather souvenir! Thanks again to Francesca and their team!
Location was good! Place has lots of amenities. Host thought of everything! Somebody told us that we were close to where the locals hang out vs tourists.  Literally right next to the rose garden.
Thank you for your hospitality. The details of this space were perfect. Location was one of our favorites. Can’t go wrong with any of the restaurants in this area.

Simona is super communicative, responsive and friendly host! The apartment is ever better than on the pictures, the views from all windows and the terrace are tremendously beautiful! You can find literally everything in the apartment for your comfort (especially in the kitchen), WiFi is good and suitable for work. Simona also helped us a lot with free parking lot for the weekend, that was a big deal and super appropriated! Dear Simona, grazzi mile for your hospitality:)

Simona is a wonderful host. She was super helpful with her recommendations given it was our first visit to Florence. The house is beautiful with a lot of character and made us feel at home straight away. We spent a couple of nights at this house and enjoyed the lovely walk to the Duomo, soaking in all the sights, small local shops and enjoyed hospitality of close by restaurants. All in all a great place to relax and make it your home for the stay.

Simona is a very professional, friendly, host.
She made us feel very welcome and relaxed.
Communication was excellent with many recommendations for site-seeing etc.
The apartment is equipment with everything you could ask for and the location is perfect, whether you choose to walk or bus.
Great sunset from the roof terrace!
Thank you for sharing your lovely home with us.
Ps. Thank you for the delicious panna cottas!

We had a wonderful 10 days in Florence at Simona’s apartment. Perfect location and far enough away from the crazy busy Summer crowds. Easy walking into the cobbled streets of old Florence to visit museums, duomo and the many gorgeous laneways and the Ponte Vecchio. Simona was so helpful with suggestions and easy to communicate with before and during our stay. Perfect apartment for 2 couples with enough space to have some quiet time. Gorgeous views out over the rooftops of Florence. Parking available just a few steps away from the apartment and easy access to roads leading out to the Tuscan hills. Would highly recommend this listing! Thank you Simona for all that you did for us, we will miss you! X
Simona is a very kind, welcoming host and her tips regarding transportation were particularly helpful. We would gladly stay here again if given the chance!

We had a wonderful stay at this house. It was spacious, clean, and generally beyond our expectations. The view is beautiful  and the location is convenient - just a few minutes walk from major attractions. Our host was incredibly helpful and friendly; even going the extra mile to greet us personally and ready to help us with anything.

This was my first booking in an airbnb and I’m afraid we will be forever spoiled. The descriptions are spot on. Our hostess went out of her way to check in on us and to make sure everything was perfect!  She also made us feel very comfortable to ask for anything we needed. If you are reading this review—stop—and book this place before it is taken!  You will be very happy you did!!

We stayed only for 1 night but we'd definitely stay again next time we visit Firenze again. Communication was easy, fast
they're super nice! it was safe and quiet
comfortable bed too! Thank you!

Raoul’s place was easy to reach by tram from the train station. He was incredibly kind and accommodating, even letting us check out late. The apartment was cool, comfortable, and well-equipped—including thoughtful touches for our small dog. Great air conditioning, smart TV, private parking, and a supermarket just a few blocks away. Highly recommended for a stay in Florence!

The apartment is really meant to Welcome guest. Giulia made sure that the house is fully equipped with what guest really want to have during the stay. Bus stops just below of the house. We love the roof top balcony most. We took photos for the scenic view of Florence. Higy recommended to stay.

We felt like home in this apartment!
Giulia was very helpful and responsive. Definitely we will choose to stay here next time as well!
The flat is new renovated and clean, great location, walking distance to everywhere, the space is big enough for 2 ppl. We liked it.

Giulio was a great host with a beautiful property. It is more quaint than what it looks like in the photos and is on the 4th floor but the building is beautiful and the location was excellent. We spend the whole day adventuring around town and it was all within 10 minutes. I’d definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful stay at Giulio’s place! We stayed for 4 nights and it’s was a perfect size for 2 people and the space was full of character. A great central location with all the main sights within a short walking distance.

Location was fantastic and the place way clean. My only thing of note is that it was so loud in the mornings between the construction going on right outside on the street and the market setting up. Other than that it was a great!

This was our first Airbnb experience and it was fantastic! Giulio was very responsive and we found the apartment to be exactly as described. The location was easy to find, perfectly located within easy walking distance to all attractions and restaurants. Important to note - the apartment is on the top floor (approx 60 steps) and as would be the case for any building like this in or near the center of Florence, there is no elevator/lift.
Ours was a wonderful experience! We recommend selection of this property and working with our host, Giulio, to anyone considering a a trip to Florence.
We loved our stay, the location is perfect - very close to all the meaningful places. Slightly noisy, but we got used to is from the second night. Very comfortable pillows. Certainly recommend.
Our family had a great stay at Giulio’s accommodation. Giulio communicated well and the accommodation was clean and convenient to all amenities.

Excellent place in the heart of Florence. Clean, tidy and reasonably private. Great hosts- lots of local advice and recommendations. Lots of stairs - so not ideal if you have lots of luggage.
Laundry service 2 doors down - 12 euros for 3kg of washing all washed, dried and folded within 24hrs.
Water pressure pretty poor and wifi speed pretty poor (likely just from city demand).
But overall great stay 😀

We were two days in Florenz and loved to stay in Ponte Vecchio Room (very big and bright room with a balcony and a wonderful view over the city of Florenz). We felt very comfortable and everything was clean and cozy.
Lovely place, nice and clean, sunlight. All went well with check in.Host was responsive.

The stay was pretty good. The room was very clean and the in house amenities were very nicely kept.
The apartment is just 10 min bus ride away from the city center therefore the apartment area was very calm and peaceful.
Very fast response of the electrical issue at the late night. The apartment is clean and cosy. We also can leave the luggages at Mamo’s office which is a bonus.
A very pretty and safe place to stay.  We were greeted outside by Ximena who was waiting for us,  which made it very welcoming. Very close to restaurants, supermarkets and tramway. We recommend it.

The place was just as pictured with such a lovely view.  Tomasso was so helpful and responded right away with any questions or needs we had.  The home/apartment is small, but great for a couple.  Very romantic little place.  Be prepared for a bit of a steep walk if you are visiting the area by foot!  We walk a lot, but could see how it may be difficult for someone who is not used to walking.   The neighborhood is quaint and just across the river is where all the action is happening.  Great place to get away from the crowds!

Gabriel’s communication was the best of any AirBnB or Vrbo we’ve stayed in. Being in Italy for the first time, we were unsure how it would go, but it turned out great. Highly recommend.
The shower stall is a little tight, but manageable. My wife would like more lighting in the bathroom, but no complaints at all.
Great location, could walk to almost everything, including the train station.

What can I say , if you want a base to explore central Florence then this is it !
50m from end of Ponte Vecchio
10-15 mins walk to most sites
3min to Pitti Palace and Bobboli Gardens
Small supermarket on other side of street
2 local bar/ cafes within 50m
Stylish apartment with all amenities including good washing machine and strong shower
Gabriel super helpful host thanks
Would happily return here :)
Best location in Florence. Super close to all the main attractions. Parking was close and the host was amazing. 10/10!!!
This apartment is in a perfect location in Florence! Everything is walkable and felt very safe. Check in was really easy and the apartment is so beautiful! The bed is very comfy!!
Beautiful apartment in a wonderful piazza! Looked exactly as described and the photos! We loved our stay here!
Absolutely amazing apartment in an incredible location in Florence. 1000% will be back here the host was very friendly and accommodating. Can’t recommend it enough

Thanks for everything you’ve helped to us. You recommended the supermarket which is nearby the apartment and I don’t have the adapter then you bought a new one to me! So incredible! The apartment is so clean, tidy, comfortable and stylish! We love love love so much! Strongly recommend!

My stay at Anna’s apartment in Florence was too short — I wish it could have been longer. I felt right at home in the apartment, which is perfectly laid out and very spacious. It has a beautiful view across the rooftops of central Florence, and is only a short walk to everything Florence has to offer. I walked every day, exploring museums, markets, restaurants, bars, and cafes, and I looked forward to returning to Anna’s apartment each day. For those less likely to walk, trams and buses are at your doorstep. I also enjoyed walking in a direction away from the center to enjoy dinner in local restaurants.

A beautiful apartment less than a mile from city center. We found a great restaurant 1 block away, recommended by a local - Vecchio Carlino 1919. Everything was as described and host was communicative and responsive.

We are so grateful for Aris’s service and recommendations. He was very kind and attentive to our requests. He gave us good suggestions for places and restaurants. We also had an inconvenience with our suitcase and he lent us a screwdriver to fix it. We truly enjoyed our stay, thank you for everything.
Easily accessible location and a great host! Donatella went above and beyond with her hospitality.
parking makes us comfortable to stay and travel. The rooms are nice , we are so happy like stay at our home.

The location is perfect, close to everything, transport, train station and restaurants, shops and sites.
Our host Donatella has helpful and obliging.
Check out Osteria Pastella....the past was something different, hand made and I highlight recommended having it cooked in the cheese wheel.
What do you say, great accommodation, amazing location and excellent value for money.
THANK YOU. ❤️
Enjoyed my time here! Perfect space for solo travelers or couples. Felt incredibly safe and enjoyed my time in and out of the apartment!

The place was nice, bathroom was very small, a large man would have a hard time with it. It's on a fairly busy street but the windows do a good job of blocking the street noise. Marco was helpful and responsive.

Loved staying here while I was studying in Florence for a month. The hosts are very friendly, responsive, and willing to help when you run into problems. The apartment was also very clean. I will definitely stay here again!

We had a wonderful time in Michelas House. It was the perfect calm getaway after a long day in the busy streets of Florence.
Nice authentic tuscan house - a dream. Very clean and with a comfy bed.
Since we were cooking a lot we were also really happy about the kitchen.
If we ever visit Florence again we hope Michelas house will be available.
thanks Michela.

Thanks Bruna for being a great host. Appreciate you are very responsive on all steps of the booking. The best thing about your place is the location, wow nothing was more than 10 min walking. The apartment is very comfortable, woth all the amenities we needed, very practical, all we needed for an Airbnb. Thanks again!

Well appointed apartment in a great central location. Apartment is on the eighth floor, and the elevator went out right after check in, but the host quickly got a repair person out to resolve the issue. Meanwhile, we got our steps in!

What a perfect place Bruna has, it exceeded our expectations completely. Perfectly placed right in the centre of Florence, walking distance from everything you could want to see, even the train station for day trips to other towns. The apartment was easily accessible with a great view and everything you could need to make your stay comfortable. The air con is an added bonus after long, hot days exploring. Highly recommend!

We had an excellent stay, the apartment is very central and it was easy to visit all the places we wanted to see in Florence.  There's lots of places to eat nearby, the apartment was clean and comfortable, perfect for our short stay.  Thank you Bruna.
Love love loved our stay at Bruna’s place! She was so accommodating and the apartment was beautiful. We loved how close it was to all the sights and so much to do! Highly recommend!
Loved the place!  Great location and  beautiful view of the Tower from the rooms.  Really appreciate the responsiveness of the host - as well as the list of restaurants/activities provided.  Ciao!

Bruna was very helpful. She gave us a guide of the city and was always fast to answer any questions.
Thank you so much Bruna
Very helpful and responsive. Place was clean and so close to places we wanted to visit.  Great experience!!!

We had a great time in Florence!
Bruna’s apartment was a great find! Really comfortable with everything we needed to enjoy our stay! It is close to everything!!!
Bruna recommended a lot of restaurants and places to visit!
Thank you Bruna!!!

Our stay in Florence was absolutely wonderful, thanks to our incredible host, Bruna. From the moment we arrived, she went above and beyond to make us feel at home, offering great local recommendations and ensuring we had everything we needed. Her warm hospitality and attention to detail truly made our experience special. The accommodation was charming, clean, and perfectly located for exploring the city. We couldn’t have asked for a better host or a more memorable stay. Grazie mille, Bruna! We hope to return soon!
Clean. Cute. Wonderful view. Great location.  Only downside the stairwell was very smelly but the apartment was awesome. Thanks for a great stay!

Bruna is a great host. Great communicator and provided very good information of what to eat. Her room is in city center and can get into key attractions in a few minutes. The room is spacious with everything needed. Great place to stay in Florence.
My family greatly enjoyed the stay at Bruna's place, great location, very quiet and relaxing, and clean, we loved it!
It was a memorable stay in Florence! The penthouse has a great view and private! We love Florence! Will book the unit again!
Good location. There was some construction in the street but we didnt hear too much noise during our time.
Great stay.  Location could not be better for exploring the hear of Florence. Fantastic view of the tower.

This apartment is at a perfect location. Everywhere is within walking distance. Caterina is also extremely friendly and supportive. She gave us a lot of travel recommendations and she really stepped beyond to make sure we have the best experience in Florence.
