We stayed 2 adults and 4 kids . It was super comfortable and beautiful appartment in lovely and quiet neighborhoods with great restaurants near by. Easy and enjoyable walk to all landmarks. Communication with Caterina was excellent, she responded fast and was very helpful. We enjoyed our stay a lot and would highly recommend this property!
Thank you Caterina

Stayed in Caterina’s beautiful apartment for a week. It is just like it looks in the photos, and was beautifully clean with excellent sheets and towels. Lift access to top floor very helpful with bags and 3 generations in our small family group of 4.
Particularly liked Caterina's helpful guest book that included lots of relevant suggestions for shops, cafes and restaurants.
Location is fantastic, and for art lovers, the Brancacci chapel is just around the corner. Caterina is a very responsive host and I highly recommend her apartment!
Beautiful place in Firenze. Easily one of the cleanest air bnbs I’ve been to. My family really enjoyed staying here. I would surely book this place again. 5 stars

Overall, the house was gorgeous!! Very spacious, had great amenities inside. There wasn’t a ton to do within walking distance, but the bus stop was just down the street about a four minute walk. We just had to figure out the bus schedule really well. Beds were comfortable, sheets were nice, green bathroom shower was wonderful!

Lovely space, absolutely huge, very well appointed and very comfortable. In an older building with fabulous music floors, located on the second floor, all new double glazed windows so it is very quiet. Beds are very comfortable. Great bathrooms with fantastic showers, large well stocked kitchen. Having a washing machine and dishwasher was wonderful.
We had one very minor issue and I sent a note at 7:55am, we had a detailed response by 8:05am; so appreciated!
Thank you!!
We loved our stay here! A little outside of the main city with so much to do still. It was perfect.
Great spacious apartment, nicely decorated rooms, alittle bit outside the busy city centre of Florence but that was good thing, 20-25 minute walk in by the river, would recommend this apartment

I was only in town for a conference and had a great time staying at Andrea & Antonella's place. They were very accommodating during check-in despite my arriving late at night instead of when I originally planned.
The place was great, super conveniently located in walking distance of old town and there are plenty of places to eat nearby. Also a large coop just 5 minutes away.

We enjoyed are stay in Andrea’s home. A little walk into the centre (20 mins) but nice to be slightly removed from all the bustle of the historic centre and still in a
Cool part of the city. Andrea was so helpful getting us there with trains and it was a great base with a super comfortable bed. Thank you!☺️

We had a great stay at the apartement. Antonella and Andrea were really helpful with everything. The area around the apartement is really nice with a lot of Restaurants and little shops, not too far from the city center.

Conveniently located near the train station, the house is very tidy, clean and provides detailed explanations about the products in a careful manner. They respond quickly and make appropriate arrangements

Great apartment just a couple blocks from the Firenze SMN train station and with amazing views of the Duomo. Just stayed one night before an early flight out and very much appreciated the mere 10 minute cab ride to the airport. Everything seemed brand new and checkin and walk through was great. Would definitely stay here again.
Great location. Very nice and quiet. Close to everything. It seems to be best part of town. There are a lot of great restaurants around.
This is one of the best parts of Florence. This is our second time in this apartment. It’s close to everything and very quiet. Great for a family.

Clean apartment outside of the train station and near the bus station for easy access to public transit. Walkable to all areas of Florence. Firm beds and some noise throughout the night but was sufficient for our needs.

This Airbnb was absolutely wonderful with a stunning view of Florence. The location was great and accessible to all the spots we wanted to see, and Filippo was a very communicative and kind host. Highly recommend staying here.

I wish I had more hands so that I could give this place 4 thumbs up. Lorenzo was such a help and such a beautiful soul. He was very quick to respond, answered any question I could have even before I thought to ask. He checked in with me everyday I stayed, I could not ask for a better host.
As far as the place.. PERFECT location, close enough to everything, but thankfully not right in the middle of all of the touristy chaos. A few blocks away from everything, but super peaceful day and night. An amazing bakery 1 min walk away and amazing lunch/dinner spots very close as well.
Inside was everything that I could ask for from an air bnb in Italy. This was the type of place I pictured when imagining a trip to Italy. Everything was clean, had all of the space we needed and the balcony was the perfect cherry on top.
Highly recommend!

Lorenzo and Lodovica were amazing hosts! They were very responsive and helpful. The place was beautiful and very close to everything by foot! I highly recommend staying here! We had a great time in Florence!

The location was great...easy access to the bus and lots of great restaurants around. The bakery, a block away, was amazing. We were there every day getting fresh focaccia bread.
Lorenzo and Lodovica really are super hosts. We had a few questions about the place and their replies were fast. We are on the older side and Lorenzo even offered to meet us and help with our bags. A lovely offer that we didn't need. The stairs were fine.
The apartment was spacious and the beds were comfortable. It was a quiet place to retreat after a busy day in Florence and when were weren't eating out it was easy to make dinner "at home".
Thanks for a wonderful couple of weeks!!

It is an absolutely beautiful home and the hosts were very kind and responsive. The location is very close to the centre so you can easily walk. The perfect place to stay if you’re coming to Florence.

We had a fantastic visit!  The apartment was perfectly located, close to main attractions but far enough away to be peaceful.  Some lovely restaurants nearby and great recommendations from hosts.  We would definitely recommend and would love to return again in the future.  Thank you Lorenzo and Lodovica!

Lorenzo’s apartment was the perfect home base for mine and my wife’s short getaway to Florence! Very easy to get in and out of (note - some stairs), safe, quite large, well appointed and air conditioned, and the location was perfect for all we wanted to do. Close to the Scuola Del Cuoio, a working wine window, even right above a fantastic restaurant! Lorenzo also wrote to give us so many helpful tips and things to do. Wish we could’ve stayed longer!!
Lorenzo and Lodovica were excellent hosts! Super sweet, helpful and very responsive. Loved our stay at their place and the location is excellent for walking to sights, museums, shops and restaurants.

Wonderful location with great views.
The balcony is exceptional, rolling views of the hills and you can also watch people roaming the plaza and enjoying the church of Santa Croce. Local restaurants all on the door step. Easy walk to all main attractions.

It was clean and nice apartment as you can see in the pictures. Our host Seif was really a good communicator and also a good guide of Firenze. Although there was a small problem with washing machine, he came and check up what was going on. He fixed it when we were out. He was really a trustworthy host. I appreciate all his sincere greeting!

My family and I had an amazing stay at Seif's place! The accommodation was comfortable, clean, and exceeded my expectations. The location was perfect, and the service was exceptional. Seif was a fantastic host—very responsive, attentive, and went above and beyond to ensure a great experience. Highly recommend this Airbnb to anyone looking for a memorable stay. Would definitely book again!
fancy kicthen，clean and large bedroom.  However，the oldstyle room key is a little bit hard to use.
Seif is a great host.  Incredibly responsive and helpful.  His place a great location a short walk from city center.

My family and I spent a few days in Florence and our stay at Seif’s place was truly amazing. Seif was very responsive and gave excellent recommendations for restaurants and things to do. Lovely and quiet neighborhood.

When we first entered the apartment, we were blown away by the aesthetic and atmosphere of the place. It was truly luxurious and feels like real care was put into the furnishings and accessories to make it splendidly accommodating and comfortable.
Seif was also a welcoming host, and personally greeted us and helped us move in on our first day. He was friendly and welcoming when showing us around the house and even prepared a guestbook at the entryway for all his insights about Florence and its treats!
It was definitely a brilliant experience that made our time in Florence all the more memorable and worthwhile; would strongly recommend.

Seif’s apartment was beyond beautiful. Our family had a wonderful time
In Florence and the apartment was a highlight. One of the most beautiful places we have stayed. It is within walking distance to many areas you want to visit and Seif was so helpful in arranging tours and giving us recommendations for restaurants and sights. Can’t wait to return.

Leonardo was a great host. He was very communicative and helpful finding restaurants and scheduling the meeting time for check-in at his place. The house was clean and as described (small flat on the top floor), which was great for our group of three young guys staying. I would stay again at any place Leonardo hosts!

I had a wonderful stay at Jessica's place during my first visit to Florence. The accommodation was clean, comfortable and exactly as described. it made the perfect home away from home.
Jessica was an incredibly welcoming and helpful host She provided recommendations for sightseeing, food and drink, ensuring we experienced the best of Florence. Her hospitality made our travel plans so much smoother and more enjoyable.
I highly recommend her place to anyone visiting Florence. Thank you, Jessica, for an unforgettable stay!!
Beautiful and eclectic apartment full of charm! Great neighborhood to stay in with plenty of restaurants and things to do. Highly recommend!

A beautiful, spacious and peaceful apartment away from the hustle and bustle of the centre and a host who really goes out of her way to make sure your stay is memorable.
A 30 min walk from the centre if you like exploring like we do, or a 15-20 min hop on the bus (No. 7 stops about 100m up the road. Simply go left as you exit the apartment).
Jessica gave us a load of recommendations for restaurants (breakfast at Ditta Artigianale is a must), bars, sightseeing and supermarkets. She was so helpful.
We’ll definitely be back again.

Gabriele was very responsive and did all he could to help us feel welcome.
There are a lot of stairs in the entrance.
Gabriele was a super host and very helpful! The apartment was great! Nice peaceful street but close to lots of tourist spots! Will definitely stay again

It was a pleasure to be hosted in this place. Clean and nicely decorated apartment, with nice photographies as a plus, besides being located not far from the center (you can get there in a few minutes with the streetcar). Very comfortable and spacious room, besides being in a quiet area where you can sleep very well. Francesco is a very nice and funny person. I learned with him many things about Italy and the Italian language. It will be my first choice the next time I go back to Florence!
This place was great! Good location. Easy to check in. Parking right outside. Comfy bed. Felt secure. Awesome neighbourhood and an extremely helpful host. We’ll be back again
Great place to stay away from the noise but close enough to city center and amazing restuarants. Julinda's place being very clean was also very appreciated!

The apartment is in a very convenient place and it's easy to reach the city center by foot.
The room was clean and the area is quite charming.
Julinda is a kind host and she is very supportive.
Great location and an easy walk to shops and main attractions in Florence.  Host maintains good communication throughout the stay. Highly recommended!

I loved this Airbnb. The location was fantastic and the little coffee shop across the street has the best cappuccino in Italy. The apartment is exactly as described. It is clean, it is comfortable and it has lots of room. Communication with the host was excellent and he had lots of suggestions to my inquiries. Some people have commented about the noise in their reviews. It is true that there is a bit of noise at night because there’s a wine window adjacent to the apartment, which attracts tourists. However, we used a white noise app and had no problem sleeping. I don’t think you can avoid noise in central Florence so this is a non-issue.
I would stay here again in a heartbeat.

Beautiful apartment in a great location. We were a group of 5 adults on a girls trip and had ample beds and bathrooms to accommodate us getting ready.  Comfortable beds. Loved the fresco in dining room. The location was perfect. Very easy walk to museums, restaurants and shopping on both sides of the river. We enjoyed the wine window below the apartment. Highly recommend this apartment.
Nice, modern flat.  Be prepared to carry luggage up 90 steps as there is no elevator (small inconvenience).  I would stay here again.
Lorenzo he is smile and kind guy!!the house it was very good and clean,the room it was comfortable,the neighbour is completely quite and no so touristic place..is a good idea to be there!!
Our favorite place we stayed at our entire trip to Italy. The view from the huge living room windows is simply stunning!! The place was extremely clean and beautifully designed! 10/10

We had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Florence! The location truly couldn’t be better — everything was within walking distance, from historic landmarks to charming cafes and restaurants. It made exploring the city so easy and enjoyable.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and had everything we needed for a short stay. The only small hiccup we had was figuring out the automatic lock system at check-in, but once we got it sorted out, everything went smoothly.
Overall, a great home base for anyone looking to experience the beauty of Florence on foot. Would definitely stay here again!
We loved our stay at Nadia’s apartment. It was cozy and well-equipped, with everything we needed. Nadia was friendly and helpful.

Nadia’s Airbnb had everything you needed. Out of main city but close to train station which is a 5min ride to main train station. Bed and pull out couch were comfy. Lovely big bowl of fruit on arrival and kindly let us store our bags before check in. Would recommend

We had an absolutely delightful stay at this stunning apartment! it was clean, cozy, and had a peaceful vibe that made us feel right at home from the moment we arrived. My wife and I spent three nights here, unwinding after our daily adventures, and we couldn’t have asked for a more perfect base.
What truly elevated the experience was our host, Chiara. She welcomed us with a warm smile, gave a thorough and thoughtful tour of the space, and gave us recommendation’s for local insights, from must-try restaurants just steps away to great tips for getting around the city effortlessly. Her genuine kindness and enthusiasm made us feel like friends rather than guests.
We can’t recommend this gem highly enough!it’s a true haven for anyone seeking comfort and charm. If you’re planning a trip, book it without hesitation!
Everything Perfect! Location, decor, cleaness, no noise. We definetely loved it and I regret of not staying more days in Florence in this apartment!

We had a wonderful stay at this beautiful apartment in Florence! The location is unbeatable – just a short walk from the Duomo, yet tucked away in a peaceful street. The interiors are stunning, tastefully designed, and very well maintained. The apartment is spacious, with two comfortable bedrooms, three modern bathrooms, and a large, inviting hall perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring. Everything was clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described. Truly felt like a home away from home – we couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay in Florence! Will definitely come back

Filippo was very communicative and flexible which really helped us.
The apartment was centrally located and perfectly suited to rest and sleep between visiting the city.
Great spacious apartment located in the heart of the San Lorenzo area with access to the busy market and walking distance to all the sights. Both Filippo & Victoria communicated excellently.
Fabulous spacious apartment in great location with fantastic food hall and market across the street. Minor problem with shower head quickly resolved by host. Would highly recommend this apartment.
Thank you it was nice and a lot of space for 2 People. There was coffee and we had everything we needed. Would stay again.

The place exceeded the description in every way. I arrived slightly earlier than my check-in time, and the host was kind enough to allow me to drop off my bags.
The apartment was very clean, and the bed was incredibly comfortable. It's about a 20-minute walk to the city center, with easy access to the bus station and tram.

good staying, walkable distance from station. but in the noisy market place.
helpful owners.. however AC is not working properly.... somehow we managed.
overall okay. host is very much helpful
Superb place to stay in Florence! The location is great and you can tell that the owner paid so much attention to design and details. I wish there was more places like this! Highly recommended.

Very unique place hosted by amazing people! Located in a great neighborhood that's quiet but also well connected to major attractions. The place was clean and provided disposable towels and slippers which was a great comfort. When we had a small issue with the induction, the host had been very responsive and helpful. Thank you for the great stay!

I highly recommend you stay in Ciro's beautiful apartment. It was recently renovated, everything brand new, perfectly clean, all the newest appliances, nicely stocked kitchen, very comfortable bed, high quality linens. I enjoyed sitting on the sunny patio with a nice view.
Center of town is about 20-30min walk, or you can take a bus nearby. It's a nice, peaceful neighborhood, and I enjoyed the quiet of the residential building. It was a great place to stay, would happily stay here again.

Place was absolutely beautiful! It was very spacious & clean . It is located in a very quiet neighborhood so if you are looking for a more peaceful place this is perfect. You can still walk to city center to restaurants but it’s just a little farther walk . Really enjoyed the stay . It was too short wish we could’ve stayed longer
Sunning historical building in great area, hosts were very helpful and friendly, the apartment was beautifully decorated and extremely comfortable, beautiful view from the balcony

We really enjoy the stay here, it’s very spacious and newly renovated. The kitchen is well equipped and there is a huge terrace looks way nicer in real than the photo. Cristiano welcomed us with very detailed guidance and welcome drink, the place is around 10mins bus to the center of Florence, bus station is very close and very convenient, also can drive to the center, but the parking fee is quite expensive. Highly recommend.

Donatella place was everything we could ask for. It was spectacular in every way. The host deserves 10 stars for all the effort made to make our vacation wonderful. I highly recommend and plan on bringing my dad. We just left and miss it already.
We hope to see you again soon and thank you for your hospitality.
Rina

This apartment was absolutely beautiful, we felt right at home!
Walking distance to the old city, parking on premises, a very stylish and comfortable apartment with all amenities
Absolutely recommend ❤️
Beautiful, newly renovated and very spacious apartment in a quiet area about 20 min walking distance to city center. We loved it and would definitely book it again when in Florence next time.
The place is huge and really awesome with all the amenities. very near to the railway station and other public transport. Good host with excellent communication.
An amazing home in a great location! Hosts were quick to respond and very helpful. Home is huge and amenities were perfect. Will definitely stsy here again!

The place was amazing. We were 2 couples and the Appartment was really spacious. All amenities were available and clean. Air conditioning every room was helpful when the weather got hot. The garage was a plus the entrance is a bit tricky but manageable I saw a BMW X5 enter without trouble. Would definitely be on my list when I return to Florence
This place was amazing for our family!! Donatella is an amazing host and her place was so clean and spacious!! Even more than the pictures! We would definitely come back next time we are in Florence!

This is truly a hidden gem in Florence.
We went with our 2-month-old baby, and the walk to the town only took 20 minutes. This was perfect because it was nice and quiet—away from all the busy tourist areas.
The apartment is finished to such a high standard; the appliances, towels, flooring, bedding—everything—would give even the best 5-star hotels a run for their money!
It was easy to find, had very secure doors, and the host family provided lots of helpful recommendations.
This was truly a home away from home!
We will be coming back again and again, and we’ll be recommending it to all our friends.

We stayed at Elaine’s for two nights. The apartment was clean and bright and the location was very convenient, close to the centre, yet still in a rather quiet area. The host was really helpful and friendly.
This place was great for our stay in Florence. It was clean, modern, and located in a quiet neighbourhood close to all of the main attractions.

Excellent location, we walked to everywhere.
Good food options in the surroundings and Elaine was very responsive.
Thanks you!

Elaine and Brandon were extremely helpful and allowed us to drop our bags when we arrived and gave us an earlier check in. The place is quiet and very nice. Away from the crowds but still walkable to the main attractions.
It is exactly as described and seen on the pics. We were 4 adults that stay for 2 nights.

Everything in general was good! Edoardo was really responsive host. Appartment was nice and cozy. As good located in city, there is quite noise outside but the appartment has double protection / no sound for a good rest at night ☺️.  It was key to have air-conditioning. I’d say recomment putting  a carpet in the bathroom and specify there is no elevator in the buildint. Rest really good and location is EXCELLENT! Thanks so much Edoardo for having us!!!

Edoardo provided us perfect apartment and service.
He met us next to the building and showed how to enter our apartment. Everything was clean and stylish, apart from that Edoardo sent us guide and restaurants recommendations, which we used.
Thanks!

This stay was absolutely perfect!
Edoardo provided us with a lot of recommendations for places to visit and local food to try. He is a friendly and responsive host!
The apartment was exactly as it looked on the photos and it couldn’t be cleaner. The windows were soundproof, which was really calming. Also the view from the windows is really nice. Besides that, the apartment is in the centre, which made it possible to walk to all the best spots of Florence!
I would recommend this stay to everyone!

Generally good stay, location is great in the middle of the duomo area with lots to do and places to eat. Apartment had a very strong smell and my fiance and I both had bad dust allergies when inside. Overall it was clean and in a good spot with all the necessary amenities. Note you have to climb 4 flights of stairs to get to the apartment

Everything about this place was great.  Ideal location to walk to both attractions and to very good cafes, restaurants and shopping.  Details are all very nice and kitchen well equipped.  Highly recommend.
Nice place in a great location. Bathrooms were a bit small and bedding needed an additional blanket, but overall very enjoyable stay.

This place was fantastic! My husband and I stayed here for 2 nights and it was perfect. You honestly can’t beat the location as it was walkable to all major aspects of Florence. We loved that it was right on a street filled with shops and restaurants. It was also extremely helpful that the apartment was only a 5 minute walk from the train station. The apartment is exactly as described and the host was so friendly and greeted us upon check in. I would highly recommend staying here!
Had such a great stay here. It was quiet - which I was worried about at first since it’s on a main road. But no noise at all. Will absolutely stay here again!

The apartment is lovely, nestled in the artsy neighborhood of Santo Spirito. it is a short walk to the Duomo.The linens are luxurious and the beds are comfortable. We really enjoyed the private rooftop terrace. The apartment has beautiful windows that let in lots of light. The air conditioning was much appreciated on warm nights. Our host was  greeted by everyone in the neighborhood and is clearly a  beloved member of his community. He had great recommendations and was super helpful getting us transport to the train station when our taxi did not arrive. We loved Casa Sofia and will stay again the next time we are in Florence. Book this place, you will not regret it!

Perfect apartment for our stay in Florence! Iacopo and Elena were helpful from checking in (helped carry bags up stairs), to finding a parking garage, to offering a discount at their bar for afternoon drinks. Santo Spirito proved to be the perfect Florence location - lots of great restaurants and stores in walking distance whilst not being in the typical tourist location.

We had an Amazon stay at Enrico’s place. He was extremely responsive, answered all questions and even recommended us some local spots that we tried out and loved.
Definitely would recommend and would come back if we’re ever in Florence again!

We loved our stay.
Location was great, nice and clean apartment and the communication was perfect.
We visited in the hotter months and the AC has been the best we have experienced so far.
Definitely rebooking on our next trip to Florence. Thank you Enrico.
Great location and lovely apartment! Enrico was very helpful with great local recommendations! Would definitely book again.

Although going up through the stairs with a heavy suitcase can be tricky nonetheless,
this place was FANTASTIC! I loved how clean and modern it was. There were two toilets 🚽 and two bathrooms. Yes, there’s no washing machine, but the place is so relaxing and fully equipped with everything you need. The bed was very clean, and the bedding is top-notch! Honestly, I should have booked this place for ten days because it was a great spot to stay in Florence, within walking distance to the high street. There’s a hotel just a minute away where you can unwind.
The host is very responsive and attentive. I really loved this place and would definitely want to stay here again when I’m back in Florence.
Large television with both Netflix and YouTube included and good resolution. The WiFi is strong, reaching 500mbps. Two bathrooms are both clean and large.
Really central locations and close to many of the local attractions! The nights can be a little noisy as it’s located in the city. Enjoyable time overall!

This is a beautiful place. We loved staying here. It was clean. It was very nice and modern. It was in a decent location close to most things. The only thing we disliked were the treacherously steep stairs, but that is to be expected with old homes in downtown Italian cities.  Overall this was a wonderful place to stay!

Enrico was great!  He was very responsive and informative. His place is close to many bars and restaurants. He provided great recommendations and was very flexible and helpful when we had some complications with our transportation to Florence.  I highly recommend staying here!

It was a pleasant stay at the apartment the host was very helpful whenever we ask for something he always replies the place is very clean and best of all the locations n of the application was excellent cause it’s near to every single tourist place and famous restaurants
Thank you Enrico for a great stay and thank you to your girlfriend. She gave my sister and I a recommended restaurant literally across the alley and it did not disappoint.

I had a wonderful stay at this Airbnb in Florence! The apartment was clean, comfortable, and perfectly located, just a short walk from many major attractions, shops, and restaurants. The host was responsive and helpful throughout the stay, making check-in and communication easy.
The only thing to note is that the apartment is on the third floor and the steps are quite steep, which can be a bit challenging with heavy luggage. But once you're in, it's absolutely worth it. Overall, a fantastic place to stay in Florence and I would happily come back!

The house was just perfect. Located close to every major point, we could easily walk to any place we wanted to visit
Other than that, the area around the house is beautiful and has tons of amazing restaurants
The house was clean, very nicely decorated, and the hosts were really nice and responsive
Great location - close to the train station and very walkable to many sites. Apartment was clean and just what we needed for a quick trip to Florence!
we had a good experience, the place was close to public transport, clean, and had many amenities. The cleaning lady is such a sweetheart! we highly recommend:)
We had a great stay at Liliana’s place! It was exactly as described. Spacious and clean room. Nice gelateria around the corner. Liliana was very flexible and always responded quickly.

Clean beautiful accommodation. Within walking distance of the tram that goes straight to the center. Nearby is a large grocery store. The apartment is clean and bright. It was very nice to stay in these apartments

Niccolo’s place is a great find! The photos don’t do it justice, it feels newly decorated, clean and modern with comfortable beds and a great size lounge and bathroom. The location is perfect for walking into the city centre (20/25mins) or easy bus and train access. There is a great Gelato shop a minute’s walk away that we would recommend! A CO-OP just across the bridge and a restaurant directly underneath. What more could you ask for!
Perfect place (very spacious and modern). We had an issue with the shower and the owner quickly responded and fixed it straight away. Very happy with this experience

We absolutely loved our stay here. Luisa, the co-host who chatted to us was so communicative, helpful and friendly. The flat was in an ideal location for us with so many great bars/cafes/restaurants around. It was also much more peaceful in Oltrarno than in the centre, though this was still super accessible and walkable. I would say that if you have a lot of bags or big bags, know that there are a lot of small, steep stairs.
Overall I’d really recommend staying here, we had the best time!

This home was perfect and right in the city center. Everything is walkable from the house and easily accessible. The stairs are a bit difficult with luggage but the location provided an amazing experience in florence!
Unbeatable location 2minutes away from the duomo and central to many sights and attractions.

We had an amazing time staying at this Airbnb in Florence! The location is truly unbeatable – just a few steps from the Duomo, allowing us to easily explore all the major attractions on foot.
The host was incredibly responsive, answering all our questions promptly and providing us with clear, detailed instructions for check-in. We felt well taken care of throughout the entire stay, and the communication was seamless. We definitely appreciated all the restaurant recommendations!
The apartment itself was cozy and had everything we needed. The washing/dryer machine was also super convenient.
Great location, nice bathroom, big bed, lift was spacious. The only thing was the aircon was loud.

it was outstanding, apartment is very nice and clean, location is perfect. Brixhildo is very careful and friendly with quick responce. we were very happy to choose this apartment and wish to come back ))
It was a great stay. The flat is tastefully rustic, but also refurbished to a very comfortable standard. The location is great and the team communication was responsive and helpful.

Nice big apartment in an excellent location. Easy check in and check out. However, the shower clogged immediately and flooded the bathroom floor every time we used the shower. The stove didn’t work and the glasses and mugs were placed in the living room and we couldn’t find it until the last day. There were also quite a few mosquitos inside despite us not opening any windows. In addition another rooms keys were placed in ours accidentally by management and they called at 12:30 at night to have us give it to them. Can definitely tell it was designed by a man. Nice place overall, but wouldn’t recommend.
The view of the gardens from the windows was beautiful. if you leave the windows open, the jasmine fills the rooms.

I highly recommend this place!
Simona, place was spotless and spacious, it’s a 10mins away from the SMN trains statio, by bus.
Simona and her team are very responsive and helpful!
Love to stay here again! ⭐ ♥️

Very nice stay at Simona's appartement!
Clean and secured, it is quiet which is nice after a day visiting the center or cities around.
Communication was easy, Simona had many recommendations and was arranging. I recommend !

A wonderful, modern, well-equipped apartment that was located well for
Restaurants and attractions. Just lovely

A good location, it’s a lively loud neighborhood but a quick walk to everything you could want to see in Florence. The home was very spacious and had comfortable beds. My family and I had a great stay!
They were very hospitable to us. When we wrote Hee, they were interested, they arranged a parking lot for our car, they were very sweet people. Thank you for everything.

Andrea was very helpful. We only stayed one night, but after a long international trip it was perfect for resting and recovering in a safe clean space. Plenty accommodating for the four of us
Grazie!
We had a great stay. I loved the location (despite it being quite loud during the night). I would come and stay here again.
We had a wonderful stay in the apartment. It was in a great location and had all the amenities that were listed.

Great place to stay at! Very central, the tram is really a 7 min walk directly to the main station Firenze SMN. We also walked back from there one day and it took around 30 mins. Washing machine, hot water, shower were all working great.
Roberta was very helpful and available, which we appreciated. Thank you!

Roberto and Aldo were lovely hosts. Always responsive if I had a question. Very nice and clean home and close to the tram/bus stop easy to go to wherever you need to go. I would definitely recommend staying here if your coming to Florence
Great place! Roberta was awesome and very responsive and kind. Right by the tram that will take you to train station and city center. Very clean and simple! I would recommend to anyone!

We had a great stay at Giulia’s place. She was very responsive and helpful, and was even able to accommodate our early check in and late check out. The apartment has gorgeous views from every window, and is in the ideal
location to walk around and explore Florence. We especially enjoyed the terraces with views over the city. Thank you for a great stay!

amazing place, very clean, had everything we needed and lots of space. walking distance to most of the sights. Donatella met us as soon as we arrived and even went over the map with us to suggested things to do and places to eat (Perseus has a great florentine steak). We wish we had planned more time in florence so we could stay at her place longer.

We were simply amazed at the beautiful, cozy apartment located just minutes from the old city.  We especially enjoyed our little haven patio where we had our morning coffee and evening glasses of wine.  Definitely coming back.  Thank you for making our stay perfect.
Fantastic apartment in a fab location to explore Florence, great comms and would highly recommend.  We will be back 👍👍

Great location in a quiet area and walkable to everything, city center, buses, train stations, and cafes. Nice to have air conditioning as it was hot when we were there and having a washing machine was bonus too. The host was great and responded quickly if we had a question. We would definitely recommend this location and stay again. Thank you!

We really loved our stay here. Giulia's been very helpful and everything was as we could hope for. Modern and clean with all the required necessities in an amazing location. Who would not like to be able. to shower whilst having a view of the Florence Duomo!

Excellent accommodation, that fulfilled our expectations! Beautiful environment full of charm and comfortable beds. Us five adults fit well in four rooms. Small minus was that the dishwasher smelled very bad when we arrived and had also some functional problems, that we solved ourselves. Otherwise everything was clean. Also the climb up the stairs to the highest floor was a feat after a day in town, even though we were prepared for it.

Camilla’s place was wonderful! She was so helpful and responsive. The location is perfect and the balcony was a huge plus! The place is small but perfect for 2. The elevator in the building was also a great perk. The bed was a bit firm. However overall we really enjoyed our stay! Would definitely recommend 😅

Great little apartment in a
Central location. Perfect for 2 people. Would definitely stay here again.
Easy check in and Camilla arranged for
Our bags to be drop off early before check in.
Thanks

Sophie was a great host, she brought us breakfast to our room in the morning and was super friendly and available for questions/tips. Alberto was very responsive and shared helpful instructions that made our check in process very smooth.
The place is super well located, 10-20 min walk to every attraction, with many stores and restaurants along the way. We loved our stay in Florence and a big part of that was this Airbnb :)

Thank you so much for having me Alberto. This was such a beautiful place to stay and right in the centre of Florence. His communication was great and very friendly, I’ll definitely be back in the future.

The place is lovely, clean and cosy and has a small but decent size and is located very nicely right next to many restaurants and small shops!
The host was very helpful and nice, and everything was overall very much to our liking!
The only three things that could improve the apartment would be a new shower cabin, because right now the solution of there being a weird combination of a door and a curtain that loves to cling on your body very much, and for there to be a big chopping board to put over the sink so you can actually prepare food properly with some workspace, and maybe a few dish cloths to have a chance to actually dry up the dishes.
It was our second time and we would love to come back!

Serena’s apartment was by far, the best Airbnb we’ve stayed have stayed in. It is recently renovated and the decor is modern and very attractive. As a host, Serena is very conscientious,  having thought of everything - little shampoos and body washes, coffee, tea, water bottles, a bottle of wine, etc. The beds are very comfortable.  The location is terrific - within walking distance to many sights and restaurants - yet quiet.  If you are coming to Florence, you do not need to search any further.  Highly recommended!

Serena was a wonderful host and was always very helpful and responsive our entire stay. The apartment was clean and spacious. The double beds were a little small for 2 people but I think that’s typical in Europe. The kitchen was well stocked with everything we needed. We stayed with our 1.5 year old daughter and were provided with a clean pack and play crib and high chair.

Great little apartment in the heart of town.
The host was super easy to communicate with and very responsive to any questions and made the stay lovely.
Great host, very flexible check in and check out times. Accommodated all of our requests.
We absolutely loved our stay at the J House.  Wonderful location and Luisa was a superb host.  Would highly recommend to anyone who is looking for a modern loft in an ideal location!

First the host was waiting outside for us which was really helpful be ause we wouldn't have been able to drive down the street the apartment was on.
Then they check half our party in while we tried navigating to the garage the host told us about. It was right around the apartment but because of Florences streets being so chaotic it took us a minute to drive to it. Then when we got their the host was waiting on us. Great customer service and they had a deal with the garage as well.
The place was really nice, right in the heart of historical Florence you can walk every where. Everything is just steps away. With this location no car or even users are needed. Right by tons of places to eat really good ones too and tons of shopping and both street vendors and high end stores.
They accommodate a late check out and it was just overall a great stay.

It was a pleasure to stay in Francesco’s place. From the warm and responsive communication to the beauty and care of details in the decoration and the quietness of the street that is connected very well to the center.
It’s not often that an air BnB is more than just a bed in city you’re visiting, but Francesco’s place really feels like a beautiful hang out, a warm home, or like a suite even, to wake up in peace and retreat in your own space in the evening. Absolute recommendation!

The apartment looks exactly like the photos—clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. It’s in a great location, quiet but close to everything you need. Communication with the host was excellent—always quick to respond and very helpful. Check-in was smooth and everything was well organized. I’d definitely stay here again!

gianluca was a perfect host, very precise and punctual, always ready for our every request. the location is excellent and very cool. the apartment is clearly renovated recently and has some really beautiful details such as the shelf with a view of the ponte vecchio.. really special.

We had a perfect stay in Saša’s apartment. The place is newly renovated, with all the furniture and equipment new and extremely clean. The beds are comfortable, the rooms are spacious and the air conditioning works well. The place is very conveniently located in a quiet area that is close to the city center so all places of interest can be reached by foot. Public transport is also easily accessible. There are lots of shops, restaurants, cafes and pharmacies nearby. The host is beyond praise - Saša helped us tremendously on a few occasions during our short stay and we were deeply thankful for that. A very kind, caring and responsive person - feels like visiting a good old friend. I definitely recommend for a trip to Florence.
Utterly stunning apartment , very comfortable, and in a great location. It was very difficult to leave!
Very nice Appartement, Cosimo was always easy to reach. The bed was super comfortable. Everything was perfect
We enjoyed our time at Cossimo’s place. It was close to public transportation, grocery store and we had a parking spot and AC. We highly reccomend Cosimo’s place.
A great place to stay in Florence. In a perfect spot very close to that train station, to the duomo and all the spots! Very clean and beautiful ideal for your Florence exploration.

The perfect start for our Italian Tour!
Gabriella was always there to message and was very polite as well.
The place it's self is stunning, easy to get to and was very clean! Walking distance from the Duomo and also the train station!
Could not recommend this place enough!
Thank you again Gabriella!

Home was exactly as described. Lovely and charming. Everything worked well. Very quiet. Very easy to get into the areas of Florence that we wanted to see by bus, tram or on foot. Responsive host. We loved it there!

The hosts were incredibly responsive and the apt is very large!  The bedroom is very dark and quiet.  If you use the living room couch pull out bed, expect noise early in the morning with the deliveries and workers.  We loved the location, the Santa Croce Bistecca and coffee shop located a few doors down were both great too. We would definitely stay here again.

Great space in a even better location. Highly recommend for 2-3 people who want to be close to the city center. The house was clean and the basic utilities were provided (towels, toilet paper, soap), which was nice! My only thing was that the AC unit was very loud at nights. Be sure to ask about it during check-in to avoid some cold nights. Other than that, great stay!

The location is absolutely great. It is in a busy area, so expect to hear people in the streets during the day and at night, but you are two steps from the duomo and close to everything great. Beds are comfy. The kitchen is functional but don't expect to cook anything complicated. We were there with two young kids and it worked very well. The place is a little bare but welcoming. Thanks!
Great place… its suck a workout to get to the apt because of the stairs but its definitely worth it
We were 2 adults and 3 kids. The apartment was just the right size. It’s in a nice neighborhood and close to the city center.

Really nice condo itself and amazing placement in the city. Very tight bathroom but still manageable.
Updated the hosts about our arrival time through the day because of issues out of my control and once we got there and tried contacting them no one responded. We stayed outside stuck for about an hour until another person staying in the building was kind enough to let us in after explaining the situation. Otherwise we were stuck outside for the night. I understand things happen, but it was avoidable.
Very responsive and helpful host group, beautiful location and immaculately clean! Would recommend to anyone staying in Florence.

Loved this spot. Felt spacious and like home after staying at some much smaller places in previous nights of our trip. Small additions like the nespresso, morning pastries, bottled water and toiletries were a lovely and welcoming touch. Central to so many things. Perfect stay for our visit!

Our stay at Tamás & Annalisa’s place was absolutely beautiful and exactly as the pictures showed. Also, close to everything!! Less than a 5 minute walk to the light rail which takes you to the main train station Santa Maria Novella and all the downtown attractions. Very clean and tidy! Would definitely stay here again if ever in Florence!

Beautiful place with all the amenities in a great walkable location. Amazing host and the team provided great restaurant recommendations. Had some issues with the washer/dryer unfortunately. But otherwise everything else was perfect.

This apartment is fantastic—spacious, comfortable, and perfect for a family or a group of friends! We loved the bedrooms, the extremely well-equipped kitchen, and the lovely living room area. Check-in was super flexible. We wish we could have stayed longer. Highly recommend! Thank you—we will definitely come back.
Excellent house, good location and good communication. We had some issues with the heating, but the hosts were quick to respond and fix the problem. Overall, no complaints
Nice place. Walkable distance from the city center. Monsef helped us with all the information we needed.
The apartment was lovely and clean. Had a great stay here! I’m familiar with the area so I had no problem with finding it. Smooth check in and was nice enough to let me check in early!
Monsef is super helpful, there was a problem with the electricity and he come within 20 mins to fix the problem. The place is nice and clean as well, highly recommended!

Great place to stay in Firenze, especially for a short period of time. The Airbnb is really well located, everything is within walking distance. We were 6 guests in total and it was a little bit cramped, but nothing too bad. The host(s) were all amazing, answering pretty quickly every single time.

Omri and Mika were wonderful communicators while I was staying for a short trip in Florence. Mika was particularly sweet in greeting me at the entrance and providing a detailed tour of the space. She also provided recommendations and overall was extremely kind. The apartment itself is perfect for one, or for a couple. The view was perfect despite the weather being very rainy, I was able to relax and get work done with a nice view. The apartment is located right in the center but due to it facing the river Arno its very very quiet. The perfect balance. There is a tiny kitchenette that was convenient for reheating some food and a small fridge space as well. Everything was modern, renovated, and most importantly clean. My only suggestion is to get softer pillows, but of course this is only my preference! 5/5 stars!
A beautiful place to stay. A lot to do near and the hosts were responsive and helpful with check in. Would stay here again.

This location was AMAZING!! My family and I couldn’t have been happier. The host was amazing and extremely responsive and really went out of his way to help us. The place was spotless when we got there and felt really clean! The beds were so comfortable (I feel like that isn’t always the case with airbnbs) so that was really appreciated. There was plenty of space and there was also an elevator so you didn’t have to haul your luggage up a bunch of stairs. Would absolutely stay here again!

Lorenzo and his team are very helpful and accommodating before and during our stay.  They are very responsive to our endless questions even though we are only staying for 2 nights. The apartment is spotless and comfortable. It was at the peak of the heatwave and all the bedrooms are with sufficient air conditioning. Living room is a bit warm even with air conditioning (but it was 38c outside).
I had a last minute booking at Giannis place and it did not disappoint. It was spacious and felt comforting. Whenever something was wrong Gianni was always quick to respond as well.

Very convenient and very clean. Master room and bath is very spacious. The small bathroom was tiny, can barely fit one person. Close to train station and attractions. No elevator, so getting luggage to the room was a bit hard, but host helped carrying. Appreciate that!

We had a great stay. The bathroom in the masterbedroom was spacious & luxury.
Everything was so 👍

My family of 5 loved staying here! Being my daughter and son in law and my son with me and my husband - having 3 bedrooms and 3 baths was so nice!! The location was great! You aren’t in the middle of the tourist but it is a short walk to many places. It is in between the 2 train stations and we walked to both. No more than 20 minutes. We walked everywhere that we went. Liana gave us some excellent recommendations for places to eat! And she and Massimiliano were very responsive and went up and beyond! If you are in Florence, I would highly recommend this place!  Thank you Liana and Massimiliano!

Camila was extremely helpful and hospitable. We arrived late because of some train issues and she was very accommodating. The apartment was clean and adorable and the area was close to bus stops to get to where you need to go. There was a great pizza place just down the road that we enjoyed for dinner the day we arrived as well as a few other resturants.
Overall, highly recommend!
Amazing stay at Camilla’s apartment. Communication was spot on. Apartment was clean, tidy and well organised. Balcony was a great bonus for the sunny weather.

Camilla’s place is beautiful, it’s clean, spacious and in an excellent location. Camilla provided everything we could need, including recommendations of things to do and see in the area. I absolutely recommend this apartment and would stay here again!

We had a great time in this house! It was exactly as described — very clean, fully equipped, and nicely decorated. The furniture was new, and the whole space felt fresh and welcoming. We especially enjoyed the cozy balcony.
The location was also very convenient, just about a 30-minute walk to the historical center of Florence.
Camilla and Lapo gave us a warm welcome when we arrived. They were in touch with us before and during our stay, always available and open to help with anything we needed.
Highly recommended!
incredible airbnb! it’s even bigger than the photos make it seem. had a wonderful time with our group

All perfect, small details like
a coffee machine
and kitchen towels
But really a fantastic place

The place is as advertised and suited our purpose however I feel the need to comment. We chose this place specifically for access to a roof top patio to relax on after a long day. The roof top patio needs a lot of attention. There are dead weeds, pots filled with dead flowers, rusty exercise bike and rusted weights laying around, tattered curtains, plastic greenery with rusted lights on them and very old furniture. The cushions are almost non existent in the couch and the chairs are white plastic, very uncomfortable. This could be a beautiful place to relax but it is not appealing at all.
The location is good to the attractions but you will hear traffic almost all night so bring ear plugs.

Very responsive and friendly host/manager. Room was quiet despite being in a central location. Very walkable.
Maintenance of air conditioning could be improved.

convenient location, 2 mins walk from the tram. only issue is that it looks slightly old, it has the old Italian home vibes. might not be for you if you're looking for something more modern and squeaky clean. no elevators so need to climb a flight of stairs. but really near the central. would suggest a renovation for the home.
Francesco was very helpful! A beautiful place tucked in a quiet part of Florence. Very easy to access the tram from the Apartment.

We loved staying here. There is an amazing gelateria in the next street and the apartment is a walkable distance from the city centre. The terrace was great for dinner and breakfast. The kitchen is well equipped. We would come back in a heartbeat.

Great location in the Spirito Santo area! Annalisa was super friendly and gave great restaurant recommendations. The place was exactly as advertised, very clean and well sized. Bathroom was very small however!
Had a fabulous stay in this quirky studio apartment. it's all i needed from an air bnb, in a great city!

Erika was the perfect host. Very communicative and even allowed us early entry to store our baggage while the apartment was being cleaned. Erika and her partner arranged to meet us in person to allow entry and offer advice about the local area and things to do in Florence. The location was perfect and only a short walk to the tram which took you into both the city centre and the airport. The apartment was newly renovated and exceptionally clean and very well resourced.Felt just like home. Would highly recommend if you want somewhere to stay within easy reach of all the historical sites in a much more peaceful setting than the busy city centre.

Our stay at the apartment Casa Vigna Nuova, in Florence was truly exceptional! The location couldn’t have been better—right in the heart of the city, with easy access to everything we needed during our stay. The apartment itself was spotless, comfortable, and had everything we could ask for. I had to work during my trip, and the fast and reliable Wi-Fi made it incredibly convenient to stay connected. Additionally, having access to a washing machine was a huge plus—it made traveling so much easier!
What truly stood out, though, was Jacqueline’s incredible hospitality. She went above and beyond to make us feel at home, sharing great tips about the area and making sure we felt secure and comfortable at all times. Her warmth and attention to detail really made this experience special.
We felt like locals in this charming neighborhood, and we loved it so much that we decided to extend our stay by two more days! Very lovely!
Jacqueline was very responsive and helpful! Very flexible with check out and made us feel right at home. Would recommend!

WOW! This was an amazing stay. The place is absolutely stunning and the decoration is beautiful. There is a total of 2 bedrooms, 2 BR + huge sofa and sofa bed on the terrace floor.
The host was very responsive when I was locked out in the middle of the night. Very helpful and friendly and made me feel very safe.
The location was in the middle of nearby attractions as well as great restaurants that the host recommended. I would definitely spend more money to stay here again.

There were a few hiccups that we not the fault of the host during our stay. The hot water went out as well as their washer. Although it made for a rough accommodation the place was absolutely adorable, the communication and responsiveness was amazing and Riccardo did everything he could to make up for the inconveniences. The location was perfect. Close to the Duomo and such cute restaurants but far enough away from the crowds as well. We would definitely come back.

The room was spacious and very clean, with great ventilation and airflow. There are cafés and restaurants nearby, and it’s very convenient to get to the Duomo and other attractions. At the same time, the area isn’t crowded at all — it’s quiet and peaceful.

The apartment is beautiful and has everything you need. The balcony is perfect for breakfast outside and to hang your laundry to dry. The kitchen was well stocked, the beds were comfortable and plenty of space for storage. The location is about a 20-25 minute walk to the center of Florence but it was nice to be away from the crowded streets and the walking felt good especially after lots of gelato and big Italian dinners :) would definitely stay here again in Florence! Grazi
We thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Gabriele’s property and would definitely stay again! Thank you for taking great care of us! 🌟
We had a short but lovely stay. Big apartment, spotless, good locations, great communication. I would not look further when we visit Florence again.  Thank you Gabriele & team
Elena and his husband is extremely wonderful people and very helpful. Place is wonderful to stay for long and short vacation. Highly recommended 👍👍👍
super good location, good amount of space, quiet area even though it's close to the main tourist areas

A beautiful appartment located 15 minutes by bus from the city center. It was very clean and well equipped. The communication was very good, the guy who received us was extremely kind, he explained everything to us and sent us links with restaurant and sights recommendations etc. When you come in the appartment you are surprised how beautiful it looks and then there is even more surprises - we even got a bottle of wine from Windows in Florence as a gift for my birthday. There was a slight issue with the key of the building that you need to put in the right position to ulock the door. Nevertheless, this is the best airbnb experience I had so far.

Wonderful place! Super responsive, kind and friendly communication. Tram stop (with massive supermarket) close by that takes you straight to the city centre. Truly a great place with everything you need to spend a great time in Florence, also very good to work remotely from.

Had such an amazing stay with my family. The hosts made us feel right at home, and were quick to respond, as well as super accommodating. Loved the home and the porch. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for an enjoyable stay in Florence that’s far enough away to be private but close enough to walk to all of the attractions.
nice place,our neighbours were noisy the first night could hear them talking from their room,but nice overall and 15 min walk to everything

Great apartment in a great location. Very walkable to all the main tourist attractions and central station. Great communication throughout and the host reached out to us everyday to ensure everything was OK. Would definitely recommend.
Close to the train station and the centro historico but far enough away so there was not a ton of noise.
Really good place clean and private with your own bathroom , very close to tram if you don’t want to walk and with a lot of bars and restaurants nearby, highly recommended the host Musa.

The place with lovely and had a great location. My only issue was that it was quite nosy above me due to the thin walls and I’m sure it was just that one person. They were very kind and the place was nice and clean I just struggled with sleep a little bit.

Such a beautiful place! ❤️ we had a amazing time at this apartment. One of the best ever. Super beautiful design, very spacious, spotless, the kitchen is very well equipped with everything one might need and the welcoming gift was very pleasant and unexpected. The location is also very convenient. Would absolutely come back again! 😍
This was a cosy place only 30 minutes walk from the train station. Lots of restaurants and cafes around, and close to several of the highlights of Florence.

It was a quick commute from the train station - about 20 mins on the bus. Annalisa (Leonardo’s mother) greeted us right when we arrived and gave us a brief tour of the house and where everything was. The apartment is a bit far from the central area so make sure to factor in a short commute to restaurants or other attractions. The hosts were always responsive and promptly answered our questions. Annalisa was very kind to us and made us feel right at home.

Close to the train station
Perfectly located with several restaurant
15 minute walk from basically all the main attractions.
Clean and accessible with a staff ready to accommodate.
You can’t go wrong, don’t hesitate, just book this place.

Stefania is the loveliest host and has the loveliest place. The accommodation was perfect for us- away from the bustle of the city but close enough to see it while being nestled in the beautiful Tuscan countryside. We couldn’t have asked for a better host than stefania - she went above and beyond for us and was super helpful, making the difficult logistics of travelling a lot easier. The pool was beautiful and felt private, the bed was comfy and the rest of the place was well equipped. Not a single negative from us. We look forward to coming back and playing a round of doubles at ping pong ;) Highly recommend Stefania’s place! X
It was a pleasure to be hosted in this room!!! Everything was super and the host is super too. There is nothing to complain about it’s a 10/10.

Great place to spend a holiday. You will find all you need. Very clean. Close to old town in 18 mn walking distance. There is also bus and tram station very close to the apartment. Aurora is an excellent host. Just friendly advise, it will be better to change the sofa bed.

A lovely apartment to stay within walking distance of all the sights.
The apartment is situated in a quiet neighbourhood ten mins by the T2 tram from the main train station (SMN) in Florence. There is a supermarket 5 minutes from the apartment if you require supplies. As well as various small shops like chemists and bookshops. Walking into the centre of town takes about 15 minutes. The hosts were very helpful and accommodating. Highly recommended.
Cutest little spot - should note though that it is a basement unit so very noisy. Had to sleep with noise canceling headphones on unfortunately.
Beautiful apartment, spotlessly clean. Great location just 1 minute from Uffizzi gallery and Museo Galileo and lots of restaurants nearby. We really enjoyed our stay!

Great experience booking with Marco in Firenze. The host gave clear and detailed instructions of how to access and find the location. The room was beautifully located 5 minutes from the center, we were able to walk to all locations easily. The room was clean and comfortable, electronics worked perfectly and room was decorated nicely. Loved the stay and when back in Firenze I will definitely book again!

Florence Stay
We had an amazing stay in Florence. The location was fantastic — very close to the historic center, yet peaceful enough to relax after a day of exploring the city. Everything from restaurants and cafés to the main attractions was within easy reach.
The host was wonderful: kind, attentive, and always quick to respond to any questions. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and communication was excellent throughout the stay.
The apartment itself was spotless, cozy, and well-equipped with everything we needed. It truly felt like a home away from home.
Overall, this was a perfect place to stay in Florence. I would absolutely recommend it to anyone visiting the city — great host, great location, and a very comfortable experience!

We had a fantastic stay at Lorenzo's unit. It's clean, beautifully decorated, and perfectly located—just a short walk from the train station and all the main attractions, including a restaurant with the one of the best steaks we've had in awhile.
Be prepared for a walk-up—it's four flights—but the charming apartment & rooftop view is a great reward!
We'll definitely rebook and highly recommend it!

Nice house, comfortable, central and clean. good price for what you get.
However we had an unpleasant experience with the host. we got stuck in traffic on our way to Florence for 5 hours; thus we missed the check in time slot. we communicated with the host repeatedly but they were not willing to change the check in time for us (even though the reason for the delay was not in our control). Therefore we had to book a second accommodation for the first night and payed double for it. We even asked for a cancellation/ refund but we got no response on this.
Make sure when you book to be in Florence couple of hours before check in time, otherwise you will lose your money.
Beautiful, neat and tidy place. But near train station, so some rooms are a bit noisy.
